e.en: The lambs began to {baa} as evening approached.
e.zh: 傍晚来临时,小羊开始咩咩地叫。

e.en: A loud {baa} echoed across the empty pasture.
e.zh: 空旷的牧场上回响着一声响亮的羊叫。

e.en: Ancient texts describe rituals dedicated to {Baal}.
e.zh: 古代文献记载了献给巴力神的仪式。

e.en: The prophets condemned worshippers of {Baal}.
e.zh: 先知们谴责崇拜巴力神的人。

baathist.t:
n. 阿拉伯复兴党党员
adj. 复兴党的

e.en: The {Baathist} regime ruled Iraq for several decades.
e.zh: 复兴党政权统治了伊拉克数十年。

e.en: He was once a senior {Baathist} official in Damascus.
e.zh: 他曾是大马士革一位高级复兴党官员。

bab.t: n. 巴孛（巴哈伊教创始人）

e.en: The {Bab} founded a religious movement in 19th-century Persia.
e.zh: 巴孛在十九世纪的波斯创立了一个宗教运动。

e.en: Followers of the {Bab} were persecuted by the authorities.
e.zh: 巴孛的追随者遭到当局迫害。

e.en: Grandma served warm rum {baba} for dessert.
e.zh: 奶奶端上了温热的朗姆芭芭蛋糕作甜点。

e.en: In many cultures, {baba} is an affectionate word for father.
e.zh: 在许多文化中,baba 是对父亲的亲切称呼。

babar.t: n. 巴巴尔（动画大象角色）

e.en: My daughter loves the storybook about {Babar} the elephant.
e.zh: 我女儿很喜欢那本关于大象巴巴的绘本。

e.en: The cartoon series follows {Babar} as he becomes king.
e.zh: 这部动画讲述巴巴成为国王的故事。

e.en: Critics called the manager a smug small-town {Babbitt}.
e.zh: 评论家说那位经理是个自满的小镇庸人。

e.en: Sinclair Lewis's novel {Babbitt} satirized middle-class conformity.
e.zh: 辛克莱·刘易斯的小说《巴比特》讽刺了中产阶级的盲从。

babble.t:
v. 含糊地说；喋喋不休
n. 嘈杂声

e.en: The toddlers {babble} happily in the playroom.
e.zh: 幼儿们在游戏室里开心地咿呀作响。

e.en: I couldn't focus over the {babble} of the crowded café.
e.zh: 咖啡馆里人声嘈杂,我没法专心。

babbled.t: v. babble 的过去式；叽叽喳喳地说

e.en: The stream {babbled} softly between the mossy stones.
e.zh: 小溪在长满青苔的石头间轻轻流淌作响。

e.en: She {babbled} excitedly about her trip to Tokyo.
e.zh: 她兴奋地讲述着东京之行,滔滔不绝。

babbler.t: n. 喋喋不休的人；话多的人

e.en: Don't tell him secrets — he's a known {babbler}.
e.zh: 别告诉他秘密,他可是个出了名的多嘴的人。

e.en: A small {babbler} bird hopped through the dense undergrowth.
e.zh: 一只小鹛鸟在茂密的灌丛中跳跃。

babbles.t: v. babble 的第三人称单数；喋喋不休

e.en: My baby {babbles} every morning when she wakes up.
e.zh: 我的宝宝每天早上醒来都会咿呀地说话。

e.en: A clear brook {babbles} just behind the cottage.
e.zh: 小屋后面有一条清澈的小溪潺潺流动。

babbling.t:
v. 含糊地说
adj. 胡言乱语的

e.en: The {babbling} brook ran through our campsite.
e.zh: 潺潺的小溪穿过我们的营地。

e.en: He kept {babbling} nervously during the job interview.
e.zh: 面试时他紧张得一直语无伦次地说个不停。

babby.t: n. 宝宝（baby 的方言/俚语）

e.en: In Liverpool slang, a {babby} is just a small child.
e.zh: 在利物浦俚语里,babby 就是指小孩子。

e.en: She cradled the {babby} gently in her arms.
e.zh: 她把小宝宝轻轻地抱在怀里。

e.en: "Hey {babe}, can you grab some milk on the way home?"
e.zh: “宝贝,回家路上能买点牛奶吗?”

e.en: The newborn {babe} slept peacefully in the crib.
e.zh: 新生的婴儿在婴儿床里安静地睡着。

e.en: The conference hall was a {babel} of competing languages.
e.zh: 会议大厅里各种语言混杂,一片喧嚣。

e.en: The story of the Tower of {Babel} appears in Genesis.
e.zh: 巴别塔的故事记载于《创世记》。

babesiosis.t: n. 巴贝虫病（蜱传疾病）

e.en: Tick bites can sometimes transmit {babesiosis} to humans.
e.zh: 蜱虫叮咬有时会将巴贝虫病传染给人类。

e.en: The dog was treated for {babesiosis} after a hiking trip.
e.zh: 那只狗远足后接受了巴贝虫病的治疗。

babies.t: n. baby 的复数；婴儿们

e.en: Newborn {babies} sleep up to sixteen hours a day.
e.zh: 新生婴儿一天能睡多达十六个小时。

e.en: Stop being so dramatic — don't act like {babies}.
e.zh: 别这么大惊小怪,别表现得像小孩子一样。

e.en: A large {baboon} stared at us from across the river.
e.zh: 一只大狒狒从河对岸盯着我们看。

e.en: The troop of {baboon} mothers groomed each other in the sun.
e.zh: 狒狒妈妈们在阳光下互相理毛。

babur.t: n. 巴布尔（莫卧儿帝国开国皇帝）

e.en: {Babur} founded the Mughal Empire in the early 1500s.
e.zh: 巴布尔在十六世纪初建立了莫卧儿帝国。

e.en: Historians still study {Babur}'s detailed memoirs.
e.zh: 史学家至今仍在研究巴布尔详尽的回忆录。

babushka.t: n. 三角头巾；俄罗斯老奶奶

e.en: My grandmother always wore a flowered {babushka} in winter.
e.zh: 我奶奶冬天总是戴着一条带花的头巾。

e.en: The {babushka} sold honey at the village market.
e.zh: 那位俄罗斯老奶奶在村集上卖蜂蜜。

baby.t:
n. 婴儿；宝贝
adj. 小型的

e.en: Their {baby} just learned to walk last week.
e.zh: 他们的宝宝上周刚学会走路。

e.en: Stop being such a {baby} about a tiny scratch.
e.zh: 别为这么点小划伤大惊小怪的。

baby-sitter.t: n. 代人临时照看小孩的人

e.en: We hired a {baby-sitter} so we could see a movie.
e.zh: 我们请了个保姆,这样就能去看场电影。

e.en: The neighborhood teen makes good money as a {baby-sitter}.
e.zh: 那个街区的青少年靠当保姆挣得不少。

babycham.t: n. 一种梨味起泡酒品牌

e.en: My aunt loved a glass of {Babycham} at Christmas.
e.zh: 我姑姑过圣诞时最爱喝一杯香槟梨酒。

e.en: The retro pub still serves {Babycham} in its tiny bottles.
e.zh: 那家复古酒吧仍然供应小瓶装的香槟梨酒。

babydoll.t: n. 娃娃装睡衣；娃娃式短裙

e.en: She wore a frilly pink {babydoll} dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿着一条粉色蓬蓬娃娃裙去参加派对。

e.en: The store sells silk {babydoll} nightgowns online.
e.zh: 这家店在网上销售丝质娃娃式睡裙。

e.en: She has photos of her son from {babyhood} to college.
e.zh: 她保存着儿子从婴儿期到大学的照片。

e.en: Memories from {babyhood} are notoriously hard to recall.
e.zh: 婴儿期的记忆是出了名地难以回想起来。

e.en: He thought the cartoon was too {babyish} for ten-year-olds.
e.zh: 他觉得那部动画对十岁孩子来说太幼稚了。

e.en: Her {babyish} pout always made her grandfather laugh.
e.zh: 她孩子气的撅嘴总让爷爷哈哈大笑。

e.en: Ancient {Babylon} was famous for its hanging gardens.
e.zh: 古巴比伦以其空中花园而闻名。

e.en: The ruins of {Babylon} lie in present-day Iraq.
e.zh: 巴比伦的遗址位于今天的伊拉克境内。

babylonian.t:
adj. 巴比伦的
n. 巴比伦人

e.en: Scholars deciphered the {Babylonian} clay tablets last century.
e.zh: 学者们在上个世纪破译了巴比伦泥板文书。

e.en: {Babylonian} astronomers tracked the planets with remarkable precision.
e.zh: 巴比伦天文学家以惊人的精度追踪行星运行。

babysat.t: v. babysit 的过去式；临时照看小孩

e.en: I {babysat} my niece every Friday last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天每个周五我都帮忙照看我侄女。

e.en: She {babysat} the twins while their parents traveled.
e.zh: 她父母外出旅行时由她照顾那对双胞胎。

e.en: Could you {babysit} the kids on Saturday night?
e.zh: 你周六晚上能帮忙照看一下孩子吗?

e.en: Teenagers often {babysit} to earn extra pocket money.
e.zh: 青少年常常通过照看小孩来赚零花钱。

babysits.t: v. babysit 的第三人称单数

e.en: Grandma {babysits} the twins every Tuesday afternoon.
e.zh: 奶奶每周二下午都会照看那对双胞胎。

e.en: She {babysits} for several families in the neighborhood.
e.zh: 她为社区里好几户家庭做临时保姆。

babysitter.t: n. 临时照看小孩的人

e.en: Our regular {babysitter} canceled at the last minute.
e.zh: 我们常用的那位保姆临时取消了。

e.en: The app helps parents find a trusted {babysitter} nearby.
e.zh: 这款应用帮助家长找到附近可靠的保姆。

e.en: Good {babysitters} are hard to find in our area.
e.zh: 在我们这一带很难找到好的保姆。

e.en: The agency screens all its {babysitters} carefully.
e.zh: 这家中介会仔细筛查所有保姆的背景。

e.en: She earns extra money {babysitting} on weekends.
e.zh: 她周末通过看孩子赚外快。

e.en: {Babysitting} three toddlers at once is exhausting.
e.zh: 同时照看三个幼儿真是累人。

bac.t: n. 血液酒精浓度（Blood Alcohol Content）

e.en: French students take the {bac} at the end of high school.
e.zh: 法国学生在高中毕业时参加 bac 会考。

e.en: The driver's {BAC} was well above the legal limit.
e.zh: 司机的血液酒精浓度远超法定限值。

bacardi.t: n. 百加得（朗姆酒品牌）

e.en: He ordered a {Bacardi} and Coke at the bar.
e.zh: 他在吧台点了一杯百加得加可乐。

e.en: The cocktail uses white {Bacardi} and fresh lime juice.
e.zh: 这款鸡尾酒用白百加得朗姆酒和新鲜青柠汁调制。

baccalaureate.t:
n. 学士学位
n. 毕业典礼布道

e.en: She earned her {baccalaureate} from a small liberal arts college.
e.zh: 她在一所小型文理学院获得了学士学位。

e.en: Many universities now accept the International {Baccalaureate} diploma.
e.zh: 许多大学现在都接受国际文凭(IB)证书。

baccarat.t: n. 百家乐（纸牌赌博游戏）

e.en: He lost a fortune playing {baccarat} in Macau.
e.zh: 他在澳门玩百家乐输了一大笔钱。

e.en: {Baccarat} is a popular card game in high-roller rooms.
e.zh: 百家乐是高额赌厅里很受欢迎的一种纸牌游戏。

bacchanal.t:
n. 狂欢宴饮
adj. 纵酒狂欢的

e.en: The wedding turned into a wild weekend {bacchanal}.
e.zh: 那场婚礼变成了一个疯狂的周末狂欢。

e.en: Renaissance painters often depicted scenes of a {bacchanal}.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的画家常描绘酒神狂欢的场景。

e.en: The fraternity party descended into noisy {bacchanalia}.
e.zh: 那场兄弟会派对演变成了喧闹的狂欢。

e.en: Ancient Roman {bacchanalia} were eventually banned by the senate.
e.zh: 古罗马的酒神狂欢节最终被元老院禁止。

e.en: The festival had a {bacchanalian} mood that lasted all night.
e.zh: 那场节庆通宵都洋溢着纵酒狂欢的气氛。

e.en: Critics called the new film a {bacchanalian} excess of style.
e.zh: 评论家说这部新片是风格上的纵欲式狂欢。

e.en: Statues of {Bacchus} often show him holding grapes and wine.
e.zh: 巴克斯的雕像常常手持葡萄和美酒。

e.en: In Roman myth, {Bacchus} is the god of wine and revelry.
e.zh: 在罗马神话中,巴克斯是酒和狂欢之神。

e.en: The old sailor packed his pipe with rolling {baccy}.
e.zh: 那位老水手往烟斗里塞了点卷烟丝。

e.en: He nipped to the corner shop for some {baccy}.
e.zh: 他溜去街角小店买点烟丝。

bach.t:
n. 巴赫（作曲家）
n. 小度假屋（新西兰）

e.en: She practiced a {Bach} prelude on the piano every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都在钢琴上练习一首巴赫前奏曲。

e.en: In New Zealand, a {bach} is a small holiday cottage.
e.zh: 在新西兰,bach 指的是简朴的度假小屋。

bachelor.t:
n. 单身男子
n. 学士（学位）

e.en: He stayed a {bachelor} until he turned forty.
e.zh: 他直到四十岁都还是单身汉。

e.en: She earned a {bachelor}'s degree in computer science.
e.zh: 她获得了计算机科学学士学位。

e.en: We threw a wild {bachelorette} party last weekend.
e.zh: 我们上周末办了一场疯狂的单身派对。

e.en: The {bachelorette} chose her favorite contestant on the show.
e.zh: 节目上的单身女主角选择了她最喜欢的选手。

bachelorhood.t: n. 单身状态；单身生活

e.en: He enjoyed his years of {bachelorhood} before settling down.
e.zh: 他在安定下来之前享受了多年的单身生活。

e.en: Many men dread leaving {bachelorhood} behind.
e.zh: 许多男人害怕告别单身汉的日子。

e.en: The lab identified harmful {bacilli} in the water sample.
e.zh: 实验室在水样中发现了有害的杆菌。

e.en: Tuberculosis is caused by rod-shaped {bacilli}.
e.zh: 结核病是由杆状细菌引起的。

e.en: Scientists isolated a new {bacillus} from the soil.
e.zh: 科学家从土壤中分离出一种新的杆菌。

e.en: Anthrax is caused by a dangerous {bacillus}.
e.zh: 炭疽病是由一种危险的杆菌引起的。

back.t:
adv. 向后；返回
n. 背部；后面

e.en: I'll be {back} in five minutes.
e.zh: 我五分钟后回来。

e.en: She hurt her {back} lifting the heavy box.
e.zh: 她抬重箱子时伤了背。

e.en: Sitting all day gave me a terrible {backache}.
e.zh: 整天坐着让我背痛得厉害。

e.en: A good mattress can prevent chronic {backache}.
e.zh: 一张好床垫能预防慢性背痛。

e.en: Frequent {backaches} are common among office workers.
e.zh: 频繁的背痛在办公室工作者中很常见。

e.en: Yoga has helped reduce my {backaches} a lot.
e.zh: 瑜伽大大减轻了我的背痛。

backbeat.t: n. 反拍节奏（音乐重拍）

e.en: The drummer kept a steady {backbeat} throughout the song.
e.zh: 鼓手在整首歌中保持稳定的反拍节奏。

e.en: Rock music depends heavily on a strong {backbeat}.
e.zh: 摇滚乐非常依赖强劲的反拍。

backbench.t: n. 后座议员席（英国议会）

e.en: He spent years on the {backbench} before getting promoted.
e.zh: 他在后座议员席上待了多年才得到晋升。

e.en: The {backbench} grew restless during the long debate.
e.zh: 在漫长的辩论中,后座议员们变得焦躁不安。

e.en: The {backbencher} surprised everyone with a powerful speech.
e.zh: 那位后座议员发表了一场有力的演讲,令所有人惊讶。

e.en: As a junior {backbencher}, she had little influence.
e.zh: 作为一名初级后座议员,她几乎没有影响力。

backbit.t: v. backbite 的过去式；背后诋毁

e.en: She {backbit} her colleagues whenever they left the room.
e.zh: 同事一离开房间,她就在背后说他们坏话。

e.en: He felt betrayed when his friend {backbit} him publicly.
e.zh: 当朋友在公开场合背后说他坏话时,他感到被背叛了。

backbiting.t:
n. 背后说人坏话
v. 诋毁

e.en: Office {backbiting} ruins team morale very quickly.
e.zh: 办公室里的背后中伤会很快毁掉团队士气。

e.en: I'm tired of all the {backbiting} in this group.
e.zh: 我厌倦了这个团体里那么多的背后中伤。

e.en: The basketball bounced off the {backboard} and through the hoop.
e.zh: 篮球弹到篮板上又穿过篮筐。

e.en: Paramedics secured the patient to a {backboard}.
e.zh: 急救人员将病人固定在脊椎板上。

backbone.t:
n. 脊柱；骨干
n. 骨气；支柱

e.en: Small businesses are the {backbone} of the local economy.
e.zh: 小企业是当地经济的支柱。

e.en: It takes real {backbone} to admit you were wrong.
e.zh: 承认自己错了需要真正的勇气。

backburner.t: n. 次要位置；暂缓处理的事

e.en: We've put the redesign on the {backburner} until next quarter.
e.zh: 我们把重新设计的事推迟到下个季度。

e.en: That project has been on the {backburner} for months.
e.zh: 那个项目已经被搁置好几个月了。

e.en: The teacher won't tolerate any {backchat} in class.
e.zh: 老师不允许课堂上有任何顶嘴。

e.en: His constant {backchat} got him sent to the principal.
e.zh: 他不停顶嘴,结果被送到了校长那里。

e.en: The painted {backcloth} showed a starry night sky.
e.zh: 画好的舞台背景幕布上是一片繁星点点的夜空。

e.en: War formed the {backcloth} for the entire novel.
e.zh: 战争构成了整部小说的背景。

e.en: They went hiking in the {backcountry} for a week.
e.zh: 他们去偏远山野里徒步了一周。

e.en: Avalanches are a real danger in the {backcountry}.
e.zh: 在偏远荒野地区,雪崩是个真实的威胁。

e.en: The point guard controlled play from the {backcourt}.
e.zh: 控球后卫在后场掌控比赛。

e.en: Her opponent kept her pinned to the {backcourt}.
e.zh: 对手把她死死压制在后场。

backdate.t: v. 回溯生效；倒填日期

e.en: The company tried to {backdate} the contract illegally.
e.zh: 公司试图非法将合同日期倒签。

e.en: Please {backdate} the invoice to last Friday.
e.zh: 请把发票日期倒填到上周五。

e.en: The executive was fined for {backdating} stock options.
e.zh: 那位高管因倒签股票期权日期被罚款。

e.en: {Backdating} documents can lead to serious legal trouble.
e.zh: 倒签文件日期可能引发严重的法律问题。

backdoor.t:
n. 后门（程序漏洞）
adj. 秘密的

e.en: Hackers exploited a {backdoor} in the software.
e.zh: 黑客利用了软件中的一个后门。

e.en: He got the job through a {backdoor} connection.
e.zh: 他通过走后门关系拿到了那份工作。

e.en: The mountains made a stunning {backdrop} for the wedding.
e.zh: 群山为婚礼提供了令人惊叹的背景。

e.en: The film unfolds against the {backdrop} of war.
e.zh: 这部电影在战争的背景下展开。

e.en: The studio uses different {backdrops} for each photo shoot.
e.zh: 工作室为每次拍摄使用不同的背景布。

e.en: Tropical beaches make beautiful {backdrops} for videos.
e.zh: 热带海滩是非常漂亮的视频背景。

backed.t:
adj. 有支持的；有背衬的
v. back 的过去式

e.en: Several investors {backed} her startup from day one.
e.zh: 几位投资者从一开始就支持她的创业公司。

e.en: He carefully {backed} the car out of the garage.
e.zh: 他小心地把车倒出车库。

e.en: The film found a wealthy {backer} at the last minute.
e.zh: 这部电影在最后关头找到了一位富有的资助人。

e.en: Every Kickstarter {backer} received a thank-you email.
e.zh: 每位Kickstarter支持者都收到了一封感谢邮件。

backfield.t: n. (橄榄球) 后卫区/后卫球员

e.en: The quarterback lined up deep in the {backfield}.
e.zh: 四分卫在后场深处站位。

e.en: Their {backfield} produced over a thousand rushing yards.
e.zh: 他们的后场球员跑出了超过一千码的推进距离。

backfill.t:
v. 回填；补缺
n. 回填物

e.en: Workers will {backfill} the trench tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 工人明天早上会回填这条沟。

e.en: We need to {backfill} her role after she resigns.
e.zh: 她辞职后我们需要补上她的职位。

backfire.t:
v. 事与愿违；回火
n. 回火

e.en: His clever plan started to {backfire} almost immediately.
e.zh: 他的聪明计划几乎立刻就适得其反。

e.en: Aggressive marketing can sometimes {backfire} on a brand.
e.zh: 激进的营销有时会让品牌反受其害。

backflip.t:
n. 后空翻
v. 态度大转弯

e.en: The gymnast landed a perfect {backflip} on the beam.
e.zh: 那位体操运动员在平衡木上完美地做了一个后空翻。

e.en: The politician did a {backflip} on his climate promises.
e.zh: 那位政客在气候承诺上来了个一百八十度大转弯。

e.en: The valve prevents {backflow} of contaminated water.
e.zh: 该阀门可防止受污染的水回流。

e.en: Plumbers installed a {backflow} preventer under the sink.
e.zh: 水管工在水槽下安装了防回流装置。

e.en: My grandfather taught me how to play {backgammon}.
e.zh: 我祖父教我玩双陆棋。

e.en: They played {backgammon} every evening after dinner.
e.zh: 他们每晚饭后都下双陆棋。

background.t:
n. 背景；后台
n. 经历；出身

e.en: Tell me a little about your educational {background}.
e.zh: 跟我说说你的教育背景吧。

e.en: Music played softly in the {background} during dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时背景里轻轻播放着音乐。

e.en: The reporter wrote a {backgrounder} on the new policy.
e.zh: 那位记者写了一篇关于新政策的背景介绍文章。

e.en: She read a quick {backgrounder} before the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议前快速读了一份背景资料。

e.en: Our team members come from many different {backgrounds}.
e.zh: 我们团队成员来自许多不同的背景。

e.en: You can change Zoom {backgrounds} during a call.
e.zh: 你可以在通话中更换Zoom背景。

backhand.t:
n. 反手击球
adj. 反手的

e.en: Her {backhand} is the strongest part of her game.
e.zh: 反手击球是她比赛中最强的环节。

e.en: He returned the shot with a powerful {backhand}.
e.zh: 他用一记强力反手把球回了过去。

e.en: That sounded like a {backhanded} compliment to me.
e.zh: 那对我来说听起来像是拐弯抹角的恭维。

e.en: She gave him a {backhanded} apology that fooled no one.
e.zh: 她给了他一个谁也骗不了的虚伪道歉。

e.en: The official was caught taking a {backhander} from contractors.
e.zh: 那名官员被发现收受承包商的贿赂。

e.en: He delivered a sharp {backhander} across the court.
e.zh: 他在球场上打出了一记犀利的反手球。

e.en: The {backhoe} dug a deep trench for the pipes.
e.zh: 反铲挖掘机为管道挖了一条深沟。

e.en: Operators must be certified to drive a {backhoe}.
e.zh: 操作员必须持证才能驾驶反铲挖掘机。

e.en: The proposal has strong {backing} from senior management.
e.zh: 该提案得到了高层管理人员的大力支持。

e.en: She sang with a full band {backing} her up.
e.zh: 她在一支完整乐队的伴奏下演唱。

e.en: The frames come with sturdy cardboard {backings}.
e.zh: 这些相框配有坚固的纸板背板。

e.en: Different rugs use different fabric {backings}.
e.zh: 不同的地毯使用不同的织物底衬。

backland.t: n. 内陆地区；偏远土地

e.en: The farm's {backland} hasn't been cultivated in years.
e.zh: 这农场的后方土地已经多年没有耕种了。

e.en: Developers eyed the empty {backland} behind the highway.
e.zh: 开发商盯上了高速公路后面那片空地。

e.en: The new pricing caused a huge {backlash} on social media.
e.zh: 新定价在社交媒体上引发了巨大的反对声浪。

e.en: Politicians worry about {backlash} from angry voters.
e.zh: 政客们担心愤怒选民的强烈反弹。

e.en: She wore a stunning {backless} dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿了一件惊艳的露背裙参加晚宴。

e.en: The {backless} stools tucked neatly under the counter.
e.zh: 那些没有靠背的凳子整齐地塞在柜台下面。

backlight.t:
n. 背光
v. 从背后打光

e.en: You can adjust the keyboard {backlight} in settings.
e.zh: 你可以在设置中调整键盘背光。

e.en: The phone's {backlight} dims automatically at night.
e.zh: 手机的背光会在夜晚自动变暗。

e.en: Soft {backlighting} made the portrait look professional.
e.zh: 柔和的逆光让这张人像照片看起来很专业。

e.en: The screen's {backlighting} drains battery quickly.
e.zh: 屏幕的背光会很快耗尽电池。

e.en: The {backlit} keyboard makes typing easier in dark rooms.
e.zh: 带背光的键盘让暗处打字更轻松。

e.en: Her silhouette looked dramatic, {backlit} by the sunset.
e.zh: 她的剪影在夕阳逆光下显得很有戏剧感。

backlog.t: n. 积压的工作；待办事项

e.en: The team worked overtime to clear the {backlog}.
e.zh: 团队加班加点处理积压的工作。

e.en: My reading {backlog} keeps growing every week.
e.zh: 我待读的书每周都在增加。

backlogged.t: adj. 积压的；未处理完的

e.en: Customer service has been heavily {backlogged} since the launch.
e.zh: 自产品发布以来,客服一直严重积压。

e.en: The court system is {backlogged} with thousands of cases.
e.zh: 法院系统积压了数千个案件。

backpack.t:
n. 双肩背包
v. 背包旅行

e.en: She packed her laptop into her {backpack} before class.
e.zh: 上课前她把笔记本装进了背包。

e.en: We {backpack} through Europe every summer.
e.zh: 我们每年夏天都在欧洲背包旅行。

backpacker.t: n. 背包客；背包旅行者

e.en: The hostel was full of young {backpacker} guests from Asia.
e.zh: 青年旅社里住满了来自亚洲的年轻背包客。

e.en: Every {backpacker} should carry a basic first-aid kit.
e.zh: 每个背包客都应该随身带个基本急救包。

e.en: Cheap hostels in Bangkok are popular with {backpackers}.
e.zh: 曼谷的廉价旅馆深受背包客欢迎。

e.en: A group of {backpackers} hiked along the mountain trail.
e.zh: 一群背包客沿着山路徒步前行。

e.en: They went {backpacking} across New Zealand for three months.
e.zh: 他们用三个月时间背包游遍了新西兰。

e.en: {Backpacking} taught me how to travel on a tight budget.
e.zh: 背包旅行教会了我如何省钱出行。

backpackings.t: n. 背包旅行（复数，罕用）

e.en: Her {backpackings} across Asia filled an entire photo album.
e.zh: 她在亚洲的多次背包旅行装满了整本相册。

e.en: The blog documented his many {backpackings} through South America.
e.zh: 这个博客记录了他在南美的多次背包旅行。

e.en: All the kids wore matching blue {backpacks} to school.
e.zh: 孩子们都背着同款的蓝色书包去上学。

e.en: She {backpacks} around Asia whenever she has vacation time.
e.zh: 她一有假期就去亚洲背包旅行。

e.en: The chair has an adjustable {backrest} for better posture.
e.zh: 这把椅子的靠背可调,有助于保持良好坐姿。

e.en: He leaned against the soft {backrest} and closed his eyes.
e.zh: 他靠在柔软的靠背上闭上了眼睛。

backroom.t:
n. 密室；幕后
adj. 幕后的

e.en: The deal was made in a smoky {backroom} after midnight.
e.zh: 那笔交易是午夜过后在烟雾缭绕的密室里谈成的。

e.en: Critics accused the party of {backroom} politics.
e.zh: 批评者指责该党搞幕后政治交易。

backs.t:
n. 背部（复数）
v. 支持（第三人称）

e.en: The coach {backs} his players even after a tough loss.
e.zh: 即使惨败,教练也力挺自己的球员。

e.en: Long hours at the desk hurt their {backs}.
e.zh: 长时间伏案工作伤了他们的腰背。

e.en: He used a {backsaw} to cut precise joints in the wood.
e.zh: 他用背锯在木头上切出精准的接缝。

e.en: A sharp {backsaw} is essential for fine carpentry work.
e.zh: 精细木工活离不开一把锋利的背锯。

e.en: The radar detected signals {backscattered} from the storm clouds.
e.zh: 雷达探测到了从风暴云团反向散射回来的信号。

e.en: {Backscattered} electrons reveal the surface details of the sample.
e.zh: 背散射电子能揭示样品的表面细节。

e.en: The kids fell asleep in the {backseat} during the drive home.
e.zh: 回家路上孩子们在后座睡着了。

e.en: She refused to take a {backseat} role on the project.
e.zh: 她拒绝在这个项目里只当个配角。

e.en: Measure the door's {backset} before buying a new lock.
e.zh: 买新锁之前先量一下门锁的后退距离。

e.en: The standard {backset} for residential doors is 60 millimeters.
e.zh: 住宅门锁的标准后退距离是60毫米。

e.en: He slipped on the ice and landed on his {backside}.
e.zh: 他在冰上滑倒,屁股着地。

e.en: The label is printed on the {backside} of the package.
e.zh: 标签印在包装盒的背面。

e.en: Don't {backslide} into old habits after finishing the program.
e.zh: 完成训练后别再回到从前的坏习惯。

e.en: Many dieters {backslide} within the first three months.
e.zh: 许多节食者在头三个月内就会故态复萌。

e.en: After two clean years, he started {backsliding} into drinking.
e.zh: 戒酒两年后,他又开始故态复萌喝起酒来。

e.en: The teacher warned against {backsliding} on grammar rules.
e.zh: 老师告诫大家不要在语法规则上倒退。

backspace.t:
n. 退格键
v. 按退格键

e.en: Press {backspace} to delete the last character you typed.
e.zh: 按退格键即可删除最后输入的字符。

e.en: She kept hitting {backspace} to fix her typos.
e.zh: 她不停地按退格键来纠正打错的字。

e.en: He hit the ball with heavy {backspin} to slow it down.
e.zh: 他给球加了很强的下旋,让球慢下来。

e.en: A good {backspin} makes the golf ball stop on the green.
e.zh: 漂亮的下旋能让高尔夫球停在果岭上。

e.en: They installed a marble {backsplash} behind the kitchen sink.
e.zh: 他们在厨房水槽后面装了大理石防溅板。

e.en: A tile {backsplash} keeps the wall clean while cooking.
e.zh: 瓷砖防溅板能在烹饪时保持墙面整洁。

backstage.t:
n. 后台
adv. 在后台；幕后

e.en: Reporters were allowed {backstage} after the concert ended.
e.zh: 演唱会结束后,记者获准进入后台。

e.en: She works {backstage} as a costume designer.
e.zh: 她在后台担任服装设计师。

e.en: The senator was accused of {backstair} dealings with lobbyists.
e.zh: 这位参议员被指控与游说者进行私下交易。

e.en: They reached the kitchen by a narrow {backstair} passage.
e.zh: 他们从一条狭窄的后楼梯通道走到厨房。

backstairs.t:
adj. 暗中进行的
n. 后楼梯

e.en: The servants used the {backstairs} to move between floors.
e.zh: 仆人们走后楼梯在各楼层之间走动。

e.en: His promotion came through {backstairs} influence, not merit.
e.zh: 他的升职靠的是暗中走门路,而非实力。

backstop.t:
n. 后挡网；后盾
v. 支援

e.en: The fence behind home plate serves as the {backstop}.
e.zh: 本垒板后面的护栏起着挡球网的作用。

e.en: Government insurance acts as a {backstop} for failing banks.
e.zh: 政府保险为濒临倒闭的银行提供后盾。

e.en: The villain's tragic {backstory} made him strangely sympathetic.
e.zh: 反派那段悲惨的背景故事让人对他生出几分同情。

e.en: Every great character needs a believable {backstory}.
e.zh: 每个出色的人物都需要一个可信的背景故事。

backstreet.t:
n. 小巷
adj. 秘密的

e.en: We found a tiny {backstreet} cafe with amazing coffee.
e.zh: 我们在一条小巷里发现了一家咖啡超棒的小店。

e.en: The taxi took a quiet {backstreet} to avoid the traffic.
e.zh: 出租车走了一条安静的小巷以避开拥堵。

e.en: The leading horse pulled ahead on the {backstretch}.
e.zh: 领先的赛马在远端直道上拉开了距离。

e.en: He sprinted hard down the {backstretch} of the track.
e.zh: 他在跑道的远端直道上奋力冲刺。

e.en: She won gold in the 100-meter {backstroke} final.
e.zh: 她在100米仰泳决赛中夺得金牌。

e.en: Learning the {backstroke} requires good body balance in water.
e.zh: 学仰泳需要在水中保持良好的身体平衡。

e.en: His {backswing} was too fast, throwing off the entire shot.
e.zh: 他的后挥杆太快,导致整个挥杆动作都走样了。

e.en: A smooth {backswing} is the key to a powerful drive.
e.zh: 流畅的后挥杆是有力开球的关键。

e.en: The teacher won't tolerate any {backtalk} from her students.
e.zh: 这位老师不会容忍学生顶嘴。

e.en: He got grounded for {backtalk} to his mother.
e.zh: 他因为顶撞母亲被禁足了。

e.en: We had to {backtrack} two miles when the trail ended.
e.zh: 小路走到尽头时,我们只好原路返回两英里。

e.en: The senator tried to {backtrack} on his earlier statement.
e.zh: 那位参议员试图收回他之前说过的话。

e.en: The algorithm solves the puzzle by systematically {backtracking}.
e.zh: 该算法通过系统性回溯来解开谜题。

e.en: He kept {backtracking} on his promises to the team.
e.zh: 他不断推翻自己对团队许下的承诺。

backup.t:
n. 备份；后援
adj. 备用的

e.en: Always keep a {backup} of your important files.
e.zh: 重要文件一定要备份。

e.en: The officer called for {backup} before entering the building.
e.zh: 警官在进入大楼前请求了支援。

e.en: The system performs automatic {backups} every night at midnight.
e.zh: 系统每晚午夜自动进行备份。

e.en: Cloud {backups} saved her thesis after the laptop crashed.
e.zh: 笔记本崩溃后,云端备份救了她的论文。

backward.t:
adj. 向后的；落后的
adv. 向后

e.en: She took a {backward} step to get a better view.
e.zh: 她向后退了一步,以便看得更清楚。

e.en: The rural region remains {backward} compared to nearby cities.
e.zh: 与周边城市相比,这个农村地区仍然落后。

e.en: The reformers blamed corruption for the country's {backwardness}.
e.zh: 改革者把国家的落后归咎于腐败。

e.en: Education programs aim to overcome economic {backwardness} in rural areas.
e.zh: 教育项目旨在改变农村地区的经济落后状况。

e.en: He can recite the alphabet {backwards} in five seconds.
e.zh: 他能在五秒内倒背字母表。

e.en: She glanced {backwards} to make sure no one was following.
e.zh: 她回头看了一眼,确认没人跟着。

e.en: Don't drink that — there's {backwash} in the bottle.
e.zh: 别喝那个,瓶子里有回流的口水。

e.en: The {backwash} from the boat rocked the kayak violently.
e.zh: 船尾激起的回流把皮划艇晃得厉害。

e.en: The town was a sleepy {backwater} until tourists discovered it.
e.zh: 这小镇曾是个冷清偏僻的地方,直到被游客发现。

e.en: They paddled into a quiet {backwater} to fish.
e.zh: 他们划船进入一处安静的回水区钓鱼。

backwood.t: n. 偏远林区；荒僻地带

e.en: He grew up in a {backwood} cabin with no electricity.
e.zh: 他在偏僻林区一座没有通电的小木屋里长大。

e.en: The old {backwood} road was barely visible under the leaves.
e.zh: 那条偏僻林区的老路几乎被落叶盖住,看不太清。

e.en: The kids built a treehouse in the {backyard}.
e.zh: 孩子们在后院搭了一间树屋。

e.en: We're hosting a barbecue in our {backyard} this weekend.
e.zh: 我们这个周末要在后院办烧烤聚会。

e.en: Suburban {backyards} often feature pools and barbecue grills.
e.zh: 郊区的后院里常常有泳池和烧烤架。

e.en: Many families keep chickens in their {backyards} now.
e.zh: 现在很多家庭在自家后院养鸡。

e.en: He fried some {bacon} and eggs for breakfast.
e.zh: 他煎了些培根和鸡蛋当早餐。

e.en: The smell of crispy {bacon} filled the kitchen.
e.zh: 酥脆培根的香味弥漫了整个厨房。

baconian.t:
adj. 培根（哲学）的
n. 培根学派信徒

e.en: Modern science still relies on the {Baconian} method of observation.
e.zh: 现代科学仍然依靠培根式的观察方法。

e.en: The professor defended a {Baconian} approach to gathering evidence.
e.zh: 教授支持用培根式的方法来收集证据。

e.en: The blood test confirmed the patient had {bacteremia}.
e.zh: 血液检测证实患者出现了菌血症。

e.en: Untreated {bacteremia} can quickly progress to sepsis.
e.zh: 菌血症若不治疗,可能迅速发展为败血症。

e.en: Antibiotics kill harmful {bacteria} in the body.
e.zh: 抗生素能杀死体内的有害细菌。

e.en: Some {bacteria} in yogurt are good for digestion.
e.zh: 酸奶里的一些细菌有助于消化。

bacterial.t: adj. 细菌的；由细菌引起的

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her with a {bacterial} infection.
e.zh: 医生诊断她患了细菌感染。

e.en: This soap is effective against most {bacterial} growth.
e.zh: 这种肥皂能有效抑制大多数细菌生长。

e.en: This cleaner has strong {bactericidal} properties for hospital use.
e.zh: 这种清洁剂具有很强的杀菌性能,适合医院使用。

e.en: Penicillin is a {bactericidal} antibiotic, not just bacteriostatic.
e.zh: 青霉素是一种杀菌抗生素,不仅仅是抑菌剂。

e.en: The lab ran a {bacteriologic} analysis of the water sample.
e.zh: 实验室对水样做了细菌学分析。

e.en: {Bacteriologic} testing confirmed the source of the outbreak.
e.zh: 细菌学检测确认了此次疫情的源头。

e.en: Health officials ordered {bacteriological} tests on the city's water supply.
e.zh: 卫生官员下令对该市的供水进行细菌学检测。

e.en: The hospital follows strict {bacteriological} safety protocols.
e.zh: 医院遵循严格的细菌学安全规程。

e.en: The {bacteriologist} examined the cultures under a microscope.
e.zh: 细菌学家在显微镜下检查这些培养物。

e.en: She trained as a {bacteriologist} before joining the research lab.
e.zh: 她在加入研究室之前接受过细菌学家的专业训练。

e.en: She studies {bacteriology} at a top medical research university.
e.zh: 她在一所顶尖医学研究大学学习细菌学。

e.en: Modern {bacteriology} helps doctors fight antibiotic-resistant infections.
e.zh: 现代细菌学帮助医生对抗抗药性感染。

e.en: Scientists use a {bacteriophage} to kill harmful bacteria in patients.
e.zh: 科学家用噬菌体杀死患者体内的有害细菌。

e.en: Each {bacteriophage} infects only one specific type of bacterium.
e.zh: 每种噬菌体只感染一种特定的细菌。

e.en: This {bacterium} causes severe food poisoning if undercooked.
e.zh: 这种细菌在食物未煮熟时会引起严重食物中毒。

e.en: A single {bacterium} can multiply into millions overnight.
e.zh: 一个细菌一夜之间能繁殖成数百万个。

bactrian.t:
n. 双峰驼
adj. 巴克特里亚的

e.en: The {bactrian} camel has two humps and thick winter fur.
e.zh: 双峰驼有两个驼峰和厚厚的冬毛。

e.en: We saw a {bactrian} camel crossing the Mongolian desert.
e.zh: 我们看到一头双峰驼穿越蒙古沙漠。

bad.t:
adj. 糟糕的；坏的
adj. 严重的

e.en: The traffic was {bad} on my way to work today.
e.zh: 我今天上班路上交通很糟糕。

e.en: Eating too much sugar is {bad} for your teeth.
e.zh: 吃太多糖对牙齿不好。

e.en: My boss gets {bad-tempered} whenever the printer breaks down.
e.zh: 我老板每次打印机坏了都会发脾气。

e.en: The {bad-tempered} old dog growled at every visitor.
e.zh: 那只脾气暴躁的老狗对每个客人都狂吠。

e.en: Every superhero movie needs a memorable {baddie} to defeat.
e.zh: 每部超级英雄电影都需要一个令人难忘的反派。

e.en: The kids cheered when the {baddie} finally got caught.
e.zh: 反派终于被抓时孩子们欢呼起来。

e.en: The film's {baddy} steals every scene with menacing charm.
e.zh: 这部电影的反派以阴森的魅力抢尽风头。

e.en: Kids always want to dress as the {baddy} for Halloween.
e.zh: 孩子们万圣节总想扮成大反派。

e.en: We toured the spa town of {Baden} in southern Germany.
e.zh: 我们游览了德国南部的温泉小镇巴登。

e.en: The wines from {Baden} pair beautifully with roasted pork.
e.zh: 巴登地区的葡萄酒与烤猪肉非常搭配。

e.en: Tap your {badge} on the reader to enter the office.
e.zh: 在读卡器上刷一下工牌就能进办公室。

e.en: She earned a verified {badge} on her social profile.
e.zh: 她在社交主页上获得了认证徽章。

badger.t:
n. 獾
v. 纠缠；烦扰

e.en: A {badger} dug a deep burrow under the garden shed.
e.zh: 一只獾在花园棚屋下挖了个深洞。

e.en: Reporters {badger} the celebrity for a quick comment.
e.zh: 记者们纠缠那位名人想要一句简短的评论。

e.en: Stop {badgering} me about the deadline; I'll finish it tonight.
e.zh: 别再为截止日期烦我了,我今晚一定完成。

e.en: The lawyer accused her of {badgering} the witness unfairly.
e.zh: 律师指责她不当地纠缠证人。

e.en: Players unlock new {badges} after completing daily challenges.
e.zh: 玩家完成每日挑战后会解锁新徽章。

e.en: All staff must wear visible ID {badges} inside the lab.
e.zh: 所有员工进入实验室必须佩戴可见的工牌。

e.en: The hosts exchanged playful {badinage} throughout the morning show.
e.zh: 主持人们整个早间节目都在打趣调侃。

e.en: Their friendly {badinage} kept the dinner party lively.
e.zh: 他们友好的玩笑让晚宴气氛热闹起来。

e.en: Hardly anything grows in this dry rocky {badland}.
e.zh: 这片干燥多石的荒地几乎寸草不生。

e.en: The film was shot in a remote western {badland}.
e.zh: 这部电影是在西部一片偏远的荒原拍摄的。

e.en: We hiked through the South Dakota {badlands} at sunrise.
e.zh: 我们日出时分徒步穿越了南达科他的荒原地带。

e.en: Erosion has carved strange shapes into the {badlands}.
e.zh: 侵蚀作用在荒原上雕刻出奇异的形状。

badly.t:
adv. 糟糕地；严重地
adv. 非常；迫切地

e.en: He sings {badly} but performs at karaoke every weekend.
e.zh: 他唱得很难听,但每个周末都去唱卡拉OK。

e.en: The team {badly} needs a reliable goalkeeper this season.
e.zh: 球队这个赛季急需一名可靠的守门员。

e.en: We play {badminton} in the park every Sunday afternoon.
e.zh: 我们每周日下午都在公园打羽毛球。

e.en: China dominates international {badminton} tournaments year after year.
e.zh: 中国年复一年在国际羽毛球赛事中占据主导地位。

e.en: The shop sells various {badmintons} sets for beginners and pros.
e.zh: 这家店出售面向初学者和专业人士的各种羽毛球套装。

e.en: Several school {badmintons} clubs compete in the city league.
e.zh: 几个学校的羽毛球俱乐部参加了城市联赛。

e.en: The cartoon teaches kids about the {badness} of bullying others.
e.zh: 这部动画片教孩子们欺负他人是不好的。

e.en: There's a certain {badness} to her humor that fans love.
e.zh: 她的幽默带着一种坏坏的味道,粉丝很喜欢。

bae.t: n. 宝贝；亲爱的（网络用语）

e.en: My {bae} surprised me with flowers after a long day.
e.zh: 忙碌一天后我的宝贝送花给我惊喜。

e.en: She posted a cute photo with her {bae} on Instagram.
e.zh: 她在Instagram上发了和宝贝的合照。

baedeker.t: n. 贝德克尔旅行指南

e.en: He carried an old {Baedeker} guidebook through the streets of Rome.
e.zh: 他拿着一本旧的贝德克尔旅行指南漫步罗马街头。

e.en: My grandfather collected vintage {Baedeker} travel guides from Europe.
e.zh: 我祖父收藏了不少欧洲的老式贝德克尔旅行指南。

baffle.t:
v. 使困惑；难住
n. 挡板

e.en: Quantum physics continues to {baffle} even seasoned researchers.
e.zh: 量子物理至今仍让经验丰富的研究者困惑不已。

e.en: The magician's tricks {baffle} the audience every single time.
e.zh: 魔术师的把戏每次都让观众百思不解。

baffled.t: adj. 困惑的；摸不着头脑的

e.en: She looked completely {baffled} by the strange error message.
e.zh: 她被那条奇怪的错误信息搞得一头雾水。

e.en: Doctors are {baffled} by the patient's mysterious symptoms.
e.zh: 医生们对患者神秘的症状感到困惑。

e.en: His {bafflement} grew as the puzzle became more complicated.
e.zh: 随着谜题越来越复杂,他的困惑也加深了。

e.en: She stared at the bill in complete {bafflement}.
e.zh: 她完全困惑地盯着那张账单。

baffling.t: adj. 令人费解的；难以理解的

e.en: The detective faced a {baffling} case with no real suspects.
e.zh: 侦探接到一个毫无嫌疑人的离奇案件。

e.en: It's {baffling} that the app crashes only on Tuesdays.
e.zh: 这款应用只在星期二崩溃,实在令人费解。

bafta.t: n. 英国电影电视艺术学院奖

e.en: The British actress won a {BAFTA} for her gripping performance.
e.zh: 这位英国女演员凭借扣人心弦的表演赢得了英国电影学院奖。

e.en: His latest film received six {BAFTA} nominations this year.
e.zh: 他的新片今年获得了六项英国电影学院奖提名。

bag.t:
n. 袋子；包
v. 把…装入袋中

e.en: Don't forget your {bag} when you leave the coffee shop.
e.zh: 离开咖啡店时别忘了你的包。

e.en: Please {bag} the groceries while I pay at the counter.
e.zh: 我在柜台付款时请你把杂货装袋。

e.en: Sugar mills burn {bagasse} to generate clean electricity onsite.
e.zh: 糖厂燃烧甘蔗渣在现场发电。

e.en: Eco-friendly plates are now made from sugarcane {bagasse}.
e.zh: 环保餐盘现在用甘蔗渣制成。

bagatelle.t:
n. 小事；不值一提的东西
n. 弹子游戏

e.en: Losing five dollars is a mere {bagatelle} to a millionaire.
e.zh: 对百万富翁来说,丢五美元只是小事一桩。

e.en: Beethoven composed many short {bagatelle} pieces for piano.
e.zh: 贝多芬为钢琴创作了许多短小的小品曲。

e.en: I grabbed a sesame {bagel} with cream cheese for breakfast.
e.zh: 我早餐买了个芝麻贝果配奶油奶酪。

e.en: This New York bakery makes the best {bagel} in town.
e.zh: 这家纽约面包店做的贝果是城里最好吃的。

e.en: She brought home a {bagful} of apples from the orchard.
e.zh: 她从果园带回家一整袋苹果。

e.en: He emptied a {bagful} of toys onto the living room floor.
e.zh: 他把一整袋玩具倒在客厅地板上。

baggage.t:
n. 行李
n. 心理包袱

e.en: Please collect your {baggage} from carousel three after landing.
e.zh: 落地后请到三号传送带领取行李。

e.en: He carries a lot of emotional {baggage} from his last relationship.
e.zh: 他从上一段感情里背负了许多情感包袱。

bagged.t: v. 装袋；捕获（bag 的过去式）

e.en: She {bagged} a great deal on a flight to Tokyo.
e.zh: 她抢到了一张飞往东京的超划算机票。

e.en: The clerk {bagged} my groceries quickly before the next customer.
e.zh: 店员在下一位顾客前迅速把我的杂货装好袋。

e.en: The friendly {bagger} helped my grandmother carry groceries to her car.
e.zh: 那位友好的装袋员帮我祖母把杂货搬到车上。

e.en: He worked as a {bagger} at the supermarket during high school.
e.zh: 他高中时在超市当装袋员。

e.en: She packed almonds into a small {baggie} for the road trip.
e.zh: 她把杏仁装进一个小密封袋准备公路旅行。

e.en: Put the leftover cookies in a {baggie} so they stay fresh.
e.zh: 把剩下的饼干放进密封袋里保鲜。

bagging.t:
v. 装袋
n. 袋装材料

e.en: The cashier started {bagging} my items while I paid.
e.zh: 我付款时收银员开始把商品装袋。

e.en: She's great at {bagging} last-minute concert tickets online.
e.zh: 她特别擅长在网上抢到最后一刻的演唱会门票。

baggy.t: adj. 宽松的；松垮的（衣裤）

e.en: He wore {baggy} jeans that were popular in the 90s.
e.zh: 他穿着90年代流行的宽松牛仔裤。

e.en: Her sweater looks comfy but a bit too {baggy}.
e.zh: 她的毛衣看起来很舒服,但有点太宽松了。

baghdad.t: n. 巴格达（伊拉克首都）

e.en: My uncle lived in {Baghdad} for several years as a journalist.
e.zh: 我叔叔作为记者在巴格达生活了好几年。

e.en: Ancient {Baghdad} was once a major center of Islamic scholarship.
e.zh: 古代巴格达曾是伊斯兰学术的重要中心。

bagman.t: n. 替人收钱者；推销员

e.en: The corrupt official used a {bagman} to collect illegal payments.
e.zh: 那名腐败官员通过送钱人收取非法款项。

e.en: Police arrested the gang's {bagman} during a sting operation.
e.zh: 警方在一次诱捕行动中逮捕了那个团伙的送钱人。

e.en: He learned to play the {bagpipe} from his Scottish grandfather.
e.zh: 他从苏格兰祖父那里学会了吹风笛。

e.en: A traditional {bagpipe} echoed through the misty Highland valley.
e.zh: 传统风笛声回荡在雾蒙蒙的高地山谷中。

e.en: A lone {bagpiper} performed at the wedding's opening ceremony.
e.zh: 一位独奏风笛手在婚礼开场仪式上演奏。

e.en: The {bagpiper} marched proudly at the front of the parade.
e.zh: 那位风笛手自豪地走在游行队伍最前面。

bags.t:
n. 袋子（复数）
v. 装袋

e.en: I packed three {bags} for our weekend trip to the coast.
e.zh: 我为周末的海滨旅行打包了三个包。

e.en: She has dark {bags} under her eyes from working late.
e.zh: 她因为熬夜工作眼下有黑眼圈。

e.en: He bought a fresh {baguette} from the corner bakery this morning.
e.zh: 他今早从街角面包店买了一根新鲜法棍。

e.en: A crusty {baguette} pairs perfectly with French cheese and wine.
e.zh: 酥脆的法棍与法国奶酪和葡萄酒是绝配。

e.en: "{Bah}, I don't believe in luck," the old man muttered.
e.zh: "呸,我才不信什么运气,"老人嘟囔道。

e.en: "{Bah}!" he shouted, throwing the broken remote on the couch.
e.zh: "呸!"他喊了一声,把坏掉的遥控器扔到沙发上。

e.en: The {Baha'i} faith teaches the unity of all world religions.
e.zh: 巴哈伊信仰主张所有世界宗教的统一。

e.en: She visited the beautiful {Baha'i} gardens in Haifa, Israel.
e.zh: 她参观了以色列海法美丽的巴哈伊花园。

e.en: My neighbor follows the {Bahai} faith and meditates each morning.
e.zh: 我的邻居信奉巴哈伊教,每天早上都会冥想。

e.en: The {Bahai} community holds regular gatherings for prayer and study.
e.zh: 巴哈伊社区定期举行祈祷和学习聚会。

bahamas.t: n. 巴哈马（加勒比岛国）

e.en: We spent our honeymoon swimming in the warm {Bahamas} waters.
e.zh: 我们在巴哈马温暖的海水里度过了蜜月。

e.en: The {Bahamas} consists of hundreds of islands across the Caribbean.
e.zh: 巴哈马由加勒比海上的数百个岛屿组成。

bahamian.t:
adj. 巴哈马的
n. 巴哈马人

e.en: The {Bahamian} chef prepared spicy conch fritters for our table.
e.zh: 那位巴哈马厨师为我们桌上准备了辣味海螺炸丸。

e.en: She speaks with a soft {Bahamian} accent that I find charming.
e.zh: 她说话带着柔和的巴哈马口音,我觉得很迷人。

e.en: We danced to samba on the beaches of {Bahia} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在巴伊亚的海滩上跳起了桑巴。

e.en: {Bahia} is famous for its Afro-Brazilian culture and cuisine.
e.zh: 巴伊亚以其非裔巴西文化和美食而闻名。

bahian.t:
adj. 巴伊亚的
n. 巴伊亚人

e.en: The {bahian} cuisine is famous for its spicy seafood stews.
e.zh: 巴伊亚菜以辛辣的海鲜炖菜闻名。

e.en: She danced to a lively {bahian} rhythm at the festival.
e.zh: 她在节日上随着欢快的巴伊亚节奏起舞。

e.en: {Bahrain} hosts a Formula One race every spring.
e.zh: 巴林每年春天都会举办一级方程式赛车比赛。

e.en: Many expats work in the banking sector in {Bahrain}.
e.zh: 许多外籍人士在巴林的银行业工作。

bahraini.t:
adj. 巴林的
n. 巴林人

e.en: He showed his {Bahraini} passport at the border.
e.zh: 他在边境出示了自己的巴林护照。

e.en: The {Bahraini} dinar is one of the strongest currencies.
e.zh: 巴林第纳尔是最坚挺的货币之一。

e.en: I exchanged dollars for {baht} at the Bangkok airport.
e.zh: 我在曼谷机场把美元换成了泰铢。

e.en: The street food cost only thirty {baht} per plate.
e.zh: 路边小吃每盘只要三十泰铢。

e.en: Lake {Baikal} is the deepest freshwater lake in the world.
e.zh: 贝加尔湖是世界上最深的淡水湖。

e.en: Tourists ice-skate across frozen Lake {Baikal} in winter.
e.zh: 游客冬天在结冰的贝加尔湖上滑冰。

bail.t:
n. 保释金
v. 保释；舀水脱身

e.en: The judge set {bail} at fifty thousand dollars.
e.zh: 法官将保释金定为五万美元。

e.en: I had to {bail} water out of the leaking boat.
e.zh: 我不得不把漏水船里的水舀出来。

bailee.t: n. 受寄托保管财物者

e.en: As the {bailee}, the warehouse must protect stored goods carefully.
e.zh: 作为受托保管人,仓库必须妥善保管寄存的货物。

e.en: The contract clearly defined the {bailee}'s responsibilities.
e.zh: 合同明确规定了受托保管人的责任。

bailey.t: n. 贝利（姓氏）；城堡外墙

e.en: Tourists climbed the castle's outer {bailey} to admire the view.
e.zh: 游客们爬上城堡的外院欣赏风景。

e.en: The medieval {bailey} once housed soldiers and horses.
e.zh: 中世纪的城堡外院曾驻扎着士兵和马匹。

e.en: The Scottish {bailie} presided over local civic matters.
e.zh: 那位苏格兰市政官主持地方民政事务。

e.en: Historical records mention the {bailie} of Edinburgh by name.
e.zh: 历史档案中点名提到了爱丁堡的市政官。

e.en: The {bailiff} escorted the witness into the courtroom.
e.zh: 法警把证人带进了法庭。

e.en: A {bailiff} arrived to seize the unpaid debtor's furniture.
e.zh: 一名执达员前来扣押欠债人的家具。

bailiwick.t: n. 管辖范围；专长领域

e.en: Marketing strategy is really her {bailiwick}, not mine.
e.zh: 营销策略其实是她的专长,不是我的。

e.en: Tax law falls outside the {bailiwick} of this department.
e.zh: 税法不属于本部门的职责范围。

e.en: The novel's hero, a stern {baillie}, ruled the burgh fairly.
e.zh: 小说的主人公是位严厉但公正的市镇官。

e.en: Old Glasgow records list every {baillie} who served.
e.zh: 格拉斯哥的旧档案列出了每一位任职的市镇官。

bailout.t: n. 紧急财政援助；跳伞脱险

e.en: The government approved a massive {bailout} for the failing banks.
e.zh: 政府批准了一项对濒危银行的大规模救助计划。

e.en: Critics argued the auto industry {bailout} rewarded poor management.
e.zh: 批评者认为汽车业救助方案是在奖励管理不善。

bails.t:
v. 保释；跳伞
n. 保释金

e.en: He always {bails} on plans at the last minute.
e.zh: 他总是在最后一刻放鸽子。

e.en: The court regularly {bails} out first-time minor offenders.
e.zh: 法院通常会保释首次犯轻罪的人。

e.en: Chefs use a {bain}-marie to melt chocolate gently.
e.zh: 厨师用隔水加热锅来缓慢融化巧克力。

e.en: The custard sat in a {bain} of warm water.
e.zh: 蛋奶酱放在一锅温水中隔水加热。

bainbridge.t: n. 班布里奇（姓氏/地名）

e.en: The ferry to {Bainbridge} Island leaves every half hour.
e.zh: 开往班布里奇岛的渡轮每半小时一班。

e.en: {Bainbridge} is a quiet getaway just outside Seattle.
e.zh: 班布里奇是西雅图近郊一个宁静的度假地。

e.en: The Scottish granny rocked the sleeping {bairn} in her arms.
e.zh: 那位苏格兰奶奶抱着熟睡的小娃儿轻轻摇晃。

e.en: Every {bairn} in the village received a Christmas gift.
e.zh: 村里每个小孩都收到了一份圣诞礼物。

bait.t:
n. 诱饵；鱼饵
v. 引诱；挑衅

e.en: He put fresh worms on the hook as {bait}.
e.zh: 他把新鲜的蚯蚓挂在钩上做诱饵。

e.en: Don't {bait} him into another pointless argument online.
e.zh: 别再挑衅他卷入毫无意义的网上争吵了。

baited.t: v. 装上诱饵；激怒（过去式）

e.en: She {baited} the trap with peanut butter to catch mice.
e.zh: 她用花生酱在陷阱里下饵抓老鼠。

e.en: The clickbait headline {baited} millions into reading the article.
e.zh: 那个标题党的标题诱使数百万人点开了文章。

e.en: The online troll was a notorious {baiter} of celebrities.
e.zh: 那个网络喷子是出了名的明星挑衅者。

e.en: As a fishing {baiter}, he prepared lures every morning.
e.zh: 作为钓鱼的挂饵手,他每天早上准备鱼饵。

e.en: Stop {baiting} your little brother during dinner.
e.zh: 吃饭时别再挑逗你弟弟了。

e.en: {Baiting} the hook properly takes a bit of practice.
e.zh: 把鱼饵挂好其实需要一点练习。

e.en: The pool table was covered in smooth green {baize}.
e.zh: 台球桌上铺着光滑的绿色台呢。

e.en: She wiped chalk dust off the worn {baize}.
e.zh: 她擦掉了磨损台呢上的粉笔灰。

baja.t: n. 下加利福尼亚（墨西哥半岛）

e.en: We drove down the {Baja} peninsula for a surfing trip.
e.zh: 我们开车南下下加利福尼亚半岛去冲浪。

e.en: {Baja} fish tacos are a staple of Mexican coastal cuisine.
e.zh: 下加州鱼肉玉米卷是墨西哥海岸美食的招牌。

e.en: I love to {bake} cookies on rainy weekends.
e.zh: 我喜欢在下雨的周末烤饼干。

e.en: Let the clay figures {bake} in the kiln overnight.
e.zh: 让黏土小人在窑里烧一整夜。

baked.t:
adj. 烤制的
v. 烘烤（过去式）

e.en: She {baked} a gorgeous chocolate cake for his birthday.
e.zh: 她为他生日烤了一个漂亮的巧克力蛋糕。

e.en: The desert sun {baked} the cracked earth all summer.
e.zh: 沙漠的烈日整个夏天炙烤着龟裂的大地。

e.en: My grandmother kept her old {Bakelite} radio on the shelf.
e.zh: 我奶奶把那台老式胶木收音机放在架子上。

e.en: Vintage {Bakelite} jewelry sells for high prices today.
e.zh: 复古胶木首饰如今卖得很贵。

e.en: The local {baker} starts work at four every morning.
e.zh: 当地的面包师每天凌晨四点就开工。

e.en: She trained as a pastry {baker} in Paris.
e.zh: 她曾在巴黎接受糕点师培训。

e.en: Several artisan {bakeries} have opened in the neighborhood.
e.zh: 附近开了好几家手工面包店。

e.en: French {bakeries} typically sell out of croissants by noon.
e.zh: 法式面包店的可颂通常中午前就卖光了。

e.en: The town's {bakers} compete for the best sourdough title.
e.zh: 镇上的面包师们争夺最佳天然酵母面包的称号。

e.en: Skilled {bakers} can shape dough almost without thinking.
e.zh: 熟练的面包师揉面几乎不用过脑子。

e.en: I stopped at the corner {bakery} for a fresh baguette.
e.zh: 我在街角的面包店买了一根新鲜的法棍。

e.en: Their family {bakery} has run for three generations.
e.zh: 他们家的面包店已经经营了三代人。

bakes.t: v. 烘烤；烘焙（bake 的三单）

e.en: She {bakes} bread every Sunday for the whole week.
e.zh: 她每个星期天烤好够吃一周的面包。

e.en: Mom's tuna {bakes} are a classic weeknight dinner.
e.zh: 妈妈做的金枪鱼焗饭是经典的工作日晚餐。

e.en: The cozy {bakeshop} smells of cinnamon every morning.
e.zh: 那家温馨的烘焙店每天早上都飘着肉桂香。

e.en: We bought macarons from a tiny Parisian {bakeshop}.
e.zh: 我们在巴黎一家小烘焙店买了马卡龙。

bakewell.t: n. 贝克韦尔（英国地名/果酱挞）

e.en: A traditional {Bakewell} tart has almond and jam filling.
e.zh: 传统的贝克威尔挞填有杏仁和果酱。

e.en: The cafe's {Bakewell} pudding is famous across Derbyshire.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆的贝克威尔布丁在德比郡远近闻名。

bakhtin.t: n. 巴赫金（俄国文论家）

e.en: Literature students often read {Bakhtin} on dialogue and the novel.
e.zh: 文学专业学生常读巴赫金论小说与对话的著作。

e.en: {Bakhtin} introduced the concept of carnival in literary theory.
e.zh: 巴赫金在文学理论中提出了狂欢化的概念。

baking.t:
n. 烘焙；烘烤
adj. 酷热的

e.en: {Baking} sourdough has become my pandemic hobby.
e.zh: 烤天然酵母面包成了我疫情期间的爱好。

e.en: It's absolutely {baking} outside today—stay hydrated.
e.zh: 今天外面热得要命,记得多喝水。

baklava.t: n. 果仁蜜饼（中东甜点）

e.en: We shared a slice of honey-soaked {baklava} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后我们分享了一块浸满蜂蜜的果仁蜜饼。

e.en: Her grandmother makes the flakiest {baklava} in town.
e.zh: 她奶奶做的果仁蜜饼是镇上最酥脆的。

baku.t: n. 巴库（阿塞拜疆首都）

e.en: {Baku} is the modern capital of Azerbaijan.
e.zh: 巴库是阿塞拜疆的现代化首都。

e.en: The skyscrapers of {Baku} overlook the Caspian Sea.
e.zh: 巴库的摩天大楼俯瞰着里海。

e.en: The Parisian {bal} musette played accordion music all night.
e.zh: 巴黎的小舞会整晚播放着手风琴音乐。

e.en: She wore a vintage gown to the masked {bal}.
e.zh: 她穿着一件复古礼服参加了化装舞会。

e.en: We hiked around Lake {Bala} in northern Wales.
e.zh: 我们在北威尔士的巴拉湖周围远足。

e.en: {Bala} is known for narrow-gauge steam railway rides.
e.zh: 巴拉以窄轨蒸汽小火车之旅闻名。

balaclava.t: n. 巴拉克拉瓦头套；防风面罩

e.en: He pulled a black {balaclava} over his face in the cold.
e.zh: 天冷时他把黑色头套套在脸上。

e.en: Skiers often wear a thin {balaclava} under their helmets.
e.zh: 滑雪者常在头盔下戴一层薄头套。

balalaika.t: n. 三角琴（俄式弦乐器）

e.en: The Russian musician strummed a triangular {balalaika} on stage.
e.zh: 那位俄罗斯乐手在台上弹奏一把三角形的巴拉莱卡琴。

e.en: She bought a small {balalaika} as a souvenir from Moscow.
e.zh: 她从莫斯科带回一把小巴拉莱卡琴作纪念品。

balance.t:
n. 平衡；余额
v. 使平衡

e.en: Try to maintain a healthy work-life {balance}.
e.zh: 努力保持工作与生活的健康平衡。

e.en: My checking account {balance} dropped after rent was paid.
e.zh: 交完房租后,我的支票账户余额掉了下去。

e.en: A {balanced} diet includes plenty of vegetables and protein.
e.zh: 均衡的饮食要包含大量蔬菜和蛋白质。

e.en: She {balanced} the heavy tray on one hand expertly.
e.zh: 她熟练地用一只手稳住了沉重的托盘。

e.en: A load {balancer} distributes traffic across multiple servers.
e.zh: 负载均衡器把流量分配到多台服务器上。

e.en: This new {balancer} keeps the washing machine from shaking.
e.zh: 这个新的平衡器能防止洗衣机晃动。

balances.t:
n. 余额；天平（复数）
v. 平衡（三单）

e.en: She carefully {balances} her studies and her part-time job.
e.zh: 她精心地兼顾学业和兼职工作。

e.en: Please check your account {balances} before transferring funds.
e.zh: 转账前请先查看您的账户余额。

e.en: {Balanchine} revolutionized American ballet with neoclassical choreography.
e.zh: 巴兰钦以新古典主义编舞革新了美国芭蕾。

e.en: The company performed a beloved {Balanchine} piece tonight.
e.zh: 剧团今晚上演了一出深受喜爱的巴兰钦作品。

balancing.t:
n. 平衡；调节
v. 平衡中

e.en: {Balancing} a budget takes patience and steady record-keeping.
e.zh: 做平衡预算需要耐心和持续的记账。

e.en: The acrobat was {balancing} on a single hand.
e.zh: 那位杂技演员正用单手支撑保持平衡。

balboa.t: n. 巴尔博亚（人名/巴拿马货币）

e.en: {Balboa} was the first European to see the Pacific Ocean.
e.zh: 巴尔博亚是第一位见到太平洋的欧洲人。

e.en: Panama's currency, the {balboa}, is named after the explorer.
e.zh: 巴拿马的货币巴波亚以这位探险家的名字命名。

balcombe.t: n. 巴尔科姆（英国地名）

e.en: The train passes the famous {Balcombe} viaduct in Sussex.
e.zh: 火车经过苏塞克斯著名的巴尔库姆高架桥。

e.en: Protesters once gathered in {Balcombe} against fracking plans.
e.zh: 抗议者曾聚集在巴尔库姆反对水力压裂计划。

e.en: From the {balcon}, we watched the parade pass below.
e.zh: 我们从阳台上看着游行队伍从下面经过。

e.en: Their hotel room had a small wrought-iron {balcon}.
e.zh: 他们的酒店房间有一个小小的铁艺阳台。

e.en: The hotel rooms with {balconies} cost extra during peak season.
e.zh: 酒店带阳台的房间在旺季要加钱。

e.en: Most apartments in the building have small {balconies} facing the park.
e.zh: 这栋楼的大多数公寓都有面向公园的小阳台。

e.en: She drank her morning coffee on the {balcony}.
e.zh: 她在阳台上喝早晨的咖啡。

e.en: We booked seats on the {balcony} for the concert.
e.zh: 我们订了音乐会的楼座位置。

e.en: My uncle went {bald} in his early thirties.
e.zh: 我叔叔三十出头就秃了。

e.en: The report gave a {bald} statement of the facts.
e.zh: 那份报告直白地陈述了事实。

e.en: He {balded} quickly after starting the new medication.
e.zh: 他开始服用新药后很快就秃了。

e.en: The tires {balded} after years of heavy use.
e.zh: 轮胎经过多年重度使用后磨平了。

e.en: His excuse was complete {balderdash} and nobody believed it.
e.zh: 他的借口完全是胡说八道,没人信。

e.en: Don't talk such {balderdash} in front of the children.
e.zh: 别在孩子面前说这种废话。

e.en: The {balding} man adjusted his cap nervously.
e.zh: 那个谢顶的男人紧张地调整着帽子。

e.en: He's slightly {balding} but still looks young.
e.zh: 他有点谢顶,但看起来还很年轻。

e.en: She {baldly} refused to apologize for her remarks.
e.zh: 她直截了当地拒绝为自己的言论道歉。

e.en: The CEO {baldly} stated that layoffs were coming.
e.zh: 首席执行官直白地表示裁员即将到来。

e.en: Genetic {baldness} runs in his family.
e.zh: 他家族有遗传性脱发。

e.en: Many treatments claim to reverse {baldness} in men.
e.zh: 许多疗法声称可以逆转男性脱发。

e.en: The train stopped briefly at {Baldock} on its way north.
e.zh: 火车北上途中在巴尔多克短暂停靠。

e.en: She grew up in {Baldock}, a small town in Hertfordshire.
e.zh: 她在赫特福德郡的小镇巴尔多克长大。

e.en: He {balds} a little more every year, he jokes.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说自己每年都多秃一点。

e.en: The mountain {balds} above the treeline are stunning.
e.zh: 高山林线之上的秃顶山地令人惊叹。

e.en: James {Baldwin} wrote powerfully about race in America.
e.zh: 詹姆斯·鲍德温对美国种族问题的描写很有力量。

e.en: The {Baldwin} apple is great for baking pies.
e.zh: 鲍德温苹果非常适合用来烤派。

e.en: The kids teasingly called their uncle {baldy}.
e.zh: 孩子们开玩笑地叫他们的叔叔秃头。

e.en: Don't call him {baldy} — he's sensitive about it.
e.zh: 别叫他秃头,他对这事很敏感。

bale.t:
n. （货物）大捆
v. 打包成捆

e.en: The farmer stacked each {bale} of hay in the barn.
e.zh: 农夫把每捆干草堆放在谷仓里。

e.en: A {bale} of cotton sells for hundreds of dollars.
e.zh: 一包棉花能卖几百美元。

e.en: We sailed around the {Balearic} Islands last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们环游了巴利阿里群岛。

e.en: Ibiza is part of the {Balearic} archipelago in Spain.
e.zh: 伊比萨岛是西班牙巴利阿里群岛的一部分。

e.en: The workers {baled} the hay before the rain came.
e.zh: 工人们在雨来之前把干草打捆。

e.en: She {baled} the recycled cardboard for shipping.
e.zh: 她把回收的纸板打包好准备运输。

e.en: The whale uses {baleen} to filter tiny krill from seawater.
e.zh: 鲸鱼用鲸须从海水中过滤小磷虾。

e.en: {Baleen} plates hang from the upper jaw of certain whales.
e.zh: 鲸须板悬挂在某些鲸鱼的上颚。

e.en: She gave him a {baleful} glare across the room.
e.zh: 她从房间另一头狠狠地瞪了他一眼。

e.en: The villain's {baleful} smile sent chills down her spine.
e.zh: 反派那阴险的微笑让她脊背发凉。

e.en: The cat stared {balefully} at the new puppy.
e.zh: 那只猫恶狠狠地盯着新来的小狗。

e.en: He glared {balefully} at his rival across the courtroom.
e.zh: 他在法庭上恶狠狠地瞪着对手。

e.en: The {baler} compresses recycling into compact blocks.
e.zh: 打包机把回收物压成紧实的方块。

e.en: Our farm just bought a new hay {baler}.
e.zh: 我们农场刚买了一台新的干草打捆机。

e.en: The {Balfour} Declaration shaped Middle Eastern politics for decades.
e.zh: 《贝尔福宣言》数十年来塑造了中东政治格局。

e.en: Arthur {Balfour} served as British Prime Minister in the early 1900s.
e.zh: 阿瑟·贝尔福在二十世纪初担任英国首相。

e.en: She rented a small flat in {Balham}, south London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦南部的巴勒姆租了一间小公寓。

e.en: The {Balham} tube station is on the Northern line.
e.zh: 巴勒姆地铁站在北线上。

e.en: We spent two weeks in {Bali} last year.
e.zh: 我们去年在巴厘岛待了两周。

e.en: {Bali} is famous for its beaches and Hindu temples.
e.zh: 巴厘岛以海滩和印度教寺庙闻名。

balinese.t:
adj. 巴厘岛的
n. 巴厘人/语

e.en: The {Balinese} dance performance lasted nearly two hours.
e.zh: 巴厘舞蹈表演持续了近两个小时。

e.en: Traditional {Balinese} architecture uses lots of carved wood.
e.zh: 传统巴厘建筑大量使用雕刻木材。

e.en: The farmers spent all afternoon {baling} hay.
e.zh: 农夫们整个下午都在打捆干草。

e.en: The crew was {baling} water out of the sinking boat.
e.zh: 船员们正在把水从下沉的船里舀出去。

balk.t:
v. 犹豫；畏缩不前
n. 障碍

e.en: Many parents {balk} at the high cost of college.
e.zh: 许多家长对高昂的大学费用望而却步。

e.en: The pitcher was called for a {balk} during the inning.
e.zh: 那名投手在那一局被判了投手犯规。

e.en: The {Balkan} region has a complex political history.
e.zh: 巴尔干地区有着复杂的政治历史。

e.en: We tried several {Balkan} dishes at the restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在餐馆尝了几道巴尔干菜肴。

balkanization.t: n. 巴尔干化；分裂割据

e.en: The {balkanization} of the internet worries many experts.
e.zh: 互联网的巴尔干化让许多专家感到担忧。

e.en: Critics warn against the {balkanization} of online communities.
e.zh: 批评者警告网络社区出现碎片化分裂。

balkanized.t: adj. 巴尔干化的；被分裂的

e.en: The market has become {balkanized} into competing platforms.
e.zh: 市场已经分裂成相互竞争的多个平台。

e.en: After the war, the region was {balkanized} into smaller states.
e.zh: 战后,该地区被分割成多个较小的国家。

e.en: She traveled across the {Balkans} by train last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天她乘火车穿越了巴尔干半岛。

e.en: The {Balkans} include countries like Serbia, Croatia, and Albania.
e.zh: 巴尔干半岛包括塞尔维亚、克罗地亚和阿尔巴尼亚等国。

balky.t: adj. 倔强的；不肯前行的

e.en: The {balky} old printer jammed again this morning.
e.zh: 那台不听话的旧打印机今早又卡纸了。

e.en: His {balky} knee has been bothering him for weeks.
e.zh: 他那不灵光的膝盖已经困扰他好几周了。

ball.t:
n. 球；舞会
v. 揉成球状

e.en: The kids kicked the {ball} around the backyard.
e.zh: 孩子们在后院踢着球玩。

e.en: Cinderella danced with the prince at the royal {ball}.
e.zh: 灰姑娘在王室舞会上与王子共舞。

e.en: The band closed the show with a slow {ballad}.
e.zh: 乐队以一首慢节奏的民谣结束了演出。

e.en: This {ballad} tells the story of a doomed romance.
e.zh: 这首歌谣讲述了一段注定悲剧的爱情故事。

e.en: The {balladeer} strummed his guitar by the campfire.
e.zh: 那位民谣歌手在篝火旁弹着吉他。

e.en: She became famous as a {balladeer} in the 1970s.
e.zh: 她在七十年代以民谣歌手身份成名。

e.en: His album features romantic {ballads} from the eighties.
e.zh: 他的专辑收录了八十年代的浪漫情歌。

e.en: Old folk {ballads} often tell tragic love stories.
e.zh: 古老的民间歌谣常讲述悲剧爱情故事。

e.en: R. M. {Ballantyne} wrote adventure novels for Victorian boys.
e.zh: R·M·巴兰坦为维多利亚时代的男孩们创作冒险小说。

e.en: The novel {Ballantyne} published influenced later children's literature.
e.zh: 巴兰坦出版的那部小说影响了后来的儿童文学。

e.en: J. G. {Ballard} explored dystopian themes in his novels.
e.zh: J·G·巴拉德在小说中探索反乌托邦主题。

e.en: {Ballard} is a trendy neighborhood in north Seattle.
e.zh: 巴拉德是西雅图北部一个时髦的街区。

ballast.t:
n. 压舱物；道砟
v. 给…加压舱物

e.en: Ships use heavy {ballast} to stay stable in rough seas.
e.zh: 船只使用重压舱物以在风浪中保持稳定。

e.en: His steady job provided {ballast} during uncertain times.
e.zh: 他稳定的工作在动荡时期成了他的支柱。

ballater.t: n. 巴拉特（苏格兰小镇）

e.en: We stopped for tea in {Ballater} on our Highlands trip.
e.zh: 我们在高地旅行中在巴拉特停下来喝茶。

e.en: {Ballater} is a charming village near Balmoral Castle.
e.zh: 巴拉特是巴尔莫勒尔城堡附近的一个迷人村庄。

ballcarrier.t: n. (橄榄球)持球进攻的球员

e.en: The {ballcarrier} sprinted toward the end zone.
e.zh: 持球队员朝达阵区冲刺。

e.en: Defenders quickly tackled the {ballcarrier} near the sideline.
e.zh: 防守队员迅速在边线附近擒抱住持球队员。

balled.t: v. 揉成球状（ball 的过去式）

e.en: He {balled} up the paper and tossed it away.
e.zh: 他把纸揉成一团扔掉了。

e.en: She {balled} her hands into tight fists.
e.zh: 她把双手紧紧地握成拳头。

e.en: The young {ballerina} practiced for hours every day.
e.zh: 那位年轻的芭蕾舞者每天练习好几个小时。

e.en: She dreamed of becoming a prima {ballerina} someday.
e.zh: 她梦想有朝一日成为首席芭蕾舞女演员。

ballesteros.t: n. 巴列斯特罗斯（西班牙姓氏）

e.en: Seve {Ballesteros} won five major golf championships.
e.zh: 塞维·巴列斯特罗斯赢得了五个高尔夫大满贯冠军。

e.en: Many fans still consider {Ballesteros} the most charismatic golfer ever.
e.zh: 许多球迷仍认为巴列斯特罗斯是最具魅力的高尔夫球手。

e.en: My daughter takes {ballet} classes on Saturdays.
e.zh: 我女儿每周六上芭蕾课。

e.en: We watched a beautiful production of Swan Lake {ballet}.
e.zh: 我们观看了一场美丽的《天鹅湖》芭蕾舞演出。

balletic.t: adj. 芭蕾舞的；如芭蕾般优雅的

e.en: The skater's moves were almost {balletic} in their grace.
e.zh: 那位滑冰选手的动作优雅得几乎像芭蕾。

e.en: He played defense with {balletic} precision and control.
e.zh: 他防守时有着芭蕾般的精准和掌控力。

e.en: We took the kids to a {ballgame} on Sunday.
e.zh: 我们周日带孩子们去看了一场球赛。

e.en: With new funding, it's a whole different {ballgame} now.
e.zh: 有了新资金,情况完全不同了。

ballgown.t: n. 舞会礼服；女式长礼服

e.en: She wore a stunning blue {ballgown} to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一件惊艳的蓝色礼服去晚宴。

e.en: The designer's {ballgown} took six months to hand-stitch.
e.zh: 那位设计师的礼服花了六个月手工缝制。

e.en: He's the best {ballhandler} on the basketball team.
e.zh: 他是篮球队最出色的控球手。

e.en: A skilled {ballhandler} can dribble through any defense.
e.zh: 一名熟练的控球手能突破任何防守。

balliol.t: n. 贝利奥尔学院（牛津大学学院）

e.en: She studied philosophy at {Balliol} College, Oxford.
e.zh: 她在牛津大学贝利奥尔学院学习哲学。

e.en: {Balliol} is one of the oldest colleges at Oxford.
e.zh: 贝利奥尔学院是牛津最古老的学院之一。

e.en: The Romans used a {ballista} to launch heavy bolts at enemies.
e.zh: 罗马人用弩炮向敌人发射重型箭矢。

e.en: Archaeologists unearthed an ancient {ballista} near the fort.
e.zh: 考古学家在堡垒附近挖出了一台古代弩炮。

ballistic.t: adj. 弹道的；暴怒的（go ballistic）

e.en: My boss went {ballistic} when he saw the report.
e.zh: 我老板看到那份报告时勃然大怒。

e.en: The military tested a new {ballistic} missile last week.
e.zh: 军方上周测试了一种新型弹道导弹。

e.en: Stock prices rose {ballistically} after the merger announcement.
e.zh: 并购消息公布后股价直线飙升。

e.en: He went {ballistically} angry when he saw the bill.
e.zh: 他看到账单时怒火冲天。

e.en: Forensic {ballistics} matched the bullet to the suspect's gun.
e.zh: 弹道鉴定将子弹与嫌犯的枪匹配上了。

e.en: The engineer studied {ballistics} to design better rockets.
e.zh: 这位工程师研究弹道学以设计更好的火箭。

balloon.t:
n. 气球
v. 激增；膨胀

e.en: The child cried when the red {balloon} floated away.
e.zh: 那个红气球飘走时,小孩哭了起来。

e.en: Housing prices began to {balloon} after the policy change.
e.zh: 政策变动后房价开始急剧膨胀。

ballooning.t:
v. 急剧膨胀；乘热气球
n. 热气球运动

e.en: Government debt is {ballooning} at an alarming rate.
e.zh: 政府债务正以惊人的速度膨胀。

e.en: They went hot-air {ballooning} over the Cappadocia valleys.
e.zh: 他们乘热气球飞越卡帕多奇亚的山谷。

e.en: The {balloonist} waved at the crowd from above the trees.
e.zh: 热气球驾驶员从树梢上方向人群挥手。

e.en: A famous {balloonist} attempted to circle the globe solo.
e.zh: 一位著名的热气球飞行员试图独自环游地球。

e.en: We tied colorful {balloons} to every chair at the party.
e.zh: 我们把彩色气球绑在派对每张椅子上。

e.en: His ego {balloons} whenever someone praises his work.
e.zh: 每当有人夸他的作品,他就会膨胀起来。

ballot.t:
n. 选票；投票
v. 投票表决

e.en: Please mark your choice clearly on the {ballot} paper.
e.zh: 请在选票上清楚地标出你的选择。

e.en: The proposal was put to a secret {ballot} yesterday.
e.zh: 这项提案昨天交付秘密投票表决。

e.en: {Balloting} closes at six o'clock this evening.
e.zh: 投票将在今晚六点结束。

e.en: Members began {balloting} for the new committee chair.
e.zh: 成员们开始投票选举新的委员会主席。

e.en: Officials counted the {ballots} late into the night.
e.zh: 工作人员一直数选票数到深夜。

e.en: Mail-in {ballots} must arrive before Tuesday's deadline.
e.zh: 邮寄选票必须在周二截止日期前送达。

ballpark.t:
n. 棒球场；大致范围
adj. 大致的（估计）

e.en: Can you give me a {ballpark} figure for the renovation?
e.zh: 你能给我一个装修费用的大概数字吗?

e.en: We took the kids to the {ballpark} on Saturday.
e.zh: 我们星期六带孩子们去了棒球场。

e.en: He became a professional {ballplayer} right after college.
e.zh: 他大学一毕业就成了职业棒球运动员。

e.en: Every {ballplayer} on the team trained twice a day.
e.zh: 队里每位球员每天训练两次。

e.en: She signed the contract with a blue {ballpoint} pen.
e.zh: 她用蓝色圆珠笔签了合同。

e.en: The {ballpoint} leaked all over my shirt pocket.
e.zh: 圆珠笔漏油弄脏了我的衬衫口袋。

ballroom.t: n. 舞厅；宴会舞会大厅

e.en: Guests danced beneath chandeliers in the grand {ballroom}.
e.zh: 宾客们在宏伟的舞厅里在水晶灯下起舞。

e.en: My grandmother still teaches {ballroom} dancing on Sundays.
e.zh: 我奶奶星期天仍然在教交谊舞。

e.en: The dog chased three tennis {balls} across the lawn.
e.zh: 那只狗在草坪上追逐三个网球。

e.en: It takes {balls} to quit a stable job like that.
e.zh: 放弃那种稳定工作需要很大的勇气。

e.en: That was a {ballsy} move asking the CEO directly.
e.zh: 直接问首席执行官,真是够大胆的。

e.en: She gave a {ballsy} speech criticizing the entire board.
e.zh: 她做了一场大胆的演讲,批评了整个董事会。

e.en: The plumber replaced a leaking {ballvalve} under the sink.
e.zh: 水管工更换了水槽下漏水的球阀。

e.en: Turn the {ballvalve} clockwise to shut off the water.
e.zh: 顺时针转动球阀即可关水。

e.en: That {bally} printer has jammed three times today.
e.zh: 那台该死的打印机今天已经卡了三次纸。

e.en: I can't find my {bally} keys anywhere.
e.zh: 我那破钥匙到处都找不到。

ballyhoo.t: n./v. 大肆宣传；喧闹的炒作

e.en: Despite the {ballyhoo}, the new phone barely sold.
e.zh: 尽管大肆宣传,这款新手机几乎没卖出去。

e.en: There was huge {ballyhoo} surrounding the film's premiere.
e.zh: 这部电影的首映被大肆炒作。

ballyhooed.t: v. 被大肆宣传（ballyhoo 的过去式）

e.en: The much-{ballyhooed} merger fell apart at the last minute.
e.zh: 那场被大肆吹捧的并购在最后关头告吹了。

e.en: Critics dismissed the {ballyhooed} novel as overrated.
e.zh: 评论家认为那本被吹捧的小说被过度赞誉了。

ballymena.t: n. 巴利米纳（北爱尔兰城镇）

e.en: My uncle grew up on a small farm near {Ballymena}.
e.zh: 我叔叔在巴利米纳附近的一个小农场长大。

e.en: {Ballymena} is a market town in County Antrim, Northern Ireland.
e.zh: 巴利米纳是北爱尔兰安特里姆郡的一个集镇。

ballymoney.t: n. 巴利莫尼（北爱尔兰城镇）

e.en: We stopped for tea in {Ballymoney} on our drive north.
e.zh: 北行途中我们在巴利莫尼停下来喝了茶。

e.en: {Ballymoney} hosts an annual motorcycle festival each May.
e.zh: 巴利莫尼每年五月举办摩托车节。

e.en: This lip {balm} keeps my skin soft all winter.
e.zh: 这款润唇膏整个冬天都能让我的皮肤保持柔软。

e.en: Her kind words were a {balm} after the bad news.
e.zh: 听到坏消息后,她温柔的话语像一剂安慰。

balmain.t: n. 巴尔曼（法国时装品牌）

e.en: She wore a vintage {Balmain} jacket to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿了一件复古巴尔曼夹克出席晚会。

e.en: {Balmain} unveiled its new collection at Paris Fashion Week.
e.zh: 巴尔曼在巴黎时装周上发布了新系列。

balmoral.t: n. 巴尔莫勒尔（英王室苏格兰行宫）

e.en: The royal family spends each summer at {Balmoral} Castle.
e.zh: 王室每年夏天都在巴尔莫勒尔城堡度过。

e.en: He polished his black {Balmoral} boots before the parade.
e.zh: 游行前他擦亮了他那双黑色的巴尔莫勒尔靴子。

e.en: We enjoyed a {balmy} evening on the hotel terrace.
e.zh: 我们在酒店露台上享受了一个温暖宜人的傍晚。

e.en: The breeze felt {balmy} after weeks of harsh winter.
e.zh: 经过几周严冬,这阵微风感觉格外温和。

e.en: His excuse for being late was complete {baloney}.
e.zh: 他迟到的借口完全是胡说八道。

e.en: Don't believe that {baloney} you read on social media.
e.zh: 别相信你在社交媒体上读到的那些胡话。

balsa.t: n. 轻木（一种极轻的木材）

e.en: Model airplanes are often built from lightweight {balsa} wood.
e.zh: 模型飞机通常用轻质轻木制成。

e.en: The students carved tiny boats out of {balsa}.
e.zh: 学生们用巴沙木雕刻小船。

e.en: The forest smelled of fresh pine and {balsam}.
e.zh: 森林里弥漫着新鲜松树和香脂的气味。

e.en: She rubbed {balsam} oil on her sore shoulders.
e.zh: 她在酸痛的肩膀上涂了香脂油。

balsamic.t: adj. 香脂的；（醋）浓稠芳香的

e.en: Drizzle {balsamic} vinegar over the strawberries before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前在草莓上淋点意大利香醋。

e.en: This salad needs a splash of aged {balsamic}.
e.zh: 这道沙拉需要加一点陈年香醋。

balt.t: n. 波罗的海沿岸居民

e.en: His grandfather was a {Balt} who emigrated after the war.
e.zh: 他的祖父是战后移民的波罗的海人。

e.en: Every {Balt} I met spoke at least three languages.
e.zh: 我遇到的每个波罗的海人都至少会说三种语言。

baltic.t:
adj. 波罗的海的
n. 波罗的海地区

e.en: We took a cruise across the {Baltic} Sea last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们乘船游览了波罗的海。

e.en: The wind off the {Baltic} coast was bitterly cold.
e.zh: 从波罗的海岸吹来的风刺骨地冷。

baltimore.t: n. 巴尔的摩（美国城市）

e.en: She moved to {Baltimore} to attend medical school.
e.zh: 她搬到巴尔的摩去读医学院。

e.en: {Baltimore} is famous for its harbor and blue crabs.
e.zh: 巴尔的摩以其港口和蓝蟹闻名。

e.en: {Baluchistan} is the largest province in Pakistan by area.
e.zh: 俾路支省是巴基斯坦面积最大的省份。

e.en: The mountains of {Baluchistan} are remote and sparsely populated.
e.zh: 俾路支斯坦的山脉偏远且人烟稀少。

e.en: One {baluster} on the staircase had cracked and split.
e.zh: 楼梯上有一根栏杆柱已经裂开了。

e.en: The carpenter carved each wooden {baluster} by hand.
e.zh: 木匠手工雕刻了每一根木栏杆柱。

e.en: She leaned against the marble {balustrade} overlooking the garden.
e.zh: 她倚着大理石栏杆俯瞰花园。

e.en: The terrace's iron {balustrade} was rusted but still elegant.
e.zh: 露台上的铁栏杆虽已生锈,却依然优雅。

balzac.t: n. 巴尔扎克（法国作家）

e.en: I'm reading a novel by {Balzac} for my literature class.
e.zh: 我在为文学课读一本巴尔扎克的小说。

e.en: {Balzac} wrote nearly a hundred novels in his lifetime.
e.zh: 巴尔扎克一生写了近一百部小说。

e.en: {Bam}! The door slammed shut behind him.
e.zh: 砰的一声,门在他身后猛地关上了。

e.en: You press the button and {bam}, your photo is uploaded.
e.zh: 你按下按钮,啪的一下,照片就上传了。

e.en: {Bamberg} is famous for its smoked beer and medieval old town.
e.zh: 班贝格以其烟熏啤酒和中世纪老城闻名。

e.en: We spent three days exploring {Bamberg}'s historic churches.
e.zh: 我们花了三天时间游览班贝格的历史教堂。

bambi.t: n. 斑比（小鹿名，动画角色）

e.en: My daughter cried during the sad scene in {Bambi}.
e.zh: 我女儿看《小鹿斑比》里悲伤的那一幕时哭了。

e.en: The fawn looked just like {Bambi} from the Disney film.
e.zh: 那只小鹿看起来就像迪士尼电影里的斑比。

e.en: Pandas eat almost nothing but fresh {bamboo} shoots.
e.zh: 熊猫几乎只吃新鲜的竹笋。

e.en: They built the entire fence from sustainable {bamboo}.
e.zh: 他们用可持续竹材建造了整面围栏。

e.en: Don't let those salesmen {bamboozle} you into buying extras.
e.zh: 别让那些推销员忽悠你买额外的东西。

e.en: Crooks often {bamboozle} elderly people with fake charity calls.
e.zh: 骗子常常用假慈善电话欺骗老年人。

bamboozled.t: v. 被欺骗；一头雾水（bamboozle 过去式）

e.en: I felt completely {bamboozled} by the contract's fine print.
e.zh: 我被合同里的小字条款彻底搞糊涂了。

e.en: She {bamboozled} the clerk into giving her a refund.
e.zh: 她哄得店员给她退了款。

e.en: {Bampton} village was used as a filming location for Downton Abbey.
e.zh: 班普顿村曾是《唐顿庄园》的拍摄地。

e.en: We drove through {Bampton} on our way to Oxford.
e.zh: 我们去牛津的路上经过了班普顿。

ban.t:
v. 禁止；取缔
n. 禁令

e.en: The city plans to {ban} single-use plastic bags next year.
e.zh: 该市计划明年禁止使用一次性塑料袋。

e.en: Several countries imposed a {ban} on the chemical pesticide.
e.zh: 多个国家禁止使用这种化学农药。

e.en: His speech was full of {banal} clichés about success.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了关于成功的陈词滥调。

e.en: Most reality shows feel {banal} after a few episodes.
e.zh: 大多数真人秀看几集后就显得乏味了。

e.en: The film exposes the {banality} of suburban middle-class life.
e.zh: 这部电影揭示了郊区中产生活的平庸。

e.en: I was surprised by the {banality} of his arguments.
e.zh: 他论点的平庸让我感到意外。

e.en: I always pack a {banana} for my morning workout.
e.zh: 我早晨锻炼时总会带一根香蕉。

e.en: She slipped on a {banana} peel in the cartoon.
e.zh: 动画片里她踩到香蕉皮滑倒了。

bananas.t:
adj. 发疯的；抓狂的
n. 香蕉（复数）

e.en: The crowd went {bananas} when the band came on stage.
e.zh: 乐队登台时观众都疯狂了。

e.en: He bought six {bananas} for tomorrow's smoothie.
e.zh: 他买了六根香蕉用来做明天的奶昔。

e.en: {Banbury} is a market town in Oxfordshire, England.
e.zh: 班伯里是英格兰牛津郡的一个集镇。

e.en: We stopped at a bakery in {Banbury} for fresh pastries.
e.zh: 我们在班伯里的一家面包店停下来买新鲜糕点。

e.en: We rode a wooden {banca} through the calm island waters.
e.zh: 我们乘着木制螃蟹船穿过平静的岛屿水域。

e.en: Local fishermen returned at dawn aboard their painted {banca}.
e.zh: 当地渔民黎明时分乘着彩绘螃蟹船归来。

banco.t: n. 赌局中跟庄家对赌的叫法

e.en: He played a {banco} bet against the dealer at the casino.
e.zh: 他在赌场押了一注满额下注对抗庄家。

e.en: The Spanish word {banco} simply means bank or bench.
e.zh: 西班牙语单词banco的意思就是银行或长凳。

band.t:
n. 乐队；带子；频段
v. 联合

e.en: Her favorite {band} is performing in town tonight.
e.zh: 她最喜欢的乐队今晚要在城里演出。

e.en: He wears a rubber {band} around his wrist.
e.zh: 他手腕上戴着一根橡皮筋。

e.en: The {banda} music filled the plaza with brass and drums.
e.zh: 班达音乐用铜管和鼓声充满了广场。

e.en: They danced all night to a traditional Mexican {banda}.
e.zh: 他们伴着传统墨西哥班达乐队跳了一整夜。

bandage.t:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎

e.en: The nurse wrapped a clean {bandage} around his arm.
e.zh: 护士在他手臂上缠了一条干净的绷带。

e.en: Please {bandage} the wound before it gets infected.
e.zh: 请在伤口感染前把它包扎好。

bandaged.t:
adj. 缠着绷带的
v. 包扎（过去式）

e.en: She {bandaged} her ankle after twisting it on the trail.
e.zh: 她在小路上扭伤脚踝后包扎了一下。

e.en: He showed up with a heavily {bandaged} hand.
e.zh: 他出现时手上缠满了厚厚的绷带。

e.en: The first-aid kit is full of {bandages} and antiseptics.
e.zh: 急救包里装满了绷带和消毒剂。

e.en: He {bandages} the cut quickly to stop the bleeding.
e.zh: 他迅速包扎伤口以止血。

bandaging.t:
v. 正在包扎
n. 包扎（动作）

e.en: The medic was {bandaging} the soldier's leg in the field.
e.zh: 军医正在战场上给士兵的腿包扎。

e.en: Proper {bandaging} can prevent further injury to the wound.
e.zh: 正确的包扎能防止伤口进一步受伤。

e.en: He tied a red {bandana} around his head while hiking.
e.zh: 他徒步时在头上系了一条红色头巾。

e.en: The dog wore a cute {bandana} around its neck.
e.zh: 那只狗脖子上戴着一条可爱的小方巾。

bandanna.t: n. 印花大头巾（bandana 异体）

e.en: She wiped her forehead with a faded blue {bandanna}.
e.zh: 她用一条褪色的蓝色头巾擦了擦额头。

e.en: Cowboys often wore a {bandanna} to block dust on the trail.
e.zh: 牛仔常戴头巾在路上挡灰尘。

bandar.t: n. 港口；班达尔（波斯语地名用字）

e.en: We landed at {Bandar} Seri Begawan, the capital of Brunei.
e.zh: 我们降落在文莱首都斯里巴加湾市。

e.en: In Hindi, {bandar} simply means monkey.
e.zh: 在印地语中,bandar就是猴子的意思。

bandbox.t: n. 轻便的帽盒或领饰盒

e.en: The small stadium feels like a {bandbox} on home-run nights.
e.zh: 在本垒打频出的夜晚,这座小球场就像个鞋盒。

e.en: She kept old hats stored in a vintage {bandbox}.
e.zh: 她把旧帽子收在一个复古的圆纸盒里。

bandeau.t: n. 束胸式上衣；窄发带

e.en: She wore a strapless {bandeau} top to the beach.
e.zh: 她穿了一件无肩带抹胸去海滩。

e.en: The vintage {bandeau} held back her curls elegantly.
e.zh: 那条复古发带优雅地束住了她的卷发。

banded.t:
adj. 有条纹的
v. 联合起来（过去式）

e.en: Local farmers {banded} together to fight the new tax.
e.zh: 当地农民联合起来反对这项新税。

e.en: The {banded} snake slithered quickly into the grass.
e.zh: 那条带斑纹的蛇迅速滑入草丛。

e.en: Silicon has a {bandgap} of about 1.1 electron volts.
e.zh: 硅的带隙约为1.1电子伏特。

e.en: Engineers tune the {bandgap} to optimize solar cell efficiency.
e.zh: 工程师调整带隙以优化太阳能电池效率。

banding.t:
n. 条带；带状花纹
v. 联合（进行时）

e.en: Researchers are {banding} migratory birds to track their routes.
e.zh: 研究人员正在给候鸟戴环以追踪迁徙路线。

e.en: You can see slight color {banding} in the gradient.
e.zh: 在渐变色中可以看到轻微的色带。

e.en: A masked {bandit} robbed the stagecoach in the old film.
e.zh: 老电影里一个蒙面强盗抢劫了驿马车。

e.en: The little boy is a snack {bandit} after school.
e.zh: 放学后那个小男孩就是个零食大盗。

banditry.t: n. 盗匪活动；打家劫舍

e.en: Rampant {banditry} forced travelers to hire armed guards.
e.zh: 猖獗的盗匪活动迫使旅客雇佣武装护卫。

e.en: The remote province suffered from years of {banditry}.
e.zh: 那个偏远省份多年来饱受匪患。

bandleader.t: n. 乐队指挥；乐队队长

e.en: The {bandleader} counted off the tempo before the song began.
e.zh: 乐队队长在歌曲开始前数着节拍。

e.en: Duke Ellington was a legendary jazz {bandleader}.
e.zh: 艾灵顿公爵是传奇的爵士乐队领班。

bandmaster.t: n. 乐队指挥（尤指军乐队）

e.en: The military {bandmaster} drilled the musicians every morning.
e.zh: 军乐队指挥每天早上都训练乐手。

e.en: A skilled {bandmaster} can unite dozens of players seamlessly.
e.zh: 一位优秀的乐队指挥能让数十名乐手浑然一体。

e.en: The soldier wore a {bandolier} of bullets across his chest.
e.zh: 那名士兵胸前斜挎着一条子弹带。

e.en: His costume included a leather {bandolier} and a wide hat.
e.zh: 他的服装配有皮制弹药带和一顶宽边帽。

bandoneon.t: n. 班多钮手风琴（探戈乐器）

e.en: The tango dancer moved to the haunting {bandoneon}.
e.zh: 探戈舞者随着哀婉的班多钮琴起舞。

e.en: He has played the {bandoneon} in Buenos Aires for decades.
e.zh: 他在布宜诺斯艾利斯演奏班多钮琴几十年了。

e.en: The radio uses a {bandpass} filter to isolate the signal.
e.zh: 这台收音机用带通滤波器来分离信号。

e.en: Engineers added a {bandpass} circuit to remove noise.
e.zh: 工程师加了一个带通电路来消除噪声。

bands.t:
n. 乐队；带子（复数）
v. 联合（三单）

e.en: Several local {bands} will play at the music festival.
e.zh: 音乐节上将有好几支本地乐队演出。

e.en: The drawer is full of colorful rubber {bands}.
e.zh: 抽屉里装满了五颜六色的橡皮筋。

bandsman.t: n. 乐队成员（尤指军乐队）

e.en: Each {bandsman} polished his instrument before the parade.
e.zh: 每位乐队成员在游行前都把乐器擦得锃亮。

e.en: The veteran {bandsman} had marched in countless ceremonies.
e.zh: 这位资深乐手参加过无数次仪式行进。

e.en: The orchestra played from the park's old wooden {bandstand}.
e.zh: 乐团在公园那座老旧的木制乐台上演奏。

e.en: Children gathered around the {bandstand} for the free concert.
e.zh: 孩子们围在乐台旁听免费音乐会。

bandwagon.t:
n. 潮流；跟风的事物
n. 花车

e.en: Investors jumped on the AI {bandwagon} after the breakthrough.
e.zh: 那次突破之后,投资者纷纷搭上了AI的潮流。

e.en: Don't join the {bandwagon} just because everyone else does.
e.zh: 别只因为大家都跟风就盲从。

bandwidth.t:
n. 带宽（网络）
n. 精力、处理能力

e.en: Streaming 4K video requires a lot of {bandwidth}.
e.zh: 播放4K视频需要很大的带宽。

e.en: I don't have the {bandwidth} to take on another project.
e.zh: 我没有精力再接一个项目了。

bandy.t:
v. 来回传递（话语）
adj. 弯曲的

e.en: Please don't {bandy} my name about the office.
e.zh: 请别在办公室里到处提我的名字。

e.en: The two lawyers {bandy} arguments back and forth in court.
e.zh: 两位律师在法庭上来回辩论。

e.en: Spam emails are the {bane} of my workday.
e.zh: 垃圾邮件是我工作中的祸根。

e.en: Traffic jams are the {bane} of commuters everywhere.
e.zh: 堵车是各地通勤者的烦恼之源。

e.en: Misinformation has a {baneful} effect on public discourse.
e.zh: 虚假信息对公共讨论产生了恶劣影响。

e.en: The novel describes the {baneful} influence of greed.
e.zh: 这部小说描述了贪婪带来的祸害。

e.en: We hiked through the stunning peaks of {Banff} National Park.
e.zh: 我们徒步穿越了班夫国家公园壮丽的山峰。

e.en: {Banff} is a popular ski destination in the Canadian Rockies.
e.zh: 班夫是加拿大落基山脉热门的滑雪胜地。

banffshire.t: n. 班夫郡（苏格兰旧郡）

e.en: My grandmother grew up in rural {Banffshire}, Scotland.
e.zh: 我奶奶在苏格兰班夫郡的乡下长大。

e.en: Old maps still label this region as {Banffshire}.
e.zh: 旧地图上这片地区仍标注为班夫郡。

bang.t:
n. 砰的巨响
v. 猛击；砰地关上

e.en: The door shut with a loud {bang}.
e.zh: 门砰的一声重重关上了。

e.en: Don't {bang} the table when you're frustrated.
e.zh: 沮丧的时候别使劲拍桌子。

bangalore.t: n. 班加罗尔（印度城市）

e.en: Many tech startups are based in {Bangalore}, India.
e.zh: 许多科技初创公司都设在印度班加罗尔。

e.en: She moved to {Bangalore} for a software engineering job.
e.zh: 她为了一份软件工程师的工作搬到了班加罗尔。

banged.t: v. 猛击、砰地撞（bang 的过去式）

e.en: He {banged} his knee against the coffee table.
e.zh: 他的膝盖撞到了咖啡桌上。

e.en: She {banged} on the door until someone answered.
e.zh: 她使劲敲门直到有人开。

banger.t:
n. 香肠（英式俚语）
n. 劲爆歌曲

e.en: That new song is an absolute {banger}.
e.zh: 那首新歌真是首神曲。

e.en: For breakfast we had {banger} and mash.
e.zh: 早餐我们吃了香肠配土豆泥。

banging.t:
v. 猛敲；砰砰作响
adj. 超赞的（俚）

e.en: The neighbors kept {banging} on the wall all night.
e.zh: 邻居整晚不停地敲墙。

e.en: There was loud {banging} coming from the basement.
e.zh: 地下室传来很大的敲击声。

e.en: The street food in {Bangkok} is incredibly delicious.
e.zh: 曼谷的街头小吃非常美味。

e.en: Our flight to {Bangkok} leaves early tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我们飞往曼谷的航班明天一早起飞。

e.en: {Bangladesh} is famous for its lush rivers and deltas.
e.zh: 孟加拉国以其茂密的河流与三角洲闻名。

e.en: Many garments in our shops are made in {Bangladesh}.
e.zh: 我们店里很多服装都是孟加拉国制造的。

bangladeshi.t:
adj. 孟加拉国的
n. 孟加拉国人

e.en: My coworker is {Bangladeshi} and shared some delicious biryani.
e.zh: 我同事是孟加拉国人,带来了好吃的香饭。

e.en: The {Bangladeshi} cricket team won an exciting match yesterday.
e.zh: 孟加拉国板球队昨天赢得了一场精彩的比赛。

e.en: Many {Bangladeshis} work in the booming garment industry.
e.zh: 许多孟加拉国人在蓬勃发展的服装业工作。

e.en: The festival drew {Bangladeshis} from across the city.
e.zh: 这个节日吸引了全城的孟加拉国人前来。

e.en: She wore a gold {bangle} on her left wrist.
e.zh: 她左手腕上戴着一只金手镯。

e.en: The shop sells handmade silver {bangle} bracelets.
e.zh: 这家店出售手工制作的银手镯。

e.en: We drove up to {Bangor}, Maine for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们周末开车去了缅因州的班戈。

e.en: {Bangor} University in Wales has a beautiful coastal campus.
e.zh: 威尔士的班戈大学有一个美丽的海滨校园。

bangs.t:
n. 刘海（前额发）
v. 猛击（bang 的三单）

e.en: She just got short {bangs} cut at the salon.
e.zh: 她刚在美发店剪了短刘海。

e.en: He {bangs} the drum loudly during every song.
e.zh: 每首歌他都使劲敲鼓。

banish.t:
v. 驱逐；放逐
v. 消除（念头等）

e.en: The new app helps {banish} distractions while you work.
e.zh: 这款新应用帮你在工作时摆脱干扰。

e.en: The king decided to {banish} the disloyal advisor.
e.zh: 国王决定将那位不忠的谋士流放。

e.en: The royal court {banished} him to a distant island.
e.zh: 宫廷把他流放到了一个遥远的岛屿。

e.en: Good coffee {banished} the morning fog from my brain.
e.zh: 一杯好咖啡驱散了我早晨脑中的迷雾。

e.en: Sunlight {banishes} the shadows from every corner of the room.
e.zh: 阳光把房间每个角落的阴影都驱散了。

e.en: The teacher {banishes} phones from her classroom every morning.
e.zh: 老师每天早上都把手机赶出她的教室。

banishing.t: v. 正在驱逐（banish 的现在分词）

e.en: The meditation app focuses on {banishing} anxious thoughts.
e.zh: 这款冥想应用专注于驱散焦虑的念头。

e.en: The judge spoke of {banishing} the criminal from the kingdom.
e.zh: 法官谈到要将这名罪犯逐出王国。

e.en: His {banishment} from court lasted for nearly ten years.
e.zh: 他被逐出宫廷的时间持续了将近十年。

e.en: Online {banishment} from the platform devastated the influencer.
e.zh: 被平台封禁让那位网红深受打击。

e.en: The history book lists several royal {banishments} from that era.
e.zh: 那本史书列出了那个时代几次皇室流放事件。

e.en: Repeated {banishments} from various forums followed his rude posts.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的发帖之后被多个论坛接连封禁。

e.en: She slid her hand along the polished {banister} as she descended.
e.zh: 她下楼时手沿着光滑的扶手滑下。

e.en: The wooden {banister} creaked under his weight.
e.zh: 木制楼梯扶手在他的重压下吱嘎作响。

e.en: After the hike we relaxed in a traditional Russian {banja}.
e.zh: 徒步之后我们在传统的俄式蒸汽浴室里放松。

e.en: The village {banja} was heated with birch logs every Saturday.
e.zh: 村里的蒸汽浴室每周六都用桦木烧热。

e.en: He strummed a lively tune on his {banjo} by the fire.
e.zh: 他在篝火旁用班卓琴弹了一首欢快的曲子。

e.en: Bluegrass music wouldn't be the same without the {banjo}.
e.zh: 没有班卓琴,蓝草音乐就不是那个味儿了。

bank.t:
n. 银行
n. 河岸；v. 存入银行

e.en: I need to stop by the {bank} before it closes.
e.zh: 我得在银行关门前去一趟。

e.en: They sat on the grassy {bank} of the river watching ducks.
e.zh: 他们坐在长满青草的河岸上看鸭子。

e.en: She's the most {bankable} star in Hollywood right now.
e.zh: 她是目前好莱坞最具票房号召力的明星。

e.en: Investors want a {bankable} business plan before signing.
e.zh: 投资者签字前想看到一份靠谱可融资的商业计划。

e.en: My grandmother still updates her {bankbook} at the branch every month.
e.zh: 我奶奶每个月还到银行网点去更新存折。

e.en: He proudly showed his first {bankbook} to his parents.
e.zh: 他自豪地把第一本存折拿给父母看。

banked.t: v. 存入银行（bank 的过去式）

e.en: The pilot {banked} the plane sharply to the left.
e.zh: 飞行员让飞机猛地向左倾斜转弯。

e.en: She {banked} her bonus instead of spending it.
e.zh: 她把奖金存进了银行,没有花掉。

e.en: The {banker} reviewed her loan application carefully.
e.zh: 那位银行职员仔细审阅了她的贷款申请。

e.en: He left law to become an investment {banker} in London.
e.zh: 他离开了律师行业,去伦敦做投资银行家。

e.en: The {bankers} met to discuss the new interest rate policy.
e.zh: 银行家们开会讨论新的利率政策。

e.en: Many {bankers} work long hours during deal season.
e.zh: 许多银行家在交易季会工作很长时间。

bankhead.t: n. 班克黑德（姓氏/地名）

e.en: Tallulah {Bankhead} was famous for her husky voice and sharp wit.
e.zh: 塔卢拉·班克黑德以沙哑的嗓音和犀利的机智闻名。

e.en: The town of {Bankhead} sits quietly in rural Alabama.
e.zh: 班克黑德镇静静地坐落在阿拉巴马州的乡村。

e.en: Online {banking} has made paying bills incredibly easy.
e.zh: 网上银行让付账单变得非常方便。

e.en: She built a long career in investment {banking}.
e.zh: 她在投资银行业建立了长久的职业生涯。

bankings.t: n. 银行业务（复数，罕用）

e.en: The report compared retail {bankings} across several European countries.
e.zh: 报告比较了几个欧洲国家的零售银行业务。

e.en: Different {bankings} offer varying rates on savings accounts.
e.zh: 不同的银行业务对储蓄账户提供不同的利率。

e.en: He pulled a crisp fifty-pound {banknote} from his wallet.
e.zh: 他从钱包里抽出一张崭新的五十英镑钞票。

e.en: The new {banknote} features a hologram to prevent forgery.
e.zh: 新版纸币加入了防伪全息图。

bankroll.t:
v. 出资资助
n. 资金

e.en: A wealthy uncle agreed to {bankroll} her startup.
e.zh: 一位富有的叔叔同意为她的创业公司提供资金。

e.en: He pulled out a thick {bankroll} to pay the bill.
e.zh: 他掏出一沓厚厚的钞票来付账。

bankrupt.t:
adj. 破产的
v. 使破产

e.en: The retailer went {bankrupt} after years of declining sales.
e.zh: 这家零售商在销售多年下滑后宣告破产。

e.en: Bad investments left him morally and financially {bankrupt}.
e.zh: 糟糕的投资让他在道德和财务上都彻底破产。

e.en: Small business {bankruptcies} surged during the recession.
e.zh: 经济衰退期间,小企业的破产案件激增。

e.en: The court handles dozens of {bankruptcies} each month.
e.zh: 该法院每月处理数十起破产案件。

e.en: The airline filed for {bankruptcy} after fuel prices soared.
e.zh: 油价飙升后,该航空公司申请破产保护。

e.en: She narrowly avoided {bankruptcy} by selling her house.
e.zh: 她靠卖掉房子才勉强避免了破产。

e.en: A single bad lawsuit {bankrupted} the family business.
e.zh: 一场糟糕的诉讼就让这家家族企业破了产。

e.en: Reckless spending {bankrupted} him within two years.
e.zh: 挥霍无度让他在两年内就破了产。

e.en: The medical bills were slowly {bankrupting} the family.
e.zh: 医疗费用正在慢慢让这个家庭走向破产。

e.en: Subsidies are {bankrupting} the local government.
e.zh: 各种补贴正让地方政府陷入破产境地。

bankrupts.t:
n. 破产者
v. 使破产（三单）

e.en: The new tax law often {bankrupts} struggling small farms.
e.zh: 新税法常常让本就挣扎的小农场走向破产。

e.en: The court appointed a trustee to manage the {bankrupts}' assets.
e.zh: 法院指定了一名受托人来管理破产人的资产。

banks.t:
n. 银行（复数）
n. 河岸（复数）

e.en: Most {banks} now offer mobile apps for transfers and deposits.
e.zh: 现在大多数银行都提供手机应用来转账和存款。

e.en: Children played along the muddy {banks} of the stream.
e.zh: 孩子们在小溪泥泞的岸边玩耍。

e.en: We picnicked on the grassy {bankside} after the long walk.
e.zh: 长途散步后我们在草地河岸边野餐。

e.en: A heron stood motionless on the {bankside} at dawn.
e.zh: 破晓时分一只苍鹭一动不动地立在河岸上。

bann.t: n. 班恩河（北爱尔兰河流）

e.en: The River {Bann} flows through Northern Ireland into the Atlantic.
e.zh: 班恩河流经北爱尔兰汇入大西洋。

e.en: Anglers gather along the {Bann} every summer to fish for salmon.
e.zh: 每年夏天垂钓者都会聚集在班恩河边钓鲑鱼。

barbecues.t:
n. 烧烤（聚会、架子）
v. 烧烤

e.en: Summer {barbecues} are a beloved tradition in many American suburbs.
e.zh: 夏日烧烤是许多美国郊区人喜爱的传统。

e.en: She {barbecues} every Sunday when the weather is nice.
e.zh: 天气好的时候她每个周日都会烧烤。

barbecuing.t: v. 烧烤（barbecue 的现在分词）

e.en: Dad is {barbecuing} burgers on the patio right now.
e.zh: 爸爸正在露台上烤汉堡肉饼呢。

e.en: {Barbecuing} over charcoal gives the meat a smoky flavor.
e.zh: 用木炭烧烤能给肉带来烟熏的风味。

barbed.t: adj. 带倒刺的；（言辞）尖刻的

e.en: A {barbed} wire fence surrounds the abandoned factory.
e.zh: 废弃的工厂周围围着一圈带刺铁丝网。

e.en: Her {barbed} comment clearly hurt his feelings.
e.zh: 她那句尖刻的评论显然伤了他的心。

barbel.t: n. 鱼的触须；欧洲鲃（一种淡水鱼）

e.en: The angler proudly held up a five-pound {barbel}.
e.zh: 那位钓鱼者自豪地举起一条五磅重的鲃鱼。

e.en: A catfish uses each {barbel} to sense food in muddy water.
e.zh: 鲶鱼用触须在浑水中感知食物。

e.en: He loaded the {barbell} with extra weight for squats.
e.zh: 他往杠铃上加了更多重量来做深蹲。

e.en: Lifting a heavy {barbell} requires proper form and focus.
e.zh: 举起沉重的杠铃需要正确的姿势和专注力。

barbeque.t: n. 烧烤（barbecue 的变体拼法）

e.en: The neighbors invited us over for a backyard {barbeque}.
e.zh: 邻居邀请我们去他们后院烧烤。

e.en: She marinated the chicken before throwing it on the {barbeque}.
e.zh: 她在把鸡肉放上烧烤架前先腌制了一下。

barber.t:
n. 理发师
v. 给…理发

e.en: My {barber} always trims my hair exactly the way I like.
e.zh: 我的理发师总能完全按我喜欢的方式剪头发。

e.en: The old {barber} has been cutting hair for over forty years.
e.zh: 那位老理发师已经剪了四十多年的头发了。

barberry.t: n. 小檗（一种带刺灌木）

e.en: Tart {barberry} berries are often used in Persian rice dishes.
e.zh: 酸酸的小檗果常用于波斯米饭料理中。

e.en: The garden hedge of {barberry} turns bright red in autumn.
e.zh: 花园里的小檗树篱到了秋天会变成鲜红色。

barbers.t: n. 理发师们；理发店（barber 的复数/所有格）

e.en: Several {barbers} in town are booked solid for the holidays.
e.zh: 镇上几位理发师在假期都被预约满了。

e.en: The {barbers} chatted with customers while sharpening their scissors.
e.zh: 理发师们一边磨剪刀一边和顾客聊天。

e.en: He stops by the corner {barbershop} every two weeks.
e.zh: 他每两周都去街角的理发店一次。

e.en: The vintage {barbershop} still uses leather chairs from the 1950s.
e.zh: 这家复古理发店还在使用上世纪五十年代的皮椅。

e.en: Old-school {barbershops} are making a comeback in trendy neighborhoods.
e.zh: 传统理发店在时尚街区正悄然回归。

e.en: Many {barbershops} now offer hot towel shaves and beard trims.
e.zh: 许多理发店如今提供热毛巾刮脸和修胡服务。

barbican.t: n. 瓮城；城堡外围的防御塔楼

e.en: Tourists climbed the medieval {barbican} for sweeping castle views.
e.zh: 游客们登上中世纪的瓮城,饱览城堡全景。

e.en: The {barbican} once defended the main gate from attackers.
