e.zh: 这座瓮城曾用于抵御来犯者保护正门。

barbie.t: n. 芭比娃娃；（澳俚）烧烤

e.en: She bought her daughter a new {Barbie} doll for her birthday.
e.zh: 她给女儿买了一个新的芭比娃娃当生日礼物。

e.en: Throw another shrimp on the {barbie}, mate!
e.zh: 哥们,再往烤架上放只虾吧!

barbiturate.t: n. 巴比妥类药物（镇静安眠药）

e.en: Doctors rarely prescribe {barbiturate} medications anymore due to safety concerns.
e.zh: 出于安全考虑,医生现在很少开巴比妥类药物了。

e.en: The patient overdosed on a {barbiturate} prescribed years ago.
e.zh: 病人服用多年前开的巴比妥类药物过量。

e.en: Many rivers now require anglers to use {barbless} hooks.
e.zh: 许多河流现在要求垂钓者使用无倒刺鱼钩。

e.en: A {barbless} hook makes it easier to release fish unharmed.
e.zh: 无倒刺鱼钩更便于将鱼安全地放生。

barbour.t: n. 巴伯（英国户外服装品牌）；姓氏

e.en: He wore a waxed {Barbour} jacket to walk the dog.
e.zh: 他穿着一件打蜡的巴伯尔夹克去遛狗。

e.en: My old {Barbour} has lasted through twenty British winters.
e.zh: 我那件旧巴伯尔外套已经熬过了二十个英国寒冬。

e.en: The rancher repaired the broken {barbwire} along the fence line.
e.zh: 牧场主修补了围栏沿线断裂的带刺铁丝。

e.en: Climbing over {barbwire} can leave nasty cuts on your hands.
e.zh: 翻越带刺铁丝网可能会让你的手被严重划伤。

barcelona.t: n. 巴塞罗那（西班牙城市）

e.en: We spent a week exploring the streets of {Barcelona} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们花了一周时间在巴塞罗那的街道上闲逛。

e.en: {Barcelona} is famous for Gaudí's stunning architecture.
e.zh: 巴塞罗那以高迪那令人惊叹的建筑而闻名。

e.en: She paid for the flights using her {Barclaycard} rewards points.
e.zh: 她用巴克莱信用卡的积分支付了机票钱。

e.en: My {Barclaycard} statement arrived in the mail this morning.
e.zh: 我的巴克莱信用卡账单今天早上邮寄到了。

e.en: He opened a savings account at {Barclays} last week.
e.zh: 他上周在巴克莱银行开了一个储蓄账户。

e.en: {Barclays} announced strong quarterly profits to its shareholders.
e.zh: 巴克莱银行向股东公布了强劲的季度利润。

e.en: The traveling {bard} sang ballads in every village inn.
e.zh: 那位流浪吟游诗人在每家村庄客栈里都唱民谣。

e.en: Shakespeare is often called the {Bard} of Avon.
e.zh: 莎士比亚常被称为埃文河畔的吟游诗人。

bardic.t: adj. 吟游诗人的；诗人风格的

e.en: His poetry has a {bardic} rhythm reminiscent of ancient Celtic verse.
e.zh: 他的诗有一种吟游诗人般的韵律,令人想起古凯尔特诗歌。

e.en: The festival celebrates the {bardic} traditions of medieval Wales.
e.zh: 这个节日是为了庆祝中世纪威尔士的吟游诗传统。

bardot.t: n. 芭铎（姓氏，常指碧姬·芭铎）

e.en: Brigitte {Bardot} became a global icon during the 1960s.
e.zh: 碧姬·芭铎在二十世纪六十年代成为了全球偶像。

e.en: She styled her hair in a classic {Bardot} updo for the party.
e.zh: 她为派对梳了一个经典的芭铎式盘发。

bare.t:
adj. 裸露的；仅有的
v. 露出

e.en: The walls of his apartment were completely {bare}.
e.zh: 他公寓的墙壁完全是光秃秃的。

e.en: She walked across the cold floor in {bare} feet.
e.zh: 她光着脚走过冰冷的地板。

e.en: She learned to ride {bareback} as a child on her grandfather's farm.
e.zh: 她小时候在外公的农场学会了不用马鞍骑马。

e.en: Riding {bareback} requires excellent balance and core strength.
e.zh: 裸骑马匹需要极好的平衡感和核心力量。

bared.t: v. 露出、袒露（bare 的过去式）

e.en: The dog growled and {bared} its teeth at the stranger.
e.zh: 那只狗对着陌生人咆哮,露出了牙齿。

e.en: He {bared} his soul in the heartfelt memoir.
e.zh: 他在那本感人的回忆录里袒露了心声。

barefaced.t: adj. 厚颜无耻的；毫不掩饰的

e.en: That was a {barefaced} lie and everyone in the room knew it.
e.zh: 那是赤裸裸的谎言,屋里每个人都心知肚明。

e.en: His {barefaced} attempt to take credit angered the whole team.
e.zh: 他厚颜无耻地抢功劳,激怒了整个团队。

e.en: The kids ran {barefoot} across the warm summer grass.
e.zh: 孩子们光着脚跑过温暖的夏日草地。

e.en: Many tourists walk {barefoot} along the powdery white beach.
e.zh: 许多游客光着脚走在细腻的白沙滩上。

barefooted.t: adj./adv. 赤脚的（barefoot 的变体）

e.en: The monk traveled {barefooted} through the mountain villages.
e.zh: 那位僧人赤着脚走遍了那些山村。

e.en: She danced {barefooted} on the wooden stage all night.
e.zh: 她整晚都赤脚在木台上跳舞。

e.en: He stood {bareheaded} in the rain to honor the fallen soldiers.
e.zh: 他不戴帽子站在雨中,向阵亡将士致敬。

e.en: Going {bareheaded} in the desert sun is genuinely dangerous.
e.zh: 在沙漠烈日下不戴帽子其实非常危险。

e.en: I can {barely} hear the music over the traffic.
e.zh: 车流声太大,我几乎听不到音乐。

e.en: She {barely} passed the exam after weeks of cramming.
e.zh: 她临时抱佛脚几周后勉强通过了考试。

bareness.t: n. 裸露；光秃；空无一物

e.en: The {bareness} of the room made it feel cold.
e.zh: 房间的空荡让人觉得冷清。

e.en: I love the stark {bareness} of winter trees.
e.zh: 我喜欢冬日树木那种光秃秃的简洁感。

barents.t: n. 巴伦支（海，位于北冰洋）

e.en: Russian fishing fleets operate across the {Barents} Sea.
e.zh: 俄罗斯渔船队在巴伦支海作业。

e.en: Climate change is rapidly warming the {Barents} region.
e.zh: 气候变化正使巴伦支地区迅速变暖。

bares.t: v. 露出、袒露（bare 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The dog {bares} its teeth when strangers approach.
e.zh: 陌生人靠近时,这只狗会龇牙。

e.en: Her memoir {bares} the painful truth of her childhood.
e.zh: 她的回忆录揭露了童年的痛苦真相。

barf.t:
v. 呕吐（俚）
n. 呕吐物

e.en: That smell makes me want to {barf}.
e.zh: 那股味道熏得我想吐。

e.en: The kid ate too much candy and started to {barf}.
e.zh: 那孩子吃太多糖,开始呕吐起来。

bargain.t:
n. 便宜货；交易
v. 讨价还价

e.en: This laptop is a real {bargain} at half price.
e.zh: 这台笔记本半价,真是超值。

e.en: They tried to {bargain} with the seller over the price.
e.zh: 他们试图就价格与卖家讨价还价。

bargained.t: v. 讨价还价（bargain 的过去式）

e.en: She {bargained} hard and got a great deal.
e.zh: 她使劲砍价,谈到了很划算的价钱。

e.en: The trip turned out harder than we {bargained} for.
e.zh: 这趟旅行比我们预想的要艰难得多。

e.en: She's a tough {bargainer} when it comes to salary.
e.zh: 谈薪水的时候,她是个难缠的谈判者。

e.en: A skilled {bargainer} never shows desperation in negotiations.
e.zh: 高明的谈判者在谈判中从不露出急切之色。

e.en: The union is {bargaining} for higher wages this year.
e.zh: 工会今年正在争取更高的工资。

e.en: She has little {bargaining} power as a new employee.
e.zh: 作为新员工,她几乎没有讨价还价的余地。

bargains.t:
n. 便宜货（复数）
v. 讨价还价

e.en: You can find great {bargains} during the Black Friday sale.
e.zh: 黑色星期五促销时能淘到很多便宜货。

e.en: He always {bargains} with vendors at the night market.
e.zh: 他在夜市总是跟摊主讨价还价。

barge.t:
n. 驳船
v. 莽撞闯入

e.en: A coal {barge} slowly drifted down the river.
e.zh: 一艘运煤驳船缓缓顺流而下。

e.en: Don't just {barge} into my office without knocking.
e.zh: 别不敲门就闯进我的办公室。

e.en: The old {bargee} steered the boat through the narrow lock.
e.zh: 老船工驾着船穿过狭窄的船闸。

e.en: A {bargee} spends most of his life on the canal.
e.zh: 驳船船工大半辈子都在运河上度过。

bargepole.t: n. 撑驳船用的长杆（多用于习语 wouldn't touch with a ~）

e.en: I wouldn't touch that deal with a {bargepole}.
e.zh: 那笔交易我可碰都不想碰。

e.en: Most investors won't go near that stock with a {bargepole}.
e.zh: 大多数投资者对那只股票避之唯恐不及。

barham.t: n. 巴勒姆（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: The village of {Barham} sits quietly in the Kent countryside.
e.zh: 巴勒姆村静静地坐落在肯特郡的乡间。

e.en: HMS {Barham} was a famous British battleship of WWII.
e.zh: 皇家海军巴勒姆号是二战时期著名的英国战列舰。

e.en: We took a ferry from {Bari} to Croatia last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们从巴里坐渡轮去克罗地亚。

e.en: {Bari} is famous for its old town and seafood.
e.zh: 巴里以其古城和海鲜闻名。

bariatric.t: adj. 减肥（医学）的；治疗肥胖症的

e.en: She underwent {bariatric} surgery to manage her weight.
e.zh: 她接受了减重手术以控制体重。

e.en: The hospital opened a new {bariatric} clinic last month.
e.zh: 医院上个月开设了一家新的减重诊所。

baring.t: v. 露出、袒露（bare 的现在分词）

e.en: The dog growled, {baring} its sharp white teeth.
e.zh: 那条狗低吼着,露出了锋利的白牙。

e.en: She wrote a blog post {baring} her struggles with anxiety.
e.zh: 她写了一篇博文,坦露自己与焦虑的抗争。

banned.t:
adj. 被禁止的
v. ban 的过去式

e.en: Smoking is {banned} in all indoor public spaces.
e.zh: 所有室内公共场所都禁止吸烟。

e.en: The player was {banned} for two games after the tackle.
e.zh: 那名球员因那次铲球被禁赛两场。

e.en: A huge {banner} welcomed the team back to the stadium.
e.zh: 一条巨大的横幅欢迎球队回到主场。

e.en: The website ran a holiday {banner} across the homepage.
e.zh: 该网站在首页放了一条节日横幅广告。

e.en: Colorful {banners} hung from every lamppost during the festival.
e.zh: 节日期间每根灯柱上都挂着五彩缤纷的横幅。

e.en: The protesters carried {banners} demanding cleaner air.
e.zh: 抗议者举着要求改善空气质量的横幅。

banning.t: v. 禁止（ban 的现在分词）

e.en: The city is considering {banning} plastic bags at checkout.
e.zh: 市政府正考虑在结账时禁用塑料袋。

e.en: {Banning} cars from the city center reduced air pollution sharply.
e.zh: 禁止汽车进入市中心大幅降低了空气污染。

e.en: The old {bannister} wobbled when he leaned against it.
e.zh: 他靠上去时,那旧楼梯扶手摇晃了起来。

e.en: She gripped the {bannister} tightly as she climbed.
e.zh: 她上楼时紧紧抓着扶手。

e.en: He baked a fresh {bannock} over the campfire.
e.zh: 他在营火上烤了一块新鲜的班诺克饼。

e.en: Scottish {bannock} is a simple, hearty flatbread.
e.zh: 苏格兰班诺克饼是一种简单又顶饱的烙饼。

bannockburn.t: n. 班诺克本（苏格兰地名）

e.en: The Battle of {Bannockburn} was a turning point for Scottish independence.
e.zh: 班诺克本战役是苏格兰独立的转折点。

e.en: Tourists visit {Bannockburn} to see the historic battlefield.
e.zh: 游客们参观班诺克本是为了看那处历史战场。

e.en: The vicar read the {banns} of marriage in church on Sunday.
e.zh: 牧师周日在教堂宣读了结婚预告。

e.en: Their {banns} were published three weeks before the wedding.
e.zh: 他们的结婚预告在婚礼前三周公布了。

e.en: The sign above the door read "{Banque} de Paris".
e.zh: 门上方的招牌写着"巴黎银行"。

e.en: She withdrew euros from a small {banque} on the corner.
e.zh: 她在街角的一家小银行取了欧元。

banquet.t:
n. 宴会，盛宴
v. 设宴款待

e.en: The hotel hosted a lavish wedding {banquet} for two hundred guests.
e.zh: 酒店为两百位宾客举办了一场奢华的婚宴。

e.en: After the awards, everyone moved to the {banquet} hall.
e.zh: 颁奖结束后,大家都移步到宴会厅。

banqueting.t:
n. 举办宴会
adj. 宴会的

e.en: The {banqueting} hall was decorated with chandeliers and roses.
e.zh: 宴会厅里装饰着水晶吊灯和玫瑰花。

e.en: Guests spent the evening {banqueting} and toasting the bride.
e.zh: 宾客们整晚都在宴饮并向新娘敬酒。

banquette.t: n. 靠墙长椅（餐厅常见）

e.en: We grabbed the cozy {banquette} in the corner of the café.
e.zh: 我们抢到了咖啡馆角落那张舒适的长椅卡座。

e.en: A leather {banquette} ran along one wall of the restaurant.
e.zh: 餐厅的一面墙边摆着一张皮质长椅卡座。

e.en: In Macbeth, {Banquo}'s ghost appears at the dinner table.
e.zh: 在《麦克白》中,班柯的鬼魂出现在餐桌旁。

e.en: {Banquo} is killed by assassins hired by Macbeth.
e.zh: 班柯被麦克白雇来的刺客杀害了。

bans.t:
n. 禁令（复数）
v. 禁止

e.en: Several countries have introduced {bans} on single-use plastics.
e.zh: 多个国家已对一次性塑料制品出台禁令。

e.en: The platform {bans} accounts that spread harmful misinformation.
e.zh: 该平台会封禁传播有害虚假信息的账号。

banshee.t: n. 报丧女妖（爱尔兰传说）

e.en: The wind howled like a {banshee} through the empty house.
e.zh: 风像女妖一样在空荡的房子里呼啸。

e.en: In Irish folklore, the {banshee} wails to foretell death.
e.zh: 在爱尔兰民间传说中,女妖的哀号预示着死亡。

bantam.t:
n. 矮脚鸡
adj. 小型的

e.en: They keep a few {bantam} hens in the backyard.
e.zh: 他们在后院养了几只矮脚鸡。

e.en: Despite his {bantam} size, he played fearlessly on defense.
e.zh: 虽然个子矮小,他在防守端踢得无所畏惧。

e.en: He won the {bantamweight} title after five tough rounds.
e.zh: 经过五个艰难的回合,他赢得了雏量级冠军。

e.en: The {bantamweight} division has produced some of boxing's quickest fighters.
e.zh: 雏量级培养出了拳坛一些最敏捷的拳手。

banter.t:
n. 打趣，调侃
v. 开玩笑

e.en: The two hosts kept up cheerful {banter} throughout the show.
e.zh: 两位主持人在整场节目中一直在愉快地打趣调侃。

e.en: There's always friendly {banter} between the coworkers at lunch.
e.zh: 同事们午餐时总会友好地互相调侃。

e.en: They were {bantering} about who would pay the bill.
e.zh: 他们正在打趣地争论谁来买单。

e.en: His {bantering} tone made the interview feel relaxed.
e.zh: 他打趣的语气让采访显得轻松自在。

e.en: Swahili belongs to the {Bantu} family of languages.
e.zh: 斯瓦希里语属于班图语系。

e.en: {Bantu} peoples spread across much of sub-Saharan Africa centuries ago.
e.zh: 几个世纪前,班图族人就迁徙到了撒哈拉以南非洲大部分地区。

e.en: Apartheid-era South Africa created the {bantustan} system to segregate Black citizens.
e.zh: 种族隔离时期的南非建立了班图斯坦制度来隔离黑人公民。

e.en: Critics called the proposed zones a modern {bantustan}.
e.zh: 批评者将提议的这些区域称为现代版的班图斯坦。

e.en: Children gathered in the shade of the giant {banyan} tree.
e.zh: 孩子们聚集在那棵大榕树的树荫下。

e.en: A sacred {banyan} stood at the center of the village.
e.zh: 村子中央矗立着一棵神圣的榕树。

e.en: The crowd shouted "{banzai}!" as the emperor passed.
e.zh: 天皇经过时人群高呼"万岁!"。

e.en: He let out a loud {banzai} after scoring the winning goal.
e.zh: 他打进制胜球后大喊了一声"万岁"。

e.en: We ordered steamed pork {bao} at the dim sum restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在点心餐厅点了蒸猪肉包。

e.en: Soft fluffy {bao} buns are perfect for braised pork belly.
e.zh: 松软蓬松的包子很适合配红烧五花肉。

e.en: The ancient {baobab} can store thousands of liters of water.
e.zh: 古老的猴面包树能储存数千升水。

e.en: A massive {baobab} dominated the savanna landscape.
e.zh: 一棵巨大的猴面包树主宰着稀树草原的景观。

e.en: He grabbed a bacon {bap} from the café before work.
e.zh: 他上班前在咖啡馆买了个培根软面包。

e.en: A warm {bap} with butter is classic British comfort food.
e.zh: 涂上黄油的温热软面包是经典的英式治愈美食。

e.en: The priest will {baptise} the baby on Sunday morning.
e.zh: 神父将于周日早上为这个婴儿施洗。

e.en: They chose to {baptise} their daughter in the family church.
e.zh: 他们选择在家族的教堂为女儿施洗。

e.en: The baby was {baptised} in the village church last Sunday.
e.zh: 婴儿上周日在乡村教堂受洗了。

e.en: He {baptised} his new boat with a bottle of champagne.
e.zh: 他用一瓶香槟为新船命名。

e.en: Her {baptism} took place in a small chapel by the lake.
e.zh: 她的洗礼在湖边的小教堂举行。

e.en: The new manager faced a real {baptism} of fire on day one.
e.zh: 新经理上任第一天就经历了严峻的考验。

e.en: The {baptismal} font is carved from white marble.
e.zh: 那个洗礼盆是用白色大理石雕成的。

e.en: She wore her grandmother's {baptismal} gown for the ceremony.
e.zh: 她在仪式上穿了祖母的受洗礼袍。

baptist.t:
n. 浸信会教徒
adj. 浸信会的

e.en: He grew up attending a {Baptist} church in Texas.
e.zh: 他从小在德州的一个浸信会教堂做礼拜。

e.en: The {Baptist} community organized a charity dinner downtown.
e.zh: 浸信会群体在市中心组织了一场慈善晚宴。

e.en: Tourists admired the medieval frescoes inside the {baptistery}.
e.zh: 游客们欣赏着洗礼堂内的中世纪壁画。

e.en: The church's octagonal {baptistery} dates back to the twelfth century.
e.zh: 教堂八角形的洗礼堂可追溯到十二世纪。

e.en: The priest will {baptize} three infants this weekend.
e.zh: 神父这个周末将为三个婴儿施洗。

e.en: They decided to {baptize} their startup with a quirky name.
e.zh: 他们决定给自己的创业公司起一个古怪的名字。

e.en: She was {baptized} as a teenager after years of doubt.
e.zh: 经过多年的犹豫,她在青少年时期受了洗。

e.en: The new recruits were {baptized} into the team during training camp.
e.zh: 新成员在训练营中正式融入了团队。

bar.t:
n. 酒吧；条，棒；栏
v. 阻拦，禁止

e.en: We met at a tiny {bar} near the train station.
e.zh: 我们在火车站附近的一家小酒吧见面。

e.en: There's only one {bar} of signal on my phone.
e.zh: 我手机上只有一格信号。

e.en: She ordered hot {bara} with curry at the Trinidadian café.
e.zh: 她在那家特立尼达餐馆点了热腾腾的巴拉饼配咖喱。

e.en: Fresh {bara} is sold at the street stall every morning.
e.zh: 街边小摊每天早晨都卖新鲜的巴拉饼。

e.en: The fishhook had a sharp {barb} that prevented escape.
e.zh: 鱼钩上有一个锋利的倒刺,让鱼无法挣脱。

e.en: Her witty {barb} made everyone in the room laugh.
e.zh: 她机智的讽刺让屋里所有人都笑了。

barbadian.t:
adj. 巴巴多斯的
n. 巴巴多斯人

e.en: The {Barbadian} singer headlined a sold-out concert in London.
e.zh: 这位巴巴多斯歌手在伦敦举办了一场座无虚席的演唱会。

e.en: He cooked a traditional {Barbadian} fish stew for dinner.
e.zh: 他做了一道传统的巴巴多斯炖鱼当晚餐。

barbados.t: n. 巴巴多斯（加勒比岛国）

e.en: They flew to {Barbados} for their honeymoon last spring.
e.zh: 他们去年春天飞往巴巴多斯度蜜月。

e.en: {Barbados} is famous for its turquoise waters and white sand beaches.
e.zh: 巴巴多斯以碧绿的海水和洁白的沙滩闻名。

e.en: Ancient Rome eventually fell to invading {barbarian} tribes.
e.zh: 古罗马最终败于入侵的蛮族部落。

e.en: Stop eating with your hands like a {barbarian}!
e.zh: 别像野人一样用手抓着吃!

e.en: Critics called the punishment cruel and {barbaric}.
e.zh: 批评者称这种惩罚残忍而野蛮。

e.en: Waking up at 4 a.m. feels {barbaric} on a weekend.
e.zh: 周末凌晨四点起床真是太折磨人了。

e.en: The novel exposes the {barbarism} of war in vivid detail.
e.zh: 这部小说生动地揭露了战争的野蛮残酷。

e.en: Many considered the dictator's policies an act of {barbarism}.
e.zh: 许多人认为独裁者的政策是一种野蛮行径。

e.en: Witnesses described the {barbarity} of the attack in court.
e.zh: 目击者在法庭上描述了袭击的残暴程度。

e.en: Historians still debate the {barbarity} committed during the conflict.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在争论那场冲突中所犯下的暴行。

barbarossa.t: n. 巴巴罗萨（红胡子腓特烈）

e.en: Operation {Barbarossa} marked Germany's invasion of the Soviet Union.
e.zh: 巴巴罗萨行动标志着德国入侵苏联。

e.en: Frederick {Barbarossa} ruled the Holy Roman Empire in the twelfth century.
e.zh: 巴巴罗萨腓特烈在十二世纪统治神圣罗马帝国。

e.en: The judge condemned the {barbarous} treatment of the prisoners.
e.zh: 法官谴责了对囚犯的野蛮虐待。

e.en: Such {barbarous} customs have long since disappeared from society.
e.zh: 这种野蛮的习俗早已从社会上消失了。

barbecue.t:
n. 烧烤，烤肉
v. 烧烤

e.en: We're hosting a {barbecue} in the backyard on Saturday.
e.zh: 我们周六要在后院办一场烧烤聚会。

e.en: The smell of {barbecue} drifted across the entire neighborhood.
e.zh: 烧烤的香味飘满了整个街区。

e.en: He {barbecued} ribs all afternoon for the family reunion.
e.zh: 他烤了一下午肋排,准备家庭聚会。

e.en: The {barbecued} chicken was tender and full of flavor.
e.zh: 烤鸡肉嫩入味十足。

e.en: The {barista} drew a perfect heart in my latte foam.
e.zh: 咖啡师在我的拿铁奶泡上拉出了一颗完美的心。

e.en: He works as a {barista} while finishing his degree.
e.zh: 他一边读完学位,一边做咖啡师。

baritone.t: n. 男中音（歌手或音域）

e.en: His warm {baritone} voice filled the concert hall.
e.zh: 他温暖的男中音回荡在音乐厅里。

e.en: The opera features a famous {baritone} from Italy.
e.zh: 这部歌剧由一位著名的意大利男中音主演。

e.en: The doctor ordered a {barium} swallow to check his stomach.
e.zh: 医生让他做钡餐检查胃部。

e.en: {Barium} compounds are used in fireworks for green colors.
e.zh: 钡的化合物被用于烟花中产生绿色。

bark.t:
v. (狗) 吠叫
n. 树皮

e.en: The dogs {bark} every time the mailman arrives.
e.zh: 每次邮递员来,狗都会狂吠。

e.en: Cinnamon comes from the inner {bark} of a tree.
e.zh: 肉桂取自一种树的内层树皮。

barked.t: v. bark 的过去式，吠叫

e.en: The sergeant {barked} orders at the new recruits.
e.zh: 中士对新兵厉声下达命令。

e.en: Our puppy {barked} at his own reflection in the mirror.
e.zh: 我们的小狗对着镜子里自己的影子狂吠。

e.en: The {barkeep} slid a cold beer across the counter.
e.zh: 酒保把一杯冰啤酒顺着吧台推了过来。

e.en: Ask the {barkeep} what's on tap tonight.
e.zh: 问问酒保今晚有什么扎啤。

barker.t: n. 吆喝招徕顾客的人

e.en: A loud {barker} stood outside the circus tent shouting.
e.zh: 一个嗓门洪亮的招徕员站在马戏团帐篷外吆喝。

e.en: The carnival {barker} promised the most amazing show ever.
e.zh: 游乐场的招客员保证这是有史以来最精彩的表演。

barking.t:
v. 吠叫（现在分词）
adj. 疯狂的

e.en: The neighbor's dog has been {barking} all night.
e.zh: 邻居家的狗叫了整整一晚。

e.en: Stop {barking} orders at me—I'm doing my best.
e.zh: 别再对我厉声下命令了,我已经尽力了。

barks.t:
v. bark 的第三人称单数
n. 树皮（复数）

e.en: The dog {barks} loudly whenever someone rings the doorbell.
e.zh: 一有人按门铃,这条狗就大声狂吠。

e.en: Different tree {barks} have different medicinal properties.
e.zh: 不同树种的树皮有不同的药用功效。

e.en: Whisky is traditionally made from malted {barley}.
e.zh: 威士忌传统上由发芽的大麦酿造。

e.en: The farmer harvested his {barley} field in late August.
e.zh: 农夫在八月底收割了他的大麦田。

e.en: Different {barleys} produce distinctly different flavors of beer.
e.zh: 不同品种的大麦酿出的啤酒风味迥异。

e.en: Scottish distilleries source {barleys} from select local farms.
e.zh: 苏格兰酒厂从精选的本地农场采购各种大麦。

e.en: Astronomers use a {Barlow} lens to magnify telescope images.
e.zh: 天文学家用巴罗透镜来放大望远镜的图像。

e.en: My grandfather always carried an old {Barlow} pocket knife.
e.zh: 我祖父总是随身带着一把旧式巴罗折刀。

e.en: The {barmaid} smiled as she poured another pint.
e.zh: 女酒保微笑着又倒了一品脱酒。

e.en: She worked as a {barmaid} to pay her tuition.
e.zh: 她做女酒保来支付学费。

e.en: The {barman} mixed cocktails with impressive flair.
e.zh: 那位男酒保调制鸡尾酒的手法十分潇洒。

e.en: Ask the {barman} to recommend a local craft beer.
e.zh: 让男酒保推荐一款本地精酿啤酒吧。

barmen.t: n. barman 的复数，男酒保

e.en: Two {barmen} worked frantically during the Friday night rush.
e.zh: 周五夜晚高峰时段,两个酒保忙得不可开交。

e.en: The hotel hires only experienced {barmen} for its rooftop lounge.
e.zh: 那家酒店的屋顶酒廊只聘请经验丰富的酒保。

e.en: You'd be {barmy} to quit your job right now.
e.zh: 你现在辞职可真是疯了。

e.en: His ideas sounded a bit {barmy} but actually worked.
e.zh: 他的想法听上去有点疯,但居然奏效了。

e.en: The horses sleep in the {barn} during winter.
e.zh: 冬天马匹睡在谷仓里。

e.en: They converted the old {barn} into a cozy guesthouse.
e.zh: 他们把那座旧谷仓改造成了温馨的民宿。

barnacle.t: n. 藤壶（附着在船底的甲壳动物）

e.en: A single {barnacle} clung to the bottom of the boat.
e.zh: 一只藤壶紧紧吸附在船底。

e.en: Divers scraped every {barnacle} off the ship's hull.
e.zh: 潜水员把船体上的每一只藤壶都刮掉了。

barnard.t: n. 巴纳德（人名或姓氏）

e.en: {Barnard} College is a women's liberal arts school in NYC.
e.zh: 巴纳德学院是位于纽约市的一所女子文理学院。

e.en: Christiaan {Barnard} performed the first human heart transplant.
e.zh: 克里斯蒂安·巴纳德实施了人类首例心脏移植手术。

e.en: Julian {Barnes} won the Booker Prize in 2011.
e.zh: 朱利安·巴恩斯于2011年获得了布克奖。

e.en: The {Barnes} Foundation houses an incredible art collection.
e.zh: 巴恩斯基金会收藏着令人惊叹的艺术品。

e.en: He needs to get his {barnet} cut—it's getting wild.
e.zh: 他得去剪头发了,都长疯了。

e.en: {Barnet} is a leafy borough in north London.
e.zh: 巴尼特是伦敦北部一个绿树成荫的区。

barney.t: n. 争吵，吵架（英式俚语）

e.en: The two of them had a right {barney} last night.
e.zh: 他们俩昨晚大吵了一架。

e.en: My niece still loves watching {Barney} the purple dinosaur.
e.zh: 我侄女还是很喜欢看紫色恐龙巴尼。

e.en: Old red {barns} dot the rolling Wisconsin countryside.
e.zh: 古老的红色谷仓点缀着威斯康星州起伏的乡间。

e.en: They store hay and tractors in two large {barns}.
e.zh: 他们把干草和拖拉机存放在两座大谷仓里。

barnsley.t: n. 巴恩斯利（英国地名）

e.en: {Barnsley} is a market town in South Yorkshire.
e.zh: 巴恩斯利是南约克郡的一个集镇。

e.en: He grew up in {Barnsley} and still has the accent.
e.zh: 他在巴恩斯利长大,至今仍带有当地口音。

barnstaple.t: n. 巴恩斯特珀尔（英国地名）

e.en: We caught the train from {Barnstaple} to Exeter.
e.zh: 我们从巴恩斯特珀尔搭火车去埃克塞特。

e.en: {Barnstaple} is one of the oldest towns in Devon.
e.zh: 巴恩斯特珀尔是德文郡最古老的城镇之一。

barnstorm.t: v. 到各地巡回演出或拉票

e.en: The candidate plans to {barnstorm} across six states this week.
e.zh: 这位候选人计划本周在六个州进行巡回游说。

e.en: Early pilots used to {barnstorm} small towns for cash.
e.zh: 早期飞行员常在小镇巡回特技表演赚钱。

barnstorming.t:
adj. 精彩的，轰动的
v. 巡回演出

e.en: She gave a {barnstorming} speech at the convention.
e.zh: 她在大会上发表了一场震撼人心的演讲。

e.en: The team had a {barnstorming} run to the championship.
e.zh: 该队一路势如破竹,杀进了总决赛。

e.en: Chickens scratched in the dusty {barnyard} all afternoon.
e.zh: 鸡群整个下午都在尘土飞扬的农家院子里刨食。

e.en: The kids loved feeding the {barnyard} animals at the farm.
e.zh: 孩子们很喜欢在农场里喂这些家畜。

barometer.t: n. 气压计；晴雨表（喻指标）

e.en: The {barometer} is dropping, so a storm is coming.
e.zh: 气压计在下降,暴风雨要来了。

e.en: Consumer spending is a key {barometer} of the economy.
e.zh: 消费者支出是衡量经济状况的关键晴雨表。

e.en: Old ship captains relied on mercury {barometers} for weather.
e.zh: 老船长靠水银气压计来判断天气。

e.en: Housing prices are reliable {barometers} of urban growth.
e.zh: 房价是城市发展的可靠晴雨表。

e.en: A sudden drop in {barometric} pressure often triggers headaches.
e.zh: 气压骤降常会引发头痛。

e.en: The app shows real-time {barometric} readings for your area.
e.zh: 这款应用显示你所在地区的实时气压读数。

e.en: The oil {baron} donated millions to the new museum.
e.zh: 那位石油大亨向新博物馆捐了数百万。

e.en: He inherited the title of {baron} from his father.
e.zh: 他从父亲那里继承了男爵的头衔。

barones.t: n. 男爵（拼写变体，罕用）

e.en: Several {barones} attended the medieval reenactment festival.
e.zh: 几位男爵出席了那场中世纪重现节庆。

e.en: The old chronicle lists the {barones} who signed the charter.
e.zh: 那份古老编年史列出了签署宪章的众位男爵。

e.en: The {baroness} hosted a charity gala at her country estate.
e.zh: 男爵夫人在她的乡间庄园举办了一场慈善晚宴。

e.en: A British {baroness} spoke in the House of Lords yesterday.
e.zh: 一位英国女男爵昨天在上议院发言。

e.en: His grandfather was made a {baronet} for wartime service.
e.zh: 他祖父因战时贡献被授予从男爵爵位。

e.en: The {baronet} inherited a crumbling manor and heavy debts.
e.zh: 那位从男爵继承了一座破败的庄园和沉重的债务。

e.en: He inherited the {baronetcy} after his elder brother died.
e.zh: 他在哥哥去世后继承了从男爵爵位。

e.en: The {baronetcy} has been in their family for centuries.
e.zh: 这个从男爵爵位在他们家族中已传承了几个世纪。

baronial.t: adj. 男爵的；豪华气派的

e.en: The hotel lobby had a grand {baronial} fireplace.
e.zh: 酒店大堂里有一座宏伟的贵族式壁炉。

e.en: They dined in a {baronial} hall lined with old portraits.
e.zh: 他们在一间挂满旧画像的贵族大厅里用餐。

barony.t: n. 男爵的爵位或领地

e.en: The {barony} stretched across several villages in the valley.
e.zh: 这片男爵领地横跨山谷中的几个村庄。

e.en: He built a small media {barony} in the 1990s.
e.zh: 他在九十年代建立了一个小型媒体王国。

baroque.t:
adj. 巴洛克风格的
n. 巴洛克艺术

e.en: She loves listening to {baroque} music while studying.
e.zh: 她喜欢一边学习一边听巴洛克音乐。

e.en: The plot was almost {baroque} in its complexity.
e.zh: 情节复杂得近乎离奇繁复。

e.en: A wooden {barque} sailed slowly into the harbor at dawn.
e.zh: 一艘木制三桅帆船在黎明缓缓驶入港口。

e.en: The old {barque} had crossed the Atlantic many times.
e.zh: 那艘老旧的三桅帆船曾多次横渡大西洋。

e.en: We grilled fresh {barra} fillets on the beach last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我们在海滩上烤了新鲜的澳洲肺鱼片。

e.en: Anglers come here hoping to catch a big {barra}.
e.zh: 垂钓者来这里希望钓到一条大澳洲肺鱼。

barrack.t:
n. 兵营
v. 起哄，喝倒彩

e.en: Soldiers were told to {barrack} in the empty school.
e.zh: 士兵们被告知要在那所空学校里驻扎。

e.en: Fans began to {barrack} the referee after the bad call.
e.zh: 球迷们在那次误判后开始嘘裁判。

e.en: The visiting team faced loud {barracking} from the home crowd.
e.zh: 客队遭到主场观众大声的喝倒彩。

e.en: He ignored the {barracking} and finished his speech calmly.
e.zh: 他不理会起哄声,平静地讲完了演讲。

e.en: The soldiers returned to the {barracks} after a long march.
e.zh: 士兵们在长途行军后回到了营房。

e.en: Old army {barracks} were converted into student housing.
e.zh: 旧军营被改造成了学生宿舍。

e.en: Divers spotted a huge {barracuda} near the coral reef.
e.zh: 潜水员在珊瑚礁附近发现了一条巨大的梭鱼。

e.en: That lawyer is a real {barracuda} in the courtroom.
e.zh: 那位律师在法庭上真是个凶狠的角色。

barrage.t:
n. 弹幕；连续轰炸
n. 拦河坝

e.en: She faced a {barrage} of questions from reporters outside.
e.zh: 她在外面遭到记者们一连串的提问。

e.en: The artillery {barrage} lasted through the entire night.
e.zh: 炮火轰击持续了整整一夜。

e.en: Dancers warmed up at the {barre} before rehearsal.
e.zh: 舞者们在排练前先在把杆上热身。

e.en: She takes a {barre} class three times a week.
e.zh: 她每周上三次芭蕾把杆健身课。

barred.t:
v. 禁止进入；阻拦
adj. 有条纹的

e.en: He was {barred} from the bar for fighting last weekend.
e.zh: 他因上周末打架被禁止进入那家酒吧。

e.en: All the windows were {barred} with thick iron rods.
e.zh: 所有窗户都用粗铁条封住了。

barrel.t:
n. 桶；一桶的量
n. 枪管

e.en: The wine ages in an oak {barrel} for two years.
e.zh: 这种酒在橡木桶里陈酿两年。

e.en: Oil prices fell below sixty dollars a {barrel} today.
e.zh: 今天油价跌破每桶六十美元。

e.en: The truck {barreled} down the highway at full speed.
e.zh: 卡车以全速在高速公路上飞驰。

e.en: He {barreled} into the room without knocking first.
e.zh: 他没敲门就一头冲进了房间。

barrels.t: n. 桶（复数）；若干桶的量

e.en: Dozens of wooden {barrels} were stacked in the cellar.
e.zh: 几十个木桶堆放在地窖里。

e.en: The factory produces thousands of {barrels} of oil daily.
e.zh: 这家工厂每天生产数千桶石油。

e.en: The {barren} land stretched for miles without a single tree.
e.zh: 那片贫瘠的土地绵延数英里,看不到一棵树。

e.en: The meeting was {barren} of any useful ideas.
e.zh: 这次会议没有产生任何有用的想法。

e.en: The {barrenness} of the desert shocked the young hikers.
e.zh: 沙漠的荒凉震撼了那些年轻的徒步者。

e.en: She wrote about the spiritual {barrenness} of modern city life.
e.zh: 她写下了现代都市生活的精神空虚。

e.en: She clipped her hair back with a small pink {barrette}.
e.zh: 她用一个粉色小发夹把头发别了起来。

e.en: The store sells handmade {barrette} sets for little girls.
e.zh: 这家店出售给小女孩的手工发夹套装。

barricade.t:
n. 路障；街垒
v. 设置障碍

e.en: Protesters built a {barricade} across the main road.
e.zh: 抗议者在主干道上筑起了一道路障。

e.en: Police told residents to {barricade} their doors during the storm.
e.zh: 警方告诉居民在风暴中堵住房门。

e.en: The suspect {barricaded} himself inside the small apartment.
e.zh: 嫌疑人把自己困在了那间小公寓里。

e.en: They {barricaded} the windows with old furniture.
e.zh: 他们用旧家具堵住了窗户。

e.en: Language can be a major {barrier} when traveling abroad.
e.zh: 在国外旅行时,语言可能是一大障碍。

e.en: A metal {barrier} kept the crowd away from the stage.
e.zh: 金属护栏把人群挡在舞台外。

e.en: The new app removes {barriers} for first-time investors.
e.zh: 这款新应用消除了新手投资者面临的种种障碍。

e.en: Crash {barriers} along the highway prevented serious accidents.
e.zh: 高速公路两侧的防撞栏避免了严重事故。

barring.t:
prep. 除…之外
v. 阻止

e.en: {Barring} bad weather, we'll leave for the airport at six.
e.zh: 除非天气恶劣,我们六点出发去机场。

e.en: The court ordered him, {barring} him from contacting the witness.
e.zh: 法院发出命令,禁止他联系证人。

e.en: He grew up in a small {barrio} on the city's edge.
e.zh: 他在城市边缘的一个小社区长大。

e.en: The {barrio} was famous for its colorful murals and music.
e.zh: 那个西语社区以彩色壁画和音乐闻名。

barrios.t: n. 西语裔居住区（复数）

e.en: Many {barrios} in Los Angeles host weekly street festivals.
e.zh: 洛杉矶的许多西语社区每周都举办街头节庆。

e.en: The film documents life in the {barrios} of Caracas.
e.zh: 这部电影记录了加拉加斯贫民区的生活。

e.en: She trained for years to become a {barrister} in London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦经过多年训练成为一名出庭律师。

e.en: The {barrister} cross-examined the witness for over an hour.
e.zh: 那位出庭律师对证人盘问了一个多小时。

e.en: A loud {barroom} brawl spilled out onto the street.
e.zh: 一场激烈的酒吧斗殴蔓延到了街上。

e.en: He tells the same {barroom} stories every Friday night.
e.zh: 他每个周五晚上都讲同样的酒吧故事。

barrow.t:
n. 手推车
n. 古墓冢

e.en: The gardener pushed a {barrow} full of leaves up the hill.
e.zh: 园丁推着一辆装满落叶的手推车上山。

e.en: Archaeologists excavated an ancient burial {barrow} on the moor.
e.zh: 考古学家在荒原上发掘了一座古代墓冢。

bars.t:
n. 酒吧；横条（复数）
v. 阻止

e.en: My phone has no {bars} in this part of the building.
e.zh: 我的手机在这栋楼这边没信号。

e.en: Several {bars} on this street stay open until dawn.
e.zh: 这条街上有几家酒吧营业到天亮。

e.en: He climbed onto a {barstool} and ordered a cold beer.
e.zh: 他爬上吧台凳,点了一杯冰啤酒。

e.en: The kitchen island has three matching {barstool} seats.
e.zh: 厨房中岛配有三张相配的高脚凳。

e.en: The {bartender} mixed a perfect old fashioned for me.
e.zh: 调酒师为我调了一杯完美的古典鸡尾酒。

e.en: Ask the {bartender} to recommend a local craft beer.
e.zh: 让调酒师推荐一款本地精酿啤酒吧。

e.en: Good {bartenders} remember regulars' names and favorite drinks.
e.zh: 出色的调酒师能记住常客的名字和爱喝的酒。

e.en: Two {bartenders} worked the busy Saturday night shift.
e.zh: 两名调酒师在繁忙的周六夜班一起工作。

barter.t:
v. 以物易物
n. 物物交换

e.en: In rural villages, people still {barter} eggs for vegetables.
e.zh: 在乡村,人们仍会用鸡蛋换蔬菜。

e.en: The two countries set up a {barter} trade agreement.
e.zh: 两国签订了一项以物易物的贸易协议。

e.en: Early settlers {bartered} fur for tools and grain.
e.zh: 早期移民用毛皮换取工具和粮食。

e.en: She {bartered} her old laptop for a used bicycle.
e.zh: 她用旧笔记本电脑换了一辆二手自行车。

e.en: After the storm, neighbors began {bartering} food and supplies.
e.zh: 风暴过后,邻居们开始以物易物地交换食物和物资。

e.en: Online forums make {bartering} between strangers much easier today.
e.zh: 网络论坛让如今陌生人之间的以物易物变得容易得多。

e.en: She baked a tart with ripe {bartlett} pears from the market.
e.zh: 她用市场买的熟巴特利特梨烤了一个挞。

e.en: The orchard grows mainly {bartlett} pears for export.
e.zh: 那个果园主要种植巴特利特梨用于出口。

e.en: A proton is the most familiar example of a {baryon}.
e.zh: 质子是最常见的重子例子。

e.en: Physicists study how a {baryon} decays inside a particle accelerator.
e.zh: 物理学家研究重子在粒子加速器中的衰变方式。

e.en: Doctors measure her {basal} body temperature every morning.
e.zh: 医生每天早晨测量她的基础体温。

e.en: The clinic checks {basal} metabolic rate before recommending a diet.
e.zh: 诊所在推荐饮食前会先检查基础代谢率。

e.en: The cliffs along the coast are made of dark {basalt}.
e.zh: 沿海的悬崖是由深色玄武岩构成的。

e.en: They paved the courtyard with rough {basalt} stones.
e.zh: 他们用粗糙的玄武岩铺了庭院。

e.en: The volcano produced thick {basaltic} lava flows last year.
e.zh: 那座火山去年喷发出厚厚的玄武岩熔岩流。

e.en: Geologists collected {basaltic} rock samples from the ocean floor.
e.zh: 地质学家从海底采集了玄武岩样本。

base.t:
n. 基础；基地
v. 以…为基础

e.en: Trust is the {base} of any healthy relationship.
e.zh: 信任是任何健康关系的基础。

e.en: The company will {base} its new office in Berlin.
e.zh: 公司将把新办事处设在柏林。

e.en: My dad and I watch {baseball} together every Saturday afternoon.
e.zh: 我和爸爸每周六下午一起看棒球。

e.en: He hit the {baseball} clear over the back fence.
e.zh: 他把棒球击得飞越了后面的围栏。

e.en: The coach brought a bucket of {baseballs} to practice.
e.zh: 教练带了一桶棒球来训练。

e.en: Kids hunted for stray {baseballs} in the tall grass.
e.zh: 孩子们在高草丛里寻找走失的棒球。

e.en: Dust collects quickly along the white {baseboard} in the hallway.
e.zh: 走廊白色踢脚线边很快就会积灰。

e.en: He painted the {baseboard} a slightly darker shade than the walls.
e.zh: 他把踢脚线漆成比墙壁略深的颜色。

based.t:
adj. 以…为基础的
v. base 的过去式

e.en: The movie is {based} on a true story from the 1970s.
e.zh: 这部电影改编自七十年代的一个真实故事。

e.en: Our team is {based} in Singapore but works globally.
e.zh: 我们团队总部设在新加坡,但服务全球。

e.en: We caught the early train from Zurich to {Basel}.
e.zh: 我们坐了从苏黎世到巴塞尔的早班火车。

e.en: {Basel} hosts one of Europe's biggest contemporary art fairs.
e.zh: 巴塞尔举办着欧洲最大的当代艺术博览会之一。

baseless.t: adj. 无根据的；毫无依据的

e.en: The CEO called the rumors completely {baseless} and harmful.
e.zh: 首席执行官称这些谣言完全没有根据,且具有危害性。

e.en: Her accusations turned out to be {baseless} after the investigation.
e.zh: 调查结束后,她的指控被证明毫无根据。

e.en: The team set a clear performance {baseline} before optimizing the code.
e.zh: 团队在优化代码前设定了明确的性能基准。

e.en: She hit a winner down the {baseline} to win the match.
e.zh: 她沿底线打出制胜球,赢下了比赛。

e.en: The first {baseman} caught the ball just before the runner arrived.
e.zh: 一垒手在跑者到达前接住了球。

e.en: He played as a second {baseman} throughout high school.
e.zh: 他整个高中时期都担任二垒手。

e.en: They turned the {basement} into a cozy home theater.
e.zh: 他们把地下室改造成了温馨的家庭影院。

e.en: The washing machine is in the {basement} next to the boiler.
e.zh: 洗衣机在地下室,就在锅炉旁边。

e.en: Many old houses have damp {basements} in the rainy season.
e.zh: 许多老房子的地下室在雨季会很潮湿。

e.en: The startup began in one of those cramped Silicon Valley {basements}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司起步于硅谷一间狭小的地下室。

e.en: The novel exposes the {baseness} of the corrupt officials.
e.zh: 这部小说揭露了那些腐败官员的卑劣。

e.en: She was shocked by the {baseness} of his betrayal.
e.zh: 他背叛行为的卑鄙令她震惊。

e.en: Bolt the motor firmly to the steel {baseplate} before testing.
e.zh: 测试前把电机牢牢地固定在钢制底板上。

e.en: The camera tripod has a quick-release {baseplate} for fast swaps.
e.zh: 这台相机三脚架配有便于快速更换的底板。

e.en: The runner advanced two {bases} on the wild pitch.
e.zh: 跑者借暴投推进了两个垒。

e.en: The company has manufacturing {bases} in three different countries.
e.zh: 该公司在三个不同国家设有制造基地。

basf.t: n. 巴斯夫（德国化工公司）

e.en: {BASF} is one of the largest chemical companies in the world.
e.zh: 巴斯夫是全球最大的化学公司之一。

e.en: She got a research internship at {BASF} headquarters in Germany.
e.zh: 她在德国巴斯夫总部获得了一份研究实习。

bash.t:
v. 猛击；痛打
n. 聚会；狂欢

e.en: They threw a huge birthday {bash} at the rooftop bar.
e.zh: 他们在屋顶酒吧办了一场盛大的生日派对。

e.en: Don't {bash} the keyboard when the app freezes.
e.zh: 应用卡住时别使劲砸键盘。

e.en: Online critics labeled him a relentless Apple {basher}.
e.zh: 网上的批评者把他称作一个不停抨击苹果的人。

e.en: The forward is known as a hard {basher} near the goal.
e.zh: 这位前锋以在门前强硬冲撞著称。

e.en: The {bashful} child hid behind her mother at the party.
e.zh: 那个害羞的小女孩在派对上躲在妈妈身后。

e.en: He gave a {bashful} smile when she complimented his cooking.
e.zh: 她夸他做饭好吃时,他羞涩地笑了笑。

e.en: She {bashfully} accepted the award and waved to the crowd.
e.zh: 她羞怯地接过奖项,向观众挥了挥手。

e.en: He {bashfully} admitted that he had written the love letter.
e.zh: 他不好意思地承认那封情书是他写的。

e.en: The media keeps {bashing} the new tax policy nonstop.
e.zh: 媒体一直在不停地抨击新的税收政策。

e.en: Stop {bashing} the door — I'm coming to open it!
e.zh: 别再砸门了,我这就来开!

e.en: Every employee must complete the {basic} safety training first.
e.zh: 每位员工都必须先完成基础安全培训。

e.en: That outfit looks pretty {basic} — try adding an accessory.
e.zh: 那身搭配看起来挺普通的,加件配饰试试吧。

e.en: The new feature is {basically} a smarter version of search.
e.zh: 这个新功能基本上就是更智能版本的搜索。

e.en: He {basically} runs the entire department by himself.
e.zh: 基本上整个部门都是他一个人在管。

e.en: The course covers the {basics} of machine learning in two weeks.
e.zh: 这门课程用两周时间讲解机器学习的基础知识。

e.en: Let's get back to the {basics} and review the rules.
e.zh: 我们回到基础,重新过一遍规则。

e.en: Sprinkle fresh {basil} on top of the pizza before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前在比萨上撒一些新鲜罗勒。

e.en: She grows {basil} in a pot on the kitchen windowsill.
e.zh: 她在厨房窗台的花盆里种着罗勒。

e.en: The doctor identified swelling near the {basilar} artery on the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描中发现基底动脉附近有肿胀。

e.en: Sound waves vibrate the {basilar} membrane inside the inner ear.
e.zh: 声波会让内耳中的基底膜产生振动。

basildon.t: n. 巴西尔登（英国城镇）

e.en: My cousin lives in {Basildon}, just east of London.
e.zh: 我表弟住在巴西尔登,就在伦敦东边。

e.en: The train to {Basildon} leaves from platform six.
e.zh: 开往巴西尔登的火车从六号站台发车。

basilica.t: n. 长方形基督教堂；大教堂

e.en: Tourists lined up for hours to enter St. Peter's {Basilica}.
e.zh: 游客们排了几个小时的队才进入圣彼得大教堂。

e.en: The ancient {basilica} has stunning mosaics on its ceiling.
e.zh: 这座古老的大教堂天花板上有令人惊叹的马赛克。

basilisk.t: n. 蛇怪；（传说中）眼睛能致人死的怪兽

e.en: The hero faced the giant {basilisk} deep in the cave.
e.zh: 英雄在洞穴深处面对那条巨大的蛇怪。

e.en: In the myth, a {basilisk} could kill with a single glance.
e.zh: 在神话中,蛇怪只需一瞥就能致人死亡。

e.en: She filled the {basin} with warm water to soak her feet.
e.zh: 她在盆里倒满温水来泡脚。

e.en: The Amazon {basin} contains the largest rainforest on Earth.
e.zh: 亚马逊流域拥有地球上最大的雨林。

basing.t: v. base 的现在分词；以…为基础

e.en: They are {basing} the next product on user feedback.
e.zh: 他们正以用户反馈为依据来打造下一款产品。

e.en: The studio is {basing} its new film on a true story.
e.zh: 该工作室正根据一个真实故事改编新电影。

basingstoke.t: n. 贝辛斯托克（英国城镇）

e.en: He commutes from {Basingstoke} to London every weekday morning.
e.zh: 他每个工作日早上从贝辛斯托克通勤到伦敦。

e.en: The conference will be held at a hotel near {Basingstoke}.
e.zh: 会议将在贝辛斯托克附近的一家酒店举行。

e.en: Two clean {basins} sit beside the mirror in the bathroom.
e.zh: 浴室镜子旁放着两个干净的洗手盆。

e.en: Major river {basins} are facing severe drought this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天主要的河流流域正面临严重干旱。

e.en: We meet on a weekly {basis} to review project progress.
e.zh: 我们每周开会回顾项目进展。

e.en: His argument has no factual {basis} whatsoever.
e.zh: 他的论点完全没有任何事实依据。

e.en: Lizards {bask} on the warm rocks in the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 蜥蜴在午后阳光下的暖石上晒太阳。

e.en: The team continues to {bask} in the glory of their victory.
e.zh: 球队仍沉浸在胜利的喜悦中。

baskerville.t: n. 巴斯克维尔（姓氏/字体名）

e.en: The Hound of the {Baskervilles} is a classic Sherlock Holmes mystery.
e.zh: 《巴斯克维尔的猎犬》是一部经典的福尔摩斯悬疑小说。

e.en: She set the document in {Baskerville} for a more elegant look.
e.zh: 为了更显优雅,她把文档设成了巴斯克维尔字体。

e.en: He filled the {basket} with apples from the orchard.
e.zh: 他在篮子里装满了从果园摘来的苹果。

e.en: She added three more items to her shopping {basket} online.
e.zh: 她又往网购购物车里加了三件商品。

e.en: He plays {basketball} every Saturday morning with his friends.
e.zh: 他每周六早上和朋友们一起打篮球。

e.en: The {basketball} bounced off the rim and into the crowd.
e.zh: 篮球弹到篮筐上后飞进了观众席。

e.en: The coach pumped up six new {basketballs} before practice.
e.zh: 教练在训练前给六个新篮球打好了气。

e.en: Old {basketballs} were donated to the local youth center.
e.zh: 那些旧篮球被捐给了当地青少年中心。

e.en: She brought home a {basketful} of strawberries from the farm.
e.zh: 她从农场带回了满满一篮草莓。

e.en: The dog dragged a {basketful} of laundry across the floor.
e.zh: 那只狗把满满一篮脏衣服拖过了地板。

e.en: The museum displays traditional {basketry} from indigenous communities.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了原住民社区的传统编篮工艺。

e.en: She learned {basketry} from her grandmother as a child.
e.zh: 她小时候跟着祖母学过编篮手艺。

e.en: Empty wicker {baskets} hung along the kitchen wall.
e.zh: 空的柳条篮挂在厨房的墙上。

e.en: He scored ten {baskets} during the second half of the game.
e.zh: 他在下半场得了十个进球。

e.en: The chair has intricate {basketwork} along the back.
e.zh: 这把椅子的椅背上有精致的编织工艺。

e.en: Local artisans sell beautiful {basketwork} at the weekend market.
e.zh: 当地工匠在周末市场上出售精美的编篮制品。

basking.t: v. bask 的现在分词；晒太阳

e.en: The cat is {basking} in a patch of afternoon sunlight.
e.zh: 猫正在一片午后阳光下惬意地晒太阳。

e.en: The author is {basking} in praise after the book's release.
e.zh: 作者在书出版后享受着众人的赞誉。

basle.t: n. 巴塞尔（瑞士城市，同 Basel）

e.en: The art fair in {Basle} attracts collectors from around the world.
e.zh: 巴塞尔的艺术博览会吸引了世界各地的收藏家。

e.en: She caught an early train from Zurich to {Basle}.
e.zh: 她搭乘清晨的火车从苏黎世前往巴塞尔。

e.en: Serve the curry with fluffy {basmati} rice and warm naan.
e.zh: 咖喱配上松软的印度香米和热乎的馕一起吃。

e.en: She rinsed the {basmati} thoroughly before cooking it.
e.zh: 她在煮之前把印度香米仔细淘洗了一遍。

basque.t:
adj. 巴斯克的
n. 巴斯克人/语

e.en: The {Basque} region is famous for its delicious pintxos.
e.zh: 巴斯克地区以美味的小吃品乔斯而闻名。

e.en: He's learning {Basque} because his grandmother grew up there.
e.zh: 他在学巴斯克语,因为他奶奶在那里长大。

e.en: Excuse me, where's the {bathroom}?
e.zh: 打扰一下，洗手间在哪里？

e.en: Our new apartment has a tiny but bright {bathroom}.
e.zh: 我们的新公寓有一个小巧但明亮的浴室。

e.en: The house has three {bathrooms} on the upper floor.
e.zh: 这栋房子楼上有三间浴室。

e.en: All {bathrooms} were renovated with new tiles last summer.
e.zh: 所有浴室去年夏天都重新铺了瓷砖。

e.en: Long hot {baths} help me unwind after work.
e.zh: 长时间的热水澡能让我下班后放松下来。

e.en: The Roman {baths} in the city are still well preserved.
e.zh: 城里的罗马浴场至今保存完好。

e.en: King David's affair with {Bathsheba} appears in the Old Testament.
e.zh: 大卫王与拔示巴的故事出现在《旧约》中。

e.en: The painting depicts {Bathsheba} reading a letter from the king.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了拔示巴正在读国王的来信。

e.en: The kids filled the {bathtub} with bubble bath foam.
e.zh: 孩子们把浴缸装满了泡泡浴的泡沫。

e.en: Our claw-foot {bathtub} is the centerpiece of the bathroom.
e.zh: 我们的爪足浴缸是浴室的视觉焦点。

e.en: {Bathurst} hosts Australia's most famous endurance car race.
e.zh: 巴瑟斯特举办着澳大利亚最著名的耐力汽车赛。

e.en: They drove through {Bathurst} on the way to Sydney.
e.zh: 他们前往悉尼的路上经过了巴瑟斯特。

e.en: Don't throw the baby out with the {bathwater}.
e.zh: 别把婴儿和洗澡水一起倒掉。

e.en: The {bathwater} had gone cold while she read.
e.zh: 她读书时洗澡水已经凉了。

e.en: She wore a colorful {batik} dress to the festival.
e.zh: 她穿着一件色彩斑斓的蜡染连衣裙去参加节庆。

e.en: Indonesian artisans use wax to create intricate {batik} patterns.
e.zh: 印尼工匠用蜡来创作精致的蜡染图案。

e.en: {Batley} is a market town in West Yorkshire, England.
e.zh: 巴特利是英格兰西约克郡的一个集镇。

e.en: My grandparents ran a small shop in {Batley} for decades.
e.zh: 我的祖父母在巴特利经营一家小店几十年。

batman.t:
n. 蝙蝠侠
n. 军官勤务兵

e.en: {Batman} patrols Gotham City after dark.
e.zh: 蝙蝠侠在夜幕降临后巡视哥谭市。

e.en: The new {Batman} film breaks box-office records this weekend.
e.zh: 新一部《蝙蝠侠》电影本周末打破了票房纪录。

baton.t: n. 指挥棒；接力棒；警棍

e.en: The runner dropped the {baton} during the relay race.
e.zh: 那名选手在接力赛中把接力棒掉在地上。

e.en: The conductor lifted his {baton} and the orchestra began.
e.zh: 指挥举起指挥棒，乐团随即奏响。

bats.t:
n. 蝙蝠；球棒（复数）
adj. 疯疯癫癫的

e.en: At dusk, {bats} swooped above the river to catch insects.
e.zh: 黄昏时，蝙蝠掠过河面捕食昆虫。

e.en: He {bats} third in the team's lineup.
e.zh: 他在球队的击球顺序里排第三棒。

e.en: The {batsman} hit a six over the boundary.
e.zh: 击球手把球打过了界绳，得了六分。

e.en: India's opening {batsman} scored a century before lunch.
e.zh: 印度的开局击球手在午餐前打出了百分。

e.en: Install a {batt} of fiberglass insulation between the studs.
e.zh: 在墙骨之间装一块玻璃纤维保温棉。

e.en: The contractor stapled each {batt} into the attic ceiling.
e.zh: 承包商把每块保温棉钉到阁楼天花板上。

e.en: The {battalion} marched through the desert for three days.
e.zh: 这支营队在沙漠里行军了三天。

e.en: A whole {battalion} of volunteers showed up to help.
e.zh: 一大批志愿者前来帮忙。

batted.t: v. 击球（bat 的过去式）

e.en: She {batted} the ball over the fence on her first try.
e.zh: 她第一次挥棒就把球打过了围栏。

e.en: He barely {batted} an eye when he heard the news.
e.zh: 听到消息时他连眼皮都没眨一下。

batten.t:
n. 板条；压条
v. 用板条钉牢

e.en: Sailors rushed to {batten} down the hatches before the storm.
e.zh: 水手们赶在暴风雨前关紧舱口。

e.en: He nailed a wooden {batten} along the edge of the roof.
e.zh: 他沿着屋顶边缘钉上一根木条。

e.en: She baked a pink and yellow {battenberg} for tea.
e.zh: 她烤了一块粉黄相间的巴腾堡蛋糕配茶。

e.en: The bakery's {battenberg} cake sold out within an hour.
e.zh: 这家面包店的巴腾堡蛋糕一小时内就售罄了。

batter.t:
n. 面糊；击球员
v. 连续猛击

e.en: Pour the {batter} into the pan and bake for thirty minutes.
e.zh: 把面糊倒进烤盘里烤三十分钟。

e.en: Heavy waves continued to {batter} the coastline overnight.
e.zh: 巨浪整夜不停地拍打着海岸线。

e.en: He drove an old, {battered} pickup truck to work every day.
e.zh: 他每天开着一辆破旧的小货车上班。

e.en: The chef served {battered} fish with chips and lemon.
e.zh: 厨师端上了裹面糊炸的鱼配薯条和柠檬。

e.en: The court ordered the {batterer} to attend counseling sessions.
e.zh: 法院判令这名施暴者参加心理辅导。

e.en: Shelters offer support to victims of a {batterer} at home.
e.zh: 庇护所为家庭施暴者的受害者提供支持。

e.en: My remote stopped working because the {batteries} died.
e.zh: 遥控器没反应了,因为电池没电了。

e.en: Modern phone {batteries} last almost a full day.
e.zh: 现代手机电池几乎能用一整天。

e.en: The boat took a {battering} from the storm all night.
e.zh: 船只整夜被暴风雨猛烈拍打。

e.en: Soldiers used a {battering} ram to break down the gate.
e.zh: 士兵们用攻城槌撞开了大门。

batters.t:
n. 击球员（复数）
v. 猛击

e.en: Heavy rain {batters} the windows whenever a typhoon hits.
e.zh: 每次台风来袭,大雨都会猛打窗户。

e.en: The coach watched as the {batters} took turns at practice.
e.zh: 教练看着击球手们轮流练习。

e.en: We took the kids to see the lights at {Battersea} Power Station.
e.zh: 我们带孩子去看巴特西发电站的灯光。

e.en: The {Battersea} dogs home rescues hundreds of pets each year.
e.zh: 巴特西流浪狗之家每年救助数百只宠物。

battery.t:
n. 电池；一组
n. 殴打罪

e.en: My laptop {battery} barely lasts four hours these days.
e.zh: 我笔记本的电池现在勉强能撑四小时。

e.en: He was charged with assault and {battery} after the fight.
e.zh: 打架之后他被控以人身攻击和殴打罪。

e.en: She has the highest {batting} average on the team this season.
e.zh: 她本赛季的击球率是队里最高的。

e.en: He kept {batting} away questions about his private life.
e.zh: 他一直回避有关私生活的问题。

battle.t:
n. 战斗；战役
v. 搏斗；奋战

e.en: The startup is in a fierce {battle} for market share.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在激烈争夺市场份额。

e.en: Soldiers prepared their gear before the {battle} began.
e.zh: 战斗打响前士兵们整理好装备。

e.en: The Viking warrior swung his heavy {battleaxe} with both hands.
e.zh: 维京战士双手挥舞着沉重的战斧。

e.en: Everyone in the office feared the old {battleaxe} in HR.
e.zh: 办公室里人人都怕人事部那个厉害的老女人。

e.en: She {battled} cancer for years before finally recovering.
e.zh: 她与癌症斗争多年,最终康复了。

e.en: The two teams {battled} to a draw in the final minute.
e.zh: 两队在最后一分钟战成平局。

e.en: The soldiers wore green {battledress} during the parade.
e.zh: 士兵们在阅兵时穿着绿色作战服。

e.en: His grandfather kept his old {battledress} in a wooden trunk.
e.zh: 他祖父把旧军装存放在一个木箱里。

e.en: Drones now play a major role on the modern {battlefield}.
e.zh: 无人机如今在现代战场上扮演重要角色。

e.en: The courtroom became a {battlefield} between rival lawyers.
e.zh: 法庭成了对立律师之间的战场。

e.en: Tourists visit the old {battlefields} of Normandy each summer.
e.zh: 游客每年夏天都会参观诺曼底的古老战场。

e.en: Reporters traveled across {battlefields} to interview survivors.
e.zh: 记者们穿越多个战场采访幸存者。

e.en: Medics worked tirelessly close to the {battlefront}.
e.zh: 医护人员在前线附近不知疲倦地工作。

e.en: Climate change has opened a new {battlefront} for policymakers.
e.zh: 气候变化为决策者开辟了新的战线。

e.en: Ohio is once again a key {battleground} state this election.
e.zh: 本次选举中俄亥俄再次成为关键的摇摆州。

e.en: Social media has become a {battleground} for public opinion.
e.zh: 社交媒体已成为舆论的战场。

e.en: Archers fired arrows from the castle's stone {battlement}.
e.zh: 弓箭手从城堡的石砌雉堞上射箭。

e.en: Tourists climbed onto the {battlement} for a panoramic view.
e.zh: 游客爬上城垛欣赏全景。

e.en: The {battlemented} tower dominated the skyline of the old town.
e.zh: 那座带城垛的塔楼是老城天际线的主角。

e.en: They restored the {battlemented} walls of the medieval fortress.
e.zh: 他们修复了中世纪堡垒带垛口的城墙。

e.en: She's a real {battler} who never gives up on her dreams.
e.zh: 她是个从不放弃梦想的硬汉子。

e.en: The old {battler} won three matches in a row last weekend.
e.zh: 那位老斗士上周末连胜三场比赛。

battles.t:
n. 战斗（复数）
v. 搏斗

e.en: He still {battles} anxiety, but therapy has helped a lot.
e.zh: 他仍在与焦虑作斗争,但心理治疗帮了大忙。

e.en: History books are full of {battles} fought over land.
e.zh: 史书里满是因争夺土地而爆发的战役。

e.en: The massive {battleship} dropped anchor near the harbor entrance.
e.zh: 巨大的战列舰在港口入口附近抛锚。

e.en: As kids, we played {battleship} on graph paper for hours.
e.zh: 小时候我们在方格纸上玩战舰游戏玩好几个小时。

e.en: He's been {battling} the flu for almost two weeks now.
e.zh: 他已经跟流感斗了快两周了。

e.en: Two startups are {battling} for control of the streaming market.
e.zh: 两家初创公司正在争夺流媒体市场的控制权。

batty.t: adj. 疯疯癫癫的；古怪的

e.en: My grandma went a little {batty} after her cat ran away.
e.zh: 我奶奶在猫跑掉后变得有点疯疯癫癫。

e.en: His {batty} ideas sometimes turn out to be brilliant.
e.zh: 他那些古怪的点子有时还真挺天才。

bauble.t: n. 小饰物；华而不实之物

e.en: She wore a cheap {bauble} on her wrist to the party.
e.zh: 她戴着一条廉价的小饰品去参加派对。

e.en: To him, the trophy was just another shiny {bauble}.
e.zh: 对他而言,那奖杯不过是又一件闪亮的小玩意儿。

e.en: The Christmas tree was covered in colorful glass {baubles}.
e.zh: 圣诞树上挂满了彩色玻璃球。

e.en: She collects vintage {baubles} from old jewelry stores.
e.zh: 她收集旧首饰店里的复古小饰品。

baud.t: n. 波特（数据传输速率单位）

e.en: Old modems connected to the internet at just 300 {baud}.
e.zh: 老式调制解调器以仅 300 波特的速率连入互联网。

e.en: The serial port was set to a {baud} rate of 9600.
e.zh: 串口的波特率设为 9600。

baudelaire.t: n. 波德莱尔（法国诗人）

e.en: She read {Baudelaire} aloud in the dim café every Sunday.
e.zh: 她每周日都在昏暗的咖啡馆里朗读波德莱尔。

e.en: {Baudelaire} influenced generations of modern French poets.
e.zh: 波德莱尔影响了一代又一代现代法国诗人。

baudrillard.t: n. 鲍德里亚（法国思想家）

e.en: My professor referenced {Baudrillard} when discussing simulation.
e.zh: 我教授在讨论拟像理论时引用了鲍德里亚。

e.en: {Baudrillard} argued that media reshapes our sense of reality.
e.zh: 鲍德里亚认为媒体重塑了我们对现实的感知。

e.en: The chair's clean lines reflect classic {Bauhaus} design.
e.zh: 这把椅子简洁的线条体现了经典的包豪斯风格。

e.en: She studied architecture inspired by the {Bauhaus} movement.
e.zh: 她学习了受包豪斯运动启发的建筑设计。

basquiat.t: n. 巴斯奎特（美国艺术家）

e.en: A {Basquiat} painting sold for over a hundred million dollars.
e.zh: 一幅巴斯奎特的画作以超过一亿美元的价格成交。

e.en: The exhibit features early sketches by Jean-Michel {Basquiat}.
e.zh: 展览展出了让-米歇尔·巴斯奎特的早期素描。

basra.t: n. 巴士拉（伊拉克城市）

e.en: {Basra} is a major port city in southern Iraq.
e.zh: 巴士拉是伊拉克南部的一座主要港口城市。

e.en: Oil is shipped from {Basra} through the Persian Gulf.
e.zh: 石油从巴士拉经波斯湾运出。

bass.t:
n. 低音；贝斯
n. 鲈鱼

e.en: He plays the {bass} guitar in a local jazz band.
e.zh: 他在一支当地的爵士乐队里弹贝斯。

e.en: Turn down the {bass} — the neighbors are complaining again.
e.zh: 把低音调低点,邻居又在抱怨了。

e.en: The town of {Bassano} del Grappa lies at the foot of the Alps.
e.zh: 巴萨诺-德尔格拉帕镇坐落在阿尔卑斯山脚下。

e.en: Several paintings by Jacopo {Bassano} hang in the museum.
e.zh: 博物馆里挂着几幅雅各布·巴萨诺的画作。

basses.t: n. bass 的复数；低音乐器/鲈鱼

e.en: The choir's two {basses} added depth to the harmony.
e.zh: 合唱团的两位男低音让和声更加饱满。

e.en: He owns three vintage {basses} from the seventies.
e.zh: 他收藏了三把七十年代的复古贝斯。

e.en: Their {basset} hound has unbelievably long droopy ears.
e.zh: 他们家的巴吉度猎犬耳朵长得不可思议。

e.en: A lazy {basset} sleeps on the porch all afternoon.
e.zh: 一只懒洋洋的巴吉度犬整个下午都在门廊上睡觉。

e.en: The newborn slept peacefully in a white wicker {bassinet}.
e.zh: 新生儿在白色柳条摇篮里安静地睡着。

e.en: They placed the {bassinet} right next to the bed.
e.zh: 他们把婴儿摇篮放在床的旁边。

bassist.t: n. 贝斯手；低音提琴手

e.en: The band's new {bassist} writes most of their songs.
e.zh: 乐队的新贝斯手包揽了他们大部分的作曲。

e.en: She's been a session {bassist} in Nashville for ten years.
e.zh: 她在纳什维尔做录音棚贝斯手已经十年了。

e.en: The opera star sang the role with a powerful {basso} voice.
e.zh: 那位歌剧明星用浑厚的男低音演绎了这个角色。

e.en: A deep {basso} hum filled the cathedral during the chant.
e.zh: 诵唱时,深沉的低音回荡在大教堂里。

e.en: She plays the {bassoon} in the city's symphony orchestra.
e.zh: 她在市交响乐团里演奏巴松管。

e.en: The {bassoon} solo gave the piece a mournful tone.
e.zh: 巴松管的独奏为这首乐曲增添了哀伤的色彩。

e.en: The {bassoonist} practiced for hours before the audition.
e.zh: 那位巴松管演奏家在试演前练习了好几个小时。

e.en: A young {bassoonist} from Korea won the international competition.
e.zh: 一位来自韩国的年轻巴松管演奏家赢得了国际大赛。

e.en: The carver chose {basswood} for its soft, even grain.
e.zh: 雕刻师选了椴木，因为它纹理柔软均匀。

e.en: A {basswood} tree shaded the corner of the yard.
e.zh: 一棵椴树为院角投下阴凉。

e.en: Ropes were traditionally made from {bast} fibers of the linden.
e.zh: 绳子传统上由椴树的韧皮纤维制成。

e.en: The basket weaver soaked the {bast} before stripping it.
e.zh: 编筐人把韧皮浸湿后再剥下来。

bastard.t:
n. 混蛋；私生子
adj. 杂种的、伪劣的

e.en: Don't be a {bastard} about the parking spot.
e.zh: 别为了那个车位这么混蛋。

e.en: The recipe is a {bastard} version of the original.
e.zh: 这道菜是原版的一个杂糅改编。

e.en: Critics called the remake a {bastardization} of the classic film.
e.zh: 评论家说这部翻拍是对经典电影的拙劣改造。

e.en: The translation is a {bastardization} of the author's elegant prose.
e.zh: 这个译本糟蹋了作者优雅的文风。

e.en: Don't {bastardize} the recipe by skipping the slow simmer.
e.zh: 别因为省去慢炖就把这道菜做走样了。

e.en: Marketers tend to {bastardize} scientific terms for catchy slogans.
e.zh: 营销人员常常滥用科学术语来制造吸睛口号。

bastardized.t: adj. 被篡改的；被劣化的

e.en: The app uses a {bastardized} form of Markdown syntax.
e.zh: 这款应用使用了一种被改造过的 Markdown 语法。

e.en: Fans complained that the sequel {bastardized} the original story.
e.zh: 粉丝抱怨续集糟蹋了原本的故事。

e.en: Old laws once denied inheritance on grounds of {bastardy}.
e.zh: 旧时法律曾以私生身份为由拒绝继承权。

e.en: The novel explores the social stigma of {bastardy} in Victorian England.
e.zh: 小说探讨了维多利亚时代英格兰对私生子的社会偏见。

baste.t:
v. 烤肉时浇油
v. 粗缝、假缝

e.en: {Baste} the turkey every twenty minutes for crispy skin.
e.zh: 每二十分钟给火鸡浇一次油，皮才会脆。

e.en: The tailor will {baste} the seam before the final stitch.
e.zh: 裁缝会在最终缝合前先疏缝一下接缝。

e.en: Use a {baster} to draw juices from the roasting pan.
e.zh: 用滴油管从烤盘里吸取肉汁。

e.en: She squeezed the {baster} and drizzled broth over the chicken.
e.zh: 她挤压滴油管，把高汤淋在鸡肉上。

e.en: The crowd stormed the {bastille} on July 14, 1789.
e.zh: 民众在 1789 年 7 月 14 日攻占了巴士底狱。

e.en: He compared the old prison to a forgotten {bastille}.
e.zh: 他把那座旧监狱比作一座被遗忘的巴士底。

e.en: Constant {basting} keeps the roast from drying out.
e.zh: 不断浇汁能让烤肉不至于变干。

e.en: She removed the {basting} stitches once the dress fit perfectly.
e.zh: 等裙子完全合身后，她拆掉了疏缝线。

e.en: The university remains a {bastion} of free speech.
e.zh: 这所大学仍是言论自由的堡垒。

e.en: That small town is the last {bastion} of the dialect.
e.zh: 那个小镇是这种方言最后的据点。

bat.t:
n. 球棒；蝙蝠
v. 击球

e.en: He swung the {bat} and missed the pitch.
e.zh: 他挥棒落空，没打中投球。

e.en: A {bat} flew out of the attic at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时一只蝙蝠从阁楼飞了出来。

e.en: Students discussed Georges {Bataille} in the philosophy seminar.
e.zh: 学生们在哲学研讨课上讨论乔治·巴塔耶。

e.en: {Bataille}'s essays explore taboo, excess, and transgression.
e.zh: 巴塔耶的随笔探讨禁忌、过度与僭越。

e.en: The {batboy} sprinted out to retrieve the dropped helmet.
e.zh: 球童飞奔出去捡回掉落的头盔。

e.en: As a kid he dreamed of being a {batboy} for the Yankees.
e.zh: 小时候他梦想着当洋基队的球童。

batch.t:
n. 一批；批处理
v. 分批处理

e.en: I baked a fresh {batch} of cookies this morning.
e.zh: 今早我烤了一炉新鲜的曲奇。

e.en: The script processes records in a single {batch}.
e.zh: 这个脚本会一次性批量处理记录。

batchelor.t: n. 巴彻勒（姓氏）；bachelor 旧拼写

e.en: The form misspells the word as {batchelor} instead of bachelor.
e.zh: 表格把 bachelor 错拼成了 batchelor。

e.en: Mr. {Batchelor} signed the contract on Friday.
e.zh: 巴彻勒先生在周五签了合同。

batches.t:
n. batch 的复数；多批
v. 分批处理

e.en: The bakery ships cookies in small {batches} each morning.
e.zh: 这家面包店每天早上小批量发货曲奇。

e.en: Run the import in {batches} of one thousand records.
e.zh: 按每批一千条记录来执行导入。

bate.t: v. 减少、压低（多用于 with bated breath）

e.en: The crowd waited with {bate}d breath for the verdict.
e.zh: 人群屏息等待裁决结果。

e.en: Nothing could {bate} her enthusiasm for the project.
e.zh: 没有什么能减弱她对这个项目的热情。

e.en: They paddled a flat-bottomed {bateau} down the river.
e.zh: 他们划着一艘平底小船顺流而下。

e.en: The old {bateau} was tied beneath the willow tree.
e.zh: 那艘旧平底船系在柳树下。

bated.t: adj. 屏住的（with bated breath 屏息）

e.en: Fans watched the final minute with {bated} breath.
e.zh: 球迷屏息观看最后一分钟。

e.en: She read the verdict with {bated} breath.
e.zh: 她屏住呼吸读着判决书。

e.en: Norman {Bates} is the chilling villain of Hitchcock's Psycho.
e.zh: 诺曼·贝茨是希区柯克《惊魂记》中令人毛骨悚然的反派。

e.en: Lawyers used {Bates} numbering to label every page of evidence.
e.zh: 律师用贝茨编号给每一页证据编序。

e.en: I took a long hot {bath} after the hike.
e.zh: 徒步之后我泡了一个长长的热水澡。

e.en: The dog hates getting a {bath} in the tub.
e.zh: 那只狗讨厌在浴缸里洗澡。

bathe.t:
v. 沐浴；浸泡
v. 沐浴在（光线中）

e.en: Doctors said to {bathe} the wound in warm water.
e.zh: 医生说要用温水清洗伤口。

e.en: On hot evenings we {bathe} in the lake.
e.zh: 炎热的傍晚我们会在湖里游泳。

bathed.t:
v. bathe 的过去式
adj. 沐浴着的、笼罩着的

e.en: The hilltop was {bathed} in golden sunset light.
e.zh: 山顶沐浴在金色的夕阳里。

e.en: She {bathed} the baby gently in the kitchen sink.
e.zh: 她在厨房水槽里轻轻地给宝宝洗澡。

e.en: A lone {bather} swam slow laps across the pool.
e.zh: 一名独自的泳客在泳池里慢慢游来回。

e.en: The lifeguard waved the {bather} closer to shore.
e.zh: 救生员示意那个泳客靠岸近一些。

bathes.t: v. bathe 的三单；沐浴、浸泡

e.en: She {bathes} the puppy every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 她每个周日早上都给小狗洗澡。

e.en: Moonlight {bathes} the quiet courtyard in silver.
e.zh: 月光把安静的庭院染成银色。

bathetic.t: adj. 陈腐伤感的；矫情的

e.en: The film's {bathetic} ending undermined its serious themes.
e.zh: 影片虎头蛇尾的结尾削弱了它严肃的主题。

e.en: His grand speech ended on a {bathetic} note about parking fees.
e.zh: 他宏大的演讲以谈论停车费这种扫兴话题收尾。

bathgate.t: n. 巴斯盖特（苏格兰地名）

e.en: The train from Edinburgh stops at {Bathgate} every half hour.
e.zh: 从爱丁堡出发的列车每半小时在巴斯盖特停一次。

e.en: She grew up in {Bathgate}, a town in West Lothian.
e.zh: 她在西洛锡安的小镇巴斯盖特长大。

e.en: We rented a towel at the public {bathhouse}.
e.zh: 我们在公共浴室租了一条毛巾。

e.en: The Japanese {bathhouse} kept its waters at perfect temperature.
e.zh: 那间日式澡堂把水温控制得恰到好处。

e.en: Traditional {bathhouses} still thrive in many Japanese neighborhoods.
e.zh: 传统澡堂在许多日本街区依然兴旺。

e.en: Roman cities were famous for their grand public {bathhouses}.
e.zh: 罗马城市以宏伟的公共浴场闻名。

bathing.t:
n. 沐浴；游泳
adj. 沐浴用的

e.en: She packed a {bathing} suit for the beach trip.
e.zh: 她为这次海滩之旅装了一件泳衣。

e.en: {Bathing} the dog takes nearly an hour.
e.zh: 给狗洗澡要花将近一个小时。

e.en: The prefix {batho} comes from Greek and means depth.
e.zh: 前缀 batho 源自希腊语，意为深度。

e.en: Words like bathysphere use {batho} to signal deep water.
e.zh: 像 bathysphere 这样的词用 batho 表示深水。

batholith.t: n. 岩基（大型侵入岩体）

e.en: Yosemite's cliffs were carved from a massive granite {batholith}.
e.zh: 约塞米蒂的悬崖是由巨大的花岗岩深成岩体雕刻而成。

e.en: Geologists mapped the buried {batholith} using gravity surveys.
e.zh: 地质学家通过重力测量绘制出地下的深成岩体。

e.en: The poem slips into {bathos} when it mentions his cat.
e.zh: 这首诗一提到他的猫就跌入了滑稽。

e.en: Avoid {bathos} by cutting the overly sentimental closing line.
e.zh: 删掉过于煽情的结尾，避免落入虎头蛇尾。

e.en: He answered the door in a fluffy white {bathrobe}.
e.zh: 他披着一件蓬松的白色浴袍来开门。

e.en: The hotel left a soft {bathrobe} on the bed.
e.zh: 酒店在床上放了一件柔软的浴袍。

baulk.t:
v. 犹豫；畏缩不前
n. 障碍

e.en: Investors might {baulk} at such a high interest rate.
e.zh: 投资者可能会对如此高的利率望而却步。

e.en: Many parents {baulk} when they see the school's tuition fees.
e.zh: 许多家长一看到学校的学费就退缩了。

e.en: Australia exports huge quantities of {bauxite} to China each year.
e.zh: 澳大利亚每年向中国出口大量铝土矿。

e.en: Aluminum is extracted from {bauxite} through electrolysis.
e.zh: 铝是通过电解从铝土矿中提取的。

bavaria.t: n. 巴伐利亚（德国州名）

e.en: We hiked through small villages across southern {Bavaria}.
e.zh: 我们徒步穿过了巴伐利亚南部的小村庄。

e.en: {Bavaria} is famous for its beer gardens and castles.
e.zh: 巴伐利亚以啤酒花园和城堡闻名。

bavarian.t:
adj. 巴伐利亚的
n. 巴伐利亚人

e.en: He ordered a {Bavarian} pretzel and a tall glass of beer.
e.zh: 他点了一只巴伐利亚椒盐卷饼和一大杯啤酒。

e.en: The {Bavarian} Alps attract skiers from all over Europe.
e.zh: 巴伐利亚阿尔卑斯山吸引着来自全欧洲的滑雪爱好者。

e.en: In the old play, a clever {bawd} ran the local tavern.
e.zh: 在那部老戏里,精明的鸨母经营着当地的小酒馆。

e.en: Shakespeare often wrote a comic {bawd} into his city scenes.
e.zh: 莎士比亚常在他的市井场景中塑造滑稽的老鸨。

e.en: The comedian told a few {bawdy} jokes that made everyone blush.
e.zh: 喜剧演员讲了几个荤段子,把大家都逗红了脸。

e.en: Sailors used to sing {bawdy} songs on long voyages.
e.zh: 水手们以前在长途航行中常唱黄色小调。

e.en: The toddler started to {bawl} when his ice cream fell.
e.zh: 小孩冰淇淋掉了之后开始嚎啕大哭。

e.en: The coach will {bawl} at any player who shows up late.
e.zh: 教练会对任何迟到的队员大吼大叫。

bawling.t: v. 大声哭喊（bawl 的现在分词）

e.en: The baby was {bawling} loudly throughout the entire flight.
e.zh: 婴儿在整个航程中一直放声大哭。

e.en: He came home to find his daughter {bawling} on the couch.
e.zh: 他回到家发现女儿在沙发上嚎啕大哭。

bay.t:
n. 海湾；隔间
v. (狗) 吠叫

e.en: We rented a small cottage overlooking the {bay}.
e.zh: 我们租了一间俯瞰海湾的小别墅。

e.en: Add a {bay} leaf to the soup for extra flavor.
e.zh: 在汤里加一片月桂叶增添风味。

e.en: She lit a {bayberry} candle to fill the room with scent.
e.zh: 她点了一支杨梅蜡烛,让房间充满香气。

e.en: {Bayberry} bushes grow wild along the New England coast.
e.zh: 杨梅灌木沿新英格兰海岸野生生长。

bayer.t: n. 拜耳（德国制药公司）

e.en: {Bayer} is one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in Europe.
e.zh: 拜耳是欧洲最大的制药公司之一。

e.en: He took a {Bayer} aspirin to ease his pounding headache.
e.zh: 他吃了一片拜耳阿司匹林缓解剧烈头痛。

bayern.t: n. 拜仁（德国巴伐利亚州/足球俱乐部）

e.en: {Bayern} Munich won another Bundesliga title this season.
e.zh: 拜仁慕尼黑本赛季再夺德甲冠军。

e.en: He bought a jersey with the {Bayern} crest at the stadium.
e.zh: 他在球场买了件印有拜仁队徽的球衣。

bayes.t: n. 贝叶斯（统计学家姓氏）

e.en: The model relies on {Bayes} theorem to update its predictions.
e.zh: 该模型依靠贝叶斯定理来更新预测。

e.en: Thomas {Bayes} laid the groundwork for modern probability theory.
e.zh: 托马斯·贝叶斯奠定了现代概率论的基础。

bayesian.t: adj. 贝叶斯的（统计方法）

e.en: Our team uses a {Bayesian} approach to analyze A/B test results.
e.zh: 我们团队用贝叶斯方法分析 A/B 测试结果。

e.en: {Bayesian} statistics can handle uncertainty more naturally.
e.zh: 贝叶斯统计能更自然地处理不确定性。

e.en: The {Bayeux} Tapestry depicts the Norman conquest of England.
e.zh: 贝叶挂毯描绘了诺曼人征服英格兰的过程。

e.en: We took a day trip to {Bayeux} from our hotel in Caen.
e.zh: 我们从卡昂的酒店出发去贝叶玩了一天。

bayfield.t: n. 贝菲尔德（地名/姓氏）

e.en: We spent the weekend kayaking near {Bayfield}, Wisconsin.
e.zh: 我们在威斯康星州贝菲尔德附近划皮划艇度过了周末。

e.en: {Bayfield} is the gateway town to the Apostle Islands.
e.zh: 贝菲尔德是通往阿波斯尔群岛的门户小镇。

baying.t: v. (犬) 嚎叫（bay 的现在分词）

e.en: The hounds were {baying} loudly at the full moon.
e.zh: 猎犬对着满月大声嗥叫。

e.en: Reporters stood {baying} for answers outside the courthouse.
e.zh: 记者们在法院外吵嚷着要答案。

e.en: The old {bayman} hauled crab traps from the shallow water.
e.zh: 那位老海湾渔民从浅水里拉起蟹笼。

e.en: Every {bayman} on the coast knew the changing tides.
e.zh: 沿岸每个海湾渔民都熟知潮汐变化。

bayonet.t:
n. 刺刀
v. 用刺刀刺

e.en: Soldiers fixed a {bayonet} to the end of each rifle.
e.zh: 士兵们在每支步枪末端装上刺刀。

e.en: The museum displayed a rusted {bayonet} from the Civil War.
e.zh: 博物馆展出一把内战时期生锈的刺刀。

e.en: We took a ferry from Manhattan over to {Bayonne}.
e.zh: 我们从曼哈顿坐渡轮到贝永。

e.en: {Bayonne} ham is famous throughout southwestern France.
e.zh: 巴约纳火腿在法国西南部远近闻名。

e.en: Alligators slid silently through the murky Louisiana {bayou}.
e.zh: 鳄鱼在浑浊的路易斯安那河汊中悄悄滑行。

e.en: They paddled a canoe deep into the cypress {bayou}.
e.zh: 他们划着独木舟深入柏树沼泽河汊。

e.en: Sheltered {bays} along the coast attract weekend sailors.
e.zh: 沿岸的避风海湾吸引着周末出海的水手。

e.en: The garage has four {bays} for servicing trucks.
e.zh: 车库有四个工位用来检修卡车。

bayswater.t: n. 贝斯沃特（伦敦地名）

e.en: She rented a small flat in {Bayswater} near Hyde Park.
e.zh: 她在海德公园附近的贝斯沃特租了一间小公寓。

e.en: {Bayswater} is known for its diverse restaurants and Victorian terraces.
e.zh: 贝斯沃特以多元餐厅和维多利亚式联排房闻名。

e.en: Reruns of {Baywatch} still air on cable channels worldwide.
e.zh: 《海岸救生队》的重播至今仍在全球有线频道播出。

e.en: He grew up watching {Baywatch} every Saturday afternoon.
e.zh: 他从小每个周六下午都看《海岸救生队》。

e.en: The Istanbul {bazaar} sells everything from spices to carpets.
e.zh: 伊斯坦布尔大集市卖的东西从香料到地毯应有尽有。

e.en: Our school holds a charity {bazaar} every December.
e.zh: 我们学校每年十二月举办慈善义卖。

e.en: Tourists wandered through the colorful Indian {bazar} all afternoon.
e.zh: 游客们整个下午在色彩缤纷的印度集市里闲逛。

e.en: The old {bazar} has stood here for over a century.
e.zh: 这座古老的集市在此屹立已超过一个世纪。

bazooka.t: n. 火箭筒；反坦克火箭

e.en: The soldier raised the {bazooka} and aimed at the tank.
e.zh: 士兵举起火箭筒,瞄准坦克。

e.en: In the game you can unlock a gold-plated {bazooka}.
e.zh: 在游戏里你可以解锁一把镀金火箭筒。

bbc.t: n. 英国广播公司（British Broadcasting Corporation）

e.en: I watch {BBC} News every morning before work.
e.zh: 我每天上班前都看BBC新闻。

e.en: The documentary was produced by the {BBC} natural history unit.
e.zh: 这部纪录片由BBC自然历史部门制作。

bcci.t: n. 国际商业信贷银行（BCCI）

e.en: The {BCCI} scandal exposed massive international banking fraud in 1991.
e.zh: 国际商业信贷银行丑闻在1991年曝光了大规模国际银行欺诈。

e.en: Regulators shut {BCCI} down across multiple countries simultaneously.
e.zh: 监管机构同时在多个国家关闭了国际商业信贷银行。

bcd.t: abbr. 二进制编码十进制（Binary-Coded Decimal）

e.en: Old calculators stored each digit using {BCD} encoding.
e.zh: 老式计算器用BCD编码存储每一位数字。

e.en: The microcontroller converts the timer value to {BCD} for display.
e.zh: 该单片机将计时值转换为BCD码以便显示。

e.en: Babies in many countries receive a {BCG} vaccine against tuberculosis.
e.zh: 许多国家的婴儿都会接种卡介苗预防结核病。

e.en: She still has a small {BCG} scar on her shoulder.
e.zh: 她肩膀上仍留着一个小小的卡介苗疤痕。

bcp.t: abbr. 业务连续性计划（Business Continuity Plan）

e.en: Every company should maintain an updated {BCP} for emergencies.
e.zh: 每家公司都应保持一份更新的业务连续性计划以应对紧急情况。

e.en: The team tested its {BCP} during the simulated outage.
e.zh: 团队在模拟停机演练中测试了业务连续性计划。

e.en: The lab studied {BCR} signaling in developing B cells.
e.zh: 实验室研究了发育中B细胞的BCR信号通路。

e.en: Mutations in the {BCR} gene can drive certain leukemias.
e.zh: BCR基因突变可能引发某些白血病。

bda.t: abbr. 百度分析/生物数据分析（语境定义）

e.en: The {BDA} oversees urban planning across the Bangalore region.
e.zh: 班加罗尔发展局负责整个班加罗尔地区的城市规划。

e.en: Developers must obtain {BDA} approval before starting construction.
e.zh: 开发商在动工前必须获得发展局的批准。

e.en: The {BDDA} regulates real estate projects within its district.
e.zh: 该发展局管辖区内的房地产项目。

e.en: Residents complained to the {BDDA} about delayed road repairs.
e.zh: 居民向发展局投诉道路修缮拖延。

bea.t: n. 贝阿（人名，Beatrice 的昵称）

e.en: My aunt {Bea} bakes the best apple pie in town.
e.zh: 我的碧阿姨烤的苹果派是镇上最好的。

e.en: {Bea} Arthur was famous for her role on Golden Girls.
e.zh: 碧·亚瑟因在《黄金女郎》中的角色而出名。

beach.t:
n. 海滩
v. 把(船)拖上岸

e.en: We spent the whole afternoon at the {beach} swimming.
e.zh: 我们整个下午都在海滩游泳。

e.en: Storms can {beach} whales on the shoreline.
e.zh: 风暴可能把鲸鱼搁浅在海岸上。

beachcomber.t: n. 海滩拾荒者；流浪汉

e.en: A {beachcomber} found a glass bottle with a note inside.
e.zh: 一位拾荒漫步者在沙滩上捡到一个装着信的玻璃瓶。

e.en: He lives like a {beachcomber}, walking the shore every dawn.
e.zh: 他过着海滩漫游者般的生活,每天黎明在岸边散步。

beached.t: adj. 搁浅的；被冲上岸的

e.en: Volunteers tried to save the {beached} dolphin at sunrise.
e.zh: 志愿者们在日出时试图救助搁浅的海豚。

e.en: A {beached} sailboat sat tilted on the wet sand.
e.zh: 一艘搁浅的帆船歪斜地躺在湿沙上。

e.en: Thailand has some of the most beautiful {beaches} in Asia.
e.zh: 泰国拥有亚洲一些最美的海滩。

e.en: Crowded {beaches} along the coast filled up by noon.
e.zh: 沿岸拥挤的海滩到中午就坐满了人。

beachfront.t:
adj. 临海滩的
n. 海滩前沿地带

e.en: They booked a {beachfront} villa for their honeymoon.
e.zh: 他们为蜜月预订了一栋海滨别墅。

e.en: {Beachfront} property prices have doubled in the past decade.
e.zh: 海滨房产的价格在过去十年里翻了一番。

e.en: Allied troops established a {beachhead} on the Normandy coast.
e.zh: 盟军在诺曼底海岸建立了滩头阵地。

e.en: The startup used Singapore as its {beachhead} into Asia.
e.zh: 这家初创公司把新加坡作为进军亚洲的桥头堡。

e.en: Her hair had that effortless {beachy} wave look.
e.zh: 她的头发呈现出那种随性的海滩卷发感。

e.en: The cafe has a relaxed, {beachy} vibe year-round.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆全年都有种放松的海滩气息。

beacon.t:
n. 信标；灯塔
v. 照亮、指引

e.en: A lighthouse {beacon} guided ships through the foggy strait.
e.zh: 灯塔的光束引导船只穿过雾蒙蒙的海峡。

e.en: The app emits a Bluetooth {beacon} for nearby devices.
e.zh: 该应用会向附近设备发射蓝牙信标。

beaconsfield.t: n. 比肯斯菲尔德（地名）

e.en: {Beaconsfield} is a quiet commuter town just outside London.
e.zh: 比肯斯菲尔德是伦敦郊外一座安静的通勤小镇。

e.en: They moved to {Beaconsfield} for the excellent schools.
e.zh: 他们因为学校优秀而搬到比肯斯菲尔德。

bead.t:
n. 珠子；小水珠
v. 串珠

e.en: A single {bead} of sweat rolled down her forehead.
e.zh: 一滴汗珠从她额头滚落。

e.en: She threaded each glass {bead} onto the silver wire.
e.zh: 她把每颗玻璃珠子串到银线上。

beaded.t: adj. 缀有珠子的；成串的

e.en: She wore a {beaded} dress to the gala dinner.
e.zh: 她穿着一条缀珠礼服出席晚宴。

e.en: Tiny droplets {beaded} on the cold glass of water.
e.zh: 小水珠在冰凉的玻璃杯上凝成了水滴。

e.en: The wedding gown features intricate {beading} along the bodice.
e.zh: 这件婚纱在胸衣处缀有精致的串珠装饰。

e.en: She spent weeks {beading} the traditional ceremonial garment.
e.zh: 她花了数周给传统礼服钉珠。

beadle.t: n. 教区执事；教堂司事

e.en: The {beadle} kept order during the church service.
e.zh: 教堂执事在礼拜期间维持秩序。

e.en: In Dickens, the {beadle} represents petty official cruelty.
e.zh: 在狄更斯笔下,教区执事象征着小官吏的冷酷。

e.en: Native American {beadwork} decorates the museum's textile gallery.
e.zh: 美洲原住民的串珠工艺装点着博物馆的纺织品展厅。

e.en: Her handmade {beadwork} sells well at craft fairs.
e.zh: 她手工制作的串珠饰品在手工艺集市上很畅销。

beady.t: adj. (眼睛) 小而亮的，珠子般的

e.en: The crow watched me with bright, {beady} eyes.
e.zh: 乌鸦用明亮的小圆眼睛盯着我。

e.en: He kept a {beady} eye on the suspicious customer.
e.zh: 他用锐利的小眼睛盯着那个可疑的顾客。

e.en: Our {beagle} howls every time the doorbell rings.
e.zh: 我们家的小猎犬每次门铃响都会嗥叫。

e.en: A {beagle} has one of the strongest noses among dogs.
e.zh: 小猎犬的嗅觉是狗类中最灵敏的之一。

e.en: Two {beagles} chased squirrels across the front lawn.
e.zh: 两只小猎犬在前院草坪上追松鼠。

e.en: {Beagles} are popular family pets because of their friendly nature.
e.zh: 小猎犬因性情友善而成为受欢迎的家庭宠物。

e.en: The parrot cracked the seed open with its strong {beak}.
e.zh: 鹦鹉用强壮的喙啄开了种子。

e.en: A pelican's {beak} can hold several liters of water.
e.zh: 鹈鹕的嘴可以容纳好几升水。

e.en: Researchers spotted a rare {beaked} whale off the island.
e.zh: 研究人员在岛屿附近发现了一头罕见的喙鲸。

e.en: The mask had a long, sharply {beaked} nose.
e.zh: 那面具有一个又长又尖的喙形鼻子。

e.en: Pour the solution carefully into a clean glass {beaker}.
e.zh: 把溶液小心倒入干净的玻璃烧杯。

e.en: The chemist heated the {beaker} over a Bunsen burner.
e.zh: 化学家把烧杯放在本生灯上加热。

e.en: Different finch species evolved distinctive {beaks} on the islands.
e.zh: 不同种类的雀鸟在岛上演化出各具特色的喙。

e.en: The chicks opened their {beaks} wide for food.
e.zh: 雏鸟张大喙等着吃食。

beaky.t: adj. 像鸟喙的；鹰钩鼻的

e.en: He had a thin face and a {beaky} nose.
e.zh: 他脸瘦削,鼻子像鸟喙一样高挺。

e.en: The cartoon character was instantly recognizable by his {beaky} profile.
e.zh: 那卡通人物因鸟喙般的侧脸而一眼就能认出。

beam.t:
n. 光束；横梁
v. 发光；笑容满面

e.en: A narrow {beam} of sunlight fell across the wooden floor.
e.zh: 一束窄窄的阳光洒在木地板上。

e.en: The steel {beam} supports the entire roof above.
e.zh: 那根钢梁支撑着上方整个屋顶。

beamed.t:
v. 发射、照射（beam 过去式）
adj. 有横梁的

e.en: She {beamed} with pride when her son graduated.
e.zh: 儿子毕业时她笑得满脸自豪。

e.en: The concert was {beamed} live to fans around the world.
e.zh: 这场音乐会向全球粉丝现场直播。

e.en: He pulled up to the office in a brand-new {beamer}.
e.zh: 他开着一辆崭新的宝马来到公司。

e.en: The startup borrowed a {beamer} for the presentation.
e.zh: 这家初创公司借了台投影仪做演讲。

beaming.t: adj. 喜气洋洋的；容光焕发的

e.en: The bride was {beaming} as she walked down the aisle.
e.zh: 新娘走过红毯时笑容灿烂。

e.en: Satellites are {beaming} live footage from the disaster zone.
e.zh: 卫星正在从灾区传送实况画面。

beamish.t: adj. 喜笑颜开的；开心的

e.en: The grandfather greeted his grandchildren with a {beamish} smile.
e.zh: 爷爷用灿烂的笑容迎接孙子孙女。

e.en: Her {beamish} face lit up the entire room.
e.zh: 她笑容满面的脸照亮了整个房间。

e.en: Old wooden {beams} run across the cottage ceiling.
e.zh: 古老的木梁横贯小屋的天花板。

e.en: Headlight {beams} cut through the heavy fog ahead.
e.zh: 车灯光束穿透前方浓雾。

e.en: The fishing boat was wide and {beamy} for stability.
e.zh: 这艘渔船船身宽阔以保持稳定。

e.en: A {beamy} catamaran handles rough seas surprisingly well.
e.zh: 宽船身的双体船在恶劣海况下表现出奇地好。

e.en: She added a black {bean} sauce to the stir-fry.
e.zh: 她在炒菜里加了豆豉酱。

e.en: Each coffee {bean} is roasted to bring out its flavor.
e.zh: 每颗咖啡豆都经过烘焙以激发风味。

e.en: She curled up on the giant {beanbag} to read.
e.zh: 她蜷在大豆袋椅上看书。

e.en: The kids tossed a {beanbag} across the playroom.
e.zh: 孩子们在游戏室里扔豆袋玩。

e.en: The soup had soft {beancurd} and fresh greens.
e.zh: 汤里有嫩豆腐和新鲜青菜。

e.en: He fried the {beancurd} until it was golden brown.
e.zh: 他把豆腐煎到金黄色。

beanie.t: n. 毛线帽；无檐小便帽

e.en: He pulled a wool {beanie} over his ears.
e.zh: 他把羊毛毛线帽拉下来盖住耳朵。

e.en: That black {beanie} suits your winter jacket perfectly.
e.zh: 那顶黑色毛线帽和你的冬季外套很配。

e.en: The whole office had a proper {beano} on Friday.
e.zh: 整个办公室周五办了一场热闹的派对。

e.en: Grandad still talks about that wild {beano} in Brighton.
e.zh: 爷爷还在念叨那次在布莱顿的狂欢。

e.en: Her teenage son grew into a lanky {beanpole}.
e.zh: 她十几岁的儿子长成了细高个儿。

e.en: The {beanpole} guard easily blocked every shot.
e.zh: 那个瘦高个儿后卫轻松封盖了每一球。

e.en: I had toast and {beans} for breakfast.
e.zh: 我早餐吃了吐司配焗豆。

e.en: She grinds fresh coffee {beans} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上现磨新鲜咖啡豆。

beanstalk.t: n. 豆茎（如杰克与豆茎）

e.en: Jack climbed the magic {beanstalk} into the clouds.
e.zh: 杰克爬上神奇的豆茎,直入云霄。

e.en: The {beanstalk} grew taller than the garden fence.
e.zh: 那株豆茎长得比花园围栏还高。

bear.t:
n. 熊
v. 承受；生育；携带

e.en: I can't {bear} watching horror movies alone.
e.zh: 我没法忍受独自看恐怖片。

e.en: A brown {bear} wandered near the campsite at dawn.
e.zh: 一只棕熊黎明时分在营地附近徘徊。

bearable.t: adj. 可忍受的；能承受的

e.en: Air conditioning made the heatwave just about {bearable}.
e.zh: 空调让这场热浪勉强还能忍受。

e.en: Good music makes long flights more {bearable}.
e.zh: 好听的音乐让长途航班更好熬一些。

e.en: He trimmed his thick {beard} before the interview.
e.zh: 他在面试前修剪了浓密的胡须。

e.en: She grew a small herb {beard} on her windowsill.
e.zh: 窗台上她种了一小撮香草。

e.en: A {bearded} barista handed me my latte.
e.zh: 一位留着胡子的咖啡师把拿铁递给我。

e.en: The {bearded} dragon basked under the heat lamp.
e.zh: 那只鬃狮蜥趴在加热灯下晒太阳。

beardless.t: adj. 没有胡须的；年少的

e.en: His {beardless} face made him look much younger.
e.zh: 没有胡子让他看起来年轻得多。

e.en: The {beardless} actor played a teenager convincingly.
e.zh: 那位没胡子的演员把少年演得很到位。

e.en: Long {beards} were fashionable among the young men.
e.zh: 大胡子在年轻男士中很流行。

e.en: The brothers both grew matching red {beards}.
e.zh: 两兄弟都留了一样的红胡子。

e.en: The {bearer} of this ticket gets free entry.
e.zh: 持此票者可免费入场。

e.en: I hate being the {bearer} of bad news.
e.zh: 我讨厌当传达坏消息的人。

bearing.t:
n. 轴承；举止；方位
v. 承受（bear 现在分词）

e.en: Her calm {bearing} impressed the entire panel.
e.zh: 她沉稳的举止让整个评审团印象深刻。

e.en: That comment has no {bearing} on our decision.
e.zh: 那条评论与我们的决定无关。

e.en: Give me a moment to get my {bearings}.
e.zh: 给我一会儿时间认清方向。

e.en: The wheel {bearings} need to be replaced soon.
e.zh: 车轮轴承很快就得换了。

e.en: Analysts remain {bearish} on tech stocks this quarter.
e.zh: 分析师本季度仍看空科技股。

e.en: The market turned {bearish} after the rate hike.
e.zh: 加息之后市场转为熊市。

e.en: The steak came with creamy {bearnaise} on the side.
e.zh: 牛排配着一份奶香浓郁的贝亚恩酱。

e.en: She whisked the {bearnaise} until perfectly smooth.
e.zh: 她把贝亚恩酱搅拌得无比顺滑。

bears.t:
n. 熊（复数）
v. 承受（第三人称单数）

e.en: This tree {bears} fruit every summer.
e.zh: 这棵树每年夏天都结果。

e.en: Two black {bears} were spotted near the trail.
e.zh: 步道附近发现了两只黑熊。

e.en: A thick {bearskin} rug covered the cabin floor.
e.zh: 一张厚实的熊皮地毯铺在小屋地板上。

e.en: The guards wore tall {bearskin} hats outside the palace.
e.zh: 卫兵在宫殿外戴着高高的熊皮帽。

e.en: That new GPU is an absolute {beast}.
e.zh: 那块新显卡简直是个怪兽。

e.en: A wild {beast} roared somewhere in the jungle.
e.zh: 丛林深处某处传来野兽的吼声。

beastie.t: n. 小动物；小虫子（口语）

e.en: What a cute little {beastie} you've adopted!
e.zh: 你领养的这只小家伙真可爱!

e.en: A furry {beastie} darted across the garden path.
e.zh: 一只毛茸茸的小动物窜过花园小径。

e.en: The {beastliness} of the crime shocked the village.
e.zh: 那桩罪行的残忍程度震惊了整个村子。

e.en: She apologized for her earlier {beastliness} at dinner.
e.zh: 她为晚餐时之前的恶劣态度道歉。

beastly.t:
adj. 糟糕的；讨厌的
adv. 非常地

e.en: The weather has been absolutely {beastly} all week.
e.zh: 这一周的天气糟糕透顶。

e.en: He apologized for his {beastly} behavior at the meeting.
e.zh: 他为自己在会上恶劣的表现道歉。

e.en: Mythical {beasts} appear throughout the old folk tales.
e.zh: 古老的民间故事里到处是神话野兽。

e.en: The farmer fed his {beasts} before sunrise.
e.zh: 农夫在日出前喂了他的牲畜。

beat.t:
v. 打败；击打
n. 节拍；节奏

e.en: Our team {beat} the champions in overtime.
e.zh: 我们队在加时赛击败了卫冕冠军。

e.en: This song has an addictive {beat}.
e.zh: 这首歌的节拍让人上瘾。

beatable.t: adj. 可击败的；可战胜的

e.en: Despite their record, the champions are still {beatable}.
e.zh: 尽管战绩亮眼,卫冕冠军并非不可战胜。

e.en: That price is hardly {beatable} anywhere online.
e.zh: 那个价格在网上几乎找不到更低的。

beaten.t: adj. 被打败的；被敲打的

e.en: Our team got {beaten} in the final round.
e.zh: 我们队在决赛中被击败。

e.en: Pour the {beaten} eggs into the hot pan.
e.zh: 把打好的鸡蛋倒进热锅里。

e.en: Use an electric {beater} to whip the cream.
e.zh: 用电动打蛋器把奶油打发。

e.en: His old car is just a rusty {beater}.
e.zh: 他那辆旧车不过是辆生锈的破车。

e.en: A {beatific} smile spread across the baby's face.
e.zh: 婴儿的脸上浮现出极乐般的微笑。

e.en: She wore a {beatific} expression after meditation.
e.zh: 冥想之后她神情安详幸福。

e.en: The monk smiled {beatifically} at the visiting children.
e.zh: 僧人对来访的孩子们露出极乐安详的微笑。

e.en: She gazed {beatifically} at the newborn in her arms.
e.zh: 她安详幸福地凝视着怀里的新生儿。

e.en: The Pope announced the {beatification} of the late nun.
e.zh: 教皇宣布为已故修女举行宣福礼。

e.en: His {beatification} drew pilgrims from across Europe.
e.zh: 他的宣福礼吸引了来自欧洲各地的朝圣者。

beatify.t: v. (天主教) 为…行宣福礼；使享天福

e.en: The Vatican voted to {beatify} the martyred priest.
e.zh: 梵蒂冈投票决定为殉道神父行宣福礼。

e.en: It can take centuries to {beatify} a candidate.
e.zh: 为一位候选人行宣福礼可能要花上几个世纪。

beating.t:
n. 殴打；挫败
v. 击打（beat 的现在分词）

e.en: Our defense took a real {beating} last night.
e.zh: 我们的防守昨晚真是被痛击了一顿。

e.en: His heart was {beating} fast after the run.
e.zh: 跑步后他的心脏跳得飞快。

e.en: The pilgrim's face glowed with quiet {beatitude}.
e.zh: 朝圣者的脸上闪着安静的至福之光。

e.en: She spoke about each {beatitude} from the sermon.
e.zh: 她讲述了布道中提到的每一条天福。

e.en: Paul is the most famous surviving {Beatle}.
e.zh: 保罗是最著名的在世披头士成员。

e.en: My dad still owns every {Beatle} record ever made.
e.zh: 我爸至今收藏着披头士发行过的每一张唱片。

beatnik.t: n. 垮掉的一代；避世青年

e.en: His grandfather was a {beatnik} poet in the fifties.
e.zh: 他祖父是五十年代的垮掉派诗人。

e.en: The cafe still has a moody {beatnik} vibe.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆仍带着颓废的垮掉派氛围。

beats.t:
n. 节拍；节奏
v. 打败（beat 第三人称单数）

e.en: Watching a movie at home {beats} sitting in traffic.
e.zh: 在家看电影比堵在路上强多了。

e.en: The producer layered jazzy {beats} under the vocals.
e.zh: 制作人在人声下铺了一层爵士节拍。

e.en: She introduced her new {beau} at the dinner party.
e.zh: 她在晚宴上介绍了她的新男友。

e.en: Grandma fondly remembered her first {beau}.
e.zh: 奶奶深情地回忆起她的初恋情人。

e.en: That startup raised {beaucoup} cash in a single round.
e.zh: 那家初创公司一轮融到了一大笔钱。

e.en: He spent {beaucoup} hours fixing the old engine.
e.zh: 他花了大把时间修那台老引擎。

e.en: Winds reached force eight on the {Beaufort} scale.
e.zh: 风力达到了蒲福风级的八级。

e.en: The yacht struggled in {Beaufort} force nine winds.
e.zh: 那艘游艇在蒲福九级大风中艰难航行。

e.en: We opened a young {Beaujolais} with the cheese course.
e.zh: 上奶酪时我们开了一瓶新酿博若莱。

e.en: This {Beaujolais} pairs nicely with roast chicken.
e.zh: 这瓶博若莱配烤鸡很合适。

e.en: We toured the vintage car museum in {Beaulieu}.
e.zh: 我们参观了博利厄的老爷车博物馆。

e.en: {Beaulieu} village sits quietly in the New Forest.
e.zh: 博利厄村静静地坐落在新森林国家公园里。

e.en: {Beaumaris} Castle is a stunning medieval ruin in Wales.
e.zh: 博马里斯城堡是威尔士一座壮观的中世纪遗迹。

e.en: We sailed into {Beaumaris} harbor at sunset.
e.zh: 我们日落时分驶入博马里斯港。

beaut.t: n. 极品；漂亮的人或物

e.en: That goal was an absolute {beaut}!
e.zh: 那个进球真是漂亮极了!

e.en: He caught a {beaut} of a fish this morning.
e.zh: 他今早钓到了一条大漂亮的鱼。

e.en: The poet praised her {beauteous} eyes in every verse.
e.zh: 诗人在每一节诗中赞美她美丽的双眸。

e.en: A {beauteous} sunset spilled across the valley.
e.zh: 绚丽的夕阳洒满了整个山谷。

e.en: My {beautician} recommended a gentler face cleanser.
e.zh: 我的美容师推荐了一款更温和的洁面乳。

e.en: She trained as a {beautician} after leaving school.
e.zh: 她离开学校后接受了美容师培训。

e.en: The city funded the {beautification} of the riverfront.
e.zh: 市政府出资美化了滨河区。

e.en: Volunteers joined the park {beautification} project.
e.zh: 志愿者们加入了公园美化项目。

beautified.t: v. 美化（beautify 的过去式）

e.en: The volunteers {beautified} the run-down playground.
e.zh: 志愿者们美化了那座破旧的游乐场。

e.en: Murals have {beautified} the once-drab subway station.
e.zh: 壁画美化了曾经单调的地铁站。

beautifies.t: v. 美化（beautify 第三人称单数）

e.en: Fresh paint truly {beautifies} this old wooden fence.
e.zh: 新刷的油漆把这道旧木栅栏装点得很漂亮。

e.en: The new garden {beautifies} the entire neighborhood.
e.zh: 新花园美化了整个社区。

e.en: The sunset over the lake was absolutely {beautiful}.
e.zh: 湖面上的日落美得令人惊叹。

e.en: She wore a {beautiful} dress to the wedding.
e.zh: 她穿了一件漂亮的裙子去参加婚礼。

e.en: The choir sang {beautifully} during the ceremony.
e.zh: 合唱团在仪式上唱得非常动听。

e.en: This app is {beautifully} designed and easy to use.
e.zh: 这款应用设计精美,使用起来也很方便。

e.en: The city plans to {beautify} the riverside with new gardens.
e.zh: 市政府计划用新花园美化河岸。

e.en: She uses filters to {beautify} her photos before posting.
e.zh: 她在发布照片前会用滤镜美化一下。

beautifying.t: v. 美化（beautify 的现在分词）

e.en: Volunteers spent the weekend {beautifying} the local park.
e.zh: 志愿者们整个周末都在美化当地公园。

e.en: She swears by this serum for {beautifying} her skin.
e.zh: 她非常推崇这款精华,说它能美肤。

e.en: The {beauty} of the mountains took my breath away.
e.zh: 山脉的美丽让我屏住了呼吸。

e.en: She runs a popular {beauty} channel on YouTube.
e.zh: 她在YouTube上经营着一个很火的美妆频道。

e.en: We landed at {Beauvais} airport north of Paris.
e.zh: 我们降落在巴黎北部的博韦机场。

e.en: The cathedral in {Beauvais} is famous for its height.
e.zh: 博韦的大教堂以其高度而闻名。

e.en: Simone de {Beauvoir} wrote a foundational feminist text.
e.zh: 西蒙娜·德·波伏娃写了一部奠基性的女权主义著作。

e.en: My professor often quotes {Beauvoir} in lectures on ethics.
e.zh: 我的教授在伦理学讲座中经常引用波伏娃的话。

beaux.t: n. 男友们（beau 的复数）

e.en: In old novels, young ladies often had several {beaux}.
e.zh: 在旧小说里,年轻女士通常有好几位追求者。

e.en: The mansion features classic {beaux}-arts architecture.
e.zh: 这座宅邸采用了经典的布扎艺术建筑风格。

e.en: A {beaver} built a dam across the small stream.
e.zh: 一只海狸在小溪上筑起了水坝。

e.en: He's an eager {beaver} who arrives early every day.
e.zh: 他是个工作狂,每天都早早到岗。

e.en: Lord {Beaverbrook} owned several major British newspapers.
e.zh: 比弗布鲁克勋爵拥有几家主要的英国报纸。

e.en: Churchill appointed {Beaverbrook} to manage aircraft production.
e.zh: 丘吉尔任命比弗布鲁克负责飞机生产。

e.en: {Beavers} were reintroduced to the river last year.
e.zh: 去年河里重新引入了海狸。

e.en: The team {beavers} away on the project all night.
e.zh: 团队整夜埋头苦干这个项目。

e.en: {Beavis} and Butt-Head defined a generation of MTV humor.
e.zh: 《瘪四与大头蛋》定义了一代MTV的幽默风格。

e.en: My brother still quotes {Beavis} cartoons from the nineties.
e.zh: 我哥哥还经常引用九十年代的瘪四动画台词。

e.en: {Bebington} is a quiet town on the Wirral peninsula.
e.zh: 贝宾顿是威勒尔半岛上一个宁静的小镇。

e.en: She grew up in {Bebington} before moving to London.
e.zh: 她在搬到伦敦之前一直在贝宾顿长大。

e.en: Charlie Parker helped invent the {bebop} style of jazz.
e.zh: 查理·帕克帮助创造了爵士乐中的比波普风格。

e.en: The trio played fast {bebop} solos all evening.
e.zh: 三重奏整晚都在演奏快速的比波普独奏。

bec.t: (罕用) n. 鸟喙（法语借词）

e.en: The abbey of {Bec} was a major medieval learning center.
e.zh: 贝克修道院是中世纪重要的学术中心。

e.en: Anselm taught at {Bec} before becoming archbishop.
e.zh: 安瑟伦在成为大主教之前曾在贝克教学。

becalm.t: v. 使风平浪静；使安静

e.en: A sudden lull can {becalm} a sailboat for hours.
e.zh: 突如其来的无风会让帆船停滞数小时。

e.en: Soft music helped {becalm} the anxious child.
e.zh: 轻柔的音乐让焦虑的孩子平静了下来。

becalmed.t: adj. (船只) 因无风而停滞的

e.en: The yacht was {becalmed} for two days at sea.
e.zh: 游艇在海上因无风停滞了两天。

e.en: Negotiations have been {becalmed} since the leadership change.
e.zh: 自领导层更换以来,谈判一直陷入停滞。
