e.en: I'm {betting} she'll get the promotion next month.
e.zh: 我打赌她下个月会升职。

e.en: Every smart {bettor} knows when to walk away.
e.zh: 每个聪明的赌徒都懂得何时收手。

e.en: The {bettor} placed a hundred dollars on the underdog.
e.zh: 那位下注者押了一百美元在弱队身上。

e.en: My grandmother {Betty} bakes the best apple pie.
e.zh: 我外婆贝蒂烤的苹果派最好吃。

e.en: Aunt {Betty} sent us a card from Paris.
e.zh: 贝蒂阿姨从巴黎寄来了一张明信片。

between.t:
prep. 在……之间
adv. 中间

e.en: The cafe sits {between} a bookstore and a bakery.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆坐落在书店和面包店之间。

e.en: Let's keep this conversation {between} you and me.
e.zh: 这次谈话就你我知道,别外传。

e.en: She felt {betwixt} two cultures growing up abroad.
e.zh: 她在国外长大,感觉夹在两种文化之间。

e.en: The village lies {betwixt} the river and the hills.
e.zh: 那座村庄坐落在河流与山丘之间。

bevel.t:
n. 斜面；斜角
v. 使成斜面

e.en: The carpenter cut a {bevel} along the edge of the board.
e.zh: 木匠在木板边缘切出一个斜角。

e.en: Use a {bevel} gauge to measure the angle accurately.
e.zh: 用斜角规来精确测量角度。

e.en: The mirror has a {beveled} edge that catches the light.
e.zh: 那面镜子有斜面边缘,能反射光线。

e.en: He installed {beveled} glass panels in the front door.
e.zh: 他在前门装了斜面玻璃板。

bevelled.t: adj. 有斜面的（英式拼写）

e.en: The table top has a beautifully {bevelled} edge.
e.zh: 那张桌面有漂亮的斜切边缘。

e.en: She admired the {bevelled} glass of the antique cabinet.
e.zh: 她欣赏那个古董柜的斜面玻璃。

e.en: Coffee is the most popular {beverage} in our office.
e.zh: 咖啡是我们办公室最受欢迎的饮料。

e.en: Please choose a {beverage} from the menu.
e.zh: 请从菜单上选一款饮品。

e.en: Fancy a {bevvy} down at the pub tonight?
e.zh: 今晚去酒吧喝一杯怎么样?

e.en: He stopped for a quick {bevvy} after work.
e.zh: 他下班后顺道去喝了一杯。

e.en: A {bevy} of reporters waited outside the courthouse.
e.zh: 一群记者在法院外等候。

e.en: The app offers a {bevy} of customization options.
e.zh: 这款应用提供了一系列自定义选项。

e.en: Many users {bewail} the loss of the old interface.
e.zh: 许多用户哀叹旧版界面的消失。

e.en: It's pointless to {bewail} mistakes you can't undo.
e.zh: 为无法挽回的错误哀叹是没有意义的。

e.en: {Beware} of phishing emails asking for your password.
e.zh: 小心索要密码的钓鱼邮件。

e.en: {Beware} the dog — that sign isn't a joke.
e.zh: 小心那只狗,那块牌子不是开玩笑的。

bewdley.t: n. 比由德利（英国地名）

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring {Bewdley} in Worcestershire.
e.zh: 我们周末去伍斯特郡的比尤德利游玩。

e.en: The river Severn flows right through {Bewdley}.
e.zh: 塞文河正好穿过比尤德利镇。

e.en: A {bewhiskered} old sailor told us stories of the sea.
e.zh: 一位满脸胡须的老水手给我们讲海上的故事。

e.en: The {bewhiskered} cat curled up on the windowsill.
e.zh: 那只长着长胡须的猫蜷缩在窗台上。

bewilder.t: v. 使迷惑；使不知所措

e.en: The new tax rules continue to {bewilder} small business owners.
e.zh: 新的税务规定让小企业主们一头雾水。

e.en: Complex menus often {bewilder} first-time users.
e.zh: 复杂的菜单常常让新用户感到困惑。

bewildered.t: adj. 困惑的；不知所措的

e.en: She looked {bewildered} when the WiFi suddenly stopped working.
e.zh: 无线网突然断了,她一脸茫然。

e.en: The tourists seemed {bewildered} by the subway map.
e.zh: 那些游客看着地铁图一头雾水。

e.en: The app has a {bewildering} array of settings to configure.
e.zh: 这款应用的设置选项多得令人眼花缭乱。

e.en: She found the legal jargon completely {bewildering}.
e.zh: 她觉得那些法律术语完全让人摸不着头脑。

e.en: The instructions were {bewilderingly} vague and contradictory.
e.zh: 那些说明含糊又矛盾,令人摸不着头脑。

e.en: Streaming services offer a {bewilderingly} wide selection.
e.zh: 流媒体服务提供的选择多得令人眼花缭乱。

e.en: He stared at the screen in complete {bewilderment}.
e.zh: 他完全茫然地盯着屏幕。

e.en: Her question was met with silent {bewilderment}.
e.zh: 她的问题换来的是一片茫然的沉默。

e.en: Modern parenting brings its own unique {bewilderments}.
e.zh: 现代育儿带来了它自己独有的种种困惑。

e.en: The novel explores the {bewilderments} of adolescence.
e.zh: 这本小说探讨了青春期的种种迷茫。

bewilders.t: v. 使迷惑（第三人称单数）

e.en: The complexity of crypto really {bewilders} most newcomers.
e.zh: 加密货币的复杂性确实让大多数新手摸不着头脑。

e.en: Her sudden mood change {bewilders} everyone around her.
e.zh: 她突然的情绪变化让身边所有人都困惑不已。

e.en: The singer's voice can {bewitch} an entire audience.
e.zh: 那位歌手的嗓音能迷住全场观众。

e.en: The seaside village will {bewitch} you within minutes.
e.zh: 那座海边小村几分钟内就会让你着迷。

bewitched.t: adj. 着迷的；被施魔法的

e.en: Audiences were {bewitched} by the dancer's grace and energy.
e.zh: 观众被那位舞者的优雅与活力深深迷住。

e.en: She felt utterly {bewitched} by the moonlit garden.
e.zh: 她完全被那座月光下的花园迷住了。

bewitching.t: adj. 迷人的；使人心醉的

e.en: The actress flashed a {bewitching} smile at the camera.
e.zh: 那位女演员对着镜头露出迷人的微笑。

e.en: Kyoto in autumn has a truly {bewitching} atmosphere.
e.zh: 秋天的京都有一种令人着迷的氛围。

e.en: The film captures the {bewitchment} of falling in love.
e.zh: 这部电影捕捉到了坠入爱河的那种迷醉。

e.en: Her voice held listeners in complete {bewitchment}.
e.zh: 她的嗓音让听众完全沉醉其中。

bexley.t: n. 贝克斯利（伦敦自治市）

e.en: My cousin commutes from {Bexley} into central London daily.
e.zh: 我表弟每天从贝克斯利通勤到伦敦市中心。

e.en: {Bexley} is one of the outer London boroughs.
e.zh: 贝克斯利是伦敦的外围自治市之一。

bey.t: n. 贝伊（旧时土耳其地方长官头衔）

e.en: The {bey} once ruled this region under Ottoman authority.
e.zh: 这位贝伊曾在奥斯曼帝国统治下管辖这片地区。

e.en: Records mention a powerful {bey} from the seventeenth century.
e.zh: 史料记载了一位十七世纪的强势贝伊。

beyond.t:
prep. 超过；在…之外
adv. 更远处

e.en: The mountains stretched far {beyond} what the eye could see.
e.zh: 群山绵延,远超目力所及。

e.en: This task is {beyond} my current skill level.
e.zh: 这项任务超出了我目前的能力范围。

bezel.t: n. 边框（屏幕/表盘外框）

e.en: The new phone has an almost invisible {bezel} around the screen.
e.zh: 这款新手机屏幕周围的边框几乎看不见。

e.en: He polished the gold {bezel} of his vintage watch.
e.zh: 他擦亮了那块复古手表的金色表圈。

bfgf.t: n. 男女朋友（boyfriend/girlfriend 缩写）

e.en: They've been {bfgf} since their second year of college.
e.zh: 他们从大二开始就是男女朋友了。

e.en: She posted a cute {bfgf} photo on Instagram.
e.zh: 她在Instagram上发了一张可爱的情侣照。

bfs.t: n. 广度优先搜索（breadth-first search）

e.en: We use {BFS} to find the shortest path in unweighted graphs.
e.zh: 我们用广度优先搜索在无权图中找最短路径。

e.en: The interviewer asked me to implement {BFS} on a binary tree.
e.zh: 面试官让我在二叉树上实现广度优先搜索。

bgs.t: n. 背景复数（backgrounds 缩写）

e.en: I love discovering new lo-fi {BGs} for my study sessions.
e.zh: 我喜欢发现新的lo-fi背景音乐配学习时听。

e.en: The designer prepared several {BGs} for the game's menu screen.
e.zh: 设计师为游戏菜单页面准备了几张背景图。

e.en: The {Bhopal} gas tragedy of 1984 remains a cautionary tale.
e.zh: 1984年的博帕尔毒气事件至今仍是一个警示。

e.en: She flew to {Bhopal} to visit her grandparents.
e.zh: 她飞往博帕尔去看望祖父母。

e.en: The new sports car produces over 500 {bhp}.
e.zh: 这款新跑车输出超过500制动马力。

e.en: This engine delivers around 200 {bhp} at high revs.
e.zh: 这台发动机在高转速下能输出约200制动马力。

bhs.t: n. 英国 BHS 百货公司缩写

e.en: Many shoppers were sad when {BHS} closed its doors.
e.zh: 许多顾客对BHS百货关门感到惋惜。

e.en: She used to buy school uniforms at {BHS} every August.
e.zh: 她以前每年八月都在BHS买校服。

e.en: {Bhutan} measures progress using Gross National Happiness.
e.zh: 不丹用国民幸福总值来衡量发展进步。

e.en: We hiked to a remote monastery in northern {Bhutan}.
e.zh: 我们徒步去了不丹北部一座偏远的寺院。

biafra.t: n. 比夫拉（尼日利亚东南部地区）

e.en: The republic of {Biafra} existed for only about three years.
e.zh: 比夫拉共和国仅存在了大约三年。

e.en: Many books recount the famine that devastated {Biafra}.
e.zh: 许多书籍记述了重创比夫拉的那场饥荒。

biafran.t:
adj. 比夫拉的
n. 比夫拉人

e.en: The {Biafran} flag features a rising sun symbol.
e.zh: 比夫拉的旗帜上有一个旭日图案。

e.en: Her grandfather served as a {Biafran} soldier in the war.
e.zh: 她外祖父在那场战争中是比夫拉的士兵。

e.en: The company holds {biannual} performance reviews in June and December.
e.zh: 公司每年六月和十二月各进行一次绩效评估。

e.en: Don't forget your {biannual} dental cleaning appointment.
e.zh: 别忘了一年两次的洗牙预约。

biarritz.t: n. 比亚里茨（法国海滨城市）

e.en: We learned to surf on the beaches of {Biarritz}.
e.zh: 我们在比亚里茨的海滩上学会了冲浪。

e.en: {Biarritz} is famous for its elegant Belle Époque architecture.
e.zh: 比亚里茨以其优雅的美好年代建筑而闻名。

bias.t:
n. 偏见；偏差
v. 使有偏向

e.en: The algorithm showed a clear {bias} against older applicants.
e.zh: 该算法对年长的申请者表现出明显的偏见。

e.en: Researchers must work hard to minimize {bias} in their studies.
e.zh: 研究人员必须努力把研究中的偏差降到最低。

biased.t: adj. 有偏见的；有偏差的

e.en: I'm probably {biased} because she's my best friend.
e.zh: 我可能有偏见,因为她是我最好的朋友。

e.en: The training data was {biased} toward English-speaking users.
e.zh: 训练数据偏向于英语用户。

biasing.t:
v. 使产生偏差
n. 偏置（电路术语）

e.en: Leading questions risk {biasing} the survey results.
e.zh: 引导性问题可能让调查结果产生偏差。

e.en: The bright lighting was {biasing} customers toward warmer colors.
e.zh: 明亮的灯光让顾客偏向选择暖色调。

biathlon.t: n. 冬季两项（越野滑雪+射击）

e.en: The Norwegian athlete won gold in the Olympic {biathlon}.
e.zh: 那位挪威选手赢得了奥运冬季两项的金牌。

e.en: {Biathlon} combines cross-country skiing and rifle shooting.
e.zh: 冬季两项结合了越野滑雪和步枪射击。

e.en: Engineers tested the material under {biaxial} stress conditions.
e.zh: 工程师在双轴应力条件下测试了这种材料。

e.en: The crystal exhibits {biaxial} optical properties.
e.zh: 这种晶体表现出双轴的光学特性。

e.en: The baby wore a tiny {bib} covered in spaghetti sauce.
e.zh: 宝宝戴着一个沾满意面酱的小围嘴。

e.en: Each runner pinned a numbered {bib} to their shirt.
e.zh: 每位跑者都把带号码的号码布别在衣服上。

e.en: Her shelves were crowded with every imaginable {bibelot}.
e.zh: 她的架子上摆满了各种想得到的小摆设。

e.en: He bought a porcelain {bibelot} as a souvenir.
e.zh: 他买了一件瓷质小摆件作为纪念品。

e.en: This cookbook is the {bible} of French home cooking.
e.zh: 这本食谱是法式家常菜的圣经。

e.en: She reads a passage from the {Bible} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都会读一段圣经。

biblical.t: adj. 圣经的；符合圣经的

e.en: The film draws on {biblical} stories of forgiveness and redemption.
e.zh: 这部电影取材于圣经中关于宽恕与救赎的故事。

e.en: The flood caused damage of {biblical} proportions across the valley.
e.zh: 洪水给整个山谷造成了空前规模的破坏。

e.en: The pastor explained the passage {biblically} for his Sunday audience.
e.zh: 牧师按照圣经的角度向周日的听众解释这段经文。

e.en: The desert was {biblically} hot during our July hike.
e.zh: 七月徒步时,沙漠热得简直像圣经里描写的一样。

bibliographer.t: n. 目录学家；参考文献编者

e.en: The {bibliographer} cataloged every rare manuscript in the library.
e.zh: 这位文献学家为图书馆里每一份珍稀手稿编目。

e.en: She trained as a {bibliographer} specializing in early American printing.
e.zh: 她接受过专门研究早期美国印刷品的目录学家训练。

bibliographic.t: adj. 书目的；参考文献的

e.en: Please add full {bibliographic} details for every cited source.
e.zh: 请为每个引用来源补充完整的文献信息。

e.en: The database offers {bibliographic} records for millions of journal articles.
e.zh: 该数据库收录了数百万篇期刊文章的文献记录。

bibliographical.t: adj. 书目的；参考文献的

e.en: His thesis includes a thorough {bibliographical} appendix at the end.
e.zh: 他的论文最后附有一份详尽的参考书目附录。

e.en: The editor flagged a few {bibliographical} errors in the citations.
e.zh: 编辑指出了引文中几处文献著录错误。

e.en: Don't forget to include a {bibliography} at the end of your essay.
e.zh: 别忘了在论文最后附上参考文献列表。

e.en: The author's {bibliography} spans over forty published novels.
e.zh: 这位作者的著作目录涵盖了四十多部已出版的小说。

e.en: As a true {bibliophile}, she spends weekends hunting through used bookstores.
e.zh: 作为一个真正的爱书人,她周末都泡在二手书店里淘书。

e.en: The auction attracted every serious {bibliophile} in the city.
e.zh: 这场拍卖会吸引了城里所有认真的藏书家。

e.en: The novelist was famous for his {bibulous} evenings with fellow poets.
e.zh: 这位小说家因常与诗人朋友们彻夜豪饮而闻名。

e.en: He gave a rambling, {bibulous} speech at the wedding reception.
e.zh: 他在婚宴上发表了一通酒后语无伦次的致辞。

e.en: We stopped for tea in {Bibury}, often called England's prettiest village.
e.zh: 我们在拜伯里停下喝茶,这里常被誉为英国最美的村庄。

e.en: Cotswold tour buses always make a photo stop at {Bibury}.
e.zh: 科茨沃尔德的旅游巴士总会在拜伯里停车拍照。

e.en: She scribbled the address with a cheap blue {Bic} pen.
e.zh: 她用一支便宜的蓝色比克圆珠笔潦草地写下地址。

e.en: I keep a pack of {Bic} lighters in the kitchen drawer.
e.zh: 我在厨房抽屉里放了一包比克打火机。

bicameral.t: adj. 两院制的（立法机关）

e.en: Most modern democracies use a {bicameral} legislature with two chambers.
e.zh: 大多数现代民主国家采用由两院组成的两院制议会。

e.en: The {bicameral} system gives smaller states equal representation in the senate.
e.zh: 两院制让小州在参议院获得平等的代表权。

e.en: A pinch of {bicarbonate} of soda will help the cake rise.
e.zh: 加一小撮小苏打能让蛋糕发得更好。

e.en: Mix {bicarbonate} with vinegar to clean stubborn drains.
e.zh: 把小苏打和醋混合可以疏通顽固的下水道。

bicentenary.t:
n. 二百周年纪念
adj. 二百周年的

e.en: The museum is hosting events for the {bicentenary} of the railway.
e.zh: 博物馆正在举办纪念铁路诞生两百周年的活动。

e.en: A new statue was unveiled to mark the city's {bicentenary}.
e.zh: 为纪念该市建市两百周年,一座新雕像揭幕了。

bicentennial.t:
n. 二百周年纪念
adj. 二百周年的

e.en: The town threw a huge parade for its {bicentennial} celebration.
e.zh: 小镇为建镇两百周年举办了盛大的游行。

e.en: He collected coins minted for the American {bicentennial} in 1976.
e.zh: 他收藏了一些为1976年美国建国两百周年铸造的硬币。

e.en: He pulled a {bicep} muscle while lifting heavy boxes upstairs.
e.zh: 他在搬重箱子上楼时拉伤了二头肌。

e.en: Curls are the classic exercise for building a stronger {bicep}.
e.zh: 弯举是练出更强壮二头肌的经典动作。

billows.t:
n. 巨浪；翻腾的烟雾
v. 翻腾；鼓起

e.en: Steam {billows} out of the kettle as it whistles.
e.zh: 水壶呜呜响时,蒸汽不断翻涌而出。

e.en: Great {billows} of fog rolled in from the harbor.
e.zh: 大团大团的雾气从港口翻滚而来。

billowy.t: adj. 波涛翻腾的；鼓起的

e.en: She wore a {billowy} white blouse to the beach party.
e.zh: 她穿着宽松飘逸的白衬衫去海滩派对。

e.en: Soft {billowy} clouds drifted across the summer sky.
e.zh: 柔软蓬松的云朵在夏日的天空中飘过。

bills.t:
n. 账单；钞票
v. 开账单

e.en: I always pay my {bills} online before the due date.
e.zh: 我总是在到期日前在网上付清账单。

e.en: He pulled a stack of crisp dollar {bills} from his wallet.
e.zh: 他从钱包里抽出一沓崭新的美元钞票。

e.en: The hiker boiled water in a {billy} over the campfire.
e.zh: 徒步者用一个小铁罐在篝火上烧开水。

e.en: My cousin {Billy} just moved to New York for college.
e.zh: 我表弟比利刚搬到纽约上大学。

bilston.t: n. 比尔斯顿（英国地名）

e.en: {Bilston} is a small town in the West Midlands of England.
e.zh: 比尔斯顿是英格兰西米德兰兹郡的一个小镇。

e.en: The old steelworks at {Bilston} closed decades ago.
e.zh: 比尔斯顿的老钢铁厂几十年前就关闭了。

e.en: Architects use {BIM} software to model entire buildings digitally.
e.zh: 建筑师使用 BIM 软件对整栋建筑进行数字化建模。

e.en: The construction firm switched to {BIM} for better coordination.
e.zh: 这家建筑公司改用 BIM 以提升协同效率。

bimbo.t: n. 漂亮但无脑的女子（贬义）

e.en: The film unfairly portrays the heroine as a {bimbo}.
e.zh: 这部电影不公平地把女主角刻画成一个花瓶。

e.en: He hates the dumb {bimbo} stereotype in old sitcoms.
e.zh: 他讨厌老情景喜剧里那种花瓶女的刻板印象。

e.en: The test scores showed a clear {bimodal} distribution.
e.zh: 考试成绩呈现出明显的双峰分布。

e.en: Commuter traffic follows a {bimodal} pattern each weekday.
e.zh: 每个工作日的通勤车流都呈现双峰模式。

bimonthly.t:
adj. 每两月一次的
n. 双月刊

e.en: Our team holds a {bimonthly} review to track progress.
e.zh: 我们团队每两个月开一次复盘会议跟踪进度。

e.en: She subscribes to a {bimonthly} science magazine.
e.zh: 她订阅了一份每两个月出版一次的科学杂志。

bin.t:
n. 垃圾桶；箱
v. 丢弃

e.en: Please throw the empty bottle in the recycling {bin}.
e.zh: 请把空瓶子扔进回收箱里。

e.en: Compiled binaries are stored in the {bin} directory.
e.zh: 编译好的二进制文件存放在 bin 目录下。

binary.t:
adj. 二进制的；二元的
n. 二进制数

e.en: Computers store all data as {binary} ones and zeros.
e.zh: 计算机以二进制的 0 和 1 存储所有数据。

e.en: Don't think of every choice as a {binary} decision.
e.zh: 不要把每个选择都看成非黑即白的二元决定。

e.en: The {binational} project links researchers in Mexico and Canada.
e.zh: 这个双边项目把墨西哥和加拿大的研究人员连接起来。

e.en: They run a {binational} program for cross-border students.
e.zh: 他们为跨境学生开办了一个双国合作项目。

e.en: Many people use {binaural} beats to help them focus.
e.zh: 很多人用双耳节拍来帮助自己集中注意力。

e.en: The podcast was recorded with a {binaural} microphone setup.
e.zh: 这档播客是用双耳麦克风录制的。

bind.t:
v. 绑定；捆绑；约束
n. 困境

e.en: Use string to {bind} the package before mailing it.
e.zh: 寄出包裹前用绳子把它捆好。

e.en: This contract will {bind} both parties for five years.
e.zh: 这份合同将对双方产生五年的约束力。

e.en: She kept her class notes in a blue {binder}.
e.zh: 她把上课笔记都收在一个蓝色活页夹里。

e.en: The recipe uses egg as a {binder} for the meatballs.
e.zh: 这道食谱用鸡蛋作为粘合剂来塑形肉丸。

binding.t:
n. 绑定；装订
adj. 有约束力的

e.en: The agreement is legally {binding} once both parties sign.
e.zh: 协议一经双方签字便具有法律约束力。

e.en: The book's leather {binding} was cracked with age.
e.zh: 这本书的皮革装订因年代久远而开裂了。

e.en: Shared history {binds} the small village community together.
e.zh: 共同的历史把这个小村庄紧紧凝聚在一起。

e.en: This clause {binds} the company to deliver on time.
e.zh: 该条款约束公司必须按时交货。

bindweed.t: n. 旋花（一种蔓生杂草）

e.en: {Bindweed} keeps strangling the roses in my garden.
e.zh: 旋花一直缠绕着我花园里的玫瑰。

e.en: Pull up {bindweed} early before it covers the fence.
e.zh: 趁旋花还没爬满栅栏时尽早把它拔掉。

bing.t: n. 必应（微软搜索引擎）

e.en: I usually search with Google instead of {Bing}.
e.zh: 我通常用谷歌搜索,而不是必应。

e.en: Microsoft added an AI chat feature to {Bing} last year.
e.zh: 微软去年给必应加上了人工智能聊天功能。

binge.t:
v. 狂刷（剧）；狂吃
n. 放纵

e.en: We plan to {binge} the entire series this weekend.
e.zh: 我们打算这个周末一口气追完整部剧。

e.en: After exams, she went on a chocolate {binge}.
e.zh: 考完试后,她疯狂地吃了一通巧克力。

bingley.t: n. 宾利（英国地名/人名）

e.en: Mr. {Bingley} is a kind character in *Pride and Prejudice*.
e.zh: 宾利先生是《傲慢与偏见》中一位善良的角色。

e.en: {Bingley} is a market town near Bradford in England.
e.zh: 宾利是英格兰布拉德福德附近的一座集镇。

bingo.t:
n. 宾果游戏
int. 中了！

e.en: My grandma plays {bingo} at the community center on Fridays.
e.zh: 我奶奶每周五在社区中心玩宾果游戏。

e.en: {Bingo}! That's exactly the answer I was looking for.
e.zh: 中了!这正是我要找的答案。

e.en: Humans rely on {binocular} vision to judge depth and distance.
e.zh: 人类依靠双眼视觉来判断深度和距离。

e.en: The microscope offers a comfortable {binocular} eyepiece.
e.zh: 这台显微镜配有舒适的双目目镜。

e.en: Bring {binoculars} if you want to spot birds clearly.
e.zh: 想看清鸟类的话记得带上望远镜。

e.en: She watched the concert through tiny {binoculars}.
e.zh: 她用一副小望远镜观看演唱会。

binomial.t:
n. 二项式
adj. 二项的

e.en: Students learn the {binomial} theorem in high school algebra.
e.zh: 学生在高中代数课上学习二项式定理。

e.en: Each species has a unique {binomial} Latin name.
e.zh: 每个物种都有一个独特的拉丁文学名(双名)。

e.en: The recycling {bins} are emptied every Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 回收箱每周二早上都会清空。

e.en: Sort the data into ten equal-sized {bins} for the histogram.
e.zh: 把数据分到十个等宽的区间里来画直方图。

bint.t: n. 小妞（英式俚语，贬义）

e.en: He rudely called her a stupid {bint} and stormed out.
e.zh: 他粗鲁地骂她是个蠢女人,然后摔门而出。

e.en: Don't use the word {bint}—it's offensive British slang.
e.zh: 别用 bint 这个词,这是冒犯人的英国俚语。

bio.t: n. 个人简介；生物（bi­ography/biology 缩写）

e.en: Update your Twitter {bio} with your new job title.
e.zh: 把你推特个人简介里的职位更新一下吧。

e.en: Her short {bio} mentioned three published novels.
e.zh: 她的简短履历里提到了三部已出版的小说。

bioaccumulation.t: n. 生物累积（毒素在生物体内的积累）

e.en: Mercury's {bioaccumulation} in fish makes large tuna risky to eat.
e.zh: 汞在鱼类体内的生物蓄积让大型金枪鱼食用起来有风险。

e.en: Scientists study pesticide {bioaccumulation} along the food chain.
e.zh: 科学家研究农药沿食物链的生物蓄积过程。

e.en: Green tea contains many {bioactive} compounds with health benefits.
e.zh: 绿茶含有许多对健康有益的生物活性化合物。

e.en: Researchers isolated a {bioactive} molecule from the rare plant.
e.zh: 研究人员从这种珍稀植物中分离出一种生物活性分子。

e.en: Hospitals monitor {bioaerosol} levels to control infection risk.
e.zh: 医院会监测生物气溶胶水平以控制感染风险。

e.en: A coughing patient can release infectious {bioaerosol} particles.
e.zh: 咳嗽的病人会释放出具有传染性的生物气溶胶颗粒。

bioassay.t: n. 生物测定；生物分析

e.en: The lab ran a {bioassay} to measure the drug's potency.
e.zh: 实验室通过生物测定法来评估这种药物的效力。

e.en: A simple {bioassay} can detect toxins in river water.
e.zh: 一个简单的生物测定就能检测出河水中的毒素。

e.en: Taking iron with vitamin C improves its {bioavailability}.
e.zh: 和维生素 C 一起服用铁剂能提高其生物利用度。

e.en: The new pill has higher {bioavailability} than older versions.
e.zh: 这款新药片的生物利用度比旧版本更高。

e.en: A {biocentric} ethic values every living organism equally.
e.zh: 以生命为中心的伦理观平等地看待每一个生命体。

e.en: She defended a {biocentric} view in her philosophy thesis.
e.zh: 她在哲学论文中为生命中心主义观点辩护。

e.en: Stress triggers a cascade of {biochemical} reactions in the body.
e.zh: 压力会在体内引发一系列生化反应。

e.en: The lab specializes in {biochemical} analysis of blood samples.
e.zh: 该实验室专门做血样的生化分析。

e.en: Caffeine and adenosine are {biochemically} similar molecules.
e.zh: 咖啡因和腺苷在生化结构上是相似的分子。

e.en: The two species are {biochemically} closer than they appear.
e.zh: 这两个物种在生化层面上比表面看起来更接近。

e.en: The {biochemist} spent years studying enzyme reactions.
e.zh: 这位生物化学家花了多年研究酶的反应。

e.en: As a {biochemist}, she develops new cancer drugs daily.
e.zh: 作为生物化学家,她每天都在研发新型抗癌药物。

e.en: Different organisms have surprisingly diverse {biochemistries}.
e.zh: 不同生物的生化机制差异之大令人惊讶。

e.en: The textbook compares the {biochemistries} of plants and bacteria.
e.zh: 这本教材比较了植物与细菌的生化体系。

e.en: She majored in {biochemistry} before applying to medical school.
e.zh: 她在申请医学院之前主修了生物化学。

e.en: Modern medicine relies heavily on {biochemistry} research.
e.zh: 现代医学高度依赖生物化学方面的研究。

e.en: A tiny {biochip} can detect viruses in a drop of blood.
e.zh: 一枚微小的生物芯片就能从一滴血中检测出病毒。

e.en: Researchers built a {biochip} for rapid DNA analysis.
e.zh: 研究人员开发了一种用于快速 DNA 分析的生物芯片。

e.en: Manufacturers add a {biocide} to prevent mold in paint.
e.zh: 厂商在涂料中加入杀生剂以防止发霉。

e.en: Overuse of {biocide} chemicals can harm aquatic ecosystems.
e.zh: 过度使用杀生剂会损害水生生态系统。

e.en: Farmers use ladybugs as a {biocontrol} against aphids.
e.zh: 农民用瓢虫作为防治蚜虫的生物手段。

e.en: The {biocontrol} program reduced pesticide use dramatically.
e.zh: 这项生物防治计划大幅减少了农药的使用。

e.en: The packaging is fully {biodegradable} and compostable.
e.zh: 这种包装完全可生物降解且可堆肥。

e.en: She switched to {biodegradable} cleaning products last year.
e.zh: 她去年改用了可生物降解的清洁用品。

e.en: Plastic bags take centuries to {biodegrade} in landfills.
e.zh: 塑料袋在垃圾填埋场需要几个世纪才能降解。

e.en: These bamboo utensils {biodegrade} within a few months.
e.zh: 这些竹制餐具几个月内就能自然降解。

e.en: The truck runs on {biodiesel} made from used cooking oil.
e.zh: 这辆卡车使用废食用油制成的生物柴油。

e.en: Several countries now blend {biodiesel} with regular diesel.
e.zh: 目前有多个国家将生物柴油与普通柴油混合使用。

bihar.t: n. 比哈尔邦（印度东部一邦）

e.en: {Bihar} is one of the most populous states in India.
e.zh: 比哈尔邦是印度人口最多的邦之一。

e.en: The ancient university of Nalanda is located in {Bihar}.
e.zh: 古老的那烂陀大学坐落在比哈尔邦。

bijou.t:
adj. 小巧精致的
n. 珠宝饰物

e.en: They live in a {bijou} apartment near the river.
e.zh: 他们住在河边一间精致小巧的公寓里。

e.en: The cafe is a {bijou} gem hidden down a side street.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆是藏在小巷里的一颗精致明珠。

bike.t:
n. 自行车；摩托车
v. 骑车

e.en: I {bike} to work every morning to stay fit.
e.zh: 我每天早上骑自行车上班以保持健康。

e.en: She locked her {bike} outside the coffee shop.
e.zh: 她把自行车锁在咖啡店外面。

biker.t: n. 骑自行车/摩托车的人

e.en: A {biker} in leather pulled up beside our car.
e.zh: 一个穿皮衣的机车骑士停在了我们车旁。

e.en: The trail is popular with both hikers and {biker} groups.
e.zh: 这条小径深受徒步者和骑行团队的喜爱。

bikes.t:
n. 自行车（复数）
v. 骑车（第三人称）

e.en: The kids parked their {bikes} by the playground fence.
e.zh: 孩子们把自行车停在游乐场围栏旁。

e.en: Electric {bikes} have become hugely popular in cities.
e.zh: 电动自行车在城市里变得非常流行。

e.en: The new {bikeway} runs along the entire riverfront.
e.zh: 新建的自行车道沿着整个河岸延伸。

e.en: Cyclists petitioned for a protected {bikeway} downtown.
e.zh: 骑行者请愿在市中心修建受保护的自行车道。

biking.t:
n. 骑车运动
v. 骑车（进行时）

e.en: We went {biking} through the forest trails on Sunday.
e.zh: 周日我们沿着森林小径骑车游玩。

e.en: Mountain {biking} is her favorite weekend activity.
e.zh: 山地骑行是她最喜欢的周末活动。

e.en: She bought a new {bikini} for the beach vacation.
e.zh: 她为这次海滩度假买了一套新比基尼。

e.en: The boutique displayed a striped {bikini} in the window.
e.zh: 精品店橱窗里陈列着一件条纹比基尼。

e.en: The store stocks dozens of {bikinis} in summer colors.
e.zh: 店里备有数十款夏日色彩的比基尼。

e.en: Designer {bikinis} can cost hundreds of dollars each.
e.zh: 设计师款的比基尼一件可能要几百美元。

e.en: The two nations signed a {bilateral} trade agreement yesterday.
e.zh: 两国昨天签署了双边贸易协定。

e.en: Doctors detected {bilateral} swelling in the patient's knees.
e.zh: 医生发现患者双膝都出现了肿胀。

bilateralism.t: n. 双边主义（外交政策）

e.en: Some economists argue {bilateralism} weakens global trade systems.
e.zh: 一些经济学家认为双边主义会削弱全球贸易体系。

e.en: The president favored {bilateralism} over multilateral negotiations.
e.zh: 总统更青睐双边主义而非多边谈判。

e.en: The dispute was resolved {bilaterally} without outside mediation.
e.zh: 争端通过双边方式解决,未经外部调停。

e.en: Nerves in the spine branch out {bilaterally} from the cord.
e.zh: 脊神经从脊髓向两侧分出。

bilayer.t: n. 双分子层（如细胞膜）

e.en: Cell membranes are made of a lipid {bilayer} structure.
e.zh: 细胞膜由脂质双分子层结构构成。

e.en: The chip uses a graphene {bilayer} for better conductivity.
e.zh: 该芯片采用石墨烯双层结构以提高导电性。

bilbao.t: n. 毕尔巴鄂（西班牙城市）

e.en: We visited the Guggenheim Museum in {Bilbao} last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天我们参观了毕尔巴鄂的古根海姆博物馆。

e.en: {Bilbao} has transformed into a major cultural destination.
e.zh: 毕尔巴鄂已经转型为一座重要的文化目的地。

bilberry.t: n. 越橘（欧洲蓝莓类浆果）

e.en: Grandma made {bilberry} jam from berries we picked.
e.zh: 奶奶用我们采来的越橘做了果酱。

e.en: {Bilberry} extract is sold as a vision supplement.
e.zh: 越橘提取物被作为护眼保健品销售。

bildungsroman.t: n. 成长小说（文学体裁）

e.en: The novel is a classic {bildungsroman} about a young artist.
e.zh: 这部小说是一部讲述年轻艺术家的经典成长小说。

e.en: Critics praised the film as a modern {bildungsroman}.
e.zh: 评论家盛赞这部电影是一部现代成长故事。

bile.t:
n. 胆汁
n. 坏脾气；怒气

e.en: The liver produces {bile} to help digest fats.
e.zh: 肝脏分泌胆汁以帮助消化脂肪。

e.en: His online posts are full of pure {bile} and resentment.
e.zh: 他的网络贴文里满是怨毒和怒气。

bilge.t:
n. 船底污水
n. 废话

e.en: The pump cleared dirty water from the boat's {bilge}.
e.zh: 水泵把船舱底部的脏水抽了出来。

e.en: That review is complete {bilge} and ignores the facts.
e.zh: 那篇评论纯属胡说八道,完全不顾事实。

e.en: Tourists were warned about {bilharzia} in the freshwater lake.
e.zh: 游客被警告淡水湖中存在血吸虫病风险。

e.en: {Bilharzia} affects millions of people in tropical regions.
e.zh: 血吸虫病影响着热带地区数百万人。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her with a {biliary} tract infection.
e.zh: 医生诊断她患有胆道感染。

e.en: Surgery removed a stone blocking the {biliary} duct.
e.zh: 手术取出了堵塞胆管的一块结石。

bilingual.t:
adj. 双语的
n. 会双语的人

e.en: Their daughter is fully {bilingual} in English and Mandarin.
e.zh: 他们女儿能流利使用英语和普通话。

e.en: The school offers a {bilingual} program for young children.
e.zh: 这所学校为低龄儿童开设了双语课程。

e.en: Studies suggest {bilingualism} may delay cognitive decline.
e.zh: 研究表明双语能力可能延缓认知能力衰退。

e.en: Canada officially promotes {bilingualism} in government services.
e.zh: 加拿大在政府服务中正式推广双语制度。

bilious.t:
adj. 坏脾气的
adj. 胆汁的；恶心的

e.en: He felt {bilious} after eating the rich, oily meal.
e.zh: 他吃了那顿油腻的大餐后觉得反胃想吐。

e.en: The room was painted a sickly, {bilious} yellow.
e.zh: 房间漆成了一种病态的黄绿色。

e.en: High {bilirubin} levels can cause yellowing of the skin.
e.zh: 胆红素水平偏高会导致皮肤发黄。

e.en: The newborn's {bilirubin} was monitored for signs of jaundice.
e.zh: 医生监测新生儿的胆红素以观察黄疸迹象。

e.en: Scammers tried to {bilk} elderly people out of savings.
e.zh: 骗子企图骗走老年人的积蓄。

e.en: The contractor was sued for trying to {bilk} clients.
e.zh: 那名承包商因企图欺诈客户而被起诉。

bill.t:
n. 账单；法案；钞票
v. 开账单；宣传

e.en: Could we have the {bill}, please? We need to leave.
e.zh: 麻烦结账好吗?我们要走了。

e.en: Congress is debating a new climate {bill} this week.
e.zh: 国会本周正在辩论一项新的气候法案。

e.en: Lawyers track every {billable} hour they spend on cases.
e.zh: 律师会记录他们办案中每一个可计费的工时。

e.en: The consultation is not {billable} under your insurance plan.
e.zh: 这次咨询在你的保险计划下不能报销。

billabong.t: n. 澳洲牛轭湖；死水潭

e.en: Kangaroos gathered to drink at the quiet {billabong}.
e.zh: 袋鼠聚集在那处静谧的死水潭边喝水。

e.en: The poet described a swagman camping by a {billabong}.
e.zh: 诗人描写了一个流浪汉在死水潭边露营。

e.en: A giant {billboard} advertised the new movie release.
e.zh: 一块巨大的广告牌宣传着新上映的电影。

e.en: Her song reached number one on the {Billboard} chart.
e.zh: 她的歌登上了公告牌排行榜冠军。

billed.t:
v. 开账单（过去式）
adj. 有喙的

e.en: The hotel {billed} us for two extra nights by mistake.
e.zh: 酒店错误地多向我们收了两晚的费用。

e.en: The event was {billed} as the concert of the year.
e.zh: 这场活动被宣传为年度最佳音乐会。

billericay.t: n. 比勒里基（英国小镇）

e.en: The train from London to {Billericay} takes about an hour.
e.zh: 从伦敦到比勒里基的火车大约要一个小时。

e.en: She grew up in {Billericay} before moving to the city.
e.zh: 她在比勒里基长大,后来才搬到城里。

billet.t:
n. 士兵住处；差事
v. 安排住宿

e.en: The soldiers found a temporary {billet} in the village inn.
e.zh: 士兵们在村里的客栈找到了临时住所。

e.en: He landed a cushy {billet} working at the embassy.
e.zh: 他在大使馆找到了一份轻松的差事。

billeting.t:
v. 分派住宿
n. 驻宿安排

e.en: The army was {billeting} troops in local farmhouses.
e.zh: 军队正把士兵安置在当地的农舍里。

e.en: {Billeting} refugees became a major challenge for the city.
e.zh: 安置难民成为这座城市的一大难题。

e.en: Anglers travel to Costa Rica to catch trophy {billfish}.
e.zh: 钓鱼爱好者远赴哥斯达黎加去钓大型旗鱼。

e.en: Conservation groups are working to protect endangered {billfish}.
e.zh: 保护组织正致力于保护濒危的旗鱼类。

e.en: He pulled a worn leather {billfold} from his back pocket.
e.zh: 他从后裤兜里掏出一只磨旧的皮夹。

e.en: My {billfold} had only a few singles left inside.
e.zh: 我的钱夹里只剩下几张一美元的钞票了。

e.en: The mansion had a grand {billiard} room with green felt.
e.zh: 那座豪宅里有一间气派的台球室,铺着绿色台呢。

e.en: He chalked his cue before the next {billiard} shot.
e.zh: 他在打下一杆台球前先给球杆头擦了粉。

e.en: They play {billiards} together every Friday night.
e.zh: 他们每周五晚上都一起打台球。

e.en: Professional {billiards} requires precision and steady nerves.
e.zh: 职业台球需要精准的技术和稳定的心理。

billing.t:
n. 开账单；计费
n. 宣传排位

e.en: The {billing} address must match the card on file.
e.zh: 账单地址必须与登记的银行卡一致。

e.en: She got top {billing} on the new movie poster.
e.zh: 她在新电影海报上获得了头牌位置。

billingham.t: n. 比林汉姆（英国地名）

e.en: He grew up in {Billingham}, a town in northeast England.
e.zh: 他在英格兰东北部的比林厄姆镇长大。

e.en: The chemical plant in {Billingham} employs hundreds of locals.
e.zh: 比林厄姆的化工厂雇用了数百名当地人。

e.en: London's {Billingsgate} market sells fresh fish every morning.
e.zh: 伦敦的比林斯盖特市场每天清晨出售新鲜鱼货。

e.en: The drunk shouted {billingsgate} at passing strangers.
e.zh: 那醉汉对路过的陌生人破口大骂。

billion.t:
n. 十亿
adj. 十亿的

e.en: The app reached one {billion} downloads last year.
e.zh: 这款应用去年下载量突破了十亿次。

e.en: A {billion} stars shimmered across the night sky.
e.zh: 夜空中有数十亿颗星星在闪烁。

e.en: The tech {billionaire} bought another mansion in California.
e.zh: 那位科技亿万富翁又在加州买了一套豪宅。

e.en: She became a {billionaire} after her startup went public.
e.zh: 她的初创公司上市后,她跻身亿万富翁行列。

e.en: Investors poured {billions} into AI startups this year.
e.zh: 今年投资者向人工智能初创公司砸下了数十亿美元。

e.en: There are {billions} of galaxies in the observable universe.
e.zh: 可观测宇宙中存在着数十亿个星系。

billionth.t:
adj. 第十亿的
n. 十亿分之一

e.en: YouTube celebrated its {billionth} user milestone with a party.
e.zh: YouTube 举办派对庆祝用户数达到十亿这一里程碑。

e.en: The signal lasted only a {billionth} of a second.
e.zh: 这个信号只持续了十亿分之一秒。

billow.t:
v. 翻腾；滚滚涌起
n. 巨浪

e.en: Smoke began to {billow} from the burning warehouse.
e.zh: 浓烟开始从燃烧的仓库里翻滚而出。

e.en: A huge {billow} of dust rolled across the desert.
e.zh: 一股巨大的尘浪在沙漠上翻腾而过。

billowing.t:
v. 翻滚；鼓起
adj. 翻腾的

e.en: Her {billowing} dress caught the breeze on the cliff.
e.zh: 她飘逸的长裙在崖边被风吹得鼓起。

e.en: Black smoke kept {billowing} from the factory chimney.
e.zh: 黑烟不断从工厂的烟囱里翻涌而出。

e.en: He flexed his {biceps} in front of the bathroom mirror.
e.zh: 他对着浴室镜子秀了秀自己的二头肌。

e.en: Pull-ups work your back as well as your {biceps}.
e.zh: 引体向上既能锻炼背部,也能练到二头肌。

e.en: Tourists flock to {Bicester} Village for designer outlet shopping.
e.zh: 游客们蜂拥到比斯特购物村抢购名牌折扣商品。

e.en: The train from London to {Bicester} only takes about an hour.
e.zh: 从伦敦到比斯特的火车大约只需一个小时。

e.en: The kids {bicker} constantly over who controls the TV remote.
e.zh: 孩子们总为谁拿电视遥控器吵个不停。

e.en: Try not to {bicker} with your siblings during the family dinner.
e.zh: 家庭聚餐时尽量别和兄弟姐妹拌嘴。

bickering.t:
n. 口角；拌嘴
v. bicker 的现在分词

e.en: Their constant {bickering} ruined what should have been a fun trip.
e.zh: 他们没完没了的拌嘴毁了本该愉快的旅行。

e.en: The roommates were {bickering} again about the dirty dishes.
e.zh: 室友们又为脏碗碟的事吵了起来。

e.en: She lives a {bicoastal} life, splitting time between New York and LA.
e.zh: 她过着两岸双城生活,在纽约和洛杉矶之间来回。

e.en: The startup runs a {bicoastal} team across both U.S. coasts.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在美国东西两岸都有团队。

e.en: Growing up {bicultural} taught her to switch easily between languages.
e.zh: 在双重文化中长大让她能轻松地在两种语言间切换。

e.en: The school celebrates its {bicultural} heritage every spring festival.
e.zh: 学校每年春季节庆都会庆祝其双文化传统。

bicycle.t:
n. 自行车
v. 骑自行车

e.en: I rode my {bicycle} to work to avoid the morning traffic.
e.zh: 我骑自行车上班,避开早高峰的拥堵。

e.en: She locked her {bicycle} to the rack outside the café.
e.zh: 她把自行车锁在了咖啡馆外面的车架上。

bicycles.t:
n. 自行车（复数）
v. 骑自行车（三单）

e.en: The shop sells secondhand {bicycles} at very reasonable prices.
e.zh: 这家店出售价格非常实惠的二手自行车。

e.en: Dozens of {bicycles} were parked outside the university library.
e.zh: 大学图书馆外停着几十辆自行车。

bicycling.t:
n. 骑自行车
v. bicycle 的现在分词

e.en: {Bicycling} along the river is my favorite weekend activity.
e.zh: 沿着河边骑自行车是我最喜欢的周末活动。

e.en: He took up {bicycling} after his doctor recommended more cardio.
e.zh: 医生建议他多做有氧运动后,他开始骑自行车。

e.en: A careless driver almost hit the {bicyclist} at the intersection.
e.zh: 一个粗心的司机在路口差点撞上那位骑自行车的人。

e.en: Every {bicyclist} on this trail must wear a helmet.
e.zh: 在这条小径上的每位骑行者都必须戴头盔。

bid.t:
v. 出价；投标
n. 报价；竞标

e.en: She placed the highest {bid} on the vintage handbag online.
e.zh: 她在网上对那只复古手袋出了最高的价。

e.en: The company made a {bid} to acquire its smaller rival.
e.zh: 该公司出价收购规模较小的竞争对手。

e.en: Their puppy is sweet and {biddable}, perfect for first-time owners.
e.zh: 他们的小狗温顺听话,非常适合第一次养狗的人。

e.en: The young apprentice was {biddable} and eager to please.
e.zh: 这位年轻的学徒听话,而且很想讨人喜欢。

e.en: The painting went to the highest {bidder} after a tense auction.
e.zh: 经过紧张的竞拍,这幅画被出价最高的人买走。

e.en: Each {bidder} must register before the auction begins.
e.zh: 每位竞拍者必须在拍卖开始前完成登记。

bidding.t:
n. 出价；投标
v. bid 的现在分词

e.en: The {bidding} for the rare painting started at one million dollars.
e.zh: 这幅珍稀画作的竞拍起价是一百万美元。

e.en: The loyal assistant did his boss's {bidding} without question.
e.zh: 那位忠心的助理对老板的吩咐从不质疑。

e.en: The servants carried out the queen's {biddings} promptly each morning.
e.zh: 仆人们每天早上都迅速执行女王的各项吩咐。

e.en: He grew tired of doing his uncle's endless {biddings}.
e.zh: 他厌倦了不停地照办叔叔的种种吩咐。

e.en: That nosy old {biddy} next door watches everyone's comings and goings.
e.zh: 隔壁那个爱管闲事的老太婆盯着每个人进出。

e.en: Don't call your grandmother a {biddy} — it's quite rude.
e.zh: 别叫你奶奶老婆子,这样很没礼貌。

e.en: Just {bide} your time and the right opportunity will come.
e.zh: 耐心等待时机,合适的机会自会出现。

e.en: He decided to {bide} his time before asking for a raise.
e.zh: 他决定先按兵不动,再开口要求加薪。

bideford.t: n. 比德福德（英国地名）

e.en: We caught the ferry from {Bideford} across to Lundy Island.
e.zh: 我们从比德福德乘渡轮前往兰迪岛。

e.en: {Bideford} sits on the River Torridge in north Devon.
e.zh: 比德福德位于北德文郡的托里奇河畔。

e.en: The hotel bathroom had a marble tub and a separate {bidet}.
e.zh: 酒店浴室里有一个大理石浴缸和一个独立的坐浴盆。

e.en: Many people install a {bidet} attachment on their toilet at home.
e.zh: 很多人会在家里马桶上加装一个坐浴喷头。

e.en: The new cable supports {bidirectional} data transfer at high speeds.
e.zh: 这种新型线缆支持高速双向数据传输。

e.en: Good communication in a team must be {bidirectional}.
e.zh: 团队中良好的沟通必须是双向的。

bids.t:
n. 出价（复数）
v. 出价（三单）

e.en: Three companies submitted {bids} to renovate the old library.
e.zh: 有三家公司投标竞投翻修这座旧图书馆。

e.en: The auction site shows live {bids} updating every few seconds.
e.zh: 拍卖网站每隔几秒就会刷新显示最新的出价。

e.en: He ended every email with a casual "très {bien}, merci".
e.zh: 他每封邮件结尾都随意地写一句“很好,谢谢”。

e.en: She lives in a quiet {bien}-aimé corner of Paris.
e.zh: 她住在巴黎一个安静而备受钟爱的角落。

e.en: Artists from sixty countries are exhibiting at this year's Venice {Biennale}.
e.zh: 今年的威尼斯双年展上有来自六十个国家的艺术家参展。

e.en: The architecture {biennale} draws designers from around the world.
e.zh: 这届建筑双年展吸引了世界各地的设计师。

biennial.t:
adj. 两年一次的
n. 两年生植物

e.en: The conference is a {biennial} event held every other summer.
e.zh: 这场会议是两年一届的活动,每隔一个夏天举办一次。

e.en: Foxgloves are {biennial} plants that flower in their second year.
e.zh: 毛地黄是两年生植物,在第二年开花。

e.en: The coffin rested on a wooden {bier} draped with white flowers.
e.zh: 棺木停放在一个铺着白花的木制灵柩台上。

e.en: Six pallbearers carried the {bier} slowly down the church aisle.
e.zh: 六位抬棺人缓缓抬着灵柩走过教堂中殿。

biff.t:
v. 猛击
n. 重击

e.en: He gave the broken vending machine a frustrated {biff}.
e.zh: 他烦躁地朝坏掉的自动售货机挥了一拳。

e.en: The boxer landed a clean {biff} on his opponent's jaw.
e.zh: 拳击手干脆利落地一拳打在对手的下巴上。

e.en: Her new {bifocal} lenses make reading menus much easier.
e.zh: 她新配的双光镜片让看菜单轻松多了。

e.en: He bought a stylish {bifocal} pair for the office.
e.zh: 他给办公室买了一副时尚的双光眼镜。

e.en: Grandpa pushed his {bifocals} up his nose to read the paper.
e.zh: 爷爷把双光眼镜往鼻梁上推了推,继续看报纸。

e.en: She finally needed {bifocals} after turning fifty last year.
e.zh: 去年五十岁后,她终于不得不戴双光眼镜了。

e.en: The trail will {bifurcate} just past the old wooden bridge.
e.zh: 这条小路在旧木桥过后会分成两条岔路。

e.en: The river begins to {bifurcate} a few miles before the sea.
e.zh: 这条河在入海前几英里开始分成两条支流。

bifurcated.t:
adj. 分叉的
v. bifurcate 的过去式

e.en: The road {bifurcated} into a coastal route and a mountain path.
e.zh: 这条路分成了一条沿海路线和一条山路。

e.en: Their family's {bifurcated} loyalties made political dinners awkward.
e.zh: 这家人内部分裂的政治立场让聚餐时的氛围很尴尬。

e.en: Take the left fork at the next {bifurcation} in the trail.
e.zh: 在小径下一个岔口处走左边那条路。

e.en: There's a clear {bifurcation} between online and in-store shoppers.
e.zh: 网购消费者和到店消费者之间存在明显的分化。

e.en: That's a really {big} decision — take your time thinking it over.
e.zh: 这可是个重大决定,慢慢想清楚再说。

e.en: They moved into a {big} house on the edge of town.
e.zh: 他们搬进了城郊一栋大房子。

e.en: He turned out to be a {bigamist} with a second family overseas.
e.zh: 原来他是个重婚者,在海外还有另一个家庭。

e.en: The {bigamist} was sentenced to two years in prison.
e.zh: 这名重婚者被判处两年监禁。

e.en: He was charged with {bigamy} after his second wife came forward.
e.zh: 他第二任妻子站出来后,他被指控犯有重婚罪。

e.en: {Bigamy} is illegal in nearly every country in the world.
e.zh: 几乎所有国家都规定重婚是违法的。

e.en: The boat returned with a huge {bigeye} tuna in the hold.
e.zh: 渔船的船舱里装着一条巨大的大眼金枪鱼回港了。

e.en: Sushi chefs prize {bigeye} for its rich, fatty flavor.
e.zh: 寿司师傅们看重大眼金枪鱼那种肥美浓郁的口感。

e.en: Hikers claimed they saw {bigfoot} in the dense forest.
e.zh: 徒步者声称在茂密森林里看到了大脚怪。

e.en: The documentary explored famous {bigfoot} sightings across America.
e.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了美国各地著名的大脚怪目击事件。

e.en: We stopped in {Biggar} for lunch on our Scotland tour.
e.zh: 苏格兰之行途中我们在比加镇停下来吃午饭。

e.en: The town of {Biggar} hosts a famous Hogmanay bonfire each year.
e.zh: 比加镇每年都会举办著名的新年篝火晚会。

e.en: Missing one meeting is no {biggie} for the team.
e.zh: 错过一次会议对团队来说没什么大不了的。

e.en: Fans still celebrate {Biggie} as a hip-hop legend.
e.zh: 歌迷至今仍把Biggie奉为嘻哈传奇。

e.en: She wore a lace {biggin} as part of her costume.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶蕾丝童帽作为戏服的一部分。

e.en: The antique shop displayed an old coffee {biggin} from the 1800s.
e.zh: 古董店里陈列着一只十九世纪的旧式咖啡壶。

e.en: Mr. {Biggins} taught math at our school for thirty years.
e.zh: 比金斯先生在我们学校教了三十年数学。

e.en: The play features a quirky character named Old {Biggins}.
e.zh: 这部戏里有个古怪的角色叫老比金斯。

e.en: They bought a {biggish} house on the edge of town.
e.zh: 他们在城郊买了一栋还算挺大的房子。

e.en: There's a {biggish} crowd waiting outside the venue.
e.zh: 场地外面已经聚了不小的一群人。

e.en: A {bighorn} sheep stood majestically on the rocky cliff.
e.zh: 一只大角羊威严地站在岩壁上。

e.en: We hiked through the {Bighorn} mountains last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们徒步穿越了大角山脉。

e.en: The ship anchored safely in the sheltered {bight}.
e.zh: 船在避风的海湾里安全抛锚了。

e.en: Sailors learn to tie a {bight} into the rope.
e.zh: 水手要学会在绳子上打个绳环。

e.en: The {bigness} of the stadium overwhelmed first-time visitors.
e.zh: 体育场的宏大令初次来访的游客叹为观止。

e.en: Critics warned about the {bigness} of tech corporations.
e.zh: 评论家警告人们要警惕科技巨头的体量。

e.en: He was called a {bigot} for his discriminatory remarks.
e.zh: 他因发表歧视性言论而被指为偏执者。

e.en: No one wants to work alongside a known {bigot}.
e.zh: 没人愿意与一个出了名的偏执狂共事。

e.en: Her {bigoted} comments cost her the job offer.
e.zh: 她那些带偏见的言论让她丢掉了工作机会。

e.en: The community rejected the candidate's {bigoted} platform.
e.zh: 社区拒绝了那位候选人充满偏见的政纲。

e.en: The school launched a campaign to fight {bigotry} on campus.
e.zh: 学校发起了一场反对校园偏执的运动。

e.en: His memoir describes growing up surrounded by {bigotry}.
e.zh: 他的回忆录描述了在偏见环绕中长大的经历。

e.en: A Hollywood {bigwig} attended the charity dinner last night.
e.zh: 昨晚一位好莱坞大佬出席了慈善晚宴。

e.en: Every {bigwig} in finance was at the conference.
e.zh: 金融界的每个大人物都出席了那场会议。

e.en: Coral reefs are among the most {biodiverse} ecosystems on Earth.
e.zh: 珊瑚礁是地球上生物多样性最丰富的生态系统之一。

e.en: The rainforest remains incredibly {biodiverse} despite logging.
e.zh: 尽管遭到砍伐,这片雨林仍保持着惊人的生物多样性。

e.en: Climate change threatens {biodiversity} across the globe.
e.zh: 气候变化正威胁着全球的生物多样性。

e.en: This park protects the region's rich {biodiversity}.
e.zh: 这座公园保护着该地区丰富的生物多样性。

e.en: The vineyard follows {biodynamic} farming principles strictly.
e.zh: 这家酒庄严格遵循生物动力农法的原则。

e.en: She prefers wines made with {biodynamic} methods.
e.zh: 她偏爱用生物动力法酿造的葡萄酒。

e.en: He studied {biodynamics} before starting his organic farm.
e.zh: 他在创办有机农场之前研究过生物动力农法。

e.en: The course covers the basics of {biodynamics} and soil health.
e.zh: 这门课涵盖生物动力学和土壤健康的基础知识。

bioengineered.t: adj. 经生物工程改造的

e.en: Scientists {bioengineered} bacteria to break down plastic waste.
e.zh: 科学家通过生物工程改造细菌来分解塑料垃圾。

e.en: The label warns that the product contains {bioengineered} ingredients.
e.zh: 标签提示该产品含有生物工程改造的成分。

e.en: She majored in {bioengineering} at a top university.
e.zh: 她在一所顶尖大学主修生物工程。

e.en: {Bioengineering} could help create artificial organs for transplant.
e.zh: 生物工程有望帮助制造可移植的人造器官。

bioes.t: n. bio 的复数，个人简介

e.en: Update your social media {bioes} to reflect your new job.
e.zh: 更新一下社交媒体上的个人简介,以反映你的新工作。

e.en: The website lets users edit their {bioes} at any time.
e.zh: 该网站允许用户随时编辑自己的个人简介。

e.en: Gene editing raises serious {bioethical} concerns.
e.zh: 基因编辑引发了严重的生命伦理问题。

e.en: The committee reviews the {bioethical} implications of new research.
e.zh: 该委员会审查新研究在生命伦理方面的影响。

e.en: A {bioethicist} advised the hospital on end-of-life decisions.
e.zh: 一位生命伦理学家就临终决策为医院提供咨询。

e.en: The {bioethicist} questioned whether the trial was truly ethical.
e.zh: 这位生命伦理学家质疑该试验是否真正符合伦理。

e.en: The professor teaches {bioethics} at the medical school.
e.zh: 这位教授在医学院讲授生命伦理学。

e.en: AI in healthcare raises new questions in {bioethics}.
e.zh: 医疗领域的人工智能引发了生命伦理学的新问题。

e.en: She uses {biofeedback} to manage her chronic anxiety.
e.zh: 她用生物反馈疗法来缓解长期焦虑。

e.en: The clinic offers {biofeedback} sessions for stress relief.
e.zh: 这家诊所提供生物反馈疗程来缓解压力。

e.en: Bacteria form a sticky {biofilm} on the inside of pipes.
e.zh: 细菌在管道内壁形成一层黏滑的生物膜。

e.en: Dental plaque is essentially a {biofilm} on your teeth.
e.zh: 牙菌斑本质上就是牙齿表面的一层生物膜。

e.en: The wastewater plant uses a {biofilter} to remove odors.
e.zh: 这家污水处理厂用生物滤池去除异味。

e.en: A {biofilter} can clean polluted air using living microbes.
e.zh: 生物过滤器可以利用活体微生物净化受污染的空气。

e.en: Brazil produces large amounts of {biofuel} from sugarcane.
e.zh: 巴西用甘蔗生产大量的生物燃料。

e.en: Some airlines have started testing {biofuel} on commercial flights.
e.zh: 一些航空公司已开始在商业航班上试用生物燃料。

e.en: The farm captures {biogas} from animal waste to generate electricity.
e.zh: 这家农场从畜禽粪便中收集沼气来发电。

e.en: {Biogas} is a renewable alternative to natural gas.
e.zh: 沼气是天然气的一种可再生替代能源。

e.en: The lab specializes in {biogenetic} research on rare diseases.
e.zh: 该实验室专攻罕见病的生物遗传学研究。

e.en: New {biogenetic} therapies offer hope for cancer patients.
e.zh: 新的生物遗传疗法为癌症患者带来希望。

e.en: The sediment contains large amounts of {biogenic} carbon.
e.zh: 这些沉积物中含有大量生物成因的碳。

e.en: Coral reefs are made of {biogenic} calcium carbonate.
e.zh: 珊瑚礁由生物成因的碳酸钙构成。

e.en: She studies {biogeochemistry} to understand how carbon cycles through forests.
e.zh: 她研究生物地球化学,以了解碳如何在森林中循环。

e.en: {Biogeochemistry} links biology, geology, and chemistry into one field.
e.zh: 生物地球化学将生物学、地质学和化学融为一门学科。

e.en: Australia is a unique {biogeographic} region full of endemic species.
e.zh: 澳大利亚是一个独特的生物地理区域,拥有大量特有物种。

e.en: Mountains often act as {biogeographic} barriers between species.
e.zh: 山脉常常成为物种之间的生物地理屏障。

e.en: The island has fascinating {biogeographical} patterns of plant life.
e.zh: 这座岛屿的植物分布呈现出引人入胜的生物地理格局。

e.en: Researchers mapped the {biogeographical} zones of the Amazon basin.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了亚马逊流域的生物地理区划图。

e.en: {Biogeography} explains why kangaroos live only in Australia.
e.zh: 生物地理学解释了为什么袋鼠只生活在澳大利亚。

e.en: His textbook is a classic introduction to island {biogeography}.
e.zh: 他的教科书是岛屿生物地理学的经典入门读物。

e.en: His official {biographer} spent ten years researching his life.
e.zh: 他的官方传记作者花了十年时间研究他的生平。

e.en: The {biographer} interviewed dozens of the singer's old friends.
e.zh: 这位传记作家采访了这位歌手的几十位老朋友。

e.en: The website shows basic {biographic} information about each author.
e.zh: 该网站展示每位作者的基本生平信息。

e.en: Please fill in your {biographic} details on the application form.
e.zh: 请在申请表上填写你的个人生平信息。

e.en: Netflix released a {biographical} film about the famous chef.
e.zh: 网飞推出了一部讲述这位著名厨师的传记电影。

e.en: The article includes a short {biographical} note about the artist.
e.zh: 文章附有这位艺术家的简短生平介绍。

e.en: She loves reading {biographies} of historical figures.
e.zh: 她喜欢阅读历史人物的传记。

e.en: The bookstore has a whole section dedicated to {biographies}.
e.zh: 这家书店有一整个专区都是传记类图书。

e.en: His {biography} of Lincoln became an instant bestseller.
e.zh: 他撰写的林肯传记一经出版便成为畅销书。

e.en: I'm currently reading a {biography} of Steve Jobs.
e.zh: 我目前在读一本史蒂夫·乔布斯的传记。

e.en: Used needles must be disposed of in a {biohazard} container.
e.zh: 用过的针头必须丢进生物危害专用容器。

e.en: The lab posted {biohazard} warnings on every door.
e.zh: 实验室在每扇门上都贴了生物危害警示标志。

e.en: {Bioinformatics} uses computers to analyze huge genomic datasets.
e.zh: 生物信息学利用计算机分析庞大的基因组数据集。

e.en: She landed a job as a {bioinformatics} engineer at a biotech startup.
e.zh: 她在一家生物科技初创公司谋得了生物信息学工程师的职位。

biologic.t:
adj. 生物的
n. 生物制剂

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {biologic} drug for her arthritis.
e.zh: 医生为她的关节炎开了一种生物制剂。

e.en: New {biologic} therapies have transformed cancer treatment.
e.zh: 新型生物制剂疗法彻底改变了癌症治疗方式。

e.en: There's a strong {biological} link between sleep and memory.
e.zh: 睡眠与记忆之间存在着紧密的生物学联系。

e.en: He met his {biological} father for the first time at thirty.
e.zh: 他在三十岁时第一次见到自己的生父。

e.en: Humans are {biologically} wired to crave sugar and fat.
e.zh: 人类在生物学上天生就渴望糖和脂肪。

e.en: The two species are {biologically} very similar despite appearances.
e.zh: 尽管外表不同,这两个物种在生物学上非常相似。

e.en: The marine {biologist} spent months studying coral reefs.
e.zh: 这位海洋生物学家花了好几个月研究珊瑚礁。

e.en: As a kid, she dreamed of becoming a {biologist}.
e.zh: 小时候,她梦想成为一名生物学家。

e.en: She majored in {biology} before going to medical school.
e.zh: 她在上医学院之前主修的是生物学。

e.en: Modern {biology} relies heavily on computer modeling.
e.zh: 现代生物学在很大程度上依赖于计算机建模。

e.en: The {bioluminescence} of the plankton lit up the night waves.
e.zh: 浮游生物的生物发光照亮了夜晚的海浪。

e.en: Fireflies are famous for their flashing {bioluminescence}.
e.zh: 萤火虫因其闪烁的生物发光现象而闻名。

e.en: Tourists flock to the bay to see the {bioluminescent} water.
e.zh: 游客蜂拥至这个海湾,只为一睹会发光的海水。

e.en: Deep-sea fish often have {bioluminescent} organs to attract prey.
e.zh: 深海鱼类常有能发光的器官,用来吸引猎物。

e.en: Doctors use this protein as a {biomarker} for early Alzheimer's.
e.zh: 医生用这种蛋白质作为早期阿尔茨海默病的生物标志物。

e.en: The blood test measures a {biomarker} linked to heart disease.
e.zh: 这项血液检测可测量一种与心脏病相关的生物标志物。

e.en: The power plant burns {biomass} like wood chips and crop waste.
e.zh: 这座发电厂燃烧木屑和农作物废料等生物质来发电。

e.en: Forests store enormous amounts of {biomass} above and below ground.
e.zh: 森林在地上和地下储存着大量的生物质。

biome.t: n. 生物群系，生物群落

e.en: The Arctic tundra is a fragile {biome} threatened by warming.
e.zh: 北极苔原是一个因气候变暖而岌岌可危的生物群落。

e.en: Each {biome} supports its own unique mix of plants and animals.
e.zh: 每个生物群落都孕育着独特的动植物组合。

e.en: Engineers designed a {biomechanical} arm for the injured athlete.
e.zh: 工程师为这位受伤的运动员设计了一只仿生机械手臂。

e.en: The coach studied the runner's {biomechanical} efficiency on video.
e.zh: 教练通过视频研究了这名跑步者的生物力学效率。

e.en: Sports {biomechanics} helps athletes prevent injuries and improve form.
e.zh: 运动生物力学有助于运动员预防伤病并改善动作。

e.en: She studies the {biomechanics} of human walking for her PhD.
e.zh: 她在博士阶段研究人类行走的生物力学。

e.en: He works as a {biomedical} engineer designing prosthetic limbs.
e.zh: 他是一名生物医学工程师,专门设计假肢。

e.en: The hospital invested heavily in new {biomedical} equipment.
e.zh: 这家医院在新型生物医学设备上投入了大量资金。

e.en: Advances in {biomedicine} have extended human life expectancy.
e.zh: 生物医学的进步延长了人类的预期寿命。

e.en: She runs a research lab focused on {biomedicine} and genetics.
e.zh: 她负责一个专注于生物医学和遗传学的研究实验室。

e.en: Most new phones unlock with {biometric} face scans.
e.zh: 大多数新款手机都通过生物识别人脸扫描来解锁。

e.en: Airports increasingly rely on {biometric} passport gates.
e.zh: 机场越来越依赖生物识别护照通道。

biometrics.t: n. 生物特征识别技术

e.en: The bank uses {biometrics} to verify customer identities.
e.zh: 这家银行使用生物识别技术来验证客户身份。

e.en: Critics worry that {biometrics} threaten personal privacy.
e.zh: 批评人士担心生物识别技术会威胁个人隐私。

e.en: The lab specializes in {biomolecular} research on protein folding.
e.zh: 该实验室专注于蛋白质折叠的生物分子研究。

e.en: She earned her degree in {biomolecular} engineering last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天取得了生物分子工程学位。

e.en: DNA is the most famous {biomolecule} in living cells.
e.zh: DNA 是活细胞中最著名的生物分子。

e.en: Each {biomolecule} plays a specific role in the body's chemistry.
e.zh: 每种生物分子在人体化学反应中都扮演着特定的角色。

e.en: The artist sculpted a strange {biomorph} resembling a deep-sea creature.
e.zh: 这位艺术家雕刻了一个酷似深海生物的奇异生物形体。

e.en: Each {biomorph} in the simulation evolves slightly different traits.
e.zh: 模拟中的每个生物形体都会演化出略微不同的特征。

e.en: The chair has a smooth, {biomorphic} shape inspired by river stones.
e.zh: 这把椅子有着仿生的流畅造型,灵感来自河中的石头。

e.en: Modernist architects often used {biomorphic} curves in their designs.
e.zh: 现代主义建筑师常在设计中使用仿生曲线。

bionic.t: adj. 仿生的，生物电子的

e.en: He received a {bionic} arm that responds to nerve signals.
e.zh: 他装上了一只能响应神经信号的仿生手臂。

e.en: The athlete trained with a {bionic} knee after his accident.
e.zh: 事故之后这位运动员戴着仿生膝盖训练。

e.en: Advances in {bionics} are helping amputees regain natural movement.
e.zh: 仿生学的进步正帮助截肢者恢复自然的动作。

e.en: She studies {bionics} to design better prosthetic limbs.
e.zh: 她研究仿生学,以设计更好的义肢。

biopharmaceutical.t:
n. 生物制药
adj. 生物药物的

e.en: The startup develops {biopharmaceutical} products to treat rare diseases.
e.zh: 这家初创公司开发用于治疗罕见病的生物制药产品。

e.en: She works for a major {biopharmaceutical} company in Boston.
e.zh: 她在波士顿一家大型生物制药公司工作。

e.en: Researchers measured the {biophysical} properties of the cell membrane.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了细胞膜的生物物理特性。

e.en: Climate models combine social and {biophysical} factors together.
e.zh: 气候模型把社会因素与生物物理因素结合起来。

e.en: The {biophysicist} studies how proteins fold inside living cells.
e.zh: 这位生物物理学家研究蛋白质在活细胞中如何折叠。

e.en: As a {biophysicist}, she uses lasers to manipulate single molecules.
e.zh: 作为生物物理学家,她用激光操控单个分子。

e.en: He earned his PhD in {biophysics} at Stanford last year.
e.zh: 他去年在斯坦福取得了生物物理学博士学位。

e.en: {Biophysics} bridges the gap between biology and physics.
e.zh: 生物物理学架起了生物学与物理学之间的桥梁。

e.en: The {biopic} about Freddie Mercury won several Oscars.
e.zh: 那部关于弗雷迪·墨丘利的传记片获得了多项奥斯卡奖。

e.en: Netflix released a {biopic} of the famous chess champion.
e.zh: 网飞推出了一部那位著名国际象棋冠军的传记片。

e.en: Scientists created a {biopolymer} that breaks down in seawater.
e.zh: 科学家研制出一种可在海水中降解的生物聚合物。

e.en: Cellulose is the most abundant {biopolymer} on Earth.
e.zh: 纤维素是地球上含量最丰富的生物聚合物。

bioprospecting.t: n. 生物资源勘探（寻找有用物种）

e.en: {Bioprospecting} in the rainforest has uncovered new cancer drugs.
e.zh: 在雨林中的生物勘探发现了新的抗癌药物。

e.en: The company funds {bioprospecting} expeditions to remote coral reefs.
e.zh: 该公司资助前往偏远珊瑚礁的生物勘探考察。

biopsy.t:
n. 活体组织检查
v. 做活检

e.en: The doctor ordered a {biopsy} to confirm the diagnosis.
e.zh: 医生开了活检,以确认诊断结果。

e.en: Her {biopsy} results came back completely normal.
e.zh: 她的活检结果完全正常。

biopsychosocial.t: adj. 生物—心理—社会模式的

e.en: Doctors now use a {biopsychosocial} model to treat chronic pain.
e.zh: 医生们现在用生物-心理-社会模型来治疗慢性疼痛。

e.en: The therapist takes a {biopsychosocial} approach to mental health.
e.zh: 这位治疗师以生物-心理-社会的视角对待心理健康。

e.en: The lab grows tissue inside a sterile {bioreactor}.
e.zh: 实验室在一台无菌生物反应器中培养组织。

e.en: Engineers designed a {bioreactor} that produces insulin from yeast.
e.zh: 工程师设计了一种用酵母生产胰岛素的生物反应器。

e.en: The Amazon {bioregion} contains thousands of unique species.
e.zh: 亚马逊生物区拥有数千个独特物种。

e.en: Each {bioregion} requires its own conservation strategy.
e.zh: 每个生物区都需要专属的保护策略。

e.en: The community follows a {bioregional} approach to farming and food.
e.zh: 这个社区在耕作与饮食上采取生物区域的理念。

e.en: Planners drafted {bioregional} policies to protect local watersheds.
e.zh: 规划者起草了生物区域政策,以保护本地流域。

bioremediation.t: n. 生物修复（污染治理）

e.en: {Bioremediation} uses microbes to clean up oil spills.
e.zh: 生物修复利用微生物清理石油泄漏。

e.en: The contaminated site was restored through {bioremediation} techniques.
e.zh: 那块受污染的场地通过生物修复技术得到了恢复。

biorhythm.t: n. 生物节律；生理周期

e.en: Jet lag throws off your natural {biorhythm} for days.
e.zh: 时差会扰乱你天然的生理节律好几天。

e.en: He plans his workouts around his daily {biorhythm}.
e.zh: 他根据自己每天的生理节律安排锻炼。

e.en: The lab follows strict {biosafety} protocols when handling viruses.
e.zh: 该实验室在处理病毒时遵循严格的生物安全规程。

e.en: All researchers must complete {biosafety} training before entering.
e.zh: 所有研究人员必须先完成生物安全培训才能进入。

bioscience.t: n. 生命科学；生物科学

e.en: She majored in {bioscience} with a focus on genetics.
e.zh: 她主修生物科学,专攻遗传学方向。

e.en: The university opened a new {bioscience} research center downtown.
e.zh: 大学在市中心开设了一个新的生物科学研究中心。

e.en: The wearable {biosensor} tracks blood glucose in real time.
e.zh: 这款可穿戴生物传感器能实时跟踪血糖。

e.en: Engineers built a {biosensor} that detects bacteria in water.
e.zh: 工程师研制出能检测水中细菌的生物传感器。

biosolids.t: n. 污泥固体（污水处理副产物）

e.en: Treated {biosolids} are sometimes used as fertilizer on farms.
e.zh: 经过处理的生物固体有时被用作农场肥料。

e.en: The plant produces tons of {biosolids} from sewage each day.
e.zh: 该工厂每天从污水中产出大量生物固体。

e.en: Pollution threatens every layer of Earth's {biosphere}.
e.zh: 污染威胁着地球生物圈的每一层。

e.en: The {biosphere} reserve protects rare birds and plants.
e.zh: 这个生物圈保护区守护着珍稀的鸟类和植物。

biospherian.t: n. 生物圈实验居住者

e.en: Each {biospherian} lived sealed inside the dome for two years.
e.zh: 每位生物圈实验员都在密封的圆顶里生活了两年。

e.en: The {biospherian} described growing all her own food underground.
e.zh: 那位生物圈实验员描述了在地下种植自己全部食物的经历。

e.en: The {biostatistician} analyzed the clinical trial data carefully.
e.zh: 这位生物统计学家仔细分析了临床试验的数据。

e.en: Hospitals are hiring more {biostatistician} roles for research projects.
e.zh: 医院正为研究项目招聘更多生物统计学家职位。

e.en: Modern {biostatistics} relies heavily on R and Python.
e.zh: 现代生物统计学在很大程度上依赖 R 和 Python。

e.en: She teaches {biostatistics} to public health graduate students.
e.zh: 她为公共卫生研究生讲授生物统计学。

e.en: Plants use sunlight to drive the {biosynthesis} of sugars.
e.zh: 植物利用阳光驱动糖类的生物合成。

e.en: Researchers mapped the {biosynthesis} pathway of the antibiotic.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制出了这种抗生素的生物合成路径。

biota.t: n. 某区域的全部生物

e.en: The lake's {biota} has changed dramatically since the dam opened.
e.zh: 自从大坝启用以来,这个湖的生物群落发生了巨大变化。

e.en: Scientists catalog the {biota} of every protected forest.
e.zh: 科学家会为每片受保护森林的生物群编目。

biotech.t: n. 生物技术（biotechnology 的缩写）

e.en: He left finance to join a {biotech} startup in Cambridge.
e.zh: 他离开金融业,加入了剑桥的一家生物科技初创公司。

e.en: {Biotech} stocks rallied after the FDA approval news.
e.zh: 在 FDA 批准消息后,生物科技股大幅上涨。

e.en: {Biotechnological} advances have transformed modern medicine.
e.zh: 生物技术的进步彻底改变了现代医学。

e.en: The firm holds several {biotechnological} patents in gene editing.
e.zh: 该公司在基因编辑领域持有多项生物技术专利。

biotechnologies.t: n. 生物技术（biotechnology 的复数）

e.en: Emerging {biotechnologies} could reshape agriculture within a decade.
e.zh: 新兴的生物技术可能在十年内重塑农业。

e.en: Regulators struggle to keep up with fast-moving {biotechnologies}.
e.zh: 监管机构难以跟上飞速发展的各种生物技术。

e.en: China is investing heavily in {biotechnology} research and startups.
e.zh: 中国正大力投资生物技术研究与创业公司。

e.en: Modern {biotechnology} allows scientists to edit DNA precisely.
e.zh: 现代生物技术让科学家能够精确编辑 DNA。

e.en: The agency runs drills to prepare for possible {bioterrorism} attacks.
e.zh: 该机构会进行演练,以应对可能的生物恐怖袭击。

e.en: Anthrax letters raised national fears of {bioterrorism}.
e.zh: 炭疽信件引发了全国对生物恐怖主义的恐慌。

biotic.t: adj. 生物的；与生物有关的

e.en: Soil health depends on both {biotic} and abiotic factors.
e.zh: 土壤健康同时取决于生物因素和非生物因素。

e.en: Invasive species disrupt the {biotic} balance of the ecosystem.
e.zh: 外来入侵物种打乱了生态系统的生物平衡。

biotin.t: n. 生物素；维生素 H

e.en: Many shampoos add {biotin} to promote stronger hair.
e.zh: 许多洗发水会添加生物素以让头发更强韧。

e.en: Eggs and nuts are good natural sources of {biotin}.
e.zh: 鸡蛋和坚果是生物素的优质天然来源。

e.en: Farmers detected a new {biotype} of the pest resistant to pesticides.
e.zh: 农民发现了一种对农药有抗性的害虫新生物型。

e.en: Each {biotype} of the bacteria reacts differently to treatment.
e.zh: 这种细菌的每种生物型对治疗的反应都不一样。

e.en: The convention outlaws all forms of {biowarfare} between nations.
e.zh: 该公约禁止国家之间一切形式的生物战。

e.en: Historians documented early attempts at {biowarfare} during sieges.
e.zh: 历史学家记录了围城战中早期生物战的尝试。

e.en: International treaties ban the development of any {bioweapon}.
e.zh: 国际条约禁止研发任何生物武器。

e.en: Investigators searched the lab for traces of a {bioweapon}.
e.zh: 调查人员在实验室里搜寻生物武器的痕迹。

biparental.t: adj. 双亲的；父母双方的

e.en: Penguins show strong {biparental} care of their chicks.
e.zh: 企鹅对雏鸟表现出强烈的双亲共同抚育。

e.en: The study compared {biparental} and single-parent households.
e.zh: 该研究比较了双亲家庭与单亲家庭的差异。

bipartisan.t: adj. 两党的；两党合作的

e.en: The senators reached a {bipartisan} deal on the infrastructure bill.
e.zh: 参议员们就基础设施法案达成了两党共识。

e.en: Voters say they want more {bipartisan} cooperation in Congress.
e.zh: 选民表示希望国会有更多两党合作。

e.en: Real {bipartisanship} has become rare in today's polarized politics.
e.zh: 在如今两极化的政治中,真正的两党合作已经很少见。

e.en: He built his career on a reputation for {bipartisanship}.
e.zh: 他凭借擅长两党合作的声誉建立起了自己的政治生涯。

e.en: They signed a {bipartite} agreement on trade and security.
e.zh: 双方签署了一份关于贸易与安全的双边协议。

e.en: The graph is {bipartite}, splitting into two distinct groups.
e.zh: 这张图是二部图,可分为两个不同的集合。

e.en: Humans are the most successful {biped} on the planet.
e.zh: 人类是地球上最成功的两足动物。

e.en: Engineers built a {biped} robot that can climb stairs.
e.zh: 工程师造出了一种能爬楼梯的两足机器人。

e.en: Early hominids evolved {bipedal} walking millions of years ago.
e.zh: 早期人科动物在数百万年前演化出了双足行走。

e.en: The new robot uses {bipedal} locomotion to navigate rough terrain.
e.zh: 这款新机器人通过双足运动在崎岖地形上前行。

e.en: Anthropologists debate when {bipedalism} first emerged in our ancestors.
e.zh: 人类学家对我们祖先何时首次出现双足行走仍有争论。

e.en: {Bipedalism} freed early humans' hands to use tools.
e.zh: 双足行走解放了早期人类的双手,使他们能使用工具。

e.en: The drug shows a {biphasic} response at different dosages.
e.zh: 这种药物在不同剂量下呈现双相反应。

e.en: Sleep researchers describe a {biphasic} pattern with afternoon naps.
e.zh: 睡眠研究者把含有午睡的睡眠模式描述为双相睡眠。

e.en: Old transformers often contained toxic polychlorinated {biphenyl} compounds.
e.zh: 旧式变压器中常含有有毒的多氯联苯化合物。

e.en: Chemists synthesized a new {biphenyl} dye for solar cells.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一种用于太阳能电池的新型联苯染料。

e.en: The pilot performed loops in a vintage red {biplane}.
e.zh: 飞行员驾驶一架红色的老式双翼机做着翻滚动作。

e.en: Early airmail routes were flown using a wooden {biplane}.
e.zh: 早期的航空邮政航线是用一种木制双翼机飞行的。

e.en: The sniper steadied his rifle on a folding {bipod}.
e.zh: 狙击手用一个可折叠两脚架稳住了步枪。

e.en: He attached a lightweight {bipod} to his spotting scope.
e.zh: 他在观靶镜上安装了一个轻巧的两脚架。

bipolar.t:
adj. 双相的；躁郁症的
adj. 两极的

e.en: She was diagnosed with {bipolar} disorder in her twenties.
e.zh: 她在二十多岁时被诊断出患有双相情感障碍。

e.en: The Cold War created a {bipolar} world dominated by two superpowers.
e.zh: 冷战造就了一个由两个超级大国主导的两极世界。

e.en: He muttered {bir} under his breath in old dialect.
e.zh: 他用古老的方言低声嘀咕着"bir"这个词。

e.en: The word {bir} appears in some Scottish folk songs.
e.zh: "bir"这个词出现在一些苏格兰民谣中。

biracial.t: adj. 由两个种族组成的；混血的

e.en: She grew up in a {biracial} family in Toronto.
e.zh: 她在多伦多一个混血家庭中长大。

e.en: The show features a {biracial} couple raising twins.
e.zh: 该剧讲述一对混血夫妇抚养双胞胎的故事。

e.en: A tall {birch} tree stood beside the lake.
e.zh: 湖边长着一棵高大的白桦树。

e.en: The cabin floor was made of polished {birch}.
e.zh: 小屋的地板是用抛光的桦木做的。

e.en: They built a canoe from {birchbark} and pine resin.
e.zh: 他们用桦树皮和松脂做了一艘独木舟。

e.en: The museum displayed an old {birchbark} scroll.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一卷古老的桦树皮卷轴。

e.en: A small {bird} landed on my windowsill this morning.
e.zh: 今早一只小鸟落在我的窗台上。

e.en: Twitter's logo used to be a blue {bird}.
e.zh: 推特的标志以前是一只蓝色的小鸟。

e.en: Sparrows splashed happily in the stone {birdbath}.
e.zh: 麻雀在石制鸟浴盆里欢快地拍水。

e.en: She filled the {birdbath} with fresh water every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都给鸟浴盆换上清水。

e.en: The antique {birdcage} hung in the sunny window.
e.zh: 那个古董鸟笼挂在阳光充足的窗前。

e.en: He cleaned the {birdcage} every Sunday afternoon.
e.zh: 他每个星期天下午都会清理鸟笼。

e.en: The pet store sold dozens of decorative {birdcages}.
e.zh: 那家宠物店出售几十种装饰性鸟笼。

e.en: Old wooden {birdcages} hung from the porch ceiling.
e.zh: 门廊的天花板上挂着几个旧木鸟笼。

e.en: He imitated the owl's {birdcall} surprisingly well.
e.zh: 他模仿猫头鹰的叫声模仿得出奇地像。

e.en: A strange {birdcall} echoed through the dark forest.
e.zh: 一阵奇怪的鸟鸣回荡在黑暗的森林里。

e.en: As a serious {birder}, she travels the world for rare species.
e.zh: 作为一名资深观鸟者,她为了稀有鸟类周游世界。

e.en: Every {birder} in town gathered for the annual count.
e.zh: 镇上的每位观鸟者都聚到一起进行年度统计。

e.en: He built a tiny {birdhouse} for his daughter's garden.
e.zh: 他为女儿的花园做了一个小巧的鸟屋。

e.en: A wooden {birdhouse} hung from the old oak tree.
e.zh: 一个木制鸟屋挂在那棵老橡树上。

birdie.t:
n. 小鸟
n. (高尔夫) 低于标准杆一杆

e.en: She scored a {birdie} on the par-four hole.
e.zh: 她在那个四杆洞打出了小鸟球。

e.en: The toddler pointed and said, "Look, a {birdie}!"
e.zh: 小朋友指着说:"看,小鸟!"

e.en: We went {birding} in the wetlands at dawn.
e.zh: 我们黎明时分去湿地观鸟。

e.en: {Birding} has become a popular weekend hobby.
e.zh: 观鸟已经成为一种流行的周末爱好。

e.en: The island is famous for its diverse {birdlife}.
e.zh: 这座岛屿以其多样的鸟类而闻名。

e.en: Pollution has threatened the local {birdlife} for decades.
e.zh: 污染已经威胁当地鸟类生存几十年了。

e.en: She had delicate, {birdlike} features and bright eyes.
e.zh: 她长着精致的、鸟儿般的五官和明亮的眼睛。

e.en: He moved with quick, {birdlike} gestures across the stage.
e.zh: 他在舞台上以鸟儿般迅捷的动作移动。

e.en: Several colorful {birds} were singing in the garden.
e.zh: 几只五彩缤纷的鸟在花园里歌唱。

e.en: Migratory {birds} fly south every autumn.
e.zh: 候鸟每年秋天都会向南迁徙。

e.en: She refilled the feeder with fresh {birdseed} weekly.
e.zh: 她每周都往喂食器里添加新鲜的鸟食。

e.en: A bag of {birdseed} costs about ten dollars now.
e.zh: 一袋鸟食现在大约要十美元。

e.en: The hunter loaded his shotgun with fine {birdshot}.
e.zh: 猎人在他的霰弹枪里装上了细鸟弹。

e.en: {Birdshot} pellets are smaller than buckshot rounds.
e.zh: 鸟弹的弹丸比鹿弹小得多。

e.en: I woke to the sound of cheerful {birdsong}.
e.zh: 我在欢快的鸟鸣声中醒来。

e.en: The app records and identifies {birdsong} automatically.
e.zh: 这个应用能自动录制并识别鸟鸣声。

e.en: My grandfather is a passionate {birdwatcher} and photographer.
e.zh: 我祖父是一位热情的观鸟者和摄影师。

e.en: Every {birdwatcher} in the park carried binoculars.
e.zh: 公园里每位观鸟者都带着望远镜。

birdy.t:
adj. 像鸟的
n. 小鸟（昵称）

e.en: The toddler waved at the {birdy} on the branch.
e.zh: 小朋友向树枝上的小鸟挥手。

e.en: She has a sweet, {birdy} voice when she sings.
e.zh: 她唱歌时有种甜美如鸟鸣的嗓音。

e.en: Calcite crystals show strong {birefringence} under polarized light.
e.zh: 方解石晶体在偏振光下显示出强烈的双折射现象。

e.en: The lab measured {birefringence} in the new polymer film.
e.zh: 实验室测量了新聚合物薄膜的双折射率。

e.en: The Scottish poem mentions a lonely {birk} by the burn.
e.zh: 那首苏格兰诗歌提到溪边孤零零的一棵桦树。

e.en: Old farmers still call the birch tree a {birk}.
e.zh: 老农民仍然把白桦树叫作"birk"。

birkbeck.t: n. 伯贝克（人名/伦敦大学学院名）

e.en: She earned her master's degree from {Birkbeck} College London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦伯贝克学院取得了硕士学位。

e.en: {Birkbeck} is famous for offering evening classes to working adults.
e.zh: 伯贝克学院以为在职成人提供夜间课程而闻名。

birkenhead.t: n. 伯肯黑德（英国地名）

e.en: The ferry crosses the Mersey from Liverpool to {Birkenhead}.
e.zh: 渡轮从利物浦穿过默西河到达伯肯黑德。

e.en: She grew up in a small house in {Birkenhead}.
e.zh: 她在伯肯黑德的一栋小房子里长大。

birkin.t: n. 铂金包（爱马仕品牌）；人名

e.en: The actress carried a tan leather {Birkin} to the premiere.
e.zh: 那位女演员拎着一只棕褐色皮革的铂金包出席首映礼。

e.en: A vintage {Birkin} bag can sell for thousands.
e.zh: 一只复古铂金包可以卖到数千美元。

birmingham.t: n. 伯明翰（英美城市名）

e.en: {Birmingham} is the second-largest city in England.
e.zh: 伯明翰是英格兰第二大城市。

e.en: She caught the early train to {Birmingham} for work.
e.zh: 她搭乘早班火车去伯明翰上班。

e.en: He scribbled the address with a blue {biro}.
e.zh: 他用一支蓝色圆珠笔潦草地写下地址。

e.en: My {biro} ran out of ink halfway through the exam.
e.zh: 我的圆珠笔在考试中途没墨了。

birth.t:
n. 出生；诞生
n. 起源

e.en: The {birth} of her son changed everything for her.
e.zh: 儿子的出生改变了她的一切。

e.en: Please write your date of {birth} on the form.
e.zh: 请在表格上写下你的出生日期。

e.en: Enter your full name and {birthdate} to register.
e.zh: 输入你的全名和出生日期即可注册。

e.en: The website asked for my {birthdate} to verify my age.
e.zh: 那个网站要求填写出生日期以验证年龄。

e.en: We threw a surprise {birthday} party for my mom.
e.zh: 我们为妈妈举办了一场惊喜生日派对。

e.en: Happy {birthday}! I hope you love the gift.
e.zh: 生日快乐!希望你喜欢这份礼物。

e.en: He always forgets his friends' {birthdays} until the last minute.
e.zh: 他总是直到最后一刻才想起朋友们的生日。

e.en: Facebook reminds me of upcoming {birthdays} every morning.
e.zh: 脸书每天早上都会提醒我即将到来的生日。

e.en: The hospital opened a new {birthing} center last year.
e.zh: 那家医院去年开设了一个新的分娩中心。

e.en: She's taking classes to prepare for {birthing} her first child.
e.zh: 她正在上课为生第一个孩子做准备。

e.en: He has a small {birthmark} on his left cheek.
e.zh: 他的左脸颊上有一个小小的胎记。

e.en: The doctor said the {birthmark} was completely harmless.
e.zh: 医生说这个胎记完全无害。

e.en: Stratford-upon-Avon is the {birthplace} of Shakespeare.
e.zh: 埃文河畔斯特拉特福是莎士比亚的出生地。

e.en: She returned to her {birthplace} after thirty years away.
e.zh: 她离开三十年后回到了出生地。

e.en: The book lists the {birthplaces} of all U.S. presidents.
e.zh: 这本书列出了所有美国总统的出生地。

e.en: Many famous {birthplaces} have become tourist attractions.
e.zh: 许多名人的出生地已经成为旅游景点。

e.en: Japan's {birthrate} has fallen sharply over the past decade.
e.zh: 日本的出生率在过去十年里大幅下降。

e.en: Economists worry about the country's declining {birthrate}.
e.zh: 经济学家对该国不断下降的出生率感到担忧。

e.en: Free education should be every child's {birthright}.
e.zh: 免费教育应该是每个孩子与生俱来的权利。

e.en: He claimed the throne as his rightful {birthright}.
e.zh: 他以与生俱来的权利要求继承王位。

e.en: The hospital recorded over a thousand {births} last year.
e.zh: 医院去年记录了一千多例新生儿出生。

e.en: Annual {births} in the country dropped to a record low.
e.zh: 该国每年新生儿数量降至历史最低水平。

bis.t: adv. 再一次（音乐术语）；两次

e.en: The audience shouted "{bis}!" demanding another song.
e.zh: 观众高喊"再来一个!"要求再唱一首歌。

e.en: Article 12 {bis} was added to the treaty later.
e.zh: 第12条之二是后来才加入条约的。

e.en: The Bay of {Biscay} is known for rough seas.
e.zh: 比斯开湾以海况恶劣而著称。

e.en: Storms in {Biscay} delayed the ferry for two days.
e.zh: 比斯开湾的风暴使渡轮延误了两天。

biscuit.t: n. 饼干（英式）；小圆面包（美式）

e.en: She dunked a {biscuit} in her morning tea.
e.zh: 她把一块饼干蘸在早茶里。

e.en: This homemade {biscuit} pairs well with strawberry jam.
e.zh: 这块自制饼干配草莓酱很好吃。

e.en: My grandma bakes the best chocolate chip {biscuits}.
e.zh: 我外婆烤的巧克力豆饼干是最棒的。

e.en: He bought a tin of shortbread {biscuits} for the trip.
e.zh: 他买了一罐黄油酥饼带去旅行。

e.en: A narrow river {bisects} the small mountain village.
e.zh: 一条窄窄的河将这个山村一分为二。

e.en: Use a compass to {bisect} the angle accurately.
e.zh: 用圆规精确地将这个角平分。

e.en: The researchers calculated a {biserial} correlation between scores and gender.
e.zh: 研究人员计算了分数与性别之间的二列相关。

e.en: A point-{biserial} coefficient measures binary-continuous variable relationships.
e.zh: 点二列系数用来衡量二元变量与连续变量之间的关系。

bisexual.t:
adj. 双性恋的
n. 双性恋者

e.en: She came out as {bisexual} during her college years.
e.zh: 她在大学期间出柜表明自己是双性恋。

e.en: The film features a {bisexual} character as its lead.
e.zh: 这部电影以一位双性恋角色为主角。

e.en: The author wrote openly about her {bisexuality} in the memoir.
e.zh: 作者在回忆录中坦率地写到自己的双性恋身份。

e.en: The panel discussed visibility and {bisexuality} in modern media.
e.zh: 小组讨论了双性恋者在现代媒体中的可见度。

bishop.t:
n. 主教
n. (国际象棋) 象

e.en: The {bishop} blessed the new chapel last Sunday.
e.zh: 主教上周日为新教堂祈福。

e.en: In chess, the {bishop} moves only along diagonals.
e.zh: 在国际象棋中,象只能沿对角线移动。

bishopric.t: n. 主教的职位或辖区

e.en: He was appointed to the {bishopric} of Canterbury.
e.zh: 他被任命为坎特伯雷的主教教区主教。

e.en: The medieval {bishopric} controlled vast tracts of farmland.
e.zh: 中世纪的主教教区控制着大片农田。

e.en: Several {bishops} attended the conference in Rome.
e.zh: 几位主教参加了在罗马召开的会议。

e.en: Two {bishops} are stronger than two knights in endgames.
e.zh: 在残局中,两个象比两个马更强。

e.en: The shooters competed at {Bisley} for the national title.
e.zh: 射手们在比斯利争夺全国冠军。

e.en: He trained at the {Bisley} ranges every weekend.
e.zh: 他每个周末都在比斯利靶场训练。

bismarck.t: n. 俾斯麦（德国政治家或地名）

e.en: The battleship {Bismarck} was sunk in 1941.
e.zh: 俾斯麦号战列舰于1941年被击沉。

e.en: {Bismarck} unified Germany in the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 俾斯麦在十九世纪统一了德国。

e.en: {Bismuth} crystals show beautiful rainbow colors.
e.zh: 铋晶体呈现出美丽的彩虹色。

e.en: Pink stomach medicine often contains {bismuth} subsalicylate.
e.zh: 粉色的胃药通常含有次水杨酸铋。

e.en: A herd of {bison} crossed the prairie at sunset.
e.zh: 一群野牛在日落时穿过大草原。

e.en: Yellowstone is famous for its wild {bison} population.
e.zh: 黄石公园以其野生美洲野牛种群而闻名。

e.en: Doctors prescribe {bisphosphonate} drugs to treat osteoporosis.
e.zh: 医生开双膦酸盐类药物来治疗骨质疏松症。

e.en: The patient started a weekly {bisphosphonate} regimen.
e.zh: 病人开始了每周一次的双膦酸盐疗程。

bisque.t:
n. 浓味海鲜汤
n. 陶瓷素坯

e.en: The restaurant serves a creamy lobster {bisque}.
e.zh: 这家餐厅提供奶油龙虾浓汤。

e.en: She ordered tomato {bisque} with grilled cheese.
e.zh: 她点了番茄浓汤配烤芝士三明治。

bistable.t: adj. 双稳态的（电路、显示）

e.en: E-ink displays use a {bistable} technology to save power.
e.zh: 电子墨水屏使用双稳态技术来节省电力。

e.en: The circuit acts as a {bistable} memory element.
e.zh: 该电路作为一个双稳态存储元件。

e.en: We had dinner at a cozy French {bistro}.
e.zh: 我们在一家温馨的法式小酒馆吃了晚餐。

e.en: The corner {bistro} is famous for its onion soup.
e.zh: 街角的小酒馆以洋葱汤闻名。

bit.t:
n. 比特（二进制位）
n. 一点儿；v. bite 的过去式

e.en: Wait a {bit} while the page loads.
e.zh: 等一下,页面正在加载。

e.en: Each {bit} stores a single binary value.
e.zh: 每个比特存储一个二进制数值。

bitch.t:
n. (粗) 婊子；母狗
v. 抱怨、发牢骚

e.en: Stop complaining—nobody likes a {bitch} session at work.
e.zh: 别再抱怨了,谁也不喜欢上班时听人发牢骚。

e.en: The breeder kept the female {bitch} for show competitions.
e.zh: 饲养者把那只母犬留作参赛之用。

e.en: Her {bitchiness} on social media drove followers away.
e.zh: 她在社交媒体上的刻薄让粉丝纷纷离开。

e.en: The show is full of office {bitchiness} and drama.
e.zh: 这部剧充满了职场上的尖酸刻薄和狗血剧情。

bitching.t:
v. 抱怨、发牢骚
adj. (俚) 超棒的

e.en: Stop {bitching} about the weather and grab an umbrella.
e.zh: 别再抱怨天气了,拿把伞吧。

e.en: They spent the whole lunch {bitching} about their boss.
e.zh: 他们整顿午饭都在吐槽老板。

e.en: Her {bitchy} comment ruined the entire dinner.
e.zh: 她那句刻薄的话毁了整顿晚餐。

e.en: Don't be {bitchy} just because you lost the game.
e.zh: 别因为输了比赛就这么尖酸。

bite.t:
v. 咬
n. 一口、咬痕

e.en: Take a {bite} of this cake—it's amazing.
e.zh: 尝一口这块蛋糕,太好吃了。

e.en: Be careful, that dog might {bite} you.
e.zh: 小心,那只狗可能会咬你。

e.en: Our puppy is a real {biter} during teething.
e.zh: 我们的小狗在长牙时特别爱咬东西。

e.en: The toddler became a {biter} at daycare last month.
e.zh: 那个小孩上个月在托儿所开始咬人了。

bites.t:
v. 咬 (bite 的第三人称单数)
n. 咬痕 (复数)

e.en: Mosquito {bites} always itch the most at night.
e.zh: 蚊子咬的包总是在晚上最痒。

e.en: She {bites} her nails whenever she's nervous.
e.zh: 她一紧张就咬指甲。

biting.t:
adj. 刺骨的；尖刻的
v. 咬（bite 的现在分词）

e.en: A {biting} wind swept across the empty parking lot.
e.zh: 刺骨的寒风扫过空荡荡的停车场。

e.en: The critic wrote a {biting} review of the film.
e.zh: 那位评论家写了一篇尖刻的影评。

e.en: She replied {bitingly}, leaving the room in silence.
e.zh: 她尖刻地回了一句,房间顿时鸦雀无声。

e.en: The wind blew {bitingly} cold across the open field.
e.zh: 风刺骨地吹过空旷的田野。

e.en: Save the image as a {bitmap} for the legacy software.
e.zh: 把图像保存为位图格式以兼容老软件。

e.en: The icon is a small 32-pixel {bitmap}.
e.zh: 这个图标是一个32像素的小位图。

bits.t:
n. 比特（复数）
n. 碎片、一点儿

e.en: There are {bits} of glass scattered across the floor.
e.zh: 地板上散落着碎玻璃。

e.en: The file is only a few hundred {bits} in size.
e.zh: 这个文件只有几百比特大小。

bitten.t: v. bite 的过去分词，被咬

e.en: Once {bitten}, twice shy—he never trusted strangers again.
e.zh: 一朝被蛇咬,十年怕井绳,他再也不信陌生人了。

e.en: She had been {bitten} by a tick during the hike.
e.zh: 她在徒步时被蜱虫叮咬了。

bitter.t: adj. 苦的；痛苦的、愤恨的

e.en: This coffee tastes a little too {bitter} for me.
e.zh: 这咖啡对我来说有点太苦了。

e.en: He felt {bitter} about being passed over for promotion.
e.zh: 他对升职被忽略一事感到愤愤不平。

e.en: She complained {bitterly} about the unfair decision.
e.zh: 她对那个不公平的决定愤愤不平地抱怨。

e.en: The wind blew {bitterly} cold all night long.
e.zh: 寒风整夜刺骨地吹着。

e.en: A {bittern} hid silently among the tall reeds.
e.zh: 一只麻鳽悄悄地躲在高高的芦苇丛中。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {bittern} at the marsh.
e.zh: 观鸟者在沼泽地发现了一只罕见的麻鳽。

e.en: Years of rejection left a deep {bitterness} in him.
e.zh: 多年的拒绝在他心中留下了深深的怨恨。

e.en: Roasting reduces the {bitterness} of the cocoa beans.
e.zh: 烘焙能减少可可豆的苦味。

e.en: Saying goodbye on graduation day was {bittersweet}.
e.zh: 毕业那天的告别让人百感交集。

e.en: The ending of the film felt {bittersweet} but satisfying.
e.zh: 电影的结局苦乐参半但令人满足。

e.en: The article felt {bitty} and lacked a clear argument.
e.zh: 这篇文章显得零碎,缺乏清晰的论点。

e.en: She made a {bitty} sandwich for her toddler.
e.zh: 她给小孩做了一个小小的三明治。

e.en: The road crew melted {bitumen} to seal the cracks.
e.zh: 道路工人熔化沥青来填补裂缝。

e.en: Roofs are often coated with {bitumen} for waterproofing.
e.zh: 屋顶常用沥青涂层来防水。

bituminous.t: adj. 含沥青的；沥青质的

e.en: {Bituminous} coal burns hotter than lignite.
e.zh: 烟煤的燃烧温度比褐煤更高。

e.en: The driveway was sealed with a {bituminous} coating.
e.zh: 车道用沥青涂层进行了密封。

e.en: Oysters and clams are popular {bivalve} mollusks.
e.zh: 牡蛎和蛤蜊是常见的双壳类软体动物。

e.en: A {bivalve} filters food particles from seawater.
e.zh: 双壳类动物从海水中过滤食物颗粒。

e.en: We ran a {bivariate} analysis of height and weight.
e.zh: 我们对身高和体重做了一次双变量分析。

e.en: The chart shows a {bivariate} distribution of the data.
e.zh: 图表展示了数据的双变量分布。

bivouac.t:
n. 露营地
v. 露宿、野营

e.en: The climbers set up a {bivouac} below the summit.
e.zh: 登山者在山顶下方搭起了临时露营地。

e.en: Soldiers had to {bivouac} in the freezing forest.
e.zh: 士兵们不得不在严寒的森林里露营。

biweekly.t:
adj. 双周的；每两周一次的
adv. 每两周一次

e.en: Our team holds a {biweekly} planning meeting on Mondays.
e.zh: 我们团队每两周一次在周一开规划会议。

e.en: She gets paid on a {biweekly} schedule.
e.zh: 她每两周发一次工资。

biz.t: n. 生意、行业（business 的缩写）

e.en: He's been in the music {biz} for over twenty years.
e.zh: 他在音乐圈里已经混了二十多年。

e.en: That's just how show {biz} works these days.
e.zh: 如今的演艺圈就是这么运作的。

e.en: What a {bizarre} coincidence to meet you here.
e.zh: 在这里遇到你真是奇怪的巧合。

e.en: The artist is known for her {bizarre} sculptures.
e.zh: 这位艺术家以她奇异的雕塑作品闻名。

e.en: He {bizarrely} insisted on wearing pajamas to the wedding.
e.zh: 他竟然奇怪地坚持穿睡衣去婚礼。

e.en: The plot twist was {bizarrely} satisfying somehow.
e.zh: 剧情的反转莫名其妙地令人满足。

e.en: The {bizarreness} of the dream stayed with her all day.
e.zh: 那个梦的离奇感整天萦绕着她。

e.en: Critics noted the {bizarreness} of the film's ending.
e.zh: 评论家们注意到电影结尾的怪异之处。

bla.t: int. 等等、废话（blah 的变体）

e.en: He just kept saying {bla} bla bla without any real point.
e.zh: 他只是不停地说啊说啊,一点重点也没有。

e.en: The lecture turned into endless {bla} after lunch.
e.zh: 午餐后,讲座变成了没完没了的废话。

e.en: Don't {blab} about the surprise party to anyone.
e.zh: 别把惊喜派对的事跟任何人乱说。

e.en: He tends to {blab} secrets after a few drinks.
e.zh: 他喝了几杯后就喜欢乱说秘密。

blabbermouth.t: n. 多嘴的人、爱泄密者

e.en: Don't tell her—she's a total {blabbermouth}.
e.zh: 别告诉她,她是个十足的大嘴巴。

e.en: The office {blabbermouth} spread the rumor by lunchtime.
e.zh: 办公室的大嘴巴在午饭前就把传闻散布开了。

black.t:
adj. 黑色的
n. 黑色；黑人

e.en: She wore a {black} dress to the gallery opening.
e.zh: 她穿了一件黑色连衣裙去画廊开幕式。

e.en: Please change the font color to {black}.
e.zh: 请把字体颜色改成黑色。

e.en: {Blackadder} remains one of Britain's most beloved sitcoms.
e.zh: 《黑爵士》仍是英国最受喜爱的情景喜剧之一。

e.en: Rowan Atkinson played the cunning {Blackadder} brilliantly.
e.zh: 罗温·艾金森把狡猾的黑爵士演得惟妙惟肖。

e.en: A young {blader} zipped past us along the boardwalk.
e.zh: 一个年轻的轮滑爱好者沿木板道从我们身边飞驰而过。

e.en: Every weekend the park fills with skaters and inline {blader} groups.
e.zh: 每个周末,公园里都挤满了滑板手和直排轮滑爱好者。

blades.t: n. 刀片；叶片（blade 的复数）

e.en: The fan's {blades} spun quietly above the dining table.
e.zh: 风扇的叶片在餐桌上方静静地转动。

e.en: Frost still clung to the green {blades} of grass at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时分,绿草叶上还挂着霜。

blah.t:
adj. 无趣的
n. 废话

e.en: The movie was just {blah} — nothing memorable at all.
e.zh: 这部电影平平无奇,完全没什么印象。

e.en: I've been feeling kind of {blah} all week for some reason.
e.zh: 不知为何这一整周我都感觉有点提不起劲。

e.en: A short walk usually helps shake off the winter {blahs}.
e.zh: 短暂散个步通常能赶走冬日的萎靡。

e.en: She fought the Monday {blahs} with strong coffee and music.
e.zh: 她靠浓咖啡和音乐对抗周一的倦怠感。

e.en: Tony {Blair} served as British prime minister for ten years.
e.zh: 托尼·布莱尔曾担任英国首相十年。

e.en: My friend {Blair} just moved to Toronto for a new job.
e.zh: 我朋友布莱尔刚搬到多伦多去做新工作了。

blakeney.t: n. 布莱克尼（姓氏/地名）

e.en: We watched seals lounging on the sandbanks near {Blakeney}.
e.zh: 我们在布莱克尼附近的沙洲上看到海豹在晒太阳。

e.en: {Blakeney} Point is a popular spot for birdwatching enthusiasts.
e.zh: 布莱克尼角是观鸟爱好者喜爱的热门地点。

blame.t:
v. 责怪；归咎
n. 责任

e.en: Don't {blame} yourself for something completely beyond your control.
e.zh: 不要为完全无法控制的事情责怪自己。

e.en: The report places most of the {blame} on poor management.
e.zh: 报告把大部分责任归咎于管理不善。

blamed.t: v. 责怪（blame 过去式/过去分词）

e.en: Investigators {blamed} the crash on a faulty sensor.
e.zh: 调查人员将坠机原因归咎于一个故障传感器。

e.en: He {blamed} his bad mood on lack of sleep.
e.zh: 他把坏心情归咎于睡眠不足。

blameless.t: adj. 无可指责的；清白的

e.en: The internal review found the engineer entirely {blameless}.
e.zh: 内部审查认定这位工程师完全没有过错。

e.en: No one in this messy situation is truly {blameless}.
e.zh: 在这种混乱的局面里,没有人是真正无辜的。

blames.t: v. 责怪（blame 第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {blames} the traffic for being late to meetings.
e.zh: 他总是把开会迟到归咎于交通堵塞。

e.en: The article {blames} rising prices on supply chain problems.
e.zh: 这篇文章把物价上涨归咎于供应链问题。

e.en: The report found several officials {blameworthy} for the data leak.
e.zh: 报告认定多名官员对数据泄露负有责任。

e.en: Honest mistakes are not always {blameworthy} in court.
e.zh: 在法庭上，无心之失并非总是该受责备的。

blaming.t: v. 责怪（blame 现在分词）

e.en: Stop {blaming} the intern for your own mistakes.
e.zh: 别再把你自己的错误怪到实习生头上。

e.en: He kept {blaming} the slow Wi-Fi for missing the meeting.
e.zh: 他一直把错过会议归咎于网速太慢。

e.en: She ordered a glass of sauvignon {blanc} with dinner.
e.zh: 她晚餐点了一杯长相思白葡萄酒。

e.en: The chef finished the sauce with a splash of vin {blanc}.
e.zh: 厨师在酱汁里淋了一点白葡萄酒收尾。

e.en: We hiked up to Sierra {Blanca} at sunrise.
e.zh: 我们在日出时分登上了布兰卡山脉。

e.en: Casa {Blanca} on the corner has the best paella in town.
e.zh: 街角那家白屋餐厅做的西班牙海鲜饭是全城最好的。

e.en: {Blanch} the green beans for two minutes before sautéing.
e.zh: 把四季豆焯水两分钟再下锅炒。

e.en: His face would {blanch} whenever the boss raised her voice.
e.zh: 老板一提高嗓门，他的脸就会发白。

e.en: Aunt {Blanche} sent us cookies every Christmas.
e.zh: 布兰奇姑妈每年圣诞节都会寄饼干给我们。

e.en: The director gave her carte {blanche} on the redesign.
e.zh: 总监给了她在改版上的全权处理权。

blanched.t: v. 焯水；变白（blanch 过去式）

e.en: She {blanched} the almonds and slipped off the skins.
e.zh: 她把杏仁焯水后剥掉了外皮。

e.en: He {blanched} when the doctor mentioned surgery.
e.zh: 医生一提手术，他的脸色就变得苍白。

e.en: Grandma served a vanilla {blancmange} with fresh berries.
e.zh: 奶奶端上了一份配新鲜浆果的香草牛奶冻。

e.en: The dessert menu still features an old-fashioned {blancmange}.
e.zh: 甜点菜单上还保留着一道传统的杏仁奶冻。

e.en: He poured a shot of tequila {blanco} for the cocktail.
e.zh: 他倒了一杯白龙舌兰来调这款鸡尾酒。

e.en: The bar specializes in agave {blanco} flights.
e.zh: 这家酒吧专门提供白龙舌兰品酒套餐。

bland.t: adj. 平淡无味的；乏味的

e.en: The hotel breakfast was cheap but pretty {bland}.
e.zh: 酒店早餐很便宜，但味道相当寡淡。

e.en: His speech was so {bland} that half the room dozed off.
e.zh: 他的演讲乏味得让半场人都打起了瞌睡。

e.en: She ignored every {blandishment} the salesman offered.
e.zh: 销售员的每一句奉承她都没放在心上。

e.en: No {blandishment} could persuade him to leave the team.
e.zh: 任何花言巧语都无法说服他离开团队。

e.en: The lobbyist's {blandishments} did not sway the senator.
e.zh: 说客的甜言蜜语没能动摇这位参议员。

e.en: She saw through his {blandishments} within minutes.
e.zh: 她几分钟内就看穿了他的奉承话。

e.en: He {blandly} denied any involvement in the scandal.
e.zh: 他不动声色地否认与这桩丑闻有任何牵连。

e.en: The spokesperson responded {blandly} to the harsh question.
e.zh: 发言人对那个尖锐问题给出了平淡的回应。

e.en: The {blandness} of the soup needed a pinch of salt.
e.zh: 这汤太淡了，得加一小撮盐。

e.en: Critics complained about the {blandness} of the new album.
e.zh: 乐评人抱怨这张新专辑过于平淡无味。

blank.t:
adj. 空白的
n. 空白处

e.en: Please fill in the {blank} with your full name.
e.zh: 请在空白处填写你的全名。

e.en: My mind went {blank} during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时我脑子一片空白。

blanket.t:
n. 毯子
adj. 全面的

e.en: She pulled the {blanket} up to her chin and dozed off.
e.zh: 她把毯子拉到下巴，迷迷糊糊睡着了。

e.en: The school imposed a {blanket} ban on phones in class.
e.zh: 学校在课堂上对手机实施了全面禁令。

e.en: Snow {blanketed} the entire valley overnight.
e.zh: 一夜之间大雪覆盖了整个山谷。

e.en: The campaign {blanketed} social media with short videos.
e.zh: 这场宣传活动用短视频铺满了社交媒体。

e.en: We packed extra {blankets} for the camping trip.
e.zh: 我们为这次露营多带了几条毯子。

e.en: Heavy fog {blankets} the city most winter mornings.
e.zh: 冬天大多数清晨，浓雾会笼罩整座城市。

blankly.t: adv. 茫然地；面无表情地

e.en: She stared {blankly} at the error message on her screen.
e.zh: 她茫然地盯着屏幕上的错误提示。

e.en: He answered {blankly}, clearly not paying attention.
e.zh: 他面无表情地回答着，显然心不在焉。

e.en: There was a strange {blankness} in his expression.
e.zh: 他脸上有一种奇怪的空洞表情。

e.en: The {blankness} of the white wall made the room feel sterile.
e.zh: 白墙的空荡让整个房间显得冷清。

e.en: The painter explored different {blanknesses} of empty canvas.
e.zh: 画家探索了空白画布上不同形态的空无感。

e.en: Therapy slowly filled the {blanknesses} in her childhood memory.
e.zh: 心理治疗慢慢填补了她童年记忆中的空白。

blanks.t:
n. 空白处（复数）
v. 使落空

e.en: The form has three {blanks} you still need to fill in.
e.zh: 这份表格还有三处空白需要你填写。

e.en: My memory of last night is full of {blanks}.
