bray.t: v./n. 驴叫；发出刺耳声音

e.en: The donkey began to {bray} at sunrise.
e.zh: 那头驴在日出时开始嘶叫起来。

e.en: His loud {bray} of a laugh startled everyone.
e.zh: 他那驴叫般的大笑把所有人都吓了一跳。

braying.t: n. 驴叫声；刺耳的喊叫

e.en: The {braying} of the donkeys woke the whole village.
e.zh: 驴子的嘶叫声把整个村子都吵醒了。

e.en: He silenced the {braying} crowd with a single gesture.
e.zh: 他一个手势就让喧闹的人群安静下来。

e.en: The technician will {braze} the copper joints together.
e.zh: 技师会把这些铜接头钎焊在一起。

e.en: You need a torch hot enough to {braze} steel.
e.zh: 你需要一把热到能钎焊钢材的喷枪。

brazen.t: adj. 厚颜无耻的；公然的

e.en: It was a {brazen} attempt to cheat the system.
e.zh: 那是公然钻系统漏洞的厚颜无耻之举。

e.en: She told a {brazen} lie right to his face.
e.zh: 她当着他的面厚着脸皮撒了个谎。

brazenly.t: adv. 厚颜无耻地；公然地

e.en: He {brazenly} copied his classmate's answers during the exam.
e.zh: 他在考试中明目张胆地抄同学的答案。

e.en: The thief {brazenly} walked out with the laptop.
e.zh: 那个小偷大摇大摆地拿着笔记本电脑走了出去。

e.en: Her {brazenness} in asking for a raise surprised everyone.
e.zh: 她毫不客气地要求加薪,让所有人都吃了一惊。

e.en: The {brazenness} of the scam left investors stunned.
e.zh: 这场骗局之厚颜无耻让投资者目瞪口呆。

e.en: They warmed their hands over the glowing {brazier}.
e.zh: 他们在燃着的火盆上烤手取暖。

e.en: A small {brazier} burned outside the night market stall.
e.zh: 夜市摊位外燃着一个小火盆。

e.en: {Brazil} won the World Cup five times.
e.zh: 巴西曾五次夺得世界杯冠军。

e.en: We're flying to {Brazil} for Carnival next year.
e.zh: 我们明年要飞去巴西过狂欢节。

brazilian.t:
adj. 巴西的
n. 巴西人

e.en: The cafe serves authentic {Brazilian} coffee every morning.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆每天早上供应正宗的巴西咖啡。

e.en: My new coworker is a {Brazilian} from São Paulo.
e.zh: 我的新同事是来自圣保罗的巴西人。

brazzaville.t: n. 布拉柴维尔（刚果共和国首都）

e.en: {Brazzaville} sits across the river from Kinshasa.
e.zh: 布拉柴维尔与金沙萨隔河相望。

e.en: He flew into {Brazzaville} for a diplomatic conference.
e.zh: 他飞抵布拉柴维尔参加一场外交会议。

breach.t:
n./v. 违反；破坏
n. 缺口；突破

e.en: The data {breach} exposed millions of user passwords.
e.zh: 那次数据泄露暴露了数百万用户的密码。

e.en: Sharing the file would {breach} our confidentiality agreement.
e.zh: 分享这份文件会违反我们的保密协议。

breached.t: v. 违反；攻破（breach 过去式）

e.en: Hackers {breached} the company's firewall last weekend.
e.zh: 黑客上周末攻破了公司的防火墙。

e.en: He {breached} the contract by missing the deadline.
e.zh: 他因错过截止日期而违反了合同。

breaches.t: n./v. 违反；突破口（breach 复数/第三人称）

e.en: The audit revealed several security {breaches} this quarter.
e.zh: 审计发现本季度有多起安全漏洞事件。

e.en: Anyone who {breaches} the rules will be removed.
e.zh: 任何违反规定的人都将被请出去。

breaching.t: v. 违反；突破（breach 进行式）

e.en: They were fined for {breaching} environmental regulations.
e.zh: 他们因违反环保法规被处以罚款。

e.en: A whale was {breaching} just off the boat's bow.
e.zh: 一头鲸鱼正在船头不远处跃出水面。

bread.t:
n. 面包
n. (俚) 钱

e.en: I bake fresh {bread} every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 我每周日早上都烤新鲜面包。

e.en: Could you pass the {bread}, please?
e.zh: 麻烦把面包递给我好吗?

e.en: Ukraine has long been called the {breadbasket} of Europe.
e.zh: 乌克兰长期以来被称为欧洲的粮仓。

e.en: She placed a warm {breadbasket} on the dinner table.
e.zh: 她把一个热乎乎的面包篮放在餐桌上。

breadboard.t: n. 电路实验板；面包板

e.en: I prototyped the circuit on a {breadboard} first.
e.zh: 我先在面包板上搭了电路原型。

e.en: Plug the LED into row five of the {breadboard}.
e.zh: 把这个 LED 插到面包板的第五行。

e.en: She kept the loaves fresh in a wooden {breadbox}.
e.zh: 她把面包放在木质面包盒里保鲜。

e.en: The phone was bigger than a {breadbox} back then.
e.zh: 那时候的电话比一个面包盒还大。

breadcrumb.t:
n. 面包屑
n. 网页导航路径

e.en: Click the {breadcrumb} link to return to the home page.
e.zh: 点击面包屑导航链接即可返回首页。

e.en: He left a {breadcrumb} trail of clues throughout the novel.
e.zh: 他在整部小说中留下了一连串面包屑般的线索。

e.en: She ordered {breaded} chicken with mashed potatoes.
e.zh: 她点了裹面包屑的炸鸡配土豆泥。

e.en: The cook {breaded} the fish before frying it.
e.zh: 厨师把鱼裹上面包屑再下锅炸。

e.en: Locals roast {breadfruit} over an open fire.
e.zh: 当地人在明火上烤面包果。

e.en: The market sold ripe {breadfruit} from the islands.
e.zh: 市场上有从岛上运来的熟面包果。

breading.t: n. 裹在食物外的面包屑

e.en: The {breading} on the chicken was perfectly crispy.
e.zh: 鸡块外面那层面包屑炸得酥脆可口。

e.en: Add herbs to the {breading} for extra flavor.
e.zh: 在面包屑里加些香草可以更入味。

breadline.t: n. 领救济食物的队伍；贫困线

e.en: Many families ended up on the {breadline} during the recession.
e.zh: 经济衰退期间,许多家庭沦落到要靠救济度日。

e.en: Rising rents pushed retirees closer to the {breadline}.
e.zh: 房租上涨让退休者更接近贫困线。

e.en: The waiter brought a basket of warm {breadstick} samples.
e.zh: 服务员端来一篮热乎乎的面包棒。

e.en: She nibbled on a {breadstick} while waiting for her pasta.
e.zh: 她一边等意面一边啃着面包棒。

brake.t:
n. 刹车；制动器
v. 刹车

e.en: Hit the {brake} hard when you see a deer crossing.
e.zh: 看到鹿过马路时用力踩刹车。

e.en: My bike's front {brake} needs adjusting before the trip.
e.zh: 出发前我的自行车前刹车需要调一下。

braked.t: v. 刹车（brake 的过去式）

e.en: The driver {braked} suddenly to avoid hitting the cyclist.
e.zh: 司机猛踩刹车,以免撞到骑车人。

e.en: She {braked} hard as the traffic light turned red.
e.zh: 红灯亮起时她狠狠踩了刹车。

e.en: The {brakeman} signaled the engineer to stop the freight train.
e.zh: 刹车员示意司机让货运列车停下。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {brakeman} on the railroad.
e.zh: 他爷爷在铁路上当过刹车员。

brakes.t:
n. 刹车（复数）
v. 刹车（第三人称单数）

e.en: The mechanic said my {brakes} need replacing soon.
e.zh: 修车师傅说我的刹车片很快得换了。

e.en: She slammed on the {brakes} when a cat ran across.
e.zh: 一只猫跑过时她猛地踩下刹车。

braking.t:
n. 制动；刹车
v. 正在刹车

e.en: Sudden {braking} on icy roads can cause your car to skid.
e.zh: 在结冰的路上急刹车可能让车打滑。

e.en: The new SUV has an automatic emergency {braking} system.
e.zh: 这款新 SUV 配备了自动紧急刹车系统。

e.en: Many young women now go {braless} for comfort at home.
e.zh: 现在许多年轻女性在家不穿胸罩,图个舒服。

e.en: She wore a loose tee {braless} to the music festival.
e.zh: 她不穿胸罩,套件宽松 T 恤就去了音乐节。

e.en: My jeans got snagged on a thorny {bramble} by the path.
e.zh: 我的牛仔裤被路边带刺的荆棘勾住了。

e.en: We picked wild blackberries from the {bramble} behind the house.
e.zh: 我们从屋后的荆棘丛里摘了野黑莓。

bramhall.t: n. 布拉姆霍尔（英国地名）

e.en: My cousin moved to {Bramhall} for the good schools.
e.zh: 我表哥为了好学区搬到了布拉姆霍尔。

e.en: {Bramhall} is a leafy suburb south of Manchester.
e.zh: 布拉姆霍尔是曼彻斯特南部一个绿树成荫的郊区。

bramley.t: n. 布拉姆利（苹果品种/地名）

e.en: A classic apple pie really needs a tart {Bramley} apple.
e.zh: 经典苹果派真的需要用酸味的布兰利苹果。

e.en: She baked a crumble using fresh {Bramley} apples from the garden.
e.zh: 她用花园里新鲜的布兰利苹果烤了酥皮派。

e.en: {Brampton} is one of Canada's fastest-growing cities near Toronto.
e.zh: 布兰普顿是加拿大多伦多附近发展最快的城市之一。

e.en: My uncle commutes from {Brampton} into downtown Toronto daily.
e.zh: 我叔叔每天从布兰普顿通勤到多伦多市中心。

e.en: I sprinkle {bran} on my yogurt to add fiber.
e.zh: 我在酸奶上撒点麸皮来增加纤维。

e.en: This cereal is high in {bran} and whole grains.
e.zh: 这款麦片麸皮和全谷物含量很高。

branch.t:
n. 分支；树枝；分店
v. 分叉

e.en: The bank opened a new {branch} downtown last month.
e.zh: 那家银行上个月在市中心开了一家新分行。

e.en: A heavy {branch} fell on my car during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中一根粗树枝砸在了我的车上。

branched.t:
v. 分叉；分支（过去式）
adj. 有分支的

e.en: The river {branched} into three smaller streams near the village.
e.zh: 河流在村庄附近分成了三条小溪。

e.en: After medical school she {branched} into pediatric research.
e.zh: 医学院毕业后她转向了儿科研究领域。

branches.t:
n. 分支（复数）
v. 分叉（第三人称单数）

e.en: The bare {branches} swayed in the cold winter wind.
e.zh: 光秃的树枝在凛冽的寒风中摇晃。

e.en: The chain has over two hundred {branches} across Asia.
e.zh: 这家连锁店在亚洲有两百多家分店。

e.en: Fish use {branchial} arches to support their gills.
e.zh: 鱼类用鳃弓来支撑鳃。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed a {branchial} cleft cyst on her neck.
e.zh: 医生诊断她脖子上长了一个鳃裂囊肿。

branching.t:
n. 分支
adj. 分叉的

e.en: Always create a new {branching} strategy before starting a feature.
e.zh: 开始做新功能前要先制定分支策略。

e.en: The old oak had thick, {branching} limbs above the path.
e.zh: 那棵老橡树在小路上方伸展着粗壮的树枝。

e.en: Rio {Branco} is the capital of Acre state in Brazil.
e.zh: 里约布兰科是巴西阿克里州的首府。

e.en: Our guide {Branco} led us through the rainforest trails.
e.zh: 我们的向导布兰科带我们穿过了雨林小径。

brand.t:
n. 品牌；商标
v. 打烙印；定性为

e.en: Apple is one of the most valuable {brand} names worldwide.
e.zh: 苹果是全球最具价值的品牌之一。

e.en: She refuses to buy any {brand} that tests on animals.
e.zh: 她拒绝购买任何做动物实验的品牌。

e.en: He showed up to work in a {brand-new} Tesla.
e.zh: 他开着一辆全新的特斯拉来上班。

e.en: My phone is {brand-new} and already has a cracked screen.
e.zh: 我的手机才刚买,屏幕就已经裂了。

e.en: We ordered the salt cod {brandade} as a starter.
e.zh: 我们点了腌鳕鱼酱作为开胃菜。

e.en: This Provençal {brandade} pairs beautifully with toasted baguette.
e.zh: 这道普罗旺斯鳕鱼酱配烤法棍非常好吃。

branded.t:
adj. 有品牌的
v. 打烙印（过去式）

e.en: He was unfairly {branded} a troublemaker after the incident.
e.zh: 那次事件后他被不公正地贴上了麻烦制造者的标签。

e.en: The company sells {branded} merchandise on its official website.
e.zh: 该公司在官网出售自家品牌的周边商品。

brandenburg.t: n. 勃兰登堡（德国地名）

e.en: The {Brandenburg} Gate is one of Berlin's most iconic landmarks.
e.zh: 勃兰登堡门是柏林最具标志性的地标之一。

e.en: Bach composed his famous concertos for the margrave of {Brandenburg}.
e.zh: 巴赫为勃兰登堡侯爵创作了他著名的协奏曲。

e.en: Grandma served {brandied} cherries over vanilla ice cream.
e.zh: 奶奶把白兰地浸樱桃浇在香草冰淇淋上。

e.en: The fruitcake is soaked in {brandied} syrup for weeks.
e.zh: 这个水果蛋糕要在白兰地糖浆里浸泡数周。

e.en: Strong {branding} helped the startup stand out in a crowded market.
e.zh: 强大的品牌形象帮这家初创公司在拥挤的市场中脱颖而出。

e.en: Cattle ranchers used hot irons for {branding} their herds.
e.zh: 牧场主用烧红的烙铁给牛群打烙印。

e.en: Don't {brandish} a knife around children, even as a joke.
e.zh: 别在孩子面前挥舞刀子,就算是开玩笑也不行。

e.en: Politicians often {brandish} statistics to support weak arguments.
e.zh: 政客们常常拿统计数据来支撑站不住脚的论点。

e.en: The robber {brandished} a pistol and demanded the cash.
e.zh: 劫匪挥舞着手枪,要他们交出现金。

e.en: She {brandished} the trophy proudly above her head.
e.zh: 她得意洋洋地把奖杯举过头顶挥舞。

brandishes.t: v. 挥舞（第三人称单数）

e.en: The villain {brandishes} a sword in every fight scene.
e.zh: 反派在每场打戏里都会挥舞着剑。

e.en: He {brandishes} his Harvard degree whenever someone questions him.
e.zh: 一有人质疑他,他就把哈佛学位拿出来炫耀。

e.en: A man was arrested for {brandishing} a weapon in public.
e.zh: 一名男子因在公共场所挥舞武器而被捕。

e.en: The protester walked in {brandishing} a homemade sign.
e.zh: 那位抗议者挥舞着自制的标语牌走了进来。

brando.t: n. 白兰度（姓氏，如马龙·白兰度）

e.en: Marlon {Brando} delivered an unforgettable performance in The Godfather.
e.zh: 马龙·白兰度在《教父》中奉献了令人难忘的表演。

e.en: Many actors still cite {Brando} as their greatest influence.
e.zh: 许多演员至今仍把白兰度视作对他们影响最大的人。

brands.t:
n. 品牌（复数）
v. 打烙印（第三人称单数）

e.en: Luxury {brands} are tightening their China pricing strategies.
e.zh: 奢侈品牌正在收紧在中国的定价策略。

e.en: I trust certain skincare {brands} more than others.
e.zh: 对某些护肤品牌我比对其他的更信任。

e.en: He poured himself a small glass of {brandy} after dinner.
e.zh: 他晚饭后给自己倒了一小杯白兰地。

e.en: This sauce gets its rich flavor from a splash of {brandy}.
e.zh: 这款酱汁靠一点白兰地获得了浓郁的风味。

brane.t: n. 膜（弦论中的多维膜）

e.en: String theorists describe our universe as a {brane} in higher dimensions.
e.zh: 弦论学家把我们的宇宙描述为高维空间中的一张膜。

e.en: The model proposes that gravity leaks off our {brane}.
e.zh: 该模型提出引力会从我们所在的膜上泄漏出去。

branson.t: n. 布兰森（姓氏，如理查德·布兰森）

e.en: Richard {Branson} built Virgin into a global empire.
e.zh: 理查德·布兰森把维珍打造成了一个全球帝国。

e.en: We took the kids to {Branson} for a country music weekend.
e.zh: 我们带孩子去布兰森过了一个乡村音乐周末。

branston.t: n. 布兰斯顿（英国泡菜品牌）

e.en: A cheddar sandwich isn't complete without some {Branston} pickle.
e.zh: 切达三明治不夹点布兰斯顿酱菜就不完整。

e.en: He always keeps a jar of {Branston} in the fridge.
e.zh: 他冰箱里总是放着一罐布兰斯顿酱菜。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a flock of {brant} along the coastal marsh.
e.zh: 观鸟者在海边沼泽看到了一群黑雁。

e.en: The {brant} migrates thousands of miles to its breeding grounds.
e.zh: 黑雁会飞行数千英里到达繁殖地。

e.en: Georges {Braque} co-founded Cubism alongside Pablo Picasso.
e.zh: 乔治·布拉克与毕加索一同创立了立体主义。

e.en: The museum acquired a rare still life by {Braque}.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏了一幅罕见的布拉克静物画。

e.en: Most {bras} in this drawer no longer fit me properly.
e.zh: 这个抽屉里大部分胸罩我穿都不合适了。

e.en: The shop sells comfortable wireless {bras} for everyday wear.
e.zh: 这家店卖适合日常穿着的舒适无钢圈胸罩。

brash.t: adj. 鲁莽的；自以为是的

e.en: The new manager came across as a bit too {brash}.
e.zh: 新经理给人的感觉有点太张扬了。

e.en: His {brash} comments cost him several long-term clients.
e.zh: 他口无遮拦的言论让他失去了好几个长期客户。

e.en: He {brashly} interrupted the CEO during her keynote speech.
e.zh: 他鲁莽地在 CEO 演讲时打断了她。

e.en: She {brashly} declared she could finish the project alone.
e.zh: 她冒失地宣称自己一个人就能完成项目。

e.en: His {brashness} in meetings makes colleagues uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他在会议上的鲁莽让同事们感到不自在。

e.en: The startup founder's {brashness} actually impressed the investors.
e.zh: 这位创始人的张扬反而打动了投资人。

brasil.t: n. 巴西（Brazil 的葡语拼写）

e.en: {Brasil} is famous for its football, samba, and Carnival.
e.zh: 巴西以足球、桑巴和狂欢节闻名于世。

e.en: We're flying to {Brasil} for the Rio Carnival next year.
e.zh: 明年我们要飞去巴西参加里约狂欢节。

brasilia.t: n. 巴西利亚（巴西首都）

e.en: {Brasilia} became the capital of Brazil in 1960.
e.zh: 巴西利亚于 1960 年成为巴西首都。

e.en: Niemeyer's modernist buildings define the skyline of {Brasilia}.
e.zh: 尼迈耶的现代主义建筑定义了巴西利亚的天际线。

brasov.t: n. 布拉索夫（罗马尼亚城市）

e.en: {Brasov} is a charming medieval city in Transylvania.
e.zh: 布拉索夫是特兰西瓦尼亚一座迷人的中世纪城市。

e.en: We hiked the mountains surrounding {Brasov} all weekend.
e.zh: 我们整个周末都在布拉索夫周围的山里徒步。

e.en: I was impressed by the {breadth} of his knowledge.
e.zh: 他知识面之广让我印象深刻。

e.en: The course covers an enormous {breadth} of topics.
e.zh: 这门课程涵盖的话题范围非常广。

e.en: After the layoffs, she became the family {breadwinner}.
e.zh: 裁员之后,她成了家里的顶梁柱。

e.en: He felt pressure as the sole {breadwinner} at home.
e.zh: 作为家里唯一的经济支柱,他倍感压力。

breadwinners.t: n. 养家糊口的人（复数）

e.en: Both parents are the {breadwinners} in our family.
e.zh: 我们家父母两人都是养家糊口的人。

e.en: Many {breadwinners} lost their jobs during the recession.
e.zh: 许多家庭顶梁柱在经济衰退中失去了工作。

break.t:
v. 打破；弄坏
n. 休息；间断

e.en: Let's take a short {break} before the next meeting.
e.zh: 我们在下次会议前先休息一会儿吧。

e.en: Be careful not to {break} the glass vase.
e.zh: 小心别把玻璃花瓶打碎了。

e.en: Please pack the {breakable} items with extra padding.
e.zh: 请用额外的填充物包装易碎物品。

e.en: This toy is sturdy and not easily {breakable}.
e.zh: 这个玩具很结实,不容易摔坏。

e.en: The shipping company covers any {breakage} during transit.
e.zh: 运输公司负责赔偿运输途中的任何破损。

e.en: Careful handling reduces {breakage} in the warehouse.
e.zh: 小心搬运能减少仓库里的物品破损。

breakaway.t:
n. 脱离；分裂
adj. 脱离的

e.en: The {breakaway} group formed its own political party.
e.zh: 分裂出来的小组成立了自己的政党。

e.en: He scored on a fast {breakaway} down the field.
e.zh: 他在场上一次快速突破中得了分。

breakdown.t:
n. 故障；崩溃
n. 分类明细

e.en: The car had a {breakdown} on the highway last night.
e.zh: 昨晚那辆车在高速公路上抛锚了。

e.en: She gave a detailed {breakdown} of the project costs.
e.zh: 她详细分解说明了项目的各项费用。

e.en: Frequent {breakdowns} forced the factory to upgrade equipment.
e.zh: 频繁的故障迫使工厂更新设备。

e.en: The report includes monthly {breakdowns} of expenses.
e.zh: 报告中包含每月开支的详细分类。

breaker.t:
n. 断路器
n. 碎浪

e.en: Flip the circuit {breaker} to restore power to the kitchen.
e.zh: 合上断路器就能恢复厨房的电源。

e.en: Surfers waited eagerly for the next big {breaker}.
e.zh: 冲浪者们急切地等待下一个大浪。

breakfast.t:
n. 早餐
v. 吃早餐

e.en: I usually have oatmeal and coffee for {breakfast}.
e.zh: 我早餐通常吃燕麦粥配咖啡。

e.en: The hotel serves a free {breakfast} every morning.
e.zh: 酒店每天早上提供免费早餐。

e.en: Hearty {breakfasts} help me focus throughout the morning.
e.zh: 丰盛的早餐能让我整个上午都很专注。

e.en: This café offers vegan {breakfasts} on weekends.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆周末供应纯素早餐。

e.en: Grandma displays her china in the antique {breakfront}.
e.zh: 奶奶把瓷器陈列在那座古董分段式柜子里。

e.en: The mahogany {breakfront} dominates the dining room.
e.zh: 那座红木分段柜在餐厅里十分显眼。

breaking.t:
n. 破坏；中断
adj. 最新的（新闻）

e.en: {Breaking} news about the election just came in.
e.zh: 刚刚收到关于选举的突发新闻。

e.en: He kept {breaking} promises until no one trusted him.
e.zh: 他一再食言,直到没人再相信他。

e.en: The startup grew at a {breakneck} pace last year.
e.zh: 这家初创公司去年以惊人的速度增长。

e.en: She drove at {breakneck} speed to catch the flight.
e.zh: 她开得飞快,只为赶上那班飞机。

breakout.t:
n. 突围；爆发
n. 分组讨论

e.en: The film became a {breakout} hit with young audiences.
e.zh: 这部电影在年轻观众中一炮而红。

e.en: Police prevented a prison {breakout} late last night.
e.zh: 警察昨晚深夜阻止了一起越狱事件。

e.en: Set a {breakpoint} on line 42 to inspect the variable.
e.zh: 在第42行设个断点来查看那个变量。

e.en: The debugger paused at the first {breakpoint}.
e.zh: 调试器在第一个断点处暂停了。

breaks.t:
n. 休息；间断（复数）
v. 打破

e.en: Frequent short {breaks} help maintain focus at work.
e.zh: 频繁的短暂休息有助于保持工作专注力。

e.en: He never {breaks} his daily exercise routine.
e.zh: 他从不打破每天锻炼的习惯。

e.en: Scientists announced a {breakthrough} in cancer treatment.
e.zh: 科学家宣布在癌症治疗上取得重大突破。

e.en: Therapy helped her achieve an emotional {breakthrough}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她在情感上取得了突破。

breakthroughs.t: n. 突破；重大进展（复数）

e.en: Recent AI {breakthroughs} have reshaped the tech industry.
e.zh: 最近人工智能的突破重塑了科技行业。

e.en: The lab celebrated several {breakthroughs} this year.
e.zh: 实验室今年庆祝了好几项重大突破。

e.en: She wrote a song about her painful {breakup}.
e.zh: 她写了一首歌讲述自己痛苦的分手经历。

e.en: The {breakup} of the company surprised investors.
e.zh: 公司解体让投资者大感意外。

e.en: Most {breakups} feel devastating at first but heal with time.
e.zh: 大多数分手起初令人心碎,但时间会抚平。

e.en: Celebrity {breakups} often dominate tabloid headlines.
e.zh: 名人分手经常霸占小报头条。

e.en: The harbor's {breakwater} protects boats from rough waves.
e.zh: 港口的防波堤保护船只免受巨浪冲击。

e.en: Seagulls perched along the concrete {breakwater}.
e.zh: 海鸥停栖在混凝土防波堤上。

e.en: He caught a large {bream} in the lake yesterday.
e.zh: 他昨天在湖里钓到一条大鲷鱼。

e.en: The chef grilled fresh {bream} with lemon and herbs.
e.zh: 厨师用柠檬和香草烤了新鲜的鲷鱼。

e.en: She ordered grilled chicken {breast} with vegetables.
e.zh: 她点了烤鸡胸肉配蔬菜。

e.en: He felt a sharp pain in his {breast} and called the doctor.
e.zh: 他胸口一阵剧痛,赶紧打电话给医生。

e.en: The doctor pressed gently on his {breastbone} during the exam.
e.zh: 医生检查时轻按他的胸骨。

e.en: A cracked {breastbone} can take months to heal completely.
e.zh: 胸骨骨裂可能需要几个月才能完全愈合。

e.en: He wore a double-{breasted} navy suit to the wedding.
e.zh: 他穿着双排扣海军蓝西装去参加婚礼。

e.en: The red-{breasted} robin sang outside our window.
e.zh: 那只红胸知更鸟在我们窗外鸣叫。

e.en: New mothers are encouraged to {breastfeed} when possible.
e.zh: 建议新妈妈尽可能进行母乳喂养。

e.en: She chose to {breastfeed} her baby for six months.
e.zh: 她选择对宝宝进行六个月的母乳喂养。

e.en: {Breastfeeding} provides important nutrients for newborns.
e.zh: 母乳喂养为新生儿提供重要的营养。

e.en: The café offers a private {breastfeeding} area for moms.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆为妈妈们提供私人哺乳区。

e.en: The knight's polished {breastplate} gleamed in the sunlight.
e.zh: 骑士光亮的胸甲在阳光下闪闪发光。

e.en: Museum visitors admired the ancient bronze {breastplate}.
e.zh: 博物馆参观者赞叹那件古老的青铜胸甲。

e.en: She bought new bras to better support her {breasts}.
e.zh: 她买了新的胸罩来更好地支撑乳房。

e.en: He cooked two chicken {breasts} for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 他今晚做了两块鸡胸肉当晚餐。

e.en: She won gold in the 100-meter {breaststroke} final.
e.zh: 她在100米蛙泳决赛中夺得金牌。

e.en: My coach taught me proper {breaststroke} technique.
e.zh: 我的教练教我正确的蛙泳技术。

breastwork.t: n. 胸墙（低矮防御工事）

e.en: Soldiers built a hasty {breastwork} from logs and earth.
e.zh: 士兵们用原木和泥土匆忙筑起胸墙。

e.en: The fort's stone {breastwork} still stands today.
e.zh: 那座堡垒的石砌胸墙至今仍然屹立。

e.en: Take a deep {breath} before answering the question.
e.zh: 回答问题前先深吸一口气。

e.en: The mountain view took my {breath} away.
e.zh: 山景美得让我屏住了呼吸。

e.en: This shirt is made from a lightweight, {breathable} fabric.
e.zh: 这件衬衫由轻盈透气的面料制成。

e.en: Cities are working hard to keep the air {breathable}.
e.zh: 各城市正努力保持空气清新可吸。

e.en: Officers can {breathalyse} drivers suspected of drinking.
e.zh: 警察可以对涉嫌饮酒的司机进行酒精测试。

e.en: Police stopped the car to {breathalyse} the driver.
e.zh: 警察拦下车辆对司机进行酒测。

e.en: The driver failed the {breathalyser} test at the checkpoint.
e.zh: 司机在检查站的酒精测试中没有通过。

e.en: Police carry a portable {breathalyser} during traffic stops.
e.zh: 警察在交通拦检时随身携带便携式酒测仪。

e.en: He blew into the {breathalyzer} and recorded a low reading.
e.zh: 他对着酒测仪吹气,显示读数较低。

e.en: Modern {breathalyzer} devices give nearly instant results.
e.zh: 现代酒测仪几乎能立即给出结果。

e.en: Try to {breathe} slowly when you feel anxious.
e.zh: 感到焦虑时,试着慢慢呼吸。

e.en: It's hard to {breathe} at high altitudes.
e.zh: 在高海拔地区呼吸会很困难。

e.en: She {breathed} a sigh of relief after the exam ended.
e.zh: 考试结束后她松了一口气。

e.en: He {breathed} new life into the struggling company.
e.zh: 他为这家陷入困境的公司注入了新活力。

breather.t:
n. 短暂休息
n. 通气口

e.en: Let's take a {breather} before tackling the next chapter.
e.zh: 我们先歇口气,再来攻读下一章吧。

e.en: The hike was tough, so we needed a {breather}.
e.zh: 那段徒步很辛苦,我们需要喘口气。

breathes.t: v. 呼吸（第三人称单数）

e.en: This jacket {breathes} well during long runs.
e.zh: 这件外套在长跑时透气性很好。

e.en: He hardly {breathes} when he's concentrating intensely.
e.zh: 他高度专注时几乎都不呼吸。

breathing.t:
n. 呼吸
adj. 活着的

e.en: Deep {breathing} exercises help reduce stress and anxiety.
e.zh: 深呼吸练习有助于减轻压力和焦虑。

e.en: I could hear him {breathing} heavily after the climb.
e.zh: 我能听到他爬完后沉重的呼吸声。

e.en: The yoga teacher guided us through several {breathings}.
e.zh: 瑜伽老师带我们做了几种呼吸练习。

e.en: Greek words use rough or smooth {breathings} as marks.
e.zh: 希腊文用粗气符或柔气符作为标记。

breathless.t: adj. 上气不接下气的；屏息的

e.en: She was {breathless} after running up six flights of stairs.
e.zh: 她爬完六层楼梯后上气不接下气。

e.en: The audience watched in {breathless} suspense.
e.zh: 观众屏息凝神地观看着,紧张万分。

breathlessly.t: adv. 气喘吁吁地；屏息地

e.en: He {breathlessly} described what he had just witnessed.
e.zh: 他气喘吁吁地描述刚刚目睹的一切。

e.en: Fans waited {breathlessly} for the album release.
e.zh: 粉丝们屏息等待着专辑的发行。

e.en: Sudden {breathlessness} can be a sign of asthma.
e.zh: 突然的呼吸急促可能是哮喘的征兆。

e.en: She felt a {breathlessness} as she reached the summit.
e.zh: 她登上山顶时感到一阵气喘。

e.en: Take three slow {breaths} to calm your nerves.
e.zh: 慢慢深呼吸三次来平复情绪。

e.en: His final {breaths} were peaceful and quiet.
e.zh: 他最后的几口气平静而安详。

breathtaking.t: adj. 令人惊叹的；壮观的

e.en: The view from the cliff was absolutely {breathtaking}.
e.zh: 从悬崖上看到的景色简直令人惊叹。

e.en: She gave a {breathtaking} performance at the concert.
e.zh: 她在音乐会上的演出令人叹为观止。

e.en: The sunset over the ocean was {breathtakingly} beautiful.
e.zh: 海上的日落美得令人窒息。

e.en: His new novel is {breathtakingly} original and bold.
e.zh: 他的新小说原创性十足,大胆得令人惊叹。

e.en: The singer has a soft, {breathy} voice that listeners love.
e.zh: 这位歌手有着听众喜爱的柔软气声嗓音。

e.en: She gave a {breathy} laugh at his silly joke.
e.zh: 她对他的傻笑话发出气音般的轻笑。

e.en: Geologists identified the rock as a volcanic {breccia}.
e.zh: 地质学家鉴定这块岩石为火山角砾岩。

e.en: The countertop is made from polished red {breccia}.
e.zh: 这台面是用抛光的红色角砾岩制成的。

brecht.t: n. 布莱希特（德国剧作家）

e.en: Bertolt {Brecht} revolutionized modern theater with his epic style.
e.zh: 贝托尔特·布莱希特用史诗剧风格革新了现代戏剧。

e.en: We studied {Brecht} in our drama class last semester.
e.zh: 上学期我们在戏剧课上学习了布莱希特。

e.en: The play uses {Brechtian} techniques to break the fourth wall.
e.zh: 这部戏运用布莱希特式手法打破第四堵墙。

e.en: Her direction has a clearly {Brechtian} feel throughout.
e.zh: 她的导演风格自始至终都有明显的布莱希特味道。

e.en: We spent a week skiing in {Breckenridge} last winter.
e.zh: 去年冬天我们在布雷肯里奇滑了一周雪。

e.en: {Breckenridge} is famous for its high-altitude ski resort.
e.zh: 布雷肯里奇以其高海拔滑雪胜地而闻名。

e.en: We hiked across the {Brecon} Beacons last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们徒步穿越了布雷肯比肯斯山区。

e.en: The town of {Brecon} sits in southern Wales.
e.zh: 布雷肯镇位于威尔士南部。

bred.t:
v. breed 的过去式/过去分词
adj. 养育出的

e.en: This dog was {bred} for hunting in cold climates.
e.zh: 这种狗是为在寒冷地区狩猎而培育的。

e.en: He was born and {bred} in a small fishing village.
e.zh: 他在一个小渔村出生长大。

e.en: The city of {Breda} hosts a famous jazz festival yearly.
e.zh: 布雷达市每年举办著名的爵士音乐节。

e.en: We took a train from Amsterdam to {Breda} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们从阿姆斯特丹坐火车去了布雷达。

e.en: The view from {Bredon} Hill stretches across three counties.
e.zh: 从布雷登山上望去,景色横跨三个郡。

e.en: We walked up {Bredon} on a clear autumn morning.
e.zh: 在一个秋高气爽的早晨我们登上了布雷登。

e.en: The baby was in {breech} position before delivery.
e.zh: 宝宝在分娩前是臀位。

e.en: He cleaned the {breech} of the rifle carefully.
e.zh: 他仔细地清洁了步枪的枪膛。

e.en: The warrior wore a simple deerskin {breechcloth}.
e.zh: 那位战士穿着一条简单的鹿皮兜裆布。

e.en: Museum displays included a beaded ceremonial {breechcloth}.
e.zh: 博物馆展品中有一条串珠的礼仪兜裆布。

breed.t:
v. 繁殖；培育
n. 品种

e.en: Labradors are a friendly {breed} popular with families.
e.zh: 拉布拉多是深受家庭喜爱的温顺犬种。

e.en: Stagnant water can {breed} mosquitoes very quickly.
e.zh: 死水会很快滋生蚊子。

e.en: We bought our puppy from a reputable local {breeder}.
e.zh: 我们从当地一位信誉良好的繁育者那里买了小狗。

e.en: The {breeder} specializes in rare orchid varieties.
e.zh: 这位育种者专门培育稀有兰花品种。

e.en: Selective {breeding} has produced many new apple varieties.
e.zh: 选择性育种培育出了许多新的苹果品种。

e.en: Poor sanitation is a {breeding} ground for disease.
e.zh: 卫生条件差是疾病滋生的温床。

e.en: The farm recorded all its cattle {breedings} in a logbook.
e.zh: 农场把所有牛的配种记录都写在日志里。

e.en: Successful {breedings} this season produced healthy calves.
e.zh: 本季成功的配种产下了健康的小牛。

breeds.t:
n. 品种（复数）
v. 繁殖（第三人称单数）

e.en: There are hundreds of dog {breeds} recognized worldwide.
e.zh: 全世界公认的狗品种有数百种。

e.en: Familiarity sometimes {breeds} contempt in close relationships.
e.zh: 亲密关系中,熟悉有时会滋生轻视。

breeze.t:
n. 微风
v. 轻松通过

e.en: A cool {breeze} drifted in through the open window.
e.zh: 一阵凉爽的微风从开着的窗户飘进来。

e.en: The math test was a {breeze} for her.
e.zh: 那次数学考试对她来说轻而易举。

e.en: Gentle ocean {breezes} kept the beach pleasantly cool.
e.zh: 轻柔的海风让沙滩保持着宜人的凉爽。

e.en: She always {breezes} through her morning workout.
e.zh: 她总是轻松地完成晨练。

e.en: They added a covered {breezeway} between the house and garage.
e.zh: 他们在房子和车库之间加建了一条有顶的连廊。

e.en: We hung wind chimes along the {breezeway}.
e.zh: 我们沿着连廊挂上了风铃。

e.en: She {breezily} dismissed the criticism and kept smiling.
e.zh: 她轻松地把批评一笑置之。

e.en: He answered the tough questions {breezily}, without hesitation.
e.zh: 他毫不犹豫地轻松回答了那些棘手的问题。

breezy.t: adj. 有微风的；轻松活泼的

e.en: It was a {breezy} afternoon, perfect for flying kites.
e.zh: 那是个微风习习的下午,正适合放风筝。

e.en: Her writing has a {breezy}, conversational tone.
e.zh: 她的文笔轻松流畅,口语化十足。

e.en: We visited the famous town musicians statue in {Bremen}.
e.zh: 我们参观了不来梅著名的城市音乐家雕像。

e.en: {Bremen} is one of Germany's oldest port cities.
e.zh: 不来梅是德国最古老的港口城市之一。

e.en: Soldiers carried the {Bren} gun throughout the war.
e.zh: 整个战争期间士兵们都使用布伦轻机枪。

e.en: The museum displays a restored {Bren} from 1942.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一挺修复后的1942年布伦机枪。

brent.t: n. 布伦特（人名/原油品种）

e.en: {Brent} crude prices rose sharply this morning.
e.zh: 今早布伦特原油价格大幅上涨。

e.en: Flocks of {Brent} geese arrive on the coast each winter.
e.zh: 每年冬天成群的黑雁都会飞到海岸。

brentford.t: n. 布伦特福德（伦敦地名）

e.en: {Brentford} won their match against Arsenal last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末布伦特福德队战胜了阿森纳。

e.en: We took the train to {Brentford} for the football game.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去布伦特福德看足球比赛。

e.en: Many celebrities live in the {Brentwood} neighborhood of Los Angeles.
e.zh: 许多名人都住在洛杉矶的布伦特伍德社区。

e.en: Real estate prices in {Brentwood} have climbed steadily.
e.zh: 布伦特伍德的房价一直在稳步上涨。

brescia.t: n. 布雷西亚（意大利城市）

e.en: {Brescia} is known for its Roman ruins and medieval squares.
e.zh: 布雷西亚以其罗马遗迹和中世纪广场而闻名。

e.en: We drove from Milan to {Brescia} in under an hour.
e.zh: 我们从米兰开车到布雷西亚不到一小时。

brest.t: n. 布雷斯特（法国/白俄城市）

e.en: The naval base at {Brest} has strategic importance for France.
e.zh: 布雷斯特海军基地对法国具有战略重要性。

e.en: Ferries depart {Brest} for the nearby Atlantic islands.
e.zh: 渡轮从布雷斯特出发开往附近的大西洋岛屿。

bretagne.t: n. 布列塔尼（法国地区）

e.en: We rented a cottage in {Bretagne} for our summer holiday.
e.zh: 我们在布列塔尼租了一间小屋度暑假。

e.en: {Bretagne} is famous for its rugged coastline and crepes.
e.zh: 布列塔尼以其崎岖的海岸线和可丽饼闻名。

breton.t:
n. 布列塔尼人/语
adj. 布列塔尼的

e.en: She speaks fluent {Breton} as well as French.
e.zh: 她法语和布列塔尼语都说得很流利。

e.en: The {Breton} fisherman mended his nets by the harbor.
e.zh: 那位布列塔尼渔夫在港口边补着渔网。

e.en: The museum acquired a rare {Breughel} landscape painting.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏了一幅罕见的勃鲁盖尔风景画。

e.en: {Breughel} captured peasant life with remarkable detail.
e.zh: 勃鲁盖尔以惊人的细节描绘了农民的生活。

e.en: He received a {brevet} promotion to colonel during wartime.
e.zh: 他在战时获得了名誉晋升为上校。

e.en: The officer wore his {brevet} rank with pride.
e.zh: 那位军官自豪地佩戴着他的名誉军衔。

breviary.t: n. 天主教每日祈祷书

e.en: The priest read prayers from his worn leather {breviary}.
e.zh: 神父从他磨损的皮面祈祷书中诵读祷文。

e.en: Each monk carried a small {breviary} throughout the day.
e.zh: 每位修士整天都随身带着一本小型日课经书。

e.en: The speaker's {brevities} were appreciated by the tired audience.
e.zh: 演讲者的简短发言深受疲惫听众的欢迎。

e.en: His emails are known for their crisp {brevities}.
e.zh: 他的邮件以简洁明快著称。

e.en: For the sake of {brevity}, I'll skip the background details.
e.zh: 为了简洁起见,我将跳过背景细节。

e.en: Good writing values clarity and {brevity} above all.
e.zh: 好的写作首先看重清晰和简洁。

brew.t:
v. 酿造；泡（茶/咖啡）
n. 酿造的饮品

e.en: I {brew} a fresh pot of coffee every morning.
e.zh: 我每天早上都煮一壶新鲜咖啡。

e.en: A storm seemed to be {brewing} on the horizon.
e.zh: 地平线上似乎正在酝酿一场暴风雨。

e.en: The local {brewer} won an award for his stout.
e.zh: 当地的酿酒师凭借他的世涛啤酒获了奖。

e.en: She trained as a {brewer} after leaving her office job.
e.zh: 她离开办公室工作后接受了酿酒师培训。

e.en: Portland is home to dozens of craft {breweries}.
e.zh: 波特兰拥有数十家精酿啤酒厂。

e.en: Many old {breweries} have been converted into apartments.
e.zh: 许多老啤酒厂已被改造成公寓。

e.en: We took a tour of the local {brewery} on Saturday.
e.zh: 周六我们参观了当地的啤酒厂。

e.en: The {brewery} releases a new seasonal beer each fall.
e.zh: 这家啤酒厂每年秋天都会推出一款新的季节限定啤酒。

brewing.t:
n. 酿造（啤酒等）
v. 酝酿；冲泡

e.en: The smell of fresh {brewing} coffee filled the kitchen.
e.zh: 刚煮的咖啡香味弥漫了整个厨房。

e.en: Trouble has been {brewing} between the two departments.
e.zh: 两个部门之间一直在酝酿矛盾。

e.en: The {brewmaster} explained how each beer was crafted.
e.zh: 酿酒大师讲解了每款啤酒的酿造工艺。

e.en: She trained for years to become a certified {brewmaster}.
e.zh: 她经过多年训练才成为认证酿酒大师。

e.en: We met some friends at the new {brewpub} downtown.
e.zh: 我们和朋友们在市中心新开的精酿酒吧见面。

e.en: Their {brewpub} serves both food and house-made beer.
e.zh: 他们的精酿酒馆既供应食物也卖自酿啤酒。

brewster.t: n. 布鲁斯特（人名/姓氏）

e.en: The town of {Brewster} sits on Cape Cod's bayside.
e.zh: 布鲁斯特镇位于科德角的海湾一侧。

e.en: David {Brewster} invented the kaleidoscope in 1816.
e.zh: 戴维·布鲁斯特于1816年发明了万花筒。

brezhnev.t: n. 勃列日涅夫（苏联领导人）

e.en: {Brezhnev} led the Soviet Union for nearly two decades.
e.zh: 勃列日涅夫领导苏联近二十年。

e.en: Historians still debate the legacy of the {Brezhnev} era.
e.zh: 历史学家们仍在争论勃列日涅夫时代的遗产。

briar.t:
n. 欧石南；带刺灌木
n. 石南根烟斗

e.en: His pipe was carved from a beautiful piece of {briar}.
e.zh: 他的烟斗是用一块漂亮的石楠木雕成的。

e.en: Thorny {briar} bushes covered the abandoned garden.
e.zh: 带刺的荆棘丛盖满了那座荒废的花园。

bribe.t:
v. 贿赂；收买
n. 贿赂物

e.en: The official refused to accept the {bribe} offered to him.
e.zh: 那位官员拒绝接受向他行贿的钱。

e.en: Parents sometimes {bribe} kids with candy to behave.
e.zh: 家长有时用糖果哄孩子听话。

e.en: The witness admitted he had been {bribed} to lie.
e.zh: 那名证人承认自己被收买说了谎。

e.en: She {bribed} her toddler with a cookie to leave the park.
e.zh: 她用一块饼干哄她的小孩离开公园。

briberies.t: n. 贿赂行为（bribery 复数）

e.en: A series of {briberies} brought down the entire administration.
e.zh: 一连串的贿赂事件使整个政府垮台。

e.en: Investigators uncovered multiple {briberies} within the agency.
e.zh: 调查人员揭露了该机构内的多起贿赂案。

e.en: Two officials were arrested on charges of {bribery}.
e.zh: 两名官员因贿赂指控被捕。

e.en: The company has strict policies against {bribery} and corruption.
e.zh: 公司有严格的反贿赂和反腐败政策。

e.en: The judge accepted {bribes} in exchange for lighter sentences.
e.zh: 那位法官收受贿赂以换取从轻判决。

e.en: She {bribes} her cat with treats to take medicine.
e.zh: 她用零食哄她的猫吃药。

e.en: He was caught {bribing} a customs officer at the border.
e.zh: 他在边境贿赂海关官员时被抓获。

e.en: {Bribing} children rarely produces lasting good behavior.
e.zh: 贿赂孩子很少能换来持久的好表现。

brick.t:
n. 砖块
v. 用砖砌

e.en: The old factory was built of solid red {brick}.
e.zh: 那座老工厂是用结实的红砖建成的。

e.en: A faulty update {bricked} my phone overnight.
e.zh: 一次故障更新让我的手机一夜之间变砖了。

e.en: The critic hurled a sharp {brickbat} at the new film.
e.zh: 那位评论家对新电影抛出尖锐的批评。

e.en: Protesters threw a {brickbat} through the office window.
e.zh: 抗议者将一块碎砖砸穿了办公室窗户。

e.en: My uncle worked as a {brickie} for thirty years.
e.zh: 我叔叔做了三十年的砌砖工。

e.en: The {brickie} finished the garden wall in two days.
e.zh: 那位砌砖工两天就完成了花园围墙。

e.en: The {bricklayer} carefully aligned each row of the wall.
e.zh: 砌砖工仔细对齐墙的每一排砖。

e.en: He trained as a {bricklayer} after leaving school.
e.zh: 他离校后接受了砌砖工的培训。

e.en: She took a course in {bricklaying} last summer.
e.zh: 她去年夏天上了一门砌砖课程。

e.en: {Bricklaying} requires patience and a steady hand.
e.zh: 砌砖工作需要耐心和稳定的手。

e.en: The wall is built from red {bricks} and mortar.
e.zh: 这堵墙是用红砖和砂浆砌成的。

e.en: Children stacked colorful {bricks} into a tall tower.
e.zh: 孩子们把彩色积木堆成高塔。

e.en: The Victorian {brickwork} on the facade is beautifully preserved.
e.zh: 立面上维多利亚式的砖砌结构保存得很好。

e.en: Rain damage cracked the {brickwork} above the doorway.
e.zh: 雨水侵蚀使门口上方的砖墙出现裂缝。

e.en: His grandfather owned a small {brickyard} near the river.
e.zh: 他祖父在河边经营一家小砖厂。

e.en: Trucks loaded clay at the {brickyard} every morning.
e.zh: 卡车每天早上在砖厂装载黏土。

bricolage.t: n. 就地取材的拼装创作

e.en: Her art is a clever {bricolage} of found objects.
e.zh: 她的艺术是用拾得物巧妙拼凑而成。

e.en: The film is a {bricolage} of styles and references.
e.zh: 这部电影是各种风格与引用的拼贴。

bricoleur.t: n. 就地取材的创作者

e.en: The designer is a true {bricoleur}, repurposing scrap into furniture.
e.zh: 这位设计师是真正的拼装家,把废料变成家具。

e.en: As a {bricoleur}, she builds projects from whatever is at hand.
e.zh: 作为拼凑创作者,她用手边的材料制作作品。

e.en: She tried on three dresses at the {bridal} shop.
e.zh: 她在婚纱店试穿了三件礼服。

e.en: The {bridal} party gathered for photos before the ceremony.
e.zh: 婚礼一行人在仪式前聚集拍照。

e.en: The {bride} walked slowly down the flower-lined aisle.
e.zh: 新娘沿着鲜花铺成的过道缓缓走来。

e.en: Every guest stood as the {bride} entered the church.
e.zh: 新娘进入教堂时所有宾客都起立。

e.en: The {bridegroom} waited nervously at the altar.
e.zh: 新郎紧张地在圣坛前等候。

e.en: His father gave the {bridegroom} a heartfelt toast.
e.zh: 他父亲为新郎致了一段真挚的祝酒词。

e.en: Many {brides} choose white gowns for tradition.
e.zh: 许多新娘出于传统选择白色礼服。

e.en: The boutique caters to {brides} on tight budgets.
e.zh: 这家精品店服务于预算有限的新娘们。

e.en: Her sister will be the chief {bridesmaid} at the wedding.
e.zh: 她姐姐将担任婚礼上的首席伴娘。

e.en: Each {bridesmaid} carried a small bouquet of roses.
e.zh: 每位伴娘都捧着一小束玫瑰。

bridewell.t: n. 拘留所；感化院（旧称）

e.en: The old {bridewell} once held petty criminals in the city.
e.zh: 那座旧拘留所曾关押城里的轻罪犯。

e.en: Records show the {bridewell} was demolished in 1860.
e.zh: 记录显示那所教化院于1860年被拆除。

bridge.t:
n. 桥；桥接
v. 架桥；弥合

e.en: We crossed the wooden {bridge} over the rushing stream.
e.zh: 我们走过那座横跨急流的木桥。

e.en: Her grandparents play {bridge} every Thursday afternoon.
e.zh: 她的祖父母每周四下午都会打桥牌。

e.en: Troops secured a {bridgehead} on the eastern bank at dawn.
e.zh: 部队拂晓时在东岸建立了桥头堡。

e.en: The startup used Singapore as a {bridgehead} into Asia.
e.zh: 这家初创公司把新加坡作为进入亚洲的桥头堡。

e.en: The {bridgeman} signaled the boats to pass safely.
e.zh: 桥工示意船只安全通过。

e.en: An old {bridgeman} controlled the drawbridge by hand.
e.zh: 一位年长的桥工手动操作着那座吊桥。

bridgend.t: n. 布里真德（英国地名）

e.en: {Bridgend} is a town in south Wales near Cardiff.
e.zh: 布里真德是南威尔士靠近卡迪夫的一个城镇。

e.en: She grew up in {Bridgend} before moving to London.
e.zh: 她在布里真德长大,后来搬到了伦敦。

e.en: The city built two new {bridges} across the harbor.
e.zh: 市政府在港口上建了两座新桥。

e.en: Good diplomacy {bridges} divides between nations.
e.zh: 良好的外交能弥合国家之间的分歧。

bridgetown.t: n. 布里奇敦（巴巴多斯首都）

e.en: {Bridgetown} is the capital city of Barbados.
e.zh: 布里奇敦是巴巴多斯的首都。

e.en: Cruise ships dock daily at the port of {Bridgetown}.
e.zh: 游轮每天停靠在布里奇敦港。

bridgewater.t: n. 布里奇沃特（地名/姓氏）

e.en: {Bridgewater} is a market town in Somerset, England.
e.zh: 布里奇沃特是英格兰萨默塞特郡的一个集镇。

e.en: He works at {Bridgewater}, the famous hedge fund.
e.zh: 他在著名的对冲基金桥水公司工作。

e.en: The dentist completed her {bridgework} in two visits.
e.zh: 牙医分两次完成了她的牙桥治疗。

e.en: Modern {bridgework} can last for many years with care.
e.zh: 现代牙桥护理得当可使用很多年。

bridging.t:
n. 桥接；衔接
v. 架桥

e.en: The startup raised a {bridging} loan to cover payroll.
e.zh: 这家初创公司筹集了一笔过桥贷款来支付工资。

e.en: Translators play a key role in {bridging} cultures.
e.zh: 翻译在沟通不同文化中起着关键作用。

bridgwater.t: n. 布里奇沃特（英国地名）

e.en: {Bridgwater} hosts a famous carnival every November.
e.zh: 布里奇沃特每年十一月都会举办著名的狂欢节。

e.en: The river Parrett flows through {Bridgwater} in Somerset.
e.zh: 帕雷特河流经萨默塞特郡的布里奇沃特。

bridie.t: n. 苏格兰肉馅饼；女子名

e.en: She bought a hot {bridie} from the Scottish bakery.
e.zh: 她从那家苏格兰面包店买了一个热腾腾的肉馅饼。

e.en: A traditional {bridie} contains minced beef and onion.
e.zh: 传统的肉馅饼里包着牛肉末和洋葱。

bridle.t:
n. 马勒；约束
v. 约束；发怒

e.en: She slipped the {bridle} over the horse's head gently.
e.zh: 她轻轻地把马笼头套到马头上。

e.en: Customers often {bridle} at hidden service charges.
e.zh: 顾客常常对隐藏的服务费感到愤怒。

e.en: We rode our horses along the wooded {bridleway}.
e.zh: 我们骑马沿着林间的马道前行。

e.en: The {bridleway} is open to walkers and cyclists too.
e.zh: 这条马道也对步行者和骑车者开放。

bridlington.t: n. 布里德灵顿（英国地名）

e.en: {Bridlington} is a seaside town on the Yorkshire coast.
e.zh: 布里德灵顿是约克郡海岸边的一座海滨小镇。

e.en: We spent the weekend fishing near {Bridlington} harbor.
e.zh: 我们在布里德灵顿港附近钓鱼度过了周末。

bridport.t: n. 布里德波特（英国地名）

e.en: {Bridport} is famous for its rope-making history.
e.zh: 布里德波特以其制绳历史而闻名。

e.en: The market in {Bridport} runs every Wednesday and Saturday.
e.zh: 布里德波特的集市每周三和周六开市。

e.en: She served warm {brie} with crackers and fig jam.
e.zh: 她端上了配饼干和无花果酱的温热布里奶酪。

e.en: A wedge of {brie} pairs nicely with a crisp white wine.
e.zh: 一块布里奶酪配清爽的白葡萄酒非常合适。

brief.t:
adj. 简短的
v. 简要介绍

e.en: The meeting was unusually {brief} and productive.
e.zh: 这次会议异常简短且富有成效。

e.en: The lawyer prepared a detailed {brief} for the case.
e.zh: 律师为这个案件准备了一份详细的简报。

e.en: He locked the documents inside his leather {briefcase}.
e.zh: 他把文件锁进了皮质公文包。

e.en: She forgot her {briefcase} on the morning train.
e.zh: 她把公文包忘在了早班火车上。

briefed.t: v. 简要介绍（brief 的过去式）

e.en: The manager {briefed} the team before the client call.
e.zh: 经理在客户通话前向团队做了简要说明。

e.en: Reporters were {briefed} on the new safety measures.
e.zh: 记者们听取了关于新安全措施的简报。

briefer.t:
n. 做简报的人
adj. 更简短的

e.en: His second presentation was much {briefer} and clearer.
e.zh: 他的第二次报告更简短也更清晰。

e.en: The {briefer} answered questions from the assembled press.
e.zh: 简报员回答了在场记者的提问。

e.en: The CEO held a quick {briefing} before the launch.
e.zh: 首席执行官在发布前召开了简短的情况说明会。

e.en: Reporters attended a daily {briefing} at the White House.
e.zh: 记者们每天参加白宫的新闻简报会。

e.en: She paused {briefly} before answering the difficult question.
e.zh: 她在回答这个难题前短暂地停顿了一下。

e.en: Let me {briefly} explain how the feature works.
e.zh: 让我简要说明一下这个功能的工作方式。

briefs.t:
n. 三角内裤；摘要
v. 简要介绍

e.en: He packed several pairs of {briefs} for the trip.
e.zh: 他为这趟旅行带了好几条三角内裤。

e.en: The general reads daily intelligence {briefs} each morning.
e.zh: 将军每天早上阅读情报简报。

e.en: Thorny {brier} bushes lined the abandoned country lane.
e.zh: 带刺的野蔷薇丛排列在废弃的乡间小路两旁。

e.en: She scratched her arm on a wild {brier} in the woods.
e.zh: 她在林中被一棵野蔷薇划伤了手臂。

e.en: {Brierley} is a small village in South Yorkshire.
e.zh: 布里尔利是南约克郡的一个小村庄。

e.en: Mr. {Brierley} signed the contract on Tuesday afternoon.
e.zh: 布里尔利先生在周二下午签了合同。

e.en: Medieval royal {brieves} authorized local officials to act.
e.zh: 中世纪王室文书授权地方官员采取行动。

e.en: Old Scottish {brieves} were short legal writs from the king.
e.zh: 古老的苏格兰文书是国王颁发的简短法律令状。

brig.t: n. 双桅横帆船；军舰禁闭室

e.en: The drunken sailor spent the night in the ship's {brig}.
e.zh: 那名醉酒的水手在船上的禁闭室过了一夜。

e.en: A two-masted {brig} appeared on the horizon at dawn.
e.zh: 破晓时分,一艘双桅帆船出现在地平线上。

e.en: The fire {brigade} arrived within five minutes of the call.
e.zh: 消防队在接到电话后五分钟内赶到。

e.en: An infantry {brigade} was deployed to the border region.
e.zh: 一支步兵旅被部署到了边境地区。

e.en: The {brigadier} addressed his troops before the parade.
e.zh: 准将在阅兵前向他的部队讲话。

e.en: She was promoted to {brigadier} after twenty years of service.
e.zh: 她在服役二十年后被晋升为准将。

e.en: A masked {brigand} robbed travelers on the mountain pass.
e.zh: 一名蒙面强盗在山口抢劫旅客。

e.en: Local legends speak of a notorious {brigand} from that era.
e.zh: 当地传说中有一位那个时代臭名昭著的强盗。

e.en: The film portrays a romantic Italian {brigante} of the 1800s.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了一位浪漫的十九世纪意大利强盗。

e.en: Folk songs celebrate the legendary {brigante} of the south.
e.zh: 民歌传颂着南方那位传奇的强盗。

e.en: A swift {brigantine} sailed into the Caribbean harbor.
e.zh: 一艘快速的双桅横帆船驶入加勒比海港。

e.en: The museum displays a model {brigantine} from 1820.
e.zh: 博物馆展出一艘1820年的双桅横帆船模型。

e.en: Mr. {Briggs} teaches chemistry at the local high school.
e.zh: 布里格斯先生在当地高中教化学。

e.en: The Myers-{Briggs} test sorts people into personality types.
e.zh: 迈尔斯-布里格斯测试把人分成不同的性格类型。

e.en: {Brigham} Young University is located in Provo, Utah.
e.zh: 杨百翰大学位于犹他州的普罗沃市。

e.en: Doctors at {Brigham} Hospital pioneered the new treatment.
e.zh: 布里格姆医院的医生们率先开发了这种新疗法。

brighouse.t: n. 布里格豪斯（英国地名）

e.en: {Brighouse} is a market town in West Yorkshire, England.
e.zh: 布里格豪斯是英格兰西约克郡的一个集镇。

e.en: The famous {Brighouse} brass band has won many awards.
e.zh: 著名的布里格豪斯铜管乐队赢得过许多奖项。

e.en: The kitchen feels {bright} after we changed the bulbs.
e.zh: 换了灯泡后,厨房显得很明亮。

e.en: She is a {bright} student who learns quickly.
e.zh: 她是个聪明的学生,学得很快。

e.en: A few plants can {brighten} a dull office.
e.zh: 几盆植物就能让沉闷的办公室变得明亮。

e.en: His face began to {brighten} when he heard the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息,他的脸渐渐露出了笑容。

brightening.t: v. 变亮（brighten 的现在分词）

e.en: The sky is slowly {brightening} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,天空正慢慢放晴。

e.en: She added a filter for {brightening} the photo.
e.zh: 她加了一个滤镜来提亮照片。

brighter.t: adj. 更明亮的；更聪明的

e.en: This screen looks much {brighter} than my old one.
e.zh: 这块屏幕看起来比我旧的那块亮多了。

e.en: The future seems {brighter} now that she has a job.
e.zh: 她找到工作后,前途看起来光明多了。

brightest.t: adj. 最明亮的；最聪明的

e.en: Venus is the {brightest} planet in the night sky.
e.zh: 金星是夜空中最亮的行星。

e.en: He is one of the {brightest} engineers on the team.
e.zh: 他是团队里最聪明的工程师之一。

e.en: The streetlamps shine {brightly} on rainy nights.
e.zh: 雨夜里,路灯照得格外明亮。

e.en: She smiled {brightly} when she saw her friends.
e.zh: 看到朋友时,她灿烂地笑了。

e.en: Professor {Brightman} will give the keynote speech tomorrow.
e.zh: 布赖特曼教授明天将做主题演讲。

e.en: The novel's hero is named David {Brightman}.
e.zh: 小说的主人公叫大卫·布赖特曼。

e.en: You can adjust the screen {brightness} in settings.
e.zh: 你可以在设置里调整屏幕亮度。

e.en: The {brightness} of the morning sun woke me up.
e.zh: 清晨阳光的亮度把我唤醒了。

e.en: We took the train down to {Brighton} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去布莱顿过周末。

e.en: {Brighton} is famous for its pebble beach and pier.
e.zh: 布莱顿以鹅卵石海滩和码头闻名。

e.en: Turn off your {brights} when other cars approach.
e.zh: 有车驶来时请关掉远光灯。

e.en: The painter loves wearing bold {brights} in summer.
e.zh: 那位画家夏天爱穿鲜艳的亮色衣服。

brill.t:
n. 菱鲆（鱼类）
adj. 极好的（英俚）

e.en: That new café is absolutely {brill}, you should try it.
e.zh: 那家新咖啡馆超棒的,你该去试试。

e.en: The chef grilled a fresh {brill} with lemon butter.
e.zh: 厨师用柠檬黄油烤了一条新鲜的菱鲆。

e.en: Everyone admires the {brilliance} of her latest novel.
e.zh: 大家都赞叹她最新小说的精彩绝伦。

e.en: The diamond's {brilliance} caught the light beautifully.
e.zh: 钻石的光彩在灯光下美极了。

e.en: The painting is praised for its color {brilliancy}.
e.zh: 这幅画因色彩的鲜艳夺目而备受赞誉。

e.en: Few players match the {brilliancy} of his chess moves.
e.zh: 很少有棋手能比得上他棋路的精妙。

e.en: She came up with a {brilliant} solution to the bug.
e.zh: 她想出了一个绝妙的办法来解决这个 bug。

e.en: The fireworks were {brilliant} against the dark sky.
e.zh: 烟花在漆黑的天空中绚丽夺目。

e.en: The team performed {brilliantly} in last night's match.
e.zh: 昨晚的比赛中球队表现得非常出色。

e.en: The stage was {brilliantly} lit for the opening act.
e.zh: 舞台为开场表演被照得灯火辉煌。

brim.t:
n. 边缘；帽檐
v. 满溢

e.en: He filled the cup to the {brim} with hot coffee.
e.zh: 他把杯子倒满了热咖啡,直到杯沿。

e.en: She pulled the {brim} of her hat down low.
e.zh: 她把帽檐压得很低。

e.en: Her eyes were {brimful} of tears as she waved goodbye.
e.zh: 她挥手告别时,眼里满是泪水。

e.en: The new album is {brimful} of catchy melodies.
e.zh: 这张新专辑充满了朗朗上口的旋律。

brimmed.t: v. 装满；满溢（brim 过去式）

e.en: His eyes {brimmed} with tears at the wedding.
e.zh: 在婚礼上,他眼里盈满了泪水。

e.en: She wore a wide-{brimmed} hat to the beach.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶宽边帽去海滩。

e.en: He raised a {brimmer} of ale and toasted his friends.
e.zh: 他举起一满杯啤酒向朋友们敬酒。

e.en: The host poured each guest a generous {brimmer}.
e.zh: 主人给每位客人都倒了满满一杯。

e.en: Her inbox is {brimming} with unread messages.
e.zh: 她的收件箱里塞满了未读邮件。

e.en: The kids were {brimming} with excitement on the trip.
e.zh: 孩子们在旅途中兴奋得不得了。

brims.t:
n. 边缘（复数）
v. 满溢

e.en: The river {brims} after several days of heavy rain.
e.zh: 连下几天大雨后,河水涨到了岸边。

e.en: Wide hat {brims} are trending again this summer.
e.zh: 宽帽檐今年夏天又流行起来了。

e.en: The preacher warned of fire and {brimstone}.
e.zh: 那位传教士警告说会有烈火与硫磺之灾。

e.en: A faint smell of {brimstone} hung in the air.
e.zh: 空气中弥漫着一股淡淡的硫磺味。

e.en: Yellow {brimstones} fluttered through the spring meadow.
e.zh: 黄色的钩粉蝶在春天的草地上翩翩飞舞。

e.en: Old sermons often spoke of {brimstones} and damnation.
e.zh: 旧时的布道常常提到硫磺与诅咒。

brindisi.t: n. 布林迪西（意大利港市）

e.en: Our ferry to Greece departs from {Brindisi} tonight.
e.zh: 我们去希腊的渡轮今晚从布林迪西出发。

e.en: {Brindisi} is a port city in southern Italy.
e.zh: 布林迪西是意大利南部的一座港口城市。

brindle.t:
n. 斑纹动物
adj. 有斑纹的

e.en: Their {brindle} boxer loves chasing tennis balls.
e.zh: 他们家那只虎斑色拳师犬喜欢追网球。

e.en: The cow had a striking {brindle} coat.
e.zh: 那头牛有一身醒目的虎斑色皮毛。

e.en: A {brindled} cat curled up on the windowsill.
e.zh: 一只虎斑猫蜷缩在窗台上。

e.en: The shelter has a friendly {brindled} puppy for adoption.
e.zh: 收容所有一只友善的虎斑色小狗等待领养。

e.en: Soak the chicken in {brine} overnight for extra flavor.
e.zh: 把鸡肉在盐水里浸一夜会更入味。

e.en: Sea {brine} stung the cuts on his hands.
e.zh: 海水的咸味刺痛了他手上的伤口。

brined.t:
adj. 盐水浸泡的
v. 用盐水腌

e.en: She {brined} the turkey before roasting it.
e.zh: 她在烤火鸡之前先用盐水腌过。

e.en: {Brined} olives are a staple in Mediterranean cooking.
e.zh: 盐渍橄榄是地中海菜里的常备食材。

e.en: The river is too {broad} to swim across.
e.zh: 这条河太宽了,游不过去。

e.en: He has a {broad} knowledge of classical music.
e.zh: 他对古典音乐有广泛的了解。

e.en: She wore a {broad-brimmed} hat to the beach.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶宽边帽去了海滩。

e.en: The cowboy's {broad-brimmed} hat shielded his face from sun.
e.zh: 那位牛仔的宽边帽为他遮挡阳光。

e.en: Our village finally got fast {broadband} last month.
e.zh: 我们村上个月终于通了高速宽带。

e.en: The {broadband} connection keeps dropping during video calls.
e.zh: 视频通话时宽带连接老是掉线。

e.en: The provider offers three different {broadbands} for home users.
e.zh: 该供应商为家庭用户提供三种不同的宽带套餐。

e.en: Rural {broadbands} often run slower than advertised speeds.
e.zh: 农村地区的宽带速度通常低于宣传值。

broadcast.t:
v. 广播；播送
n. 广播节目

e.en: The match will be {broadcast} live on Saturday.
e.zh: 这场比赛将在周六现场直播。

e.en: She listened to the news {broadcast} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都听新闻广播。

e.en: The veteran {broadcaster} retired after forty years on air.
e.zh: 那位资深主播在播音四十年后退休了。

e.en: BBC is the largest public {broadcaster} in the UK.
e.zh: BBC是英国最大的公共广播机构。

e.en: Several {broadcasters} bid for the rights to the tournament.
e.zh: 几家广播公司争抢这场赛事的转播权。

e.en: Independent {broadcasters} struggle to compete with streaming giants.
e.zh: 独立广播公司难以与流媒体巨头竞争。

broadcasting.t:
n. 广播业
v. 广播（进行时）

e.en: She studied {broadcasting} before becoming a news anchor.
e.zh: 她在成为新闻主播前学的是广播专业。

e.en: The station is {broadcasting} the concert live tonight.
e.zh: 该电台今晚正在直播这场音乐会。

e.en: The radio station {broadcasts} 24 hours a day.
e.zh: 这家电台全天候不间断播出。

e.en: He listened to old wartime {broadcasts} on his phone.
e.zh: 他在手机上听旧时的战时广播。

e.en: The shirt was made of fine cotton {broadcloth}.
e.zh: 那件衬衫是用上等纯棉府绸做的。

e.en: {Broadcloth} drapes nicely and is great for dress shirts.
e.zh: 府绸垂感很好,非常适合做正装衬衫。

e.en: Travel can {broaden} your perspective on the world.
e.zh: 旅行可以拓宽你看世界的视野。

e.en: The company plans to {broaden} its product line.
e.zh: 该公司计划扩大产品线。

e.en: Studying abroad {broadened} her cultural horizons enormously.
e.zh: 出国留学极大地拓宽了她的文化视野。

e.en: The road was {broadened} to ease traffic congestion.
e.zh: 这条路被拓宽以缓解交通拥堵。

broadening.t:
v. 拓宽（进行时）
n. 扩展

e.en: Reading fiction is a great way of {broadening} the mind.
e.zh: 读小说是开阔思维的好方法。

e.en: The river is {broadening} as it nears the sea.
e.zh: 这条河接近大海时正在变宽。

e.en: This course {broadens} students' understanding of global issues.
e.zh: 这门课拓宽了学生对全球议题的理解。

e.en: The path {broadens} into a wide meadow ahead.
e.zh: 前方的小路变宽,通向一片广阔的草地。

e.en: He used a {broadhead} arrow to hunt deer.
e.zh: 他用宽刃箭头来猎鹿。

e.en: A sharp {broadhead} is essential for ethical bowhunting.
e.zh: 锋利的宽刃箭头对人道弓猎至关重要。

e.en: We rented a boat to explore the Norfolk {Broadland}.
e.zh: 我们租了条船游览诺福克的布罗德兰湿地。

e.en: The {Broadland} region is famous for its waterways.
e.zh: 布罗德兰地区以纵横的水道而闻名。

broadleaf.t:
adj. 阔叶的
n. 阔叶植物

e.en: Oak and maple are common {broadleaf} trees in the park.
e.zh: 橡树和枫树是公园里常见的阔叶树。

e.en: {Broadleaf} forests turn brilliant colors in autumn.
e.zh: 阔叶林在秋天会变得五彩斑斓。

e.en: The hill is covered in dense {broadleaved} woodland.
e.zh: 山上覆盖着茂密的阔叶林。

e.en: {Broadleaved} species shed their leaves each winter.
e.zh: 阔叶树种每年冬天都会落叶。

e.en: {Broadly} speaking, the project has been a success.
e.zh: 总体来说,这个项目是成功的。

e.en: She smiled {broadly} when she saw the gift.
e.zh: 看到礼物时她咧嘴笑了。

broadminded.t: adj. 心胸开阔的；开明的

e.en: His parents are {broadminded} about his career choices.
e.zh: 他的父母对他的职业选择很开明。

e.en: You need to be {broadminded} to live in this city.
e.zh: 在这座城市生活,你需要心胸开阔。

broadmoor.t: n. 地名（英国精神病院）

e.en: The notorious patient was transferred to {Broadmoor} hospital.
e.zh: 那名臭名昭著的病人被转移到了布罗德莫医院。

e.en: {Broadmoor} is a high-security psychiatric facility in England.
e.zh: 布罗德莫是英国一家高戒备的精神病院。

e.en: The {broadness} of his shoulders made suits hard to fit.
e.zh: 他肩膀宽厚,西装很难合身。

e.en: I admire the {broadness} of her reading interests.
e.zh: 我很佩服她阅读兴趣的广泛。

e.en: He still reads a {broadsheet} newspaper every Sunday.
e.zh: 他每个周日仍会读一份大开本报纸。

e.en: The {broadsheet} ran a long feature on climate policy.
e.zh: 那份大开本报纸刊登了一篇关于气候政策的长篇报道。

e.en: The senator launched a {broadside} against the new bill.
e.zh: 那位参议员对这项新法案展开了猛烈抨击。

e.en: A truck hit our car {broadside} at the intersection.
e.zh: 一辆卡车在路口从侧面撞上了我们的车。

e.en: The knight wielded a heavy {broadsword} in battle.
e.zh: 那位骑士在战斗中挥舞着一把沉重的阔剑。

e.en: Museums often display medieval {broadsword} replicas for visitors.
e.zh: 博物馆常为游客展出中世纪阔剑的复制品。

e.en: Her vintage coat was made of expensive {broadtail} fur.
e.zh: 她那件复古大衣是用昂贵的小卷羔皮做的。

e.en: {Broadtail} lambskin has a distinctive moiré pattern.
e.zh: 小卷羔皮有独特的水波纹样。

broadway.t: n. 百老汇（纽约剧院区）

e.en: She dreams of starring in a {Broadway} musical someday.
e.zh: 她梦想有一天能在百老汇音乐剧中担任主演。

e.en: Tickets to the {Broadway} show sold out in minutes.
e.zh: 那场百老汇演出的门票几分钟内就售罄了。

brobdingnagian.t: adj. 巨大无比的（源自《格列佛游记》）

e.en: The new stadium is truly {Brobdingnagian} in scale.
e.zh: 这座新体育场的规模简直巨大无比。

e.en: He served himself a {Brobdingnagian} portion of pasta.
e.zh: 他给自己盛了一大份意面。

e.en: The empress wore a gold silk {brocade} robe.
e.zh: 皇后身穿一件金丝织锦长袍。

e.en: The sofa was upholstered in rich red {brocade}.
e.zh: 那张沙发用深红色织锦布做了软垫。

e.en: She bought a beautifully {brocaded} cushion at the market.
e.zh: 她在市场上买了一个织锦精美的靠垫。

e.en: The {brocaded} curtains added elegance to the dining room.
e.zh: 织锦窗帘为餐厅增添了几分典雅。

e.en: My kids refuse to eat their {broccoli} at dinner.
e.zh: 我家孩子吃晚饭时拒绝吃西兰花。

e.en: Steam the {broccoli} for just three minutes.
e.zh: 西兰花只需蒸三分钟。

e.en: The chef arranged tiny {broccolis} around the roasted lamb.
e.zh: 厨师把小朵西兰花摆在烤羊肉旁边。

e.en: Different {broccolis} grow well in cool spring weather.
e.zh: 不同品种的西兰花在凉爽的春季长势良好。

e.en: She picked up a travel {brochure} at the airport.
e.zh: 她在机场拿了一本旅游宣传册。

e.en: The university sent a glossy {brochure} to prospective students.
e.zh: 大学给准学生寄了一本精美的宣传册。

e.en: Stacks of {brochures} covered the conference welcome desk.
e.zh: 会议接待台上堆满了宣传册。

e.en: The agency designs colorful {brochures} for small businesses.
e.zh: 这家公司为小企业设计彩色宣传册。

e.en: In old folktales, the {brock} digs deep burrows in the woods.
e.zh: 在古老的民间故事里,獾在林中挖掘深深的洞穴。

e.en: A young {brock} crossed the country lane at dusk.
e.zh: 一只小獾在黄昏时穿过了乡间小路。

e.en: Her white blouse featured delicate {broderie} along the collar.
e.zh: 她的白衬衫领口饰有精致的镂空刺绣。

e.en: The dress was trimmed with handmade {broderie} anglaise.
e.zh: 那条裙子镶有手工的英式镂空绣边。

e.en: The farmer pulled on his heavy leather {brogan} before sunrise.
e.zh: 农夫天亮前穿上了那双笨重的皮工作鞋。

e.en: Soldiers once marched for miles in stiff {brogan} boots.
e.zh: 士兵们曾穿着硬邦邦的粗革靴行军数英里。

brogue.t: n. 布洛克皮鞋；浓重的爱尔兰口音

e.en: You can hear a soft Irish {brogue} in his voice.
e.zh: 你能听出他声音里柔和的爱尔兰口音。

e.en: He polished his brown leather {brogue} before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前他把那双棕色布洛克皮鞋擦得锃亮。

e.en: {Broil} the salmon for six minutes until the top crisps.
e.zh: 把三文鱼烤六分钟,直到表面变脆。

e.en: Tempers began to {broil} as the meeting dragged on.
e.zh: 会议拖得太久,大家的情绪开始激动起来。

e.en: She served {broiled} chicken with lemon and herbs.
e.zh: 她端上了配柠檬和香草的炙烤鸡肉。

e.en: The desert sun {broiled} the empty highway all afternoon.
e.zh: 沙漠的烈日整个下午炙烤着空荡荡的公路。

e.en: Place the steak under the {broiler} for two minutes.
e.zh: 把牛排放到上火烤架下烤两分钟。

e.en: The farm raises thousands of {broiler} chickens each year.
e.zh: 这家农场每年饲养数千只肉鸡。

broiling.t:
adj. 酷热的
v. 炙烤（进行时）

e.en: We crossed the parking lot in the {broiling} afternoon heat.
e.zh: 我们顶着下午的酷热穿过停车场。

e.en: She is {broiling} shrimp skewers for tonight's dinner.
e.zh: 她正在烤虾串作为今晚的晚餐。

broke.t:
adj. 身无分文的
v. break 的过去式

e.en: I'm completely {broke} until my paycheck arrives Friday.
e.zh: 在周五发工资之前我身上一分钱都没有。

e.en: The toddler {broke} the vase while chasing the cat.
e.zh: 那个小孩在追猫时打碎了花瓶。

e.en: Please {bring} your laptop to tomorrow's meeting.
e.zh: 请把笔记本电脑带到明天的会议上。

e.en: Spring rains usually {bring} cooler nights.
e.zh: 春雨通常会带来凉爽的夜晚。

e.en: She is widely seen as a {bringer} of good news.
e.zh: 大家普遍把她视为带来好消息的人。

e.en: In the myth, the goddess is the {bringer} of dawn.
e.zh: 在神话中,这位女神是带来黎明的使者。

bringing.t: v. bring 的现在分词；带来

e.en: Thanks for {bringing} dessert to the dinner party.
e.zh: 谢谢你带甜点来晚宴。

e.en: The new manager is {bringing} fresh ideas to the team.
e.zh: 新经理正在为团队带来新的想法。

brings.t: v. bring 的第三人称单数

e.en: Each season {brings} its own challenges to farmers.
e.zh: 每个季节都给农民带来不同的挑战。

e.en: This song always {brings} back childhood memories.
e.zh: 这首歌总能唤起童年的回忆。

brink.t: n. 边缘；濒临（崩溃、战争的临界点）

e.en: The two countries were on the {brink} of war.
e.zh: 两国当时已濒临战争边缘。

e.en: She stood at the {brink} of the cliff and looked down.
e.zh: 她站在悬崖边向下望去。

brinkmanship.t: n. 边缘政策；走钢丝策略

e.en: Such {brinkmanship} during talks worries investors.
e.zh: 谈判中这种边缘政策让投资者感到担忧。

e.en: The senator accused the president of nuclear {brinkmanship}.
e.zh: 那位参议员指责总统在玩核边缘政策。

brinks.t: n. 布林克斯（押运公司名）

e.en: A {Brinks} truck pulled up outside the bank.
e.zh: 一辆布林克斯运钞车停在了银行门口。

e.en: The country has reached the {brinks} of financial collapse.
e.zh: 该国已濒临金融崩溃的边缘。

e.en: A {briny} breeze blew in from the harbor.
e.zh: 一阵带着咸味的海风从港口吹来。

e.en: The soup tasted a little too {briny} for me.
e.zh: 这汤对我来说有点太咸了。

e.en: She delivered her speech with great {brio}.
e.zh: 她充满活力地发表了演讲。

e.en: The orchestra played the finale with {brio}.
e.zh: 管弦乐队精神饱满地演奏了终曲。

brioche.t: n. 布里欧修（法式奶油面包）

e.en: The café serves warm {brioche} with fresh jam.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆供应配新鲜果酱的温热布里欧修面包。

e.en: He ordered a burger on a toasted {brioche} bun.
e.zh: 他点了一个用烤布里欧面包做的汉堡。

e.en: Add another {briquette} to keep the grill hot.
e.zh: 再加一块煤球,让烤架保持热度。

e.en: Each charcoal {briquette} burns for about an hour.
e.zh: 每块炭饼大约能烧一个小时。

bris.t: n. 犹太教婴儿割礼仪式

e.en: The family invited friends to their son's {bris}.
e.zh: 那家人邀请朋友们参加儿子的割礼仪式。

e.en: A {bris} is traditionally held on the eighth day.
e.zh: 按传统,割礼仪式通常在第八天举行。

brisbane.t: n. 布里斯班（澳大利亚城市）

e.en: My cousin moved to {Brisbane} for a tech job.
e.zh: 我表弟搬到布里斯班去做一份科技工作。

e.en: {Brisbane} enjoys warm weather most of the year.
e.zh: 布里斯班一年中大部分时间气候温暖。

brisk.t: adj. 轻快的；活跃的（生意、步伐）

e.en: We took a {brisk} walk along the river before lunch.
e.zh: 午饭前我们沿着河边快步走了一段。

e.en: Sales have been {brisk} since the holiday started.
e.zh: 假期开始以来销售一直很红火。

e.en: Smoked {brisket} is the highlight of Texas barbecue.
e.zh: 烟熏牛胸肉是德州烧烤的招牌。

e.en: She slow-cooked the {brisket} for eight hours.
e.zh: 她把牛腩慢炖了八个小时。

e.en: He walked {briskly} to catch the morning train.
e.zh: 他快步走着去赶早班火车。

e.en: The new phones are selling {briskly} this week.
e.zh: 这款新手机本周卖得很快。

e.en: There was a pleasant {briskness} in the autumn air.
e.zh: 秋日的空气中带着一丝怡人的清爽。

e.en: She answered questions with professional {briskness}.
e.zh: 她以干练利落的方式回答问题。

bristle.t:
n. 鬃毛；硬毛
v. 发怒；竖起

e.en: Use a soft {bristle} brush to clean the lens.
e.zh: 用软毛刷清洁镜头。

e.en: Voters tend to {bristle} at sudden tax hikes.
e.zh: 选民通常对突然加税感到反感。

e.en: The fortress was {bristling} with cannons and guards.
e.zh: 那座堡垒上布满了大炮和卫兵。

e.en: He was {bristling} with anger after the meeting.
e.zh: 开完会后,他怒气冲冲。

bristly.t: adj. 硬毛丛生的；粗硬的

e.en: His {bristly} beard scratched her cheek.
e.zh: 他粗硬的胡子扎到了她的脸颊。

e.en: The cactus has {bristly} spines all over it.
e.zh: 那株仙人掌浑身长满了硬刺。

bristol.t: n. 布里斯托（英国城市）

e.en: She studies engineering at the University of {Bristol}.
e.zh: 她在布里斯托大学读工程专业。

e.en: {Bristol} has a lively street art scene.
e.zh: 布里斯托有着活跃的街头艺术氛围。

e.en: My new neighbor is a {Brit} from Manchester.
e.zh: 我的新邻居是个来自曼彻斯特的英国人。

e.en: Several {Brits} won medals at the swimming finals.
e.zh: 在游泳决赛中,几位英国人摘得了奖牌。

e.en: {Britain} left the European Union in 2020.
e.zh: 英国于2020年脱离了欧盟。

e.en: She moved from {Britain} to Singapore last year.
e.zh: 她去年从英国搬到了新加坡。

britannia.t: n. 不列颠（英国的拟人化称呼）

e.en: The old coin features {Britannia} holding a trident.
e.zh: 那枚旧硬币上刻着手持三叉戟的不列颠尼亚女神。

e.en: The hotel's pub is called the {Britannia} Arms.
e.zh: 那家酒店的酒吧叫作不列颠尼亚之家。

e.en: His {Britannic} Majesty signed the treaty in London.
e.zh: 英王陛下在伦敦签署了这份条约。

e.en: The ship sailed under the {Britannic} flag.
e.zh: 那艘船悬挂着英国国旗航行。

e.en: My grandfather kept a full set of {Britannica} encyclopedias.
e.zh: 我祖父收藏了一整套大英百科全书。

e.en: The {Britannica} now exists primarily as an online resource.
e.zh: 《大英百科全书》现在主要以网络版形式存在。

e.en: He was getting too big for his {britches}.
e.zh: 他变得越来越自以为是了。

e.en: The boy ripped his {britches} climbing the fence.
e.zh: 那男孩翻栅栏时把短裤撕破了。

e.en: The {British} drink more tea than coffee.
e.zh: 英国人喝茶比喝咖啡更多。

e.en: She speaks with a slight {British} accent.
e.zh: 她说话带着轻微的英国口音。

e.en: Every {Britisher} I met was polite and reserved.
e.zh: 我遇到的每个英国人都礼貌而内敛。

e.en: He's a true {Britisher} despite living abroad for decades.
e.zh: 尽管在国外住了几十年,他仍是个地道的英国人。

e.en: Tea and queuing are symbols of {Britishness}.
e.zh: 喝茶和排队是英国特色的象征。

e.en: The film captures a quiet sense of {Britishness}.
e.zh: 这部电影捕捉到了一种含蓄的英伦气质。

e.en: Every {Briton} remembers where they were that day.
e.zh: 每个英国人都记得那天自己在哪里。

e.en: She became the first {Briton} to win the award.
e.zh: 她成为首位获此奖项的英国人。

brittany.t: n. 布列塔尼（法国地区）；女性名

e.en: We spent a week sailing along the coast of {Brittany}.
e.zh: 我们在布列塔尼海岸航行了一周。

e.en: {Brittany} is famous for its crepes and cider.
e.zh: 布列塔尼以可丽饼和苹果酒闻名。

e.en: Old plastic becomes {brittle} after years in the sun.
e.zh: 塑料在阳光下放久了会变得很脆。

e.en: Her confidence was {brittle} after the criticism.
e.zh: 批评过后,她的自信变得脆弱。

e.en: The {brittleness} of the glass surprised the engineers.
e.zh: 这种玻璃的脆性令工程师们感到意外。

e.en: Cold weather increases the {brittleness} of metal pipes.
e.zh: 寒冷天气会增加金属管道的脆性。

brixham.t: n. 布里克瑟姆（英国港口）

e.en: We bought fresh fish at the {Brixham} harbor market.
e.zh: 我们在布里克瑟姆港口市场买了新鲜的鱼。

e.en: {Brixham} is a charming fishing town in Devon.
e.zh: 布里克瑟姆是德文郡一座迷人的渔镇。

brixton.t: n. 布里克斯顿（伦敦地区）

e.en: The band played a sold-out show in {Brixton}.
e.zh: 乐队在布里克斯顿举办了一场座无虚席的演出。

e.en: {Brixton} has become one of London's trendiest neighborhoods.
e.zh: 布里克斯顿已成为伦敦最潮的街区之一。

brize.t: n. 布赖兹（地名，如 Brize Norton）

e.en: The transport flight departed from RAF {Brize} Norton yesterday.
e.zh: 那架运输机昨天从布里兹诺顿空军基地起飞。

e.en: {Brize} Norton is the largest RAF station in Britain.
e.zh: 布里兹诺顿是英国最大的皇家空军基地。

brm.t: n. BRM（英国赛车制造商缩写）

e.en: The vintage {BRM} racing car sold for a fortune.
e.zh: 那辆古董BRM赛车卖出了天价。

e.en: {BRM} dominated Formula One briefly in the 1960s.
e.zh: BRM车队曾在1960年代短暂称霸一级方程式。

e.en: {Brno} is the second-largest city in the Czech Republic.
e.zh: 布尔诺是捷克的第二大城市。

e.en: We took the train from Prague to {Brno}.
e.zh: 我们坐火车从布拉格前往布尔诺。

bro.t: n. 兄弟；哥们（brother 的口语缩写）

e.en: Hey {bro}, want to grab some lunch?
e.zh: 嘿哥们,要一起去吃午饭吗?

e.en: My older {bro} taught me how to drive.
e.zh: 我哥教会了我开车。

broach.t:
v. 提起（话题）；开启
n. 胸针；拉刀

e.en: I didn't want to {broach} the subject of money.
e.zh: 我不想提起钱的话题。

e.en: She finally decided to {broach} the issue with her boss.
e.zh: 她终于决定向老板提出这个问题。

broken.t:
adj. 破碎的；破损的
adj. （关系、制度）破裂的

e.en: The screen on my phone is badly {broken}.
e.zh: 我的手机屏幕碎得很严重。

e.en: He has {broken} every promise he ever made.
e.zh: 他违背了自己许下的每一个承诺。

brokenly.t: adv. 断断续续地；不连贯地

e.en: She spoke {brokenly} through her tears at the funeral.
e.zh: 她在葬礼上哽咽着断断续续地说话。

e.en: The old radio played jazz {brokenly} in the corner.
e.zh: 那台旧收音机在角落里断断续续地放着爵士乐。

e.en: Her poems explore the {brokenness} that follows great loss.
e.zh: 她的诗探讨了重大失去之后的破碎感。

e.en: There is honesty in admitting your own {brokenness}.
e.zh: 承认自己的破碎本身就是一种真诚。

broker.t:
n. 经纪人；中介
v. 经办、斡旋（交易）

e.en: My {broker} recommended selling the tech stocks last week.
e.zh: 我的经纪人上周建议卖掉那些科技股。

e.en: Diplomats worked overnight to {broker} a ceasefire.
e.zh: 外交官们彻夜工作以促成停火协议。

e.en: She opened a {brokerage} account to start trading stocks.
e.zh: 她开了一个证券账户开始买卖股票。

e.en: The {brokerage} charges low fees for online trades.
e.zh: 这家券商对线上交易收取的手续费很低。

brokered.t: v. 经办、斡旋（broker 的过去式）

e.en: The UN {brokered} a fragile peace between the two nations.
e.zh: 联合国促成了两国之间脆弱的和平。

e.en: He {brokered} the sale of the company in record time.
e.zh: 他以创纪录的速度促成了公司的出售。

brokering.t: v. 居间经办；撮合（broker 的现在分词）

e.en: She specializes in {brokering} deals between startups and investors.
e.zh: 她专门为初创公司和投资人之间撮合交易。

e.en: The mayor is {brokering} a compromise on the housing plan.
e.zh: 市长正在为住房方案斡旋达成妥协。

broking.t: n. 经纪业务（英式用法）

e.en: He works in insurance {broking} for a London firm.
e.zh: 他在伦敦一家公司从事保险经纪业务。

e.en: Online platforms have transformed the share {broking} industry.
e.zh: 网络平台彻底改变了股票经纪行业。

e.en: Don't forget your {brolly} — it's pouring outside.
e.zh: 别忘了带伞,外面下大雨呢。

e.en: She tucked a folding {brolly} into her handbag.
e.zh: 她把一把折叠伞塞进了手提包。

brom.t: (罕用) n. 溴（bromine 的缩写形式）

e.en: In the story, {Brom} challenged the schoolmaster to a duel.
e.zh: 故事中,布罗姆向那位教书先生挑战决斗。

e.en: The character {Brom} is known for his fearless bravado.
e.zh: 布罗姆这个角色以无所畏惧的虚张声势著称。

e.en: A bright pink {bromeliad} bloomed on the windowsill.
e.zh: 窗台上开着一株鲜艳的粉色凤梨花。

e.en: Tropical frogs often live inside the cup of a {bromeliad}.
e.zh: 热带青蛙常常栖息在凤梨科植物的杯状叶心里。

bromide.t:
n. 溴化物
n. 陈词滥调

e.en: His speech was full of tired {bromide} about hard work.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了关于努力工作的陈词滥调。

e.en: Doctors once prescribed potassium {bromide} as a sedative.
e.zh: 医生过去常开溴化钾作为镇静剂。

e.en: {Bromine} is a heavy reddish-brown liquid at room temperature.
e.zh: 溴在室温下是一种深红棕色的重液体。

e.en: Pool owners sometimes use {bromine} instead of chlorine.
e.zh: 泳池业主有时用溴代替氯来消毒。

bromley.t: n. 布罗姆利（伦敦地区地名）

e.en: She caught the train from {Bromley} into central London.
e.zh: 她从布罗姆利搭火车进入伦敦市中心。

e.en: {Bromley} is one of the largest boroughs in Greater London.
e.zh: 布罗姆利是大伦敦地区最大的自治市之一。

brompton.t: n. 布朗普顿（伦敦地名；折叠自行车品牌）

e.en: He folded his {Brompton} bike and carried it onto the train.
e.zh: 他把那辆布朗普顿折叠车收好,带上了火车。

e.en: The {Brompton} Road is famous for its luxury shops.
e.zh: 布朗普顿路以其奢侈品商店而闻名。

bromsgrove.t: n. 布罗姆斯格罗夫（英国地名）

e.en: They moved from Birmingham to {Bromsgrove} last summer.
e.zh: 他们去年夏天从伯明翰搬到了布罗姆斯格罗夫。

e.en: {Bromsgrove} is a market town in Worcestershire, England.
e.zh: 布罗姆斯格罗夫是英格兰伍斯特郡的一个集镇。

bromwich.t: n. 布罗姆维奇（英国地名）

e.en: West {Bromwich} Albion drew with Leeds on Saturday.
e.zh: 西布罗姆维奇足球俱乐部周六与利兹队战成平局。

e.en: He grew up in West {Bromwich} near Birmingham.
e.zh: 他在伯明翰附近的西布罗姆维奇长大。

e.en: The cowboy was thrown from the wild {bronc} within seconds.
e.zh: 几秒钟之内,牛仔就被那匹烈马甩了下来。

e.en: Riding a bucking {bronc} takes years of practice.
e.zh: 骑乘暴跳的烈马需要多年的练习。

bronchi.t: n. 支气管（bronchus 的复数）

e.en: Smoke irritates the delicate lining of the {bronchi}.
e.zh: 烟雾会刺激支气管脆弱的内壁。

e.en: The doctor scanned her lungs and {bronchi} for blockages.
e.zh: 医生扫描了她的肺部和支气管以查看是否有堵塞。

e.en: Cold air can trigger her {bronchial} asthma at night.
e.zh: 冷空气可能在夜里引发她的支气管哮喘。

e.en: The infection spread quickly through his {bronchial} tubes.
e.zh: 感染很快蔓延到他的支气管。

e.en: Chronic infections eventually led to her {bronchiectasis} diagnosis.
e.zh: 长期反复感染最终让她被诊断为支气管扩张症。

e.en: Patients with {bronchiectasis} often need daily chest physiotherapy.
e.zh: 支气管扩张症患者通常需要每天进行胸部物理治疗。

e.en: Heavy smokers are at high risk of chronic {bronchitis}.
e.zh: 重度吸烟者患慢性支气管炎的风险很高。

e.en: She missed a week of school with acute {bronchitis}.
e.zh: 她因急性支气管炎缺了一周的课。

e.en: The nurse handed him a {bronchodilator} inhaler before the test.
e.zh: 护士在检查前递给他一支支气管扩张剂吸入器。

e.en: A quick puff of the {bronchodilator} eased her breathing.
e.zh: 喷一下支气管扩张剂,她的呼吸就轻松了。

e.en: The surgeon used a {bronchoscope} to inspect the airway.
e.zh: 外科医生用支气管镜检查了气道。

e.en: A flexible {bronchoscope} can reach deep into the lungs.
e.zh: 软质支气管镜可以深入到肺部内部。

e.en: The rodeo star clung tightly to the bucking {bronco}.
e.zh: 那位牛仔竞技明星紧紧抓住暴跳的烈马。

e.en: He drives an old Ford {Bronco} on weekend trips.
e.zh: 他周末出游开的是一辆旧款福特Bronco越野车。

bronte.t: n. 勃朗特（姓氏，如勃朗特三姐妹）

e.en: Charlotte {Brontë} wrote the classic novel Jane Eyre.
e.zh: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特创作了经典小说《简·爱》。

e.en: Tourists visit the {Brontë} parsonage in Yorkshire each year.
e.zh: 游客每年都会参观位于约克郡的勃朗特故居。

e.en: The museum's {brontosaur} skeleton towered over the visitors.
e.zh: 博物馆里的雷龙骨架高高耸立在参观者头顶。

e.en: Children stared in awe at the giant {brontosaur} model.
e.zh: 孩子们敬畏地盯着那只巨大的雷龙模型。

brontosaurus.t: n. 雷龙（大型蜥脚类恐龙）

e.en: A massive {brontosaurus} once roamed the prehistoric plains.
e.zh: 一只巨大的雷龙曾在史前的平原上漫步。

e.en: He drew a friendly {brontosaurus} chewing on tall ferns.
e.zh: 他画了一只友善的雷龙在啃食高高的蕨类植物。

bronx.t: n. 布朗克斯（纽约市行政区）

e.en: She grew up in a small apartment in the {Bronx}.
e.zh: 她在布朗克斯区的一间小公寓里长大。

e.en: The {Bronx} Zoo is one of the largest in America.
e.zh: 布朗克斯动物园是美国最大的动物园之一。

bronze.t:
n. 青铜；铜牌
adj. 青铜色的

e.en: Our team won the {bronze} medal at the championship.
e.zh: 我们队在锦标赛上赢得了铜牌。

e.en: A heavy {bronze} statue stood at the park entrance.
e.zh: 公园入口处立着一座沉重的青铜雕像。

e.en: After two weeks in Bali, his skin was deeply {bronzed}.
e.zh: 在巴厘岛待了两周后,他的皮肤晒成了古铜色。

e.en: She {bronzed} her cheeks lightly before the photo shoot.
e.zh: 拍照前她在脸颊上轻轻扫了点古铜色修容。

bronzer.t: n. 古铜色修容粉（化妆品）

e.en: She swept some {bronzer} across her cheekbones for warmth.
e.zh: 她在颧骨上扫了点修容粉,让气色显得暖一些。

e.en: A good {bronzer} adds a sun-kissed glow to pale skin.
e.zh: 一款好的修容粉能让苍白的皮肤呈现日晒般的光泽。

e.en: The gallery displays ancient Chinese {bronzes} from the Shang dynasty.
e.zh: 美术馆展出了商代的中国古代青铜器。

e.en: Several {bronzes} by Rodin sold for record prices.
e.zh: 罗丹的几件青铜雕塑拍出了创纪录的高价。

e.en: She applied a light {bronzing} powder before heading out.
e.zh: 她出门前涂了一层薄薄的古铜色修容粉。

e.en: The autumn sun was slowly {bronzing} the wheat fields.
e.zh: 秋天的阳光慢慢把麦田染成了古铜色。

e.en: Her hair took on a {bronzy} shimmer in the sunset.
e.zh: 她的头发在夕阳下泛出古铜色的光泽。

e.en: The lipstick had a warm {bronzy} undertone.
e.zh: 那支口红带有温暖的古铜色底调。

e.en: Grandma pinned a silver {brooch} to her wool coat.
e.zh: 奶奶在她的羊毛大衣上别了一枚银胸针。

e.en: The antique {brooch} was studded with tiny pearls.
e.zh: 那枚古董胸针上镶满了细小的珍珠。

brood.t:
n. 一窝（雏鸟、幼崽）
v. 沉思；忧思

e.en: The hen guarded her {brood} of fluffy yellow chicks.
e.zh: 母鸡守护着她那群毛茸茸的黄色小鸡。

e.en: Try not to {brood} over mistakes you can't change.
e.zh: 别为已经无法改变的错误反复纠结。

brooded.t: v. 沉思；郁郁不乐（brood 的过去式）

e.en: He {brooded} for hours after losing the championship match.
e.zh: 输掉冠军赛后,他闷闷不乐地想了好几个小时。

e.en: Dark clouds {brooded} over the valley all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午,乌云沉沉地笼罩着山谷。

e.en: He's a quiet {brooder} who rarely shares his feelings.
e.zh: 他是个沉默寡言的人，很少表露情绪。

e.en: The chicks huddled inside the warm {brooder} overnight.
e.zh: 小鸡们整夜挤在温暖的育雏箱里。

e.en: The film has a dark, {brooding} atmosphere throughout.
e.zh: 这部电影自始至终笼罩着阴郁压抑的氛围。

e.en: He sat by the window, {brooding} over the bad news.
e.zh: 他坐在窗边，为那个坏消息闷闷不乐。

e.en: He stared {broodingly} out at the gray sea.
e.zh: 他若有所思地望着灰蒙蒙的大海。

e.en: The mountains loomed {broodingly} above the village.
e.zh: 群山阴沉地耸立在村庄之上。

e.en: The farm sold its prized {broodmare} for a record price.
e.zh: 农场以创纪录的价格卖出了那匹珍贵的母马。

e.en: Each {broodmare} is checked by the vet every spring.
e.zh: 每匹种母马每年春天都会接受兽医检查。

broods.t:
n. 一窝（复数）
v. 沉思（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {broods} for hours after losing a chess match.
e.zh: 输掉一局棋后，他会闷闷不乐好几个小时。

e.en: The hen carefully {broods} over her clutch of eggs.
e.zh: 母鸡仔细地孵着那一窝蛋。

broody.t:
adj. （母鸡）抱窝的
adj. 郁郁寡欢的

e.en: She gets {broody} whenever she sees a newborn baby.
e.zh: 每次看到新生儿，她就特别想要个孩子。

e.en: Our hen turned {broody} and stopped laying eggs.
e.zh: 我们的母鸡开始抱窝，不再下蛋了。

brook.t:
n. 小溪
v. 容忍（常用于否定）

e.en: A small {brook} runs behind our cabin in the woods.
e.zh: 林中小屋后面有一条小溪流过。

e.en: The manager will not {brook} any more excuses.
e.zh: 经理不会再容忍任何借口了。

brookfield.t: n. 布鲁克菲尔德（地名）

e.en: She grew up in {Brookfield}, a quiet suburb of Milwaukee.
e.zh: 她在密尔沃基的安静郊区布鲁克菲尔德长大。

e.en: The {Brookfield} Zoo is famous for its dolphin shows.
e.zh: 布鲁克菲尔德动物园以海豚表演闻名。

brooklyn.t: n. 布鲁克林（纽约一区）

e.en: They moved to {Brooklyn} after their second child was born.
e.zh: 二胎出生后他们搬到了布鲁克林。

e.en: The {Brooklyn} Bridge looks stunning at sunset.
e.zh: 布鲁克林大桥在日落时分美极了。

brooks.t:
n. 小溪（brook 的复数）
v. 容忍

e.en: Several clear {brooks} flow through the national park.
e.zh: 几条清澈的小溪穿过这座国家公园。

e.en: Mr. {Brooks} teaches history at the local high school.
e.zh: 布鲁克斯先生在当地高中教历史。

e.en: We had a picnic at the shady {brookside} clearing.
e.zh: 我们在阴凉的溪边空地野餐。

e.en: Her cottage stands on a quiet {brookside} lane.
e.zh: 她的小屋坐落在一条安静的溪边小路上。

broom.t:
n. 扫帚
v. 用扫帚扫

e.en: Please grab the {broom} and sweep up this mess.
e.zh: 请拿扫帚把这堆乱七八糟的东西扫干净。

e.en: The witch flew off on her magical {broom}.
e.zh: 女巫骑着她的魔法扫帚飞走了。

e.en: {Broome} is a coastal town famous for its pearl industry.
e.zh: 布鲁姆是一座以珍珠业闻名的海滨小镇。

e.en: David {Broome} won several major show jumping titles.
e.zh: 大卫·布鲁姆赢得了多项重要的障碍赛冠军。

broomfield.t: n. 布鲁姆菲尔德（地名）

e.en: The conference will be held in {Broomfield}, Colorado.
e.zh: 会议将在科罗拉多州的布鲁姆菲尔德举行。

e.en: {Broomfield} has grown rapidly over the past decade.
e.zh: 布鲁姆菲尔德在过去十年里发展迅速。

broomstick.t: n. 扫帚柄（女巫骑的那种）

e.en: Harry mounted his {broomstick} and soared into the sky.
e.zh: 哈利骑上扫帚，飞向天空。

e.en: She leaned the dusty {broomstick} against the wall.
e.zh: 她把那把满是灰尘的扫帚靠在墙上。

bros.t: n. 兄弟们，哥们（brothers 的非正式简写）

e.en: The {bros} spent every Saturday playing video games together.
e.zh: 这群哥们儿每个周六都在一起打游戏。

e.en: Warner {Bros}. released a new superhero movie last week.
e.zh: 华纳兄弟上周上映了一部新的超级英雄电影。

e.en: A bowl of warm chicken {broth} always soothes my cold.
e.zh: 一碗温热的鸡汤总能缓解我的感冒。

e.en: Simmer the bones in water to make a rich {broth}.
e.zh: 把骨头用水慢炖，做成浓郁的高汤。

e.en: Police raided an illegal {brothel} downtown last night.
e.zh: 警方昨晚突击搜查了市中心一家非法妓院。

e.en: The novel is set in a 19th-century Paris {brothel}.
e.zh: 小说的背景设定在19世纪巴黎的一家妓院。

e.en: My older {brother} is teaching me how to drive.
e.zh: 我哥哥正在教我开车。

e.en: Hey {brother}, can you pass me the remote?
e.zh: 哥们，能把遥控器递给我吗？

brother-in-law.t: n. 姐夫、妹夫、内兄、小舅子等

e.en: My {brother-in-law} runs a small bakery in town.
e.zh: 我姐夫在镇上经营一家小面包店。

e.en: Her {brother-in-law} helped her move into the new apartment.
e.zh: 她小叔子帮她搬进了新公寓。

brother-in-laws.t: n. brother-in-law 的复数（标准为 brothers-in-law）

e.en: Both her {brother-in-laws} attended the family reunion.
e.zh: 她的两位姐夫都参加了家庭聚会。

e.en: His {brother-in-laws} get along surprisingly well.
e.zh: 他的几位连襟相处得出奇地好。

e.en: The team built a strong sense of {brotherhood} during training.
e.zh: 球队在训练中建立了强烈的兄弟情谊。

e.en: He joined a religious {brotherhood} after college.
e.zh: 大学毕业后，他加入了一个宗教兄弟会。

brotherhoods.t: n. 兄弟会（brotherhood 的复数）

e.en: Several medieval {brotherhoods} once protected pilgrims on the road.
e.zh: 中世纪的几个兄弟会曾在路上保护朝圣者。

e.en: Secret {brotherhoods} feature heavily in conspiracy novels.
e.zh: 秘密兄弟会在阴谋论小说中经常出现。

brotherly.t: adj. 兄弟般的，亲如手足的

e.en: He gave his teammate a {brotherly} pat on the back.
e.zh: 他像兄弟一样拍了拍队友的背。

e.en: There's a deep {brotherly} bond between the two coworkers.
e.zh: 这两位同事之间有着深厚的兄弟情谊。

brothers.t: n. 兄弟们（brother 的复数）

e.en: The three {brothers} started a business together after college.
e.zh: 三兄弟大学毕业后一起创业。

e.en: My {brothers} always argue about who gets the front seat.
e.zh: 我的兄弟们总是争谁坐前排。

brougham.t: n. 一种封闭式四轮马车；同名早期轿车款式

e.en: A polished {brougham} waited outside the opera house.
e.zh: 一辆擦得锃亮的四轮马车停在歌剧院外。

e.en: The museum displays an antique {brougham} from the 1880s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出着一辆1880年代的古董四轮马车。

brought.t: v. bring 的过去式与过去分词，带来、带去

e.en: She {brought} homemade cookies to the office party.
e.zh: 她带了自制饼干来办公室派对。

e.en: The new policy {brought} significant changes to our workflow.
e.zh: 新政策给我们的工作流程带来了重大改变。

e.en: {Broughton} is a small village just north of Edinburgh.
e.zh: 布劳顿是爱丁堡以北的一个小村庄。

e.en: Dr. {Broughton} published a paper on marine biology.
e.zh: 布劳顿博士发表了一篇海洋生物学论文。

e.en: The CEO's tweet caused a huge {brouhaha} on social media.
e.zh: CEO的推文在社交媒体上掀起了轩然大波。

e.en: There was quite a {brouhaha} over the new dress code.
e.zh: 新着装规定引起了一阵不小的骚动。

brouhahas.t: n. 喧闹，骚动（brouhaha 的复数）

e.en: The celebrity is known for sparking minor {brouhahas} online.
e.zh: 这位名人以在网上引发小风波而闻名。

e.en: Political {brouhahas} dominate the news cycle these days.
e.zh: 如今政治风波占据了新闻头条。

e.en: She wiped the sweat from her {brow} after the run.
e.zh: 跑完步后，她擦了擦额头上的汗。

e.en: He raised an eye{brow} when he heard the price.
e.zh: 听到价格时，他扬了扬眉毛。

browbeat.t: v. 威吓，胁迫（用眼神/言辞）

e.en: The boss tried to {browbeat} her into accepting overtime.
e.zh: 老板想要恐吓她接受加班。

e.en: Don't let anyone {browbeat} you into changing your mind.
e.zh: 别让任何人威逼你改变主意。

browbeaten.t: v. browbeat 的过去分词，被威吓的

e.en: The {browbeaten} employee finally quit after years of abuse.
e.zh: 那位饱受欺压的员工在多年虐待后终于辞职了。

e.en: She felt {browbeaten} into signing the unfair contract.
e.zh: 她觉得自己是被胁迫签下这份不公平合同的。

brown.t:
adj. 棕色的
v. 把…煎成褐色

e.en: He ordered a {brown} leather jacket from the website.
e.zh: 他从网站上订购了一件棕色皮夹克。

e.en: {Brown} the onions before adding the garlic.
e.zh: 先把洋葱炒至焦黄，再加入大蒜。

browned.t: v. brown 的过去式，煎/烤成褐色

e.en: She {browned} the beef before adding it to the stew.
e.zh: 她把牛肉煎成焦黄色，然后加入炖菜中。

e.en: The pages had {browned} with age over the decades.
e.zh: 几十年来，书页因年代久远而泛黄。

brownfield.t: n. 棕地（待再开发的旧工业用地）

e.en: The city plans to redevelop the old {brownfield} site.
e.zh: 市政府计划重新开发那块旧工业棕地。

e.en: Many startups prefer greenfield projects over {brownfield} ones.
e.zh: 许多初创公司更喜欢绿地项目而不是棕地改造项目。

e.en: Einstein famously explained {Brownian} motion in 1905.
e.zh: 爱因斯坦在1905年因解释布朗运动而闻名。

e.en: Pollen grains in water exhibit visible {Brownian} movement.
e.zh: 水中的花粉颗粒呈现出可见的布朗运动。

brownie.t: n. 布朗尼（巧克力小蛋糕）

e.en: I baked a tray of chocolate {brownies} for the party.
e.zh: 我为聚会烤了一盘巧克力布朗尼。

e.en: You'll earn {brownie} points for helping with the dishes.
e.zh: 帮忙洗碗能给你加分。

browning.t:
v. 变褐，煎黄
n. 勃朗宁（姓氏/枪械）

e.en: The leaves are slowly {browning} as autumn approaches.
e.zh: 随着秋天临近，树叶正慢慢变黄。

e.en: Add a little lemon juice to prevent the apples from {browning}.
e.zh: 加点柠檬汁可以防止苹果变褐。

e.en: The river had a {brownish} tint after the heavy rain.
e.zh: 暴雨过后，河水呈现出微褐色。

e.en: She dyed her hair a soft {brownish} red.
e.zh: 她把头发染成了柔和的棕红色。

e.en: The {brownness} of the toast was just perfect.
e.zh: 这片吐司烤得焦黄程度正合适。

e.en: He admired the rich {brownness} of the polished wood.
e.zh: 他欣赏着抛光木材那浓郁的棕色。

e.en: A sudden {brownout} dimmed the lights across the city.
e.zh: 突如其来的电压骤降使整个城市的灯光变暗。

e.en: The factory installed generators to handle frequent {brownouts}.
e.zh: 工厂安装了发电机来应对频繁的电压不足。

browns.t:
n. 棕色（复数）
v. brown 的第三人称单数

e.en: The artist mixed several {browns} to paint the tree bark.
e.zh: 画家调出几种棕色来画树皮。

e.en: The Cleveland {Browns} lost their season opener again.
e.zh: 克利夫兰布朗队又一次输掉了赛季揭幕战。

brownshirt.t: n. 纳粹冲锋队员；引申极右暴徒

e.en: The novel depicts a {brownshirt} marching through the village.
e.zh: 小说描绘了一名褐衫军在村中行进的场景。

e.en: Critics labeled the militia as modern-day {brownshirts}.
e.zh: 批评人士把这支民兵称为当代褐衫党。

brownstone.t: n. 褐砂石；褐石联排住宅

e.en: They bought a beautiful {brownstone} in the West Village.
e.zh: 他们在西村买下了一栋漂亮的褐石建筑。

e.en: Her {brownstone} apartment overlooks a tree-lined street.
e.zh: 她的褐石公寓俯瞰着一条林荫街道。

e.en: The sauce had a {browny} color and rich aroma.
e.zh: 酱汁呈棕褐色，散发着浓郁的香气。

e.en: She wore a soft {browny} sweater on the chilly morning.
e.zh: 凉爽的早晨，她穿了一件柔软的棕色毛衣。

browse.t:
v. 浏览（网页、商品）
n. 一次浏览

e.en: I like to {browse} bookstores on rainy afternoons.
e.zh: 下雨的下午我喜欢逛书店。

e.en: Feel free to {browse} our website for more options.
e.zh: 欢迎浏览我们的网站了解更多选项。

browsed.t: v. browse 的过去式，浏览过

e.en: She {browsed} the menu before deciding on the pasta.
e.zh: 她浏览了菜单后决定点意面。

e.en: He {browsed} through the catalog looking for a gift.
e.zh: 他翻看着目录，想找份礼物。

e.en: Chrome is the most popular web {browser} worldwide.
e.zh: Chrome 是全球最受欢迎的网页浏览器。

e.en: Try clearing your {browser} cache to fix the issue.
e.zh: 试试清除浏览器缓存来解决这个问题。

browsers.t: n. 浏览器（browser 的复数）

e.en: The site works well on all modern {browsers}.
e.zh: 该网站在所有现代浏览器上都能正常运行。

e.en: Different {browsers} sometimes render the page slightly differently.
e.zh: 不同的浏览器有时会以略微不同的方式呈现页面。

browses.t: v. browse 的第三人称单数，浏览

e.en: She {browses} the online store during her lunch break.
e.zh: 她午休时浏览那家网店。

e.en: The deer {browses} on tender leaves at dawn.
e.zh: 那只鹿在黎明时啃食嫩叶。

browsing.t:
v. 正在浏览
n. 浏览行为

e.en: I was {browsing} Reddit when the news broke.
e.zh: 消息传出时我正在刷 Reddit。

e.en: Private {browsing} mode hides your search history.
e.zh: 隐私浏览模式会隐藏你的搜索记录。

broxbourne.t: n. 布罗克斯本（英国地名）

e.en: My cousin lives in {Broxbourne}, just north of London.
e.zh: 我表弟住在伦敦北边的布罗克斯本。

e.en: The train to {Broxbourne} leaves every twenty minutes.
e.zh: 开往布罗克斯本的火车每二十分钟一班。

brs.t: n. bros 的变体，兄弟们（网络用语）

e.en: Just typed {brs} in chat to say I'd be right back.
e.zh: 我在聊天里打了 brs,表示马上回来。

e.en: She sent a quick {brs} before muting her mic.
e.zh: 她静音前快速发了句 brs。

e.en: The cattle were tested for {brucellosis} last week.
e.zh: 那批牛上周接受了布鲁氏菌病检测。

e.en: Unpasteurized milk can spread {brucellosis} to humans.
e.zh: 未经巴氏消毒的牛奶可能将布鲁氏菌病传给人类。

bruges.t: n. 布鲁日（比利时城市，法语名）

e.en: We spent the weekend wandering the canals of {Bruges}.
e.zh: 我们整个周末都在布鲁日的运河边闲逛。

e.en: {Bruges} is famous for its medieval architecture and chocolate.
e.zh: 布鲁日以中世纪建筑和巧克力闻名。

brugge.t: n. 布鲁日（比利时城市，荷语名）

e.en: In Dutch, the city is spelled {Brugge}, not Bruges.
e.zh: 在荷兰语里,这座城市拼作 Brugge,而不是 Bruges。

e.en: Our train arrived in {Brugge} just before sunset.
e.zh: 我们的火车在日落前抵达了布鲁日。

bruin.t: n. 棕熊（童话中对熊的称呼）

e.en: A massive {bruin} wandered into the campsite that night.
e.zh: 那晚一头巨大的棕熊闯进了营地。

e.en: He grew up cheering for the Boston {Bruin} hockey team.
e.zh: 他从小就为波士顿棕熊冰球队加油。

bruise.t:
n. 淤青，瘀伤
v. 撞伤，擦伤

e.en: She got a nasty {bruise} on her knee from the fall.
e.zh: 她摔倒后膝盖上留下了一块难看的淤青。

e.en: Don't pack the peaches too tightly or they'll {bruise}.
e.zh: 桃子别装得太紧,不然会碰伤。

e.en: His {bruised} ego kept him quiet for the rest of dinner.
e.zh: 自尊心受挫让他整顿饭剩下的时间都没说话。

e.en: The apples at the bottom got {bruised} during shipping.
e.zh: 底下的苹果在运输中被磕碰得发青了。

e.en: That linebacker is a real {bruiser} on the field.
e.zh: 那名线卫在场上是个不折不扣的硬汉。

e.en: The bouncer was a {bruiser} nobody wanted to challenge.
e.zh: 那个保安是个壮汉,没人想招惹他。

bruises.t:
n. 淤青（复数）
v. 撞伤（第三人称单数）

e.en: The boxer's arms were covered in {bruises} after the match.
e.zh: 比赛结束后,拳击手的手臂上满是淤青。

e.en: Soft fruit easily {bruises} when stacked in plastic crates.
e.zh: 软质水果堆放在塑料筐里时很容易擦伤。

bruising.t:
adj. 激烈的，艰苦的
n. 淤青

e.en: She survived a {bruising} campaign to win the seat.
e.zh: 她挺过一场艰难的竞选,最终赢得了席位。

e.en: There's heavy {bruising} around the patient's left eye.
e.zh: 病人左眼周围有明显的淤伤。

bruit.t:
v. 散布（消息）
n. 杂音

e.en: The doctor heard a faint {bruit} over the patient's neck.
e.zh: 医生在病人颈部听到了轻微的血管杂音。

e.en: Don't {bruit} the news around until it's official.
e.zh: 消息正式公布前别到处张扬。

brummie.t: n. 伯明翰人或其口音

e.en: His thick {Brummie} accent made the audience laugh instantly.
e.zh: 他浓重的伯明翰口音瞬间逗笑了观众。

e.en: She's a proper {Brummie}, born and raised in Birmingham.
e.zh: 她是地地道道的伯明翰人,在伯明翰出生长大。

e.en: Let's grab {brunch} at that new café on Sunday.
e.zh: 周日我们去那家新开的咖啡馆吃早午餐吧。

e.en: The hotel serves a fantastic weekend {brunch} buffet.
e.zh: 那家酒店周末的早午餐自助非常棒。

e.en: {Brunei} is a small, oil-rich nation on Borneo.
e.zh: 文莱是位于婆罗洲的一个石油储量丰富的小国。

e.en: She landed a teaching job in {Brunei} last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天在文莱找到了一份教职。

brunet.t: n. 深褐色头发的男子

e.en: The tall {brunet} in the corner is my brother.
e.zh: 角落里那位高个子棕发男士是我哥哥。

e.en: He's a slim {brunet} with bright green eyes.
e.zh: 他是个瘦削的棕发男子,有一双明亮的绿眼睛。

brunette.t: n. 深褐色头发的女子

e.en: The {brunette} in the photo is my college roommate.
e.zh: 照片里那位棕发女子是我的大学室友。
