e.en: She dyed her hair from blonde back to {brunette}.
e.zh: 她把头发从金色染回了棕色。

brunswick.t: n. 不伦瑞克（德国城市）

e.en: We drove through {Brunswick} on our way to Maine.
e.zh: 我们去缅因州的路上穿过了布伦瑞克。

e.en: {Brunswick} stew is a hearty Southern dish with shredded meat.
e.zh: 布伦瑞克炖菜是一道用碎肉做的丰盛南方菜。

brunt.t: n. 主要冲击，首当其冲

e.en: Coastal towns bore the {brunt} of the hurricane.
e.zh: 沿海城镇首当其冲承受了飓风的冲击。

e.en: Junior staff took the {brunt} of the budget cuts.
e.zh: 基层员工承担了预算削减的主要冲击。

e.en: We started the meal with tomato {bruschetta} and olive oil.
e.zh: 我们用番茄烤面包配橄榄油作为开胃菜。

e.en: She toasts the bread before topping the {bruschetta}.
e.zh: 她先把面包烤一下,再放上烤面包片的配料。

brush.t:
n. 刷子，画笔
v. 刷，轻触

e.en: Don't forget to {brush} your teeth before bed.
e.zh: 睡前别忘了刷牙。

e.en: He had a close {brush} with death on the highway.
e.zh: 他在高速公路上与死神擦肩而过。

brushed.t:
v. 刷过（过去式）
adj. 拉绒的（面料）

e.en: She {brushed} the crumbs off the kitchen counter.
e.zh: 她把厨房台面上的面包屑扫掉。

e.en: He {brushed} aside my concerns and changed the subject.
e.zh: 他对我的担忧不予理会,转而换了话题。

brushes.t:
n. 刷子（复数）
v. 刷（第三人称单数）

e.en: The artist cleaned her {brushes} after every session.
e.zh: 那位画家每次画完都会清洗画笔。

e.en: He {brushes} his dog every morning to reduce shedding.
e.zh: 他每天早上给狗梳毛以减少掉毛。

brushfire.t: n. 丛林小火；小规模冲突

e.en: A {brushfire} broke out near the highway last night.
e.zh: 昨晚高速公路附近突发了一场野草火灾。

e.en: The rumor spread like a {brushfire} through the office.
e.zh: 那条谣言像野火一样在办公室里蔓延。

brushing.t:
v. 正在刷（进行时）
n. 刷拭

e.en: {Brushing} twice a day helps prevent cavities.
e.zh: 每天刷两次牙有助于预防蛀牙。

e.en: She kept {brushing} hair off her sweater all evening.
e.zh: 她整晚都在不停地拨掉毛衣上的头发。

e.en: Modern drones use {brushless} motors for better efficiency.
e.zh: 现代无人机采用无刷电机以获得更高的效率。

e.en: This {brushless} drill runs cooler and lasts longer.
e.zh: 这款无刷电钻发热更少,使用寿命更长。

e.en: Every {brushstroke} in the painting felt deliberate and bold.
e.zh: 画中的每一笔都显得既有意为之又大胆有力。

e.en: The artist signs each piece with a single red {brushstroke}.
e.zh: 那位画家在每幅作品上都签上一道红色的笔触。

e.en: They gathered {brushwood} to start a fire at camp.
e.zh: 他们捡了些枯枝准备在营地生火。

e.en: A rabbit darted out from behind the dense {brushwood}.
e.zh: 一只兔子从茂密的灌木丛后窜了出来。

e.en: The painting's delicate {brushwork} drew gasps from the crowd.
e.zh: 画作精致的笔法让观众发出阵阵惊叹。

e.en: Her loose {brushwork} gives the portraits a lively feel.
e.zh: 她奔放的笔触让人物画显得生动鲜活。

e.en: The deer disappeared into the {brushy} hillside.
e.zh: 那只鹿消失在长满灌木的山坡里。

e.en: We hiked through {brushy} terrain to reach the lake.
e.zh: 我们穿过灌木丛生的地带才到达湖边。

e.en: His {brusque} reply ended the conversation immediately.
e.zh: 他生硬的回答立刻让谈话戛然而止。

e.en: The manager has a {brusque} manner that intimidates new hires.
e.zh: 那位经理态度生硬,常让新员工感到害怕。

e.en: She {brusquely} dismissed the question and walked away.
e.zh: 她不耐烦地打发了那个问题,转身走开。

e.en: He answered {brusquely}, clearly annoyed by the interruption.
e.zh: 他回答得很冲,显然对被打断感到恼火。

e.en: His {brusqueness} on calls often unsettles new clients.
e.zh: 他在电话里态度生硬,常让新客户感到不安。

e.en: The waiter's {brusqueness} ruined an otherwise lovely dinner.
e.zh: 服务员态度的粗鲁毁了一顿原本愉快的晚餐。

brussels.t: n. 布鲁塞尔（比利时首都）

e.en: The summit will be held in {Brussels} next month.
e.zh: 峰会下个月将在布鲁塞尔举行。

e.en: I roast {Brussels} sprouts with bacon every Thanksgiving.
e.zh: 每年感恩节我都会用培根烤孢子甘蓝。

e.en: We toasted the new year with a bottle of {brut} champagne.
e.zh: 我们用一瓶干型香槟庆祝了新年。

e.en: She prefers {brut} over sweeter sparkling wines at dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时她更喜欢干型起泡酒,而不是偏甜的款。

e.en: The training schedule was absolutely {brutal} that summer.
e.zh: 那年夏天的训练安排简直惨无人道。

e.en: His {brutal} honesty sometimes hurts people's feelings.
e.zh: 他直白得过分的诚实有时会伤到别人的感情。

brutalise.t: v. 使变残忍，粗暴对待（英式拼写）

e.en: Years of war can {brutalise} even the gentlest soldier.
e.zh: 长年的战争连最温和的士兵也会变得冷酷。

e.en: The film shows how prison life can {brutalise} young inmates.
e.zh: 这部影片展现了监狱生活如何让年轻犯人变得麻木冷酷。

e.en: The report documented widespread police {brutality} in the city.
e.zh: 报告记录了该市普遍存在的警察暴力行为。

e.en: Witnesses were shocked by the sheer {brutality} of the attack.
e.zh: 目击者对那次袭击的极端残暴感到震惊。

e.en: The novel explores the {brutalization} of soldiers in combat.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了士兵在战斗中变得冷酷无情的过程。

e.en: Activists protested the {brutalization} of detainees in custody.
e.zh: 活动人士抗议拘留中对被关押者的残暴对待。

brutalize.t: v. 使变残忍，粗暴对待

e.en: Constant violence can {brutalize} an entire generation.
e.zh: 持续的暴力会让整整一代人变得冷酷无情。

e.en: Guards were accused of trying to {brutalize} the prisoners.
e.zh: 看守被指控企图对囚犯施以残暴对待。

brutalized.t:
adj. 遭虐待的
v. 粗暴对待（过去式）

e.en: The refugees had been {brutalized} by years of civil war.
e.zh: 那些难民因多年的内战而饱受摧残。

e.en: He felt {brutalized} by the long hours and constant pressure.
e.zh: 长时间工作和持续的压力让他感到身心俱疲。

e.en: She was {brutally} honest about my chances of winning.
e.zh: 她直言不讳地告诉我获胜的可能性有多小。

e.en: The regime {brutally} suppressed every form of dissent.
e.zh: 该政权以残暴手段镇压一切异见。

brute.t:
n. 野兽，畜生
adj. 蛮力的

e.en: It took {brute} force to pry the door open.
e.zh: 硬是用蛮力才把门撬开。

e.en: Hackers used {brute} force to crack the weak password.
e.zh: 黑客用暴力破解的方式攻破了那个弱密码。

e.en: His {brutish} table manners embarrassed everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的餐桌礼仪让晚餐席上的所有人都很尴尬。

e.en: Life in the camp was cold, hungry, and {brutish}.
e.zh: 营地里的生活又冷又饿,粗鄙不堪。

e.en: The village of {Bruton} is known for its art galleries.
e.zh: 布鲁顿这个小镇以艺术画廊闻名。

e.en: We stopped for lunch at a quiet pub in {Bruton}.
e.zh: 我们在布鲁顿一家安静的酒馆停下来吃了午饭。

brutus.t: n. 布鲁图斯（罗马人名）

e.en: In Shakespeare's play, {Brutus} betrays his close friend Caesar.
e.zh: 在莎士比亚的剧中,布鲁图斯背叛了他的挚友凯撒。

e.en: She named her loyal Labrador {Brutus} after the Roman senator.
e.zh: 她按那位罗马元老的名字给她忠诚的拉布拉多取名布鲁图斯。

bryony.t:
n. 泻根（一种攀缘植物）
n. 布里奥妮（女名）

e.en: Wild {bryony} climbs over the hedge every summer.
e.zh: 每到夏天,野泻根就会爬满篱笆。

e.en: The roots of {bryony} are toxic if eaten raw.
e.zh: 泻根的根部生吃有毒。

e.en: Each {bryozoan} colony forms delicate, lace-like patterns underwater.
e.zh: 每个苔藓虫群落都会在水下形成精致的花边状图案。

e.en: Divers found a rare {bryozoan} clinging to the shipwreck.
e.zh: 潜水员在沉船上发现了一种罕见的苔藓虫。

bsa.t: n. 英国标准协会（British Standards Association）

e.en: The {BSA} oversees scouting programs across the United States.
e.zh: 美国童子军组织管理着全美的童军项目。

e.en: We added {BSA} to the buffer to stabilize the protein.
e.zh: 我们在缓冲液中加入牛血清白蛋白以稳定蛋白质。

bsb.t: n. 英国卫星广播公司（British Satellite Broadcasting）

e.en: Please send the payment to my account using this {BSB} number.
e.zh: 请使用这个银行代码把款项转到我的账户。

e.en: Australian banks require a six-digit {BSB} for domestic transfers.
e.zh: 澳大利亚银行进行国内转账需要六位数的银行代码。

bsc.t: n. 理学学士学位（Bachelor of Science）

e.en: She earned a {BSc} in computer science last year.
e.zh: 她去年获得了计算机科学的理学学士学位。

e.en: Most engineering jobs require at least a {BSc} degree.
e.zh: 大多数工程岗位至少要求理学学士学位。

bse.t: n. 疯牛病（牛海绵状脑病）

e.en: The outbreak of {BSE} devastated British beef exports in the 1990s.
e.zh: 上世纪九十年代疯牛病的爆发重创了英国牛肉出口。

e.en: Scientists traced the {BSE} epidemic to contaminated animal feed.
e.zh: 科学家把疯牛病疫情追溯到受污染的动物饲料。

bsi.t: n. 英国标准协会（British Standards Institution）

e.en: The product meets all {BSI} standards for electrical safety.
e.zh: 该产品符合英国标准协会的所有电气安全标准。

e.en: {BSI} publishes thousands of technical standards each year.
e.zh: 英国标准协会每年发布数千项技术标准。

bskyb.t: n. 英国天空广播公司

e.en: {BSkyB} once dominated pay-television in the United Kingdom.
e.zh: 英国天空广播公司曾主导英国的付费电视市场。

e.en: Comcast eventually acquired {BSkyB} after a long bidding war.
e.zh: 经过漫长的竞购,康卡斯特最终收购了英国天空广播公司。

bsl.t: n. 英国手语（British Sign Language）

e.en: She learned {BSL} to communicate with her deaf cousin.
e.zh: 她学习英国手语以便和失聪的表弟交流。

e.en: The lecture was interpreted live into {BSL} for the audience.
e.zh: 讲座现场被同步翻译成英国手语供观众观看。

bsp.t: n. 菲律宾中央银行；也指二叉空间分割

e.en: The {BSP} raised interest rates to control inflation.
e.zh: 菲律宾中央银行提高利率以抑制通胀。

e.en: Our game engine bakes the {BSP} tree during level compilation.
e.zh: 我们的游戏引擎在关卡编译时生成BSP空间分割树。

bst.t: n. 英国夏令时间（British Summer Time）

e.en: The meeting starts at 3 PM {BST} tomorrow.
e.zh: 会议将在明天英国夏令时下午三点开始。

e.en: London clocks switch to {BST} on the last Sunday of March.
e.zh: 伦敦的时钟在三月的最后一个星期日切换到英国夏令时。

bta.t: n. 英国旅游局（British Tourist Authority）

e.en: The {BTA} promotes British tourism to international visitors.
e.zh: 英国旅游局向国际游客推广英国旅游。

e.en: Travelers should check the latest {BTA} guidelines before booking.
e.zh: 旅客在预订前应查看最新的英国旅游局指南。

btec.t: n. 英国商业与技术教育委员会证书

e.en: He completed a {BTEC} in engineering before starting his apprenticeship.
e.zh: 他在开始学徒培训前修完了工程类的BTEC课程。

e.en: Many universities accept {BTEC} qualifications alongside A-levels.
e.zh: 许多大学接受BTEC资格证书作为A-level的替代。

btr.t: n. 缩写，依语境而定（罕用）

e.en: The {BTR} sector is booming as more people rent long-term.
e.zh: 随着更多人长期租房,租赁住宅行业正蓬勃发展。

e.en: Investors poured millions into {BTR} developments last quarter.
e.zh: 投资者上个季度向租赁住宅项目投入了数百万资金。

bub.t: n. 小子，老兄（非正式称呼）

e.en: Hey {bub}, can you pass me that wrench?
e.zh: 嘿哥们,能把那把扳手递给我吗?

e.en: Watch where you're going, {bub}, this isn't a playground.
e.zh: 看着点路,老兄,这里不是游乐场。

bubba.t: n. 老兄，哥们（美国南方俚语）

e.en: My little brother {Bubba} loves playing in the backyard.
e.zh: 我的小弟弟巴巴最喜欢在后院玩耍。

e.en: The dog wagged its tail when {Bubba} came home.
e.zh: 巴巴回家时,小狗摇着尾巴迎接他。

bubble.t:
n. 气泡；泡沫
v. 冒泡，沸腾

e.en: The child blew a giant {bubble} with her gum.
e.zh: 那个小孩用口香糖吹出一个巨大的泡泡。

e.en: Many analysts warn of a housing {bubble} in major cities.
e.zh: 许多分析师警告大城市存在房地产泡沫。

bubblegum.t:
n. 泡泡糖
adj. 轻快俏皮的（流行乐风格）

e.en: She chewed {bubblegum} loudly during the entire movie.
e.zh: 她整场电影都在大声地嚼泡泡糖。

e.en: The walls were painted a cheerful {bubblegum} pink.
e.zh: 墙壁被刷成欢快的泡泡糖粉色。

bubbles.t:
n. 气泡（复数）
v. 冒泡（第三人称单数）

e.en: Children love chasing {bubbles} in the summer breeze.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在夏日的微风中追逐泡泡。

e.en: Champagne {bubbles} rose slowly to the top of the glass.
e.zh: 香槟的气泡缓缓升到酒杯顶端。

bubbling.t:
v. 冒泡（现在分词）
adj. 活泼的，兴高采烈的

e.en: The soup was {bubbling} gently on the stove.
e.zh: 汤在炉子上轻轻地咕嘟咕嘟冒泡。

e.en: She was {bubbling} with excitement about her promotion.
e.zh: 她为升职的事兴奋得不得了。

bubbly.t:
adj. 起泡的；活泼开朗的
n. 香槟

e.en: Her {bubbly} personality makes everyone feel welcome.
e.zh: 她活泼开朗的性格让每个人都感到被欢迎。

e.en: Let's open a bottle of {bubbly} to celebrate.
e.zh: 我们开一瓶香槟来庆祝吧。

bubonic.t: adj. 腺的，淋巴腺的（多用于 bubonic plague 腺鼠疫）

e.en: The {bubonic} plague killed millions during the Middle Ages.
e.zh: 黑死病在中世纪造成数百万人死亡。

e.en: Doctors can now treat {bubonic} plague effectively with antibiotics.
e.zh: 医生现在可以用抗生素有效治疗腺鼠疫。

e.en: The dentist examined the {buccal} surface of her molars.
e.zh: 牙医检查了她臼齿的颊侧表面。

e.en: Researchers collected DNA using a simple {buccal} swab.
e.zh: 研究人员用简单的口腔拭子采集了DNA样本。

e.en: The film portrays a fearless {buccaneer} sailing the Caribbean.
e.zh: 这部影片描绘了一位无畏的海盗在加勒比海上航行。

e.en: He's a real {buccaneer} in the world of tech startups.
e.zh: 在科技创业界他是个真正的冒险家。

buccaneered.t: v. 当海盗，劫掠（过去式）

e.en: The crew {buccaneered} along the coast for nearly a decade.
e.zh: 那帮人在海岸沿线当了将近十年的海盗。

e.en: He {buccaneered} his way through the corporate world ruthlessly.
e.zh: 他在商界一路横行霸道地闯荡。

buccaneering.t:
n. 海盗行为
adj. 冒险投机的

e.en: His {buccaneering} approach to business made him many enemies.
e.zh: 他冒险激进的经营方式给他树了不少敌人。

e.en: The startup founder is known for his {buccaneering} spirit.
e.zh: 这位创业者以其敢闯敢拼的冒险精神闻名。

e.en: Tampa Bay {Buccaneers} won the Super Bowl that year.
e.zh: 那一年坦帕湾海盗队赢得了超级碗冠军。

e.en: The novel follows a band of {buccaneers} across the high seas.
e.zh: 小说讲述一群海盗在大海上的冒险故事。

buccleuch.t: n. 巴克卢（苏格兰公爵家族姓氏）

e.en: The Duke of {Buccleuch} owns vast estates across Scotland.
e.zh: 巴克卢公爵在苏格兰拥有大片庄园。

e.en: We toured {Buccleuch} House during our trip to the Borders.
e.zh: 我们在边境地区旅行时参观了巴克卢宅邸。

buchan.t: n. 布坎（姓氏/苏格兰地名）

e.en: John {Buchan} wrote the famous thriller The Thirty-Nine Steps.
e.zh: 约翰·巴肯写了著名的惊悚小说《三十九级台阶》。

e.en: The {Buchan} oilfield remains an important site in the North Sea.
e.zh: 布坎油田至今仍是北海的重要油田。

e.en: James {Buchanan} served as the fifteenth president of the United States.
e.zh: 詹姆斯·布坎南是美国第十五任总统。

e.en: Daisy {Buchanan} is a central character in The Great Gatsby.
e.zh: 黛西·布坎南是《了不起的盖茨比》中的核心人物。

bucharest.t: n. 布加勒斯特（罗马尼亚首都）

e.en: We spent a long weekend exploring the old town of {Bucharest}.
e.zh: 我们用一个长周末游览了布加勒斯特老城区。

e.en: {Bucharest} is the capital and largest city of Romania.
e.zh: 布加勒斯特是罗马尼亚的首都也是最大的城市。

buck.t:
n. 美元；雄鹿
v. （马）尥蹶子；反抗

e.en: Can you lend me a {buck} for the vending machine?
e.zh: 能借我一块钱用自动售货机吗?

e.en: The young {buck} darted across the forest trail.
e.zh: 那只年轻的雄鹿快速穿过林间小路。

buckaroo.t: n. 牛仔（美国西部俚语）

e.en: Hold on tight, little {buckaroo}, the ride gets bumpy.
e.zh: 抓紧了,小牛仔,这一程会很颠簸。

e.en: The old {buckaroo} could rope a steer in seconds.
e.zh: 那位老牛仔几秒钟就能套住一头公牛。

e.en: The settlers loaded their belongings onto a wooden {buckboard}.
e.zh: 拓荒者们把家当装上了一辆木制马车。

e.en: A horse-drawn {buckboard} bounced along the dusty trail.
e.zh: 一辆马拉的轻便马车在尘土飞扬的小路上颠簸前行。

bucket.t:
n. 水桶；一桶的量
v. 倾盆而下

e.en: She filled a {bucket} with soapy water to wash the car.
e.zh: 她装了一桶肥皂水来洗车。

e.en: Visiting Japan has been on my {bucket} list for years.
e.zh: 去日本旅行一直是我多年来的愿望清单之一。

e.en: The kids brought back a {bucketful} of seashells from the beach.
e.zh: 孩子们从海滩上带回了一整桶贝壳。

e.en: She poured a {bucketful} of water over the smoking grill.
e.zh: 她把一整桶水浇在冒烟的烧烤架上。

e.en: It's been raining {buckets} all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午都在下倾盆大雨。

e.en: They carried wooden {buckets} from the well each morning.
e.zh: 他们每天早晨从井里提着木桶打水。

e.en: Ohio is often called the {Buckeye} State.
e.zh: 俄亥俄州常被称为七叶树之州。

e.en: He picked up a shiny {buckeye} from beneath the tree.
e.zh: 他从树下捡起了一颗光亮的七叶树果。

bucking.t: v. （马）尥蹶子；反抗（现在分词）

e.en: The wild horse kept {bucking} until the rider fell off.
e.zh: 那匹野马不停地尥蹶子,直到骑手摔了下来。

e.en: The startup is {bucking} the trend by hiring during the recession.
e.zh: 这家创业公司逆势而行,在经济衰退期间反而招人。

buckingham.t: n. 白金汉（英国地名/宫名）

e.en: Tourists gather outside {Buckingham} Palace to watch the changing of the guard.
e.zh: 游客们聚集在白金汉宫外观看换岗仪式。

e.en: The Duke of {Buckingham} was a powerful figure at the royal court.
e.zh: 白金汉公爵在王室中是个权势显赫的人物。

buckinghamshire.t: n. 白金汉郡（英格兰郡名）

e.en: They moved to a quiet village in {Buckinghamshire} last spring.
e.zh: 他们去年春天搬到了白金汉郡的一个安静村庄。

e.en: {Buckinghamshire} is known for its rolling hills and historic homes.
e.zh: 白金汉郡以连绵起伏的丘陵和历史悠久的宅邸闻名。

e.en: William {Buckland} was a pioneering geologist of the early 1800s.
e.zh: 威廉·巴克兰是十九世纪初一位开创性的地质学家。

e.en: The village of {Buckland} sits quietly in the English countryside.
e.zh: 巴克兰村静静地坐落在英国的乡间。

buckle.t:
n. 带扣，搭扣
v. 扣紧；压弯

e.en: Please {buckle} your seatbelt before takeoff.
e.zh: 请在起飞前系好安全带。

e.en: Her belt had a beautiful silver {buckle}.
e.zh: 她的腰带上有一个漂亮的银色搭扣。

buckled.t:
v. 扣上（buckle 过去式）
adj. 变形的

e.en: He {buckled} his helmet before climbing onto the bike.
e.zh: 他在骑上自行车前扣紧了头盔。

e.en: Her knees {buckled} when she heard the shocking news.
e.zh: 听到那个令人震惊的消息时,她的双膝一软。

e.en: The knight raised his small {buckler} to deflect the blow.
e.zh: 骑士举起小圆盾来挡开那一击。

e.en: Medieval fighters often paired a sword with a {buckler}.
e.zh: 中世纪的战士常把剑和小圆盾搭配使用。

buckling.t:
n. 屈曲，压屈变形
v. 扣紧（buckle 现在分词）

e.en: The old bookshelf is {buckling} under the weight of the encyclopedias.
e.zh: 那个旧书架在百科全书的重压下快要弯塌了。

e.en: Engineers tested the column to prevent {buckling} under heavy loads.
e.zh: 工程师测试柱子以防止在重载下发生屈曲。

e.en: Listen here, {bucko}, you can't park in that spot.
e.zh: 听好了,老兄,你不能停在那个位子。

e.en: Easy there, {bucko}, no need to get angry.
e.zh: 冷静点,小子,没必要发火。

e.en: The book was bound in dark green {buckram} cloth.
e.zh: 这本书用深绿色的硬麻布做了装订。

e.en: Tailors used {buckram} to stiffen the collar of the jacket.
e.zh: 裁缝用硬麻布来使夹克的领子挺括。

bucks.t: n. 美元（俚语）；雄鹿（复数）

e.en: That jacket cost me almost two hundred {bucks}.
e.zh: 那件夹克花了我将近两百美元。

e.en: The Milwaukee {Bucks} won the championship that season.
e.zh: 密尔沃基雄鹿队那个赛季夺得了总冠军。

e.en: The hunter loaded his shotgun with heavy {buckshot}.
e.zh: 猎人把粗鹿弹装进了他的霰弹枪。

e.en: Pellets of {buckshot} scattered widely across the target.
e.zh: 鹿弹的弹丸在靶面上散布得很广。

e.en: The cowboy wore soft {buckskin} gloves while riding.
e.zh: 那位牛仔骑马时戴着柔软的鹿皮手套。

e.en: She admired the fringed {buckskin} jacket in the museum.
e.zh: 她在博物馆欣赏着那件有流苏的鹿皮夹克。

e.en: Invasive {buckthorn} is choking native plants in the forest.
e.zh: 入侵的鼠李正在挤压森林里的原生植物。

e.en: Volunteers worked all weekend to remove {buckthorn} from the park.
e.zh: 志愿者们整个周末都在公园里清除鼠李。

e.en: She made fluffy {buckwheat} pancakes for breakfast.
e.zh: 她做了松软的荞麦煎饼当早餐。

e.en: {Buckwheat} noodles are popular in Japanese cuisine.
e.zh: 荞麦面在日本料理中很受欢迎。

buckyball.t: n. 巴基球（C60 富勒烯分子）

e.en: The {buckyball} molecule contains sixty carbon atoms.
e.zh: 巴克球分子包含六十个碳原子。

e.en: Scientists discovered the {buckyball} structure in 1985.
e.zh: 科学家在1985年发现了巴克球结构。

e.en: The painting captures a {bucolic} village scene.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了一幅田园乡村景象。

e.en: They retired to a {bucolic} cottage in Vermont.
e.zh: 他们退休后搬到佛蒙特州一栋田园小屋。

bud.t:
n. 芽，花蕾
v. 发芽

e.en: A tiny {bud} appeared on the rose stem.
e.zh: 玫瑰枝上冒出一个小花苞。

e.en: Hey {bud}, can you pass me the wrench?
e.zh: 哥们儿,能把扳手递给我吗?

buda.t: n. 布达（布达佩斯西半部）

e.en: {Buda} sits on the western bank of the Danube.
e.zh: 布达位于多瑙河的西岸。

e.en: We toured the historic castle in {Buda}.
e.zh: 我们参观了布达的古老城堡。

budapest.t: n. 布达佩斯（匈牙利首都）

e.en: {Budapest} is famous for its thermal baths.
e.zh: 布达佩斯以温泉浴池闻名。

e.en: We took a night cruise along the Danube in {Budapest}.
e.zh: 我们在布达佩斯乘船夜游多瑙河。

e.en: A golden {Buddha} statue stood in the temple courtyard.
e.zh: 一尊金佛像矗立在寺院庭院中。

e.en: The {Buddha} taught the path to enlightenment.
e.zh: 佛陀教导通往觉悟的道路。

e.en: {Buddhism} spread from India across much of Asia.
e.zh: 佛教从印度传播到亚洲大部分地区。

e.en: She studies Zen {Buddhism} in her free time.
e.zh: 她空闲时研究禅宗佛教。

buddhist.t:
n. 佛教徒
adj. 佛教的

e.en: He became a {Buddhist} monk after college.
e.zh: 他大学毕业后成为一名佛教僧侣。

e.en: The {Buddhist} temple welcomes visitors every weekend.
e.zh: 这座佛寺每个周末都欢迎访客。

e.en: My old {buddie} from school called me yesterday.
e.zh: 我学生时代的老伙伴昨天给我打电话了。

e.en: Hey {buddie}, want to grab a beer tonight?
e.zh: 哥们儿,今晚想去喝杯啤酒吗?

e.en: My college {buddies} still meet up every summer.
e.zh: 我的大学好友每年夏天还会聚一次。

e.en: The two boys became {buddies} on the first day.
e.zh: 两个男孩第一天就成了好朋友。

budding.t: adj. 初露头角的，刚萌芽的

e.en: She is a {budding} novelist with real talent.
e.zh: 她是一位崭露头角且很有天赋的小说家。

e.en: The cherry trees are {budding} early this spring.
e.zh: 今年春天樱花树发芽得很早。

e.en: Butterflies love the purple flowers of the {buddleia}.
e.zh: 蝴蝶喜爱醉鱼草的紫色花朵。

e.en: She planted a {buddleia} near the garden fence.
e.zh: 她在花园围栏边种了一株醉鱼草。

e.en: My best {buddy} helped me move last weekend.
e.zh: 我最好的哥们儿上周末帮我搬了家。

e.en: Hey {buddy}, you dropped your wallet over there.
e.zh: 哥们儿,你的钱包掉在那边了。

e.en: We surfed the rocky beaches near {Bude}.
e.zh: 我们在比德附近的礁石海滩冲浪。

e.en: {Bude} is a charming seaside town in Cornwall.
e.zh: 比德是康沃尔郡一个迷人的海滨小镇。

e.en: The heavy crate wouldn't {budge} an inch.
e.zh: 那个沉重的箱子一寸也挪不动。

e.en: He refused to {budge} on the asking price.
e.zh: 他在要价上一步也不肯让。

e.en: Her pet {budgerigar} can mimic short phrases.
e.zh: 她养的虎皮鹦鹉能模仿简短的短语。

e.en: The blue {budgerigar} chirped happily in its cage.
e.zh: 那只蓝色虎皮鹦鹉在笼子里欢快地叫着。

budget.t:
n. 预算
adj. 经济型的

e.en: We need to stay within the project {budget}.
e.zh: 我们必须把开支控制在项目预算之内。

e.en: The film was made on a tiny {budget}.
e.zh: 这部电影是用极少的预算拍成的。

e.en: The team faces serious {budgetary} constraints this quarter.
e.zh: 团队本季度面临严重的预算限制。

e.en: Congress debated {budgetary} reforms for weeks.
e.zh: 国会就预算改革辩论了数周。

budgeted.t: v. 已编入预算（budget 过去式）

e.en: We {budgeted} two thousand dollars for the trip.
e.zh: 我们为这次旅行预算了两千美元。

e.en: The renovation cost more than originally {budgeted}.
e.zh: 装修费用超出了原先的预算。

budgeting.t:
n. 预算编制
v. 编制预算

e.en: {Budgeting} apps help young people manage their money.
e.zh: 记账应用能帮助年轻人管理资金。

e.en: Careful {budgeting} let them save for a house.
e.zh: 精心的预算让他们攒钱买了房。

e.en: Marketing {budgets} have been cut across the company.
e.zh: 公司各部门的营销预算都被削减了。

e.en: She {budgets} carefully every month for groceries.
e.zh: 她每个月都仔细安排买菜的开销。

budgie.t: n. 虎皮鹦鹉（budgerigar 口语）

e.en: Our green {budgie} loves to sit on my shoulder.
e.zh: 我们那只绿色的虎皮鹦鹉喜欢站在我肩上。

e.en: The {budgie} learned to say hello in a week.
e.zh: 这只虎皮鹦鹉一周就学会说你好了。

e.en: Tiny green {buds} are appearing on the branches.
e.zh: 嫩绿的花苞正在枝头冒出来。

e.en: My wireless ear{buds} died right before the meeting.
e.zh: 我的无线耳塞在开会前刚好没电了。

e.en: He ordered a cold {Budweiser} at the bar.
e.zh: 他在酒吧点了一瓶冰镇百威啤酒。

e.en: {Budweiser} sponsors many major sports events worldwide.
e.zh: 百威赞助了全球许多大型体育赛事。

buenos.t: adj. 好的（西语）；常见于 Buenos Aires

e.en: We spent a week exploring {Buenos} Aires last spring.
e.zh: 我们去年春天花了一周游览布宜诺斯艾利斯。

e.en: {Buenos} Aires is famous for tango and steak.
e.zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯以探戈和牛排闻名。

e.en: The airport code for Buffalo is {BUF}.
e.zh: 布法罗机场的代码是 BUF。

e.en: She booked a flight from JFK to {BUF}.
e.zh: 她订了一张从肯尼迪机场飞往 BUF 的机票。

buff.t:
n. 爱好者；米黄色
v. 抛光；(游戏) 增强

e.en: My brother is a serious history {buff}.
e.zh: 我哥哥是个十足的历史爱好者。

e.en: He goes to the gym daily to get {buff}.
e.zh: 他每天去健身房想练得壮一点。

e.en: A herd of {buffalo} crossed the dusty plain.
e.zh: 一群水牛穿过尘土飞扬的平原。

e.en: We ordered spicy {buffalo} wings at the bar.
e.zh: 我们在酒吧点了辣味水牛城鸡翅。

buffed.t:
v. 抛光（过去式）
adj. 肌肉发达的

e.en: He {buffed} his shoes until they shone.
e.zh: 他把鞋擦得锃亮。

e.en: The character got {buffed} in the latest patch.
e.zh: 这个角色在最新的补丁中被增强了。

buffer.t:
n. 缓冲区；缓冲物
v. 缓冲

e.en: The video keeps stopping to {buffer} on my phone.
e.zh: 视频在我手机上一直卡着缓冲。

e.en: A wide lawn acts as a {buffer} between houses.
e.zh: 宽阔的草坪在房屋之间起到缓冲作用。

buffered.t:
adj. 已缓冲的
v. 缓冲（过去式）

e.en: The data is {buffered} before being written to disk.
e.zh: 数据在写入磁盘前会先被缓存。

e.en: Trees {buffered} the cottage from highway noise.
e.zh: 树木为小屋阻挡了高速公路的噪音。

e.en: The stream keeps {buffering} during the big game.
e.zh: 重要比赛期间直播一直在缓冲。

e.en: Slow Wi-Fi causes constant {buffering} on Netflix.
e.zh: 网速慢导致 Netflix 不停地缓冲。

e.en: Open editor {buffers} are listed in the sidebar.
e.zh: 侧边栏列出了所有打开的编辑器缓冲区。

e.en: Forests act as natural {buffers} against flooding.
e.zh: 森林起到防洪的天然缓冲作用。

buffet.t:
n. 自助餐
v. 反复打击

e.en: The hotel offers a free breakfast {buffet}.
e.zh: 酒店提供免费的自助早餐。

e.en: Strong winds {buffet} the coast every winter.
e.zh: 每年冬天强风都会猛烈拍打海岸。

buffeting.t:
n. 连续冲击
v. 反复拍打（buffet 的现在分词）

e.en: The plane shook from heavy turbulence {buffeting} the wings.
e.zh: 飞机因强烈气流冲击机翼而剧烈颠簸。

e.en: Waves kept {buffeting} the small fishing boat.
e.zh: 海浪不断拍打着那艘小渔船。

e.en: He acted like a complete {buffoon} at the party.
e.zh: 他在派对上表现得像个十足的小丑。

e.en: The politician was dismissed as a loud {buffoon}.
e.zh: 那位政客被人们当作一个聒噪的小丑而不予理睬。

buffooneries.t: n. 滑稽举动（buffoonery 的复数）

e.en: His endless {buffooneries} embarrassed the whole family.
e.zh: 他没完没了的滑稽行为让全家人都很难堪。

e.en: The clown's {buffooneries} kept the children laughing.
e.zh: 小丑的滑稽表演逗得孩子们一直在笑。

e.en: The meeting descended into pure {buffoonery}.
e.zh: 会议彻底沦为一场闹剧。

e.en: Voters are tired of political {buffoonery}.
e.zh: 选民们已经厌倦了政治闹剧。

buffoonish.t: adj. 像小丑一样的；滑稽可笑的

e.en: His {buffoonish} antics ruined the serious moment.
e.zh: 他滑稽搞笑的举动毁掉了那个严肃的时刻。

e.en: The character is portrayed as charming but {buffoonish}.
e.zh: 这个角色被塑造得既迷人又有些滑稽。

buffoons.t: n. 小丑们（buffoon 的复数）

e.en: The committee was full of pompous {buffoons}.
e.zh: 委员会里全是自负的小丑。

e.en: Critics dismissed the cast as untalented {buffoons}.
e.zh: 评论家把这群演员斥为毫无才华的小丑。

e.en: {Buffy} the Vampire Slayer remains a cult classic.
e.zh: 《吸血鬼猎人巴菲》至今仍是邪典经典。

e.en: She named her cat {Buffy} after the show.
e.zh: 她以那部剧给猫取名巴菲。

bug.t:
n. 程序漏洞；虫子
v. 烦扰；装窃听器

e.en: I found a nasty {bug} in the login flow.
e.zh: 我在登录流程里发现了一个棘手的 bug。

e.en: A small {bug} crawled across the kitchen counter.
e.zh: 一只小虫子爬过厨房台面。

bugaboo.t: n. 令人烦恼的事；假想的恐惧

e.en: Public speaking has always been my biggest {bugaboo}.
e.zh: 当众演讲一直是我最害怕的事。

e.en: Inflation remains the central bank's main {bugaboo}.
e.zh: 通胀仍然是央行最头疼的问题。

bugatti.t: n. 布加迪（豪华跑车品牌）

e.en: He drove a sleek black {Bugatti} down the highway.
e.zh: 他驾驶着一辆流线型黑色布加迪在高速上飞驰。

e.en: The {Bugatti} Chiron can exceed three hundred miles per hour.
e.zh: 布加迪 Chiron 时速可超过三百英里。

bugbear.t: n. 令人烦恼或恐惧的事物

e.en: Long meetings are my biggest {bugbear} at work.
e.zh: 冗长的会议是我工作中最讨厌的事。

e.en: Rising rents remain a constant {bugbear} for tenants.
e.zh: 不断上涨的房租始终是租客的一大烦恼。

bugger.t:
n. 家伙（俚语）
v. 搞砸；烦扰

e.en: Oh {bugger}, I forgot my keys at home.
e.zh: 该死,我把钥匙忘在家里了。

e.en: That little {bugger} ate the last cookie.
e.zh: 那个小家伙吃掉了最后一块饼干。

e.en: The novel doesn't make any {buggery} sense to me.
e.zh: 这本小说对我来说完全狗屁不通。

e.en: He cursed and shouted, what the {buggery} happened?
e.zh: 他咒骂着喊道,这他妈到底怎么回事?

bugging.t: v. 窃听；烦扰（bug 的现在分词）

e.en: Stop {bugging} me about the report deadline.
e.zh: 别再为报告截止日期烦我了。

e.en: That weird noise has been {bugging} me all day.
e.zh: 那个奇怪的声音一整天都让我心烦。

buggy.t:
n. 婴儿车；小车
adj. 有漏洞的

e.en: This new app is way too {buggy} to use.
e.zh: 这款新应用 bug 太多,根本没法用。

e.en: The toddler napped peacefully in his {buggy}.
e.zh: 小宝宝在婴儿车里安静地睡着。

bugle.t:
n. 军号；喇叭
v. 吹号

e.en: The soldier played a {bugle} call at sunrise.
e.zh: 士兵在日出时吹响了号角。

e.en: A lone {bugle} echoed across the quiet field.
e.zh: 一支孤独的军号在寂静的原野上回响。

e.en: The {bugler} signaled the start of the ceremony.
e.zh: 号手吹号宣告仪式开始。

e.en: Every morning the camp {bugler} woke the troops.
e.zh: 每天早上营地号手叫醒部队。

bugling.t: v. 吹号（bugle 的现在分词）

e.en: The elk were {bugling} loudly during mating season.
e.zh: 麋鹿在交配季节大声鸣叫。

e.en: He spent the dawn {bugling} on a brass horn.
e.zh: 他在黎明时分用铜号吹奏号声。

bugs.t: n. 漏洞；虫子（bug 的复数）

e.en: The new app still has a few annoying {bugs}.
e.zh: 这款新应用还有几个烦人的漏洞。

e.en: Tiny {bugs} crawled across the kitchen counter.
e.zh: 小虫子在厨房台面上爬来爬去。

e.en: My grandfather drove an old blue {Buick} sedan.
e.zh: 我祖父开着一辆旧的蓝色别克轿车。

e.en: The {Buick} parked outside was polished to a shine.
e.zh: 停在外面的别克车被擦得锃亮。

build.t:
v. 建造；构建
n. 体格；版本

e.en: They plan to {build} a treehouse this summer.
e.zh: 他们打算今年夏天搭一座树屋。

e.en: Developers can {build} the project with a single command.
e.zh: 开发者只需一条命令就能构建该项目。

buildable.t: adj. 可建造的；适合建设的

e.en: The vacant lot is fully {buildable} under current zoning.
e.zh: 按现行分区规定,这块空地完全可以建造。

e.en: Make sure the codebase remains {buildable} after every commit.
e.zh: 确保每次提交后代码库都能成功构建。

e.en: The {builder} promised to finish the kitchen by June.
e.zh: 建筑商承诺六月前完成厨房工程。

e.en: This website {builder} lets you drag and drop elements.
e.zh: 这个网站构建器支持拖放元素。

builders.t: n. 建造者们（builder 的复数）

e.en: Local {builders} restored the historic church last year.
e.zh: 当地建筑工人去年修复了那座历史教堂。

e.en: Game {builders} use this engine for cross-platform releases.
e.zh: 游戏开发者用这个引擎做跨平台发布。

building.t:
n. 建筑物
v. 建造（build 的现在分词）

e.en: The tallest {building} in the city has eighty floors.
e.zh: 市内最高的大楼有八十层。

e.en: She is {building} a small business from scratch.
e.zh: 她正在从零开始打造一家小公司。

e.en: Many old {buildings} downtown have been carefully preserved.
e.zh: 市中心许多老建筑都被精心保护下来。

e.en: Tall office {buildings} surround the central park.
e.zh: 高高的写字楼环绕着中央公园。

builds.t:
n. 构建版本
v. 建造（第三人称单数）

e.en: The CI server {builds} the project every few minutes.
e.zh: 持续集成服务器每隔几分钟构建一次项目。

e.en: Regular exercise {builds} both strength and confidence.
e.zh: 经常锻炼能增强体力,也能增强自信。

e.en: There was a slow {buildup} of dust on the shelves.
e.zh: 架子上慢慢积起了一层灰尘。

e.en: The film's {buildup} to the climax felt very tense.
e.zh: 影片向高潮的铺垫感觉非常紧张。

built.t:
v. 建造（build 的过去式）
adj. 体格结实的

e.en: They {built} a cabin near the lake last summer.
e.zh: 他们去年夏天在湖边建了一间小木屋。

e.en: This phone is {built} to survive accidental drops.
e.zh: 这款手机的设计能承受意外跌落。

bukhara.t: n. 布哈拉（乌兹别克斯坦城市）

e.en: Travelers admire the ancient mosques of {Bukhara}.
e.zh: 旅行者们赞叹布哈拉古老的清真寺。

e.en: {Bukhara} was once a major hub on the Silk Road.
e.zh: 布哈拉曾是丝绸之路上的重要枢纽。

bulawayo.t: n. 布拉瓦约（津巴布韦城市）

e.en: {Bulawayo} is the second-largest city in Zimbabwe.
e.zh: 布拉瓦约是津巴布韦第二大城市。

e.en: Her aunt grew up on a farm near {Bulawayo}.
e.zh: 她姑姑在布拉瓦约附近的农场长大。

e.en: The kitchen {bulb} burned out and needs replacing.
e.zh: 厨房的灯泡烧了,需要换一只。

e.en: Plant the tulip {bulb} about six inches deep.
e.zh: 把郁金香的球茎埋进土里大约六英寸。

e.en: Each lily produces a tiny {bulblet} along its stem.
e.zh: 每株百合都会在茎上长出一个小鳞茎。

e.en: Gardeners separate every {bulblet} to grow new plants.
e.zh: 园丁把每个小球茎分开来培育新植株。

e.en: The clown wore a bright, {bulbous} red nose.
e.zh: 小丑戴着一个鲜红圆鼓鼓的鼻子。

e.en: The vase had a {bulbous} base and a slim neck.
e.zh: 花瓶底部圆鼓,瓶颈细长。

e.en: LED {bulbs} use far less energy than older ones.
e.zh: LED灯泡比老式灯泡省电得多。

e.en: She planted daffodil {bulbs} along the garden path.
e.zh: 她沿着花园小径种下了水仙球茎。

e.en: A {bulbul} sang sweetly outside the bedroom window.
e.zh: 一只夜莺在卧室窗外婉转鸣唱。

e.en: The garden attracts colorful {bulbul} birds each spring.
e.zh: 每到春天,花园都会引来色彩鲜艳的鹎鸟。

e.en: {Bulgaria} is famous for its rose oil and yogurt.
e.zh: 保加利亚以玫瑰精油和酸奶闻名。

e.en: They spent two weeks hiking through southern {Bulgaria}.
e.zh: 他们花了两周时间在保加利亚南部徒步。

bulgarian.t:
adj. 保加利亚的
n. 保加利亚人/语

e.en: She is learning to speak {Bulgarian} for her trip.
e.zh: 她正在学保加利亚语,为旅行做准备。

e.en: The restaurant served traditional {Bulgarian} cabbage rolls.
e.zh: 餐厅供应传统的保加利亚卷心菜卷。

bulge.t:
n. 凸起；隆起
v. 膨胀；鼓起

e.en: His wallet made a thick {bulge} in his pocket.
e.zh: 他的钱包在口袋里鼓出一大块。

e.en: The dam began to {bulge} under the rising pressure.
e.zh: 水坝在不断上升的压力下开始鼓胀起来。

e.en: She carried a {bulging} bag of groceries inside.
e.zh: 她拎着一个鼓鼓囊囊的购物袋走进来。

e.en: His eyes were {bulging} with surprise at the news.
e.zh: 听到这消息他眼睛瞪得圆圆的。

bulgur.t: n. 碾碎干小麦（中东食材）

e.en: I made a salad with {bulgur}, parsley, and lemon.
e.zh: 我用碎小麦、欧芹和柠檬做了一份沙拉。

e.en: {Bulgur} cooks quickly and works well in tabbouleh.
e.zh: 碎小麦煮得很快,做塔布勒沙拉很合适。

e.en: She bravely shared her recovery from {bulimia}.
e.zh: 她勇敢地分享了自己从暴食症中康复的经历。

e.en: Doctors treat {bulimia} with therapy and careful nutrition.
e.zh: 医生用心理治疗和合理营养来治疗暴食症。

bulimias.t: n. 贪食症（bulimia 的复数）

e.en: Researchers compared two distinct {bulimias} in their study.
e.zh: 研究人员在研究中比较了两种不同的暴食症类型。

e.en: The textbook discussed several {bulimias} described in past literature.
e.zh: 教材讨论了过去文献中描述的几种暴食症形式。

bulimic.t:
adj. 患贪食症的
n. 贪食症患者

e.en: The novel's main character struggles with {bulimic} behavior.
e.zh: 小说的主角与暴食症行为作斗争。

e.en: A {bulimic} pattern often hides behind a calm exterior.
e.zh: 暴食症的模式常常隐藏在平静的外表之下。

bulk.t:
n. 大批；大部分
adj. 大量的

e.en: We buy rice in {bulk} to save money.
e.zh: 我们大量购买大米以节省开支。

e.en: The {bulk} of his savings went into the house.
e.zh: 他大部分积蓄都花在了房子上。

e.en: A steel {bulkhead} divides the cargo hold in two.
e.zh: 一道钢制隔舱壁把货舱分成两部分。

e.en: The crew sealed the {bulkhead} to stop the leak.
e.zh: 船员封闭了隔舱壁以阻止漏水。

bulking.t: v. 增大体积；增肌（健身术语）

e.en: He's {bulking} up at the gym before competition season.
e.zh: 他在比赛季前到健身房增肌。

e.en: Adding oats is great for {bulking} a smoothie.
e.zh: 加燕麦能很好地让奶昔更有饱腹感。

bulks.t:
n. 大批；大块（bulk 的复数/三单）
v. 使显得庞大

e.en: The mountain {bulks} large on the western horizon.
e.zh: 那座山在西边的地平线上显得格外高大。

e.en: He buys protein powder in five-pound {bulks}.
e.zh: 他每次都买五磅装的大包蛋白粉。

e.en: The {bulky} winter coat barely fit in the suitcase.
e.zh: 那件厚重的冬衣几乎塞不进行李箱。

e.en: Old laptops were noticeably {bulky} compared to modern ones.
e.zh: 老式笔记本电脑跟现代的比起来明显笨重。

bull.t:
n. 公牛
n. （股市）看涨者

e.en: The angry {bull} charged across the dusty field.
e.zh: 那头愤怒的公牛冲过尘土飞扬的田野。

e.en: Investors are betting on a {bull} market this year.
e.zh: 投资者押注今年会出现牛市。

bulla.t:
n. 大水疱（医学）
n. 铅封印章

e.en: The doctor noted a small {bulla} on her foot.
e.zh: 医生注意到她脚上有一个小水疱。

e.en: A Roman child often wore a protective {bulla} amulet.
e.zh: 罗马儿童常佩戴一种叫bulla的护身符。

e.en: Their stubby {bulldog} snores loudly on the couch.
e.zh: 他们家矮胖的斗牛犬在沙发上呼噜声很响。

e.en: The detective had a {bulldog} grip on every clue.
e.zh: 那位侦探死死咬住每一条线索不放。

bulldoze.t: v. 用推土机推平；强行推进

e.en: The city plans to {bulldoze} the old warehouse soon.
e.zh: 市政府打算很快把那座旧仓库推平。

e.en: Don't let him {bulldoze} you into a quick decision.
e.zh: 别让他强迫你仓促做决定。

bulldozed.t: v. 推平；强行推动（过去式）

e.en: They {bulldozed} the abandoned house to make room for parking.
e.zh: 他们推平了那座废弃的房子,腾出停车的地方。

e.en: He {bulldozed} his way through the meeting, ignoring objections.
e.zh: 他无视反对意见,在会议上一路强势推进。

e.en: A yellow {bulldozer} cleared rocks from the construction site.
e.zh: 一台黄色推土机把工地上的石块清理干净。

e.en: Her colleagues called her a {bulldozer} in negotiations.
e.zh: 同事们称她在谈判中是台推土机。

bulldozing.t: v. 正在推平；强推（现在分词）

e.en: Crews are {bulldozing} the lot for a new park.
e.zh: 工人们正在平整这块地,准备建一座新公园。

e.en: Stop {bulldozing} everyone and listen to their ideas.
e.zh: 别再独断专行了,听听大家的想法。

bullet.t:
n. 子弹
n. 项目符号（列表）

e.en: A single {bullet} was found at the crime scene.
e.zh: 案发现场只发现了一颗子弹。

e.en: Add each task as a {bullet} in your notes.
e.zh: 把每项任务以项目符号形式写进笔记。

bulletin.t: n. 公告；简报；新闻快讯

e.en: The school posted the schedule on its weekly {bulletin}.
e.zh: 学校在每周公告上贴出了课程表。

e.en: A breaking news {bulletin} interrupted the morning broadcast.
e.zh: 一则突发新闻简报打断了早间广播。

e.en: Storm warning {bulletins} appeared on every news channel.
e.zh: 每个新闻频道都出现了风暴预警公告。

e.en: The agency issues weekly {bulletins} about market trends.
e.zh: 该机构每周发布有关市场走势的简报。

bulletproof.t: adj. 防弹的；万无一失的

e.en: The president travels in a {bulletproof} black SUV.
e.zh: 总统乘坐一辆防弹的黑色越野车出行。

e.en: Her argument was practically {bulletproof} during the debate.
e.zh: 她在辩论中的论点几乎无懈可击。

bullets.t: n. 子弹；项目符号（复数）

e.en: The officer reloaded with six fresh {bullets}.
e.zh: 那名警察装上了六颗新子弹。

e.en: Summarize the report in three clear {bullets}.
e.zh: 用三个清晰的要点概括这份报告。

e.en: They watched a controversial {bullfight} during their visit to Spain.
e.zh: 他们在西班牙旅行时观看了一场有争议的斗牛。

e.en: Many tourists refuse to attend a {bullfight} on ethical grounds.
e.zh: 许多游客出于伦理考虑拒绝观看斗牛表演。

e.en: The young {bullfighter} stepped into the arena nervously.
e.zh: 年轻的斗牛士紧张地走进竞技场。

e.en: A famous {bullfighter} retired after his serious injury.
e.zh: 一位著名斗牛士在重伤后退役了。

e.en: A bright pink {bullfinch} landed on the garden feeder.
e.zh: 一只羽色粉红的红腹灰雀落在花园喂食器上。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {bullfinch} near the riverbank.
e.zh: 观鸟者在河岸边发现了一只罕见的红腹灰雀。

e.en: A huge {bullfrog} croaked beside the lily pond.
e.zh: 一只巨大的牛蛙在睡莲池边呱呱叫着。

e.en: The {bullfrog} leapt into the water with a splash.
e.zh: 那只牛蛙扑通一声跳进了水里。

bullhead.t: n. 杜父鱼；鲶鱼类淡水鱼

e.en: He caught a small {bullhead} catfish in the muddy stream.
e.zh: 他在浑浊的小溪里钓到一条小牛头鲶。

e.en: That {bullhead} refuses to listen to any advice.
e.zh: 那个倔脾气的人根本听不进任何劝告。

bullhorn.t: n. 手持扩音器；喊话筒

e.en: The officer shouted instructions through a {bullhorn}.
e.zh: 警官用扩音喇叭大声喊出指令。

e.en: Protesters passed the {bullhorn} from one speaker to another.
e.zh: 抗议者把扩音器从一位发言人传给另一位。

e.en: He was {bullied} at school for being shy.
e.zh: 他因为腼腆在学校里受人欺负。

e.en: The manager {bullied} his staff into working weekends.
e.zh: 那位经理逼迫员工周末加班。

bullies.t:
n. 恶霸（复数）
v. 欺凌（三单）

e.en: Schools should take action against classroom {bullies}.
e.zh: 学校应当对课堂上的霸凌者采取措施。

e.en: She {bullies} her younger brother whenever parents leave.
e.zh: 父母一离开,她就欺负弟弟。

e.en: The vault stored gold {bullion} worth millions of dollars.
e.zh: 金库里存放着价值数百万美元的金条。

e.en: Investors bought silver {bullion} as a hedge against inflation.
e.zh: 投资者购买银条以对冲通货膨胀。

e.en: Analysts remain {bullish} on tech stocks this quarter.
e.zh: 分析师本季度仍看好科技股。

e.en: She is {bullish} about the startup's future prospects.
e.zh: 她对这家初创公司的前景非常乐观。

e.en: The farmer used a {bullock} to plough the rice field.
e.zh: 农夫用一头阉牛来犁稻田。

e.en: A heavy cart was pulled by two strong {bullock} teams.
e.zh: 沉重的大车由两组健壮的犍牛拉着。

bullpen.t:
n. 棒球候补投手区
n. 办公室开放工位区

e.en: The relief pitcher warmed up in the {bullpen}.
e.zh: 替补投手在牛棚里热身。

e.en: Junior lawyers worked together in the office {bullpen}.
e.zh: 年轻律师们在办公室的开放工作区一起办公。

e.en: Tourists watched the matador enter the ancient {bullring}.
e.zh: 游客们观看斗牛士走进古老的斗牛场。

e.en: Seville's famous {bullring} attracts thousands of visitors yearly.
e.zh: 塞维利亚著名的斗牛场每年吸引数千名游客。

bullrush.t: n. 芦苇；香蒲（bulrush 异写）

e.en: Tall {bullrush} plants swayed along the riverbank.
e.zh: 高高的香蒲在河岸边随风摇曳。

e.en: Ducks built their nest hidden among the {bullrush}.
e.zh: 野鸭在香蒲丛中筑起了隐蔽的巢。

e.en: Ranchers herded the {bulls} into a separate pasture.
e.zh: 牧场主把公牛赶进另一片牧场。

e.en: The Chicago {bulls} won another championship that season.
e.zh: 芝加哥公牛队那个赛季又夺得一次总冠军。

e.en: Her arrow hit the {bullseye} on the first try.
e.zh: 她的箭第一次就正中靶心。

e.en: The marketing campaign was a complete {bullseye} for sales.
e.zh: 那场营销活动对销售而言是完美的命中。

bullshit.t:
n. 胡说八道（粗俗）
v. 瞎扯；忽悠

e.en: Stop talking {bullshit} and tell me the truth.
e.zh: 别再胡说八道,告诉我实情。

e.en: His excuse for being late was total {bullshit}.
e.zh: 他迟到的理由完全是胡扯。

bullwhip.t:
n. 长牛皮鞭
v. 鞭打

e.en: The cowboy cracked his {bullwhip} above the herd's heads.
e.zh: 牛仔在牛群头顶上甩响了长鞭。

e.en: Indiana Jones famously carried a leather {bullwhip}.
e.zh: 印第安纳·琼斯以携带一条皮长鞭而著称。

bully.t:
n. 恶霸
v. 欺负；霸凌

e.en: Don't let that {bully} push you around anymore.
e.zh: 别再让那个恶霸欺负你了。

e.en: He tried to {bully} her into signing the contract.
e.zh: 他试图威逼她签下那份合同。

bullying.t:
n. 霸凌行为
v. 欺凌（进行时）

e.en: The school launched a campaign to stop {bullying} online.
e.zh: 学校发起了一项遏制网络霸凌的活动。

e.en: She reported her boss for {bullying} junior employees.
e.zh: 她举报老板欺凌初级员工。

e.en: Moses was hidden in a basket among the {bulrush}.
e.zh: 摩西被藏在香蒲丛中的篮子里。

e.en: Frogs croaked from behind the swaying {bulrush}.
e.zh: 青蛙在摇曳的香蒲后呱呱地叫着。

e.en: The constitution serves as a {bulwark} against tyranny.
e.zh: 宪法是抵御暴政的坚固屏障。

e.en: Strong courts are a {bulwark} of any democracy.
e.zh: 强有力的法院是任何民主制度的中流砥柱。

bum.t:
n. 流浪汉；懒汉
n. 屁股（英式俚语）

e.en: He felt like a {bum} after losing his job.
e.zh: 失业之后他觉得自己像个游手好闲的人。

e.en: Can I {bum} a cigarette off you?
e.zh: 我能向你讨根烟抽吗?

bumble.t: v. 跌跌撞撞；结结巴巴地说

e.en: Tourists {bumble} around the station looking for the exit.
e.zh: 游客们在车站里东撞西撞地找出口。

e.en: Don't {bumble} through the presentation; rehearse it first.
e.zh: 别在演讲时磕磕巴巴,先排练一遍。

e.en: A fat {bumblebee} buzzed lazily around the lavender.
e.zh: 一只胖乎乎的大黄蜂懒洋洋地在薰衣草间嗡嗡飞。

e.en: The {bumblebee} pollinates many garden flowers each spring.
e.zh: 大黄蜂每年春天为许多花园里的花朵传粉。

e.en: The new intern is a complete {bumbler} in meetings.
e.zh: 新来的实习生在会议上完全是个笨手笨脚的人。

e.en: Voters dismissed the candidate as a hopeless {bumbler}.
e.zh: 选民把那位候选人视为无可救药的庸才。

bumbling.t: adj. 笨手笨脚的；糊里糊涂的

e.en: The {bumbling} detective somehow solved the case anyway.
e.zh: 那位笨拙的侦探不知怎的还是破了案。

e.en: His {bumbling} attempts at apology only made things worse.
e.zh: 他笨拙的道歉尝试只让情况更糟。

bumf.t: n. 无用的文件；废纸（英俚）

e.en: My inbox is full of marketing {bumf} again.
e.zh: 我的收件箱又塞满了没用的营销废纸。

e.en: He tossed the company {bumf} straight into the recycling bin.
e.zh: 他把公司发的废纸直接扔进了回收箱。

bummed.t:
adj. 失落的；沮丧的
v. 蹭（东西）（过去式）

e.en: I was really {bummed} when the concert got cancelled.
e.zh: 演唱会被取消时我真的很沮丧。

e.en: She {bummed} a ride home from a coworker.
e.zh: 她蹭了同事的车回家。

e.en: It's a real {bummer} that the trip got postponed.
e.zh: 旅行被推迟真的太扫兴了。

e.en: Losing my wallet on vacation was a total {bummer}.
e.zh: 度假时丢了钱包真是件糟心事。

bump.t:
v. 碰撞；颠簸
n. 肿块；隆起

e.en: Watch out for that {bump} in the road ahead.
e.zh: 小心前面路上的那个凸起。

e.en: Please {bump} the meeting to three o'clock.
e.zh: 请把会议改到三点。

e.en: I {bumped} into an old friend at the airport.
e.zh: 我在机场偶然遇到了一位老朋友。

e.en: The airline {bumped} her from the overbooked flight.
e.zh: 航空公司把她从超额预订的航班上挤下来了。

bumper.t:
n. 汽车保险杠
adj. 丰盛的；特大的

e.en: The car's rear {bumper} was dented in the accident.
e.zh: 汽车的后保险杠在事故中凹了进去。

e.en: Farmers harvested a {bumper} crop of wheat this year.
e.zh: 农民们今年小麦获得了大丰收。

e.en: Modern cars have plastic {bumpers} that absorb minor impacts.
e.zh: 现代汽车的塑料保险杠可以吸收轻微的撞击。

e.en: Kids love bowling with the {bumpers} raised in the gutters.
e.zh: 小孩喜欢在边沟竖起护栏时打保龄球。

bumph.t: n. 无用的文件；厕纸（俚）

e.en: The conference handed out folders full of {bumph}.
e.zh: 会议发了好几个装满废纸资料的文件夹。

e.en: She skimmed the {bumph} before tossing it in the bin.
e.zh: 她随手翻了翻那些废纸资料就扔进了垃圾桶。

bumping.t:
v. 碰撞；颠簸
adj. 碰撞的

e.en: The bus kept {bumping} along the unpaved road.
e.zh: 公交车一路在没铺过的路上颠簸。

e.en: I keep {bumping} into her at the coffee shop lately.
e.zh: 最近我总在咖啡店里碰见她。

e.en: City folks unfairly called him a country {bumpkin}.
e.zh: 城里人不公平地叫他乡巴佬。

e.en: Don't dismiss her as a {bumpkin} just because she's rural.
e.zh: 不要因为她来自乡下就把她当成土包子。

bumps.t:
n. 肿块；颠簸处
v. 碰撞（bump 复数）

e.en: The road is full of {bumps} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后路面上到处是凸起。

e.en: Every relationship hits a few {bumps} along the way.
e.zh: 每段关系都会经历一些波折。

bumptious.t: adj. 自负的；傲慢无礼的

e.en: The {bumptious} executive irritated everyone in the meeting.
e.zh: 那位自大傲慢的高管让会上每个人都很恼火。

e.en: Nobody enjoys working with such a {bumptious} colleague.
e.zh: 没人喜欢跟这样傲慢自负的同事共事。

bumpy.t: adj. 颠簸的；坑洼不平的

e.en: The flight was {bumpy} due to heavy turbulence.
e.zh: 由于剧烈颠簸,这趟航班很不平稳。

e.en: Their relationship had a {bumpy} start but improved later.
e.zh: 他们的关系起初坎坷,但后来逐渐改善。

bums.t: n. 流浪汉；屁股（英俚，复数）

e.en: Several {bums} were sleeping under the highway bridge.
e.zh: 几个流浪汉睡在高架桥下。

e.en: He always {bums} cigarettes off his coworkers.
e.zh: 他总是向同事讨烟抽。

e.en: She tied her hair up in a neat {bun}.
e.zh: 她把头发整齐地盘成了一个发髻。

e.en: I had a warm cinnamon {bun} for breakfast.
e.zh: 我早餐吃了一个热乎乎的肉桂面包。

e.en: He invented a fake friend called {bunbury} to skip dinners.
e.zh: 他编造了一位名叫邦伯里的假朋友来逃避晚餐。

e.en: Wilde's Algernon used a {bunbury} to escape social duties.
e.zh: 王尔德笔下的阿尔杰农用一个虚构借口来逃避社交义务。

bunce.t: n. 意外收益（英俚，罕用）

e.en: The unexpected bonus felt like pure {bunce}.
e.zh: 那笔意外的奖金感觉像是天上掉下来的横财。

e.en: Selling those old comics turned out to be real {bunce}.
e.zh: 卖掉那些旧漫画书原来是一笔意外之财。

bunch.t:
n. 一束；一群
v. 捆成一束

e.en: She bought a {bunch} of bananas at the market.
e.zh: 她在市场上买了一串香蕉。

e.en: A whole {bunch} of friends came to the party.
e.zh: 一大群朋友都来参加了派对。

e.en: The runners {bunched} together at the starting line.
e.zh: 跑步选手在起跑线上挤成了一团。

e.en: Her dress {bunched} awkwardly around the waist.
e.zh: 她的裙子在腰部不自然地皱成一团。

bunches.t:
n. 束、群（bunch 复数）
n. 双马尾

e.en: The florist arranged {bunches} of roses in vases.
e.zh: 花艺师把一束束玫瑰插进花瓶里。

e.en: She wore her hair in two cute {bunches}.
e.zh: 她把头发扎成了两个可爱的小辫。

e.en: Buses keep {bunching} together during rush hour traffic.
e.zh: 高峰时段公交车总是扎堆到一起。

e.en: The fabric is {bunching} around the seams awkwardly.
e.zh: 布料在接缝处别扭地皱起来了。

bunco.t:
n. 骗局
v. 行骗

e.en: Police arrested the men running an elaborate {bunco} scheme.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了那些经营精心骗局的男子。

e.en: Grandma plays {bunco} with her friends every Thursday night.
e.zh: 奶奶每周四晚上和朋友们玩骰子游戏。

bund.t: n. 堤岸；(上海) 外滩

e.en: We strolled along the {bund} watching boats on the river.
e.zh: 我们沿着外滩散步,看着江面上的船只。

e.en: Shanghai's historic {bund} is famous for its colonial architecture.
e.zh: 上海历史悠久的外滩以其殖民时期建筑而闻名。

e.en: The {bundesbank} announced new interest rate guidelines today.
e.zh: 德国联邦银行今天公布了新的利率指导方针。

e.en: Germany's {bundesbank} influences eurozone monetary policy heavily.
e.zh: 德国联邦银行对欧元区货币政策影响深远。

bundesliga.t: n. 德国足球甲级联赛

e.en: Bayern Munich dominates the {bundesliga} almost every season.
e.zh: 拜仁慕尼黑几乎每个赛季都统治着德甲联赛。

e.en: He dreams of playing in the German {bundesliga} someday.
e.zh: 他梦想有一天能在德国甲级联赛踢球。

e.en: The old {bundespost} once handled all German mail and telecoms.
e.zh: 以前的德国联邦邮政曾负责所有德国邮件和电信业务。

e.en: Privatization ended the {bundespost} monopoly in the 1990s.
e.zh: 私有化在九十年代终结了德国联邦邮政的垄断。

e.en: The German {bundesrat} represents the interests of the states.
e.zh: 德国联邦参议院代表各州的利益。

e.en: That bill must still pass the {bundesrat} before becoming law.
e.zh: 该法案在成为法律前还须经联邦参议院通过。

e.en: The {Bundestag} passed the new climate bill last week.
e.zh: 联邦议院上周通过了新的气候法案。

e.en: German voters elect members of the {Bundestag} every four years.
e.zh: 德国选民每四年选举一次联邦议院议员。

bundle.t:
n. 一捆；套装
v. 捆绑；打包

e.en: The streaming service offers a {bundle} with music and video.
e.zh: 该流媒体服务提供音乐加视频的套餐。

e.en: She carried a {bundle} of clothes to the laundry.
e.zh: 她抱着一捆衣服去洗衣房。

bundled.t:
adj. 捆绑出售的
v. 打包（过去式）

e.en: The phone comes {bundled} with free wireless earbuds.
e.zh: 这款手机随机附赠免费的无线耳机。

e.en: The kids {bundled} up before heading out into the snow.
e.zh: 孩子们裹得严严实实才出门去玩雪。

e.en: Webpack is a popular JavaScript {bundler} for modern web apps.
e.zh: Webpack 是现代网页应用常用的 JavaScript 打包工具。

e.en: The campaign relied on a top {bundler} to raise funds.
e.zh: 竞选团队依靠一位顶级募款人来筹集资金。

bundling.t:
n. 捆绑销售
v. 打包

e.en: Microsoft was accused of illegally {bundling} its browser with Windows.
e.zh: 微软曾被指控将浏览器非法捆绑进 Windows。

e.en: She was {bundling} old newspapers for recycling.
e.zh: 她正在把旧报纸捆起来准备回收。

bung.t:
n. (桶口) 塞子
v. 塞住；扔

e.en: Just {bung} your bag in the back of the car.
e.zh: 你把包随手扔到车后座就行了。

e.en: He pulled the {bung} out of the wine barrel.
e.zh: 他把酒桶上的塞子拔了出来。

e.en: They retired to a small seaside {bungalow} in Florida.
e.zh: 他们退休后住进了佛罗里达海边的一栋小平房。

e.en: The resort offers private {bungalow} rentals over the water.
e.zh: 度假村提供建在水上的独立小屋出租。

bungay.t: n. 邦盖（英国地名，罕用）

e.en: The market town of {Bungay} sits on the Suffolk border.
e.zh: 邦盖这座集镇坐落在萨福克郡边界上。

e.en: We stopped for tea in {Bungay} on the way home.
e.zh: 回家路上我们在邦盖停下来喝了杯茶。

e.en: He went {bungee} jumping off a bridge in New Zealand.
e.zh: 他在新西兰的一座桥上玩了蹦极。

e.en: Secure the load with a {bungee} cord before driving.
e.zh: 开车前用弹力绳把货物固定好。

e.en: Wine seeped slowly from the barrel's {bunghole}.
e.zh: 葡萄酒从酒桶的塞口慢慢渗了出来。

e.en: The cooper sealed the {bunghole} with a wooden plug.
e.zh: 箍桶匠用木塞封住了桶口。

bungle.t:
v. 笨手笨脚地搞砸
n. 拙劣之作

e.en: Don't let the rookie {bungle} this important client meeting.
e.zh: 别让那个新手把这次重要的客户会议搞砸。

e.en: The whole rescue operation was a complete {bungle}.
e.zh: 整个救援行动彻底是一团糟。

bungled.t:
adj. 搞砸的
v. 弄糟（过去式）

e.en: The robbers {bungled} the heist and were caught immediately.
e.zh: 劫匪把抢劫搞砸了,当场就被抓住。

e.en: Critics say the agency {bungled} its pandemic response.
e.zh: 批评者称该机构搞砸了疫情应对工作。

e.en: The new manager turned out to be a complete {bungler}.
e.zh: 新来的经理结果是个彻头彻尾的笨蛋。

e.en: Only a {bungler} would forget to back up the database.
e.zh: 只有蠢货才会忘记备份数据库。

e.en: His {bungling} attempt to fix the printer made it worse.
e.zh: 他笨手笨脚地修打印机,反而把事情搞得更糟。

e.en: The press mocked the {bungling} police investigation.
e.zh: 媒体嘲讽了警方那次乱七八糟的调查。

e.en: Queenstown is famous for its thrilling {bungy} jumps.
e.zh: 皇后镇以惊险刺激的蹦极闻名。

e.en: She finally worked up the courage to try {bungy} jumping.
e.zh: 她终于鼓起勇气去尝试蹦极。

e.en: Tight shoes can cause a painful {bunion} to form.
e.zh: 鞋子太紧会引起痛苦的拇趾外翻。

e.en: She had surgery to remove a large {bunion} on her foot.
e.zh: 她做了手术切除脚上一个大的拇囊肿。

bunk.t:
n. 铺位；上下铺
v. 逃学；睡铺位

e.en: The kids climbed into the top {bunk} and turned off the light.
e.zh: 孩子们爬上上铺关了灯。

e.en: That conspiracy theory is complete {bunk}.
e.zh: 那个阴谋论纯粹是胡说八道。

bunker.t:
n. 地堡；掩体
n. (高尔夫) 沙坑

e.en: Officials hid in an underground {bunker} during the air raid.
e.zh: 空袭期间官员们躲进了地下掩体。

e.en: His tee shot landed in a deep sand {bunker}.
e.zh: 他的开球落进了一个很深的沙坑。

e.en: Ranch hands slept in the {bunkhouse} near the stables.
e.zh: 牧场工人睡在马厩旁边的工棚里。

e.en: The summer camp's {bunkhouse} sleeps twelve children.
e.zh: 夏令营的宿舍小屋可以睡十二个孩子。

e.en: My {bunkmate} at camp became my best friend.
e.zh: 夏令营里和我同住的室友成了我最好的朋友。

e.en: Her Navy {bunkmate} snored loudly every night.
e.zh: 她在海军舱房里的同铺每晚都打呼噜很响。

e.en: His promises about quick riches are pure {bunkum}.
e.zh: 他关于快速致富的承诺纯属胡言乱语。

e.en: Don't believe that {bunkum} you read on social media.
e.zh: 别信你在社交媒体上看到的那些瞎扯。

e.en: The kids spotted a wild {bunny} in the backyard.
e.zh: 孩子们在后院发现了一只野兔。

e.en: She wore fluffy {bunny} slippers around the house.
e.zh: 她在家里穿着毛茸茸的兔子拖鞋。

buns.t:
n. 小圆面包（复数）
n. 屁股（俚）

e.en: The bakery sells warm cinnamon {buns} every morning.
e.zh: 那家面包店每天早上都卖热腾腾的肉桂卷。

e.en: She tied her hair into two cute {buns}.
e.zh: 她把头发扎成两个可爱的丸子头。

bunsen.t: n. 本生灯（化学实验用）

e.en: Light the {Bunsen} burner before heating the test tube.
e.zh: 加热试管前先点燃本生灯。

e.en: Every chemistry lab has a row of {Bunsen} burners.
e.zh: 每间化学实验室都摆着一排本生灯。

bunt.t:
v. 棒球短打
n. 触击球

e.en: The batter laid down a perfect {bunt} to advance the runner.
e.zh: 击球员漂亮地短打一下,让跑垒员推进。

e.en: Coach signaled him to {bunt} on the next pitch.
e.zh: 教练示意他下一球进行触击短打。

e.en: The pitcher kept his eyes on the {bunter} at the plate.
e.zh: 投手紧盯着本垒上准备短打的击球手。

e.en: He's known as a reliable {bunter} in tight situations.
e.zh: 在关键时刻他是个可靠的短打高手。

bunting.t:
n. 彩旗；旗布
n. 鹀（鸟类）

e.en: They hung red, white, and blue {bunting} for the parade.
e.zh: 他们为游行挂上了红白蓝三色彩旗。

e.en: A small {bunting} sang from the hedge in spring.
e.zh: 春天里一只小巫鸟在树篱上歌唱。

buoy.t:
n. 浮标
v. 使浮起；鼓舞

e.en: Swimmers were warned not to swim past the red {buoy}.
e.zh: 游泳的人被警告不要游过红色浮标。

e.en: Strong sales helped {buoy} the company's stock price.
e.zh: 强劲的销售业绩支撑了公司的股价。

e.en: Salt water has greater {buoyancy} than fresh water.
e.zh: 咸水的浮力比淡水大。

e.en: The market regained its {buoyancy} after the rate cut.
e.zh: 降息之后市场恢复了活力。

buoyant.t: adj. 有浮力的；轻快乐观的

e.en: She remained {buoyant} despite all the bad news.
e.zh: 尽管坏消息不断,她依然乐观开朗。

e.en: The housing market stayed surprisingly {buoyant} this year.
e.zh: 今年房地产市场出人意料地保持活跃。

e.en: She walked {buoyantly} into the office after the promotion.
e.zh: 升职后她脚步轻快地走进了办公室。

e.en: The CEO spoke {buoyantly} about next year's prospects.
e.zh: 首席执行官信心满满地谈起明年的前景。

bupa.t: n. 保柏（英国医疗保险公司）

e.en: My employer covers private health insurance through {Bupa}.
e.zh: 我的雇主通过保柏为员工购买私人医疗保险。

e.en: She booked a full health check at a {Bupa} clinic.
e.zh: 她在保柏诊所预约了全面体检。

e.en: Doctors prescribe {buprenorphine} to treat opioid addiction.
e.zh: 医生开丁丙诺啡来治疗阿片类药物成瘾。

e.en: The clinic offers {buprenorphine} as part of recovery treatment.
e.zh: 该诊所将丁丙诺啡作为戒断治疗的一部分。

bupropion.t: n. 安非他酮（抗抑郁药）

e.en: Her doctor switched her to {bupropion} for depression.
e.zh: 医生把她的抗抑郁药改成了安非他酮。

e.en: {Bupropion} is also used to help people quit smoking.
e.zh: 安非他酮也用来帮助人们戒烟。

e.en: A prickly {bur} got stuck in the dog's fur.
e.zh: 一颗带刺的草籽粘在了狗毛上。

e.en: She pulled a {bur} from the hem of her jeans.
e.zh: 她从牛仔裤的裤脚上摘下一颗刺果。

e.en: He grew up in a quiet {burb} outside Chicago.
e.zh: 他在芝加哥城外一个安静的郊区长大。

e.en: Young families are moving back to the {burb}.
e.zh: 年轻的家庭正在搬回郊区居住。

burberry.t: n. 博柏利（英国奢侈品牌）

e.en: She wrapped herself in a classic {Burberry} trench coat.
e.zh: 她穿上一件经典的巴宝莉风衣。

e.en: The store had a sale on {Burberry} scarves last weekend.
e.zh: 那家店上周末搞了巴宝莉围巾的促销。

burble.t:
v. 汩汩作响；咕哝地说
n. 汩汩声

e.en: You could hear the stream {burble} over the rocks.
e.zh: 可以听见小溪在石头上汩汩流过。

e.en: The toddler began to {burble} happily in his crib.
e.zh: 小宝宝在婴儿床里开心地咿呀作语。

burbling.t:
n. 汩汩声
adj. 咕哝的

e.en: A {burbling} fountain sat in the middle of the courtyard.
e.zh: 一座潺潺作响的喷泉立在庭院中央。

e.en: She kept {burbling} on about her vacation plans.
e.zh: 她滔滔不绝地讲着自己的度假计划。

burden.t:
n. 负担；重任
v. 使负担

e.en: Student loans have become a heavy {burden} for young workers.
e.zh: 助学贷款已成为年轻上班族的沉重负担。

e.en: I don't want to {burden} you with my problems.
e.zh: 我不想拿我的烦心事来给你添麻烦。

burdened.t: adj. 负担沉重的；受累的

e.en: She felt {burdened} by the responsibility of caring for her parents.
e.zh: 照顾父母的责任让她感到压力很大。

e.en: The donkey was {burdened} with sacks of grain.
e.zh: 那头驴驮着一袋袋谷物。

e.en: Critics say the new tax is {burdening} small businesses.
e.zh: 批评人士说新税种正在加重小企业的负担。

e.en: Stop {burdening} yourself with everyone else's problems.
e.zh: 别再把别人的问题都揽到自己身上了。

burdens.t:
n. 负担（复数）
v. 使负担

e.en: Single parents often carry heavy financial {burdens}.
e.zh: 单亲父母常常背负着沉重的经济负担。

e.en: The reform aims to reduce administrative {burdens} on schools.
e.zh: 这项改革旨在减轻学校的行政负担。

e.en: Filing taxes has become increasingly {burdensome} for freelancers.
e.zh: 对自由职业者来说,报税变得越来越繁琐。

e.en: The new regulations are {burdensome} for small clinics.
e.zh: 新规对小型诊所来说是个不小的负担。

e.en: {Burdock} root is a popular ingredient in Japanese cooking.
e.zh: 牛蒡根是日本料理中常见的食材。

e.en: She brewed a tea from fresh {burdock} leaves.
e.zh: 她用新鲜的牛蒡叶泡了一杯茶。

bureau.t:
n. 局；办事处
n. 写字台

e.en: The Federal {Bureau} of Investigation opened a new case.
e.zh: 联邦调查局开立了一宗新案件。

e.en: She keeps her sweaters in the bottom drawer of the {bureau}.
e.zh: 她把毛衣放在五斗柜最下面的抽屉里。

e.en: Large {bureaucracies} often resist meaningful change.
e.zh: 庞大的官僚机构往往抗拒实质性的变革。

e.en: Tech startups try to avoid the {bureaucracies} of big corporations.
e.zh: 科技创业公司努力避开大企业那种繁琐的官僚体制。

bureaucracy.t: n. 官僚机构；官僚作风

e.en: Getting a visa involves dealing with endless {bureaucracy}.
e.zh: 办签证要应付没完没了的官僚手续。

e.en: The startup wants to cut through corporate {bureaucracy}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司想绕开企业的繁文缛节。

e.en: A faceless {bureaucrat} rejected her permit application.
e.zh: 一个不知名的官僚驳回了她的许可申请。

e.en: He spent thirty years as a {bureaucrat} at the ministry.
e.zh: 他在部里当了三十年的公务员。

e.en: The memo was written in dense {bureaucratese} no one understood.
e.zh: 那份备忘录写满了没人看得懂的官腔术语。

e.en: Plain English is replacing {bureaucratese} in government forms.
e.zh: 政府表格正在用通俗英语取代官样文章。

bureaucratic.t: adj. 官僚的；繁文缛节的

e.en: The visa process is slow and {bureaucratic}.
e.zh: 签证流程缓慢又官僚。

e.en: Small startups often avoid {bureaucratic} hiring procedures.
e.zh: 小型创业公司通常会避开繁琐的官僚招聘流程。

bureaucratically.t: adv. 官僚地；按官僚程序

e.en: The agency handled the request {bureaucratically} and slowly.
e.zh: 该机构以官僚方式缓慢地处理了请求。

e.en: Decisions are made {bureaucratically}, requiring many signatures.
e.zh: 决策按官僚程序进行,需要许多签字。

e.en: The {bureaucratisation} of healthcare frustrates many doctors.
e.zh: 医疗系统的官僚化让许多医生感到沮丧。

e.en: Critics warn against the {bureaucratisation} of universities.
e.zh: 批评者警告大学正在走向官僚化。

e.en: Rapid {bureaucratization} slowed the company's innovation.
e.zh: 迅速的官僚化拖慢了公司的创新步伐。

e.en: He wrote a paper criticizing the {bureaucratization} of schools.
e.zh: 他写了一篇论文批评学校的官僚化。

bureaucratized.t:
adj. 官僚化的
v. 使官僚化

e.en: The startup became heavily {bureaucratized} after the merger.
e.zh: 合并后这家创业公司变得高度官僚化。

e.en: Modern hospitals are increasingly {bureaucratized} institutions.
e.zh: 现代医院越来越成为官僚化的机构。

e.en: Several federal {bureaus} share data on tax fraud.
e.zh: 多个联邦机构共享税务欺诈方面的数据。

e.en: The news network has {bureaus} in twelve major cities.
e.zh: 该新闻网在十二个主要城市设有分社。

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring the village of {Burford}.
e.zh: 我们整个周末都在伯福德村里逛。

e.en: {Burford} is a popular tourist stop in the Cotswolds.
e.zh: 伯福德是科茨沃尔德地区受欢迎的旅游小镇。

e.en: He grew up in a sleepy little {burg} in Iowa.
e.zh: 他在爱荷华州一个安静的小镇长大。

e.en: This {burg} barely has a coffee shop open past nine.
e.zh: 这个小镇连家九点后还开门的咖啡店都没有。

e.en: Online tutoring services continue to {burgeon} worldwide.
e.zh: 在线辅导服务在全球持续蓬勃发展。

e.en: Tulips {burgeon} across the fields every April.
e.zh: 每年四月郁金香都在田野上竞相绽放。

burgeoning.t: adj. 迅速发展的；激增的

e.en: The {burgeoning} AI industry is hiring rapidly.
e.zh: 迅速发展的人工智能行业正在大量招聘。

e.en: Vietnam has a {burgeoning} middle class of consumers.
e.zh: 越南拥有一个迅速壮大的中产消费阶层。

e.en: I ordered a cheese {burger} and fries for lunch.
e.zh: 我午餐点了个芝士汉堡配薯条。

e.en: This veggie {burger} actually tastes pretty good.
e.zh: 这个素食汉堡其实挺好吃的。

e.en: The diner is famous for its juicy {burgers}.
e.zh: 这家餐厅以多汁的汉堡闻名。

e.en: We grilled {burgers} in the backyard last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们在后院烤了汉堡。

e.en: Each {burgess} represented his town in the old assembly.
e.zh: 每位市民代表都在旧议会中代表他的城镇。

e.en: The book traces the rise of the medieval {burgess} class.
e.zh: 这本书追溯了中世纪市民阶层的崛起。

e.en: Edinburgh became a royal {burgh} in the twelfth century.
e.zh: 爱丁堡在十二世纪成为皇家自治市。

e.en: Each Scottish {burgh} had its own market charter.
e.zh: 每个苏格兰自治市都有自己的市场特许状。

burgher.t: n. 市民；中产阶级居民

e.en: The wealthy {burgher} donated land to build a chapel.
e.zh: 那位富有的市民捐出土地修建了一座小教堂。

e.en: Dutch paintings often depict a prosperous {burgher} family.
e.zh: 荷兰画作常常描绘富足的市民家庭。

burghley.t: n. 伯利（英国姓氏/庄园名）

e.en: We toured {Burghley} House on a rainy afternoon.
e.zh: 一个雨天下午我们参观了伯利庄园。

e.en: {Burghley} hosts a famous horse trial every September.
e.zh: 伯利庄园每年九月举办著名的马术赛事。

e.en: A {burglar} broke in through the kitchen window.
e.zh: 一名窃贼从厨房窗户闯了进来。

e.en: The motion sensor scared the {burglar} away.
e.zh: 运动传感器把窃贼吓跑了。

e.en: Police reported a sharp drop in {burglaries} this year.
e.zh: 警方报告今年入室盗窃案大幅下降。

e.en: Most {burglaries} in the area happen during daytime.
e.zh: 该地区大多数入室盗窃案都发生在白天。

e.en: Thieves tried to {burglarize} the empty office overnight.
e.zh: 窃贼企图在夜里盗窃这间空办公室。

e.en: They installed cameras to discourage anyone trying to {burglarize} the store.
e.zh: 他们安装了摄像头以阻止任何想盗窃店铺的人。

e.en: Two {burglars} were caught on the security camera.
e.zh: 两名窃贼被监控摄像头拍了下来。

e.en: {Burglars} usually avoid houses with barking dogs.
e.zh: 窃贼通常会避开有狗叫的房子。

e.en: He was arrested for {burglary} at a downtown apartment.
e.zh: 他因在市中心一公寓入室盗窃被捕。

e.en: Our insurance covers fire damage but not {burglary}.
e.zh: 我们的保险涵盖火灾损失,但不包括入室盗窃。

e.en: Someone tried to {burgle} the corner shop last night.
e.zh: 昨晚有人企图盗窃街角那家小店。

e.en: It's hard to {burgle} a house with this alarm system.
e.zh: 装了这套警报系统的房子很难被入室盗窃。

e.en: Their flat was {burgled} while they were on holiday.
e.zh: 他们度假期间公寓被盗了。

e.en: The shop was {burgled} twice in the same month.
e.zh: 这家店在同一个月内被盗了两次。

e.en: Whoever {burgles} that house will trigger silent alarms.
e.zh: 任何盗窃那栋房子的人都会触发无声警报。

e.en: He {burgles} empty homes during long weekends.
e.zh: 他专挑长周末盗窃空置的房屋。

e.en: They were caught {burgling} a jewelry store at midnight.
e.zh: 他们半夜在盗窃一家珠宝店时被抓。

e.en: He spent years {burgling} suburban homes before getting caught.
e.zh: 他在被抓之前盗窃郊区住宅多年。

burgos.t: n. 布尔戈斯（西班牙城市）

e.en: {Burgos} is famous for its stunning Gothic cathedral.
e.zh: 布尔戈斯以其壮观的哥特式大教堂闻名。

e.en: We stopped in {Burgos} on the way to Madrid.
e.zh: 我们去马德里的路上在布尔戈斯停了一下。

burgundian.t:
adj. 勃艮第的
n. 勃艮第人

e.en: The {Burgundian} dukes ruled much of medieval France.
e.zh: 勃艮第公爵曾统治中世纪法国的大部分地区。

e.en: This restaurant serves traditional {Burgundian} beef stew.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应传统的勃艮第炖牛肉。

burgundy.t:
n. 勃艮第（法国产区）
n. 酒红色

e.en: She wore a {burgundy} dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一条酒红色礼服去了晚会。

e.en: We opened a bottle of {burgundy} with dinner.
e.zh: 我们晚餐时开了一瓶勃艮第葡萄酒。

e.en: The {burial} took place in a quiet country churchyard.
e.zh: 葬礼在一处宁静的乡村教堂墓地举行。

e.en: Archaeologists discovered an ancient {burial} site nearby.
e.zh: 考古学家在附近发现了一处古代墓葬。

e.en: The cemetery has recorded {burials} since 1820.
e.zh: 这座墓地记录的下葬可追溯到1820年。

e.en: Some cultures hold {burials} on the same day as death.
e.zh: 有些文化在逝者去世当天就举行葬礼。

buried.t:
v. 埋葬（bury 的过去式）
adj. 被埋的

e.en: My phone is {buried} somewhere under all these papers.
e.zh: 我的手机被埋在这堆文件下面的某处了。

e.en: The dog {buried} a bone in the backyard again.
e.zh: 那只狗又把骨头埋在了后院里。

buries.t: v. 埋葬（bury 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The algorithm {buries} negative reviews under positive ones.
e.zh: 该算法把负面评价压在好评下面。

e.en: He {buries} himself in work to avoid thinking about it.
e.zh: 他埋头于工作,以免去想这件事。

e.en: The engraver carved fine lines using a steel {burin}.
e.zh: 雕刻师用钢制刻刀刻出细致的线条。

e.en: A sharp {burin} is essential for detailed copperplate work.
e.zh: 一把锋利的雕刻刀对精细的铜版作品必不可少。

burka.t: n. 布卡（穆斯林女性罩袍）

e.en: She chose to wear a {burka} for religious reasons.
e.zh: 出于宗教原因,她选择穿罩袍。

e.en: Some countries have banned the {burka} in public buildings.
e.zh: 一些国家禁止在公共建筑内穿罩袍。

burke.t:
n. 伯克（姓氏）
v. 悄悄压制

e.en: Officials tried to {burke} the investigation before it began.
e.zh: 官员们在调查开始前就试图扼杀此事。

e.en: The committee voted to {burke} the controversial proposal.
e.zh: 委员会投票压下了那项有争议的提案。

e.en: He carved a beautiful bowl from a maple {burl}.
e.zh: 他用枫树瘤雕刻出一只漂亮的木碗。

e.en: Each walnut {burl} has a unique swirling grain pattern.
e.zh: 每块胡桃木瘤都有独特的旋涡纹理。

e.en: The coffee beans are shipped in rough {burlap} sacks.
e.zh: 咖啡豆装在粗麻布袋里运输。

e.en: She wrapped the gift in {burlap} for a rustic look.
e.zh: 她用粗麻布包装礼物,营造质朴的感觉。

burlesque.t:
n. 滑稽戏；讽刺剧
adj. 滑稽模仿的

e.en: The show is a playful {burlesque} of corporate culture.
e.zh: 这场演出是对企业文化的一场戏谑滑稽剧。

e.en: She performs at a {burlesque} club downtown on weekends.
e.zh: 她周末在市中心一家滑稽歌舞俱乐部表演。

burley.t: n. 伯利烟草（浅色烤烟）

e.en: Kentucky farmers still grow large amounts of {burley} tobacco.
e.zh: 肯塔基的农民仍种植大量伯利烟草。

e.en: The blend uses {burley} for its rich, nutty flavor.
e.zh: 这款混合烟草用伯利烟提供浓郁坚果味。

e.en: We took a weekend trip up to {Burlington}, Vermont.
e.zh: 我们周末驱车去了佛蒙特州的伯灵顿。

e.en: {Burlington} sits on the eastern shore of Lake Champlain.
e.zh: 伯灵顿坐落在尚普兰湖的东岸。

e.en: A {burly} bouncer stood at the club entrance.
e.zh: 一个魁梧的保安站在俱乐部门口。

e.en: The {burly} farmer lifted the hay bale with ease.
e.zh: 那个壮实的农夫轻松地举起了那捆干草。

e.en: {Burma} is now officially known as Myanmar.
e.zh: 缅甸现在的官方名称是Myanmar。

e.en: She traveled through {Burma} during her gap year.
e.zh: 她在间隔年期间游历了缅甸。

burman.t:
n. 缅甸人
adj. 缅甸的

e.en: The book describes traditional {Burman} village life in detail.
e.zh: 这本书详细描述了缅族传统的村庄生活。

e.en: {Burman} is the largest ethnic group in Myanmar.
e.zh: 缅族是缅甸最大的民族。

burmese.t:
adj. 缅甸的
n. 缅甸人；缅甸语

e.en: My neighbor adopted a fluffy {Burmese} kitten last week.
e.zh: 我邻居上周领养了一只毛茸茸的缅甸小猫。

e.en: The restaurant specializes in spicy {Burmese} noodle soup.
e.zh: 这家餐厅专门做香辣的缅甸汤面。

burn.t:
v. 燃烧；烧伤
n. 烧伤

e.en: Be careful not to {burn} the toast this time.
e.zh: 小心这次别把吐司烤糊了。

e.en: My eyes {burn} after staring at the screen all day.
e.zh: 盯了一天屏幕后我的眼睛火辣辣地疼。

burned.t:
v. 燃烧（过去式）
adj. 烧焦的

e.en: I {burned} my finger on the hot pan.
e.zh: 我的手指被烫到了那只热平底锅。

e.en: She {burned} a copy of the playlist onto a CD.
e.zh: 她把那个播放列表刻录到了CD上。

e.en: Turn the front {burner} down to medium heat.
e.zh: 把前面那个炉头调到中火。

e.en: He used a {burner} phone for the anonymous tip.
e.zh: 他用一次性手机提供了匿名线索。

e.en: Salad {burnet} adds a mild cucumber flavor to dishes.
e.zh: 沙拉地榆能为菜肴增添淡淡的黄瓜味。

e.en: The herb garden has thyme, sage, and {burnet}.
e.zh: 这个香草园里有百里香、鼠尾草和地榆。

e.en: Daniel {Burnham} designed many iconic Chicago buildings.
e.zh: 丹尼尔·伯纳姆设计了许多芝加哥的标志性建筑。

e.en: We hiked along the beach near {Burnham}-on-Sea.
e.zh: 我们沿着伯纳姆海滨的海滩远足。

burning.t:
adj. 燃烧的；强烈的
n. 燃烧

e.en: The candle has been {burning} for three hours.
e.zh: 这支蜡烛已经燃烧了三个小时。

e.en: She has a {burning} desire to start her own company.
e.zh: 她有一种强烈的渴望要创办自己的公司。

e.en: He used a soft cloth to {burnish} the silver trophy.
e.zh: 他用软布把银制奖杯擦得锃亮。

e.en: The CEO tried to {burnish} her image after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻之后,首席执行官试图重塑自己的形象。

e.en: The {burnished} brass railing gleamed in the sunlight.
e.zh: 擦亮的黄铜扶手在阳光下闪闪发光。

e.en: Her latest novel further {burnished} her literary reputation.
e.zh: 她的新小说进一步提升了她的文学声誉。

e.en: {Burnley} drew one-all against Manchester City last night.
e.zh: 伯恩利昨晚与曼城一比一战平。

e.en: He grew up in a small town near {Burnley}.
e.zh: 他在伯恩利附近的一个小镇长大。

burnout.t: n. 职业倦怠；精疲力竭

e.en: Many remote workers are reporting severe {burnout} this year.
e.zh: 今年许多远程办公者出现了严重的职业倦怠。

e.en: She took a month off to recover from {burnout}.
e.zh: 她请了一个月的假来缓解职业倦怠。

burns.t:
v. 燃烧（第三人称单数）
n. 伯恩斯（姓氏）

e.en: This candle {burns} for about forty hours.
e.zh: 这支蜡烯大约能燃烧四十个小时。

e.en: The patient suffered second-degree {burns} on his arms.
e.zh: 病人手臂上有二度烧伤。

burnside.t:
n. 伯恩赛德（姓氏）
n. 络腮胡

e.en: General {Burnside} was famous for his unusual facial hair.
e.zh: 伯恩赛德将军以他独特的络腮胡而闻名。

e.en: We crossed the {Burnside} Bridge into downtown Portland.
e.zh: 我们走过伯恩赛德桥进入波特兰市中心。

burnt.t:
adj. 烧焦的
v. 燃烧（过去式）

e.en: The toast got {burnt} while I answered the phone.
e.zh: 我接电话的时候吐司烤焦了。

e.en: The kitchen still smelled of {burnt} garlic.
e.zh: 厨房里还残留着焦蒜的味道。

e.en: The baby gave a loud {burp} after her bottle.
e.zh: 宝宝喝完奶后大声打了个嗝。

e.en: Don't {burp} so loudly at the dinner table.
e.zh: 在餐桌上不要打嗝打得那么响。

burqa.t: n. 布卡（穆斯林女性罩袍）

e.en: She wore a blue {burqa} when leaving the house.
e.zh: 她出门时穿着一件蓝色的罩袍。

e.en: The law banning the {burqa} sparked heated debate.
e.zh: 禁止穿罩袍的法律引发了激烈争论。

burr.t:
n. 毛刺；小钻头
n. 小舌颤音

e.en: A {burr} stuck to my sock during the hike.
e.zh: 徒步时一颗带刺的草籽粘在了我的袜子上。

e.en: He spoke with a soft Scottish {burr}.
e.zh: 他说话带着柔和的苏格兰口音。

e.en: The {Burra} copper mine is a major historic site.
e.zh: 布拉铜矿是一处重要的历史遗址。

e.en: We camped near the old {Burra} town center.
e.zh: 我们在布拉镇老城中心附近露营。

e.en: I ordered a chicken {burrito} with extra guacamole.
e.zh: 我点了一份加多牛油果酱的鸡肉卷。

e.en: This {burrito} is way too spicy for me.
e.zh: 这个墨西哥卷饼对我来说太辣了。

e.en: The old farmer led his {burro} up the trail.
e.zh: 老农牵着他的小毛驴沿小路上山。

e.en: A stubborn {burro} refused to cross the stream.
e.zh: 一头倔强的小毛驴拒绝过那条小溪。

burrow.t:
n. 地洞
v. 挖洞；钻进

e.en: The rabbit darted into its {burrow} when startled.
e.zh: 兔子受惊后窜进了它的洞穴。

e.en: Moles {burrow} deep underground to find food.
e.zh: 鼹鼠在地下深处挖洞寻找食物。

burrowing.t:
v. 挖洞（现在分词）
adj. 穴居的

e.en: {Burrowing} owls live in abandoned prairie dog tunnels.
e.zh: 穴鸮住在被废弃的草原犬鼠洞里。

e.en: The dog spent hours {burrowing} under the fence.
e.zh: 那只狗花了几个小时在篱笆下挖洞。

burrows.t:
n. 地洞（复数）
v. 挖洞（第三人称单数）

e.en: Wild rabbits dig deep {burrows} across the meadow.
e.zh: 野兔在草地上挖出深深的洞穴。

e.en: The fox {burrows} into the hillside every winter.
e.zh: 狐狸每年冬天都钻进山坡里挖洞。

e.en: Gut bacteria produce {butyrate}, which feeds colon cells.
e.zh: 肠道细菌会产生丁酸盐，为结肠细胞提供能量。

e.en: High-fiber diets boost {butyrate} levels in the intestine.
e.zh: 高纤维饮食可以提高肠道中的丁酸盐水平。

e.en: The painting shows a {buxom} woman holding a basket of fruit.
e.zh: 画中是一位丰满的女子手捧一篮水果。

e.en: The novel describes a cheerful, {buxom} innkeeper.
e.zh: 小说里描写了一位开朗丰腴的女店主。

buxton.t: n. 巴克斯顿（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: We spent the weekend hiking near {Buxton} in Derbyshire.
e.zh: 我们周末在德比郡的巴克斯顿附近徒步。

e.en: {Buxton} is famous for its natural mineral spring water.
e.zh: 巴克斯顿以天然矿泉水闻名。

buy.t:
v. 购买
n. 所购之物；划算的买卖

e.en: I want to {buy} a new laptop before school starts.
e.zh: 我想在开学前买一台新笔记本电脑。

e.en: Honestly, I don't {buy} his excuse at all.
e.zh: 说实话，我一点都不相信他的借口。

e.en: The company announced a one-billion-dollar share {buyback} program.
e.zh: 公司宣布了一项十亿美元的股票回购计划。

e.en: The store offers a {buyback} on used phones.
e.zh: 这家店提供旧手机回购服务。

e.en: The seller is waiting for a serious {buyer} to make an offer.
e.zh: 卖家正在等一位认真的买家出价。

e.en: She works as a fashion {buyer} for a major department store.
e.zh: 她在一家大型百货公司担任时装采购员。

buyers.t: n. 买家们；采购员（复数）

e.en: First-time {buyers} are struggling with high mortgage rates.
e.zh: 首次购房者正被高企的房贷利率所困扰。

e.en: The auction attracted {buyers} from all over Europe.
e.zh: 这场拍卖吸引了来自欧洲各地的买家。

buying.t:
n. 购买；采购
v. 购买（现在分词）

e.en: I'm thinking of {buying} an electric car next year.
e.zh: 我打算明年买一辆电动车。

e.en: Nobody is {buying} his explanation for being late.
e.zh: 没人相信他迟到的解释。

e.en: Management announced a surprise {buyout} of the struggling startup.
e.zh: 管理层意外宣布收购这家陷入困境的初创公司。

e.en: Senior staff were offered a generous voluntary {buyout}.
e.zh: 资深员工获得了一份丰厚的自愿离职补偿方案。

buys.t:
v. 购买（第三人称单数）
n. 所购之物（复数）

e.en: She {buys} fresh flowers every Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 她每周五下午都会买些鲜花。

e.en: That backpack is one of the best {buys} this year.
e.zh: 那个背包是今年最划算的购物之一。

buz.t: n. buzz 的变体，嗡嗡声

e.en: The kids called their grandfather {Buz} for short.
e.zh: 孩子们简称他们的祖父为巴兹。

e.en: Old comic books often featured a pilot named {Buz}.
e.zh: 旧漫画里常出现一个叫巴兹的飞行员。

buzz.t:
n. 嗡嗡声；热议
v. 发出嗡嗡声；传出消息

e.en: There's a lot of {buzz} online about the new phone.
e.zh: 网上对这款新手机有不少热议。

e.en: I heard a bee {buzz} past my ear in the garden.
e.zh: 我听见一只蜜蜂从耳边嗡嗡飞过。

e.en: A {buzzard} circled high above the open field.
e.zh: 一只秃鹰在开阔的田野上空盘旋。

e.en: The {buzzard} swooped down to grab a small rabbit.
e.zh: 那只秃鹰俯冲下来抓住了一只小兔子。

e.en: Several {buzzards} gathered around the roadside carcass.
e.zh: 几只秃鹰聚集在路边的尸体旁。

e.en: We watched {buzzards} riding the warm afternoon thermals.
e.zh: 我们看着秃鹰借助下午的暖气流盘旋飞翔。

buzzed.t: v. 嗡嗡作响（过去式）；微醺

e.en: My phone {buzzed} with a message during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时我的手机震动了一下，来了条消息。

e.en: The crowd {buzzed} with excitement before the concert started.
e.zh: 演唱会开始前，人群兴奋地议论纷纷。

e.en: Press the {buzzer} and I'll let you into the building.
e.zh: 按一下门铃，我就放你进楼。

e.en: He scored the winning shot just before the {buzzer}.
e.zh: 他在终场蜂鸣器响起前投进了制胜一球。

e.en: The contestants slammed their {buzzers} to answer first.
e.zh: 选手们猛拍抢答器，争着先回答。

e.en: All the apartment {buzzers} were broken again this morning.
e.zh: 今早整栋公寓的门铃又都坏了。

buzzes.t: n./v. 嗡嗡作响（第三人称单数/复数）

e.en: My watch {buzzes} whenever I get a new email.
e.zh: 每来一封新邮件，我的手表就会震动一下。

e.en: The café {buzzes} with energy on Saturday mornings.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆周六早上总是热闹非凡。

buzzing.t:
adj. 嗡嗡作响的；热闹的
v. 嗡嗡响（现在分词）

e.en: The whole office is {buzzing} about the merger news.
e.zh: 整个办公室都在热议合并的消息。

e.en: A mosquito kept {buzzing} around my head all night.
e.zh: 一只蚊子整夜在我头边嗡嗡乱飞。

e.en: The defense hit the rookie quarterback like a {buzzsaw}.
e.zh: 防守组像电锯一样扑向那位新秀四分卫。

e.en: He cut through the planks with a noisy {buzzsaw}.
e.zh: 他用一台嘈杂的圆锯把木板切开。

e.en: "Synergy" became the corporate {buzzword} of the decade.
e.zh: "协同效应"成了那十年最流行的企业流行语。

e.en: Every startup pitch features the same tired AI {buzzword}.
e.zh: 每个创业路演都在重复同一个老套的 AI 流行词。

e.en: That new restaurant has a really {buzzy} atmosphere on weekends.
e.zh: 那家新餐厅周末气氛特别热闹。

e.en: The startup is the most {buzzy} name in fintech right now.
e.zh: 这家初创公司是当下金融科技领域最受关注的名字。

e.en: The cartoon bee {buzzzes} loudly across the screen.
e.zh: 卡通蜜蜂在屏幕上大声地嗡嗡飞过。

e.en: In the comic, the alarm {buzzzes} until someone wakes up.
e.zh: 漫画里闹钟一直嗡嗡响，直到有人醒来。

e.en: Stress is often a {by-product} of poor time management.
e.zh: 压力往往是时间管理不善的副产品。

e.en: Glycerin is a useful {by-product} of soap manufacturing.
e.zh: 甘油是制皂过程中的一种有用副产品。

bye.t:
int. 再见
n. 轮空（赛制）

e.en: She waved {bye} as the train pulled away.
e.zh: 火车驶离时她挥手告别。

e.en: The top seed got a first-round {bye} in the tournament.
e.zh: 头号种子在锦标赛首轮轮空。

e.en: A local {byelaw} bans drinking alcohol in this park.
e.zh: 当地一项地方法规禁止在这个公园饮酒。

e.en: The council passed a new {byelaw} on dog walking.
e.zh: 市议会通过了一项关于遛狗的新地方法规。

e.en: Her grandparents emigrated from {Byelorussia} after the war.
e.zh: 她的祖父母在战后从白俄罗斯移民出来。

e.en: Old maps still labeled the region as {Byelorussia}.
e.zh: 旧地图上这一地区仍标注为白俄罗斯。

byelorussian.t:
adj. 白俄罗斯的
n. 白俄罗斯人

e.en: He speaks Russian fluently and a little {Byelorussian}.
e.zh: 他俄语说得流利，还会一点白俄罗斯语。

e.en: The museum displayed traditional {Byelorussian} costumes and crafts.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了白俄罗斯的传统服饰与手工艺品。

byes.t:
int. 再见（复数）
n. 轮空（复数）

e.en: We said our {byes} at the airport gate.
e.zh: 我们在机场登机口互相道别。

e.en: The top four players received first-round {byes}.
e.zh: 前四名选手在首轮获得了轮空资格。

e.en: The old theater has the charm of a {bygone} era.
e.zh: 这座老剧院有种逝去年代的魅力。

e.en: Let's let {bygone} arguments stay in the past.
e.zh: 过去的争吵就让它过去吧。

bylaw.t: n. 地方法规；（组织的）章程

e.en: A city {bylaw} prohibits loud music after eleven at night.
e.zh: 市政条例禁止晚上十一点后播放吵闹的音乐。

e.en: The condo's {bylaw} doesn't allow large dogs.
e.zh: 这栋公寓的章程不允许养大型犬。

e.en: Her first {byline} appeared in the school newspaper.
e.zh: 她的第一个署名出现在校报上。

e.en: The article carried a famous reporter's {byline}.
e.zh: 这篇文章署着一位著名记者的名字。

bypass.t:
v. 绕过；规避
n. 旁路；搭桥手术

e.en: Use the new {bypass} to avoid downtown traffic.
e.zh: 走新修的绕城路就能避开市中心的拥堵。

e.en: Hackers found a way to {bypass} the login screen.
e.zh: 黑客找到了绕过登录界面的办法。

e.en: The update {bypassed} the usual security checks entirely.
e.zh: 这次更新完全绕过了常规的安全检查。

e.en: We {bypassed} the village to save twenty minutes.
e.zh: 我们绕过那个村子，省下了二十分钟。

bypasses.t:
v. 绕过（第三人称单数）
n. 旁路（复数）

e.en: This shortcut {bypasses} three traffic lights downtown.
e.zh: 这条捷径能绕开市区的三个红绿灯。

e.en: The script {bypasses} the captcha during testing.
e.zh: 这段脚本在测试时会绕过验证码。

bypassing.t: v. 绕过；跳过（现在分词）

e.en: He saved time by {bypassing} the form and emailing directly.
e.zh: 他直接发邮件，绕过表格，省下了时间。

e.en: The app is {bypassing} the App Store with a web version.
e.zh: 这款应用通过网页版绕过了应用商店。

e.en: Carbon dioxide is a common {byproduct} of burning fuel.
e.zh: 二氧化碳是燃烧燃料常见的副产物。

e.en: Better sleep was an unexpected {byproduct} of daily exercise.
e.zh: 睡眠改善是每天锻炼意外带来的好处。

e.en: The farmer led the cows back into the {byre} at dusk.
e.zh: 傍晚时农夫把牛赶回了牛棚。

e.en: An old stone {byre} stood at the edge of the field.
e.zh: 田边立着一座古老的石砌牛棚。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on the poetry of Lord {Byron}.
e.zh: 她的论文是研究拜伦勋爵的诗歌。

e.en: {Byron} traveled widely across Italy and Greece.
e.zh: 拜伦曾遍游意大利和希腊各地。

byronic.t: adj. 拜伦式的；浪漫忧郁的

e.en: The novel's hero has a brooding, {Byronic} charm.
e.zh: 小说主人公带有一种忧郁的拜伦式魅力。

e.en: He cultivated a {Byronic} image of moody rebellion.
e.zh: 他刻意营造一种拜伦式的忧郁叛逆形象。

bursa.t: n. 滑囊（关节处的囊状结构）

e.en: The doctor said the {bursa} in my shoulder is inflamed.
e.zh: 医生说我肩部的滑囊发炎了。

e.en: We flew to {Bursa} to visit the ancient mosques.
e.zh: 我们飞往布尔萨参观古老的清真寺。

e.en: The college {bursar} handles all tuition payments.
e.zh: 学院的财务主管负责处理所有学费缴纳事宜。

e.en: Please email the {bursar} about the billing error.
e.zh: 请就账单错误一事发邮件给财务主管。

bursary.t:
n. 助学金
n. 财务办公室

e.en: She received a generous {bursary} to study abroad.
e.zh: 她获得了一笔丰厚的助学金出国留学。

e.en: The university offers a {bursary} for low-income students.
e.zh: 这所大学为低收入学生提供助学金。

e.en: Years of tennis left him with chronic {bursitis}.
e.zh: 多年打网球让他患上了慢性滑囊炎。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her shoulder pain as {bursitis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断她的肩痛是滑囊炎。

burst.t:
v. 爆裂；突然发生
n. 爆发；一阵

e.en: The water pipe {burst} during last night's freeze.
e.zh: 水管在昨晚的霜冻中爆裂了。

e.en: She {burst} into laughter at his silly joke.
e.zh: 听到他的傻笑话,她突然大笑起来。

e.en: Astronomers detected a powerful X-ray {burster} in the galaxy.
e.zh: 天文学家在该星系探测到一个强大的X射线爆发源。

e.en: The neutron star is classified as a slow {burster}.
e.zh: 这颗中子星被归类为慢速爆发源。

bursting.t: v. 爆裂；迸发（burst 的现在分词）

e.en: The kids were {bursting} with excitement on Christmas morning.
e.zh: 孩子们在圣诞节早上兴奋得不得了。

e.en: My suitcase is {bursting} at the seams.
e.zh: 我的行李箱已经塞得快要爆开了。

bursts.t: n./v. 爆发（burst 的复数/三单）

e.en: The engine produces short {bursts} of acceleration.
e.zh: 这台引擎能产生短暂的加速爆发。

e.en: She {bursts} into the room without knocking.
e.zh: 她不敲门就闯进了房间。

e.en: Tim {Burton} is famous for his gothic film style.
e.zh: 蒂姆·伯顿以其哥特式电影风格而闻名。

e.en: We caught the train to {Burton}-on-Trent yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天搭火车去了特伦特河畔伯顿。

e.en: The {Burun} people live mainly in eastern Sudan.
e.zh: 布伦人主要生活在苏丹东部。

e.en: Linguists are documenting the endangered {Burun} language.
e.zh: 语言学家正在记录濒危的布伦语。

e.en: {Burundi} is a small landlocked country in East Africa.
e.zh: 布隆迪是东非一个内陆小国。

e.en: Coffee is one of {Burundi}'s main exports.
e.zh: 咖啡是布隆迪的主要出口商品之一。

burundian.t:
adj. 布隆迪的
n. 布隆迪人

e.en: The {Burundian} delegation arrived at the summit yesterday.
e.zh: 布隆迪代表团昨天抵达峰会现场。

e.en: She married a {Burundian} doctor she met in Brussels.
e.zh: 她嫁给了一位在布鲁塞尔认识的布隆迪医生。

e.en: Squirrels {bury} acorns to eat during winter.
e.zh: 松鼠把橡子埋起来,以备冬天食用。

e.en: Don't {bury} the important details in the footnotes.
e.zh: 不要把重要的细节藏在脚注里。

burying.t: v. 埋葬（bury 的现在分词）

e.en: The dog is {burying} a bone in the garden.
e.zh: 那只狗正在花园里埋骨头。

e.en: He's {burying} himself in work to avoid grief.
e.zh: 他把自己埋进工作里以逃避悲伤。

bus.t:
n. 公交车
n. 总线（计算机）

e.en: I take the {bus} to work every morning.
e.zh: 我每天早上坐公交车去上班。

e.en: The school {bus} arrives at seven sharp.
e.zh: 校车七点整准时到达。

busboy.t: n. 餐厅收拾餐具的男杂工

e.en: The {busboy} cleared the dishes from our table.
e.zh: 杂工把我们桌上的盘子收走了。

e.en: He worked as a {busboy} to pay for college.
e.zh: 他做餐厅杂工来支付大学学费。

busby.t: n. 英军仪仗队的毛皮高帽

e.en: The guard wore a tall black {busby} on duty.
e.zh: 卫兵执勤时戴着高高的黑色熊皮帽。

e.en: Tourists love photographing soldiers in their {busby} hats.
e.zh: 游客喜欢拍戴熊皮帽的士兵。

buses.t: n. 公交车（bus 的复数）

e.en: All the {buses} were delayed because of the snowstorm.
e.zh: 所有公交车都因暴风雪而延误。

e.en: The city is replacing old {buses} with electric ones.
e.zh: 该市正在用电动巴士替换旧公交车。

bush.t:
n. 灌木丛
n. 布什（姓氏）

e.en: A small bird hid in the rose {bush}.
e.zh: 一只小鸟躲在玫瑰丛里。

e.en: They went hiking through the Australian {bush}.
e.zh: 他们在澳大利亚的丛林里徒步旅行。

e.en: The farmer sold a {bushel} of apples for ten dollars.
e.zh: 农夫以十美元的价格卖出了一蒲式耳苹果。

e.en: Wheat prices rose by fifty cents per {bushel}.
e.zh: 小麦价格每蒲式耳上涨了五十美分。

e.en: The cat is hiding behind the {bushes} again.
e.zh: 猫又躲在灌木丛后面了。

e.en: We trimmed the {bushes} along the front walkway.
e.zh: 我们修剪了前门小路边的灌木。

e.en: The mechanic replaced a worn {bushing} in the suspension.
e.zh: 机械师更换了悬挂系统里磨损的衬套。

e.en: A faulty {bushing} can cause excessive vibration.
e.zh: 衬套故障会导致过度震动。

bushman.t: n. 丛林居民；布须曼人

e.en: The {bushman} tracked the antelope across the dry plain.
e.zh: 丛林人追踪羚羊穿过干旱的平原。

e.en: An experienced {bushman} can find water anywhere.
e.zh: 经验丰富的丛林人在哪里都能找到水源。

e.en: The {bushmaster} is one of the longest venomous snakes.
e.zh: 巨蝮蛇是最长的毒蛇之一。

e.en: Locals warned us to watch for the deadly {bushmaster}.
e.zh: 当地人警告我们要提防致命的巨蝮蛇。

bushwhack.t: v. 在丛林中穿行；伏击

e.en: We had to {bushwhack} through dense jungle for hours.
e.zh: 我们不得不在密林中艰难穿行好几个小时。

e.en: Rebels would often {bushwhack} convoys at the mountain pass.
e.zh: 叛军经常在山口伏击车队。

bushwhacker.t: n. 丛林伏击者；拓荒者

e.en: A lone {bushwhacker} ambushed the patrol at dawn.
e.zh: 一名独行的伏击者在黎明时偷袭了巡逻队。

e.en: The veteran {bushwhacker} knew every trail in the forest.
e.zh: 那位老练的丛林开路者熟悉森林里的每一条小路。

bushy.t: adj. 浓密的；灌木丛生的

e.en: He has thick {bushy} eyebrows like his father.
e.zh: 他和父亲一样有着浓密的眉毛。

e.en: The squirrel flicked its {bushy} tail nervously.
e.zh: 松鼠紧张地甩动着它毛茸茸的尾巴。

e.en: The bees were {busily} collecting pollen from the flowers.
e.zh: 蜜蜂正忙碌地从花朵中采集花粉。

e.en: She typed {busily} to meet the deadline.
e.zh: 她忙着打字以赶上截止期限。

business.t:
n. 生意；商业
n. 事务；公司

e.en: She started her own {business} right after college.
e.zh: 她大学一毕业就自己创业了。

e.en: That's none of your {business}, honestly.
e.zh: 老实说,那不关你的事。

e.en: Her tone was polite but strictly {businesslike}.
e.zh: 她的语气礼貌但完全是公事公办。

e.en: He has a {businesslike} approach to every meeting.
e.zh: 他对每次会议都采取一种公事公办的方式。

e.en: The young {businessman} closed his first major deal.
e.zh: 那位年轻的商人完成了他的第一笔大生意。

e.en: A successful {businessman} donated millions to the school.
e.zh: 一位成功的商人向学校捐赠了数百万。

businessmen.t: n. 商人们（businessman 的复数）

e.en: Several {businessmen} attended the trade conference in Tokyo.
e.zh: 几位商人出席了在东京举行的贸易会议。

e.en: The {businessmen} signed a partnership agreement yesterday.
e.zh: 那些商人昨天签署了一份合作协议。

e.en: Local {businesspeople} gathered to discuss tax reform.
e.zh: 当地的商界人士聚在一起讨论税制改革。

e.en: Many {businesspeople} are switching to remote work.
e.zh: 许多商界人士正在转向远程办公。

e.en: Every {businessperson} should understand basic accounting.
e.zh: 每个商务人士都应该了解基本的会计知识。

e.en: She's a sharp {businessperson} with strong negotiation skills.
e.zh: 她是个精明的商务人士,谈判能力很强。

e.en: She became a successful {businesswoman} after launching her own startup.
e.zh: 她创办自己的初创公司后成为了一名成功的女企业家。

e.en: The {businesswoman} closed a major deal with a Tokyo client.
e.zh: 这位女企业家与一位东京客户敲定了一笔大订单。

e.en: Several {businesswomen} spoke at the leadership conference yesterday.
e.zh: 几位女企业家昨天在领导力大会上发表了演讲。

e.en: The award honors {businesswomen} who mentor young professionals.
e.zh: 该奖项表彰那些指导年轻职场人士的女企业家。

busing.t: n. 用校车接送（学生上下学）

e.en: The city ended {busing} students across districts last year.
e.zh: 该市去年取消了跨学区用校车接送学生的政策。

e.en: Court-ordered {busing} aimed to integrate public schools.
e.zh: 法院下令的校车接送政策旨在让公立学校实现种族融合。

e.en: Street musicians {busk} near the subway entrance every weekend.
e.zh: 街头艺人每个周末都在地铁口附近卖艺。

e.en: He used to {busk} with his guitar to pay for college.
e.zh: 他过去常常弹吉他卖艺来支付大学学费。

e.en: A talented {busker} drew a crowd outside the train station.
e.zh: 一位才华横溢的街头艺人在火车站外吸引了一群观众。

e.en: The {busker} earned more in tips than at her day job.
e.zh: 这位街头艺人赚的小费比白天工作的工资还多。

busload.t: n. 一辆公交车的载客量

e.en: A {busload} of tourists arrived at the museum this morning.
e.zh: 一大巴车的游客今天早上抵达了博物馆。

e.en: The team brought a {busload} of fans to the championship game.
e.zh: 球队带着满满一巴士的球迷去观看冠军赛。

e.en: Reading code on vacation feels like a {busman}'s holiday.
e.zh: 度假时还在看代码,感觉像是司机度假还在开车。

e.en: The {busman} waved kindly as passengers boarded at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨乘客上车时,巴士司机友好地挥了挥手。

e.en: Grandma gave the baby a gentle {buss} on the cheek.
e.zh: 奶奶在宝宝脸上轻轻亲了一下。

e.en: He leaned over to {buss} his wife before leaving for work.
e.zh: 他出门上班前俯身亲了一下妻子。

bust.t:
v. 打破；破产
n. 半身像；胸围

e.en: Police carried out a major drug {bust} downtown last night.
e.zh: 昨晚警方在市中心进行了一次大规模的毒品突击行动。

e.en: Be careful not to {bust} the zipper on that suitcase.
e.zh: 小心别把那个行李箱的拉链弄坏了。

e.en: The great {bustard} is one of the heaviest flying birds alive.
e.zh: 大鸨是现存最重的飞行鸟类之一。

e.en: Conservationists are working to protect the endangered {bustard}.
e.zh: 保护人士正在努力保护濒危的鸨鸟。

busted.t:
adj. 坏掉的；破产的
v. 被抓（bust 的过去式）

e.en: My headphones {busted} after only three months of use.
e.zh: 我的耳机才用了三个月就坏了。

e.en: He got {busted} for cheating on the final exam.
e.zh: 他因为在期末考试中作弊被抓了。

buster.t: n. 破坏者；克星（常用于合成词）

e.en: Hey {buster}, you can't park your car here.
e.zh: 喂,老兄,你不能把车停在这里。

e.en: The new app is a real myth {buster} about healthy eating.
e.zh: 这款新应用真是健康饮食谣言的克星。

busting.t: v. 打破、抓捕（bust 的现在分词）

e.en: My new jeans are {busting} at the seams already.
