e.en: The {bandswitch} broke after years of heavy use.
e.zh: 这个波段开关使用多年后损坏了。

bandura.t: 班杜拉琴(乌克兰多弦民间乐器)

e.en: She played a folk tune on the {bandura}.
e.zh: 她用班杜拉琴弹了一首民谣。

e.en: The {bandura} has dozens of strings of varying length.
e.zh: 班杜拉琴有几十根长短不一的琴弦。

e.en: The old sailor walked with a {bandy-legged} gait.
e.zh: 那位老水手走起路来是罗圈腿的姿态。

e.en: His {bandy-legged} stance amused the children.
e.zh: 他罗圈腿的站姿逗乐了孩子们。

e.en: Children with severe rickets often develop {bandyleg}.
e.zh: 患严重佝偻病的儿童常出现罗圈腿。

e.en: The horse's {bandyleg} clearly affected its gait.
e.zh: 这匹马的弓形腿明显影响了它的步态。

baneberry.t: 类叶升麻;毒浆果(有毒林地植物)

e.en: Hikers should avoid the tempting fruit of the {baneberry}.
e.zh: 徒步者应避开类叶升麻诱人的果实。

e.en: The {baneberry} grows in shaded woodlands across the north.
e.zh: 类叶升麻生长在北方阴暗的林地中。

bang-bang.t: 砰砰(声);开关式急剧切换的(控制)

e.en: Engineers use {bang-bang} control for simple thermostats.
e.zh: 工程师用开关式控制设计简单的恒温器。

e.en: The kids ran around playing {bang-bang} with toy pistols.
e.zh: 孩子们拿着玩具枪砰砰地到处对射。

bang-for-the-buck.t: 性价比;物有所值的程度

e.en: This phone offers tremendous {bang-for-the-buck}.
e.zh: 这款手机性价比极高。

e.en: Investors are always hunting for the best {bang-for-the-buck}.
e.zh: 投资者总在寻求最高的性价比。

e.en: She did a {bang-up} job on the renovation.
e.zh: 她把这次翻修做得棒极了。

e.en: They threw a {bang-up} party for his retirement.
e.zh: 他们为他的退休举办了一场盛大的派对。

e.en: Farmers tossed ears of corn against the {bangboard}.
e.zh: 农民把玉米棒掷向撞板上。

e.en: The wagon's {bangboard} caught the harvested corn neatly.
e.zh: 货车的撞板把收获的玉米整齐地接住。

e.en: The {bangtail} won the third race by a length.
e.zh: 那匹剪尾马以一个马身的优势赢得第三场比赛。

e.en: He bet on every {bangtail} at the track that afternoon.
e.zh: 那天下午他在赛道上每匹马都下了注。

bangup.t: 极好的;一流的(bang-up的不连字符变体)

e.en: It was a {bangup} performance from start to finish.
e.zh: 那是一场从头到尾都极佳的表演。

e.en: She turned in a {bangup} report ahead of schedule.
e.zh: 她提前交了一份非常出色的报告。

e.en: He {banjaxed} the printer trying to fix the paper jam.
e.zh: 他想修卡纸,结果把打印机弄坏了。

e.en: The sudden storm {banjaxed} our weekend plans.
e.zh: 突如其来的暴风雨把我们的周末计划全毁了。

e.en: The {banjoist} joined the bluegrass band on stage.
e.zh: 班卓琴手登台加入了蓝草乐队。

e.en: She trained as a {banjoist} from early childhood.
e.zh: 她从小就接受班卓琴演奏训练。

banjulele.t: 班卓尤克里里(班卓琴与尤克里里的混合乐器)

e.en: George Formby famously played the {banjulele}.
e.zh: 乔治·福姆比以演奏班卓尤克里里闻名。

e.en: He bought a vintage {banjulele} at the music shop.
e.zh: 他在乐器店买了一把复古班卓尤克里里。

e.en: She opened a {bank-account} last week.
e.zh: 她上周开了一个银行账户。

e.en: Please transfer the money to my {bank-account}.
e.zh: 请把钱转到我的银行账户。

e.en: He paid for the groceries with his {bank-card}.
e.zh: 他用银行卡支付了食品杂货款。

e.en: I lost my {bank-card} somewhere yesterday.
e.zh: 我昨天把银行卡弄丢在某处。

e.en: The shop accepts only {bank-issued} credit cards.
e.zh: 这家店只接受银行发行的信用卡。

e.en: He carried a {bank-issued} cashier's cheque to the closing.
e.zh: 他带着一张银行开出的本票去办理交割。

e.en: They took out a {bank-loan} to buy the house.
e.zh: 他们办了一笔银行贷款来买房。

e.en: Repaying the {bank-loan} took nearly ten years.
e.zh: 偿还这笔银行贷款花了将近十年。

e.en: She handed the cashier a crisp {bank-note}.
e.zh: 她递给收银员一张崭新的钞票。

e.en: The machine rejected the torn {bank-note}.
e.zh: 机器拒收那张破损的纸币。

e.en: Miners extract gold from the {banket} formations underground.
e.zh: 矿工从地下的含金砾岩层中开采黄金。

e.en: Witwatersrand {banket} contains some of the richest gold deposits.
e.zh: 威特沃特斯兰德的含金砾岩蕴藏着最丰富的金矿之一。

bankfull.t: 齐岸的;平岸水位的(水文学)

e.en: The river reached {bankfull} stage after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,河水达到了平岸水位。

e.en: Engineers measured the {bankfull} discharge of the channel.
e.zh: 工程师测量了河道的平岸流量。

e.en: We bought {bar-height} chairs for the kitchen island.
e.zh: 我们为厨房中岛买了高脚椅。

e.en: The {bar-height} table seats six comfortably.
e.zh: 这张高脚桌可舒适地坐下六人。

e.en: Let's {bar-hop} downtown tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我们去市中心一家接一家地泡酒吧吧。

e.en: They {bar-hopped} until two in the morning.
e.zh: 他们一直泡酒吧到凌晨两点。

bar-hopping.t: 串酒吧；连续光顾多家酒吧

e.en: We went {bar-hopping} along the riverfront.
e.zh: 我们沿着河滨串了一家又一家酒吧。

e.en: {Bar-hopping} is popular with tourists here.
e.zh: 在这里串酒吧很受游客欢迎。

bar-keeper.t: 酒吧老板；酒保；吧台老板

e.en: The friendly {bar-keeper} remembered everyone's name.
e.zh: 那位热心的酒吧老板记得每个人的名字。

e.en: She worked as a {bar-keeper} for years.
e.zh: 她当了多年酒保。

bar-line.t: 乐谱小节线；分小节的竖线

e.en: Draw a {bar-line} between every measure.
e.zh: 在每小节之间画一条小节线。

e.en: The {bar-line} marks the end of the measure.
e.zh: 小节线标志着这一小节的结束。

bar-mitzvah.t: 犹太男孩十三岁成年礼

e.en: His {bar-mitzvah} was a joyful family celebration.
e.zh: 他的犹太成年礼是一场欢乐的家庭庆典。

e.en: She attended her cousin's {bar-mitzvah} last Saturday.
e.zh: 上周六她参加了表弟的犹太成年礼。

bar-tender.t: 酒保；调酒师；吧台服务员

e.en: The {bar-tender} mixed a perfect cocktail.
e.zh: 那位调酒师调出了一杯完美的鸡尾酒。

e.en: Ask the {bar-tender} for the wifi password.
e.zh: 向酒保问一下无线网密码。

e.en: Doctors test {baraesthesia} with calibrated weights.
e.zh: 医生用校准过的砝码来测试压觉。

e.en: Loss of {baraesthesia} can indicate nerve damage.
e.zh: 压觉丧失可能提示神经受损。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {baragnosis}.
e.zh: 患者被诊断为重量觉缺失。

e.en: {Baragnosis} often follows a parietal lobe injury.
e.zh: 重量觉缺失常发生在顶叶受损之后。

baramin.t: 创造论中的受造基本类群

e.en: Creationists group species into a single {baramin}.
e.zh: 创造论者把物种归入同一个受造类群。

e.en: The concept of {baramin} is unfamiliar to most biologists.
e.zh: 受造类群这一概念对大多数生物学家来说很陌生。

barathea.t: 巴拉西亚布；细斜纹精纺毛织物

e.en: His suit was tailored from fine {barathea}.
e.zh: 他的西装是用上好的巴拉西亚布定做的。

e.en: {Barathea} has a soft, pebbly texture.
e.zh: 巴拉西亚布质地柔软、有细颗粒感。

barbacan.t: 城堡前的外堡塔楼；瓮城

e.en: The {barbacan} guarded the main gate of the castle.
e.zh: 外堡塔楼守卫着城堡的主门。

e.en: We climbed to the top of the medieval {barbacan}.
e.zh: 我们爬上了那座中世纪外堡塔楼的顶端。

e.en: The {barback} restocked glasses all night.
e.zh: 那名酒吧助理整晚都在补充酒杯。

e.en: He started as a {barback} before becoming a bartender.
e.zh: 他先做酒吧助理，后来才当上调酒师。

barbaresque.t: 巴巴里风格的；北非海岸的

e.en: The museum displayed {barbaresque} corsair artifacts.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了巴巴里海岸海盗的文物。

e.en: He collected {barbaresque} swords and daggers.
e.zh: 他收藏巴巴里风格的刀剑。

e.en: The empire descended into {barbarianism} after the invasion.
e.zh: 帝国在入侵之后陷入了野蛮状态。

e.en: She condemned the {barbarianism} of the regime.
e.zh: 她谴责该政权的野蛮行径。

e.en: War can {barbarianize} even peaceful societies.
e.zh: 战争甚至会使原本和平的社会变得野蛮。

e.en: He warned against allowing greed to {barbarianize} the culture.
e.zh: 他警告不要让贪婪使整个文化变得野蛮。

e.en: The prisoners were treated {barbarically}.
e.zh: 那些囚犯遭到了野蛮的对待。

e.en: He laughed {barbarically} at the cruel joke.
e.zh: 他对那个残忍的玩笑粗野地大笑。

barbarisation.t: 野蛮化；逐渐沦为野蛮状态

e.en: Scholars debated the {barbarisation} of the late empire.
e.zh: 学者们讨论着帝国晚期的野蛮化进程。

e.en: He warned against the {barbarisation} of public discourse.
e.zh: 他警告公共讨论正在走向野蛮化。

barbarise.t: 使变野蛮；使粗野化；英式拼法

e.en: Endless conflict can {barbarise} a society.
e.zh: 无休止的冲突会使一个社会变得野蛮。

e.en: She refused to let cynicism {barbarise} her writing.
e.zh: 她不让愤世嫉俗使自己的写作变得粗野。

e.en: Historians traced the slow {barbarization} of the army.
e.zh: 历史学家追溯了军队缓慢的野蛮化过程。

e.en: The {barbarization} of language alarmed the academy.
e.zh: 语言的粗鄙化让学术界深感不安。

e.en: Fear and isolation can {barbarize} entire communities.
e.zh: 恐惧和孤立可以使整个社区变得野蛮。

e.en: He warned that violence would {barbarize} the next generation.
e.zh: 他警告暴力会使下一代变得野蛮。

e.en: The children ran {barelegged} through the meadow.
e.zh: 孩子们光着腿在草地上奔跑。

e.en: She felt cold standing {barelegged} in the snow.
e.zh: 她赤腿站在雪地里感到很冷。

baresark.t: 狂战士；不穿铠甲作战的勇士

e.en: The Norse {baresark} charged into battle without armor.
e.zh: 那名北欧狂战士不穿铠甲冲入战场。

e.en: Old sagas describe warriors fighting like a {baresark}.
e.zh: 古老的萨迦描述战士像狂战士那样厮杀。

baresthesia.t: 压觉感受能力；触压感觉

e.en: Doctors test {baresthesia} to assess nerve function.
e.zh: 医生通过测试压觉来评估神经功能。

e.en: Diabetes can impair {baresthesia} in the feet.
e.zh: 糖尿病可能损害足部的压觉。

baresthesiometer.t: 压觉计；测量压觉的仪器

e.en: The clinic uses a {baresthesiometer} for diagnosis.
e.zh: 诊所使用压觉计来诊断。

e.en: A {baresthesiometer} measures sensitivity to pressure.
e.zh: 压觉计用来测量对压力的敏感度。

e.en: A few {barflies} sat hunched over their drinks.
e.zh: 几个酒吧常客弓着背喝酒。

e.en: The old pub was full of regular {barflies}.
e.zh: 那家老酒馆里坐满了熟客。

bargain-basement.t: 廉价的；低档的；处理品的

e.en: He bought a {bargain-basement} suit for the wedding.
e.zh: 他买了一套廉价西装去参加婚礼。

e.en: The hotel had a {bargain-basement} feel.
e.zh: 那家酒店给人一种廉价感。

bargain-hunter.t: 喜欢淘便宜货的人；精打细算的购物者

e.en: She is a serious {bargain-hunter} on weekends.
e.zh: 她周末是个认真淘便宜货的人。

e.en: Every {bargain-hunter} loves the post-holiday sales.
e.zh: 每个淘便宜货的人都喜欢节后大减价。

bargainable.t: 可议价的；可协商讨价的

e.en: The price is firm and not {bargainable}.
e.zh: 价格已定，没有商量的余地。

e.en: Working hours are usually {bargainable} in negotiations.
e.zh: 工作时间在谈判中通常是可协商的。

bargainbasement.t: 廉价的；处理品的；低档商品的

e.en: They sell {bargainbasement} electronics online.
e.zh: 他们在网上出售廉价电子产品。

e.en: It looked like {bargainbasement} furniture.
e.zh: 那看起来像是处理品家具。

bargainee.t: 受让人；契约买方（法律用语）

e.en: The {bargainee} signed the deed of transfer.
e.zh: 受让人在转让契约上签了字。

e.en: Risk passes to the {bargainee} at delivery.
e.zh: 风险在交付时转移给受让人。

bargainor.t: 出让人；契约卖方（法律用语）

e.en: The {bargainor} retained no interest in the property.
e.zh: 出让人未保留该财产的任何权益。

e.en: A {bargainor} must disclose all known defects.
e.zh: 出让人必须披露所有已知的缺陷。

e.en: The cottage's carved {barge-board} was newly painted.
e.zh: 村舍上雕花的博风板刚刚漆过。

e.en: They restored the rotting {barge-board} on the gable.
e.zh: 他们修复了山墙上腐烂的博风板。

bargeboard.t: 博风板；山墙封檐装饰板

e.en: A decorative {bargeboard} framed the cottage gable.
e.zh: 装饰性的博风板镶嵌在村舍山墙上。

e.en: The {bargeboard} had been carved with floral motifs.
e.zh: 那块博风板上雕有花卉图案。

bargeboarded.t: 装有博风板的；带山墙封檐板的

e.en: The {bargeboarded} cottage looked charmingly Victorian.
e.zh: 那栋装有博风板的小屋显得颇具维多利亚风情。

e.en: They admired the {bargeboarded} gables of the chapel.
e.zh: 他们欣赏小教堂上装有博风板的山墙。

bargello.t: 巴杰罗刺绣；火焰针绣花

e.en: She stitched a {bargello} cushion in bright colors.
e.zh: 她用鲜艳的颜色绣了一个巴杰罗靠垫。

e.en: {Bargello} patterns often resemble flames or waves.
e.zh: 火焰针绣的图案常常像火焰或波浪。

e.en: The {bargeman} steered carefully under the bridge.
e.zh: 驳船船夫小心翼翼地驾船穿过桥下。

e.en: An old {bargeman} told stories of the canals.
e.zh: 一位老船工讲述着运河上的故事。

e.en: The {bargemaster} oversaw loading at the wharf.
e.zh: 驳船船长在码头监督装货。

e.en: A royal {bargemaster} once led ceremonial river processions.
e.zh: 皇家船队领队曾带领河上的仪典船队。

barghest.t: 妖犬；预兆死亡的传说鬼狗

e.en: Villagers swore they had seen the {barghest} at midnight.
e.zh: 村民们发誓在午夜看到了那只妖犬。

e.en: Folklore says the {barghest} appears before someone dies.
e.zh: 民间传说妖犬会在有人去世前出现。

e.en: A friendly {bargirl} took our drink orders.
e.zh: 一位友好的酒吧女招待为我们点了酒。

e.en: She worked as a {bargirl} during college.
e.zh: 她大学期间做过吧女。

e.en: The slide showed sales as a colorful {bargraph}.
e.zh: 幻灯片用彩色条形图显示销售情况。

e.en: Please convert this table into a {bargraph}.
e.zh: 请把这张表格转换成柱状图。

e.en: Let's {barhop} along the riverside tonight.
e.zh: 我们今晚沿着河边一家家地泡酒吧吧。

e.en: Tourists often {barhop} in the old quarter.
e.zh: 游客们经常在老城区一家接一家地喝酒。

barhopped.t: 连续逛了几家酒吧（过去式）

e.en: We {barhopped} through downtown until dawn.
e.zh: 我们一路逛酒吧逛到天亮。

e.en: They {barhopped} all over the French Quarter.
e.zh: 他们在法国区四处串酒吧。

barhopping.t: 连续光顾多家酒吧；串酒吧

e.en: Friday night was perfect for {barhopping}.
e.zh: 周五晚上正适合串酒吧。

e.en: She is too tired for {barhopping} tonight.
e.zh: 她今晚太累了，不想串酒吧。

barhops.t: 一家接一家地泡酒吧（第三人称单数）

e.en: He often {barhops} with old college friends.
e.zh: 他常常和老同学一家家地串酒吧。

e.en: My brother {barhops} every weekend in Soho.
e.zh: 我哥哥每个周末都在苏豪区串酒吧。

bariatrician.t: 减重医师；肥胖症专科医生

e.en: Her {bariatrician} designed a personalized weight-loss plan.
e.zh: 她的减重医师设计了个性化的减肥方案。

e.en: He consulted a {bariatrician} before considering surgery.
e.zh: 他在考虑手术前咨询了肥胖症专科医生。

e.en: The lab analyzed several {baric} compounds.
e.zh: 实验室分析了几种含钡化合物。

e.en: Industrial waste may contain {baric} residues.
e.zh: 工业废料可能含有钡残留物。

barilla.t: 海蓬子；制碱用海生植物

e.en: Soap makers once burned {barilla} for soda ash.
e.zh: 制皂工人曾焚烧海蓬子来获取苏打灰。

e.en: Spanish coasts produced large quantities of {barilla}.
e.zh: 西班牙沿海曾出产大量海蓬子。

barish.t: 略显空荡的；有点光秃的

e.en: The new apartment still looked a bit {barish}.
e.zh: 那间新公寓看起来仍有点空荡。

e.en: Winter trees stood {barish} against the sky.
e.zh: 冬天的树木光秃秃地映在天空下。

e.en: Drillers add {barite} to mud to control pressure.
e.zh: 钻井工人在泥浆中加入重晶石以控制压力。

e.en: This region has rich deposits of {barite}.
e.zh: 该地区蕴藏着丰富的重晶石矿。

baritonal.t: 男中音的；具有男中音特征的

e.en: His warm {baritonal} voice filled the hall.
e.zh: 他温暖的男中音嗓音充满了大厅。

e.en: The role demands a rich {baritonal} quality.
e.zh: 这个角色需要浑厚的男中音音色。

e.en: Miners can develop {baritosis} from inhaling barium dust.
e.zh: 矿工吸入钡尘可能患上钡尘肺。

e.en: {Baritosis} is usually considered a benign pneumoconiosis.
e.zh: 钡尘肺通常被认为是一种良性尘肺病。

bark-bound.t: 树皮过紧的；皮缚的（树木病态）

e.en: The {bark-bound} oak failed to grow normally.
e.zh: 那棵皮缚的橡树无法正常生长。

e.en: Foresters slit {bark-bound} trunks to relieve pressure.
e.zh: 林务员在皮缚的树干上划口以释放压力。

e.en: The {barkeepers} polished glasses behind the long oak counter.
e.zh: 酒保们在长长的橡木吧台后擦拭酒杯。

e.en: Two friendly {barkeepers} mixed cocktails for the late crowd.
e.zh: 两位友好的酒保为深夜的客人调制鸡尾酒。

e.en: The old {barkentine} sailed gracefully into the harbor.
e.zh: 那艘古老的三桅帆船优雅地驶入港口。

e.en: Sailors trained on a restored {barkentine} off the coast.
e.zh: 水手们在沿海一艘修复的三桅帆船上接受训练。

e.en: A massive {barkhan} slowly migrated across the desert floor.
e.zh: 一座巨大的新月形沙丘在沙漠上缓慢移动。

e.en: Researchers studied how each {barkhan} shifted with the wind.
e.zh: 研究人员研究每座新月形沙丘如何随风移动。

e.en: The {barkless} tree stood out against the green forest.
e.zh: 那棵无树皮的树在绿色森林中格外显眼。

e.en: Their {barkless} dog rarely made any noise at night.
e.zh: 他们那只不吠的狗夜里几乎从不出声。

e.en: She admired the {barky} texture of the old oak.
e.zh: 她欣赏那棵老橡树粗糙的树皮纹理。

e.en: Children carved their initials into the {barky} trunk.
e.zh: 孩子们把自己的名字刻在粗糙的树干上。

e.en: Workers stacked the {barley-mow} high before winter.
e.zh: 冬天来临前工人们把麦垛堆得高高的。

e.en: An old folk song still celebrates the {barley-mow}.
e.zh: 一首古老的民歌至今仍在歌颂麦垛。

barleybrake.t: 麦地捕人游戏（古时乡村游戏）

e.en: Village children played {barleybrake} in the summer fields.
e.zh: 村里的孩子们夏天在田野里玩麦地捕人游戏。

e.en: Old poems mention couples playing {barleybrake} at dusk.
e.zh: 古诗中提到情侣在黄昏玩麦地捕人游戏。

barleybreak.t: 麦地捕人游戏（古英国游戏）

e.en: Shakespeare-era youths enjoyed games like {barleybreak}.
e.zh: 莎士比亚时代的年轻人喜爱玩麦地捕人之类的游戏。

e.en: She read about {barleybreak} in a sixteenth-century pastoral.
e.zh: 她在一首十六世纪牧歌中读到麦地捕人游戏。

e.en: John {Barleycorn} symbolizes whisky in Scottish folk songs.
e.zh: 约翰·大麦粒在苏格兰民歌中象征威士忌。

e.en: A {barleycorn} was once used as a small unit of length.
e.zh: 大麦粒曾被用作一种小型长度单位。

e.en: Bakers once used {barm} skimmed from brewing vats.
e.zh: 面包师曾用酿酒桶上撇下的酵母浮沫来发面。

e.en: The ale produced thick {barm} on its surface.
e.zh: 这种麦芽酒表面产生了浓厚的酵母浮沫。

barmbrack.t: 爱尔兰葡萄干水果面包

e.en: Her grandmother always baked {barmbrack} for Halloween.
e.zh: 她奶奶总在万圣节烤爱尔兰葡萄干面包。

e.en: We sliced the warm {barmbrack} and spread butter on it.
e.zh: 我们切开温热的葡萄干面包，涂上黄油。

e.en: He offered only a {barmecide} promise of help.
e.zh: 他只给出空头的帮助承诺。

e.en: The dinner turned out to be a {barmecide} feast.
e.zh: 那顿晚餐结果是一场虚有其表的盛宴。

e.en: That was the {barmiest} plan I had ever heard.
e.zh: 那是我听过最荒唐的计划。

e.en: He was easily the {barmiest} professor on campus.
e.zh: 他无疑是校园里最疯癫的教授。

barn-burning.t: 精彩绝伦的；焚烧谷仓的

e.en: The team delivered a {barn-burning} performance in the final.
e.zh: 球队在决赛中奉献了一场精彩绝伦的演出。

e.en: Police investigated a series of {barn-burning} incidents.
e.zh: 警方调查了一系列焚烧谷仓的案件。

e.en: A {barn-owl} silently glided across the moonlit field.
e.zh: 一只仓鸮悄无声息地掠过月光下的田野。

e.en: Farmers welcome the {barn-owl} for hunting mice.
e.zh: 农民欢迎仓鸮，因为它能捕鼠。

barnburner.t: 激动人心的事件；干劲十足的人

e.en: Last night's game was a real {barnburner}.
e.zh: 昨晚的比赛真是精彩刺激。

e.en: Their debate turned into a political {barnburner}.
e.zh: 他们的辩论变成了一场政治激战。

barnlike.t: 似谷仓的；像谷仓一样空旷的

e.en: They converted a {barnlike} hall into a cozy restaurant.
e.zh: 他们把一座似谷仓的大厅改造成温馨的餐厅。

e.en: The studio had a vast, {barnlike} interior.
e.zh: 那间工作室内部宽敞如谷仓。

e.en: The doctor reviewed the patient's {ballistocardiogram} for irregularities.
e.zh: 医生查看了病人的心冲击图，检查是否有异常。

e.en: A {ballistocardiogram} can reveal subtle cardiac problems.
e.zh: 心冲击图可以揭示细微的心脏问题。

e.en: The lab installed a new {ballistocardiograph} last month.
e.zh: 实验室上个月安装了一台新的心冲击描记器。

e.en: Researchers used a {ballistocardiograph} to monitor heart movement.
e.zh: 研究人员用心冲击描记器监测心脏运动。

ballistophobia.t: 飞射物恐惧症；弹丸恐惧症

e.en: His {ballistophobia} made him avoid baseball games.
e.zh: 他对飞射物的恐惧让他不敢去看棒球比赛。

e.en: She developed {ballistophobia} after a bad accident.
e.zh: 她在一场严重事故后患上了飞射物恐惧症。

e.en: The mechanic replaced a worn {balljoint} on the front axle.
e.zh: 机械师更换了前桥上一个磨损的球形接头。

e.en: This camera tripod uses a smooth {balljoint} head.
e.zh: 这个相机三脚架使用了顺滑的球形云台。

e.en: That's a load of {ballocks} and you know it.
e.zh: 那完全是胡说八道，你心里清楚。

e.en: He muttered "{ballocks}" when he dropped the keys.
e.zh: 他钥匙掉了，嘟囔了一句"该死"。

balloelectric.t: 水滴起电的；喷雾起电的

e.en: The {balloelectric} effect occurs when water droplets break apart.
e.zh: 水滴破裂时会产生喷雾起电效应。

e.en: Waterfalls can generate a faint {balloelectric} charge.
e.zh: 瀑布可以产生微弱的喷雾起电电荷。

ballonet.t: 副气囊（飞艇内调节气压用）

e.en: The airship's {ballonet} expanded as it climbed.
e.zh: 飞艇上升时副气囊随之膨胀。

e.en: Engineers inspected each {ballonet} before takeoff.
e.zh: 起飞前工程师检查了每个副气囊。

e.en: The dirigible's two {ballonets} kept it level.
e.zh: 飞艇的两个副气囊让它保持平衡。

e.en: Both {ballonets} were checked for leaks.
e.zh: 两个副气囊都进行了漏气检查。

balloon-borne.t: 气球载运的；气球搭载的

e.en: Scientists launched a {balloon-borne} telescope into the stratosphere.
e.zh: 科学家把一架气球载运的望远镜送入了平流层。

e.en: The {balloon-borne} sensors collected weather data.
e.zh: 那些气球搭载的传感器收集了气象数据。

ballooners.t: 乘热气球的人；气球驾驶员

e.en: The {ballooners} drifted gracefully over the valley.
e.zh: 那些气球驾驶员优雅地飘过山谷。

e.en: Several {ballooners} gathered for the dawn launch.
e.zh: 几位热气球爱好者聚在一起准备黎明起飞。

e.en: A spiny {balloonfish} puffed up in the diver's flashlight.
e.zh: 一条带刺的气球鱼在潜水员的手电下鼓胀起来。

e.en: Children laughed at the round {balloonfish} in the tank.
e.zh: 孩子们看着水族缸里圆滚滚的气球鱼大笑。

balloonlike.t: 气球状的；像气球一样的

e.en: Her dress had a {balloonlike} skirt that swayed as she walked.
e.zh: 她的裙子有个气球状的裙摆，走起路来一摆一摆。

e.en: The cake rose into a {balloonlike} dome.
e.zh: 蛋糕烤成了一个气球状的圆顶。

e.en: Voters dropped their slips into the {ballot-box}.
e.zh: 选民们把选票投进投票箱。

e.en: He hopes to settle this dispute at the {ballot-box}.
e.zh: 他希望通过投票来解决这场争端。

ballotable.t: 可付诸表决的；可投票决定的

e.en: The motion was deemed {ballotable} by the chair.
e.zh: 主席认定该动议可以付诸表决。

e.en: Only {ballotable} items appear on the agenda.
e.zh: 只有可表决的事项才会列入议程。

e.en: The election went to a {ballotage} between the top two candidates.
e.zh: 选举进入了前两名候选人之间的决选投票。

e.en: A {ballotage} was scheduled for the following Sunday.
e.zh: 决选投票安排在下个星期日举行。

e.en: The midwife used {ballottement} to feel the baby's position.
e.zh: 助产士用冲击触诊法来感知胎儿的位置。

e.en: {Ballottement} can detect a floating fetus in late pregnancy.
e.zh: 冲击触诊法可以在妊娠晚期感知漂浮的胎儿。

e.en: She signed the form with a blue {ballpen}.
e.zh: 她用蓝色圆珠笔在表格上签了字。

e.en: Could you lend me a {ballpen}?
e.zh: 能借我一支圆珠笔吗？

ballproof.t: 防弹的；不被子弹穿透的

e.en: The general wore a {ballproof} vest beneath his coat.
e.zh: 将军在外套下穿了件防弹背心。

e.en: Old armor was rarely truly {ballproof}.
e.zh: 古时的盔甲很少真正能防弹。

e.en: They take {ballroom-dance} lessons every Tuesday.
e.zh: 他们每周二上交谊舞课。

e.en: The couple loves to {ballroom-dance} on weekends.
e.zh: 这对夫妇喜欢在周末跳交谊舞。

e.en: He made a complete {balls-up} of the presentation.
e.zh: 他把那场演讲彻底搞砸了。

e.en: What a {balls-up} this whole project has become.
e.zh: 整个项目变成了一团糟。

e.en: I admire the sheer {ballsiness} of her negotiation tactics.
e.zh: 我佩服她谈判时那股十足的胆量。

e.en: It took some {ballsiness} to confront the boss directly.
e.zh: 直接顶撞老板需要相当的胆量。

e.en: The schedule turned into a complete {ballup}.
e.zh: 日程安排变成了一团乱麻。

e.en: What a {ballup} this meeting has become.
e.zh: 这场会议怎么搞成这样一团糟。

e.en: A child peered through the carved {balluster}.
e.zh: 一个孩子从雕花栏杆柱缝里往外看。

e.en: Each {balluster} on the staircase was hand-turned.
e.zh: 楼梯上每根栏杆柱都是手工车制的。

e.en: The capsule deployed a {ballute} to slow its descent.
e.zh: 返回舱展开了一个球状降落伞来减速。

e.en: Engineers tested the {ballute} in a wind tunnel.
e.zh: 工程师在风洞中测试了这个球状降落伞。

e.en: Don't let them {ballyrag} you into agreeing.
e.zh: 别让他们恫吓你点头答应。

e.en: The older boys would {ballyrag} the new students.
e.zh: 高年级男生常常戏弄新生。

e.en: The recruits were {ballyragged} by their drill sergeant.
e.zh: 新兵们被教官狠狠地训斥过。

e.en: She felt she had been {ballyragged} into signing.
e.zh: 她觉得自己是被恫吓着才签了字。

e.en: His constant {ballyragging} drove the new clerk away.
e.zh: 他不停的欺凌把新来的职员逼走了。

e.en: There's no excuse for {ballyragging} junior staff.
e.zh: 欺凌下属是毫无借口的。

e.en: He wore a tweed {balmacaan} against the autumn chill.
e.zh: 他穿着一件粗花呢宽松大衣抵挡秋寒。

e.en: A grey {balmacaan} hung by the door.
e.zh: 一件灰色的宽松大衣挂在门边。

e.en: The breeze blew {balmily} through the open window.
e.zh: 微风温和地从敞开的窗户吹进来。

e.en: The evening air settled {balmily} over the garden.
e.zh: 夜晚的空气宜人地笼罩着花园。

e.en: I love the {balminess} of late spring evenings.
e.zh: 我喜欢晚春夜晚那种温和宜人的感觉。

e.en: There was a tropical {balminess} in the air.
e.zh: 空气中弥漫着一种热带的温润气息。

balmusette.t: 巴黎手风琴舞会；小酒馆舞场

e.en: They danced all night at a Paris {balmusette}.
e.zh: 他们在巴黎一家小酒馆舞场里跳了一整夜。

e.en: The accordion music recalled an old {balmusette}.
e.zh: 那手风琴的旋律让人想起从前的小酒馆舞场。

e.en: The spa offered traditional {balneal} treatments.
e.zh: 水疗中心提供传统的沐浴疗法。

e.en: Roman {balneal} customs spread across the empire.
e.zh: 罗马的沐浴习俗传遍了整个帝国。

bartizan.t: 角楼；塔楼上突出的小炮塔

e.en: A stone {bartizan} jutted from the castle's corner.
e.zh: 一座石制角楼从城堡的转角处探出。

e.en: Archers once watched the road from that {bartizan}.
e.zh: 昔日弓箭手曾从那座角楼上监视道路。

e.en: She arranged the {barware} on a polished tray.
e.zh: 她把酒吧用具摆在一个抛光的托盘上。

e.en: The shop sells crystal {barware} for cocktail enthusiasts.
e.zh: 这家店出售供鸡尾酒爱好者使用的水晶酒具。

e.en: The two stars orbit their common {barycenter}.
e.zh: 这两颗恒星围绕它们共同的质心运行。

e.en: Pluto and Charon share a {barycenter} outside Pluto itself.
e.zh: 冥王星和卡戎的质心位于冥王星本体之外。

e.en: Astronomers calculated the system's {barycentre} precisely.
e.zh: 天文学家精确计算了该系统的质心。

e.en: The moon's orbit is defined relative to the {barycentre}.
e.zh: 月球的轨道是相对于质心来定义的。

e.en: Most {baryonic} matter exists as hydrogen and helium.
e.zh: 大多数重子物质以氢和氦的形式存在。

e.en: Dark matter is not {baryonic} in nature.
e.zh: 暗物质本质上不是重子物质。

barysphere.t: 重圈；地球内核与地幔合称

e.en: Geologists once used {barysphere} to describe Earth's dense interior.
e.zh: 地质学家曾用重圈一词来描述地球致密的内部。

e.en: The term {barysphere} has largely fallen out of modern usage.
e.zh: 重圈这一术语在现代基本不再使用。

e.en: The chemist heated {baryta} to study its reactions.
e.zh: 化学家加热重土以研究其反应。

e.en: Photographic paper coated with {baryta} produces sharp prints.
e.zh: 涂有重土的相纸能洗印出清晰的相片。

e.en: Miners extracted {barytes} from the limestone vein.
e.zh: 矿工从石灰岩矿脉中开采出重晶石。

e.en: {Barytes} is widely used as a drilling-mud additive.
e.zh: 重晶石被广泛用作钻井泥浆的添加剂。

e.en: The choir's {barytone} sang the solo beautifully.
e.zh: 合唱团的男中音独唱得很优美。

e.en: Older scores often spell the part as {barytone}.
e.zh: 较旧的乐谱常把这个声部拼作 barytone。

e.en: The lab installed a new {barothermohydrograph} on the roof.
e.zh: 实验室在屋顶安装了一台新的气压温度湿度记录仪。

e.en: Engineers calibrated the {barothermohydrograph} every morning.
e.zh: 工程师每天早上都校准这台气压温度湿度记录仪。

e.en: She studied the {barothermohygrogram} for trends.
e.zh: 她研究气压温湿度记录图以寻找规律。

e.en: The {barothermohygrogram} showed a sudden pressure drop.
e.zh: 气压温湿度记录图显示气压骤降。

e.en: The weather station relies on a {barothermohygrograph}.
e.zh: 气象站依靠一台气压温湿度记录仪工作。

e.en: Technicians repaired the broken {barothermohygrograph} yesterday.
e.zh: 技术人员昨天修好了坏掉的气压温湿度记录仪。

e.en: The pilot checked the {barothermohygrometer} before takeoff.
e.zh: 飞行员起飞前检查了气压温湿度计。

e.en: This {barothermohygrometer} measures three variables at once.
e.zh: 这台气压温湿度计可同时测量三个变量。

e.en: Deep-sea bacteria show remarkable {barotolerance}.
e.zh: 深海细菌表现出惊人的耐压能力。

e.en: They tested the cells for {barotolerance} under extreme pressure.
e.zh: 他们在极端压力下测试细胞的耐压性。

barotropism.t: 向压性（生物对气压的反应）

e.en: Some plants exhibit a subtle form of {barotropism}.
e.zh: 一些植物表现出微妙的向压性。

e.en: Researchers debated whether {barotropism} truly exists.
e.zh: 研究人员争论向压性是否真的存在。

e.en: The model assumes complete {barotropy} of the fluid.
e.zh: 该模型假设流体完全呈正压性。

e.en: {Barotropy} simplifies many atmospheric equations.
e.zh: 正压性简化了许多大气方程。

e.en: They rode through the park in a polished {barouche}.
e.zh: 他们乘坐一辆擦得锃亮的四轮敞篷马车穿过公园。

e.en: The duchess kept an antique {barouche} in her stables.
e.zh: 公爵夫人在马厩里收藏着一辆古董敞篷马车。

e.en: A graceful {barquentine} sailed into the harbor.
e.zh: 一艘优雅的纵帆船驶入港口。

e.en: The {barquentine} carried spices across the Atlantic.
e.zh: 这艘纵帆船横渡大西洋运送香料。

e.en: She filled each {barquette} with lemon cream.
e.zh: 她在每个船形酥饼里都填满柠檬奶油。

e.en: The bakery's fruit {barquette} sold out by noon.
e.zh: 面包店的水果船形酥饼中午前就卖光了。

barrable.t: 可被禁止的；可以阻止的

e.en: The judge ruled that the claim was not {barrable}.
e.zh: 法官裁定该诉求不可被排除。

e.en: Some offenses are not {barrable} by any statute of limitations.
e.zh: 有些罪行不受任何时效限制的阻挡。

e.en: He wore a heavy cloak of {barracan}.
e.zh: 他穿着一件厚重的粗毛织物斗篷。

e.en: {Barracan} was once popular for travelers' coats.
e.zh: 这种粗毛织物曾流行于旅行者的外套。

barracoon.t: （旧时关押奴隶或囚犯的）木栅营房

e.en: Captives were held in a coastal {barracoon} before shipment.
e.zh: 被俘者在装船前被关在海岸的木栅营房里。

e.en: Historians documented the cruel conditions of every {barracoon}.
e.zh: 历史学家记录下每座木栅营房的残酷状况。

barracoons.t: （旧时关押奴隶的）木栅营房（复数）

e.en: The slave traders built {barracoons} along the coast.
e.zh: 奴隶贩子沿海岸修建了一座座木栅营房。

e.en: Few traces of those {barracoons} remain today.
e.zh: 那些木栅营房如今几乎没有留下痕迹。

e.en: The fishermen netted a large {barracouta} at dawn.
e.zh: 渔民们在黎明时网到了一条大梭鱼。

e.en: Smoked {barracouta} is a New Zealand specialty.
e.zh: 熏梭鱼是新西兰的特色食品。

e.en: A {barrage-balloon} floated above the harbor during the war.
e.zh: 战时一只防空阻塞气球漂浮在港口上空。

e.en: The crew tethered the {barrage-balloon} to a heavy winch.
e.zh: 船员把防空阻塞气球系在一台重型绞车上。

e.en: Dozens of {barrage-balloons} dotted the London sky in 1940.
e.zh: 1940年伦敦上空布满了几十只防空阻塞气球。

e.en: The city deployed {barrage-balloons} to deter low-flying bombers.
e.zh: 该市部署防空阻塞气球以阻止低空轰炸机。

e.en: The {barramunda} is one of Australia's oldest fish species.
e.zh: 澳洲肺鱼是澳大利亚最古老的鱼类之一。

e.en: Scientists studied the lungs of the {barramunda} in detail.
e.zh: 科学家详细研究了澳洲肺鱼的肺部结构。

e.en: We grilled fresh {barramundi} for dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐我们烤了新鲜的盲曹鱼。

e.en: {Barramundi} is farmed across northern Australia.
e.zh: 澳大利亚北部各地都养殖盲曹鱼。

e.en: The trail wound along a deep {barranca}.
e.zh: 小径沿着一道深峡谷蜿蜒而行。

e.en: Rain transformed the dry {barranca} into a torrent.
e.zh: 雨水把干涸的冲沟变成了急流。

e.en: Mountain {barrancas} cut sharply through the desert plateau.
e.zh: 山间的峡谷在沙漠高原上深深切下。

e.en: They mapped every one of the region's {barrancas}.
e.zh: 他们绘制了该地区每一道峡谷。

barrater.t: 诉讼煽动者；舞弊船长（barrator的旧拼）

e.en: The medieval court punished the {barrater} severely.
e.zh: 中世纪法庭严惩这位诉讼煽动者。

e.en: He was branded a {barrater} for stirring up lawsuits.
e.zh: 他因挑起诉讼而被斥为诉讼煽动者。

barrathea.t: 巴拉西厄毛料（一种细密织物）

e.en: His suit was tailored from fine black {barrathea}.
e.zh: 他的西装是用上等的黑色巴拉西厄毛料定制的。

e.en: {Barrathea} drapes beautifully on formal wear.
e.zh: 巴拉西厄毛料在正装上垂坠效果极佳。

barrator.t: 诉讼煽动者；恶意诉讼者

e.en: The court labeled him a habitual {barrator}.
e.zh: 法院将他定性为惯常的诉讼煽动者。

e.en: A {barrator} profits by stirring up needless litigation.
e.zh: 诉讼煽动者靠挑起无谓的诉讼牟利。

e.en: Medieval statutes punished {barrators} with hefty fines.
e.zh: 中世纪法令对诉讼煽动者处以重罚。

e.en: The bar association investigated suspected {barrators}.
e.zh: 律师协会调查了几名涉嫌煽讼的人。

barratrous.t: 恶意诉讼的；船长舞弊的

e.en: The insurer refused to cover {barratrous} losses.
e.zh: 保险公司拒绝赔偿因船长舞弊造成的损失。

e.en: His {barratrous} conduct cost the firm its reputation.
e.zh: 他煽动诉讼的行为使公司声誉受损。

barratry.t: 挑唆诉讼罪；船长舞弊行为

e.en: The lawyer was disbarred for {barratry}.
e.zh: 那位律师因挑唆诉讼罪被吊销执照。

e.en: Marine insurance policies often exclude {barratry}.
e.zh: 海运保险单常将船长舞弊行为列为除外责任。

barrel-bulk.t: 桶容积单位（约五立方英尺）

e.en: Freight was charged by the {barrel-bulk}.
e.zh: 货运按桶容积单位计费。

e.en: They estimated the cargo at two hundred {barrel-bulk}.
e.zh: 他们估计货物有两百个桶容积单位。

e.en: The {barrel-chested} sergeant bellowed across the parade ground.
e.zh: 那位胸膛宽厚的中士在阅兵场上大吼。

e.en: He was a short, {barrel-chested} man with strong arms.
e.zh: 他个子不高，胸膛宽厚，胳膊有力。

e.en: The Victorians built brick {barrel-drain} systems beneath the city.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的人在城市下方修建了砖砌的圆桶形排水管系统。

e.en: Workers cleared debris from the old {barrel-drain}.
e.zh: 工人们清理了那条老旧圆桶排水管里的杂物。

e.en: A street musician cranked his {barrel-organ} for coins.
e.zh: 一位街头艺人摇着他的手摇风琴讨赏钱。

e.en: The old {barrel-organ} played a cheerful tune.
e.zh: 那台旧手摇风琴奏出欢快的曲调。

e.en: She won the regional {barrel-racing} championship.
e.zh: 她赢得了地区绕桶赛马冠军。

e.en: {Barrel-racing} demands speed and tight turns.
e.zh: 绕桶赛马需要速度和急转弯的技巧。

e.en: The brewery reported a record {barrelage} this year.
e.zh: 啤酒厂报告今年的桶装产量创下纪录。

e.en: Tax was assessed on the total {barrelage} sold.
e.zh: 税款按售出的总桶装量征收。

e.en: The kids brought home a {barrelful} of apples.
e.zh: 孩子们带回家满满一桶苹果。

e.en: She emptied a whole {barrelful} of rainwater into the garden.
e.zh: 她把整整一桶雨水倒进了花园。

e.en: She devoted her career to {basic-science} research.
e.zh: 她把职业生涯献给了基础科学研究。

e.en: Funding for {basic-science} has dropped sharply.
e.zh: 基础科学的经费大幅下降。

e.en: The course covers {basic-skills} like reading and writing.
e.zh: 这门课涵盖读写等基本技能。

e.en: Many adults still lack {basic-skills} in math.
e.zh: 许多成年人仍缺乏基本的数学技能。

e.en: The {basicity} of the solution was measured carefully.
e.zh: 溶液的碱度被仔细测定。

e.en: Higher {basicity} indicates a stronger base.
e.zh: 碱度越高说明碱性越强。

basidia.t: 担子（担子菌的产孢结构，复数）

e.en: The mushroom releases spores from its {basidia}.
e.zh: 这种蘑菇通过担子释放孢子。

e.en: Microscopy revealed clusters of {basidia}.
e.zh: 显微镜下可见成簇的担子。

e.en: The {basidial} layer was examined under the microscope.
e.zh: 在显微镜下观察了担子层。

e.en: He studied {basidial} development in fungi.
e.zh: 他研究真菌中担子的发育。

e.en: The mushroom is a typical {basidiomycete}.
e.zh: 这种蘑菇是典型的担子菌。

e.en: Many edible fungi are {basidiomycetes}.
e.zh: 许多食用真菌都属于担子菌。

basidiomycetous.t: 担子菌的；属于担子菌类的

e.en: They identified several {basidiomycetous} species in the forest.
e.zh: 他们在森林中鉴定出几种担子菌物种。

e.en: The disease is caused by a {basidiomycetous} fungus.
e.zh: 该病由一种担子菌引起。

basidiospore.t: 担孢子（担子菌产生的孢子）

e.en: Each {basidiospore} can grow into a new fungus.
e.zh: 每个担孢子都能长成新的真菌。

e.en: The wind disperses {basidiospores} over long distances.
e.zh: 风把担孢子吹散到很远的地方。

e.en: They studied the {basidiosporous} fungi of the region.
e.zh: 他们研究了该地区的产担孢子真菌。

e.en: This species is clearly {basidiosporous}.
e.zh: 这一物种明显属于产担孢子类。

basidium.t: 担子（担子菌的产孢细胞）

e.en: Each {basidium} produces four spores.
e.zh: 每个担子产生四个孢子。

e.en: The {basidium} is a key feature of these fungi.
e.zh: 担子是这类真菌的关键特征。

e.en: Soil {basification} can harm certain crops.
e.zh: 土壤碱化可能危害某些作物。

e.en: Researchers measured the rate of {basification}.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了碱化的速率。

e.en: The solution was {basified} with sodium hydroxide.
e.zh: 用氢氧化钠把溶液变成碱性。

e.en: Once {basified}, the mixture changed color.
e.zh: 一经碱化，混合物就变了色。

e.en: Adding ammonia {basifies} the water.
e.zh: 加入氨水会使水变碱。

e.en: This reagent gradually {basifies} the solution.
e.zh: 这种试剂会逐渐让溶液变碱。

basifixed.t: 基着的（花药基部连于花丝）

e.en: The flower has {basifixed} anthers.
e.zh: 这种花的花药是基着的。

e.en: Botanists noted the {basifixed} attachment.
e.zh: 植物学家记下了基着的着生方式。

basiflory.t: 基生开花（花长在茎基部的现象）

e.en: This tree shows clear {basiflory}.
e.zh: 这种树呈现出明显的基生开花现象。

e.en: Researchers studied {basiflory} in tropical species.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了热带物种的基生开花。

basifugal.t: 离基的；自基部向顶端发育的

e.en: The leaves develop in a {basifugal} sequence.
e.zh: 叶片以离基方式依次发育。

e.en: Growth here is distinctly {basifugal}.
e.zh: 这里的生长方式明显是离基式的。

e.en: Add a few drops of base to {basify} the solution.
e.zh: 加几滴碱液即可使溶液变碱。

e.en: The chemist needed to {basify} the mixture first.
e.zh: 化学家需要先把混合物变成碱性。

e.en: They are slowly {basifying} the reaction mixture.
e.zh: 他们正在缓慢地把反应混合物变成碱性。

e.en: {Basifying} the soil improved certain crops.
e.zh: 使土壤碱化改善了某些作物的生长。

e.en: The doctor noted a {basilary} fracture.
e.zh: 医生指出有一处颅底骨折。

e.en: He examined the {basilary} region carefully.
e.zh: 他仔细检查了基底部区域。

basilect.t: 基层方言；最底层的克里奥尔变体

e.en: Linguists recorded the local {basilect}.
e.zh: 语言学家记录了当地的基层方言。

e.en: The {basilect} differs sharply from the standard language.
e.zh: 基层方言与标准语差别很大。

basilic.t: 贵要的（指手臂内侧的贵要静脉）

e.en: The nurse located the {basilic} vein for the IV.
e.zh: 护士找到贵要静脉以便输液。

e.en: Blood was drawn from the {basilic} vein.
e.zh: 血液取自贵要静脉。

basilical.t: 大教堂的；长方形廊柱大厅式的

e.en: The church has a {basilical} layout.
e.zh: 这座教堂采用大教堂式的布局。

e.en: Scholars admired the {basilical} architecture.
e.zh: 学者们赞赏这种廊柱大厅式的建筑。

basilican.t: 大教堂式的；廊柱大厅式的

e.en: The cathedral follows a {basilican} plan.
e.zh: 这座大教堂采用大教堂式的平面布局。

e.en: Many old churches share a {basilican} design.
e.zh: 许多古老教堂都采用廊柱大厅式设计。

basilicon.t: 巴西利康软膏（一种古时油性药膏）

e.en: The wound was dressed with {basilicon} ointment.
e.zh: 伤口上敷了巴西利康软膏。

e.en: Old pharmacopoeias mention {basilicon} frequently.
e.zh: 旧药典中常提到巴西利康软膏。

e.en: The team mapped the {basinal} sediments.
e.zh: 团队绘制了盆地沉积物的地图。

e.en: Oil often accumulates in {basinal} structures.
e.zh: 石油常聚集于盆地构造中。

basinet.t: 轻型尖顶头盔（中世纪骑士所戴）

e.en: The knight polished his {basinet} before battle.
e.zh: 骑士在战斗前擦亮了他的尖顶头盔。

e.en: A {basinet} hung beside the suit of armor.
e.zh: 一顶尖顶头盔挂在那套盔甲旁边。

e.en: She poured a {basinful} of warm water.
e.zh: 她倒了满满一盆温水。

e.en: He brought a {basinful} of strawberries from the garden.
e.zh: 他从花园里端来满满一盆草莓。

basion.t: 颅底点（枕骨大孔前缘正中点）

e.en: The anatomist marked the {basion} on the skull.
e.zh: 解剖学家在头骨上标出颅底点。

e.en: Measurements were taken from the {basion}.
e.zh: 测量是从颅底点开始的。

basionym.t: 基本异名（生物命名学中的原名）

e.en: The botanist cited the original {basionym}.
e.zh: 植物学家引用了原始的基本异名。

e.en: Every new combination must reference its {basionym}.
e.zh: 每个新组合都必须注明其基本异名。

basipetal.t: 向基的；自顶端向基部发育的

e.en: The leaves mature in {basipetal} order.
e.zh: 叶片按向基顺序成熟。

e.en: Hormone movement here is {basipetal}.
e.zh: 此处激素的运输方向是向基的。

e.en: He drew a {basket-hilted} broadsword from its scabbard.
e.zh: 他从剑鞘中拔出一把带篮形护手的阔剑。

e.en: The museum displayed several {basket-hilted} swords from Scotland.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几把来自苏格兰的篮柄剑。

e.en: The village {basket-maker} sold his wares at the market.
e.zh: 村里的编篮工匠在集市上出售他的作品。

e.en: She trained as a {basket-maker} under her grandmother.
e.zh: 她跟着祖母学做编篮工匠。

e.en: The chair had a beautiful {basket-weave} seat.
e.zh: 那把椅子有漂亮的篮纹编织座面。

e.en: She chose a {basket-weave} pattern for the rug.
e.zh: 她为地毯选择了席纹编织的图案。

e.en: The shop specialized in handmade {basket-work}.
e.zh: 这家店专营手工编篮制品。

e.en: Traditional {basket-work} requires years of practice.
e.zh: 传统编篮工艺需要多年练习。

e.en: We watched a {basketball-game} on TV last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我们在电视上看了一场篮球比赛。

e.en: The {basketball-game} ended in overtime.
e.zh: 那场篮球比赛在加时赛中结束。

e.en: The young {basketeer} dreamed of going pro.
e.zh: 那个年轻的篮球手梦想着打职业。

e.en: He was the school's star {basketeer}.
e.zh: 他是学校的明星篮球队员。

e.en: The drug targets {basolateral} membrane proteins.
e.zh: 该药物作用于基底外侧膜蛋白。

e.en: Researchers studied the {basolateral} amygdala in mice.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了小鼠的基底外侧杏仁核。

e.en: The blood test showed an elevated {basophil} count.
e.zh: 血液检查显示嗜碱性粒细胞计数升高。

e.en: A {basophil} releases histamine during allergic reactions.
e.zh: 嗜碱性粒细胞在过敏反应中释放组胺。

e.en: The slide showed several {basophile} cells.
e.zh: 载玻片上显示有几个嗜碱性细胞。

e.en: Certain bacteria are classified as {basophile} organisms.
e.zh: 某些细菌被归类为嗜碱性生物。

e.en: The tumor cells appeared strongly {basophilic} under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下肿瘤细胞呈强嗜碱性。

e.en: These granules are {basophilic} when stained.
e.zh: 这些颗粒经染色后呈嗜碱性。

e.en: {Basophilous} plants thrive in alkaline soils.
e.zh: 喜碱性植物在碱性土壤中茁壮生长。

e.en: The region's flora is largely {basophilous}.
e.zh: 该地区的植物群大多喜碱性。

e.en: He pounded the {bass-drum} in the marching band.
e.zh: 他在行进乐队里敲着大鼓。

e.en: The {bass-drum} kept the beat steady.
e.zh: 大鼓稳稳地敲着节拍。

e.en: The temple walls were carved in {bass-relief}.
e.zh: 神庙的墙壁雕刻成浅浮雕。

e.en: She admired the {bass-relief} above the doorway.
e.zh: 她欣赏门楣上方的浅浮雕。

e.en: The baby slept soundly in her {bassinette}.
e.zh: 宝宝在摇篮里睡得很香。

e.en: They placed the {bassinette} beside the bed.
e.zh: 他们把婴儿摇篮放在床边。

e.en: The band's {bassman} laid down a solid groove.
e.zh: 乐队的贝斯手奏出了扎实的律动。

e.en: He's been the {bassman} for over twenty years.
e.zh: 他担任贝斯手已超过二十年。

e.en: The {baroceptor} detects sudden changes in blood pressure.
e.zh: 压力感受器能感知血压的突然变化。

e.en: Damaged {baroceptors} can lead to unstable blood pressure.
e.zh: 压力感受器受损会导致血压不稳定。

e.en: Strong {baroclinicity} often signals storm development.
e.zh: 强烈的斜压性往往预示着风暴的形成。

e.en: The model captures atmospheric {baroclinicity} surprisingly well.
e.zh: 该模型对大气斜压性的刻画相当出色。

barococo.t: 过分华丽繁缛的（巴洛克与洛可可混合风格）

e.en: Critics dismissed the hotel's {barococo} interior as kitsch.
e.zh: 评论家把这家酒店繁缛华丽的内饰斥为俗艳。

e.en: The room had a {barococo} feel with its excessive ornamentation.
e.zh: 这房间装饰过度，给人一种繁缛华丽之感。

e.en: Old sailors used a {barocyclonometer} to anticipate tropical storms.
e.zh: 老水手们用旋风风暴预测仪来预判热带风暴。

e.en: A dusty {barocyclonometer} still hung in the captain's cabin.
e.zh: 船长室里还挂着一台落满灰尘的旋风风暴预测仪。

e.en: Pilots sometimes complain of {barodontalgia} during rapid ascent.
e.zh: 飞行员在快速爬升时有时会抱怨气压性牙痛。

e.en: A poor filling can trigger {barodontalgia} in flight.
e.zh: 补牙不当可能在飞行中诱发气压性牙痛。

barodynamics.t: 重力动力学；重荷动力学

e.en: Engineers studied {barodynamics} to model heavy-load behaviour.
e.zh: 工程师们研究重荷动力学，以建模重载行为。

e.en: The textbook devotes a chapter to {barodynamics}.
e.zh: 这本教科书用整整一章讲解重荷动力学。

e.en: Doctors test {barognosis} by asking patients to compare two weights.
e.zh: 医生让病人比较两个物体的重量来检测重量觉。

e.en: Loss of {barognosis} may signal nerve damage.
e.zh: 重量觉丧失可能提示神经损伤。

e.en: The {barogram} showed a sharp pressure drop overnight.
e.zh: 气压记录图显示气压在夜间骤降。

e.en: She analysed the {barogram} to forecast the incoming storm.
e.zh: 她分析气压记录图以预报来袭的风暴。

barograph.t: 自记气压计；气压记录仪

e.en: An old brass {barograph} sat on the lighthouse keeper's desk.
e.zh: 灯塔守护人的桌上摆着一台老式黄铜气压记录仪。

e.en: The {barograph} traced a steady decline before the gale arrived.
e.zh: 狂风来临前，气压记录仪描出一条稳步下降的曲线。

barographic.t: 气压记录仪的；气压图的

e.en: We compared the {barographic} traces from two coastal stations.
e.zh: 我们比较了两个沿海站的气压图记录。

e.en: {Barographic} data confirmed the cyclone's path.
e.zh: 气压图数据证实了气旋的路径。

e.en: Several {barographs} were installed along the exposed coastline.
e.zh: 沿着暴露的海岸线安装了好几台自记气压计。

e.en: The museum displays a row of antique {barographs}.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着一排古董自记气压计。

e.en: The pilot relied on a {barogyroscope} for altitude reference.
e.zh: 飞行员依靠气压陀螺仪来获取高度参考。

e.en: Modern aircraft replaced the {barogyroscope} with electronic sensors.
e.zh: 现代飞机已用电子传感器取代了气压陀螺仪。

e.en: {Barology} examines how weight affects physical systems.
e.zh: 重力学研究重量对物理系统的影响。

e.en: Few universities still teach {barology} as a separate subject.
e.zh: 现在还把重力学单列为一门课程的大学已寥寥无几。

e.en: The {barometrical} reading suggested an approaching cold front.
e.zh: 气压计的读数显示有冷锋逼近。

e.en: They took {barometrical} measurements at the summit.
e.zh: 他们在山顶进行了气压测量。

barometrically.t: 用气压计地；按气压方式

e.en: Altitude can be estimated {barometrically} with reasonable accuracy.
e.zh: 用气压计估算海拔可以达到相当高的精度。

e.en: The depth gauge works {barometrically}.
e.zh: 这种深度计是按气压原理工作的。

e.en: The vessel carried a {barometrograph} for long voyages.
e.zh: 这艘船配有一台自记气压计以备远航之需。

e.en: His {barometrograph} recorded a slow but steady rise overnight.
e.zh: 他的自记气压计夜里记录到气压在缓慢但稳步上升。

e.en: {Barometry} is essential for accurate weather forecasting.
e.zh: 气压测定法对准确的天气预报至关重要。

e.en: Students learned the basics of {barometry} in the lab.
e.zh: 学生们在实验室里学习气压测定法的基础。

baromil.t: 巴罗米尔（气压单位，约合一毫米汞柱）

e.en: Pressure on the old chart was given in {baromil}.
e.zh: 旧图表上的压力以巴罗米尔为单位。

e.en: Engineers rarely use the {baromil} today.
e.zh: 现在的工程师已很少使用巴罗米尔这一单位。

e.en: The medieval {baronage} held considerable political power.
e.zh: 中世纪的男爵阶层握有相当大的政治权力。

e.en: He was raised to the {baronage} after years of loyal service.
e.zh: 他多年效忠之后获封男爵爵位。

baronduki.t: 美洲一种小型有袋哺乳动物

e.en: The naturalist sketched a {baronduki} in his field journal.
e.zh: 博物学家在野外日记里画下一只这种小型有袋动物。

e.en: A {baronduki} darted across the forest path at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时分，一只这种小型有袋动物从林间小径上窜过。

baronetage.t: 从男爵阶层；从男爵爵位

e.en: He inherited a place in the {baronetage} from his father.
e.zh: 他从父亲那里继承了从男爵的爵位。

e.en: The {baronetage} is older than people often realise.
e.zh: 从男爵这一阶层比人们通常想象的还要古老。

e.en: The king moved to {baronetise} several loyal allies.
e.zh: 国王决意将几位忠心的盟友封为从男爵。

e.en: Few men were {baronetised} in that turbulent year.
e.zh: 那个动荡的年份里被封为从男爵的人寥寥无几。

e.en: The crown decided to {baronetize} the new judge.
e.zh: 王室决定将这位新法官封为从男爵。

e.en: He hoped one day to be {baronetized} for his service.
e.zh: 他希望有朝一日能因功获封从男爵。

barong.t: 巴隆衫（菲律宾传统男装）；巴龙刀

e.en: He wore a finely embroidered {barong} to the Filipino wedding.
e.zh: 他穿着一件刺绣精美的巴隆衫出席菲律宾婚礼。

e.en: The warrior carried a curved {barong} at his hip.
e.zh: 那名武士腰间挂着一把弯曲的巴龙刀。

e.en: The article described a new {barophil} from the Mariana Trench.
e.zh: 这篇文章介绍了来自马里亚纳海沟的一种新嗜压生物。

e.en: Few scientists have studied this {barophil} in detail.
e.zh: 很少有科学家详细研究过这种嗜压生物。

e.en: Some deep-sea bacteria are true {barophiles}.
e.zh: 一些深海细菌是真正的嗜压生物。

e.en: Researchers cultured {barophiles} in pressurised chambers.
e.zh: 研究人员在加压舱中培养嗜压生物。

e.en: These {barophilic} microbes thrive only at extreme depths.
e.zh: 这些嗜压微生物只能在极深处茁壮生长。

e.en: The lab specialises in {barophilic} organisms.
e.zh: 该实验室专门研究嗜压生物。

e.en: Patients with {barophobia} fear being crushed by gravity.
e.zh: 重力恐惧症患者害怕被重力压垮。

e.en: {Barophobia} is rarely diagnosed in modern clinics.
e.zh: 重力恐惧症在现代诊所中很少被诊断出来。

e.en: {Barophoresis} can separate particles by their pressure response.
e.zh: 压力分离法能根据颗粒对压力的响应将其分开。

e.en: The team applied {barophoresis} to study the colloid.
e.zh: 团队运用压泳法研究这种胶体。

baroreceptor.t: 压力感受器；血压感受器

e.en: The {baroreceptors} in the carotid arteries help regulate blood pressure.
e.zh: 颈动脉里的压力感受器帮助调节血压。

e.en: A faulty {baroreceptor} response can cause dizziness on standing.
e.zh: 压力感受器反应异常可能导致起身时头晕。

baroreflex.t: 压力感受性反射；血压调节反射

e.en: The {baroreflex} kicks in when blood pressure drops suddenly.
e.zh: 血压突然下降时，压力感受性反射会即刻启动。

e.en: Researchers measured the patient's {baroreflex} sensitivity.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了病人压力感受性反射的灵敏度。

e.en: The antique {baroscope} once warned sailors of approaching storms.
e.zh: 这台古董验压器曾为水手警示来袭的风暴。

e.en: He demonstrated the {baroscope} to his curious students.
e.zh: 他向好奇的学生们演示这台验压器。

e.en: The {baroscopic} reading gave us a clue about the weather.
e.zh: 验压器的读数给了我们关于天气的线索。

e.en: She wrote a paper on {baroscopic} principles.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于验压原理的论文。

e.en: He used {baroscopical} methods at his amateur weather station.
e.zh: 他在自己的业余气象站采用验压方法。

e.en: {Baroscopical} observations were recorded daily for the project.
e.zh: 为这个项目，每日都记录验压观测结果。

e.en: Some seeds are {barosperse}, scattered by wind pressure alone.
e.zh: 有些种子借气压传播，仅靠风力压差就能散播。

e.en: Botanists classified the plant as {barosperse}.
e.zh: 植物学家将这种植物归为靠气压传播一类。

e.en: The {barosphere} is a theoretical layer of the atmosphere.
e.zh: 重圈是大气中一个理论上的分层。

e.en: Few textbooks still mention the {barosphere} today.
e.zh: 如今的教科书已很少提及重圈这一概念。

e.en: A {barostat} maintains constant pressure inside the chamber.
e.zh: 恒压器使舱内压力保持稳定。

e.en: The lab installed a new digital {barostat} last month.
e.zh: 上个月实验室安装了一台新的数字恒压器。

e.en: The weather balloon used a {baroswitch} to release its payload.
e.zh: 气象气球用气压开关来释放载荷。

e.en: A faulty {baroswitch} caused the device to fail mid-flight.
e.zh: 气压开关故障导致该装置在飞行途中失灵。

e.en: Some bacteria show clear {barotaxis} along pressure gradients.
e.zh: 一些细菌沿压力梯度表现出明显的趋压性。

e.en: The study explored {barotaxis} in marine plankton.
e.zh: 该研究探讨了海洋浮游生物的趋压性。

e.en: The {barothermograph} recorded both pressure and temperature continuously.
e.zh: 气压温度记录仪同时连续记录气压和温度。

e.en: Crews installed a {barothermograph} on the research vessel.
e.zh: 船员们在科考船上装上了一台气压温度记录仪。

e.en: My old college {batchmate} now runs a startup.
e.zh: 我大学的同届同学现在经营一家创业公司。

e.en: He invited every {batchmate} to the reunion.
e.zh: 他邀请了每位同期同学参加聚会。

e.en: Several wooden {bateaux} drifted along the river.
e.zh: 几条木制平底船沿河漂流。

e.en: The settlers loaded supplies onto the {bateaux}.
e.zh: 移民们把补给装上平底船。

e.en: A {bateleur} soared above the savanna.
e.zh: 一只短尾雕在大草原上空盘旋。

e.en: We spotted a {bateleur} hunting near the cliffs.
e.zh: 我们看见一只短尾雕在悬崖附近捕猎。

e.en: A red-lipped {batfish} crawled along the seabed.
e.zh: 一条红唇蝙蝠鱼在海底爬行。

e.en: Divers photographed a colorful {batfish} near the reef.
e.zh: 潜水员在礁石附近拍到一条色彩鲜艳的蝙蝠鱼。

e.en: Villagers used to {batfowl} on moonless nights.
e.zh: 村民们过去常在无月之夜用灯诱捕鸟类。

e.en: It is now illegal to {batfowl} in this region.
e.zh: 在该地区夜间用灯诱鸟现已违法。

batfowled.t: 夜间用灯诱捕鸟（过去式）

e.en: They {batfowled} along the hedgerow until dawn.
e.zh: 他们沿着树篱用灯诱捕鸟一直到天亮。

e.en: Boys {batfowled} sparrows in the old barn.
e.zh: 男孩们在旧谷仓里用灯诱捕麻雀。

e.en: The old {batfowler} carried a lantern and net.
e.zh: 那位老猎鸟人带着提灯和网具。

e.en: A skilled {batfowler} could fill a sack overnight.
e.zh: 熟练的诱鸟人一夜能装满一袋。

e.en: {Batfowling} was once a common rural pastime.
e.zh: 夜间诱鸟曾是常见的乡村消遣。

e.en: He wrote about {batfowling} in old England.
e.zh: 他写过旧时英格兰的诱鸟活动。

batfowls.t: 夜间用灯诱鸟（第三人称单数）

e.en: He still {batfowls} in the woods each autumn.
e.zh: 他每年秋天仍在林中用灯诱鸟。

e.en: Whenever he {batfowls}, he brings a bright lantern.
e.zh: 每次诱鸟，他都带着明亮的提灯。

e.en: The old {bath-house} still has marble basins.
e.zh: 那座老澡堂仍保留着大理石浴池。

e.en: We changed clothes in the wooden {bath-house}.
e.zh: 我们在木制浴室里换衣服。

e.en: She poured lavender {bath-salt} into the tub.
e.zh: 她把薰衣草沐浴盐倒进浴缸。

e.en: This {bath-salt} smells of eucalyptus and mint.
e.zh: 这款沐浴盐有桉树和薄荷的香味。

e.en: Please fold the clean {bath-towels} neatly.
e.zh: 请把干净的浴巾整齐叠好。

e.en: The hotel provides fresh {bath-towels} every day.
e.zh: 酒店每天提供干净的浴巾。

e.en: The river is no longer {bathable} after the spill.
e.zh: 泄漏事故后这条河已不再适合沐浴。

e.en: Only a few coves remain safely {bathable}.
e.zh: 只剩少数几处海湾仍可安全下水。

e.en: The doctor tested the patient's {bathesthesia} carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了病人的深部感觉。

e.en: Loss of {bathesthesia} can signal nerve damage.
e.zh: 深部感觉丧失可能提示神经损伤。

e.en: The speech ended {bathetically} with a weak joke.
e.zh: 演讲以一个无聊的笑话突降式收尾。

e.en: He {bathetically} compared his breakup to war.
e.zh: 他荒唐可笑地把分手比作战争。

e.en: She bathed the baby in a portable {bathinette}.
e.zh: 她在便携式婴儿浴盆里给宝宝洗澡。

e.en: The old {bathinette} folds away after use.
e.zh: 那个旧式婴儿浴盆用完可以折起。

e.en: The town's {bathing-beach} fills up every summer.
e.zh: 小镇的海水浴场每年夏天都人满为患。

e.en: Lifeguards patrol the public {bathing-beach} daily.
e.zh: 救生员每天在公共海水浴场巡逻。

e.en: After three {bathless} days, he longed for soap.
e.zh: 三天没洗澡后，他渴望来块肥皂。

e.en: The cabin was small and entirely {bathless}.
e.zh: 那间小屋很小，完全没有浴室。

e.en: Step onto the {bathmat} so you don't slip.
e.zh: 踩到浴室地垫上，免得滑倒。

e.en: The fluffy {bathmat} soaked up the water.
e.zh: 毛绒绒的浴室地垫吸干了水。

e.en: We bought matching {bathmats} for the new bathroom.
e.zh: 我们为新浴室买了配套的地垫。

e.en: The {bathmats} need washing this weekend.
e.zh: 这些浴室地垫这周末需要清洗。

e.en: The dye contains a {bathochrome} that shifts absorption.
e.zh: 该染料含有使吸收红移的基团。

e.en: Adding a {bathochrome} deepens the molecule's color.
e.zh: 加入红移基团会使分子颜色变深。

e.en: The mountains have a clear {batholithic} core.
e.zh: 这些山脉有明显的岩基核心。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {batholithic} granite formations.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了岩基花岗岩的分布。

e.en: The region's {batholitic} rocks date back millions of years.
e.zh: 该地区的岩基岩石可追溯至数百万年前。

e.en: Erosion exposed the {batholitic} mass beneath.
e.zh: 侵蚀作用使下方的岩基暴露出来。

e.en: The crew lowered a {bathometer} into the trench.
e.zh: 船员把测深仪放入海沟。

e.en: Their {bathometer} recorded an unexpected drop.
e.zh: 他们的测深仪记录到意外的下降。

e.en: Strange creatures live in the {bathyal} zone.
e.zh: 半深海带栖息着许多奇异的生物。

e.en: They studied {bathyal} sediments from the slope.
e.zh: 他们研究了来自陆坡的半深海沉积物。

e.en: Few species can survive in {bathybic} waters.
e.zh: 很少有物种能在深海水域存活。

e.en: Their submersible reached truly {bathybic} depths.
e.zh: 他们的潜水器抵达了真正的深海深度。

e.en: A {bathyclinograph} recorded the deep currents accurately.
e.zh: 深海流速仪准确记录了深层洋流。

e.en: The ship deployed its {bathyclinograph} overnight.
e.zh: 船只整夜投放着深海流速仪。

e.en: The {bathyconductograph} measures conductivity at varying depths.
e.zh: 该仪器测量不同深度的海水电导率。

e.en: Researchers calibrated the {bathyconductograph} before launch.
e.zh: 研究人员在投放前校准了电导深度仪。

e.en: The neurologist tested her {bathyesthesia} thoroughly.
e.zh: 神经科医生彻底检查了她的深部感觉。

e.en: Diabetes can impair {bathyesthesia} in the feet.
e.zh: 糖尿病可能损害足部的深部感觉。

e.en: {Bathygenesis} explains the slow sinking of certain basins.
e.zh: 地壳深陷作用解释了某些盆地的缓慢下沉。

e.en: Geologists debated the rate of {bathygenesis} there.
e.zh: 地质学家就当地深陷作用的速率展开争论。

e.en: The ship's {bathygram} showed a sudden trench.
e.zh: 船上的深度图显示出一道突然的海沟。

e.en: She analyzed every {bathygram} from the survey.
e.zh: 她分析了此次勘测的每张深度记录图。

e.en: A massive granite {bathylith} underlies the range.
e.zh: 山脉之下是巨大的花岗岩岩基。

e.en: Erosion has exposed parts of the {bathylith}.
e.zh: 侵蚀已使部分岩基暴露出来。

e.en: They used a {bathymeter} to chart the lake.
e.zh: 他们用测深仪绘制了湖泊地形。

e.en: Their {bathymeter} found a hidden underwater ridge.
e.zh: 测深仪发现了一道隐藏的水下山脊。

e.en: The {bathymetric} map revealed underwater canyons.
e.zh: 水深图揭示了水下峡谷。

e.en: Engineers consulted the {bathymetric} data carefully.
e.zh: 工程师仔细查阅了水深测量数据。

e.en: The seabed has been {bathymetrically} surveyed.
e.zh: 海底已经过水深测量勘察。

e.en: They mapped the area {bathymetrically} last summer.
e.zh: 他们去年夏天对该地区进行了水深测量制图。

e.en: The new speakers have a very {bassy} sound.
e.zh: 这对新音箱的低音非常浑厚。

e.en: His voice was deep and {bassy}.
e.zh: 他的嗓音低沉浑厚。

e.en: Critics say the remake will {bastardise} the original story.
e.zh: 评论家说翻拍版会糟蹋原作的故事。

e.en: He accused them of {bastardising} the language.
e.zh: 他指责他们糟蹋了这种语言。

e.en: The film is a {bastardised} version of the novel.
e.zh: 这部电影是该小说的劣化版本。

e.en: They sang a {bastardised} folk tune.
e.zh: 他们唱了一首被改得面目全非的民谣。

e.en: He called the betrayal an act of pure {bastardry}.
e.zh: 他称那次背叛纯属卑鄙行径。

e.en: The boss is known for his casual {bastardry}.
e.zh: 那位老板以随意刁难下属而出名。

bastinado.t: 棒打脚底之刑；用棒打脚底

e.en: The prisoner was sentenced to the {bastinado}.
e.zh: 那名囚犯被判处棒打脚底之刑。

e.en: Soldiers used to {bastinado} captives to extract confessions.
e.zh: 士兵们过去常棒打俘虏的脚底以逼供。

bastinadoed.t: 被棒打脚底；遭受脚底刑

e.en: The captives were {bastinadoed} until they confessed.
e.zh: 俘虏们被棒打脚底，直到招供。

e.en: He was {bastinadoed} for stealing bread.
e.zh: 他因偷面包而被棒打脚底。

e.en: Historical records describe brutal {bastinadoes} in the prison.
e.zh: 史料记载了狱中残酷的棒打脚底之刑。

e.en: The tyrant ordered repeated {bastinadoes} for dissenters.
e.zh: 暴君下令对异见者反复施以棒打脚底之刑。

e.en: The guards spent the morning {bastinadoing} the prisoners.
e.zh: 狱卒们整个上午都在棒打囚犯的脚底。

e.en: He recounted scenes of {bastinadoing} from the old empire.
e.zh: 他讲述了旧帝国时期棒打脚底的场景。

bat-blind.t: 瞎得像蝙蝠；几乎全盲的

e.en: Without his glasses he was {bat-blind}.
e.zh: 不戴眼镜他几乎是个瞎子。

e.en: The old miner had grown {bat-blind} in the dark tunnels.
e.zh: 那位老矿工在黑暗坑道里几乎瞎了。

bat-eyed.t: 视力极差的；近乎失明的

e.en: He squinted like a {bat-eyed} old scholar.
e.zh: 他像个视力极差的老学究般眯着眼。

e.en: The {bat-eyed} clerk struggled to read the form.
e.zh: 那位视力极差的职员艰难地辨认表格。

e.en: The officer's {bat-man} polished his boots every morning.
e.zh: 那名军官的勤务兵每天早上为他擦靴子。

e.en: He served as a {bat-man} during the war.
e.zh: 他在战争期间担任勤务兵。

e.en: She wore a dress with {bat-wing} sleeves.
e.zh: 她穿着一件蝠袖连衣裙。

e.en: The old plane had a strange {bat-wing} design.
e.zh: 那架旧飞机有着奇特的蝙蝠翼设计。

e.en: The {batallion} marched through the valley at dawn.
e.zh: 那个营在黎明时分穿越山谷。

e.en: He commanded a {batallion} of infantry.
e.zh: 他指挥着一个步兵营。

e.en: Grandma served warm {battercakes} with syrup.
e.zh: 奶奶端上了浇着糖浆的热煎饼。

e.en: He flipped the {battercake} in the skillet.
e.zh: 他在煎锅里把薄饼翻了个面。

e.en: The soldiers used a {battering-ram} to break the gate.
e.zh: 士兵们用攻城槌撞开了城门。

e.en: Police brought a {battering-ram} to force the door.
e.zh: 警察带来撞门槌强行破门。

battery-acid.t: 电池酸液；蓄电池电解液

e.en: Be careful—{battery-acid} can burn your skin.
e.zh: 小心——电池酸液会灼伤皮肤。

e.en: The leaking {battery-acid} corroded the metal tray.
e.zh: 泄漏的电池酸液腐蚀了金属托盘。

battery-operated.t: 用电池供电的；电池驱动的

e.en: She bought a {battery-operated} toy car for her son.
e.zh: 她给儿子买了一辆电池驱动的玩具车。

e.en: This {battery-operated} clock runs for a year.
e.zh: 这只电池供电的钟可以走一年。

e.en: That was the {battiest} plan I've ever heard.
e.zh: 那是我听过最离谱的计划。

e.en: He's the {battiest} professor in the department.
e.zh: 他是系里最古怪的教授。

e.en: She wore a colorful {battik} skirt to the festival.
e.zh: 她穿着一条色彩鲜艳的蜡染裙去参加节日。

e.en: The artist taught a class on traditional {battik}.
e.zh: 那位艺术家教授传统蜡染课程。

e.en: His charming {battiness} made him beloved.
e.zh: 他迷人的古怪劲儿让人喜爱。

e.en: There was a hint of {battiness} in her laugh.
e.zh: 她的笑声里带着一丝疯癫。

e.en: The warrior swung his heavy {battle-ax}.
e.zh: 那名战士挥动着沉重的战斧。

e.en: Their landlady was a real {battle-ax}.
e.zh: 他们的女房东是个十足的悍妇。

e.en: He raised his {battle-axe} above his head.
e.zh: 他把战斧高举过头。

e.en: The old {battle-axe} ran the office with iron rules.
e.zh: 那位悍妇用铁腕规矩管理办公室。

battle-axes.t: 战斧（复数）；凶悍的女人们

e.en: The museum displayed several medieval {battle-axes}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几把中世纪战斧。

e.en: Those old {battle-axes} dominate the committee.
e.zh: 那几个泼辣老太把持着委员会。

battle-clad.t: 全副武装的；披甲上阵的

e.en: The {battle-clad} knights rode toward the castle.
e.zh: 披甲的骑士们朝城堡奔去。

e.en: {Battle-clad} soldiers lined the city walls.
e.zh: 全副武装的士兵列在城墙上。

e.en: "Freedom!" became their {battle-cry}.
e.zh: “自由！”成了他们的战斗口号。

e.en: He let out a fierce {battle-cry}.
e.zh: 他发出一声猛烈的呐喊。

battle-fatigued.t: 因战斗而疲惫的；身心俱疲的

e.en: The {battle-fatigued} troops needed rest.
e.zh: 作战疲惫的部队需要休整。

e.en: He returned home {battle-fatigued} and silent.
e.zh: 他身心俱疲地回到家中，沉默不语。

e.en: The old {battle-fields} are now quiet farmland.
e.zh: 昔日的战场如今已是宁静的农田。

e.en: Tourists visit famous European {battle-fields}.
e.zh: 游客们参观欧洲著名的战场。

e.en: The valley became a bloody {battle-ground}.
e.zh: 那山谷成了血腥的战场。

e.en: Education funding is a political {battle-ground}.
e.zh: 教育经费成了政治角力的焦点。

e.en: Soldiers held the {battle-line} for hours.
e.zh: 士兵们坚守战线达数小时。

e.en: The debate drew a clear {battle-line}.
e.zh: 这场辩论划出了清晰的阵线。

e.en: The general revised his {battle-plan} overnight.
e.zh: 将军连夜修改了作战计划。

e.en: We need a clear {battle-plan} for the launch.
e.zh: 我们需要为产品发布制定清晰的行动方案。

battle-ready.t: 战备就绪的；随时可投入战斗的

e.en: The fleet is fully {battle-ready}.
e.zh: 舰队已完全战备就绪。

e.en: Our team is {battle-ready} for tomorrow's match.
e.zh: 我们队为明天的比赛做好了万全准备。

battle-scarred.t: 伤痕累累的；饱经风霜的

e.en: The {battle-scarred} veteran told his story.
e.zh: 那位伤痕累累的老兵讲述了自己的故事。

e.en: She drove a {battle-scarred} old pickup truck.
e.zh: 她开着一辆饱经风霜的旧皮卡。

e.en: He swung the {battleax} with both hands.
e.zh: 他双手挥舞那把战斧。

e.en: The headmistress was a fearsome {battleax}.
e.zh: 那位女校长是个令人生畏的悍妇。

e.en: The {battlecruiser} led the fleet into harbor.
e.zh: 那艘战列巡洋舰率领舰队进港。

e.en: Engineers designed a faster {battlecruiser}.
e.zh: 工程师们设计了一艘更快的战列巡洋舰。

e.en: Children played {battledoor} on the lawn.
e.zh: 孩子们在草坪上打板羽球。

e.en: He bought an antique {battledoor} at auction.
e.zh: 他在拍卖会上买了一只古董羽毛球拍。

e.en: They played {battledore} and shuttlecock.
e.zh: 他们玩起了板羽球和毽球。

e.en: The old {battledore} hung above the fireplace.
e.zh: 那只旧板羽球拍挂在壁炉上方。

e.en: The shop sold wooden {battledores}.
e.zh: 那家店出售木制板羽球拍。

e.en: Pairs of {battledores} were lined up neatly.
e.zh: 一对对板羽球拍整齐地摆放着。

e.en: The generals drafted a new {battleplan}.
e.zh: 将军们起草了新的作战计划。

e.en: Our marketing {battleplan} targets younger users.
e.zh: 我们的营销作战方案针对年轻用户。

e.en: The {battleplane} roared overhead.
e.zh: 那架战斗机从头顶轰鸣而过。

e.en: Old {battleplanes} sat in the museum hangar.
e.zh: 老式战机停在博物馆的机库里。

e.en: The walls were painted {battleship-gray}.
e.zh: 墙壁被刷成了军舰灰。

e.en: He drove a {battleship-gray} sedan.
e.zh: 他开着一辆铁灰色的轿车。

e.en: The crew defended the {battlestar} from attack.
e.zh: 舰员们抵御了对太空战舰的袭击。

e.en: A massive {battlestar} appeared on the screen.
e.zh: 屏幕上出现了一艘巨大的太空战舰。

e.en: The old {battlewagon} dominated the seas.
e.zh: 那艘老式战列舰称霸大海。

e.en: He calls his huge SUV a {battlewagon}.
e.zh: 他把自己那辆巨大的SUV称作“战车”。

e.en: Two {battlewagons} steamed into the bay.
e.zh: 两艘战列舰驶入了海湾。

e.en: The fleet's {battlewagons} were retired.
e.zh: 舰队的战列舰已经退役。

e.en: The nobles organized a grand {battue} in the woods.
e.zh: 贵族们在林中组织了一场盛大的围猎。

e.en: Critics likened the slaughter to a {battue}.
e.zh: 评论家把这场屠杀比作一次围猎。

e.en: She wore a sweater with {batwing} sleeves.
e.zh: 她穿着一件蝠袖毛衣。

e.en: The cape had a dramatic {batwing} cut.
e.zh: 那件斗篷有夸张的蝙蝠翼剪裁。

e.en: The costume featured large black {batwings}.
e.zh: 那套戏服配有巨大的黑色蝙蝠翅膀。

e.en: Her dress flared into elegant {batwings}.
e.zh: 她的连衣裙张开成优雅的蝠形袖。

bas-relief.t: 浅浮雕雕刻；低浮雕作品

e.en: The temple wall featured an exquisite {bas-relief} of dancers.
e.zh: 庙宇墙上有一幅精美的舞者浅浮雕。

e.en: She studied medieval {bas-relief} carvings in Italy.
e.zh: 她在意大利研究中世纪的浅浮雕雕刻。

bas-reliefs.t: 浅浮雕作品；低浮雕雕刻群

e.en: The cathedral walls displayed centuries-old {bas-reliefs}.
e.zh: 大教堂墙上展示着数百年前的浅浮雕。

e.en: Tourists admired the temple's intricate stone {bas-reliefs}.
e.zh: 游客欣赏着寺庙精美的石质浅浮雕。

basa.t: 巴沙鱼；越南鲶鱼养殖品种

e.en: I bought some frozen {basa} fillets at the supermarket.
e.zh: 我在超市买了些冷冻巴沙鱼柳。

e.en: {Basa} is a popular farmed fish from Vietnam.
e.zh: 巴沙鱼是产自越南的常见养殖鱼。

basal-cell.t: 基底细胞；皮肤基底层细胞

e.en: The doctor diagnosed a {basal-cell} carcinoma on his nose.
e.zh: 医生诊断他鼻子上长了基底细胞癌。

e.en: {Basal-cell} skin cancer is the most common type.
e.zh: 基底细胞皮肤癌是最常见的类型。

basaltiform.t: 玄武岩状的；柱状玄武岩结构

e.en: The cliffs displayed striking {basaltiform} columns.
e.zh: 悬崖上呈现出引人注目的玄武岩柱状结构。

e.en: Geologists noted the rock's {basaltiform} structure.
e.zh: 地质学家注意到岩石的玄武岩状结构。

basaltoid.t: 似玄武岩的；玄武岩状岩石

e.en: The sample had a {basaltoid} appearance under the microscope.
e.zh: 样品在显微镜下呈现似玄武岩的外观。

e.en: They classified the dark rock as {basaltoid}.
e.zh: 他们将这种深色岩石归类为似玄武岩。

basan.t: 鞣制羊皮；染色绵羊皮革

e.en: The old book was bound in {basan} leather.
e.zh: 这本旧书是用鞣制羊皮装订的。

e.en: Cobblers once used {basan} for cheap shoe linings.
e.zh: 鞋匠以前用鞣制羊皮做廉价鞋衬。

basanite.t: 碧玄岩；含似长石玄武岩

e.en: The volcano produced flows of dark {basanite}.
e.zh: 火山喷发出深色的碧玄岩岩流。

e.en: {Basanite} is rich in feldspathoid minerals.
e.zh: 碧玄岩富含似长石类矿物。

e.en: The surgeon performed a careful {basculation} of the implant.
e.zh: 外科医生小心地完成了植入物的翻转。

e.en: {Basculation} of the bridge let the boat through.
e.zh: 桥的翘转让船顺利通过。

e.en: Tower Bridge is a famous {bascule} bridge in London.
e.zh: 塔桥是伦敦著名的开启式活动桥。

e.en: The {bascule} lifted to let the ship pass.
e.zh: 活动桥升起让船通过。

e.en: The harbor had two old {bascules} for tall ships.
e.zh: 港口有两座供高桅船通过的老式开启桥。

e.en: Engineers inspected the {bascules} for wear.
e.zh: 工程师检查了开启桥的磨损情况。

e.en: Calculate the {base-area} of the cylinder first.
e.zh: 先计算圆柱的底面积。

e.en: The military expanded the {base-area} significantly.
e.zh: 军方大幅扩展了基地占地面积。

e.en: She painted the {base-board} a soft white.
e.zh: 她把踢脚板漆成柔和的白色。

e.en: Dust collected along the wooden {base-board}.
e.zh: 灰尘积在木质踢脚板边缘。

base-case.t: 基准情形；递归基础情形

e.en: Every recursion needs a {base-case} to terminate.
e.zh: 每个递归都需要一个递归基础来终止。

e.en: The {base-case} forecast assumes steady economic growth.
e.zh: 基准情形预测假设经济稳定增长。

base-jumping.t: 定点跳伞；高空定点跳伞运动

e.en: He died while {base-jumping} off a Norwegian cliff.
e.zh: 他从挪威悬崖上定点跳伞时丧生。

e.en: {Base-jumping} is illegal in many national parks.
e.zh: 在许多国家公园里定点跳伞是违法的。

base-level.t: 侵蚀基准面；基本水平线

e.en: The river eroded down to its {base-level}.
e.zh: 河流侵蚀至其基准面。

e.en: Sea level acts as the ultimate {base-level}.
e.zh: 海平面是最终的侵蚀基准面。

base-load.t: 基本负荷；电网基础负载

e.en: Nuclear plants typically supply {base-load} electricity.
e.zh: 核电站通常供应基本负荷电力。

e.en: Coal still provides much of the {base-load}.
e.zh: 煤炭仍提供大部分电网基础负载。

e.en: Cartographers started with a topographic {base-map}.
e.zh: 制图员从地形底图开始绘制。

e.en: Update the {base-map} before adding new layers.
e.zh: 添加新图层前先更新底图。

e.en: The {base-model} car lacks leather seats.
e.zh: 基础款汽车没有真皮座椅。

e.en: We chose the {base-model} to save money.
e.zh: 我们选了最低配置型号以省钱。

base-pair.t: 碱基对；脱氧核糖核酸配对

e.en: DNA mutations can change a single {base-pair}.
e.zh: DNA突变可能改变一个碱基对。

e.en: The genome contains billions of {base-pair} sequences.
e.zh: 基因组包含数十亿个碱基对序列。

e.en: The bank raised its {base-rate} again.
e.zh: 银行再次上调了基础利率。

e.en: Doctors often ignore the disease's {base-rate}.
e.zh: 医生常常忽视疾病的基础概率。

base-rates.t: 多种基础利率；各类基本概率

e.en: Different countries have very different {base-rates}.
e.zh: 不同国家的基础利率差异很大。

e.en: Statisticians compared {base-rates} across populations.
e.zh: 统计学家比较了不同人群的基础概率。

base-stock.t: 基础库存；常备高汤底料

e.en: Maintain a {base-stock} of essential parts.
e.zh: 保持基本零件的基础库存。

e.en: Chefs prepare a rich {base-stock} each morning.
e.zh: 厨师每天早上准备浓郁的高汤底料。

e.en: Inflation is measured against a {base-year}.
e.zh: 通胀以基准年为参照来衡量。

e.en: Economists chose 2010 as the {base-year}.
e.zh: 经济学家选定2010年为基年。

e.en: He plays for his school's {baseball-team}.
e.zh: 他在学校棒球队打球。

e.en: Our local {baseball-team} won the championship.
e.zh: 我们当地的棒球队赢得了冠军。

baseballers.t: 棒球运动员；棒球选手们

e.en: Young {baseballers} train hard every weekend.
e.zh: 年轻棒球运动员每个周末刻苦训练。

e.en: The famous {baseballers} signed autographs for fans.
e.zh: 著名棒球运动员为粉丝签名。

e.en: The chip handles {baseband} signal processing.
e.zh: 该芯片处理基带信号。

e.en: Engineers tested the phone's {baseband} firmware.
e.zh: 工程师测试了手机的基带固件。

e.en: The {baseborn} knight earned glory through battle.
e.zh: 这位出身低微的骑士通过战斗赢得荣誉。

e.en: She was scorned as a {baseborn} child.
e.zh: 她因是私生子而遭人鄙视。

baseburner.t: 底燃式火炉；底烧自给炉

e.en: Grandfather's old {baseburner} warmed the entire parlor.
e.zh: 祖父的旧底燃炉温暖了整个客厅。

e.en: Antique {baseburner} stoves are now collectors' items.
e.zh: 古董底烧式火炉如今成了收藏品。

e.en: Apply a {basecoat} before the colored topcoat.
e.zh: 在彩色面漆前先涂底漆。

e.en: The {basecoat} dries in two hours.
e.zh: 底漆两小时干透。

e.en: Servants worked in the castle's {basecourt}.
e.zh: 仆人们在城堡的外院工作。

e.en: Horses were stabled near the {basecourt}.
e.zh: 马匹养在外院附近的马厩里。

baseload.t: 基本负荷电力；基础负载

e.en: Nuclear reactors provide steady {baseload} power.
e.zh: 核反应堆提供稳定的基本负荷电力。

e.en: Renewables struggle to meet {baseload} demand.
e.zh: 可再生能源难以满足基础负载需求。

basemen.t: 棒球内场手；垒位防守员

e.en: Both {basemen} caught the line drive.
e.zh: 两位内场手都接到了平飞球。

e.en: The team's {basemen} practice double plays daily.
e.zh: 球队的内场手每天练习双杀。

e.en: A {basenji} rarely barks but yodels instead.
e.zh: 巴辛吉犬很少吠叫，而是发出尖叫声。

e.en: She adopted a tan-and-white {basenji} puppy.
e.zh: 她领养了一只黄白色的巴辛吉犬幼犬。

basenjis.t: 巴辛吉犬；多只非洲不吠犬

e.en: Two {basenjis} chased squirrels in the yard.
e.zh: 两只巴辛吉犬在院子里追松鼠。

e.en: {Basenjis} originally come from Central Africa.
e.zh: 巴辛吉犬原产于非洲中部。

e.en: Define the {baseplane} before drawing the model.
e.zh: 绘制模型前先定义基面。

e.en: All measurements reference the original {baseplane}.
e.zh: 所有测量都以原始基准面为参照。

basest.t: 最卑劣的；最低劣最下贱

e.en: He acted from the {basest} of motives.
e.zh: 他出于最卑劣的动机行事。

e.en: Treason was considered the {basest} crime.
e.zh: 叛国曾被视为最低劣的罪行。

e.en: The drunkards sang {bawdily} all night.
e.zh: 醉汉们整晚下流地唱着歌。

e.en: She laughed {bawdily} at his crude joke.
e.zh: 她对他粗俗的笑话猥亵地大笑。

e.en: Critics objected to the play's {bawdiness}.
e.zh: 评论家反对该剧的下流内容。

e.en: The novel's {bawdiness} shocked Victorian readers.
e.zh: 这部小说的淫秽内容震惊了维多利亚时代的读者。

e.en: The tavern was full of {bawdry} and laughter.
e.zh: 酒馆里充满了淫言秽语和笑声。

e.en: His poems mix wit with cheerful {bawdry}.
e.zh: 他的诗歌将机智与欢快的猥亵融合在一起。

e.en: The sailors visited a notorious {bawdyhouse}.
e.zh: 水手们光顾了一家臭名昭著的妓院。

e.en: Police raided the {bawdyhouse} that night.
e.zh: 警察那晚突袭了那家妓院。

e.en: Sunlight poured through the {bay-window} all morning.
e.zh: 整个上午阳光从凸窗洒进来。

e.en: She read in the cozy {bay-window} seat.
e.zh: 她坐在舒适的飘窗座位上阅读。

e.en: The {bayadere} performed at the temple festival.
e.zh: 那位印度舞女在寺庙节日上表演。

e.en: She wore a colorful {bayadere} skirt.
e.zh: 她穿着一条彩色横条纹的裙子。

bayesianism.t: 贝叶斯主义；贝叶斯学派

e.en: {Bayesianism} treats probability as degrees of belief.
e.zh: 贝叶斯主义将概率视为信念的程度。

e.en: Many statisticians have embraced {Bayesianism} in recent decades.
e.zh: 近几十年许多统计学家接受了贝叶斯主义。

e.en: A tall {baytree} grew beside the cottage.
e.zh: 小屋旁长着一棵高大的月桂树。

e.en: She picked leaves from the {baytree} for cooking.
e.zh: 她从月桂树上摘叶子用来烹饪。

e.en: The victor was crowned with a {baywreath}.
e.zh: 胜利者被戴上了月桂花环。

e.en: Ancient poets wore the {baywreath} as honor.
e.zh: 古代诗人佩戴桂冠作为荣誉。

e.en: Modern {bathymetry} maps the ocean floor with sonar.
e.zh: 现代水深测量学利用声呐绘制海底地形。

e.en: The survey provided detailed {bathymetry} of the lake.
e.zh: 这次勘测提供了该湖泊详细的水深数据。

e.en: The atlas includes {bathyorographical} charts of the region.
e.zh: 该地图集收录该地区的海陆地形图。

e.en: {Bathyorographical} data combine ocean depths and mountain heights.
e.zh: 海陆地形数据将海洋深度与山脉高度结合。

e.en: Strange creatures inhabit the {bathypelagic} zone.
e.zh: 奇异的生物栖息于半深海带。

e.en: The fish was caught at {bathypelagic} depths.
e.zh: 这条鱼是在半深海深度捕获的。

bathyscape.t: 深海潜水器；深海探测艇

e.en: The {bathyscape} descended into the trench.
e.zh: 深海潜水器下潜进入海沟。

e.en: Engineers tested the new {bathyscape} prototype.
e.zh: 工程师测试了新型深海潜水器原型。

bathyscaph.t: 深海潜水器；深海探测艇

e.en: The {bathyscaph} reached the ocean floor.
e.zh: 深海潜水器抵达海底。

e.en: He designed a manned {bathyscaph}.
e.zh: 他设计了一艘载人深海潜水器。

bathyscaphe.t: 深海潜水器；深海探测艇

e.en: The {bathyscaphe} Trieste dove into the Mariana Trench.
e.zh: 的里雅斯特号深海潜水器下潜至马里亚纳海沟。

e.en: Scientists observed deep-sea life from a {bathyscaphe}.
e.zh: 科学家从深海潜水器中观察深海生物。

e.en: Sensors detected a faint {bathyseism} offshore.
e.zh: 传感器在近海探测到一次微弱的深海地震。

e.en: Researchers study {bathyseism} along the trench.
e.zh: 研究人员沿海沟研究深海地震活动。

bathysphere.t: 深海球形潜水器；探海球

e.en: Beebe descended in a {bathysphere}.
e.zh: 毕比乘坐探海球下潜。

e.en: The {bathysphere} was lowered by cable.
e.zh: 探海球由钢缆放下。

bathythermograhp.t: 深海温度记录仪；测温仪

e.en: The {bathythermograhp} recorded ocean temperatures.
e.zh: 深海温度记录仪记录了海洋温度。

e.en: Crews dropped the {bathythermograhp} from the ship.
e.zh: 船员从船上投下深海温度记录仪。

e.en: The {bathythermogram} showed a clear thermocline.
e.zh: 海水温度记录图显示出明显的温跃层。

e.en: Analysts compared each {bathythermogram} from the cruise.
e.zh: 分析人员比较了航次中每一份温度记录图。

bathythermograph.t: 深海温度记录仪；温深仪

e.en: The ship deployed a {bathythermograph} at each station.
e.zh: 船在每个观测站投放一台深海温度记录仪。

e.en: An expendable {bathythermograph} sank as it transmitted data.
e.zh: 一次性深海温度记录仪在传送数据时下沉。

bathythermometer.t: 深海温度计；测深温度计

e.en: He read the depth from the {bathythermometer}.
e.zh: 他从深海温度计上读取深度。

e.en: A modern {bathythermometer} replaced the older instrument.
e.zh: 现代深海温度计取代了旧仪器。

e.en: The {bathyvessel} carried two scientists down.
e.zh: 该深海潜艇搭载两位科学家下潜。

e.en: Engineers serviced the {bathyvessel} between dives.
e.zh: 工程师在两次下潜之间检修深海潜艇。

e.en: Her dress was made of soft {batiste}.
e.zh: 她的连衣裙是用柔软的细薄棉布做的。

e.en: The shirt collar was edged with white {batiste}.
e.zh: 衬衫领子镶着白色细亚麻布。

e.en: The {batleship} fired a warning shot.
e.zh: 战列舰打出一发警告炮。

e.en: Children played {batleship} on graph paper.
e.zh: 孩子们在方格纸上玩战舰游戏。

batologist.t: 悬钩子属研究者；荆棘学家

e.en: The {batologist} catalogued every bramble species.
e.zh: 这位荆棘学家记录了每一种悬钩子属植物。

e.en: Few {batologists} study these obscure shrubs.
e.zh: 很少有荆棘学家研究这些冷僻灌木。

e.en: The {batonist} led the marching band.
e.zh: 指挥棒手领着行进乐队。

e.en: A skilled {batonist} can twirl two rods at once.
e.zh: 熟练的指挥棒手能同时旋转两根棒。

batonistic.t: 指挥棒手风格的；持棒的

e.en: His conducting had a {batonistic} flair.
e.zh: 他的指挥带有指挥棒手般的风采。

e.en: She admired the drum major's {batonistic} skill.
e.zh: 她钦佩鼓队队长的持棒技艺。

e.en: The constable carried a wooden {batoon}.
e.zh: 警员带着一根木棍。

e.en: He raised his {batoon} to lead the dance.
e.zh: 他举起指挥棒带领舞蹈。

e.en: Her {batophobia} kept her off tall buildings.
e.zh: 她的恐高症使她不敢上高楼。

e.en: {Batophobia} can be triggered by looking up at skyscrapers.
e.zh: 仰望摩天大楼可能诱发恐高症。

e.en: The sergeant drew an extra {batpay} allowance.
e.zh: 中士领取了额外的勤务兵津贴。

e.en: Officers refused the {batpay} reduction.
e.zh: 军官们拒绝削减勤务兵津贴。

e.en: The pond was full of {batrachian} life.
e.zh: 池塘里满是蛙类生物。

e.en: Scientists classified the new species as {batrachian}.
e.zh: 科学家将新物种归为蛙类。

e.en: The fish has a {batrachoid} appearance.
e.zh: 这种鱼呈蛙形外观。

e.en: {Batrachoid} fishes hide on sandy seabeds.
e.zh: 蟾鱼科鱼类藏身于沙质海床。

batrachoplasty.t: 蛙肿成形术；舌下囊肿手术

e.en: The surgeon performed {batrachoplasty} to remove the cyst.
e.zh: 外科医生施行蛙肿成形术以切除囊肿。

e.en: {Batrachoplasty} is rarely needed in modern practice.
e.zh: 现代医疗实践中很少需要蛙肿成形术。

e.en: {Batrachotoxin} is one of nature's deadliest poisons.
e.zh: 箭毒蛙毒素是自然界最致命的毒素之一。

e.en: The frogs secrete {batrachotoxin} through their skin.
e.zh: 这些青蛙通过皮肤分泌箭毒蛙毒素。

batrachotoxins.t: 蟾毒素（复数）；箭毒蛙毒素

e.en: Researchers extracted several {batrachotoxins} from the frogs.
e.zh: 研究人员从这些青蛙中提取了几种箭毒蛙毒素。

e.en: {Batrachotoxins} block sodium channels in nerves.
e.zh: 箭毒蛙毒素能阻断神经细胞的钠离子通道。

batta.t: 印度特别津贴；额外补助

e.en: Soldiers received a small {batta} for the campaign.
e.zh: 士兵们因这场战役获得了少量津贴。

e.en: Officers complained about the cut to their {batta}.
e.zh: 军官们对津贴削减表示不满。

e.en: The knight donned his {battailous} armor.
e.zh: 骑士穿上了他的战甲。

e.en: A {battailous} mood swept the kingdom.
e.zh: 一种好战情绪席卷整个王国。

battalia.t: 战阵；军队序列；战斗队形

e.en: The army drew up in {battalia}.
e.zh: 军队列成战阵。

e.en: He surveyed the {battalia} before the charge.
e.zh: 冲锋前他检视了战阵。

e.en: His {battarism} grew worse under pressure.
e.zh: 他的口吃在压力下愈发严重。

e.en: Therapists treated her {battarism} with breathing exercises.
e.zh: 治疗师用呼吸训练改善她的口吃。

e.en: Trappers paddled the {batteau} down the river.
e.zh: 捕兽者划着平底船顺流而下。

e.en: A long {batteau} carried supplies upstream.
e.zh: 一艘长形平底船向上游运送物资。

battel.t: 牛津伙食账目；伙食账款

e.en: Students paid their {battel} at term's end.
e.zh: 学生在学期末缴纳伙食账款。

e.en: His {battel} bill was unusually high that month.
e.zh: 他那个月的伙食账单异常高。

batteler.t: 牛津半费学生；自费寄宿生

e.en: He entered Oxford as a {batteler}.
e.zh: 他作为半费学生入读牛津。

e.en: A poor {batteler} paid reduced college fees.
e.zh: 贫困的半费生只需缴纳减免后的学院费用。

e.en: The tutorial used foo, bar, and {baz} as variable names.
e.zh: 教程用 foo、bar 和 {baz} 作为变量名。

e.en: Replace {baz} with your actual function name.
e.zh: 把 {baz} 换成你实际的函数名。

e.en: There are a {bazillion} apps that do this.
e.zh: 做这件事的应用多得数不清。

e.en: I've told you a {bazillion} times to lock the door.
e.zh: 我跟你说过无数次要锁门。

e.en: {Bazillions} of stars filled the night sky.
e.zh: 夜空中布满了无数颗星星。

e.en: He claims to have {bazillions} of followers online.
e.zh: 他声称在网上有数不清的粉丝。

e.en: Shut your big {bazoo} for once.
e.zh: 你就闭上你那张大嘴一次吧。

e.en: He blew into the {bazoo} and made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 他对着卡祖笛一吹，把大家都逗笑了。

be-all.t: 全部所在；最重要的事物

e.en: Money isn't the {be-all} and end-all of life.
e.zh: 金钱并不是人生的全部。

e.en: For him, football is the {be-all} of his weekends.
e.zh: 对他来说，足球就是周末的全部。

e.en: He fell in love with {be-bop} in the 1950s.
e.zh: 他在五十年代爱上了比波普爵士乐。

e.en: The club mostly plays classic {be-bop} records.
e.zh: 那家俱乐部主要播放经典的比波普唱片。

be-in.t: 集体聚会（尤指六十年代嬉皮士集会）

e.en: They organized a {be-in} in the park last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天他们在公园里组织了一次嬉皮士聚会。

e.en: The famous {be-in} of 1967 drew thousands of hippies.
e.zh: 1967 年那场著名的集体聚会吸引了数千名嬉皮士。

be-ribboned.t: 系着丝带的；佩戴绶带的

e.en: The {be-ribboned} general greeted the visiting dignitaries.
e.zh: 那位佩戴绶带的将军接待了来访的要人。

e.en: She wore a {be-ribboned} straw hat to the garden party.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶系着丝带的草帽参加花园派对。

e.en: The kids tossed a colorful {beach-ball} in the waves.
e.zh: 孩子们在海浪里抛着一只彩色沙滩球。

e.en: She inflated the {beach-ball} before heading to the shore.
e.zh: 她在去海边之前把沙滩球充好气。

e.en: The {beach-bound} traffic crawled along the coastal road.
e.zh: 前往海滩的车流在沿海公路上缓慢挪动。

e.en: Pack sunscreen before joining the {beach-bound} crowd.
e.zh: 加入前往海滩的人群前别忘了带防晒霜。

beach-comber.t: 在海滩上拾物的人；流浪汉

e.en: The old {beach-comber} collected shells every morning.
e.zh: 那位老人每天早晨在海滩上拾贝壳。

e.en: He lived like a {beach-comber} after quitting his job.
e.zh: 辞职之后他像个海滩流浪者一样生活。

e.en: They booked a {beach-front} hotel for the weekend.
e.zh: 他们订了一家海滨酒店度周末。

e.en: Property along the {beach-front} has become very expensive.
e.zh: 海滨一带的房产已变得非常昂贵。

e.en: The marines secured a {beach-head} at dawn.
e.zh: 陆战队在拂晓时建立了滩头阵地。

e.en: The startup established a {beach-head} in the European market.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在欧洲市场建立了立足点。

e.en: They rented a {beach-house} for the summer.
e.zh: 他们租了一栋海滨别墅过暑假。

e.en: The {beach-house} has a view of the entire bay.
e.zh: 这栋海滨别墅可以俯瞰整个海湾。

e.en: The town funded a {beach-nourishment} project to fight erosion.
e.zh: 该镇出资开展海滩补沙工程以抵御侵蚀。

e.en: Engineers debated the long-term effects of {beach-nourishment}.
e.zh: 工程师们争论沙滩养护的长期效果。

e.en: They threw a huge {beach-party} for her birthday.
e.zh: 他们为她的生日办了一场盛大的海滩派对。

e.en: Bring a guitar to the {beach-party} tonight.
e.zh: 今晚的海滩派对带上吉他来吧。

e.en: Volunteers trained for {beach-rescue} every weekend.
e.zh: 志愿者们每个周末都在进行海滩救援训练。

e.en: The {beach-rescue} team pulled three swimmers from the surf.
e.zh: 海滩救援队从浪中救起了三名游泳者。

e.en: We had dinner at a small {beach-side} restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在一家海滨小餐馆吃了晚饭。

e.en: The {beach-side} cabins fill up quickly in July.
e.zh: 七月份海滩边的小木屋很快就被订满。

e.en: The kids tossed a {beachball} in the waves.
e.zh: 孩子们在浪里抛着沙滩球。

e.en: She bought a striped {beachball} for the trip.
e.zh: 她为这趟旅行买了个条纹沙滩球。

e.en: They like to {beachcomb} after a storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后他们喜欢去海滩拾物。

e.en: We {beachcomb} every morning for shells.
e.zh: 我们每天清晨在海滩捡贝壳。

e.en: The {beachmaster} directed the landing craft.
e.zh: 滩头指挥官指挥着登陆艇。

e.en: A veteran {beachmaster} coordinated the troops.
e.zh: 一位经验丰富的滩头指挥官协调部队。

e.en: They booked a {beachside} cottage for July.
e.zh: 他们订了一间七月份的海滩小屋。

e.en: We dined at a {beachside} café.
e.zh: 我们在一家海边咖啡馆用餐。

e.en: The shop sells colorful {beachwear} all summer.
e.zh: 这家店整个夏天都卖各色沙滩装。

e.en: Pack light {beachwear} for the trip.
e.zh: 出行时带些轻便的沙滩装。

e.en: The ship drifted on a {beaconless} coast.
e.zh: 船只在没有灯标的海岸上漂流。

e.en: They wandered through {beaconless} darkness.
e.zh: 他们在无指引的黑暗中徘徊。

e.en: Local {beaders} sold handmade necklaces.
e.zh: 当地的串珠艺人售卖手工项链。

e.en: The {beaders} met weekly to share patterns.
e.zh: 串珠爱好者每周聚会交流图案。

beadier.t: 更像珠子的；眼神更锐利的（beady的比较级）

e.en: His eyes grew {beadier} with suspicion.
e.zh: 他的眼睛因怀疑而变得更加锐利。

e.en: The bird's gaze seemed {beadier} up close.
e.zh: 近看那只鸟的目光显得更像珠子般闪亮。

beadiest.t: 最像珠子的；眼神最锐利的

e.en: He gave her his {beadiest} stare.
e.zh: 他用最锐利的目光盯着她。

e.en: That rat had the {beadiest} little eyes.
e.zh: 那只老鼠的眼睛闪得像最亮的小珠子。

beadily.t: 以锐利的目光；像珠子般闪亮地

e.en: He stared {beadily} at the stranger.
e.zh: 他用锐利的目光盯着那个陌生人。

e.en: The crow watched {beadily} from the fence.
e.zh: 乌鸦在篱笆上目光犀利地注视着。

e.en: Tiny {beadlike} drops formed on the leaf.
e.zh: 叶子上凝结出珠子般的小水滴。

e.en: She wore a necklace of {beadlike} seeds.
e.zh: 她戴着一串珠状种子做的项链。

e.en: The monk recited names from the {beadroll}.
e.zh: 修士从祈祷名册上诵念名字。

e.en: Her {beadroll} listed every fallen soldier.
e.zh: 她的名册上列着每一位阵亡士兵。

beadsman.t: 受雇为他人祈祷的人；念珠者

e.en: An old {beadsman} prayed at the chapel.
e.zh: 一位年迈的祈祷者在小教堂里诵祷。

e.en: The lord kept a {beadsman} on his estate.
e.zh: 领主在庄园里供养着一位祈祷人。

e.en: The chapel housed several aged {beadsmen}.
e.zh: 小教堂里住着几位年迈的祈祷人。

e.en: Wealthy patrons supported their own {beadsmen}.
e.zh: 富有的赞助人各自供养着祈祷人。

e.en: The {beadswoman} prayed daily for her patron.
e.zh: 那位祈祷女子每天为赞助人祷告。

e.en: An aging {beadswoman} tended the shrine.
e.zh: 一位年迈的祈祷女子照料着神龛。

beady-eyed.t: 眼睛像珠子般小而亮的；目光锐利的

e.en: A {beady-eyed} clerk watched every customer.
e.zh: 一个目光锐利的店员盯着每位顾客。

e.en: The {beady-eyed} rat scurried into the alley.
e.zh: 那只眼睛像珠子的老鼠窜进了小巷。

e.en: The robin carried a {beakful} of worms.
e.zh: 知更鸟叼着满嘴的虫子。

e.en: She fed the chicks one {beakful} at a time.
e.zh: 她一次喂雏鸟一嘴的食物。

e.en: The galleon had a carved {beakhead}.
e.zh: 那艘大帆船有雕刻的船首饰。

e.en: Salt spray battered the ship's {beakhead}.
e.zh: 咸涩的浪花拍打着船的喙形船首。

e.en: The storm threw the ship on her {beam-ends}.
e.zh: 暴风把船吹得几乎倾覆。

e.en: The company was on its {beam-ends}.
e.zh: 公司已陷入岌岌可危的境地。

e.en: Engineers aligned the accelerator's {beam-line}.
e.zh: 工程师调校加速器的束流线。

e.en: A new {beam-line} was added to the lab.
e.zh: 实验室新增了一条束流线。

e.en: Hides are soaked in the {beamhouse} first.
e.zh: 兽皮先在制革准备车间浸泡。

e.en: The tannery's {beamhouse} smelled strongly of lime.
e.zh: 制革厂的准备车间散发着浓烈的石灰味。

beamily.t: 喜气洋洋地；笑容满面地

e.en: She greeted us {beamily} at the door.
e.zh: 她在门口笑容满面地迎接我们。

e.en: He spoke {beamily} about his grandchildren.
e.zh: 他眉开眼笑地谈起孙辈。

e.en: Her {beaminess} lifted the whole room.
e.zh: 她那满面的笑容感染了整个房间。

e.en: There was a quiet {beaminess} in his voice.
e.zh: 他的话音中带着安静的喜悦。

e.en: A {beamsplitter} divides the laser into two paths.
e.zh: 分束器将激光分成两路。

e.en: The interferometer relies on a precise {beamsplitter}.
e.zh: 干涉仪依赖于精密的分束器。

e.en: The antenna has a narrow {beamwidth}.
e.zh: 该天线的波束宽度很窄。

e.en: Engineers measured the radar's {beamwidth}.
e.zh: 工程师测量了雷达的波束宽度。

e.en: He flopped onto the giant {bean-bag}.
e.zh: 他一屁股坐进那个大豆袋椅。

e.en: The kids tossed a {bean-bag} at the target.
e.zh: 孩子们朝靶子扔豆袋。

bean-counter.t: 斤斤计较的会计；财务管制者（贬）

e.en: The {bean-counter} cut every team's budget.
e.zh: 那位斤斤计较的财务把每个部门的预算都砍了。

e.en: Don't let the {bean-counters} kill the project.
e.zh: 别让那些算账的把项目搞黄了。

e.en: She split open a green {bean-pod}.
e.zh: 她剥开一只绿色的豆荚。

e.en: Each {bean-pod} held five tiny beans.
e.zh: 每个豆荚里有五颗小豆子。

e.en: The kidney is a {bean-shaped} organ.
e.zh: 肾脏是一种豆形器官。

e.en: They sat around a {bean-shaped} table.
e.zh: 他们围坐在一张豆形的桌子旁。

beboppers.t: 比波普爵士乐手；比波普爵士乐迷

e.en: The club was packed with old {beboppers} reliving their youth.
e.zh: 俱乐部里挤满了重温青春的比波普老乐迷。

e.en: Young {beboppers} crowded around the saxophonist after the set.
e.zh: 演出结束后，年轻的比波普乐迷围住了那位萨克斯手。

e.en: Whatever may {bechance} us, we shall remain together.
e.zh: 无论我们遭遇何事，都将不离不弃。

e.en: Such misfortunes seldom {bechance} the prudent traveller.
e.zh: 这种不幸鲜少降临谨慎的旅人身上。

e.en: A strange thing {bechanced} him on the way home.
e.zh: 回家路上他碰巧遇到了一件怪事。

e.en: Misfortune {bechanced} the travellers in the dark wood.
e.zh: 不幸降临到了那些走入幽暗森林的旅人身上。

e.en: Whatever {bechances}, he keeps a steady mind.
e.zh: 无论发生何事，他都心绪如常。

e.en: Strange luck sometimes {bechances} the most cautious player.
e.zh: 奇异的运气有时也会降临到最谨慎的玩家身上。

e.en: Any ill {bechancing} the prince was reported at once.
e.zh: 任何降临到王子身上的不幸都会被立即上报。

e.en: He feared the dangers {bechancing} travellers on that road.
e.zh: 他害怕那条路上旅人会遭遇的种种危险。

e.en: Her singing seemed to {becharm} every listener in the hall.
e.zh: 她的歌声似乎令大厅里每一位听众都为之倾倒。

e.en: The witch tried to {becharm} the young prince with a spell.
e.zh: 女巫试图用咒语迷惑那位年轻的王子。

e.en: This cream is marketed as a powerful skin {beautifier}.
e.zh: 这款面霜被宣传为强效护肤美容品。

e.en: He became the chief {beautifier} of the city's old parks.
e.zh: 他成了那座城市旧公园的首席美化师。

e.en: She won the {beauty-pageant} when she was just eighteen.
e.zh: 她十八岁就赢得了选美比赛。

e.en: The {beauty-pageant} was broadcast live on national television.
e.zh: 那场选美比赛在全国电视上现场直播。

e.en: The {beauty-queen} waved to the cheering crowd.
e.zh: 选美皇后向欢呼的人群挥手致意。

e.en: She was crowned {beauty-queen} at the local festival.
e.zh: 她在当地节日上被加冕为选美皇后。

e.en: She visits the {beauty-salon} every other week.
e.zh: 她每隔一周去一次美容院。

e.en: They opened a new {beauty-salon} downtown last month.
e.zh: 他们上个月在市中心开了一家新的美容院。

beaux-arts.t: 美术学院派的；布扎风格的

e.en: The library was built in the {beaux-arts} style.
e.zh: 这座图书馆是按学院派风格建造的。

e.en: Many old train stations feature grand {beaux-arts} architecture.
e.zh: 许多老式火车站都呈现宏伟的学院派建筑风格。

e.en: The two cats became unlikely {bedmates}.
e.zh: 那两只猫成了想不到的同床伙伴。

e.en: Politics makes strange {bedmates} sometimes.
e.zh: 政治有时会造就奇怪的同盟者。

e.en: The engine sits on a steel {bedplate}.
e.zh: 发动机安装在钢制底板上。

e.en: Cracks appeared in the cast-iron {bedplate}.
e.zh: 铸铁底座上出现了裂纹。

e.en: Grandma stitched a colorful {bedquilt}.
e.zh: 奶奶缝了一床彩色的被子。

e.en: The {bedquilt} kept us warm all night.
e.zh: 那床被子让我们一整夜都很暖和。

e.en: Rain began to {bedraggle} her dress.
e.zh: 雨水开始把她的裙子打湿弄脏。

e.en: Mud will {bedraggle} the hem of your coat.
e.zh: 泥水会把你大衣的下摆弄得又脏又湿。

bedraggles.t: 使湿透弄脏（第三人称单数）

e.en: The storm {bedraggles} every traveler on the road.
e.zh: 暴风雨把路上每一个旅人都淋得湿透肮脏。

e.en: Wading through puddles {bedraggles} her shoes.
e.zh: 蹚过水坑把她的鞋弄得又湿又脏。

e.en: The rain kept {bedraggling} the parade marchers.
e.zh: 大雨不停地把游行队伍淋得狼狈不堪。

e.en: Mud was {bedraggling} the hem of her gown.
e.zh: 泥水正把她长袍的下摆弄得又湿又脏。

e.en: A sudden downpour can {bedrench} you instantly.
e.zh: 一场骤雨能瞬间把你浇个透湿。
