e.en: Tears seemed to {bedrench} her cheeks.
e.zh: 泪水似乎浸湿了她的双颊。

e.en: He arrived {bedrenched} from the storm.
e.zh: 他被暴风雨淋得湿透才到。

e.en: The fields lay {bedrenched} after days of rain.
e.zh: 连日大雨过后田野都被浸透了。

e.en: The waves were {bedrenching} the deck.
e.zh: 海浪正把甲板浇得湿透。

e.en: A burst pipe kept {bedrenching} the carpet.
e.zh: 破裂的水管不停地把地毯浸湿。

e.en: The old man lay {bedrid} for years.
e.zh: 那位老人卧床多年。

e.en: She nursed her {bedrid} mother daily.
e.zh: 她每天照料卧床的母亲。

e.en: Guests can sleep on the {bedsettee}.
e.zh: 客人可以睡在沙发床上。

e.en: We bought a small {bedsettee} for the study.
e.zh: 我们给书房买了一张小沙发床。

e.en: She slipped on a woolen {bedsock}.
e.zh: 她套上了一只羊毛睡袜。

e.en: A thick {bedsock} keeps your feet warm.
e.zh: 一只厚睡袜能让脚保持温暖。

e.en: The hostel still has some {bedspace} available.
e.zh: 青旅还有一些床位空余。

e.en: He rented a cheap {bedspace} downtown.
e.zh: 他在市中心租了一个便宜的床位。

e.en: {Bedstraw} grows wild along the hedges.
e.zh: 猪殃殃在树篱旁野生生长。

e.en: She picked some yellow {bedstraw} for the table.
e.zh: 她摘了一些黄色拉拉藤放在桌上。

e.en: The straw spilled out of the {bedtick}.
e.zh: 稻草从床垫套里漏了出来。

e.en: She sewed a sturdy linen {bedtick}.
e.zh: 她缝了一个结实的亚麻褥套。

beduin.t: 贝都因人；阿拉伯游牧民

e.en: A {beduin} guide led us through the desert.
e.zh: 一位贝都因向导带我们穿越沙漠。

e.en: The {beduin} pitched their tents at sunset.
e.zh: 贝都因人在日落时分搭起帐篷。

e.en: Many young children outgrow {bedwetting} naturally.
e.zh: 许多幼儿长大后自然就不尿床了。

e.en: The doctor offered advice on managing {bedwetting}.
e.zh: 医生就如何应对尿床提出了建议。

e.en: A colorful {bee-eater} darted across the field.
e.zh: 一只色彩斑斓的蜂虎掠过田野。

e.en: The {bee-eater} snatched insects in mid-air.
e.zh: 那只食蜂鸟在空中捕捉昆虫。

e.en: He carefully approached the {bee-hive}.
e.zh: 他小心翼翼地靠近蜂巢。

e.en: The garden {bee-hive} produces sweet honey.
e.zh: 花园里的蜂巢出产甘甜的蜂蜜。

e.en: My uncle is a part-time {bee-keeper}.
e.zh: 我叔叔是个兼职养蜂人。

e.en: The {bee-keeper} wore a protective veil.
e.zh: 养蜂人戴着防护面纱。

e.en: He made a {bee-line} for the buffet.
e.zh: 他径直朝自助餐台走去。

e.en: The kids took a {bee-line} home.
e.zh: 孩子们抄近路直奔家中。

bee-stung.t: 被蜂蛰过的；丰满如蜂蛰般的

e.en: She had famously {bee-stung} lips.
e.zh: 她有着出了名的丰润嘴唇。

e.en: His {bee-stung} hand swelled overnight.
e.zh: 他被蜜蜂蛰过的手一夜之间肿了起来。

e.en: He shot a tin can with a {beebee}.
e.zh: 他用BB弹打中了一个锡罐。

e.en: Kids loaded the air rifle with a {beebee}.
e.zh: 孩子们把BB弹装进了气枪。

e.en: Bees feed their larvae with {beebread}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂用蜂粮喂养幼虫。

e.en: {Beebread} is rich in protein and vitamins.
e.zh: 蜂面包富含蛋白质和维生素。

e.en: Squirrels gathered the fallen {beech-nut}.
e.zh: 松鼠把落下的山毛榉果捡起来。

e.en: A {beech-nut} crunched under his boot.
e.zh: 一颗山毛榉果在他靴子下嘎吱碎裂。

e.en: {Beechdrops} sprout under old beech trees.
e.zh: 山毛榉寄生草在老山毛榉树下萌芽。

e.en: Botanists collected samples of {beechdrops}.
e.zh: 植物学家采集了山毛榉寄生草的标本。

beechen.t: 山毛榉木制的；山毛榉的

e.en: The old cottage had a {beechen} floor that creaked underfoot.
e.zh: 那座老屋铺着山毛榉木地板，踩上去吱吱作响。

e.en: She rested in the {beechen} shade by the river.
e.zh: 她在河边的山毛榉树荫下歇息。

e.en: He chewed on a piece of {beef-jerky} during the long drive.
e.zh: 长途开车时他嚼着一块牛肉干。

e.en: Hikers often pack {beef-jerky} for protein on the trail.
e.zh: 徒步者常带牛肉干在路上补充蛋白质。

e.en: Shakespeare mocks the clown as a {beef-witted} fool.
e.zh: 莎士比亚把那个小丑讥讽为愚钝的傻瓜。

e.en: Don't be so {beef-witted}; think before you speak.
e.zh: 别这么糊涂，说话前先想想。

beefalo.t: 皮福娄牛（牛与北美野牛的杂交种）

e.en: The rancher raises {beefalo} for leaner meat.
e.zh: 那位牧场主饲养皮福娄牛以获得更瘦的肉。

e.en: A {beefalo} combines bison hardiness with cattle docility.
e.zh: 皮福娄牛兼具野牛的耐力和家牛的温顺。

beefcakery.t: 展示男性肌肉魅力的作品或风格

e.en: The film leans heavily on {beefcakery} to sell tickets.
e.zh: 那部电影靠展示男性肌肉魅力来卖票。

e.en: Old action movies were full of cheesy {beefcakery}.
e.zh: 老式动作片里充斥着俗气的肌肉男展示。

e.en: Security was {beefed-up} after the break-in.
e.zh: 那次闯入事件后，保安力量得到加强。

e.en: The new model has a {beefed-up} engine.
e.zh: 新款车型配备了增强型发动机。

e.en: He's the {beefiest} player on the team.
e.zh: 他是队里最壮实的球员。

e.en: They picked the {beefiest} server for the database.
e.zh: 他们挑了配置最强劲的服务器来跑数据库。

e.en: The table was carved from Australian {beefwood}.
e.zh: 那张桌子是用澳洲牛肉木雕成的。

e.en: {Beefwood} gets its name from its deep red grain.
e.zh: 牛肉木因其深红色纹理而得名。

e.en: The old {beehouse} stood at the edge of the orchard.
e.zh: 那座旧蜂房立在果园的边上。

e.en: He painted the {beehouse} bright yellow.
e.zh: 他把蜂房漆成了亮黄色。

e.en: The crowd moved with {beelike} purpose toward the stage.
e.zh: 人群像蜂群一样有目的地涌向舞台。

e.en: She had a {beelike} energy that exhausted everyone.
e.zh: 她那种蜜蜂似的精力让所有人都疲惫不堪。

e.en: The village {beeman} sells honey at the market.
e.zh: 村里的养蜂人在市场上卖蜂蜜。

e.en: My grandfather was a lifelong {beeman}.
e.zh: 我祖父一辈子都是养蜂人。

e.en: The old {beemaster} could calm any swarm.
e.zh: 那位老养蜂能手能让任何蜂群安静下来。

e.en: She trained for years to become a respected {beemaster}.
e.zh: 她苦练多年，成为了受人尊敬的养蜂能手。

been-to.t: 留过洋的人（尤指非洲留学归国者）

e.en: In the novel, the {been-to} returns home full of foreign ideas.
e.zh: 小说里那位留洋归来的人满脑子都是外国思想。

e.en: Villagers regarded him as a {been-to} with airs.
e.zh: 村民们把他看作一个摆架子的留洋归国者。

e.en: The taxi went {beep-beep} as it pulled into the driveway.
e.zh: 出租车开进车道时嘟嘟地按着喇叭。

e.en: The kids shouted '{beep-beep}!' while playing with toy cars.
e.zh: 孩子们玩玩具车时喊着"嘟嘟！"。

e.en: A {beer-bellied} man dozed in the armchair.
e.zh: 一个挺着啤酒肚的男人在扶手椅上打盹。

e.en: He's grown {beer-bellied} since giving up running.
e.zh: 自从不再跑步后，他长出了啤酒肚。

e.en: An empty {beer-bottle} rolled across the floor.
e.zh: 一个空啤酒瓶在地板上滚来滚去。

e.en: He used a {beer-bottle} as a candleholder.
e.zh: 他把一个啤酒瓶当作烛台。

e.en: They met at a noisy {beer-house} near the docks.
e.zh: 他们在码头附近一家喧闹的啤酒馆见面。

e.en: The old {beer-house} on the corner has shut down.
e.zh: 街角那家老啤酒馆已经关门了。

e.en: He earns a bit of {beer-money} fixing bikes on weekends.
e.zh: 他周末修自行车赚点零花钱。

e.en: The side gig brings in some {beer-money}.
e.zh: 那份兼职能赚点喝酒的钱。

e.en: He raised his heavy {beer-mug} in a toast.
e.zh: 他举起沉甸甸的啤酒杯敬酒。

e.en: The waiter slid a frothy {beer-mug} across the bar.
e.zh: 侍者把一只满是泡沫的啤酒杯滑过吧台。

beerage.t: 啤酒大亨集团；酿酒贵族

e.en: The {beerage} wielded enormous influence in Victorian politics.
e.zh: 啤酒大亨集团在维多利亚时代的政界有巨大影响力。

e.en: Critics mocked the new lords as members of the {beerage}.
e.zh: 批评者讥讽这些新贵族是"啤酒贵族"。

e.en: They spent the evening singing in a Munich {beerhall}.
e.zh: 他们在慕尼黑的一家啤酒馆里唱了一晚上。

e.en: The {beerhall} was packed for Oktoberfest.
e.zh: 啤酒馆在十月节期间挤得水泄不通。

e.en: The village {beerhouse} dates back two centuries.
e.zh: 村里的啤酒馆有两百年历史。

e.en: He stumbled out of the {beerhouse} at midnight.
e.zh: 他半夜从啤酒馆里跌跌撞撞地出来。

e.en: A faint {beeriness} hung in the air of the pub.
e.zh: 酒吧里飘着一股淡淡的啤酒味。

e.en: His speech betrayed a certain {beeriness}.
e.zh: 他的话音里透着几分醉意。

beerless.t: 无啤酒的；没有啤酒喝的

e.en: A {beerless} barbecue felt like a sad affair.
e.zh: 没有啤酒的烧烤聚会让人觉得扫兴。

e.en: He grumbled about spending a {beerless} weekend.
e.zh: 他抱怨过了个没酒喝的周末。

e.en: He scribbled his number on a {beermat}.
e.zh: 他把电话号码草草写在啤酒杯垫上。

e.en: The pub had {beermat}s from a dozen breweries.
e.zh: 酒吧里摆着十几家酿酒厂的啤酒杯垫。

e.en: The {beerslinger} kept the mugs full all night.
e.zh: 那位酒保整晚都让杯子满着。

e.en: She worked as a {beerslinger} at the festival tent.
e.zh: 她在节日帐篷里当卖啤酒的。

e.en: A {beesting} on his arm swelled up overnight.
e.zh: 他胳膊上被蜜蜂蜇的地方一夜之间肿了起来。

e.en: Apply ice to a {beesting} to reduce the pain.
e.zh: 被蜜蜂蜇了敷点冰能减轻疼痛。

e.en: The farmer collected {beestings} from the cow that morning.
e.zh: 农夫那天早上收集了那头牛的初乳。

e.en: {Beestings} are rich in antibodies for the calf.
e.zh: 初乳富含抗体，对小牛有益。

beeswing.t: 陈年葡萄酒中的薄片沉淀

e.en: The old port had a delicate {beeswing} floating in the glass.
e.zh: 那瓶陈年波特酒杯中漂着细薄的酒花沉淀。

e.en: Connoisseurs prize the {beeswing} as a sign of age.
e.zh: 行家把这种酒花视为陈酿的标志。

e.en: Don't be such a {beetle-brain}; read the instructions.
e.zh: 别这么蠢，读读说明书吧。

e.en: He called his rival a {beetle-brain} in the debate.
e.zh: 他在辩论中骂对手是笨蛋。

e.en: A {beetle-browed} guard glared at the visitors.
e.zh: 一个浓眉的卫兵怒视着来客。

e.en: He looked {beetle-browed} as he read the report.
e.zh: 他读报告时眉头紧锁。

e.en: He clomped in wearing a pair of {beetle-crusher}s.
e.zh: 他穿着一双大笨鞋咚咚地走了进来。

e.en: Mind where you put those {beetle-crusher}s of yours!
e.zh: 留神你那双大脚踩到哪儿！

e.en: Only a {beetlehead} would lock the keys inside the car.
e.zh: 只有笨蛋才会把钥匙锁在车里。

e.en: He cursed himself as a {beetlehead} for forgetting.
e.zh: 他骂自己是个忘性大的蠢货。

e.en: His {beetleheaded} suggestion was quickly dismissed.
e.zh: 他那愚蠢的建议很快就被否决了。

e.en: Don't be so {beetleheaded} about money.
e.zh: 在金钱问题上别这么糊涂。

e.en: His apron was {bedaubed} with paint and grease.
e.zh: 他的围裙上沾满了油漆和油污。

e.en: The walls were {bedaubed} with mud after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，墙壁上糊满了泥巴。

e.en: The children kept {bedaubing} the fence with sticky paint.
e.zh: 孩子们不停地把黏糊糊的颜料涂到栅栏上。

e.en: He spent hours {bedaubing} the canvas with thick oils.
e.zh: 他花了好几个小时往画布上厚厚地涂抹油彩。

bedaubs.t: 涂抹；弄脏（第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {bedaubs} his shirt while eating spaghetti.
e.zh: 他吃意大利面时总会把衬衫弄得一塌糊涂。

e.en: The toddler {bedaubs} every wall within reach.
e.zh: 那个学步的孩子把够得着的每面墙都涂得乱七八糟。

e.en: The bright lights {bedaze} him as he steps onstage.
e.zh: 他走上舞台时，强烈的灯光让他一阵眩晕。

e.en: Her sudden questions tend to {bedaze} new students.
e.zh: 她突如其来的提问常常让新学生措手不及。

e.en: His grandmother has been {bedbound} for several months.
e.zh: 他的祖母已经卧床好几个月了。

e.en: After surgery, she was {bedbound} for two weeks.
e.zh: 手术后她卧床了两个星期。

e.en: She washes the {bedcoverings} every weekend.
e.zh: 她每个周末都洗床上用品。

e.en: The hotel offers fresh {bedcoverings} for each guest.
e.zh: 酒店为每位客人提供干净的被褥。

e.en: The actor was famous for playing {beddable} villains.
e.zh: 那位演员以饰演性感诱人的反派而闻名。

e.en: She found his confidence oddly {beddable}.
e.zh: 她觉得他的自信莫名地有种诱惑力。

e.en: Time for {beddy-bye}, sweetheart.
e.zh: 宝贝，该睡觉觉了。

e.en: The kids went off to {beddy-bye} after the story.
e.zh: 听完故事后孩子们就去睡觉觉了。

e.en: Botanists collected a {bedegar} from the wild rose.
e.zh: 植物学家从野蔷薇上采集了一个虫瘿。

e.en: A fuzzy {bedegar} clung to the briar branch.
e.zh: 一团毛茸茸的蔷薇虫瘿挂在荆棘枝上。

e.en: He pointed out a mossy {bedeguar} on the rosebush.
e.zh: 他指出蔷薇丛上一团长着苔状物的虫瘿。

e.en: The {bedeguar} is caused by a tiny gall wasp.
e.zh: 这种蔷薇虫瘿是由一种小型瘿蜂引起的。

e.en: The medieval {bedehouse} sheltered the town's poor.
e.zh: 那座中世纪的济贫养老院收容着镇上的穷人。

e.en: Visitors toured the restored {bedehouse} on the hill.
e.zh: 游客们参观了山上修复过的祈祷院。

e.en: The old {bedesman} prayed daily for his benefactor.
e.zh: 那位年老的领救济祈祷者每日为他的施主祈祷。

e.en: Each {bedesman} received a small stipend and lodging.
e.zh: 每位领救济祈祷者都获得少量津贴和住所。

e.en: The {bedeswoman} lived quietly in the almshouse.
e.zh: 那位领救济的祈祷女在救济院里安静地生活着。

e.en: A devout {bedeswoman} tended the chapel candles.
e.zh: 一位虔诚的祈祷女照看着教堂的蜡烛。

e.en: The constant {bedevilment} by his rivals wore him down.
e.zh: 对手们不断的捉弄让他疲惫不堪。

e.en: She endured years of {bedevilment} from petty officials.
e.zh: 她忍受了多年小官吏的折磨。

e.en: Tears began to {bedew} her cheeks.
e.zh: 泪水开始沾湿她的脸颊。

e.en: Light rain will {bedew} the meadow at dawn.
e.zh: 细雨会在拂晓时分润湿草地。

e.en: The grass was {bedewed} with morning sparkle.
e.zh: 草地上沾着晨露闪闪发亮。

e.en: Her face was {bedewed} with sweat after the run.
e.zh: 跑步后她满脸都是汗珠。

e.en: The fountain acted as a gentle {bedewer} of the lawn.
e.zh: 那座喷泉像个温和的洒水器，润湿了草坪。

e.en: Mist served as a natural {bedewer} of the leaves.
e.zh: 薄雾成了树叶的天然润湿剂。

e.en: Soft rain was {bedewing} the rose petals.
e.zh: 细雨正润湿着玫瑰花瓣。

e.en: Tears kept {bedewing} the page she was writing.
e.zh: 泪水不断滴湿她正在写的纸页。

e.en: The morning mist {bedews} every blade of grass.
e.zh: 晨雾沾湿了每一片草叶。

e.en: Sweat {bedews} his brow during the long sermon.
e.zh: 长长的布道期间他额头上沁出了汗珠。

e.en: The illness left him {bedfast} for months.
e.zh: 那场病让他卧床不起好几个月。

e.en: Her elderly aunt has been {bedfast} since winter.
e.zh: 她年迈的姑姑从冬天起就卧床不起。

e.en: She slipped a warm {bedgown} over her shoulders.
e.zh: 她在肩上披上了一件暖和的睡袍。

e.en: The cotton {bedgown} hung neatly behind the door.
e.zh: 那件棉布睡袍整齐地挂在门后。

e.en: The novel's hero refuses to {bedhop} despite temptation.
e.zh: 小说的主人公面对诱惑也拒绝乱搞男女关系。

e.en: Tabloids accused the star of {bedhopping} all summer.
e.zh: 小报指责那位明星整个夏天都在频繁更换情人。

e.en: Geologists studied a black {bediasite} found in Texas.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了一块在德州发现的黑色贝迪亚陨石玻璃。

e.en: A glossy {bediasite} sat in the museum's display case.
e.zh: 博物馆的展柜里摆着一块光亮的贝迪亚陨石玻璃。

e.en: They {bedight} the hall with garlands and lights.
e.zh: 他们用花环和灯饰装点大厅。

e.en: The knight was {bedight} in shining armor.
e.zh: 那位骑士身披闪亮的铠甲。

e.en: The bride appeared {bedighted} in pearls and silk.
e.zh: 新娘身着珍珠与丝绸盛装出场。

e.en: The chapel was {bedighted} with white roses.
e.zh: 小教堂用白玫瑰装饰一新。

e.en: Servants spent the day {bedighting} the great hall.
e.zh: 仆人们花了一整天装饰大厅。

e.en: She was {bedighting} herself for the masquerade.
e.zh: 她正在为化装舞会盛装打扮。

bedights.t: 装饰；装扮（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {bedights} the altar with fresh lilies each Sunday.
e.zh: 他每个星期天都用新鲜的百合装饰祭坛。

e.en: Tradition {bedights} the throne with crimson cloth.
e.zh: 按照传统，王座要用深红色布料装饰。

e.en: Heavy clouds began to {bedim} the afternoon sky.
e.zh: 厚重的云层开始让午后的天空变得昏暗。

e.en: Tears can {bedim} even the sharpest vision.
e.zh: 泪水能让最敏锐的视线也变得模糊。

e.en: His eyes were {bedimmed} by years of reading.
e.zh: 多年读书让他的双眼变得昏花。

e.en: Smoke {bedimmed} the lanterns in the alley.
e.zh: 烟雾使巷子里的灯笼光线变得昏暗。

e.en: Dust was slowly {bedimming} the chandelier's glow.
e.zh: 灰尘正慢慢遮蔽吊灯的光芒。

e.en: Grief seemed to be {bedimming} her natural cheer.
e.zh: 悲伤似乎在让她原本的开朗黯淡下去。

e.en: The setting sun {bedims} the canyon walls.
e.zh: 夕阳让峡谷的岩壁渐渐昏暗。

e.en: Old age {bedims} memory more than eyesight.
e.zh: 年岁让记忆比视力更易模糊。

e.en: She arrived {bedized} in gaudy jewels and feathers.
e.zh: 她头戴艳俗的珠宝和羽饰登场。

e.en: The room looked vulgarly {bedized} with cheap glitter.
e.zh: 那间屋子被廉价的亮片装点得俗不可耐。

e.en: Critics mocked the singer's gaudy {bedizenment}.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑那位歌手俗气的装扮。

e.en: Her {bedizenment} drew stares from every passerby.
e.zh: 她俗丽的打扮引得过路人纷纷侧目。

e.en: Grandma wore a quilted {bedjacket} while reading.
e.zh: 奶奶读书时披着一件绗缝的床上短外套。

e.en: She knitted a pink {bedjacket} for the patient.
e.zh: 她为病人织了一件粉色的床上披肩。

e.en: He used a {bedkey} to tighten the loose bedframe.
e.zh: 他用一把床架扳手把松动的床架拧紧。

e.en: The antique shop sold an old iron {bedkey}.
e.zh: 那家古董店出售一把旧铁制的床架扳手。

e.en: He ranted in the street like a complete {bedlamite}.
e.zh: 他在街上大喊大叫，活像个十足的疯子。

e.en: The novel's narrator turns out to be a {bedlamite}.
e.zh: 小说的叙述者最后竟然是个精神错乱者。

e.en: She switched on the {bedlamp} to read for a while.
e.zh: 她打开床头灯，读了一会儿书。

e.en: A small {bedlamp} cast a warm glow on the pillow.
e.zh: 一盏小床头灯在枕头上投下温暖的光。

e.en: Many shelters remain {bedless} during the cold season.
e.zh: 许多收容所在寒冷季节仍然床位短缺。

e.en: The travelers spent a {bedless} night at the airport.
e.zh: 旅客们在机场度过了一个无床可睡的夜晚。

e.en: He sprayed a tough {bedliner} into the truck.
e.zh: 他往皮卡车厢里喷了一层耐用的内衬。

e.en: A rubber {bedliner} protects the metal from scratches.
e.zh: 橡胶车厢内衬保护金属不被刮伤。

e.en: The college {bedmaker} tidied each student's room.
e.zh: 学院的宿舍清洁工把每位学生的房间整理干净。

e.en: At Cambridge, the {bedmaker} is a long tradition.
e.zh: 在剑桥，宿舍清洁工是一项悠久的传统。

e.en: His snoring made him a difficult {bedmate}.
e.zh: 他打鼾让他成了难对付的同床伴侣。

e.en: The puppy quickly became her favorite {bedmate}.
e.zh: 那只小狗很快成了她最爱的睡伴。

e.en: The pitcher threw a {beanball} at the batter's head.
e.zh: 投手朝击球员的头部投了一个故意触身球。

e.en: He was ejected for throwing a {beanball}.
e.zh: 他因投出故意伤人球而被驱逐出场。

e.en: Cheap {beaneries} lined the old downtown street.
e.zh: 廉价小饭馆排列在老城区的街上。

e.en: Workers used to eat at the local {beaneries}.
e.zh: 工人们过去常在当地的小饭馆吃饭。

e.en: They grabbed lunch at a roadside {beanery}.
e.zh: 他们在路边的小餐馆吃了午饭。

e.en: The old {beanery} served hearty stews.
e.zh: 那家老饭馆供应丰盛的炖菜。

e.en: The annual {beanfeast} was a noisy affair.
e.zh: 年度聚餐场面喧闹热烈。

e.en: Workers looked forward to the company {beanfeast}.
e.zh: 员工们都盼望着公司的年度聚餐。

e.en: She split the {beanpod} open with her thumb.
e.zh: 她用拇指把豆荚剥开。

e.en: The dried {beanpod} rattled in the wind.
e.zh: 干豆荚在风中沙沙作响。

e.en: The boys made a {beanshooter} from a forked stick.
e.zh: 男孩们用分叉的树枝做了一把豆枪。

e.en: He fired dried peas with his {beanshooter}.
e.zh: 他用豆枪发射干豌豆。

e.en: The soup had a {beany} aftertaste.
e.zh: 这汤有股豆腥味。

e.en: She disliked the {beany} flavor of the paste.
e.zh: 她不喜欢这种酱料的豆味。

e.en: The {bear's-ear} bloomed in alpine meadows.
e.zh: 熊耳花在高山草甸上盛开。

e.en: She pressed a {bear's-ear} into her album.
e.zh: 她把一朵熊耳花压进了相册。

e.en: {Bear-baiting} was a popular Elizabethan spectacle.
e.zh: 纵狗逗熊是伊丽莎白时代流行的娱乐。

e.en: They banned {bear-baiting} as cruel.
e.zh: 他们以残忍为由禁止了纵狗逗熊。

e.en: He ordered a {bear-claw} with his coffee.
e.zh: 他点了一份熊掌酥配咖啡。

e.en: The bakery's {bear-claw} was warm and flaky.
e.zh: 面包店的熊掌酥温热酥脆。

e.en: He gave his old friend a {bear-hug}.
e.zh: 他给了老朋友一个大大的熊抱。

e.en: She greeted me with a warm {bear-hug}.
e.zh: 她热情地给了我一个熊抱。

e.en: He was a {bear-like} man with a booming voice.
e.zh: 他身材魁梧像熊，嗓音洪亮。

e.en: The dog had a {bear-like} appearance.
e.zh: 那只狗外形酷似熊。

e.en: Investors panicked during the {bear-market}.
e.zh: 投资者在熊市中陷入恐慌。

e.en: A prolonged {bear-market} hurt retirement funds.
e.zh: 长期的熊市损害了退休基金。

e.en: The pain was {bearably} mild that morning.
e.zh: 那天早上疼痛尚可忍受。

e.en: He performed {bearably} well under pressure.
e.zh: 他在压力下表现尚可。

e.en: The {bearbaiter} led his dogs into the pit.
e.zh: 逗熊者把他的狗带进斗熊场。

e.en: Crowds cheered as the {bearbaiter} took the stage.
e.zh: 逗熊者登场时人群欢呼。

e.en: {Bearbaiting} drew large crowds in old London.
e.zh: 纵狗逗熊在旧伦敦吸引了大批观众。

e.en: Reformers campaigned against {bearbaiting}.
e.zh: 改革者发起了反对纵狗逗熊的运动。

e.en: Red {bearberries} dotted the rocky slope.
e.zh: 红色的熊果点缀着岩坡。

e.en: Birds feasted on the autumn {bearberries}.
e.zh: 鸟儿们饱餐秋天的熊果。

e.en: The {bearberry} grows in cold mountainous regions.
e.zh: 熊果生长在寒冷的山区。

e.en: Native peoples used {bearberry} leaves medicinally.
e.zh: 原住民用熊果的叶子入药。

e.en: The {bearcat} prowled along the rainforest branches.
e.zh: 熊狸在雨林的枝头悄悄行走。

e.en: Their linebacker was a real {bearcat}.
e.zh: 他们的中后卫真是个猛人。

e.en: The infant was wrapped in a heirloom {bearcloth}.
e.zh: 婴儿被裹在传家的洗礼斗篷里。

e.en: She embroidered the family {bearcloth} by hand.
e.zh: 她亲手绣制了家族的洗礼斗篷。

e.en: Purple {beardtongue} bloomed across the prairie.
e.zh: 紫色的钓钟柳开遍草原。

e.en: She planted {beardtongue} along the garden path.
e.zh: 她在花园小径旁种了钓钟柳。

e.en: The classroom became a {beargarden} after the bell.
e.zh: 铃声一响，教室就乱成一团。

e.en: Parliament turned into a {beargarden} during the debate.
e.zh: 辩论时议会变得像一锅粥。

e.en: He wrapped her in a tight {bearhug}.
e.zh: 他紧紧地把她熊抱在怀里。

e.en: The reunion ended with a long {bearhug}.
e.zh: 重聚以一个长长的熊抱结束。

e.en: He had a {bearlike} build and gentle manner.
e.zh: 他身材像熊，性情却温和。

e.en: The dog let out a {bearlike} growl.
e.zh: 那只狗发出像熊一样的咆哮。

e.en: He strapped on a pair of {bearpaw} snowshoes.
e.zh: 他绑上一双熊掌形雪鞋。

e.en: The trail required {bearpaw} footwear in winter.
e.zh: 冬天走这条小径需要熊掌雪鞋。

e.en: Their {bearpaws} kept them above the deep snow.
e.zh: 熊掌雪鞋让他们不会陷进深雪里。

e.en: She tied her {bearpaws} on tightly.
e.zh: 她把熊掌雪鞋牢牢系紧。

e.en: The {bearward} led his bear through the village.
e.zh: 驯熊人牵着熊穿过村庄。

e.en: A grumpy {bearward} guarded the cage.
e.zh: 一个脾气暴躁的看熊人守着笼子。

e.en: {Bearwood} bark was traditionally used as a laxative.
e.zh: 鼠李木的树皮传统上用作泻药。

e.en: He gathered {bearwood} from the riverbank.
e.zh: 他在河岸边采集鼠李木。

e.en: The novel explores the boundary between humanity and {beasthood}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨人性与兽性的界限。

e.en: He sank into a kind of feral {beasthood}.
e.zh: 他堕入一种野蛮的兽性状态。

e.en: The farmer collected {beastings} from the new calf.
e.zh: 农夫收集了新生小牛的初乳。

e.en: {Beastings} are rich in antibodies.
e.zh: 初乳富含抗体。

e.en: He let out a {beastlike} roar of fury.
e.zh: 他发出野兽般愤怒的咆哮。

e.en: Her hunger drove her to {beastlike} behavior.
e.zh: 饥饿使她做出野兽般的举动。

e.en: A hulking {beastman} guarded the cavern entrance.
e.zh: 一个魁梧的兽人守在洞口。

e.en: The legend tells of a forest-dwelling {beastman}.
e.zh: 传说讲述一个住在森林里的兽人。

e.en: He took a serious {beat-down} in the alley.
e.zh: 他在小巷里被狠狠揍了一顿。

e.en: The team gave their rivals a real {beat-down}.
e.zh: 那支球队把对手痛扁了一顿。

e.en: He drove a {beat-up} old pickup truck.
e.zh: 他开着一辆破旧的小卡车。

e.en: She wore a {beat-up} leather jacket.
e.zh: 她穿着一件磨损的皮夹克。

e.en: He can {beatbox} an entire drum track.
e.zh: 他能用嘴模仿整段鼓点。

e.en: The kids gathered around to hear him {beatbox}.
e.zh: 孩子们围上来听他玩口技节奏。

e.en: The {beatboxer} stunned the crowd with his rhythms.
e.zh: 那位口技节奏手用节拍震撼了观众。

e.en: She trained for years to become a top {beatboxer}.
e.zh: 她苦练多年才成为顶尖的口技节奏手。

e.en: Their team suffered a humiliating {beatdown}.
e.zh: 他们队遭遇了一场惨败。

e.en: He gave the bully a thorough {beatdown}.
e.zh: 他把那个恶霸狠狠揍了一顿。

e.en: He arrived in a {beaten-up} taxi.
e.zh: 他乘着一辆破旧的出租车赶到。

e.en: She found a {beaten-up} copy of the book.
e.zh: 她找到一本破破烂烂的旧书。

e.en: We heard a {bellbird} calling deep in the rainforest.
e.zh: 我们听到雨林深处有只钟鸟在鸣叫。

e.en: The male {bellbird} has a startlingly loud song.
e.zh: 雄性钟鸟的叫声大得惊人。

e.en: She wore faded {bellbottoms} to the seventies-themed party.
e.zh: 她穿着褪色的喇叭裤去参加七十年代主题派对。

e.en: Vintage {bellbottoms} are back in fashion this year.
e.zh: 今年复古喇叭裤又流行起来了。

e.en: He devoted his retirement to reading French {belles-lettres}.
e.zh: 退休后他专心阅读法国纯文学作品。

e.en: The journal publishes essays, criticism, and {belles-lettres}.
e.zh: 该期刊刊登散文、评论和纯文学作品。

e.en: Critics dismissed his work as mere {belletrism}.
e.zh: 评论家将他的作品贬为单纯的美文写作。

e.en: The course traced the rise of European {belletrism}.
e.zh: 这门课程梳理了欧洲纯文学的兴起。

e.en: She was a respected {belletrist} of the late nineteenth century.
e.zh: 她是十九世纪末一位受人尊敬的纯文学作家。

e.en: The {belletrist} preferred elegant essays to political polemics.
e.zh: 这位美文作者偏爱优雅的散文，胜过政治论战。

e.en: His prose has a distinctly {belletristic} flavor.
e.zh: 他的散文带有鲜明的纯文学风味。

e.en: The journal favors scholarly rather than {belletristic} writing.
e.zh: 该期刊偏好学术性而非美文风格的文章。

e.en: The {bellhanger} ran new wires through the old hallway.
e.zh: 装铃工在老旧的走廊里重新布线。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {bellhanger} before electric doorbells.
e.zh: 他的祖父在电铃出现前是一名装铃工。

e.en: The poem praised the {bellipotent} king and his armies.
e.zh: 这首诗赞颂这位善战的国王及其军队。

e.en: Rome remained a {bellipotent} power for centuries.
e.zh: 罗马在数百年间一直是以武力称雄的强国。

e.en: Two {bellmen} hurried over to take our suitcases.
e.zh: 两名行李员急忙过来接我们的行李箱。

e.en: The hotel's {bellmen} wear smart burgundy uniforms.
e.zh: 这家酒店的门童身着考究的酒红色制服。

e.en: Water poured into the spillway through a concrete {bellmouth}.
e.zh: 水通过混凝土喇叭口涌入溢洪道。

e.en: Engineers redesigned the tunnel's {bellmouth} to reduce turbulence.
e.zh: 工程师重新设计了隧道的喇叭口以减少湍流。

e.en: The pipe ends in a wide, {bellmouthed} opening.
e.zh: 管子末端是一个宽大的喇叭口形开口。

e.en: A {bellmouthed} intake helps water flow more smoothly.
e.zh: 喇叭口形的进水口能让水流更顺畅。

bellows-contact.t: 波纹管式触点（电气元件）

e.en: The relay uses a sealed {bellows-contact} to handle high currents.
e.zh: 该继电器采用密封波纹管式触点来承载大电流。

e.en: Engineers replaced the worn {bellows-contact} during routine maintenance.
e.zh: 工程师在例行维护中更换了磨损的波纹管式触点。

e.en: She tugged the embroidered {bellpull} to summon a servant.
e.zh: 她拉了拉绣花拉铃绳，把仆人叫来。

e.en: An ornate brass {bellpull} hung beside the front door.
e.zh: 前门旁挂着一根华丽的黄铜拉铃手柄。

e.en: The walls were painted a soft, {beigy} cream.
e.zh: 墙壁刷成柔和的米黄奶油色。

e.en: She wore a {beigy} trench coat over her dress.
e.zh: 她在裙子外套了一件米色风衣。

e.en: Heidegger explored the concept of {being-in-the-world} extensively.
e.zh: 海德格尔深入探讨了在世存在这一概念。

e.en: Her essay analyzed {being-in-the-world} as a unified phenomenon.
e.zh: 她的论文将在世存在分析为一个统一的现象。

e.en: The poet described a {beingless} void at the heart of memory.
e.zh: 诗人描绘了记忆深处那片无存在的虚空。

e.en: Some philosophers reject the idea of a {beingless} state.
e.zh: 有些哲学家否认无存在状态这一观念。

e.en: {Bejabbers}, that horse can run fast!
e.zh: 天哪，那匹马跑得真快！

e.en: "{Bejabbers}!" he cried when the door slammed shut.
e.zh: 门砰地关上时他喊道："天哪！"

e.en: A crowd of {bejeaned} students filled the lecture hall.
e.zh: 一群穿牛仔裤的学生挤满了演讲厅。

e.en: He spotted a {bejeaned} figure leaning by the door.
e.zh: 他看见一个穿牛仔裤的身影靠在门边。

e.en: Designers often {bejewel} the gowns with tiny crystals.
e.zh: 设计师们常用细小的水晶装饰这些礼服。

e.en: Frost seemed to {bejewel} every blade of grass.
e.zh: 霜似乎为每一片草叶镶上了珠宝。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {bejeweling} her costume for the show.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在为演出的戏服镶嵌珠宝。

e.en: The artist was {bejeweling} the mask with tiny gems.
e.zh: 那位艺术家正在用细小的宝石装饰面具。

e.en: Tailors {bejewell} the royal robes for the ceremony.
e.zh: 裁缝们为典礼装饰王室长袍。

e.en: They would {bejewell} the crown with rare stones.
e.zh: 他们会用稀有宝石装饰那顶王冠。

bejewelling.t: 用珠宝装饰（英式现在分词）

e.en: She is {bejewelling} the tiara for tomorrow's pageant.
e.zh: 她正在为明天的选美装饰头冠。

e.en: The dewdrops were {bejewelling} every leaf at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨的露珠把每片叶子都装点得像宝石。

bejewels.t: 装饰以珠宝（第三人称单数）

e.en: Frost {bejewels} the windows on cold mornings.
e.zh: 寒冷的早晨，霜把窗户装点得晶莹剔透。

e.en: She {bejewels} every costume she designs.
e.zh: 她设计的每件戏服都镶嵌着珠宝。

e.en: The pamphleteer would {beknave} every rival in print.
e.zh: 那位写小册子的人在文章里把每个对手都骂作恶棍。

e.en: He dared not {beknave} the duke to his face.
e.zh: 他不敢当面把公爵骂作无赖。

belah.t: 贝拉树（澳洲一种木麻黄）

e.en: The {belah} provides dense timber prized by carvers.
e.zh: 贝拉树木质致密，深受雕刻师喜爱。

e.en: Sheep often shelter under the spreading {belah}.
e.zh: 羊群常在枝叶舒展的贝拉树下避荫。

belaid.t: 包围；铺设（belay的过去式变体）

e.en: The fortress was {belaid} by enemy troops for weeks.
e.zh: 那座要塞被敌军围困了数周。

e.en: Cables had been {belaid} carefully along the deck.
e.zh: 缆绳已沿甲板小心地铺设好。

belat.t: 贝拉风（阿拉伯半岛冬季陆风）

e.en: Sailors learned to read the dry {belat} blowing from the desert.
e.zh: 水手们学会辨识从沙漠刮来的干燥贝拉风。

e.en: The {belat} can stir up dust storms along the coast.
e.zh: 贝拉风会沿着海岸卷起沙尘暴。

e.en: The storm was {belating} every flight out of the airport.
e.zh: 那场风暴使机场的每个航班都被耽搁。

e.en: Heavy traffic kept {belating} their arrival at the venue.
e.zh: 严重的交通拥堵不断耽误他们到达会场。

e.en: Critics continued to {belaud} the young novelist's debut.
e.zh: 评论家们持续盛赞这位年轻小说家的处女作。

e.en: He would {belaud} his patron in every speech.
e.zh: 他每次演讲都对他的赞助人大加颂扬。

e.en: In the tale, an old {beldam} curses the prince.
e.zh: 故事里，一个老巫婆诅咒了王子。

e.en: The villagers feared the {beldam} who lived in the woods.
e.zh: 村民们害怕住在林中的那位老妪。

e.en: A toothless {beldame} sat muttering by the fire.
e.zh: 一个没了牙的老妇人坐在火边喃喃自语。

e.en: The play features a wicked {beldame} as the antagonist.
e.zh: 这部戏剧以一位邪恶的老妪作为反派。

e.en: The city's long {beleaguerment} finally ended at dawn.
e.zh: 这座城市漫长的围困终于在黎明时分结束。

e.en: He wrote about the constant {beleaguerment} of public officials.
e.zh: 他撰文描述公职人员所遭受的持续困扰。

beleagured.t: 被围困的；饱受困扰的（拼写变体）

e.en: Reinforcements finally reached the {beleagured} garrison.
e.zh: 援军终于抵达那支被围困的驻军。

e.en: Reporters interviewed the {beleagured} mayor after the scandal.
e.zh: 记者们在丑闻后采访了那位饱受困扰的市长。

e.en: This test is the industry {bench-mark} for safety.
e.zh: 这项测试是该行业的安全基准。

e.en: We use last year's results as a {bench-mark}.
e.zh: 我们用去年的成绩作为基准。

e.en: He can {bench-press} over a hundred kilos.
e.zh: 他卧推可以超过一百公斤。

e.en: The {bench-press} is a classic chest exercise.
e.zh: 卧推是一项经典的胸部训练动作。

e.en: She {bench-pressed} her own body weight today.
e.zh: 她今天卧推了自身体重。

e.en: He {bench-pressed} twice a week last year.
e.zh: 去年他每周卧推两次。

e.en: He {bench-presses} every Monday morning.
e.zh: 他每周一早上都做卧推。

e.en: The gym has three new {bench-presses}.
e.zh: 健身房新添了三台卧推架。

e.en: He hurt his shoulder while {bench-pressing}.
e.zh: 他在做卧推时弄伤了肩膀。

e.en: {Bench-pressing} builds chest and arm strength.
e.zh: 卧推能锻炼胸部和手臂力量。

bench-scale.t: 实验室小规模的；台架规模的

e.en: The reaction was tested at {bench-scale} first.
e.zh: 该反应先在实验室小规模下进行了测试。

e.en: They built a {bench-scale} prototype to verify the design.
e.zh: 他们制作了一个台架规模的原型来验证设计。

e.en: The old truck has a wide {bench-seat} in front.
e.zh: 这辆旧卡车前面有一个宽大的长条座椅。

e.en: They sat together on the wooden {bench-seat}.
e.zh: 他们一起坐在木制长椅上。

e.en: A stone {bench-table} ran along the church wall.
e.zh: 教堂墙边有一排石制靠墙长凳。

e.en: They ate at a long {bench-table} in the hall.
e.zh: 他们在大厅里一张长凳式餐桌上用餐。

e.en: Each {benchman} polished the parts by hand.
e.zh: 每位工作台技工都用手工打磨这些零件。

e.en: The factory hired a skilled {benchman} for fine assembly.
e.zh: 工厂聘请了一位熟练的工作台技工进行精细装配。

benchwarmer.t: 替补球员；坐冷板凳的人

e.en: He spent the whole season as a {benchwarmer}.
e.zh: 他整个赛季都坐着冷板凳。

e.en: Even a {benchwarmer} can become a star with practice.
e.zh: 经过苦练，连替补球员也能成为明星。

e.en: This wire is {bendier} than the older type.
e.zh: 这种电线比旧款更容易弯曲。

e.en: The new straws are much {bendier}.
e.zh: 新款吸管要柔韧得多。

e.en: The shield was divided {bendwise} by a red stripe.
e.zh: 盾牌被一条红色斜带沿斜向分开。

e.en: Stripes running {bendwise} appear on the family crest.
e.zh: 沿斜带方向的条纹出现在家族纹章上。

e.en: The new policy has many {bene-fits} for workers.
e.zh: 新政策对工人有许多益处。

e.en: Health {bene-fits} are included in the package.
e.zh: 该套餐包括医疗福利。

e.en: The monks sang the {benedicite} at dawn.
e.zh: 修士们在黎明时吟唱祝福祷文。

e.en: He murmured a soft {benedicite} over the meal.
e.zh: 他在饭前低声念了一句祝福。

e.en: The old {benedick} surprised everyone by marrying.
e.zh: 那位老单身汉竟然结婚了，让所有人都很惊讶。

e.en: He became a happy {benedick} at fifty.
e.zh: 他在五十岁时成了幸福的新婚旧单身汉。

benedictional.t: 主教祝福书的；与祝福相关的

e.en: The library held a rare {benedictional} manuscript.
e.zh: 图书馆藏有一份罕见的主教祝福书手稿。

e.en: He studied {benedictional} texts from the Middle Ages.
e.zh: 他研究了中世纪的祝福文献。

e.en: She raised her hand in a {benedictive} gesture.
e.zh: 她举起手做了一个祝福的手势。

e.en: His tone was warm and {benedictive}.
e.zh: 他的语气温暖而充满祝福。

e.en: The priest spoke in a {benedictory} tone.
e.zh: 牧师用祝福的语气说话。

e.en: He ended the letter with a {benedictory} note.
e.zh: 他在信末写下了祝福的话语。

e.en: That remark was really {below-the-belt}.
e.zh: 那句话实在太卑鄙了。

e.en: Attacking his family was a {below-the-belt} move.
e.zh: 攻击他的家人是不光彩的手段。

e.en: The crew slept {belowdecks} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中船员们在甲板下睡觉。

e.en: Cargo was stored {belowdecks} for safety.
e.zh: 货物为安全起见存放在下层甲板。

e.en: They mounted a {belt-fed} machine gun on the truck.
e.zh: 他们在卡车上安装了一挺弹链供弹的机枪。

e.en: The {belt-fed} weapon could fire continuously.
e.zh: 这种弹链供弹武器可以连续射击。

e.en: A {belt-like} band of clouds circled the planet.
e.zh: 一条带状云带环绕着这颗行星。

e.en: She wore a {belt-like} sash over her dress.
e.zh: 她在裙子外系了一条腰带似的饰带。

e.en: Families had to {belt-tighten} during the recession.
e.zh: 经济衰退期间家庭不得不勒紧裤带。

e.en: The company asked staff to {belt-tighten} this year.
e.zh: 公司今年要求员工节衣缩食。

e.en: The budget calls for serious {belt-tightening}.
e.zh: 这份预算要求大幅缩减开支。

e.en: After the layoffs, more {belt-tightening} was expected.
e.zh: 裁员之后预计还会有更多节衣缩食的措施。

e.en: Traffic on the {beltline} was bumper-to-bumper.
e.zh: 环城公路上的车辆挤得水泄不通。

e.en: The car's chrome {beltline} caught the sunlight.
e.zh: 汽车镀铬的腰线在阳光下闪闪发亮。

e.en: The rabbi ascended the {bema} to read.
e.zh: 拉比登上诵经台开始诵读。

e.en: An ornate {bema} stood at the front of the synagogue.
e.zh: 一座装饰华丽的诵经台立于会堂前方。

e.en: Several {bemas} lined the ancient basilica.
e.zh: 古老的大教堂里排列着几座讲坛。

e.en: The synagogues featured wooden {bemas}.
e.zh: 这些会堂都设有木制诵经台。

e.en: The orators spoke from raised {bemata}.
e.zh: 演说者们站在抬高的讲坛上发言。

e.en: Ancient {bemata} were carved from stone.
e.zh: 古代的讲坛是用石头雕成的。

e.en: The bear could {bemaul} an intruder easily.
e.zh: 那只熊可以轻易地把入侵者狠狠抓伤。

e.en: Critics seemed to {bemaul} every new film.
e.zh: 评论家似乎要把每一部新片都狠批一顿。

e.en: The puzzle seemed designed to {bemaze} solvers.
e.zh: 这道谜题似乎是专门设计来让解题者迷惑的。

e.en: His vague answers only {bemaze} the audience.
e.zh: 他含糊的回答只让听众更加困惑。

e.en: He refused to {bemean} himself by lying.
e.zh: 他不愿意撒谎而自贬身份。

e.en: Such gossip would only {bemean} the speaker.
e.zh: 这种闲话只会让说的人显得卑微。

e.en: A {bemedalled} general led the parade.
e.zh: 一位佩戴勋章的将军带领游行队伍。

e.en: The {bemedalled} veteran spoke at the ceremony.
e.zh: 那位胸前挂满勋章的老兵在典礼上发言。

e.en: Heavy rain would {bemire} the country lanes.
e.zh: 大雨会把乡间小道弄得泥泞不堪。

e.en: He feared the scandal might {bemire} his name.
e.zh: 他担心这桩丑闻会玷污他的名声。

e.en: The carriage was {bemired} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后马车陷在泥里。

e.en: His reputation was {bemired} by the allegations.
e.zh: 那些指控让他的名誉蒙上污点。

e.en: Each storm {bemires} the unpaved road.
e.zh: 每场暴雨都会让这条土路陷入泥泞。

e.en: Gossip {bemires} reputations quickly.
e.zh: 流言蜚语很快就会玷污人的名誉。

e.en: The flood was {bemiring} the entire valley.
e.zh: 洪水正把整个山谷淹没在泥泞中。

e.en: Rumors kept {bemiring} the candidate's image.
e.zh: 谣言不断玷污这位候选人的形象。

e.en: Steam from the kettle began to {bemist} the windows.
e.zh: 水壶冒出的蒸汽开始让窗户起雾。

e.en: Tears seemed to {bemist} her eyes.
e.zh: 泪水似乎让她的双眼蒙上一层雾气。

e.en: The crowd began to {bemock} the failed performer.
e.zh: 人群开始嘲弄那位失败的表演者。

e.en: He would never {bemock} another's misfortune.
e.zh: 他绝不会嘲笑别人的不幸。

e.en: The poet was {bemocked} by his contemporaries.
e.zh: 这位诗人被同时代的人嘲笑。

e.en: She felt {bemocked} by the smirking guests.
e.zh: 她觉得被那些窃笑的客人讥讽了。

e.en: His {bemocking} tone offended everyone present.
e.zh: 他嘲弄的口吻冒犯了在场的每一个人。

e.en: She caught a {bemocking} smile on his face.
e.zh: 她发现他脸上挂着一丝嘲讽的微笑。

e.en: The satirist {bemocks} every politician in town.
e.zh: 这位讽刺作家嘲弄镇上的每一位政客。

e.en: He {bemocks} those who take themselves too seriously.
e.zh: 他嘲笑那些过于自命不凡的人。

e.en: The muddy path would {bemoil} her white dress.
e.zh: 泥泞的小路会把她的白裙子弄脏。

e.en: Workers tried not to {bemoil} the clean floor.
e.zh: 工人们尽量不把干净的地板弄脏。

e.en: Light dew began to {bemoisten} the grass.
e.zh: 细密的露水开始打湿草地。

e.en: Tears {bemoisten} the page she was writing on.
e.zh: 泪水沾湿了她正在书写的那页纸。

e.en: Too many options can {bemuddle} the choice.
e.zh: 选项太多会让人难以抉择。

e.en: His rambling explanation only {bemuddle} the issue.
e.zh: 他冗长的解释只让问题更加扑朔迷离。

e.en: The elders would {bename} each newborn child.
e.zh: 长老们会为每个新生儿命名。

e.en: Ancient texts {bename} the hero many ways.
e.zh: 古代典籍以多种方式称呼这位英雄。

e.en: The {bent-back} old man shuffled along the path.
e.zh: 那位驼背的老人沿小路缓缓而行。

e.en: She noticed the {bent-back} posture of the gardener.
e.zh: 她注意到园丁弯腰的姿势。

e.en: The golf green was planted with {bent-grass}.
e.zh: 高尔夫球场的果岭种着剪股颖。

e.en: {Bent-grass} thrives in cool, moist climates.
e.zh: 剪股颖适合在凉爽湿润的气候中生长。

e.en: The submersible studied {benthal} life forms.
e.zh: 潜水器研究了水底生物。

e.en: Pressure increases sharply in the {benthal} zone.
e.zh: 在海底区域压力急剧增加。

benthamic.t: 边沁主义的；功利主义的

e.en: His ethics took a {benthamic} turn toward utility.
e.zh: 他的伦理观转向了边沁式的功利主义。

e.en: The reform was guided by {benthamic} principles.
e.zh: 这项改革以边沁主义原则为指导。

e.en: The headmaster {belectured} the boys for hours.
e.zh: 校长对男孩们训诫了好几个小时。

e.en: She {belectured} her brother on his bad habits.
e.zh: 她就坏习惯一事训诫了她弟弟。

belee.t: 置于下风；使船无法行进

e.en: The fleet was {beleed} by adverse winds.
e.zh: 舰队因逆风被困在下风处。

e.en: Heavy gales {beleed} the merchant ship for days.
e.zh: 狂风数日将这艘商船困于下风。

e.en: The cliff contained {belemnitic} fossils from the Jurassic.
e.zh: 这处悬崖含有侏罗纪的箭石化石。

e.en: Geologists studied the {belemnitic} layer in detail.
e.zh: 地质学家详细研究了那层箭石化石层。

e.en: {Belemnoid} cephalopods resembled modern squid.
e.zh: 箭石类头足动物外形类似现代鱿鱼。

e.en: The museum displayed several {belemnoid} fossils.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几件箭石类化石。

e.en: The artisan {belettered} each panel by hand.
e.zh: 工匠在每块板上手工刻写了文字。

e.en: He {belettered} his old maps with new place names.
e.zh: 他在旧地图上重新标注了地名。

e.en: We approached a quiet {belfried} village church.
e.zh: 我们走近一座建有钟楼的安静乡村教堂。

e.en: The {belfried} town hall dominated the square.
e.zh: 带钟楼的市政厅俯瞰着整个广场。

belga.t: 贝尔加（旧时比利时货币单位）

e.en: One {belga} was equivalent to five Belgian francs.
e.zh: 一贝尔加相当于五比利时法郎。

e.en: Some pre-war coins were denominated in {belgas}.
e.zh: 一些战前硬币以贝尔加为面值。

belgard.t: 深情的目光；爱怜的注视

e.en: She gave the knight a tender {belgard}.
e.zh: 她向那位骑士投去温柔的目光。

e.en: The poet sang of his lady's sweet {belgard}.
e.zh: 诗人歌颂着爱人甜美的爱怜眼神。

e.en: The tabloid {belibeled} the senator's reputation.
e.zh: 那家小报严重诽谤了那位参议员的名誉。

e.en: He felt {belibeled} by the article's false claims.
e.zh: 他觉得那篇文章的虚假指控对他构成恶意中伤。

e.en: {Belike} he has forgotten our appointment.
e.zh: 他多半是忘了我们的约定。

e.en: It will rain, {belike}, before evening.
e.zh: 大概天黑前就会下雨。

belite.t: 贝利特；硅酸二钙（水泥成分）

e.en: {Belite} contributes to the long-term strength of cement.
e.zh: 贝利特有助于提升水泥的长期强度。

e.en: This cement contains more {belite} than alite.
e.zh: 这种水泥中贝利特比阿利特含量更高。

e.en: She resented his constant {belittlement} of her ideas.
e.zh: 她厌恶他对她想法的不断贬低。

e.en: {Belittlement} can seriously undermine a child's confidence.
e.zh: 轻视会严重损害孩子的自信。

e.en: The messenger shall arrive {belive}.
e.zh: 信使很快就会到达。

e.en: He vowed to return {belive} from the journey.
e.zh: 他发誓不久就会从旅途归来。

e.en: She wore {bell-bottom} jeans to the concert.
e.zh: 她穿着喇叭裤去看演唱会。

e.en: {Bell-bottom} pants were popular in the 1970s.
e.zh: 喇叭裤在七十年代很流行。

bell-bottomed.t: 裤脚呈喇叭形的；下摆外张的

e.en: He sported {bell-bottomed} trousers and platform shoes.
e.zh: 他穿着喇叭裤和厚底鞋。

e.en: Sailors traditionally wore {bell-bottomed} pants on duty.
e.zh: 水手值勤时传统上穿喇叭裤。

bell-curve.t: 钟形曲线；正态分布曲线

e.en: Test scores often follow a {bell-curve} distribution.
e.zh: 考试成绩通常呈钟形曲线分布。

e.en: The plotted data formed a smooth {bell-curve}.
e.zh: 绘制出的数据形成了平滑的钟形曲线。

bell-like.t: 似铃声的；如钟声般清脆的

e.en: Her laughter was {bell-like} and pure.
e.zh: 她的笑声如银铃般纯净。

e.en: The bird's {bell-like} call echoed through the woods.
e.zh: 鸟儿如钟声般的鸣叫在林中回荡。

e.en: Slice the {bell-pepper} thinly for the salad.
e.zh: 把甜椒切成薄片做沙拉。

e.en: Red {bell-peppers} are sweeter than green ones.
e.zh: 红甜椒比青甜椒更甜。

e.en: He yanked the {bell-pull} to summon the butler.
e.zh: 他猛拉铃绳召唤管家。

e.en: An embroidered {bell-pull} hung beside the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉旁挂着一根绣花铃绳。

e.en: The {bell-ringer} climbed the tower at dawn.
e.zh: 敲钟人黎明时分登上钟楼。

e.en: She trained for years as a church {bell-ringer}.
e.zh: 她接受多年训练成为教堂敲钟人。

e.en: {Bell-ringing} is a long-standing English tradition.
e.zh: 敲钟是一项历史悠久的英国传统。

e.en: He took up {bell-ringing} as a weekend hobby.
e.zh: 他把敲钟作为周末的爱好。

e.en: A distant {bell-sound} drifted across the lake.
e.zh: 远处的钟声飘过湖面。

e.en: She woke to the gentle {bell-sound} of a chime.
e.zh: 她在轻柔的铃声中醒来。

e.en: The cathedral's {bell-tower} loomed above the city.
e.zh: 大教堂的钟楼高耸于城市之上。

e.en: Tourists climbed the medieval {bell-tower} for the view.
e.zh: 游客们登上中世纪的钟楼欣赏风景。

bell-wether.t: 领头羊；风向标；先兆指标

e.en: This state is a {bell-wether} of national elections.
e.zh: 这个州是全国选举的风向标。

e.en: The company is a {bell-wether} for the tech sector.
e.zh: 这家公司是科技行业的风向标。

e.en: These polls are reliable {bell-wethers} of public mood.
e.zh: 这些民调是公众情绪的可靠风向标。

e.en: Swing voters often act as political {bell-wethers}.
e.zh: 摇摆选民常被视为政治风向标。

belladonnine.t: 颠茄碱；颠茄宁（一种生物碱）

e.en: {Belladonnine} is one of several toxic alkaloids in deadly nightshade.
e.zh: 颠茄碱是颠茄中数种有毒生物碱之一。

e.en: Researchers extracted {belladonnine} for pharmacological studies.
e.zh: 研究人员提取颠茄碱用于药理学研究。

e.en: Sodium {benzoate} is a common food preservative.
e.zh: 苯甲酸钠是一种常见的食品防腐剂。

e.en: The label warned that {benzoate} may trigger allergies.
e.zh: 标签警告苯甲酸盐可能引发过敏。

e.en: The dentist applied {benzocaine} to numb the gum.
e.zh: 牙医涂抹苯佐卡因来麻醉牙龈。

e.en: Throat sprays often contain {benzocaine} for quick relief.
e.zh: 喉咙喷雾常含苯佐卡因以快速缓解疼痛。

e.en: {Benzoic} acid is widely used as a preservative.
e.zh: 苯甲酸被广泛用作防腐剂。

e.en: The compound contains a {benzoic} ring structure.
e.zh: 该化合物含有一个苯甲酸环结构。

e.en: The incense gave off a sweet {benzoin} aroma.
e.zh: 这种香散发出甜美的安息香气味。

e.en: She tinctured the wound with {benzoin} resin.
e.zh: 她用安息香树脂为伤口消毒。

e.en: Old factories often distilled {benzol} from coal tar.
e.zh: 老工厂常从煤焦油中蒸馏出粗苯。

e.en: Workers exposed to {benzol} risked serious illness.
e.zh: 接触苯的工人有患重病的风险。

e.en: Cigarette smoke contains carcinogenic {benzopyrene}.
e.zh: 香烟烟雾中含有致癌的苯并芘。

e.en: Grilled meat may release small amounts of {benzopyrene}.
e.zh: 烧烤肉类可能释放少量苯并芘。

benthamism.t: 边沁主义；功利主义哲学

e.en: He criticized {benthamism} for ignoring human dignity.
e.zh: 他批评边沁主义忽视了人的尊严。

e.en: Victorian reformers were heavily influenced by {benthamism}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的改革者深受边沁主义的影响。

e.en: They studied the {benthonic} organisms in the lake bed.
e.zh: 他们研究了湖底的底栖生物。

e.en: {Benthonic} sediments hold clues to ancient climates.
e.zh: 底栖沉积物蕴藏着古代气候的线索。

benthoscope.t: 深海观测器；海底观察舱

e.en: The {benthoscope} let researchers view the seafloor directly.
e.zh: 这台深海观测器让研究人员直接观察海底。

e.en: Early {benthoscope} dives revealed strange new creatures.
e.zh: 早期的深海观测舱下潜揭示了奇异的新物种。

e.en: Drillers pump {bentonite} slurry to stabilize the borehole.
e.zh: 钻井工人注入膨润土泥浆以稳固井壁。

e.en: {Bentonite} clay is often used in face masks.
e.zh: 膨润土黏土常被用于面膜中。

bentonitic.t: 含膨润土的；膨润土质的

e.en: The well passed through a thick {bentonitic} layer.
e.zh: 井孔穿过了一层厚厚的膨润土层。

e.en: {Bentonitic} soils swell dramatically when wet.
e.zh: 膨润土质土壤遇水后会显著膨胀。

e.en: The reaction yields a {benzal} derivative as the main product.
e.zh: 该反应主要生成一种亚苄基衍生物。

e.en: Chemists analyzed the {benzal} group's reactivity.
e.zh: 化学家分析了亚苄基的反应活性。

benzalacetone.t: 亚苄基丙酮；苯亚甲基丙酮

e.en: They synthesized {benzalacetone} via an aldol condensation.
e.zh: 他们通过羟醛缩合反应合成了亚苄基丙酮。

e.en: {Benzalacetone} crystallizes as pale yellow needles.
e.zh: 亚苄基丙酮结晶为淡黄色针状物。

e.en: {Benzalaniline} forms readily from benzaldehyde and aniline.
e.zh: 苄叉苯胺易由苯甲醛和苯胺反应生成。

e.en: The students prepared {benzalaniline} in the lab.
e.zh: 学生们在实验室里制备了苄叉苯胺。

e.en: The mixture turned yellow as {benzalazine} precipitated.
e.zh: 随着苯甲醛连氮沉淀析出，混合物变黄。

e.en: {Benzalazine} can be reduced to give hydrazo compounds.
e.zh: 苯甲醛连氮可被还原成偶氮基化合物。

e.en: {Benzaldehyde} smells strongly of bitter almonds.
e.zh: 苯甲醛带有浓烈的苦杏仁气味。

e.en: The flavoring contains a trace of {benzaldehyde}.
e.zh: 这种香精中含有微量的苯甲醛。

e.en: The wipes contain {benzalkonium} chloride as a disinfectant.
e.zh: 这种湿巾含有苯扎氯铵作为消毒剂。

e.en: Many eye drops use {benzalkonium} as a preservative.
e.zh: 许多眼药水以苯扎氯铵作为防腐剂。

e.en: {Benzamidine} is a classic inhibitor of trypsin.
e.zh: 苯甲脒是胰蛋白酶的经典抑制剂。

e.en: They added {benzamidine} to block protease activity.
e.zh: 他们加入苯甲脒以抑制蛋白酶活性。

e.en: {Benzanilide} forms when benzoic acid reacts with aniline.
e.zh: 苯甲酸与苯胺反应即可生成苯甲酰苯胺。

e.en: The crystals of {benzanilide} melt around 163°C.
e.zh: 苯甲酰苯胺晶体的熔点约为163℃。

e.en: {Benzanthracene} is a known polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon.
e.zh: 苯并蒽是一种已知的多环芳烃。

e.en: Coal tar contains measurable amounts of {benzanthracene}.
e.zh: 煤焦油中含有可测量的苯并蒽。

e.en: The patient received {benzathine} penicillin by injection.
e.zh: 病人通过注射接受了苄星青霉素治疗。

e.en: {Benzathine} salts release the drug slowly over weeks.
e.zh: 苄星盐能在数周内缓慢释放药物。

e.en: Many drugs contain a {benzazole} ring system.
e.zh: 许多药物都含有苯并唑环系。

e.en: They synthesized a new {benzazole} derivative.
e.zh: 他们合成了一种新的苯并唑衍生物。

benzedrine.t: 苯齐巨林；安非他命兴奋剂

e.en: In the 1940s, soldiers were sometimes given {benzedrine}.
e.zh: 在二十世纪四十年代，士兵有时会被给予苯齐巨林。

e.en: He kept awake all night using {benzedrine}.
e.zh: 他靠苯齐巨林整夜没睡。

e.en: The climbers carefully crossed the {bergschrund} at dawn.
e.zh: 登山者在黎明时分小心翼翼地越过冰川裂隙。

e.en: A wide {bergschrund} blocked the route to the summit.
e.zh: 一条宽阔的冰川裂隙挡住了通往山顶的路线。

e.en: The ship navigated through {bergy} waters near the coast.
e.zh: 船只在沿海带冰块的水域中航行。

e.en: A {bergy} bit floated past the research vessel.
e.zh: 一块小冰山碎块从科考船旁漂过。

e.en: Poets often {berhyme} the beauty of nature.
e.zh: 诗人常以韵文歌咏自然之美。

e.en: He sought to {berhyme} her virtues in verse.
e.zh: 他想用诗赞颂她的美德。

e.en: The hero was much {berhymed} in old ballads.
e.zh: 这位英雄在古老的民谣中被反复歌咏。

e.en: Her beauty was {berhymed} by every court poet.
e.zh: 宫廷诗人无不以诗赞颂她的美貌。

e.en: The bard spent years {berhyming} the king's deeds.
e.zh: 那位吟游诗人花了数年用韵文赞颂国王的功绩。

e.en: She enjoyed {berhyming} ordinary moments in her diary.
e.zh: 她喜欢在日记里用诗句歌咏平凡的瞬间。

e.en: He played a steady rhythm on the {berimbau}.
e.zh: 他用贝林宝奏出稳定的节奏。

e.en: The capoeira circle opened with the {berimbau}.
e.zh: 卡波耶拉圈以贝林宝的乐声开场。

e.en: Scientists synthesized tiny amounts of {berkelium} in the lab.
e.zh: 科学家在实验室合成了少量的锫。

e.en: {Berkelium} was first produced at Berkeley in 1949.
e.zh: 锫于1949年首次在伯克利被制造出来。

e.en: The fishermen scattered {berley} to attract the tuna.
e.zh: 渔民撒下诱饵以吸引金枪鱼。

e.en: He prepared a bucket of {berley} before launching the boat.
e.zh: 他在下船前准备了一桶饵料。

bellwort.t: 百合科黄花植物，钟形花

e.en: We spotted yellow {bellwort} blooming along the forest trail.
e.zh: 我们在林间小径旁看到黄色的钟形花盛开。

e.en: The botanist sketched a delicate {bellwort} in her field notebook.
e.zh: 植物学家在野外笔记中描绘了一株精致的钟形花。

e.en: The baby giggled when I tickled her {belly-button}.
e.zh: 我挠宝宝肚脐时，她咯咯地笑。

e.en: He has a small piercing in his {belly-button}.
e.zh: 他的肚脐上有一个小小的穿环。

e.en: A {belly-dancer} performed at the Turkish restaurant last night.
e.zh: 昨晚一位肚皮舞舞者在那家土耳其餐厅表演。

e.en: She trained for years to become a professional {belly-dancer}.
e.zh: 她经过多年训练，成为了一名专业的肚皮舞舞者。

belly-flop.t: 肚子先着水的跳水；惨败

e.en: He did an enormous {belly-flop} into the pool.
e.zh: 他肚子先着水，扑通一声跳进了泳池。

e.en: The new product was a complete {belly-flop} in the market.
e.zh: 这款新产品在市场上彻底失败了。

belly-flopped.t: 肚子先着水地跳入；惨败

e.en: He {belly-flopped} into the pool and made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 他肚子先着水跳进泳池，逗得大家哈哈大笑。

e.en: Their startup {belly-flopped} within six months.
e.zh: 他们的创业公司在六个月内就惨败了。

e.en: The kids spent the afternoon {belly-flopping} into the lake.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在湖里玩肚子着水的跳水。

e.en: Stop {belly-flopping}—you're going to hurt yourself.
e.zh: 别再那样跳水了，你会伤到自己的。

belly-flops.t: 肚子先着水的跳水（复数）

e.en: His diving routine ended in a series of painful {belly-flops}.
e.zh: 他的跳水表演以一连串疼痛的肚子着水告终。

e.en: The studio's last three films were all {belly-flops}.
e.zh: 这家电影公司最近的三部片子都惨败了。

e.en: The pilot had to {belly-land} the aircraft in a field.
e.zh: 飞行员不得不让飞机在田野里机腹着陆。

e.en: They were forced to {belly-land} after the gear failed.
e.zh: 起落架失灵后，他们被迫机腹着陆。

e.en: His joke got a real {belly-laugh} from the crowd.
e.zh: 他的笑话引得观众捧腹大笑。

e.en: I hadn't had a good {belly-laugh} like that in years.
e.zh: 我已经好多年没这么开怀大笑过了。

e.en: The company finally went {belly-up} last spring.
e.zh: 那家公司终于在去年春天倒闭了。

e.en: Several fish were floating {belly-up} in the tank.
e.zh: 水箱里有几条鱼翻着肚皮浮在水面上。

e.en: The groom tightened the {bellyband} on the saddle.
e.zh: 马夫拉紧了马鞍上的腹带。

e.en: The book came wrapped in a paper {bellyband} with the author's quote.
e.zh: 那本书外面裹着一条印有作者引言的纸腰封。

e.en: She takes a weekly {bellydance} class downtown.
e.zh: 她每周在市中心上一节肚皮舞课。

e.en: The festival featured live music and {bellydance} performances.
e.zh: 节庆活动有现场音乐和肚皮舞表演。

bellyflop.t: 肚子先着水的跳水；惨败

e.en: His attempted dive turned into a loud {bellyflop}.
e.zh: 他想跳水，结果变成了响亮的肚子着水。

e.en: The film was a critical {bellyflop} on opening weekend.
e.zh: 这部电影在首映周末口碑惨败。

e.en: The comedian's punchline drew a huge {bellylaugh}.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员的妙语引来一阵开怀大笑。

e.en: Nothing beats a good {bellylaugh} with old friends.
e.zh: 没什么比和老朋友捧腹大笑更棒的了。

e.en: Her {belonephobia} makes routine blood tests terrifying.
e.zh: 她的恐针症让常规抽血变得非常可怕。

e.en: Therapists treat {belonephobia} with gradual exposure techniques.
e.zh: 治疗师用渐进暴露疗法治疗恐针症。

belorussian.t: 白俄罗斯的；白俄罗斯人

e.en: She speaks fluent {Belorussian} and Russian.
e.zh: 她能流利地说白俄罗斯语和俄语。

e.en: The museum displayed traditional {Belorussian} embroidery.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了传统的白俄罗斯刺绣。

e.en: The old poet wrote that he would {belove} her always.
e.zh: 那位老诗人写道他会永远珍爱她。

e.en: Whom the gods {belove} dies young, the saying goes.
e.zh: 俗话说，神所钟爱的人英年早逝。

below-average.t: 低于平均水平的；不及格的

e.en: His test scores have been {below-average} this semester.
e.zh: 他这学期的考试成绩一直低于平均水平。

e.en: Rainfall this year was {below-average} for the region.
e.zh: 今年该地区的降雨量低于往年平均水平。

e.en: The crew slept {below-deck} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间船员们在甲板下睡觉。

e.en: Cargo was stowed {below-deck} for the voyage.
e.zh: 货物存放在甲板下以便航行。

e.en: Passengers gathered {below-decks} when the rain started.
e.zh: 下雨时乘客们聚集到甲板下面。

e.en: The engine room is located {below-decks}.
e.zh: 机舱位于甲板下方。

e.en: The garage is built {below-grade} to save space.
e.zh: 车库建在地面以下以节省空间。

e.en: They installed waterproofing on all {below-grade} walls.
e.zh: 他们在所有地下墙体上做了防水处理。

e.en: The cables run {below-ground} for safety reasons.
e.zh: 出于安全考虑，电缆铺设在地下。

e.en: Most of the plant's mass is actually {below-ground}.
e.zh: 这种植物大部分的质量其实都在地下。

below-par.t: 低于标准的；身体不适的

e.en: Her performance has been {below-par} all week.
e.zh: 她整周的表现都低于水准。

e.en: I've been feeling a bit {below-par} since the flu.
e.zh: 自从得了流感后，我一直感觉不太舒服。

below-stairs.t: 仆人区的；楼下仆役间的

e.en: The novel depicts {below-stairs} life in a Victorian mansion.
e.zh: 小说描绘了维多利亚式宅邸里仆人区的生活。

e.en: Gossip spread quickly through the {below-stairs} staff.
e.zh: 流言在楼下的仆人之间迅速传开。

benefactive.t: 受益格；语法中表示受益对象的格

e.en: Some languages mark the {benefactive} case to show who benefits.
e.zh: 有些语言用受益格来标示动作的受益者。

e.en: She wrote a paper on {benefactive} constructions in Japanese.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于日语受益格结构的论文。

benefactrix.t: 女施主；女恩人；女赞助者

e.en: The museum honored its longtime {benefactrix} with a plaque.
e.zh: 博物馆为长期捐助的女恩人立了一块铭牌。

e.en: After her husband died she became the orphanage's {benefactrix}.
e.zh: 丈夫去世后，她成了那家孤儿院的女施主。

benefic.t: 有益的；占星中的吉星；吉祥的

e.en: Astrologers consider Jupiter a {benefic} planet.
e.zh: 占星家认为木星是一颗吉星。

e.en: The herbs were thought to have a {benefic} influence on the body.
e.zh: 人们认为这些草药对身体有益。

beneficiate.t: 对矿石进行选矿处理；提纯

e.en: The plant {beneficiates} low-grade iron ore before smelting.
e.zh: 工厂在冶炼前先对低品位铁矿进行选矿处理。

e.en: New technology lets us {beneficiate} this mineral economically.
e.zh: 新技术让我们能够经济地选别这种矿石。

beneficiation.t: 选矿；矿石选别加工过程

e.en: Coal {beneficiation} removes ash and sulfur from the raw ore.
e.zh: 煤炭选矿过程会去除原矿中的灰分和硫。

e.en: The mine invested in a new {beneficiation} plant.
e.zh: 那座矿山投资修建了一座新选矿厂。

e.en: The knight was {benempt} Sir Roland in the old tale.
e.zh: 在那个古老传说里，那位骑士被命名为罗兰爵士。

e.en: In ancient lore the dragon was {benempt} guardian of the cave.
e.zh: 在远古传说中，那条龙被称作洞穴的守护者。

e.en: The poachers tried to {benet} the rare birds at dawn.
e.zh: 偷猎者试图在黎明用网捕捉那些珍稀鸟类。

e.en: Old hunters knew how to {benet} hares in the tall grass.
e.zh: 老猎人懂得在深草丛中用网捕兔。

e.en: Hamlet felt {benetted} round with villainies.
e.zh: 哈姆雷特感到自己被种种恶行重重困住。

e.en: The deer was {benetted} in the clearing before dawn.
e.zh: 黎明前那头鹿在空地上被网住了。

bengaline.t: 棱纹绸；罗缎；一种丝棉混纺布料

e.en: She wore a dress of black {bengaline} silk.
e.zh: 她穿着一条黑色棱纹丝绸连衣裙。

e.en: The shop sold {bengaline} ribbons in many colors.
e.zh: 那家店出售各种颜色的棱纹丝带。

benighting.t: 使陷入黑暗；使蒙昧；使无知

e.en: A {benighting} fog rolled in across the moors.
e.zh: 一阵昏暗的浓雾笼罩了荒野。

e.en: He blamed his {benighting} upbringing for his prejudices.
e.zh: 他把自己的偏见归咎于使人蒙昧的成长环境。

benightment.t: 黑暗状态；蒙昧无知的处境

e.en: Travelers feared {benightment} in the dense forest.
e.zh: 旅人害怕在密林中陷入暗夜。

e.en: The author lamented the moral {benightment} of his age.
e.zh: 作者哀叹他那个时代道德上的蒙昧。

e.en: Her {benignancy} toward strangers was well known.
e.zh: 她对陌生人的仁慈广为人知。

e.en: The old doctor treated his patients with quiet {benignancy}.
e.zh: 那位老医生以平和的善意对待病人。

e.en: The {benignant} old gentleman patted the child's head.
e.zh: 那位慈祥的老先生拍了拍孩子的头。

e.en: She gave him a {benignant} smile from across the room.
e.zh: 她从房间另一头向他露出和蔼的微笑。

e.en: The teacher smiled {benignantly} at the nervous student.
e.zh: 老师慈祥地朝那个紧张的学生微笑。

e.en: He nodded {benignantly} as the children sang.
e.zh: 孩子们唱歌时，他和蔼地点头致意。

e.en: We were touched by the {benignity} of our hosts.
e.zh: 主人的善意让我们深受感动。

e.en: His face wore an expression of perfect {benignity}.
e.zh: 他脸上挂着一副十足慈祥的神情。

beninese.t: 贝宁的；贝宁人；贝宁人的

e.en: The {Beninese} delegation arrived at the conference.
e.zh: 贝宁代表团抵达了会场。

e.en: She studies traditional {Beninese} music and dance.
e.zh: 她研究贝宁传统音乐和舞蹈。

benitoite.t: 蓝锥矿；一种稀有的蓝色宝石

e.en: Collectors prize {benitoite} for its rare blue color.
e.zh: 收藏家因蓝锥矿罕见的蓝色而珍视它。

e.en: A mine in California produces gem-quality {benitoite}.
e.zh: 加州的一座矿山出产宝石级的蓝锥矿。

e.en: The shrub produces small {berrylike} fruits in autumn.
e.zh: 这种灌木在秋天结出像浆果一样的小果实。

e.en: She admired the {berrylike} clusters on the branches.
e.zh: 她欣赏着枝头那一簇簇浆果状的果实。

berseem.t: 埃及三叶草；一种饲料苜蓿

e.en: Farmers grow {berseem} as winter fodder for cattle.
e.zh: 农民们种植埃及三叶草作为牛的冬季饲料。

e.en: {Berseem} thrives in irrigated soils along the Nile.
e.zh: 埃及三叶草在尼罗河沿岸的灌溉土壤中长势良好。

e.en: The harbor charges a daily {berthage} for visiting yachts.
e.zh: 港口对到访的游艇收取每日泊位费。

e.en: {Berthage} fees vary depending on vessel size.
e.zh: 停泊费根据船只大小而有所不同。

e.en: The geologist identified {berthierine} in the iron ore samples.
e.zh: 地质学家在铁矿石样品中鉴定出了铁绿泥石。

e.en: {Berthierine} often forms in low-temperature sedimentary environments.
e.zh: 铁绿泥石常在低温沉积环境中形成。

e.en: {Berthierite} is a sulfide mineral containing iron and antimony.
e.zh: 硫锑铁矿是一种含铁和锑的硫化物矿物。

e.en: Miners occasionally encounter {berthierite} in antimony deposits.
e.zh: 矿工偶尔会在锑矿床中遇到硫锑铁矿。

bertholide.t: 非整比化合物；贝多来体

e.en: A {bertholide} compound has variable, non-stoichiometric composition.
e.zh: 非整比化合物的成分是可变的、非化学计量的。

e.en: Many transition-metal oxides behave as {bertholides}.
e.zh: 许多过渡金属氧化物表现为非整比化合物。

berthollide.t: 非整比化合物；贝多来体

e.en: Iron oxides are classic examples of {berthollide} compounds.
e.zh: 氧化铁是非整比化合物的经典例子。

e.en: A {berthollide} does not obey the law of definite proportions.
e.zh: 非整比化合物不遵循定比定律。

e.en: Engineers study {beryllide} alloys for high-temperature applications.
e.zh: 工程师们研究铍化物合金以用于高温应用。

e.en: A {beryllide} forms when beryllium combines with another metal.
e.zh: 铍与另一种金属结合时形成铍化物。

e.en: The lake had a clear, {berylline} hue in the morning light.
e.zh: 湖水在晨光中呈现出清澈的绿宝石色。

e.en: She wore a gown of {berylline} silk to the ball.
e.zh: 她穿着一件绿宝石色的丝绸礼服去参加舞会。

bequeathable.t: 可遗赠的；可作为遗产传给后人的

e.en: These rights are not {bequeathable} under current law.
e.zh: 根据现行法律，这些权利不可遗赠。

e.en: He listed every {bequeathable} item in his will.
e.zh: 他在遗嘱里列出了每一件可遗赠的物品。

e.en: The {bequeathal} of his estate triggered a family feud.
e.zh: 他遗产的转让引发了一场家族纷争。

e.en: She announced the {bequeathal} of her paintings to the museum.
e.zh: 她宣布把自己的画作遗赠给博物馆。

e.en: The lawyer argued that the {bequeathalment} was legally invalid.
e.zh: 律师辩称这项遗赠在法律上无效。

e.en: They contested the {bequeathalment} of the family home.
e.zh: 他们对祖宅的遗赠提出了异议。

e.en: The columnist would {berascal} every politician in sight.
e.zh: 那位专栏作家见到哪个政客都要把他骂成无赖。

e.en: Don't {berascal} him before you've heard the full story.
e.zh: 没听完整件事之前别把他骂作混蛋。

e.en: She played a soft {berceuse} on the piano.
e.zh: 她在钢琴上弹奏了一首轻柔的摇篮曲。

e.en: Chopin wrote a famous {berceuse} in D-flat major.
e.zh: 肖邦谱写过一首著名的降D大调摇篮曲。

berdache.t: (北美原住民文化中的)双灵人；跨性别角色者

e.en: Anthropologists once used {berdache} to describe two-spirit people.
e.zh: 人类学家曾用 berdache 一词来指代双灵人。

e.en: The term {berdache} is now considered outdated and offensive.
e.zh: berdache 这个词如今被视为过时且具冒犯性。

berdaches.t: 双灵人(复数)；跨性别角色者们

e.en: Several {berdaches} held respected roles within their tribes.
e.zh: 部落里有数位双灵人担任受人尊敬的角色。

e.en: Older texts often misrepresented {berdaches} entirely.
e.zh: 早期文献常常完全曲解了双灵人这一群体。

e.en: Debussy's {bergamasque} suite remains a recital favorite.
e.zh: 德彪西的《贝加莫组曲》至今仍是独奏会的热门曲目。

e.en: The dancers performed an old {bergamasque} at the festival.
e.zh: 舞者在节日上表演了一支古老的贝加莫舞曲。

e.en: Glitter {bespangles} her evening gown.
e.zh: 亮片点缀着她的晚礼服。

e.en: Dew {bespangles} the morning grass.
e.zh: 露珠点缀着清晨的草地。

e.en: Stars were {bespangling} the night sky.
e.zh: 繁星点缀着夜空。

e.en: She spent hours {bespangling} the costume.
e.zh: 她花了几个小时给戏服缀上亮片。

e.en: Trucks {bespatter} pedestrians with mud.
e.zh: 卡车把泥水溅到行人身上。

e.en: Rumors can {bespatter} a person's reputation.
e.zh: 流言会玷污一个人的名誉。

e.en: His boots were {bespattered} with mud.
e.zh: 他的靴子溅满了泥。

e.en: The wall was {bespattered} with paint.
e.zh: 墙上溅满了油漆。

e.en: Rain was {bespattering} the windows.
e.zh: 雨水溅打着窗户。

e.en: He kept {bespattering} her dress with wine.
e.zh: 他不断把酒溅到她的裙子上。

e.en: The fountain {bespatters} nearby benches.
e.zh: 喷泉溅湿了旁边的长椅。

e.en: Gossip {bespatters} every name it touches.
e.zh: 流言玷污每一个被提及的名字。

e.en: Freckles {bespeckle} her nose.
e.zh: 雀斑布满她的鼻子。

e.en: Wildflowers {bespeckle} the meadow.
e.zh: 野花点缀着草地。

e.en: The egg was {bespeckled} with brown.
e.zh: 鸡蛋上布满褐色斑点。

e.en: His shirt was {bespeckled} with ink.
e.zh: 他的衬衫沾满墨点。

e.en: Sunlight was {bespeckling} the forest floor.
e.zh: 阳光在林地上洒下斑驳光点。

e.en: Rain was {bespeckling} the dusty windshield.
e.zh: 雨点在落满灰尘的挡风玻璃上溅起斑点。

e.en: The witch tried to {bespell} the prince.
e.zh: 女巫想给王子施魔法。

e.en: Her voice seemed to {bespell} the audience.
e.zh: 她的嗓音仿佛蛊惑了观众。

e.en: He stared as if {bespelled}.
e.zh: 他像中了魔咒般凝视着。

e.en: The {bespelled} mirror showed only lies.
e.zh: 那面被施魔法的镜子只显示谎言。

e.en: Cooks {bespice} the stew with cloves.
e.zh: 厨师用丁香给炖菜调味。

e.en: They {bespice} the wine before serving.
e.zh: 他们在上酒前先加入香料。

e.en: The coach tried to {bespirit} his team.
e.zh: 教练努力鼓舞他的队员。

e.en: Her speech {bespirit} the volunteers.
e.zh: 她的演讲激励了志愿者们。

e.en: Waves {besplash} the rocky shore.
e.zh: 海浪拍打着多石的海岸。

e.en: Children love to {besplash} each other.
e.zh: 孩子们爱互相泼水。

e.en: His coat was {besplashed} with mud.
e.zh: 他的外套被泥水溅湿了。

e.en: The deck was {besplashed} with seawater.
e.zh: 甲板被海水溅湿了。

e.en: Her apron was {bespotted} with grease.
e.zh: 她的围裙沾满油渍。

e.en: The {bespotted} pony pleased the children.
e.zh: 那只布满斑点的小马很讨孩子们喜欢。

e.en: Rain was {bespotting} the freshly washed car.
e.zh: 雨点把刚洗的车溅得满是水痕。

e.en: Ink kept {bespotting} the manuscript.
e.zh: 墨水不断地在手稿上留下污点。

e.en: Snow {bespread} the rooftops.
e.zh: 白雪覆盖着屋顶。

e.en: Linen {bespread} the long banquet table.
e.zh: 亚麻布铺满了长长的宴桌。

e.en: Mist was {bespreading} the valley.
e.zh: 薄雾正笼罩着山谷。

e.en: Vines were {bespreading} the old wall.
e.zh: 藤蔓蔓延覆盖着旧墙。

e.en: Frost {bespreads} the lawn each morning.
e.zh: 每天早晨霜覆盖着草坪。

e.en: Moss {bespreads} the shaded stones.
e.zh: 青苔覆盖着背阴的石头。

e.en: The path was {besprent} with petals.
e.zh: 小径上洒满花瓣。

e.en: Her cheeks were {besprent} with tears.
e.zh: 她的脸颊上洒满了泪水。

e.en: Chefs {besprinkle} the dish with herbs.
e.zh: 厨师在菜上撒上香草。

e.en: Priests {besprinkle} water on worshippers.
e.zh: 神职人员把水洒在信众身上。

e.en: The cake was {besprinkled} with sugar.
e.zh: 蛋糕上撒满了糖粉。

e.en: The sky was {besprinkled} with stars.
e.zh: 天空缀满了星星。

e.en: He acted as the {besprinkler} at the ceremony.
e.zh: 他在仪式上担任洒水者。

e.en: The garden's {besprinkler} ran every dawn.
e.zh: 花园的洒水器每天清晨都会启动。

e.en: She {besprinkles} salt over the fries.
e.zh: 她在薯条上撒盐。

e.en: The fountain {besprinkles} passersby.
e.zh: 喷泉把水溅到行人身上。

e.en: He was {besprinkling} flour over the dough.
e.zh: 他正把面粉撒在面团上。

e.en: Rain was {besprinkling} the parched fields.
e.zh: 小雨正洒在干涸的田地上。

e.en: Engineers learned to {bessemerize} pig iron.
e.zh: 工程师们学会用贝塞麦法处理生铁。

e.en: They {bessemerize} the metal to remove impurities.
e.zh: 他们用贝塞麦法炼制金属以去除杂质。

e.en: The mill was {bessemerizing} tons of iron.
e.zh: 工厂正用贝塞麦法炼制大量生铁。

e.en: {Bessemerizing} revolutionized steel production.
e.zh: 贝塞麦炼钢法彻底改变了钢铁生产。

e.en: He won the {best-actor} award last night.
e.zh: 他昨晚赢得了最佳男演员奖。

e.en: Critics predicted a {best-actor} nomination.
e.zh: 评论家预测他会获最佳男演员提名。

e.en: She received the {best-actress} trophy.
e.zh: 她拿到了最佳女演员奖杯。

e.en: Her performance earned a {best-actress} nod.
e.zh: 她的表演赢得最佳女演员提名。

e.en: We chose the {best-available} option.
e.zh: 我们选择了现有最好的方案。

e.en: The hospital used the {best-available} treatment.
e.zh: 医院采用了现有最好的疗法。

best-ball.t: 高尔夫四人赛择优计分赛制

e.en: They played a {best-ball} round on Saturday.
e.zh: 他们星期六打了一场择优计分赛。

e.en: Our team won the {best-ball} tournament.
e.zh: 我们队赢了那场择优计分锦标赛。

best-bet.t: 最佳选择；最稳妥的办法

e.en: Taking the train is your {best-bet}.
e.zh: 坐火车是你最稳妥的办法。

e.en: Saving early is the {best-bet} for retirement.
e.zh: 尽早储蓄是退休理财的最佳选择。

e.en: In the {best-case} scenario, we finish today.
e.zh: 在最理想的情况下，我们今天就能完成。

e.en: Their plan only works in a {best-case} outcome.
e.zh: 他们的计划只在最理想的结果下才行得通。

e.en: They offered {best-effort} delivery, not a guarantee.
e.zh: 他们提供尽力而为的送达，并不保证。

e.en: The network provides {best-effort} service.
e.zh: 该网络提供尽力而为的服务。

e.en: The drama won {best-film} at Cannes.
e.zh: 这部剧情片在戛纳获得最佳影片奖。

e.en: Critics tipped it for {best-film} honors.
e.zh: 评论家看好它角逐最佳影片荣誉。

e.en: She picked the {best-fitting} jeans.
e.zh: 她挑了最合身的牛仔裤。

e.en: We chose the {best-fitting} model for the data.
e.zh: 我们选择了最契合数据的模型。

e.en: She is my {best-friend} since childhood.
e.zh: 她是我从小到大的最好的朋友。

e.en: My dog is my {best-friend}.
e.zh: 我的狗是我最好的朋友。

e.en: My {best-guess} is around fifty people.
e.zh: 我估计大概有五十人左右。

e.en: The forecast is just a {best-guess}.
e.zh: 这份预测只是最有根据的猜测。

e.en: This phone offers {best-in-class} battery life.
e.zh: 这款手机的电池续航在同类中最佳。

e.en: They aim for {best-in-class} customer service.
e.zh: 他们致力于提供同类最佳的客户服务。

e.en: The poodle took {best-in-show}.
e.zh: 那只贵宾犬赢得了全场总冠军。

e.en: Her painting was named {best-in-show}.
e.zh: 她的画作被评为全场总冠军。

e.en: He is {best-known} for his comedies.
e.zh: 他以喜剧最为人熟知。

e.en: This is her {best-known} novel.
e.zh: 这是她最著名的一部小说。

e.en: Even the {best-laid} plans can fail.
e.zh: 即便是精心安排的计划也可能失败。

e.en: Their {best-laid} schemes fell apart in minutes.
e.zh: 他们精心策划的方案几分钟内就崩溃了。

best-liked.t: 最受欢迎的；最被喜爱的

e.en: She is the {best-liked} teacher in our school.
e.zh: 她是我们学校最受欢迎的老师。

e.en: That song became the {best-liked} track on the album.
e.zh: 那首歌成了专辑里最受喜爱的曲目。

e.en: The finals are a {best-of-seven} series.
e.zh: 总决赛采用七战四胜制。

e.en: They won the {best-of-seven} championship in six games.
e.zh: 他们以六场比赛赢得了七战四胜制的冠军。

e.en: We played a {best-of-three} match.
e.zh: 我们打了一场三局两胜的比赛。

e.en: The semifinal is a {best-of-three} format.
e.zh: 半决赛采用三局两胜制。

e.en: The {best-off} families can afford private tutors.
e.zh: 最富裕的家庭请得起私人家教。

e.en: Even the {best-off} pensioners worry about inflation.
e.zh: 就连境况最好的退休人员也担心通货膨胀。

e.en: The hospital follows {best-practice} guidelines.
e.zh: 这家医院遵循最佳实践指南。

e.en: This manual documents industry {best-practice}.
e.zh: 这本手册记录了行业最佳实践。

e.en: Her novel became an instant {best-seller}.
e.zh: 她的小说瞬间成了畅销书。

e.en: This phone is our biggest {best-seller}.
e.zh: 这款手机是我们最畅销的产品。

e.en: He is a {best-selling} author worldwide.
e.zh: 他是一位全球最畅销的作家。

e.en: It was the {best-selling} album of the year.
e.zh: 那是当年最畅销的专辑。

e.en: They camped under a {bestarred} sky.
e.zh: 他们在缀满星星的夜空下露营。

e.en: The poet described a {bestarred} heaven above the sea.
e.zh: 诗人描绘了海上那片缀满繁星的天空。

e.en: Your advice will {bestead} me greatly.
e.zh: 你的建议对我大有帮助。

e.en: Courage may {bestead} a soldier in danger.
e.zh: 勇气在危难时可能会帮助士兵。

e.en: His training {besteaded} him in the crisis.
e.zh: 他所受的训练在危机中帮了他。

e.en: Her wisdom {besteaded} the young king.
e.zh: 她的智慧帮助了年轻的国王。

e.en: You are my {bestest} friend ever.
e.zh: 你是我最最好的朋友。

e.en: That was the {bestest} cake I've ever tasted.
e.zh: 那是我吃过最最好吃的蛋糕。

e.en: War can {bestialise} even gentle men.
e.zh: 战争甚至能让温和的人兽性化。

e.en: The novel shows how poverty {bestialises} people.
e.zh: 这部小说展示了贫困如何使人变得野蛮。

e.en: Prolonged cruelty can {bestialize} the soul.
e.zh: 长期的残忍会使灵魂兽性化。

e.en: The propaganda sought to {bestialize} the enemy.
e.zh: 那种宣传企图把敌人妖魔化为野兽。

bestialized.t: 被兽性化的；变得野蛮的

e.en: The prisoners were {bestialized} by years of abuse.
e.zh: 囚犯们因多年虐待而变得野蛮。

e.en: Critics said the cartoon {bestialized} immigrants.
e.zh: 批评者说那幅漫画把移民兽化了。

bestializes.t: 使兽性化；使堕落（第三人称单数）

e.en: Hatred slowly {bestializes} the human heart.
e.zh: 仇恨慢慢使人心兽性化。

e.en: The regime {bestializes} dissenters in its propaganda.
e.zh: 该政权在宣传中把异见者妖魔化。

bestializing.t: 使兽性化；使堕落（进行时）

e.en: He warned against {bestializing} political opponents.
e.zh: 他警告不要把政敌妖魔化为野兽。

e.en: Constant violence is {bestializing} the population.
e.zh: 持续的暴力正在使民众变得野蛮。

e.en: She is my {bestie} since kindergarten.
e.zh: 她是我从幼儿园起的闺蜜。

e.en: I told my {bestie} everything about the date.
e.zh: 我把约会的所有事都告诉了我最好的朋友。

e.en: Be still, and {bestill} my anxious heart.
e.zh: 安静下来，让我焦虑的心平静吧。

e.en: The music seemed to {bestill} the storm inside her.
e.zh: 音乐似乎让她内心的风暴平息了下来。

e.en: His brother was the {bestman} at the wedding.
e.zh: 他哥哥是婚礼上的伴郎。

e.en: The {bestman} gave a hilarious speech.
e.zh: 伴郎做了一段非常搞笑的致辞。

e.en: The cowboy moved to {bestraddle} the wooden fence.
e.zh: 那个牛仔跨坐到木栅栏上。

e.en: A small bridge seemed to {bestraddle} the stream.
e.zh: 一座小桥似乎横跨在小溪之上。

e.en: Petals {bestrew} the path to the altar.
e.zh: 花瓣撒满了通往圣坛的小路。

e.en: They like to {bestrew} the table with rose petals.
e.zh: 他们喜欢在桌上撒满玫瑰花瓣。

e.en: Children {bestrewed} the lawn with confetti.
e.zh: 孩子们把彩纸撒满了草坪。

e.en: Autumn leaves {bestrewed} the garden path.
e.zh: 秋叶撒落在花园小径上。

e.en: Guests were {bestrewing} flowers along the aisle.
e.zh: 客人们正沿着走道撒花。

e.en: The wind kept {bestrewing} blossoms across the yard.
e.zh: 风不停地把花瓣吹散在院子里。

e.en: The floor was {bestrewn} with old papers.
e.zh: 地板上散落着旧报纸。

e.en: A path {bestrewn} with rose petals led inside.
e.zh: 一条铺满玫瑰花瓣的小径通向屋内。

bestrews.t: 撒满；散布（第三人称单数）

e.en: Each spring she {bestrews} the grave with lilies.
e.zh: 每年春天她都在坟前撒满百合花。

e.en: The wind {bestrews} blossoms over the courtyard.
e.zh: 风把花瓣撒满了庭院。

e.en: He {bestrid} the horse and rode away.
e.zh: 他跨上马背疾驰而去。

e.en: The hero {bestrid} the narrow bridge alone.
e.zh: 那位英雄独自横跨过那座窄桥。

bestridden.t: 被跨骑；被横跨（过去分词）

e.en: The wild stallion had never been {bestridden} before.
e.zh: 那匹野马以前从未被人骑过。

e.en: That ancient bridge has been {bestridden} by armies.
e.zh: 那座古桥曾被一支支军队跨越。

e.en: Her debut novel rocketed into {bestsellerdom}.
e.zh: 她的处女作迅速跻身畅销书之列。

e.en: Few writers ever reach the heights of {bestsellerdom}.
e.zh: 很少有作家能登上畅销书界的顶峰。

e.en: She wore a belt {bestudded} with silver.
e.zh: 她系着一条镶满银饰的腰带。

e.en: The night sky was {bestudded} with stars.
e.zh: 夜空中点缀着繁星。

e.en: The jeweler was {bestudding} the crown with rubies.
e.zh: 珠宝匠正在王冠上镶嵌红宝石。

e.en: Frost was {bestudding} the lawn with tiny crystals.
e.zh: 霜花把草坪点缀得满是细小的晶粒。

e.en: Doctors prescribed a {beta-agonist} for her asthma.
e.zh: 医生给她开了β受体激动剂来治哮喘。

e.en: This inhaler contains a short-acting {beta-agonist}.
e.zh: 这种吸入器含有一种短效β受体激动剂。

e.en: {Beta-amyloid} plaques accumulate in Alzheimer's disease.
e.zh: β-淀粉样蛋白斑块会在阿尔茨海默病中堆积。

e.en: Researchers measured {beta-amyloid} levels in the brain.
e.zh: 研究者测量了大脑中β-淀粉样蛋白的水平。

e.en: The isotope undergoes {beta-decay} into nitrogen.
e.zh: 该同位素经β衰变转变为氮。

e.en: Students learned how {beta-decay} releases electrons.
e.zh: 学生们学习了β衰变如何释放电子。

e.en: Exercise can boost levels of {beta-endorphin}.
e.zh: 运动可以提升β-内啡肽的水平。

e.en: {Beta-endorphin} acts as a natural painkiller in the body.
e.zh: β-内啡肽在体内起到天然止痛剂的作用。

e.en: Running releases {beta-endorphins} into the bloodstream.
e.zh: 跑步会让β-内啡肽释放到血液中。

e.en: Researchers measured {beta-endorphins} after the workout.
e.zh: 研究者在锻炼后测量了β-内啡肽水平。

e.en: The molecule exists mainly in its {beta-form}.
e.zh: 该分子主要以β型存在。

e.en: Heating converts the alpha to the {beta-form}.
e.zh: 加热会使α型转变为β型。

e.en: Oats are rich in {beta-glucan} fiber.
e.zh: 燕麦富含β-葡聚糖纤维。

e.en: {Beta-glucan} may help lower cholesterol levels.
e.zh: β-葡聚糖可能有助于降低胆固醇水平。

e.en: She receives {beta-interferon} injections weekly.
e.zh: 她每周注射β干扰素。

e.en: {Beta-interferon} is used to treat multiple sclerosis.
e.zh: β干扰素用于治疗多发性硬化症。

e.en: Workers exposed to dust developed {berylliosis}.
e.zh: 接触粉尘的工人患上了铍中毒。

e.en: Chronic {berylliosis} can cause lung scarring.
e.zh: 慢性铍肺病可导致肺部纤维化。

beryllonite.t: 磷铍钠石（一种稀有矿物）

e.en: The geologist identified a rare {beryllonite} crystal.
e.zh: 地质学家鉴定出一块罕见的磷铍钠石晶体。

e.en: Pure {beryllonite} is prized by collectors.
e.zh: 纯净的磷铍钠石深受收藏家珍视。

e.en: Petals {bescatter} the path in spring.
e.zh: 春天里花瓣撒满了小路。

e.en: Autumn winds {bescatter} leaves across the lawn.
e.zh: 秋风把落叶吹得满草坪都是。

e.en: Children love to {bescribble} every wall.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在每面墙上乱涂乱画。

e.en: He {bescribbled} the margins of his book.
e.zh: 他在书的页边胡乱涂写。

e.en: Her tearful {beseechment} moved the judge.
e.zh: 她含泪的恳求打动了法官。

e.en: Despite his {beseechment}, she walked away.
e.zh: 尽管他苦苦哀求，她还是转身离开了。

e.en: Such conduct does not {beseem} a knight.
e.zh: 这种行为与骑士身份不相称。

e.en: Modesty {beseems} a young scholar.
e.zh: 谦逊适合一位年轻的学者。

e.en: His silence {beseemed} the solemn occasion.
e.zh: 他的沉默与这庄严的场合相称。

e.en: The plain dress {beseemed} her quiet manner.
e.zh: 那朴素的衣裙与她安静的举止相宜。

e.en: He gave a {beseeming} reply to the king.
e.zh: 他给国王一个得体的回答。

e.en: Her {beseeming} demeanor impressed the elders.
e.zh: 她得体的举止给长辈们留下了印象。

beseems.t: 适合；与…相称（第三人称单数）

e.en: It {beseems} a guest to be courteous.
e.zh: 客人理应彬彬有礼。

e.en: Such humility {beseems} a true scholar.
e.zh: 这种谦逊适合真正的学者。

beseiged.t: 被围困的；被围攻的（besieged的拼写变体）

e.en: The castle was {beseiged} for many months.
e.zh: 这座城堡被围困了数月之久。

e.en: She felt {beseiged} by endless requests.
e.zh: 她感到自己被无尽的请求所围困。

e.en: His chief {besetment} was chronic procrastination.
e.zh: 他最大的毛病就是长期拖延。

e.en: She prayed for deliverance from this {besetment}.
e.zh: 她祈求摆脱这种困扰。

e.en: They {beshear} the sheep every spring.
e.zh: 他们每年春天给羊剪毛。

e.en: The barber will {beshear} his thick beard.
e.zh: 理发师会剃光他浓密的胡须。

e.en: The fishermen hauled in a large {beshow}.
e.zh: 渔民拉上来一条大裸盖鱼。

e.en: {Beshow} is prized in Asian cuisine.
e.zh: 裸盖鱼在亚洲菜系中备受推崇。

e.en: {Beshrew} the day I ever met him!
e.zh: 真该诅咒我遇到他的那一天！

e.en: She would {beshrew} him for his betrayal.
e.zh: 她要为他的背叛而诅咒他。

e.en: She {beshrewed} her own foolishness loudly.
e.zh: 她大声咒骂自己的愚蠢。

e.en: He {beshrewed} the messenger of bad news.
e.zh: 他咒骂那个传来坏消息的使者。

e.en: {Beshrewing} fate, she wept silently alone.
e.zh: 她暗暗诅咒命运，独自默默流泪。

e.en: He left the inn {beshrewing} every step.
e.zh: 他离开客栈，一路咒骂个不停。

beshrews.t: 诅咒；咒骂（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {beshrews} the hour of his birth.
e.zh: 她诅咒他出生的那一刻。

e.en: He {beshrews} all who cross his path.
e.zh: 他咒骂所有挡他道的人。

e.en: The optometrist used a {besiclometer} to fit frames.
e.zh: 验光师用眼镜测量仪来调整镜框。

e.en: An old brass {besiclometer} sat on the shelf.
e.zh: 一台老式黄铜眼镜测量仪放在架子上。

e.en: The {besiegement} of the city lasted six months.
e.zh: 这座城市被围攻了六个月。

e.en: Her {besiegement} by reporters never seemed to end.
e.zh: 她始终被记者围堵纠缠，似乎没有尽头。

e.en: Tyrants seek to {beslave} their own people.
e.zh: 暴君总想奴役自己的人民。

e.en: He refused to {beslave} himself to fashion.
e.zh: 他拒绝沦为时尚的奴隶。

e.en: The dog will {beslaver} your sleeve again.
e.zh: 狗又会把你的袖子舔得满是口水。

e.en: Courtiers {beslaver} the king with empty praise.
e.zh: 朝臣们用空洞的赞美奉承国王。

beslavered.t: 用口水弄脏；过分奉承（过去式）

e.en: The hound {beslavered} the bone with delight.
e.zh: 猎犬得意地把骨头舔得满是口水。

e.en: Her admirers {beslavered} her with constant compliments.
e.zh: 仰慕者们对她极尽奉承之能事。

beslavering.t: 流口水弄脏；过分奉承（进行式）

e.en: The puppy came {beslavering} my hand happily.
e.zh: 小狗高兴地过来把我的手舔得满是口水。

e.en: Stop {beslavering} the boss with cheap flattery.
e.zh: 别再对老板廉价奉承了。

e.en: The puppy will {beslobber} the new cushion.
e.zh: 小狗会把新垫子弄得满是口水。

e.en: He {beslobbered} the toddler with sticky kisses.
e.zh: 他在小孩脸上湿乎乎地亲个不停。

beslubber.t: 涂污；弄脏（莎士比亚用语）

e.en: He {beslubbered} his tunic with kitchen grease.
e.zh: 他把外衣弄得满是厨房的油渍。

e.en: Don't {beslubber} the page with wet ink.
e.zh: 别把纸页涂得满是湿墨。

e.en: Mud {besmeared} his clean white shirt.
e.zh: 泥巴把他干净的白衬衫弄脏了。

e.en: Don't {besmear} the painting with sticky fingers.
e.zh: 别用脏手指涂污这幅画。

e.en: The walls were {besmeared} with dripping paint.
e.zh: 墙上涂满了滴落的油漆。

e.en: His face was {besmeared} with melted chocolate.
e.zh: 他满脸都是融化的巧克力。

e.en: That little {besmearer} ruined the fresh wall.
e.zh: 那个小涂鸦者毁了刚粉刷的墙。

e.en: He earned a name as a {besmearer} of reputations.
e.zh: 他落得一个败坏他人名声的恶名。

e.en: She is {besmearing} the cake with frosting.
e.zh: 她正在给蛋糕涂上糖霜。

e.en: Stop {besmearing} my reputation with vicious lies.
e.zh: 别再用恶毒的谎言诋毁我的名声了。

besmears.t: 涂抹；弄脏（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {besmears} the canvas with thick paint.
e.zh: 他在画布上涂上厚厚的颜料。

e.en: Idle gossip {besmears} her good name.
e.zh: 无聊的流言玷污了她的好名声。

e.en: They {besmoke} the hams over hickory wood.
e.zh: 他们用山核桃木来熏火腿。

e.en: The candles will {besmoke} the white ceiling.
e.zh: 蜡烛会把白色的天花板熏黑。

e.en: Storms {besnow} the high mountain peaks.
e.zh: 暴风雪把高山之巅覆盖上厚厚的雪。

e.en: The fields were {besnowed} overnight by drifts.
e.zh: 一夜之间田野被堆积的雪覆盖。

e.en: The roof was {besnowed} after the blizzard.
e.zh: 暴风雪过后屋顶覆盖着积雪。

e.en: {Besnowed} pines lined the country road.
e.zh: 乡间小路两旁是覆雪的松树。

besom.t: 扫帚；笤帚（多用细枝扎成）

e.en: She swept the hearth with an old {besom}.
e.zh: 她用一把旧扫帚清扫炉床。

e.en: The witch flew away on a {besom}.
e.zh: 女巫骑着扫帚飞走了。

e.en: She {besomed} the cottage floor every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上用扫帚扫小屋的地板。

e.en: The yard was carefully {besomed} clean.
e.zh: 院子被仔细地扫干净了。

e.en: An old {besomer} cleaned the abbey courtyard.
e.zh: 一位老扫地工清扫着修道院的院子。

e.en: She worked as a {besomer} for years.
e.zh: 她做扫地工做了好多年。

e.en: Strong drink will {besott} even the wisest.
e.zh: 烈酒会让最聪明的人也昏头昏脑。

e.en: Vanity had {besotted} his clear judgment.
e.zh: 虚荣已经迷昏了他清醒的判断力。

besottingly.t: 令人沉醉地；使人迷醉地

e.en: She smiled {besottingly} at her sleeping infant.
e.zh: 她对着熟睡的婴儿陶醉地微笑。

e.en: The garden's perfume was {besottingly} sweet.
e.zh: 花园的芳香甜得让人沉醉。

e.en: He {besought} her forgiveness on his knees.
e.zh: 他跪下恳求她的原谅。

e.en: The villagers {besought} the king for mercy.
e.zh: 村民们恳求国王开恩。

bespake.t: 开口说；预示（古语，bespoke的旧式）

e.en: The captain {bespake} his weary crew gravely.
e.zh: 船长神色凝重地对疲惫的船员开口说话。

e.en: Her trembling hands {bespake} terrible fear.
e.zh: 她颤抖的双手显出极大的恐惧。

bespangle.t: 缀以闪光饰物；点缀闪光

e.en: Stars {bespangle} the clear night sky.
e.zh: 繁星点缀着晴朗的夜空。

e.en: She wore a gown {bespangled} with sequins.
e.zh: 她穿着一件缀满亮片的长裙。

bespangled.t: 缀有闪光饰物的；星光点点的

e.en: A {bespangled} dancer twirled across the stage.
e.zh: 一位身着亮片服饰的舞者在舞台上旋转。

e.en: Morning dew {bespangled} every blade of grass.
e.zh: 清晨的露珠缀满了每一根草叶。

e.en: The vet removed a hairy {bezoar} from the cat's stomach.
e.zh: 兽医从猫的胃里取出了一团毛粪石。

e.en: Medieval doctors believed a {bezoar} could neutralize poison.
e.zh: 中世纪的医生相信胃石能解毒。

e.en: She often quotes verses from the {Bhagavad-Gita}.
e.zh: 她常常引用《薄伽梵歌》中的诗句。

e.en: The {Bhagavad-Gita} is one of Hinduism's most sacred texts.
e.zh: 《薄伽梵歌》是印度教最神圣的经典之一。

bhaji.t: 印度炸蔬菜饼（多为洋葱）

e.en: We ordered onion {bhaji} as a starter.
e.zh: 我们点了洋葱炸饼作为开胃菜。

e.en: The {bhaji} was crispy and lightly spiced.
e.zh: 那道印度炸饼酥脆，带着淡淡的香料味。

bhakti.t: 巴克提，印度教虔信运动

e.en: The poet expressed deep {bhakti} toward Krishna.
e.zh: 这位诗人对克里希那表达了深切的虔信之情。

e.en: {Bhakti} traditions emphasize loving devotion to a personal god.
e.zh: 巴克提传统强调对人格神的爱与奉献。

e.en: During Holi, many people drink {bhang} mixed with milk.
e.zh: 洒红节期间，许多人会喝掺了牛奶的印度大麻饮料。

e.en: The use of {bhang} has a long history in South Asia.
e.zh: 在南亚，使用印度大麻有着悠久的历史。

bhangra.t: 旁遮普民间舞蹈与音乐

e.en: They danced {bhangra} at the wedding reception.
e.zh: 他们在婚宴上跳了旁遮普民间舞。

e.en: {Bhangra} beats are popular in British clubs.
e.zh: 旁遮普舞曲的节奏在英国夜店里很受欢迎。

betweenmaid.t: 打杂女仆；介于厨娘与女佣之间的帮工

e.en: The household kept a cook, a housemaid and a {betweenmaid}.
e.zh: 那户人家雇了一名厨娘、一名女仆和一名打杂女仆。

e.en: As a {betweenmaid}, she helped both upstairs and in the kitchen.
e.zh: 作为打杂女仆，她楼上楼下和厨房都要帮忙。

e.en: He works at the bakery and writes poems {betweentimes}.
e.zh: 他在面包店工作，间歇时写写诗。

e.en: She studied law and {betweentimes} taught yoga.
e.zh: 她攻读法律，闲暇时教教瑜伽。

e.en: She nursed the baby and read {betweenwhiles}.
e.zh: 她照顾婴儿，间歇时看看书。

e.en: The farmer mended fences {betweenwhiles}.
e.zh: 农夫趁着空当修补篱笆。

bevatron.t: 高能质子同步加速器；十亿电子伏加速器

e.en: The {bevatron} at Berkeley discovered the antiproton in 1955.
e.zh: 伯克利的高能质子加速器于1955年发现了反质子。

e.en: Physicists collided particles in the old {bevatron}.
e.zh: 物理学家在那台老式高能加速器中进行粒子对撞。

e.en: Her constant {bewailment} of her fate annoyed her friends.
e.zh: 她不停地哀叹自己的命运，让朋友们厌烦。

e.en: The poem is a {bewailment} of lost youth.
e.zh: 这首诗是对逝去青春的悲叹。

e.en: She would {beweep} her brother's untimely death.
e.zh: 她会为弟弟的英年早逝而恸哭。

e.en: The mourners came to {beweep} the fallen king.
e.zh: 哀悼者前来为陨落的国王哭泣。

e.en: She sat alone, {beweeping} her lost love.
e.zh: 她独自坐着，为失去的爱情痛哭。

e.en: The villagers were {beweeping} their ruined harvest.
e.zh: 村民们正在为毁掉的收成而悲叹。

e.en: She had long {bewept} the loss of her child.
e.zh: 她已为丧子之痛哭泣良久。

e.en: He looked up with a {bewept} face.
e.zh: 他抬起一张满是泪痕的脸。

e.en: Tears {bewet} her pale cheeks.
e.zh: 泪水沾湿了她苍白的脸颊。

e.en: The dew began to {bewet} the grass.
e.zh: 露水渐渐沾湿了草地。

e.en: His pillow was {bewetted} with silent tears.
e.zh: 他的枕头被无声的泪水浸湿。

e.en: The morning mist had {bewetted} every leaf.
e.zh: 晨雾沾湿了每一片树叶。

e.en: A {bewigged} judge presided over the old courtroom.
e.zh: 一位戴着假发的法官在古老的法庭上主持审判。

e.en: Portraits of {bewigged} aristocrats lined the hall.
e.zh: 走廊里挂着戴假发的贵族画像。

e.en: Her smile had a quiet {bewitchery} that drew everyone in.
e.zh: 她的微笑带着一种悄然蛊惑人心的魅力。

e.en: The old town held a strange {bewitchery} for travelers.
e.zh: 那座古城对旅人有种奇异的魅惑。

e.en: Heavy clouds began to {bewrap} the mountain peaks.
e.zh: 厚重的云层开始裹住山峰。

e.en: She would {bewrap} the infant in a woolen shawl.
e.zh: 她会用羊毛披肩把婴儿裹起来。

e.en: His trembling voice did {bewray} his guilt.
e.zh: 他颤抖的声音泄露了他的罪行。

e.en: Do not {bewray} the secrets of your friends.
e.zh: 切勿泄露朋友的秘密。

e.en: His accent {bewrayed} his northern origins.
e.zh: 他的口音泄露了他来自北方。

e.en: The traitor had {bewrayed} the king's plans.
e.zh: 那个叛徒出卖了国王的计划。

e.en: He was branded a {bewrayer} of his comrades.
e.zh: 他被斥为出卖同伴的告密者。

e.en: Every traitor needs a {bewrayer} to expose him.
e.zh: 每个叛徒都需要一个告密者来揭穿他。

e.en: Her eyes kept {bewraying} her true feelings.
e.zh: 她的双眼不断泄露着她真实的感情。

e.en: He spoke softly, fearing of {bewraying} the plan.
e.zh: 他低声说话，生怕泄露了计划。

e.en: His blush {bewrays} him whenever he lies.
e.zh: 他每次撒谎，脸红都会泄露他。

e.en: A small detail often {bewrays} the forger.
e.zh: 一个小细节往往就能揭穿伪造者。

e.en: The chronicler sought to {bewrite} the deeds of kings.
e.zh: 史官力图记述列王的事迹。

e.en: No words can rightly {bewrite} her sorrow.
e.zh: 没有任何文字能恰切描写她的悲伤。

bi-annual.t: 一年两次的；两年一次的

e.en: The committee holds {bi-annual} meetings each spring and fall.
e.zh: 该委员会每年春秋两季各召开一次会议。

e.en: They published a {bi-annual} report on industry trends.
e.zh: 他们发布了一份每半年一次的行业趋势报告。

bi-coastal.t: 两岸的；横跨东西海岸的

e.en: She lives a {bi-coastal} life between New York and Los Angeles.
e.zh: 她在纽约和洛杉矶两岸之间过着双城生活。

e.en: Their firm has a {bi-coastal} presence in the United States.
e.zh: 他们公司在美国东西两岸都设有办事处。

e.en: Their {bi-cultural} upbringing shaped how they saw the world.
e.zh: 双文化的成长背景塑造了他们看待世界的方式。

e.en: The school promotes a {bi-cultural} learning environment.
e.zh: 这所学校营造了一个双文化的学习环境。

e.en: The cable supports {bi-directional} data transfer.
e.zh: 这种线缆支持双向数据传输。

e.en: They installed {bi-directional} traffic on the new bridge.
e.zh: 新桥上设置了双向通行车道。

e.en: My grandfather wears {bi-focal} glasses for reading and driving.
e.zh: 我祖父戴双焦点眼镜来阅读和开车。

e.en: The lens uses a {bi-focal} design for added clarity.
e.zh: 这种镜片采用双焦设计以提升清晰度。

e.en: They installed a {bi-fold} door between the kitchen and patio.
e.zh: 他们在厨房和露台之间装了一扇双折门。

e.en: He keeps his cards in a slim {bi-fold} wallet.
e.zh: 他把卡片放在一个轻薄的两折钱包里。

e.en: The two countries signed a {bi-lateral} trade agreement.
e.zh: 两国签署了一项双边贸易协定。

e.en: Doctors found {bi-lateral} swelling in his knees.
e.zh: 医生发现他双侧膝盖都有肿胀。

e.en: They bought a {bi-level} house in the suburbs.
e.zh: 他们在郊区买了一栋上下两层的房子。

e.en: The machine offers {bi-level} pressure support.
e.zh: 这台机器提供双水平压力支持。

e.en: She grew up {bi-lingual} in English and Spanish.
e.zh: 她从小就会说英语和西班牙语两种语言。

e.en: The school offers a {bi-lingual} program for new immigrants.
e.zh: 这所学校为新移民开设了双语课程。

bi-monthly.t: 每两月一次的；每月两次的

e.en: The magazine is published on a {bi-monthly} schedule.
e.zh: 这本杂志每两个月出版一次。

e.en: Our team holds {bi-monthly} planning sessions.
e.zh: 我们团队每两个月举行一次规划会议。

e.en: They launched a {bi-national} research initiative.
e.zh: 他们启动了一个两国合作的研究项目。

e.en: The festival celebrates {bi-national} friendship.
e.zh: 该节庆颂扬两国之间的友谊。

e.en: The bill received rare {bi-partisan} support in Congress.
e.zh: 这项法案在国会获得了少有的两党共同支持。

e.en: They formed a {bi-partisan} committee on infrastructure.
e.zh: 他们成立了一个两党联合的基础设施委员会。

e.en: The pilot performed loops in a vintage {bi-plane}.
e.zh: 飞行员驾驶一架老式双翼机做了几个翻滚动作。

e.en: A bright red {bi-plane} circled above the airshow.
e.zh: 一架鲜红的双翼飞机在航展上空盘旋。

e.en: The novel portrays a {bi-racial} family in the 1970s.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了20世纪70年代一个混血家庭的故事。

e.en: He spoke openly about his {bi-racial} identity.
e.zh: 他坦率地谈论了自己混血的身份。

e.en: She came out as {bi-sexual} in college.
e.zh: 她在大学时公开了自己是双性恋。

e.en: The character is openly {bi-sexual} in the show.
e.zh: 剧中这个角色是公开的双性恋者。

e.en: The documentary explores attitudes toward {bi-sexuality}.
e.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了人们对双性恋的态度。

e.en: She wrote an essay about her own {bi-sexuality}.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于自己双性恋经历的散文。

e.en: A {bi-state} agency manages the harbor.
e.zh: 该港口由一个跨州机构管理。

e.en: They proposed a {bi-state} transportation plan.
e.zh: 他们提出了一项跨两州的交通规划。

bi-weekly.t: 每两周一次的；每周两次的

e.en: We have a {bi-weekly} team meeting on Fridays.
e.zh: 我们每两周的星期五开一次团队会议。

e.en: She writes a {bi-weekly} column for the newspaper.
e.zh: 她为这家报纸撰写一个每两周一期的专栏。

e.en: Audiophiles often try {bi-wiring} their speakers for cleaner sound.
e.zh: 发烧友常常用双线接法来让音箱声音更纯净。

e.en: The amplifier supports {bi-wiring} on the rear panel.
e.zh: 这台功放在后面板上支持双线连接。

e.en: He toasted a {bialy} and spread it with cream cheese.
e.zh: 他烤了一个比亚利面包，抹上了奶油奶酪。

e.en: The deli is famous for its onion {bialy}.
e.zh: 这家熟食店以洋葱比亚利面包闻名。

betimes.t: 趁早；及时；很早地；在清晨

e.en: We arrived {betimes} to get good seats.
e.zh: 我们早早到达以便抢到好座位。
