e.en: She finally met her {biological-parent} after thirty years.
e.zh: 三十年后她终于见到了亲生父母。

e.en: The court considered the rights of the {biological-parent}.
e.zh: 法院考虑了亲生父母的权利。

e.en: Critics accused the theory of crude {biologism}.
e.zh: 批评者指责该理论是粗糙的生物学主义。

e.en: {Biologism} reduces social behavior to genetic causes.
e.zh: 生物学主义将社会行为归结为基因原因。

e.en: His {biologistic} explanation of culture drew criticism.
e.zh: 他对文化的生物学主义解释招致批评。

e.en: The book rejects {biologistic} accounts of gender.
e.zh: 本书反对从生物学主义角度解释性别。

e.en: {Biolysis} breaks down organic matter in soil.
e.zh: 生物分解作用分解土壤中的有机物。

e.en: Bacteria drive {biolysis} in compost piles.
e.zh: 细菌推动堆肥中的生物分解。

e.en: The treatment uses {biolytic} enzymes to dissolve plaque.
e.zh: 该疗法使用生物分解酶溶解菌斑。

e.en: {Biolytic} reactions accelerate in warm conditions.
e.zh: 生物分解反应在温暖条件下加快。

biolytics.t: 生物分解过程；生物溶解作用

e.en: The lab specializes in {biolytics} for waste treatment.
e.zh: 实验室专门研究用于废物处理的生物分解过程。

e.en: Modern {biolytics} can break down stubborn plastics.
e.zh: 现代生物分解技术能分解顽固塑料。

e.en: DNA is the most studied {biomacromolecule} in biology.
e.zh: DNA是生物学中研究最多的生物大分子。

e.en: Proteins fold into specific {biomacromolecule} structures.
e.zh: 蛋白质折叠成特定的生物大分子结构。

e.en: Mercury shows strong {biomagnification} in food chains.
e.zh: 汞在食物链中显示出强烈的生物放大作用。

e.en: {Biomagnification} threatens top predators with toxin exposure.
e.zh: 生物放大作用使顶级捕食者面临毒素暴露的威胁。

e.en: Pesticides {biomagnify} as they move up food chains.
e.zh: 农药沿食物链上行时会发生生物放大。

e.en: Heavy metals {biomagnify} in fish-eating birds.
e.zh: 重金属在食鱼鸟类体内会生物富集。

e.en: The lake recovered through careful {biomanipulation}.
e.zh: 通过精心的生物操纵，湖泊得到了恢复。

e.en: {Biomanipulation} adjusts species ratios to improve water quality.
e.zh: 生物操纵法通过调整物种比例改善水质。

e.en: The reactor converts {biomas} into electricity.
e.zh: 反应堆将生物质转化为电能。

e.en: Forest {biomas} stores enormous amounts of carbon.
e.zh: 森林生物质储存着大量的碳。

e.en: Titanium is a popular {biomaterial} for implants.
e.zh: 钛是常用于植入物的生物材料。

e.en: Researchers developed a new {biomaterial} for wound healing.
e.zh: 研究人员开发了用于伤口愈合的新型生物材料。

e.en: He built a {biomathematical} model of tumor growth.
e.zh: 他建立了肿瘤生长的生物数学模型。

e.en: {Biomathematical} approaches predict epidemic spread.
e.zh: 生物数学方法可预测疫情的传播。

e.en: She earned her PhD in {biomathematics} last year.
e.zh: 她去年获得了生物数学博士学位。

e.en: {Biomathematics} applies equations to biological systems.
e.zh: 生物数学将方程应用于生物系统。

e.en: The {biomembrane} controls what enters the cell.
e.zh: 生物膜控制着进入细胞的物质。

e.en: Cholesterol stabilizes the lipid {biomembrane}.
e.zh: 胆固醇稳定脂质生物膜。

e.en: Each {biomere} represents a major faunal turnover.
e.zh: 每个生物地层带都代表一次重大的动物群更替。

e.en: Trilobite fossils define Cambrian {biomere} boundaries.
e.zh: 三叶虫化石界定了寒武纪生物地层带的边界。

biopsychologist.t: 生物心理学家；研究脑与行为关系的学者

e.en: The {biopsychologist} studies how brain chemistry shapes behavior.
e.zh: 这位生物心理学家研究脑化学如何影响行为。

e.en: She trained as a {biopsychologist} at a major university.
e.zh: 她在一所知名大学接受了生物心理学家的训练。

biopsychology.t: 生物心理学；研究脑机制与行为的学科

e.en: He's majoring in {biopsychology} this semester.
e.zh: 他这学期主修生物心理学。

e.en: {Biopsychology} explores the biological basis of the mind.
e.zh: 生物心理学探究心智的生物学基础。

bioptics.t: 助视光学；为弱视者设计的望远镜片

e.en: Low-vision drivers sometimes wear {bioptics} for distance reading.
e.zh: 低视力驾驶者有时戴助视望远镜片来看远处。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {bioptics} and other visual aids.
e.zh: 这家诊所专攻助视光学及其他视觉辅具。

bioreacter.t: 生物反应器；培养生物的容器装置

e.en: The {bioreacter} produced large quantities of enzyme.
e.zh: 该生物反应器产出了大量酶。

e.en: Engineers monitored the {bioreacter} throughout the run.
e.zh: 工程师在整个反应过程中监控生物反应器。

biorefractive.t: 生物折射的；与生物组织折光相关的

e.en: The lens uses a {biorefractive} polymer film.
e.zh: 该镜片使用一种生物折射性聚合物膜。

e.en: {Biorefractive} materials interact uniquely with light.
e.zh: 生物折射性材料与光的相互作用很独特。

biorefractory.t: 生物难降解的；难以被微生物分解的

e.en: Many industrial pollutants are highly {biorefractory}.
e.zh: 许多工业污染物极难被生物降解。

e.en: The compound proved {biorefractory} in long trials.
e.zh: 该化合物在长期试验中表现出难生物降解性。

bioregionalism.t: 生物区域主义；按生态边界组织生活的理念

e.en: {Bioregionalism} encourages living within ecological boundaries.
e.zh: 生物区域主义提倡在生态边界内生活。

e.en: Her writing promotes {bioregionalism} as a daily practice.
e.zh: 她的文章把生物区域主义倡导为日常实践。

bioregionalist.t: 生物区域主义者；按生态区生活的倡导者

e.en: The {bioregionalist} maps watersheds rather than counties.
e.zh: 这位生物区域主义者画的是流域而非行政区。

e.en: He calls himself a {bioregionalist} farmer.
e.zh: 他自称是一名生物区域主义农人。

bioresearch.t: 生物研究；与生命科学相关的科研活动

e.en: The lab does {bioresearch} on rare diseases.
e.zh: 该实验室从事罕见病的生物研究。

e.en: Funding for {bioresearch} has grown sharply this decade.
e.zh: 近十年生物研究的经费大幅增长。

bioreserve.t: 生物保护区；保护生物多样性的特定区域

e.en: The {bioreserve} protects several endangered amphibians.
e.zh: 这片生物保护区庇护着多种濒危两栖动物。

e.en: Tourists may enter the {bioreserve} only with a guide.
e.zh: 游客只能在向导陪同下进入生物保护区。

bioresistance.t: 生物抗性；生物对药物或外因的抵抗力

e.en: Mosquitoes are showing {bioresistance} to common sprays.
e.zh: 蚊子开始对常用喷雾产生生物抗性。

e.en: The crop developed {bioresistance} to the fungus.
e.zh: 这种作物对该真菌产生了生物抗性。

bioresmethrin.t: 生物苄呋菊酯，一种合成拟除虫菊酯类杀虫剂

e.en: {Bioresmethrin} is used to control household pests.
e.zh: 生物苄呋菊酯被用于防治家居害虫。

e.en: The spray contains a small dose of {bioresmethrin}.
e.zh: 这种喷雾含有少量生物苄呋菊酯。

biorheology.t: 生物流变学；研究生物体液流动特性的学科

e.en: {Biorheology} studies how blood flows through tiny vessels.
e.zh: 生物流变学研究血液在微细血管中的流动。

e.en: His research bridges {biorheology} and clinical medicine.
e.zh: 他的研究横跨生物流变学与临床医学。

biorhythmic.t: 生物节律的；与生命节奏周期相关的

e.en: Travel can disrupt your {biorhythmic} cycles.
e.zh: 旅行会打乱你的生物节律周期。

e.en: The athlete tracks her {biorhythmic} patterns daily.
e.zh: 这位运动员每天记录自己的生物节律模式。

biorization.t: 生物化处理；以生物方法进行处理的过程

e.en: The plant uses {biorization} to break down waste.
e.zh: 该工厂用生物化处理来分解废物。

e.en: {Biorization} converts organic matter via microbes.
e.zh: 生物化处理通过微生物转化有机物。

biosatellite.t: 生物卫星；搭载生物样本进入轨道的人造卫星

e.en: The {biosatellite} carried mice into low orbit.
e.zh: 这颗生物卫星把小鼠送入了近地轨道。

e.en: Researchers analyzed data from the {biosatellite} mission.
e.zh: 研究人员分析了该生物卫星任务的数据。

bioscientific.t: 生物科学的；与生命科学相关的

e.en: The journal publishes peer-reviewed {bioscientific} research.
e.zh: 该期刊发表经同行评审的生物科学研究。

e.en: She works at a major {bioscientific} research center.
e.zh: 她在一家大型生物科学研究中心工作。

bioscope.t: 早期电影放映机；亦指生物显微镜

e.en: Early audiences crowded around the {bioscope} for short films.
e.zh: 早期观众围在放映机前观看短片。

e.en: The museum displays a working {bioscope} from 1900.
e.zh: 博物馆展出一台1900年仍能运转的电影放映机。

bioscopy.t: 活体检查；对活组织进行观察的方法

e.en: {Bioscopy} lets doctors examine living tissue directly.
e.zh: 活体检查让医生直接观察活组织。

e.en: The clinic offers a quick painless {bioscopy}.
e.zh: 该诊所提供快速无痛的活体检查。

bioseston.t: 生物悬浮颗粒；水中悬浮的生物性物质

e.en: Researchers measured {bioseston} levels in the lake.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了湖中的生物悬浮颗粒含量。

e.en: High {bioseston} can indicate excess nutrients.
e.zh: 较高的生物悬浮颗粒可能反映养分过剩。

bioshield.t: 生物防护屏障；防御生物威胁的防护体系

e.en: The lab installed a {bioshield} around the reactor.
e.zh: 实验室在反应堆周围装设了生物防护屏障。

e.en: Government plans included a national {bioshield} initiative.
e.zh: 政府计划中包含一项国家生物防护倡议。

biosimulation.t: 生物仿真；用计算机模拟生物过程的方法

e.en: {Biosimulation} predicts how drugs behave in the body.
e.zh: 生物仿真可预测药物在体内的表现。

e.en: The team uses {biosimulation} to design new treatments.
e.zh: 该团队用生物仿真来设计新疗法。

biosis.t: 生命状态；生物存在的方式

e.en: The Greek root {biosis} means life or way of living.
e.zh: 希腊词根biosis意为生命或生活方式。

e.en: Symbiosis is one of many forms of {biosis}.
e.zh: 共生是众多生命存在方式之一。

biosocial.t: 生物社会的；兼涉生物与社会因素的

e.en: The study takes a {biosocial} approach to addiction.
e.zh: 该研究从生物社会角度切入成瘾问题。

e.en: {Biosocial} factors shape childhood development.
e.zh: 生物社会因素塑造儿童的成长。

biosocially.t: 在生物社会层面上；从生物社会角度看

e.en: The disease must be understood {biosocially}.
e.zh: 必须从生物社会层面理解这种疾病。

e.en: Behavior often emerges {biosocially} rather than purely genetically.
e.zh: 行为往往源于生物社会因素而非纯遗传。

biosociology.t: 生物社会学；研究生物因素如何影响社会行为

e.en: {Biosociology} examines how genes and culture interact.
e.zh: 生物社会学考察基因与文化的互动。

e.en: He teaches {biosociology} at the graduate level.
e.zh: 他在研究生阶段讲授生物社会学。

biosonar.t: 生物声纳；动物用声波回声定位的能力

e.en: Bats navigate dark caves using {biosonar}.
e.zh: 蝙蝠靠生物声纳在漆黑的洞穴中导航。

e.en: Dolphins rely on {biosonar} to locate prey.
e.zh: 海豚依靠生物声纳来定位猎物。

biosorption.t: 生物吸附作用；生物体表面吸附污染物的过程

e.en: {Biosorption} can remove heavy metals from wastewater.
e.zh: 生物吸附可去除废水中的重金属。

e.en: Researchers tested {biosorption} using dried algae.
e.zh: 研究人员用干藻类测试了生物吸附效果。

biosparite.t: 生物亮晶灰岩；含化石碎屑的方解石灰岩

e.en: The cliff is composed mainly of {biosparite}.
e.zh: 这片悬崖主要由生物亮晶灰岩构成。

e.en: Geologists collected {biosparite} samples for dating.
e.zh: 地质学家采集了生物亮晶灰岩样品做年代测定。

biosparrudite.t: 生物亮晶砾屑灰岩；含粗粒化石的灰岩

e.en: The reef formed thick layers of {biosparrudite}.
e.zh: 该礁体形成了厚层的生物亮晶砾屑灰岩。

e.en: Drill cores revealed {biosparrudite} below the seabed.
e.zh: 钻芯显示海床之下存在生物亮晶砾屑灰岩。

biospeleology.t: 洞穴生物学；研究洞穴中生物的学科

e.en: {Biospeleology} studies creatures that live inside caves.
e.zh: 洞穴生物学研究生活在洞穴内的生物。

e.en: Her thesis focused on {biospeleology} in central Mexico.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于墨西哥中部的洞穴生物学研究。

biosphere-reserve.t: 生物圈保护区；联合国教科文组织指定的保护区

e.en: UNESCO designated the area a {biosphere-reserve}.
e.zh: 联合国教科文组织把该地区定为生物圈保护区。

e.en: Tourists need permits to enter the {biosphere-reserve}.
e.zh: 游客须持许可证才能进入生物圈保护区。

biospheric.t: 生物圈的；与地球生命圈相关的

e.en: Climate change disrupts the {biospheric} balance.
e.zh: 气候变化扰动了生物圈的平衡。

e.en: Scientists track {biospheric} carbon flows globally.
e.zh: 科学家在全球范围内追踪生物圈的碳流动。

biostabilizer.t: 生物稳定剂；用以稳定生物体系的添加物

e.en: Engineers added a {biostabilizer} to the slurry.
e.zh: 工程师在浆料里加入了生物稳定剂。

e.en: The {biostabilizer} keeps the soil from eroding.
e.zh: 这种生物稳定剂能防止土壤侵蚀。

biostatics.t: 生物静力学；研究生物体平衡状态的力学

e.en: {Biostatics} studies bodies in mechanical equilibrium.
e.zh: 生物静力学研究处于力学平衡状态的生物体。

e.en: His paper applies {biostatics} to plant stems.
e.zh: 他的论文把生物静力学应用于植物茎。

biostatistical.t: 生物统计学的；与生物数据统计相关的

e.en: The trial used rigorous {biostatistical} methods.
e.zh: 该试验采用严格的生物统计方法。

e.en: She has a strong {biostatistical} background.
e.zh: 她有扎实的生物统计学背景。

biostereometrics.t: 生物立体测量学；测量生物体三维形态

e.en: {Biostereometrics} measures the body in three dimensions.
e.zh: 生物立体测量学对人体进行三维测量。

e.en: Surgeons use {biostereometrics} for facial reconstruction.
e.zh: 外科医生用生物立体测量学辅助面部重建。

biosterol.t: 生物甾醇；从生物体提取的甾醇类化合物

e.en: {Biosterol} occurs naturally in many plant oils.
e.zh: 生物甾醇天然存在于多种植物油中。

e.en: Researchers isolated a new {biosterol} from algae.
e.zh: 研究人员从藻类中分离出一种新的生物甾醇。

biostrategy.t: 生物战略；生物体的生存策略

e.en: The firm's {biostrategy} focuses on rare diseases.
e.zh: 这家公司的生物战略聚焦于罕见病领域。

e.en: Each species evolves its own {biostrategy} for survival.
e.zh: 每个物种都演化出自己独特的生存策略。

biostratigraphic.t: 生物地层学的；按化石分层的

e.en: Fossils provide important {biostratigraphic} markers.
e.zh: 化石提供重要的生物地层标志。

e.en: The team published a detailed {biostratigraphic} chart.
e.zh: 该团队发表了一份详细的生物地层图表。

biostrome.t: 生物岩层；由生物遗骸形成的层状岩

e.en: The cliff exposes an ancient {biostrome}.
e.zh: 这片悬崖出露着一段古老的生物岩层。

e.en: Coral fragments dominate the {biostrome}.
e.zh: 珊瑚碎屑构成生物岩层的主体。

biosuit.t: 生化防护服；防生物危害的密闭防护服装

e.en: Researchers wore a {biosuit} inside the containment lab.
e.zh: 研究人员在隔离实验室里穿着生化防护服。

e.en: The {biosuit} blocks airborne pathogens completely.
e.zh: 这套生化防护服能彻底阻挡空气中的病原体。

biosynthesize.t: 生物合成；通过生物作用合成物质

e.en: Plants {biosynthesize} their own pigments and oils.
e.zh: 植物自行生物合成色素和油脂。

e.en: Engineered bacteria can {biosynthesize} useful enzymes.
e.zh: 经过改造的细菌能生物合成有用的酶。

biosynthetic.t: 生物合成的；由生物体合成产生的

e.en: {Biosynthetic} pathways differ between species.
e.zh: 不同物种的生物合成途径各不相同。

e.en: The drug uses {biosynthetic} insulin from yeast.
e.zh: 该药物使用酵母合成的生物合成胰岛素。

biosynthetically.t: 以生物合成方式；通过生物合成途径

e.en: The hormone is now produced {biosynthetically}.
e.zh: 这种激素如今以生物合成方式生产。

e.en: Some vitamins can be made {biosynthetically} in labs.
e.zh: 某些维生素可在实验室中以生物合成方式制得。

birl.t: 在水上滚动浮木以保持平衡

e.en: Loggers used to {birl} floating logs for sport.
e.zh: 伐木工人过去常以滚浮木为乐。

e.en: He could {birl} a log longer than anyone in camp.
e.zh: 他踩浮木的时间比营地里任何人都长。

e.en: They tried to {birle} the log without falling.
e.zh: 他们试着滚动浮木而不掉下去。

e.en: Few lumberjacks can {birle} for very long.
e.zh: 很少有伐木工能长时间踩浮木。

e.en: He {birled} the log expertly across the pond.
e.zh: 他熟练地把浮木滚过池塘。

e.en: They {birled} logs for the crowd's amusement.
e.zh: 他们滚动浮木供观众取乐。

e.en: The veteran {birler} won the contest easily.
e.zh: 那位资深滚木选手轻松赢得比赛。

e.en: Every {birler} fell into the cold water eventually.
e.zh: 每个滚木选手最终都掉进了冷水里。

e.en: {Birling} is a traditional lumberjack sport.
e.zh: 踩滚浮木是一项传统的伐木工运动。

e.en: She trains in {birling} every summer.
e.zh: 她每年夏天都练习踩滚浮木。

e.en: He {birls} logs at the county fair.
e.zh: 他在县集市上表演滚浮木。

e.en: The champion {birls} better than anyone here.
e.zh: 冠军滚浮木的本事比这里任何人都强。

birr.t: 埃塞俄比亚货币比尔；嗖嗖声

e.en: The taxi cost twenty {birr}.
e.zh: 出租车费二十比尔。

e.en: We heard the {birr} of the spinning wheel.
e.zh: 我们听到了纺车嗡嗡作响。

e.en: Many couples discuss {birth-control} options with their doctor.
e.zh: 许多夫妻会与医生讨论避孕方法。

e.en: The clinic offers free {birth-control} pills.
e.zh: 诊所免费提供避孕药。

e.en: Today is my little sister's {birth-day}.
e.zh: 今天是我妹妹的生日。

e.en: We baked a cake for his {birth-day}.
e.zh: 我们为他的生日烤了蛋糕。

e.en: She has a small {birth-mark} on her shoulder.
e.zh: 她肩膀上有一块小胎记。

e.en: The {birth-mark} faded as he grew older.
e.zh: 他长大后那块胎记渐渐变淡了。

e.en: Freedom is every citizen's {birth-right}.
e.zh: 自由是每位公民与生俱来的权利。

e.en: He sold his {birth-right} for a fortune.
e.zh: 他为了一笔财富出卖了自己的与生俱来的权利。

e.en: The baby's {birth-weight} was perfectly normal.
e.zh: 婴儿的出生体重完全正常。

e.en: Doctors track {birth-weight} closely in premature infants.
e.zh: 医生密切关注早产儿的出生体重。

e.en: We're throwing a {birthday-party} for grandma.
e.zh: 我们要为奶奶办一场生日聚会。

e.en: The kids loved the {birthday-party} games.
e.zh: 孩子们很喜欢生日聚会上的游戏。

e.en: He was a {birthless} man who rose by talent.
e.zh: 他出身寒微，全凭才华出人头地。

e.en: The old king died {birthless} and unmourned.
e.zh: 老国王无后而终，无人哀悼。

birthnight.t: 诞辰之夜；生日庆典之夜

e.en: The court celebrated the queen's {birthnight} with a ball.
e.zh: 宫廷以舞会庆祝女王的诞辰之夜。

e.en: Fireworks lit up the prince's {birthnight}.
e.zh: 烟花点亮了王子的诞辰之夜。

e.en: She finally met her {birthparents} after thirty years.
e.zh: 三十年后她终于见到了亲生父母。

e.en: Many adopted children search for their {birthparents}.
e.zh: 许多被领养的孩子都会寻找亲生父母。

e.en: Native healers used {birthroot} to ease childbirth.
e.zh: 原住民医者用延龄草根来缓解分娩。

e.en: The old book described {birthroot} as a folk remedy.
e.zh: 那本旧书将延龄草根描述为一种民间药方。

e.en: Her {birthstone} is a deep blue sapphire.
e.zh: 她的诞生石是一颗深蓝色的蓝宝石。

e.en: Each month has its own {birthstone}.
e.zh: 每个月份都有自己的诞生石。

e.en: Low {birthweight} can lead to health issues.
e.zh: 出生体重过低可能导致健康问题。

e.en: The nurse recorded the baby's {birthweight}.
e.zh: 护士记录下了婴儿的出生体重。

e.en: The study compared {birthweights} across regions.
e.zh: 该研究比较了不同地区的出生体重。

e.en: Average {birthweights} have risen slightly.
e.zh: 平均出生体重略有上升。

e.en: We ordered chicken {biryani} for dinner.
e.zh: 我们点了鸡肉香饭当晚餐。

e.en: This restaurant makes the best {biryani} in town.
e.zh: 这家餐厅做的香饭是城里最好的。

e.en: The menu lists several different {biryanis}.
e.zh: 菜单上列有好几种不同的印度香饭。

e.en: They sampled {biryanis} from across India.
e.zh: 他们品尝了来自印度各地的香饭。

e.en: She dipped her {biscotti} into the espresso.
e.zh: 她把脆饼蘸进浓缩咖啡里。

e.en: The bakery sells almond {biscotti} every morning.
e.zh: 那家面包店每天早上都卖杏仁脆饼。

e.en: The model encodes every {biphone} as a feature.
e.zh: 该模型将每个双音素编码为一个特征。

e.en: Linguists tabulated the most frequent {biphone} sequences.
e.zh: 语言学家统计了最常见的双音素序列。

biphyletic.t: 双系起源的；二系演化的

e.en: The group turned out to be {biphyletic}.
e.zh: 该类群最终被证明是双系起源的。

e.en: Genetic data revealed a {biphyletic} origin.
e.zh: 基因数据揭示了双系起源。

e.en: Mimosa leaves are typically {bipinnate}.
e.zh: 含羞草的叶子通常是二回羽状的。

e.en: Botanists noted the fern's {bipinnate} fronds.
e.zh: 植物学家记录了这种蕨类的二回羽状叶。

e.en: The shrub bore delicate {bipinnated} leaves.
e.zh: 这种灌木长着精致的二回羽状叶。

e.en: She sketched a {bipinnated} foliage pattern.
e.zh: 她画了一幅二回羽状叶的图样。

e.en: The leaflets are arranged {bipinnately} along the rachis.
e.zh: 小叶沿叶轴呈二回羽状排列。

e.en: This species branches {bipinnately} near the tip.
e.zh: 该物种在尖端附近以二回羽状方式分枝。

e.en: The fern has {bipinnatifid} fronds.
e.zh: 这种蕨类有二回羽状半裂的叶片。

e.en: Botany texts illustrate {bipinnatifid} leaf forms.
e.zh: 植物学教科书图示了二回羽状半裂的叶形。

e.en: Wild carrots can show {bipinnatipartite} foliage.
e.zh: 野胡萝卜的叶子有时呈二回羽状深裂状。

e.en: The leaf was clearly {bipinnatipartite} in shape.
e.zh: 该叶片形状明显为二回羽状深裂。

e.en: The herb's leaves are {bipinnatisect}.
e.zh: 这种草本植物的叶子是二回羽状全裂的。

e.en: He labelled the diagram as {bipinnatisect}.
e.zh: 他把图示标注为二回羽状全裂。

e.en: The barn has a {bipitch} roof design.
e.zh: 该谷仓采用了双坡屋顶设计。

e.en: Engineers preferred a {bipitch} configuration here.
e.zh: 工程师在这里更倾向于双坡构造。

e.en: The X-ray uses a {biplanar} system.
e.zh: 该X光机采用双平面系统。

e.en: Surgeons prefer {biplanar} imaging for accuracy.
e.zh: 外科医生偏好双平面影像以提高准确度。

e.en: Cold War {bipolarity} shaped global politics.
e.zh: 冷战时期的两极格局塑造了全球政治。

e.en: The patient struggles with emotional {bipolarity}.
e.zh: 该患者饱受情绪双极性的困扰。

e.en: Political {bipolarization} has worsened recently.
e.zh: 近期政治两极化加剧。

e.en: Media drives the {bipolarization} of public opinion.
e.zh: 媒体推动了公众舆论的两极化。

e.en: Such rhetoric tends to {bipolarize} voters.
e.zh: 这种言论容易使选民两极化。

e.en: The debate {bipolarized} the entire community.
e.zh: 这场辩论使整个社区两极化。

e.en: Researchers synthesized a new {bipolymer}.
e.zh: 研究人员合成了一种新的双聚合物。

e.en: This {bipolymer} shows unusual elasticity.
e.zh: 该双聚合物展现出不寻常的弹性。

e.en: She {bipped} him on the nose playfully.
e.zh: 她俏皮地在他鼻子上轻点了一下。

e.en: He {bipped} the horn twice in greeting.
e.zh: 他按了两下喇叭打招呼。

e.en: The rocket uses a {bipropellant} engine.
e.zh: 该火箭采用双组元推进剂发动机。

e.en: Engineers tested the new {bipropellant} mixture.
e.zh: 工程师测试了新型双组元推进剂的配比。

e.en: The horn made two short {bips}.
e.zh: 喇叭发出两声短促的轻鸣。

e.en: He gave the puppy a few gentle {bips} on the nose.
e.zh: 他在小狗鼻子上轻轻点了几下。

e.en: The beetle is described as {bipunctate}.
e.zh: 该甲虫被描述为具两个斑点的。

e.en: Entomologists noted the {bipunctate} pattern on its wings.
e.zh: 昆虫学家记录了它翅膀上的两点斑纹。

e.en: The butterfly's eyespots are {bipupillate}.
e.zh: 这种蝴蝶的眼斑具两个瞳点。

e.en: Each {bipupillate} marking has two white centers.
e.zh: 每个双瞳眼斑都有两个白色中心。

e.en: A {bipyramid} has two pyramids joined at the base.
e.zh: 双锥体由两个底面相接的锥体组成。

e.en: The crystal grew into a perfect {bipyramid}.
e.zh: 该晶体长成了一个完美的双锥体。

e.en: He calculated the {biquadrate} of the number.
e.zh: 他计算了该数的四次方。

e.en: The {biquadrate} grew enormous very quickly.
e.zh: 该四次方很快变得极大。

e.en: The textbook covers {biquadratic} equations.
e.zh: 教科书讲解了四次方程。

e.en: Solving a {biquadratic} can be tricky.
e.zh: 求解四次方程可能很棘手。

e.en: They publish a {biquarterly} newsletter.
e.zh: 他们每季出版两次简报。

e.en: Audits happen on a {biquarterly} schedule.
e.zh: 审计按每季两次的进度进行。

e.en: The polarimeter contains a {biquartz} plate.
e.zh: 该旋光仪内含一片双石英片。

e.en: Light through the {biquartz} reveals optical rotation.
e.zh: 穿过双石英片的光显示出旋光性。

e.en: The astrologer noted a {biquintile} aspect.
e.zh: 占星师注意到一个双五分相。

e.en: A {biquintile} is said to indicate creative talent.
e.zh: 双五分相据说象征创造性才能。

biracialism.t: 双种族主义；两种族体制

e.en: The book examines historical {biracialism}.
e.zh: 这本书审视历史上的两种族体制。

e.en: Critics rejected the policy's {biracialism}.
e.zh: 批评者反对这项政策中的双种族主义色彩。

e.en: Comb jellies show {biradial} symmetry.
e.zh: 栉水母呈两辐射对称。

e.en: This animal is described as {biradial}.
e.zh: 这种动物被描述为两辐射对称的。

e.en: The body is arranged {biradially}.
e.zh: 该身体以两辐射对称方式排列。

e.en: Tentacles spread {biradially} from the mouth.
e.zh: 触手以两辐射对称方式从口部展开。

biradiated.t: 具两射线的；二度辐照的

e.en: The samples were {biradiated} for the trial.
e.zh: 试验中样品经过了二度辐照。

e.en: They observed {biradiated} structures under the microscope.
e.zh: 他们在显微镜下观察到具两射线的结构。

e.en: Chemists trapped the unstable {biradical}.
e.zh: 化学家捕获了不稳定的双自由基。

e.en: The {biradical} reacts rapidly with oxygen.
e.zh: 该双自由基迅速与氧反应。

e.en: Crustaceans often have {birameous} appendages.
e.zh: 甲壳类动物常有双枝附肢。

e.en: Each leg is clearly {birameous}.
e.zh: 每条腿都明显是双枝的。

e.en: The shrimp's antennae are {biramose}.
e.zh: 虾的触角是双枝的。

e.en: A {biramose} limb has two branches.
e.zh: 双枝肢有两条分支。

e.en: Crab appendages are typically {biramous}.
e.zh: 螃蟹的附肢通常是双枝的。

e.en: He sketched the {biramous} leg in detail.
e.zh: 他详细描绘了那条双枝肢。

e.en: He carried a {birchen} staff into the forest.
e.zh: 他拿着一根桦木手杖走进森林。

e.en: Old poems often mention {birchen} groves.
e.zh: 古诗中常提到桦树林。

e.en: We got a {bird's-eye} view of the city.
e.zh: 我们俯瞰了整座城市。

e.en: The map provides a {bird's-eye} perspective.
e.zh: 地图提供了俯瞰视角。

e.en: Bees love {bird's-foot} trefoil flowers.
e.zh: 蜜蜂喜欢百脉根的花。

e.en: The leaf has a {bird's-foot} shape.
e.zh: 这片叶子呈鸟足状。

e.en: There's a {bird's-nest} in the eaves.
e.zh: 屋檐下有一个鸟窝。

e.en: Her hair looked like a {bird's-nest}.
e.zh: 她的头发乱得像鸟窝。

e.en: Boys went {bird's-nesting} in the woods.
e.zh: 男孩们到林子里掏鸟窝。

e.en: {Bird's-nesting} is now illegal here.
e.zh: 在这里掏鸟窝现已违法。

e.en: The old {bird-catcher} set his nets at dawn.
e.zh: 老捕鸟人在黎明时分布下了网。

e.en: In the opera, a {bird-catcher} sings about his trade.
e.zh: 歌剧里捕鸟人唱起了他的行当。

e.en: A {bird-dog} retrieved the fallen pheasant.
e.zh: 一条猎鸟犬叼回了倒下的雉鸡。

e.en: Reporters {bird-dog} every move of the candidate.
e.zh: 记者紧盯候选人的一举一动。

bird-dogs.t: 猎鸟犬（复数）；紧盯（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {bird-dogs} the suspect for hours.
e.zh: 他紧盯嫌疑人长达数小时。

e.en: Two {bird-dogs} waited eagerly by the truck.
e.zh: 两条猎鸟犬急切地守在卡车旁。

e.en: The farm reported a {bird-flu} outbreak.
e.zh: 该农场报告了禽流感疫情。

e.en: Officials warned about {bird-flu} spreading.
e.zh: 官员警告禽流感正在蔓延。

e.en: She has {bird-like} eating habits.
e.zh: 她吃东西像小鸟一样。

e.en: His {bird-like} movements amused the children.
e.zh: 他像鸟一样的动作逗乐了孩子们。

e.en: The old {bird-man} kept dozens of pigeons.
e.zh: 那位老养鸟人养了几十只鸽子。

e.en: In the legend, a {bird-man} flew over the cliffs.
e.zh: 传说中，鸟人飞越了悬崖。

e.en: A robin built its {bird-nest} in our hedge.
e.zh: 一只知更鸟在我们树篱里筑了巢。

e.en: Children love spotting a hidden {bird-nest}.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢寻找隐藏的鸟巢。

e.en: A {bird-of-paradise} bloomed in the garden.
e.zh: 花园里盛开着一朵天堂鸟花。

e.en: He photographed a male {bird-of-paradise} dancing.
e.zh: 他拍下了一只雄性极乐鸟跳舞的画面。

e.en: She refilled the {bird-table} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都给喂鸟台添食。

e.en: Sparrows crowded around the {bird-table}.
e.zh: 麻雀挤在喂鸟台旁。

e.en: The wine has a {biscuity} aroma.
e.zh: 这款酒带有饼干般的香气。

e.en: I love the {biscuity} flavor of this champagne.
e.zh: 我喜欢这款香槟的饼干风味。

e.en: The {bisection} of the angle was done with a compass.
e.zh: 用圆规将这个角二等分。

e.en: He explained the {bisection} method in class.
e.zh: 他在课堂上讲解了二分法。

e.en: The {bisectional} cut divided the shape evenly.
e.zh: 这一对分切割将图形均匀分开。

e.en: They studied the {bisectional} properties of the triangle.
e.zh: 他们研究了该三角形的对分性质。

e.en: The line was drawn {bisectionally} across the figure.
e.zh: 这条线以二等分的方式横贯图形。

e.en: The shape splits {bisectionally} into mirror halves.
e.zh: 该形状对分成镜像的两半。

e.en: Draw the angle {bisector} with your protractor.
e.zh: 用量角器画出这个角的平分线。

e.en: The perpendicular {bisector} passes through the midpoint.
e.zh: 这条垂直平分线经过中点。

e.en: In optics, the {bisectrix} divides the optic axes.
e.zh: 在光学中,角平分线划分光轴。

e.en: The crystal's {bisectrix} was carefully measured.
e.zh: 该晶体的角平分线被仔细测量。

e.en: Each {bisegment} of the line had equal length.
e.zh: 该线段的每一对分段长度相等。

e.en: He drew a {bisegment} through the figure.
e.zh: 他在图形中画了一条二等分段。

e.en: The {bisegmentation} of the image revealed two layers.
e.zh: 对该图像的二等分割揭示了两层结构。

e.en: Researchers used {bisegmentation} to analyze the cell.
e.zh: 研究人员用对分分割法分析了细胞。

e.en: The fungus produces {biseptate} spores.
e.zh: 该真菌产生具二隔膜的孢子。

e.en: Under the microscope, the cells appeared {biseptate}.
e.zh: 显微镜下,这些细胞呈现双隔结构。

e.en: Some flowers are {bisexed}, containing both organs.
e.zh: 有些花是两性的,同时具备两种器官。

e.en: The species was described as {bisexed}.
e.zh: 该物种被描述为雌雄同体。

e.en: The mineral is classified as a {bisilicate}.
e.zh: 这种矿物被归类为二硅酸盐。

e.en: They synthesized a new {bisilicate} compound.
e.zh: 他们合成了一种新的二硅酸盐化合物。

e.en: The {bismuthal} compound was used in the experiment.
e.zh: 这种含铋化合物被用于实验。

e.en: He examined the {bismuthal} ore sample.
e.zh: 他检查了这块含铋的矿石样本。

e.en: The {bismuthic} acid is a strong oxidizer.
e.zh: 铋酸是一种强氧化剂。

e.en: They prepared a {bismuthic} salt for testing.
e.zh: 他们制备了一种铋盐用于测试。

e.en: The {bismuthide} formed at high temperature.
e.zh: 该铋化物在高温下形成。

e.en: Sodium {bismuthide} is studied for thermoelectric uses.
e.zh: 钠铋化物因热电用途而受到研究。

e.en: They mined a {bismuthiferous} vein in the hills.
e.zh: 他们在山中开采了一条含铋矿脉。

e.en: The region is known for {bismuthiferous} ores.
e.zh: 该地区以产铋矿石著称。

e.en: Chronic exposure can lead to {bismuthism}.
e.zh: 长期接触可能导致铋中毒。

e.en: The patient showed signs of {bismuthism}.
e.zh: 该患者出现铋中毒的症状。

e.en: The {bismuthous} salt dissolved slowly.
e.zh: 这种亚铋盐缓慢溶解。

e.en: They analyzed a {bismuthous} compound in the lab.
e.zh: 他们在实验室分析了一种亚铋化合物。

e.en: The painting captured a {bisontine} silhouette at dusk.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉了黄昏时野牛的剪影。

e.en: His shoulders had a {bisontine} bulk.
e.zh: 他的肩膀有着野牛般的厚实。

e.en: The crystal exhibits a {bisphenoid} form.
e.zh: 这种晶体呈现双楔形结构。

e.en: Geologists identified a {bisphenoid} habit in the sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在样本中识别出双楔形晶习。

e.en: Many plastics contain {bisphenol} compounds.
e.zh: 许多塑料含有双酚类化合物。

e.en: Researchers warned about {bisphenol} exposure.
e.zh: 研究人员警告双酚类物质的接触风险。

e.en: A {bissextile} year contains an extra day in February.
e.zh: 闰年的二月会多出一天。

e.en: Scholars once called February 29 the {bissextile} day.
e.zh: 学者曾把二月二十九日称为闰日。

bistate.t: 涉及两个州的；两州共管的

e.en: They formed a {bistate} commission to manage the river.
e.zh: 他们成立了一个两州共管的委员会管理这条河。

e.en: The airport is run by a {bistate} agency.
e.zh: 该机场由一个跨两州的机构运营。

bistatic.t: 双基地的（雷达收发分置）

e.en: A {bistatic} radar separates its transmitter from its receiver.
e.zh: 双基地雷达将发射机与接收机分开布置。

e.en: Engineers tested the new {bistatic} sonar at sea.
e.zh: 工程师在海上测试了新型双基地声呐。

e.en: The artist sketched the trees in {bister}.
e.zh: 画家用深棕色颜料勾勒树木。

e.en: Old maps were often tinted with {bister} ink.
e.zh: 古地图常用棕褐色墨水着色。

e.en: Her eyes looked dark and {bistered} from lack of sleep.
e.zh: 她的双眼因缺觉而显得棕黑发暗。

e.en: He used {bistered} paper for his sepia drawings.
e.zh: 他用染成棕褐色的纸作乌贼墨色素描。

bistort.t: 拳参（一种药用草本植物）

e.en: {Bistort} grows in damp meadows across northern Europe.
e.zh: 拳参生长在北欧潮湿的草地上。

e.en: Villagers once boiled {bistort} roots as medicine.
e.zh: 村民过去把拳参根熬煮入药。

e.en: The surgeon laid out his {bistouries} on a tray.
e.zh: 外科医生把他的狭长手术刀摆在托盘上。

e.en: Antique {bistouries} are displayed in the medical museum.
e.zh: 医学博物馆里展示着古董手术刀。

e.en: He made a careful incision with a {bistoury}.
e.zh: 他用狭长手术刀小心地切开伤口。

e.en: The {bistoury} is a slender surgical knife.
e.zh: 这种手术刀是一种细长的外科器械。

e.en: The walls were {bistred} by decades of smoke.
e.zh: 墙壁被数十年的烟雾熏成了深棕色。

e.en: She wore a coat of {bistred} velvet.
e.zh: 她穿着一件深棕色的天鹅绒外套。

e.en: Sodium {bisulfate} is used to lower pool pH.
e.zh: 硫酸氢钠常用于降低泳池水的酸碱度。

e.en: The lab stored potassium {bisulfate} in glass jars.
e.zh: 实验室把硫酸氢钾装在玻璃瓶里保存。

e.en: Old textbooks spell the compound as {bisulfid}.
e.zh: 旧教科书把这种化合物拼作 bisulfid。

e.en: Carbon {bisulfid} was once a common solvent.
e.zh: 二硫化碳曾是一种常用溶剂。

e.en: Carbon {bisulfide} has a distinct unpleasant odor.
e.zh: 二硫化碳有一种独特的难闻气味。

e.en: The mineral contains an iron {bisulfide} layer.
e.zh: 这种矿物含有一层二硫化铁。

e.en: Sodium {bisulfite} is added as a wine preservative.
e.zh: 亚硫酸氢钠被用作葡萄酒防腐剂。

e.en: Researchers used {bisulfite} sequencing to study DNA methylation.
e.zh: 研究人员用亚硫酸氢盐测序研究 DNA 甲基化。

e.en: Potassium {bisulphate} is sold in many fertilizers.
e.zh: 硫酸氢钾被广泛用于多种化肥。

e.en: The textbook uses the British spelling {bisulphate}.
e.zh: 这本教材使用英式拼写 bisulphate。

e.en: Older British texts write carbon {bisulphid}.
e.zh: 较早的英国文献写作二硫化碳的旧拼形式。

e.en: The label still reads iron {bisulphid}.
e.zh: 标签上仍写着二硫化铁的旧拼形式。

e.en: Carbon {bisulphide} was used in early rubber processing.
e.zh: 二硫化碳曾用于早期的橡胶加工。

e.en: The British report mentions hydrogen {bisulphide}.
e.zh: 这份英国报告提到了硫氢化物。

e.en: Winemakers add sodium {bisulphite} to prevent oxidation.
e.zh: 酿酒师加入亚硫酸氢钠以防氧化。

e.en: The protocol calls for {bisulphite} treatment of DNA.
e.zh: 该方案要求对 DNA 进行亚硫酸氢盐处理。

e.en: Various {bisulphites} are used as food preservatives.
e.zh: 各种亚硫酸氢盐被用作食品防腐剂。

e.en: The chemist compared several {bisulphites} for stability.
e.zh: 化学家比较了几种亚硫酸氢盐的稳定性。

e.en: The matrix turned out to be {bisymmetric}.
e.zh: 这个矩阵被证明是双对称的。

e.en: Engineers prefer a {bisymmetric} design for balance.
e.zh: 工程师偏好双对称设计以求平衡。

e.en: The crystal exhibits a striking {bisymmetry}.
e.zh: 这种晶体表现出明显的双对称性。

e.en: He proved the {bisymmetry} of the operator.
e.zh: 他证明了该算子具有双对称性。

bit-map.t: 位图（图像或内存的位映射）

e.en: The icon was stored as a small {bit-map}.
e.zh: 这个图标以小型位图的形式存储。

e.en: He drew the sprite pixel by pixel on a {bit-map}.
e.zh: 他在位图上一像素一像素地绘制角色图案。

bit-mapped.t: 位图的；以位图方式存储的

e.en: Early monitors displayed {bit-mapped} graphics in monochrome.
e.zh: 早期显示器以单色显示位图图形。

e.en: The fonts on this system are {bit-mapped}.
e.zh: 这个系统上的字体是位图字体。

e.en: She started out playing {bit-part} roles in soap operas.
e.zh: 她最初在肥皂剧里出演一些小角色。

e.en: He had a {bit-part} in the new film.
e.zh: 他在这部新片中演了一个小角色。

bit-player.t: 配角演员；不重要的参与者

e.en: He spent years as a {bit-player} before his breakthrough.
e.zh: 他做了多年配角才迎来突破。

e.en: In this market the firm is just a {bit-player}.
e.zh: 在这个市场里这家公司只是个无足轻重的角色。

bitangent.t: 双切线（与曲线两点相切的直线）

e.en: The curve has a {bitangent} touching it twice.
e.zh: 这条曲线有一条与之两点相切的双切线。

e.en: Mathematicians study {bitangent} lines of quartic curves.
e.zh: 数学家研究四次曲线的双切线。

e.en: Potassium {bitartrate} is the chemical name for cream of tartar.
e.zh: 酒石酸氢钾就是塔塔粉的化学名称。

e.en: The drug contains hydrocodone {bitartrate}.
e.zh: 这种药物含有氢可酮酒石酸氢盐。

e.en: The office was full of petty {bitchery}.
e.zh: 办公室里充满了刻薄的小动作。

e.en: She had no patience for tabloid {bitchery}.
e.zh: 她对小报上的刻薄八卦毫无耐心。

e.en: He gets {bitchier} when he hasn't slept.
e.zh: 他没睡好时会变得更刻薄。

e.en: Her tone grew {bitchier} as the meeting dragged on.
e.zh: 会议拖得越久，她的语气就越刻薄。

e.en: She smiled {bitchily} as he stumbled over his words.
e.zh: 他说话结巴时，她刻薄地笑了笑。

e.en: He responded {bitchily} to every suggestion.
e.zh: 他对每条建议都恶语相向。

e.en: That's a totally {bitchin} guitar solo.
e.zh: 那段吉他独奏酷毙了。

e.en: We had a {bitchin} time at the beach.
e.zh: 我们在海滩上玩得超爽。

bite-sized.t: 一口大小的；易于消化的

e.en: She cut the cheese into {bite-sized} pieces.
e.zh: 她把奶酪切成一口大小的块。

e.en: The course is broken into {bite-sized} lessons.
e.zh: 这门课程被拆分成易于消化的小课节。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {bituminiferous} layers of shale.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了含沥青页岩层的分布图。

e.en: The region is famous for its {bituminiferous} deposits.
e.zh: 该地区以其含沥青矿藏闻名。

e.en: Workers will {bituminise} the cracked road surface.
e.zh: 工人将对开裂的路面进行沥青处理。

e.en: They plan to {bituminise} the rural lane next month.
e.zh: 他们打算下个月给乡间小路铺沥青。

e.en: Engineers decided to {bituminize} the dirt path.
e.zh: 工程师决定将这条土路沥青化。

e.en: The factory can {bituminize} large batches of fabric.
e.zh: 工厂能给大批织物浸涂沥青。

bituminized.t: 沥青处理过的；已浸沥青的

e.en: They drove along the freshly {bituminized} road.
e.zh: 他们沿着刚铺好沥青的路行驶。

e.en: The crew used {bituminized} paper for waterproofing.
e.zh: 工人用浸沥青纸做防水。

e.en: The plant {bituminizes} thousands of meters of cable.
e.zh: 该工厂给数千米电缆浸涂沥青。

e.en: This machine {bituminizes} the surface evenly.
e.zh: 这台机器能均匀地给表面涂沥青。

e.en: The sample had a sticky, {bituminoid} texture.
e.zh: 样品具有黏稠的类沥青质地。

e.en: Chemists isolated a {bituminoid} residue from the rock.
e.zh: 化学家从岩石中分离出一种类沥青残留物。

e.en: The crew laid {bituminous-treated} planks on the pier.
e.zh: 工人在码头上铺设经沥青处理的木板。

e.en: They use {bituminous-treated} fabric for the roof.
e.zh: 屋顶使用经沥青处理的织物。

e.en: The fungus produces {bitunicate} asci under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下这种真菌产生双层壁子囊。

e.en: Scientists examined the {bitunicate} structures carefully.
e.zh: 科学家仔细观察了这些双层壁结构。

bitzer.t: 杂种狗；混血狗（澳洲俚语）

e.en: Their backyard {bitzer} barked at every passerby.
e.zh: 他们家后院的杂种狗对每个路人狂吠。

e.en: She adopted a friendly {bitzer} from the shelter.
e.zh: 她从收容所领养了一只温顺的杂种狗。

biunique.t: 一一对应的；双向唯一的

e.en: The mapping between the sets is {biunique}.
e.zh: 两个集合之间的映射是一一对应的。

e.en: They proved a {biunique} correspondence exists.
e.zh: 他们证明了存在一一对应的关系。

e.en: The chemist synthesized {biurea} for the experiment.
e.zh: 化学家为实验合成了双脲。

e.en: {Biurea} is used as a foaming agent in plastics.
e.zh: 双脲在塑料中用作发泡剂。

e.en: The {biuret} test detects proteins in solution.
e.zh: 双缩脲试验可检测溶液中的蛋白质。

e.en: Students learned to perform the {biuret} reaction.
e.zh: 学生们学习如何进行缩二脲反应。

bivacancy.t: 双空位（晶体中两个相邻空位）

e.en: Researchers studied {bivacancy} formation in silicon crystals.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了硅晶体中双空位的形成。

e.en: A {bivacancy} can affect the material's conductivity.
e.zh: 双空位会影响材料的导电性。

e.en: Classical logic relies on the principle of {bivalence}.
e.zh: 经典逻辑依赖于二值原则。

e.en: Some philosophers reject the law of {bivalence}.
e.zh: 一些哲学家拒绝接受二值律。

e.en: Calcium is a {bivalent} metal ion.
e.zh: 钙是一种二价金属离子。

e.en: The new {bivalent} vaccine targets two virus strains.
e.zh: 这种新的二联疫苗针对两种病毒株。

e.en: The hill fort has a {bivallate} earthwork defense.
e.zh: 这座山地堡垒有双壕土工防御工事。

e.en: Archaeologists excavated a {bivallate} Iron Age site.
e.zh: 考古学家发掘了一处双壕铁器时代遗址。

e.en: Oysters have a {bivalvular} shell structure.
e.zh: 牡蛎具有双瓣壳结构。

e.en: The biologist sketched the {bivalvular} mollusk.
e.zh: 生物学家画下了这种双壳软体动物。

e.en: The physicist used a {bivector} to represent rotation.
e.zh: 物理学家用双向量表示旋转。

e.en: In geometric algebra, a {bivector} spans an oriented plane.
e.zh: 在几何代数中，双向量张成一个有向平面。

e.en: The textbook describes the {biventer} muscle of the neck.
e.zh: 教科书描述了颈部的二腹肌。

e.en: Surgeons identified the {biventer} during the procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术中识别出了二腹肌。

e.en: Researchers analyzed {biverdin} concentrations in tissue samples.
e.zh: 研究人员分析了组织样本中的胆绿素衍生物浓度。

e.en: They detected {biverdin} during the assay.
e.zh: 在化验过程中他们检测到了这种胆绿素衍生物。

e.en: The circuit uses a {bivibrator} to generate pulses.
e.zh: 该电路使用双振荡器产生脉冲。

e.en: He repaired the malfunctioning {bivibrator} on the board.
e.zh: 他修好了电路板上故障的双振荡器。

e.en: Climbers pitched their {bivies} on the narrow ledge.
e.zh: 登山者在狭窄的岩壁上搭起了小帐篷。

e.en: Two {bivies} were barely visible in the snowstorm.
e.zh: 暴风雪中两顶小帐篷几乎看不见。

e.en: {Bivinyl} is another name for butadiene.
e.zh: 双乙烯基是丁二烯的别名。

e.en: The lab synthesized rubber from {bivinyl}.
e.zh: 实验室用丁二烯合成了橡胶。

bivouacks.t: 露营；野营（动词第三人称）

e.en: Each summer the platoon {bivouacks} in the mountains.
e.zh: 每年夏天该排都在山中露营。

e.en: He often {bivouacks} alone on multi-day climbs.
e.zh: 他多日攀登时常常独自露营。

e.en: He crawled into his {bivvy} as snow began falling.
e.zh: 雪开始下时他钻进了露营袋。

e.en: We had a quick {bivvy} on the ridge.
e.zh: 我们在山脊上简短地露营了一下。

e.en: She unrolled her {bivy} beneath the overhang.
e.zh: 她在岩壁下展开了露营袋。

e.en: A {bivy} sack saved him from the cold rain.
e.zh: 露营袋让他免受冷雨之苦。

e.en: The musician played a haunting tune on the {biwa}.
e.zh: 乐师用琵琶弹奏出令人难忘的旋律。

e.en: He inherited an antique {biwa} from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从祖父那里继承了一把古董琵琶。

e.en: Several {biwas} hung on the museum wall.
e.zh: 几把日本琵琶挂在博物馆的墙上。

e.en: Old {biwas} are increasingly rare today.
e.zh: 如今古旧的日本琵琶越来越罕见。

bixylidene.t: 双二甲苯亚基（化学基团）

e.en: Chemists studied the {bixylidene} compound's reactivity.
e.zh: 化学家研究了双二甲苯亚基化合物的反应性。

e.en: The synthesis produced a stable {bixylidene} derivative.
e.zh: 合成得到了一种稳定的双二甲苯亚基衍生物。

e.en: The molecule contains a {bixylyl} group.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个双二甲苯基。

e.en: They characterized the new {bixylyl} compound.
e.zh: 他们对这种新的双二甲苯基化合物进行了表征。

biyearly.t: 一年两次的；每两年一次的

e.en: The committee holds {biyearly} meetings to review progress.
e.zh: 委员会每年两次召开会议审查进展。

e.en: He receives a {biyearly} dental checkup.
e.zh: 他每半年接受一次牙科检查。

e.en: The film's {bizarrerie} delighted some critics and baffled others.
e.zh: 这部电影的怪诞既令一些评论家欣喜，也让另一些人困惑。

e.en: She collected every {bizarrerie} she could find at the market.
e.zh: 她在市集上搜罗每一件能找到的奇特物品。

e.en: The whole meeting felt like a {bizarro} version of reality.
e.zh: 整场会议感觉像是颠倒错乱的现实版本。

e.en: He told a {bizarro} story about his commute.
e.zh: 他讲了一个关于通勤的离奇故事。

bizonal.t: 双区的；涉及两个区域的

e.en: After the war, a {bizonal} administration was established.
e.zh: 战后建立了双区行政管理。

e.en: The treaty created a {bizonal} economic council.
e.zh: 该条约设立了一个双区经济委员会。

e.en: He {blabbered} on about his weekend for an hour.
e.zh: 他絮絮叨叨地讲了一个小时的周末见闻。

e.en: She {blabbered} the secret to everyone she met.
e.zh: 她见人就把那个秘密说漏了嘴。

e.en: Stop {blabbering} and listen for once.
e.zh: 别再唠叨了，听一次别人说话吧。

e.en: He kept {blabbering} about his new car.
e.zh: 他不停地絮叨他的新车。

e.en: She always {blabbers} when she's nervous.
e.zh: 她一紧张就会乱说话。

e.en: Don't tell him; he {blabbers} everything.
e.zh: 别告诉他，他什么都会说出去。

e.en: My {blabby} cousin ruined the surprise.
e.zh: 我那张大嘴的表姐把惊喜搞砸了。

e.en: Don't be so {blabby} about other people's lives.
e.zh: 别这么爱八卦别人的私事。

e.en: His speech was just {blabla} and no real ideas.
e.zh: 他的演讲全是废话，没有真正的内容。

e.en: Stop the {blabla} and get to the point.
e.zh: 别再说那些废话了，直奔主题吧。

e.en: A {black-a-vised} stranger entered the tavern.
e.zh: 一个面色黝黑的陌生人走进了酒馆。

e.en: He was a tall, {black-a-vised} man with piercing eyes.
e.zh: 他是个高个子、面色黝黑、目光锐利的男人。

black-and-blue.t: 青一块紫一块；遍体鳞伤

e.en: After the fall she was {black-and-blue} all over.
e.zh: 摔了那一跤后，她浑身青一块紫一块。

e.en: His arm was {black-and-blue} from the accident.
e.zh: 事故让他的手臂淤青一片。

black-and-tan.t: 黑棕相间的；黑棕色饮品

e.en: He ordered a {black-and-tan} at the Irish pub.
e.zh: 他在爱尔兰酒吧点了一杯黑棕啤酒。

e.en: The dog was a sleek {black-and-tan} terrier.
e.zh: 那只狗是一条毛色油亮的黑棕梗犬。

e.en: She loves old {black-and-white} films.
e.zh: 她喜欢老式的黑白电影。

e.en: The issue isn't as {black-and-white} as it seems.
e.zh: 这个问题并非看起来那么非黑即白。

e.en: She framed several {black-and-whites} from her trip.
e.zh: 她把旅行中拍的几张黑白照片裱了起来。

e.en: Two {black-and-whites} pulled up outside the bar.
e.zh: 两辆黑白警车停在了酒吧外。

e.en: The agency ran {black-bag} operations abroad.
e.zh: 该机构在海外开展秘密非法行动。

e.en: It was a classic {black-bag} job to plant the bug.
e.zh: 那是一次典型的秘密潜入安装窃听器的行动。

e.en: She made a hearty {black-bean} soup for dinner.
e.zh: 她做了一锅丰盛的黑豆汤当晚餐。

e.en: I love spareribs in {black-bean} sauce.
e.zh: 我特别喜欢豉汁排骨。

e.en: She earned her {black-belt} in karate last year.
e.zh: 她去年拿到了空手道黑带。

e.en: He's a {black-belt} in judo.
e.zh: 他是柔道黑带。

black-body.t: 黑体（物理学完全吸收辐射的物体）

e.en: The lab measured {black-body} radiation curves.
e.zh: 实验室测量了黑体辐射曲线。

e.en: A perfect {black-body} absorbs all incident light.
e.zh: 理想黑体能吸收一切入射光。

e.en: His name went straight into the boss's {black-book}.
e.zh: 他的名字直接被记入了老板的黑名单。

e.en: She flipped through her little {black-book} for a date.
e.zh: 她翻着自己的小黑本找约会对象。

black-bordered.t: 镶有黑边的（多用于讣告）

e.en: The newspaper printed a {black-bordered} obituary.
e.zh: 报纸登出了一则镶黑边的讣告。

e.en: She received a {black-bordered} envelope in the mail.
e.zh: 她收到了一封镶黑边的信件。

e.en: He poured the wine into a {black-bottomed} glass.
e.zh: 他把葡萄酒倒进了一个黑底的杯子里。

e.en: The chef used a {black-bottomed} pan to sear the steak.
e.zh: 厨师用黑底煎锅煎牛排。

e.en: A {black-browed} judge stared down at the defendant.
e.zh: 一位面色阴沉的法官低头盯着被告。

e.en: He was a tall, {black-browed} man with a stern voice.
e.zh: 他是个高个子、浓眉、声音严厉的男人。

black-cat.t: 黑猫（常被视为不祥之兆）

e.en: A {black-cat} crossed our path on Halloween.
e.zh: 万圣节那天有只黑猫从我们面前走过。

e.en: She adopted a sleek {black-cat} from the shelter.
e.zh: 她从收容所领养了一只毛色油亮的黑猫。

black-coated.t: 穿黑外套的；表面涂黑的

e.en: A line of {black-coated} mourners entered the church.
e.zh: 一队穿黑外套的送葬者走进了教堂。

e.en: The pan has a {black-coated} non-stick surface.
e.zh: 那只锅有一层涂黑的不粘表面。

e.en: The cable has a {black-core} insulation layer.
e.zh: 这条电缆带有黑芯绝缘层。

e.en: Engineers tested the {black-core} sample under heat.
e.zh: 工程师在高温下测试了那块黑芯样品。

e.en: She made jam from fresh {black-currant} berries.
e.zh: 她用新鲜的黑加仑做了果酱。

e.en: I'd like a {black-currant} cordial, please.
e.zh: 请给我一杯黑加仑果汁。

e.en: Only experts ski the {black-diamond} runs here.
e.zh: 这里只有高手才会去滑黑钻雪道。

e.en: She wore a stunning {black-diamond} ring.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚惊艳的黑钻戒指。

black-drop.t: 黑滴效应（金星凌日时的光学现象）

e.en: Astronomers observed the {black-drop} during the transit.
e.zh: 天文学家在凌日期间观察到了黑滴效应。

e.en: The {black-drop} effect made timing difficult.
e.zh: 黑滴效应使精确计时变得困难。

e.en: He came home {black-eyed} from the fight.
e.zh: 打架之后他眼眶发青地回到家。

e.en: She planted a row of {black-eyed} Susans.
e.zh: 她种了一排黑心金光菊。

e.en: A flock of {black-faced} sheep grazed on the hill.
e.zh: 一群黑脸羊在山坡上吃草。

e.en: He sat {black-faced} through the whole meeting.
e.zh: 他整场会议都阴沉着脸坐在那里。

black-figure.t: 黑绘式（古希腊陶器风格）

e.en: The museum displays many {black-figure} vases.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着许多黑绘式陶瓶。

e.en: This {black-figure} amphora dates from the 6th century BC.
e.zh: 这只黑绘式双耳瓶可追溯到公元前六世纪。

e.en: Officials {black-flag} drivers who break the rules.
e.zh: 裁判会用黑旗将违规的赛车手罚出比赛。

e.en: The pirates raised a {black-flag} as they approached.
e.zh: 海盗们逼近时升起了黑旗。

black-flagged.t: 被罚下场的；挥黑旗示意停赛的

e.en: The driver was {black-flagged} for unsafe driving.
e.zh: 那名车手因危险驾驶被罚下赛道。

e.en: He got {black-flagged} on the final lap.
e.zh: 他在最后一圈被挥黑旗罚下。

e.en: The kitchen has a polished {black-granite} countertop.
e.zh: 厨房铺着抛光的黑色花岗岩台面。

e.en: They built the memorial from {black-granite} slabs.
e.zh: 他们用黑色花岗岩石板建造了那座纪念碑。

e.en: A {black-hat} hacker breached the company's servers.
e.zh: 一名黑帽黑客攻破了该公司的服务器。

e.en: In every Western there's a clear {black-hat} villain.
e.zh: 每部西部片里都有一个明显的黑帽反派。

e.en: A {black-hatted} cowboy rode into town.
e.zh: 一个戴黑帽的牛仔骑马进了镇。

e.en: The {black-hatted} villain pulled out his pistol.
e.zh: 那个戴黑帽的反派拔出了手枪。

e.en: A {black-headed} gull circled above the harbor.
e.zh: 一只黑头鸥在港口上空盘旋。

e.en: We spotted several {black-headed} buntings in the field.
e.zh: 我们在田野里发现了几只黑头鹀。

e.en: The {black-hearted} villain betrayed his closest friend.
e.zh: 那个心肠歹毒的反派背叛了最亲密的朋友。

e.en: Only a {black-hearted} person would do such a thing.
e.zh: 只有心黑的人才会做出这种事。

e.en: Astronomers photographed a supermassive {black-hole}.
e.zh: 天文学家拍到了一个超大质量黑洞。

e.en: My inbox is a {black-hole} for emails.
e.zh: 我的收件箱就是邮件的黑洞。

e.en: The dentist took a {bitewing} to check for cavities between my molars.
e.zh: 牙医拍了一张咬翼片，检查臼齿之间有没有蛀牙。

e.en: Routine {bitewing} X-rays are recommended once a year.
e.zh: 建议每年拍一次常规咬翼X光片。

bitless.t: 无衔铁的（马具，不用嚼子的）

e.en: She prefers riding her horse with a {bitless} bridle.
e.zh: 她更喜欢用无衔铁的笼头骑马。

e.en: Many trainers say {bitless} riding is gentler on the horse.
e.zh: 许多训马师说无衔铁骑乘对马更温和。

e.en: The composer wrote a {bitonal} passage using two keys at once.
e.zh: 作曲家写了一段同时使用两个调性的双调乐段。

e.en: The scanner produced a {bitonal} image with only black and white pixels.
e.zh: 扫描仪生成了一张只有黑白像素的双色调图像。

bitonality.t: 双调性（音乐中同时使用两个调）

e.en: Stravinsky often experimented with {bitonality} in his orchestral works.
e.zh: 斯特拉文斯基在管弦乐作品中常常尝试双调性。

e.en: The dissonance in this piece comes from its {bitonality}.
e.zh: 这首曲子的不协和感来自它的双调性。

e.en: This audio file has a higher {bitrate} than the streaming version.
e.zh: 这个音频文件的比特率比流媒体版本更高。

e.en: Lower the {bitrate} if your internet connection is slow.
e.zh: 如果你的网速慢，就把码率调低。

e.en: The carpenter clamped the drill bit into the {bitstock}.
e.zh: 木匠把钻头夹进了曲柄钻里。

e.en: Old {bitstock} tools are still useful for delicate woodwork.
e.zh: 老式手摇钻柄在精细木工活中仍然好用。

e.en: The decoder reads the incoming {bitstream} in real time.
e.zh: 解码器实时读取进入的比特流。

e.en: A corrupted {bitstream} can crash the player.
e.zh: 损坏的位流可能让播放器崩溃。

e.en: The chip can process several {bitstreams} in parallel.
e.zh: 这块芯片可以并行处理多路比特流。

e.en: Different video {bitstreams} share the same channel.
e.zh: 不同的视频位流共用同一个信道。

e.en: She wore an itsy-{bitsy} polka-dot bikini.
e.zh: 她穿了一件小小的圆点比基尼。

e.en: Just a {bitsy} bit of sugar will do.
e.zh: 加一点点糖就够了。

e.en: The sailors wrapped the heavy rope around the {bitt} on deck.
e.zh: 水手们把粗绳缠在甲板上的系缆桩上。

e.en: Each {bitt} must be strong enough to hold the ship in a storm.
e.zh: 每个系缆桩都得结实到能在风暴中拴住船。

e.en: He spat the {bitten-off} bit of apple into the bin.
e.zh: 他把咬下来的那块苹果吐进了垃圾桶。

e.en: A {bitten-off} fingernail lay on the table.
e.zh: 桌上躺着一片咬掉的指甲。

bitter-bark.t: 苦皮树（一种澳洲药用树皮）

e.en: The settlers brewed a tonic from {bitter-bark} to fight fevers.
e.zh: 拓荒者用苦皮树皮熬补药来退烧。

e.en: {Bitter-bark} grows in the rainforests of northern Australia.
e.zh: 苦皮树生长在澳大利亚北部的雨林里。

e.en: They fought to the {bitter-end} and never surrendered.
e.zh: 他们一直战斗到最后关头，从未投降。

e.en: She stayed with the failing project until the {bitter-end}.
e.zh: 她陪着这个失败的项目一直坚持到最后。

e.en: He was a {bitter-ender} who refused any compromise.
e.zh: 他是个死硬派，拒绝任何妥协。

e.en: Only a few {bitter-enders} kept the strike going.
e.zh: 只有几个坚持到底的人还在维持罢工。

bitter-sweet.t: 苦乐参半的；又苦又甜的

e.en: Graduation day felt {bitter-sweet} for everyone.
e.zh: 毕业那天大家都觉得苦乐参半。

e.en: She gave a {bitter-sweet} smile as she waved goodbye.
e.zh: 她挥手告别时露出一个苦乐参半的微笑。

bitterbrush.t: 苦灌木（北美一种鹿食灌木）

e.en: Mule deer browse on {bitterbrush} throughout the winter.
e.zh: 骡鹿整个冬天都啃食苦灌木。

e.en: {Bitterbrush} thrives on dry, rocky slopes.
e.zh: 苦灌木在干燥的岩坡上长得很好。

e.en: That was the {bitterest} defeat of his career.
e.zh: 那是他职业生涯中最惨痛的失败。

e.en: This is the {bitterest} coffee I've ever tasted.
e.zh: 这是我喝过最苦的咖啡。

e.en: The tea had a {bitterish} aftertaste.
e.zh: 这茶有点微苦的回味。

e.en: He made a {bitterish} remark about the result.
e.zh: 他对结果说了句略带苦涩的话。

bitternut.t: 苦山核桃（一种北美核桃树）

e.en: A tall {bitternut} hickory shaded the back yard.
e.zh: 一棵高大的苦山核桃树荫蔽着后院。

e.en: Squirrels avoid the {bitternut} because of its taste.
e.zh: 松鼠因为味道苦而不吃苦山核桃。

bitterroot.t: 苦根（北美一种带粉花的可食植物）

e.en: Native peoples dug {bitterroot} as an important food source.
e.zh: 原住民挖苦根作为重要的食物来源。

e.en: Pink {bitterroot} blooms across the dry prairie in spring.
e.zh: 粉色的苦根春天开满干旱的草原。

bitterweed.t: 苦草（一种使牛奶变苦的杂草）

e.en: Cows that eat {bitterweed} produce sour-tasting milk.
e.zh: 吃了苦草的奶牛产出的奶味道发苦。

e.en: Farmers pull {bitterweed} out of the pasture every summer.
e.zh: 农民每年夏天都从牧场里拔掉苦草。

bitterwood.t: 苦木（一种药用热带树木）

e.en: Extracts of {bitterwood} have long been used as a tonic.
e.zh: 苦木的提取物长期被用作补药。

e.en: The bark of the {bitterwood} tree is intensely bitter.
e.zh: 苦木树的树皮极其苦涩。

e.en: She held a {bittie} kitten in her palm.
e.zh: 她手心里捧着一只小小的猫崽。

e.en: Just a {bittie} taste, please.
e.zh: 请就给我一小口尝尝。

e.en: She picked the {bittiest} crumbs off the plate.
e.zh: 她把盘子上最小的碎屑都捡起来了。

e.en: That's the {bittiest} portion I've ever been served.
e.zh: 那是我吃过最小的一份。

bittock.t: 一小段；一小会儿（苏格兰方言）

e.en: It's just a wee {bittock} down the road.
e.zh: 沿路再走一小段就到了。

e.en: Wait a {bittock} and I'll be ready.
e.zh: 再等一小会儿我就准备好了。

bitumastic.t: 沥青胶泥；防水沥青涂料

e.en: The pipes were coated with {bitumastic} to prevent corrosion.
e.zh: 管道涂上了沥青胶泥以防腐蚀。

e.en: Workers brushed {bitumastic} onto the foundation walls.
e.zh: 工人在地基墙上刷了一层防水沥青涂料。

bitumen-impregnated.t: 浸渍沥青的；含浸沥青的

e.en: They laid {bitumen-impregnated} felt over the roof deck.
e.zh: 他们在屋面板上铺了一层浸渍沥青的油毡。

e.en: The cables are wrapped in {bitumen-impregnated} paper.
e.zh: 电缆外面包着浸渍沥青的纸。

e.en: The road surface underwent {bitumination} before winter.
e.zh: 路面在入冬前进行了沥青化处理。

e.en: {Bitumination} of the joints helps keep water out.
e.zh: 对接缝进行涂沥青处理可以阻挡水分渗入。

e.en: He is not {blamable} for the accident.
e.zh: 他对这起事故并无可责之处。

e.en: Her conduct was hardly {blamable} under the circumstances.
e.zh: 在那种情况下她的行为实在算不上该受责备。

e.en: He acted {blamably} in ignoring the warning.
e.zh: 他无视警告的行为应受责备。

e.en: She was {blamably} careless with the documents.
e.zh: 她对待这些文件的疏忽实属该受责备。

e.en: No one is {blameable} for what happened.
e.zh: 对于所发生的事，谁也不该受责备。

e.en: His actions were clearly {blameable}.
e.zh: 他的行为显然该受谴责。

blameful.t: 该受责备的；充满责备的

e.en: She gave him a {blameful} look.
e.zh: 她责备地看了他一眼。

e.en: His {blameful} silence said it all.
e.zh: 他那充满责备的沉默说明了一切。

e.en: She stared {blamefully} at the broken vase.
e.zh: 她责备地盯着摔碎的花瓶。

e.en: He spoke {blamefully} of his colleague.
e.zh: 他带着责备的口吻谈起同事。

blamestorm.t: 集体追责；开会推卸责任

e.en: The team gathered to {blamestorm} after the launch failed.
e.zh: 产品发布失败后团队开会互相追责。

e.en: Don't {blamestorm}; figure out the real cause.
e.zh: 别只顾着推卸责任，先找出真正原因。

blamestorming.t: 集体追究责任；推诿大会

e.en: The meeting quickly turned into {blamestorming}.
e.zh: 会议很快变成了相互推卸责任的场面。

e.en: We need solutions, not {blamestorming}.
e.zh: 我们需要解决方案，而不是互相追责。

blameworthiness.t: 应受责备的程度；可责性

e.en: The court considered the defendant's {blameworthiness}.
e.zh: 法庭考量了被告应负责任的程度。

e.en: There is no clear {blameworthiness} in this case.
e.zh: 此案中并无明确的可责之处。

e.en: His {blandiloquence} fooled the crowd.
e.zh: 他的花言巧语骗倒了众人。

e.en: She saw through the politician's {blandiloquence}.
e.zh: 她看穿了那位政客的甜言蜜语。

e.en: He tried to {blandish} her into agreeing.
e.zh: 他试图用花言巧语哄她答应。

e.en: Don't let him {blandish} you with empty promises.
e.zh: 别让他用空头承诺把你哄住。

e.en: She {blandished} him until he gave in.
e.zh: 她一再奉承直到他让步。

e.en: They {blandished} the investors with rosy forecasts.
e.zh: 他们用乐观的预测哄骗投资者。

e.en: He's a smooth {blandisher} who flatters everyone.
e.zh: 他是个圆滑的奉承家，对谁都恭维。

e.en: Beware of the {blandisher} at court.
e.zh: 当心宫廷里的阿谀之徒。

blandishes.t: 奉承；甜言蜜语地哄（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {blandishes} her boss to get promoted.
e.zh: 她奉承上司以求升迁。

e.en: He always {blandishes} clients with charm.
e.zh: 他总用魅力来哄客户。

blandishing.t: 奉承的；甜言蜜语哄骗的

e.en: She used {blandishing} words to win his trust.
e.zh: 她用甜言蜜语赢得了他的信任。

e.en: His {blandishing} tone made her suspicious.
e.zh: 他那讨好的语气让她起了疑心。

e.en: She bought a leather {blankbook} for sketching.
e.zh: 她买了一本皮面空白本用来画速写。

e.en: He keeps a small {blankbook} for ideas.
e.zh: 他随身带着一本小空白本记灵感。

e.en: She gave me the {blankest} stare imaginable.
e.zh: 她给了我一个最茫然的眼神。

e.en: His face wore the {blankest} expression.
e.zh: 他脸上挂着最空洞的表情。

e.en: She rubbed her eyes to clear the {bleariness} of sleep.
e.zh: 她揉揉眼睛，赶走睡意带来的朦胧感。

e.en: A faint {bleariness} crept into his vision after hours of reading.
e.zh: 看了好几个小时书后，他的视线渐渐模糊起来。

e.en: Tears were {blearing} her view of the stage.
e.zh: 泪水让她看舞台的视线变得模糊。

e.en: Smoke was slowly {blearing} the morning sky.
e.zh: 烟雾正慢慢遮蔽着清晨的天空。

e.en: Crying for hours always {blears} her eyes.
e.zh: 连哭几个小时总会让她双眼模糊。

e.en: The thick fog {blears} every distant outline.
e.zh: 浓雾使所有远处的轮廓都变得模糊。

bleary-eyed.t: 睡眼惺忪的；眼神朦胧的

e.en: He stumbled into the kitchen, {bleary-eyed} and yawning.
e.zh: 他睡眼惺忪地打着哈欠走进厨房。

e.en: The students looked {bleary-eyed} after the all-night exam.
e.zh: 通宵考试后学生们个个睡眼朦胧。

blearyeyed.t: 睡眼惺忪的；眼神模糊的

e.en: She emerged {blearyeyed} from the bedroom at noon.
e.zh: 她中午才睡眼惺忪地从卧室出来。

e.en: The pilots looked {blearyeyed} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后飞行员们都显得睡眼朦胧。

e.en: A tiny {bleb} formed on the burned skin.
e.zh: 烫伤的皮肤上起了一个小水泡。

e.en: The glass had a {bleb} trapped near its edge.
e.zh: 玻璃边缘附近困着一个小气泡。

e.en: The dying cells {blebbed} under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，垂死的细胞表面起了小泡。

e.en: The paint had {blebbed} from the heat.
e.zh: 油漆因高温而起了小泡。

e.en: The lava cooled into a {blebby} surface.
e.zh: 熔岩冷却后形成布满小泡的表面。

e.en: He noticed a {blebby} patch on the leaf.
e.zh: 他注意到叶子上有一块带着小泡的斑。

blech.t: 呸；恶心（表示厌恶的感叹词）

e.en: {Blech}, this milk has gone sour!
e.zh: 呸，这牛奶已经酸了！

e.en: She made a {blech} face at the lukewarm soup.
e.zh: 她对那温吞的汤露出嫌恶的表情。

e.en: Engineers installed a valve to handle the {bleed-off} of excess steam.
e.zh: 工程师安装了阀门来排放多余的蒸汽。

e.en: The system uses a slow {bleed-off} to relieve pressure.
e.zh: 该系统通过缓慢泄放来减压。

bleeding-edge.t: 最前沿的；极尖端的（技术）

e.en: The startup runs on {bleeding-edge} AI hardware.
e.zh: 这家初创公司使用最前沿的人工智能硬件。

e.en: Adopting {bleeding-edge} tools often comes with bugs.
e.zh: 采用最尖端的工具通常会伴随各种漏洞。

e.en: He lived without the slightest {blemishment} to his name.
e.zh: 他一生清白，名声毫无瑕疵。

e.en: The scandal was a serious {blemishment} on her career.
e.zh: 那桩丑闻是她事业上的一大污点。

e.en: This foundation is highly {blendable} on dry skin.
e.zh: 这款粉底在干性皮肤上非常易于推开。

e.en: The two paints are perfectly {blendable}.
e.zh: 这两种颜料能完美混合。

e.en: The mine yielded large amounts of zinc {blende}.
e.zh: 这座矿山出产大量闪锌矿。

e.en: Geologists studied the {blende} samples carefully.
e.zh: 地质学家仔细研究了那些闪锌矿样本。

e.en: The plant now runs on a {blended-fuel} mixture.
e.zh: 该工厂现已使用混合燃料运行。

e.en: Many trucks burn a {blended-fuel} of diesel and biofuel.
e.zh: 许多卡车烧的是柴油和生物燃料的混合燃料。

e.en: Several {blennies} darted between the rocks.
e.zh: 几条䲁鱼在礁石间来回穿梭。

e.en: Tide pools often hide tiny {blennies}.
e.zh: 潮池里常藏着小小的䲁鱼。

e.en: A bright {blenny} peeked out of the coral.
e.zh: 一条色彩鲜艳的䲁鱼从珊瑚里探出头来。

e.en: The {blenny} hid in a crack in the reef.
e.zh: 那条䲁鱼躲进了礁石的裂缝中。

blent.t: 混合的（古旧用法，blend 的过去式）

e.en: Their voices {blent} into one harmonious chord.
e.zh: 他们的嗓音融合成一个和谐的和弦。

e.en: Sea and sky {blent} on the horizon.
e.zh: 海与天在地平线上融为一体。

blepharoplasty.t: 眼睑整形术；双眼皮手术

e.en: She is considering a {blepharoplasty} to reduce eyelid sagging.
e.zh: 她正在考虑做眼睑整形术以改善眼皮松弛。

e.en: The surgeon specializes in {blepharoplasty} and other facial procedures.
e.zh: 那位外科医生专门做眼睑整形和其他面部手术。

blesbok.t: 白纹牛羚（南非一种羚羊）

e.en: A herd of {blesbok} grazed on the open plain.
e.zh: 一群白纹牛羚在开阔的平原上吃草。

e.en: The {blesbok} is native to South Africa.
e.zh: 白纹牛羚原产于南非。

blesbuck.t: 白纹牛羚（blesbok 的另一拼法）

e.en: Hunters spotted a lone {blesbuck} near the ridge.
e.zh: 猎人在山脊附近发现了一只独行的白纹牛羚。

e.en: The reserve protects herds of {blesbuck}.
e.zh: 该保护区保护着成群的白纹牛羚。

e.en: She signed the contract with {black-ink}.
e.zh: 她用黑墨水签了合同。

e.en: The company finally posted {black-ink} this quarter.
e.zh: 公司这一季度终于实现盈利。

e.en: The medieval manuscript was printed in {black-letter}.
e.zh: 那本中世纪手稿用哥特体印刷。

e.en: {Black-letter} law leaves little room for interpretation.
e.zh: 成文法几乎没有解释空间。

e.en: The poster glowed under the {black-light}.
e.zh: 海报在黑光灯下发亮。

e.en: Detectives used a {black-light} to find stains.
e.zh: 侦探用紫外灯寻找污渍。

e.en: The villagers feared her {black-magic}.
e.zh: 村民害怕她的黑魔法。

e.en: He was accused of practicing {black-magic}.
e.zh: 他被指控施行妖术。

e.en: He bought medicine on the {black-market}.
e.zh: 他在黑市上买了药。

e.en: A huge {black-market} for fuel emerged.
e.zh: 出现了庞大的燃油黑市。

e.en: The {black-marketeer} was finally arrested.
e.zh: 那个黑市商人终于被捕。

e.en: He worked as a {black-marketeer} during the war.
e.zh: 战争期间他从事黑市买卖。

e.en: {Black-marketeers} sold rationed goods at huge profits.
e.zh: 黑市商人高价倒卖配给物资。

e.en: Police cracked down on the {black-marketeers}.
e.zh: 警方严厉打击这些黑市贩子。

black-metal.t: 黑金属(一种重金属音乐)

e.en: He plays guitar in a {black-metal} band.
e.zh: 他在一支黑金属乐队弹吉他。

e.en: Norwegian {black-metal} is famous worldwide.
e.zh: 挪威黑金属在全球闻名。

e.en: The athlete raised his fist in a {black-power} salute.
e.zh: 那位运动员举拳致黑人权力礼。

e.en: {Black-power} activists demanded equal rights.
e.zh: 黑人权力运动者要求平等权利。

e.en: The wine had a deep {black-red} color.
e.zh: 这酒呈深邃的黑红色。

e.en: Her dress was a striking {black-red}.
e.zh: 她的裙子是抢眼的暗红色。

e.en: The Hawaiian beach was covered in {black-sand}.
e.zh: 那片夏威夷海滩铺满黑沙。

e.en: {Black-sand} comes from eroded volcanic rock.
e.zh: 黑沙来自侵蚀的火山岩。

e.en: He's the {black-sheep} of the family.
e.zh: 他是家里的败家子。

e.en: Every team has its {black-sheep}.
e.zh: 每个团队都有害群之马。

e.en: This junction is a notorious {black-spot}.
e.zh: 这个路口是出了名的事故黑点。

e.en: The roses suffered from a {black-spot} fungus.
e.zh: 玫瑰患上了黑斑真菌病。

e.en: She majored in {black-studies} at university.
e.zh: 她大学主修黑人研究。

e.en: The college launched a {black-studies} program.
e.zh: 该学院开设了黑人研究项目。

e.en: The wedding was a {black-tie} affair.
e.zh: 这场婚礼要求穿正式礼服。

e.en: Please wear {black-tie} to the gala.
e.zh: 请穿正式礼服出席晚宴。

black-velvet.t: 黑色丝绒；黑天鹅绒鸡尾酒

e.en: She wore a stunning {black-velvet} dress.
e.zh: 她穿着一袭惊艳的黑丝绒礼服。

e.en: He ordered a pint of {black-velvet} at the pub.
e.zh: 他在酒馆点了一品脱黑天鹅绒酒。

e.en: The desk is made of solid {black-walnut}.
e.zh: 这书桌用纯黑胡桃木做成。

e.en: {Black-walnut} ice cream is rich and nutty.
e.zh: 黑核桃冰淇淋香浓有坚果味。

e.en: The flood pushed {black-water} into the basement.
e.zh: 洪水把生活污水冲进了地下室。

e.en: He paddled through the swamp's {black-water}.
e.zh: 他划船穿过沼泽的黑水。

blackacre.t: (法律假设的)黑庄园；案例土地代称

e.en: Law students debated who owned {blackacre}.
e.zh: 法学院学生辩论黑庄园的归属。

e.en: The deed transferred {blackacre} to the heir.
e.zh: 契约把黑庄园转给了继承人。

e.en: The {blackade-runner} slipped past the warships at dawn.
e.zh: 那艘走私船黎明时分溜过军舰。

e.en: His grandfather served on a Civil War {blackade-runner}.
e.zh: 他祖父在内战时期一艘封锁突破船上服役。

e.en: The old portrait depicted a {blackamoor} servant.
e.zh: 那幅旧画像描绘了一名黑摩尔仆人。

e.en: The word {blackamoor} is now deeply offensive.
e.zh: blackamoor 一词如今带有严重冒犯意味。

e.en: He was rumored to dabble in {blackart}.
e.zh: 据传他涉足黑魔法。

e.en: Books on {blackart} were burned in the square.
e.zh: 关于妖术的书籍在广场上被焚烧。

blackavised.t: 皮肤黝黑的；面色黝黑的

e.en: A {blackavised} stranger entered the inn.
e.zh: 一名皮肤黝黑的陌生人走进客栈。

e.en: She described him as {blackavised} and stern.
e.zh: 她形容他面色黝黑而严厉。

e.en: A {blackbeetle} scuttled across the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 一只蟑螂从厨房地板上窜过。

e.en: She screamed at the sight of a {blackbeetle}.
e.zh: 她看到蟑螂吓得尖叫起来。

e.en: The plane's {blackbox} was recovered from the wreckage.
e.zh: 飞机的黑匣子从残骸中被找回。

e.en: To users, the algorithm is a {blackbox}.
e.zh: 对用户而言,这套算法就是个黑箱。

e.en: The {blackbuck} is native to the Indian plains.
e.zh: 黑羚原产于印度平原。

e.en: We spotted a {blackbuck} in the reserve.
e.zh: 我们在保护区里发现一只黑羚。

e.en: A {blackcap} sang from the hedgerow.
e.zh: 一只黑顶林莺在树篱里歌唱。

e.en: {Blackcap} migrate south every autumn.
e.zh: 黑顶林莺每年秋天南迁。

e.en: The village {blackcoat} preached every Sunday.
e.zh: 村里的牧师每个礼拜天讲道。

e.en: He scorned the local {blackcoat} for his hypocrisy.
e.zh: 他鄙视那位牧师的虚伪。

e.en: Hunters stalked the {blackcock} at dawn.
e.zh: 猎人黎明时分追踪雄黑琴鸡。

e.en: A {blackcock} displayed proudly on the moor.
e.zh: 一只黑琴鸡在荒原上炫耀求偶。

e.en: Several miners died from {blackdamp} in the tunnel.
e.zh: 几名矿工在隧道里因黑湿气窒息身亡。

e.en: {Blackdamp} contains too much carbon dioxide to breathe.
e.zh: 黑湿气二氧化碳浓度高得无法呼吸。

e.en: The whole city was {blacked-out} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间整座城市停了电。

e.en: Several names were {blacked-out} in the report.
e.zh: 报告里有几个名字被涂黑了。

e.en: The widow received a {blackedged} envelope.
e.zh: 那位寡妇收到一封镶黑边的信封。

e.en: Mourning cards were traditionally {blackedged}.
e.zh: 讣告卡片传统上镶有黑边。

blacker-than-black.t: 比黑还黑的；极致深黑的

e.en: The new display achieves a {blacker-than-black} contrast.
e.zh: 这块新屏达到比黑还黑的对比度。

e.en: The cave was {blacker-than-black} inside.
e.zh: 洞内漆黑得超乎想象。

e.en: Old novels referred to Aboriginal men as {blackfellow}.
e.zh: 旧小说把土著男子称作 blackfellow。

e.en: The term {blackfellow} is now considered offensive.
e.zh: blackfellow 一词如今被视为冒犯。

e.en: Settlers wrote condescendingly about the {blackfellows}.
e.zh: 殖民者以居高临下口吻描写土著人。

e.en: Modern Australians avoid saying {blackfellows}.
e.zh: 现代澳大利亚人避免使用 blackfellows 一词。

e.en: He hooked a {blackfin} off the Florida coast.
e.zh: 他在佛罗里达海岸钓到一条黑鳍鱼。

e.en: {Blackfin} tuna is popular for sashimi.
e.zh: 黑鳍金枪鱼是受欢迎的刺身食材。

e.en: His {blackguardism} shocked polite society.
e.zh: 他的流氓行径震惊了上流社会。

e.en: The novel exposes the {blackguardism} of corrupt officials.
e.zh: 小说揭露了腐败官员的卑劣行径。

e.en: The {blackgum} turns brilliant red in autumn.
e.zh: 黑胶木秋天变成鲜艳的红色。

e.en: Bees love {blackgum} blossoms for honey.
e.zh: 蜜蜂喜爱黑胶木的花来酿蜜。

blackhander.t: 黑手党成员；勒索敲诈者

e.en: The {blackhander} demanded protection money.
e.zh: 那名黑手党敲诈者索要保护费。

e.en: Police arrested a suspected {blackhander} last night.
e.zh: 警方昨晚逮捕了一名涉嫌敲诈者。

e.en: The orchard suffered from {blackheart} disease.
e.zh: 果园受到黑心病侵害。

e.en: She picked a basket of {blackheart} cherries.
e.zh: 她摘了一篮黑心樱桃。

e.en: The {blackhearted} villain plotted his revenge.
e.zh: 那黑心反派密谋报复。

e.en: Don't trust that {blackhearted} schemer.
e.zh: 别相信那个黑心的阴谋家。

e.en: The story features two {blackhearts} as antagonists.
e.zh: 故事里有两个黑心反派。

e.en: Such {blackhearts} deserve no sympathy.
e.zh: 这种黑心之人不值得同情。

e.en: Drivers should beware of {blackice} on bridges.
e.zh: 司机要当心桥面上的黑冰。

e.en: She slipped on {blackice} and broke her wrist.
e.zh: 她在黑冰上滑倒,摔断了手腕。

blastomycosis.t: 芽生菌病；一种真菌感染

e.en: The doctor diagnosed him with {blastomycosis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断他患有芽生菌病。

e.en: {Blastomycosis} can affect the lungs and skin.
e.zh: 芽生菌病可能影响肺部和皮肤。

e.en: She studied the {blastoporal} region of the embryo.
e.zh: 她研究胚胎的原口区域。

e.en: The {blastoporal} lip plays a key role in development.
e.zh: 原口唇在发育中起关键作用。

blastopore.t: 原口；胚胎发育时的开口

e.en: The {blastopore} forms during gastrulation.
e.zh: 原口在原肠胚形成期出现。

e.en: Cells migrate inward through the {blastopore}.
e.zh: 细胞通过原口向内迁移。

e.en: The {blastoporic} canal closes later in development.
e.zh: 原口管在发育后期闭合。

e.en: Researchers traced the {blastoporic} cells.
e.zh: 研究者追踪了原口细胞。

blastoporphyritic.t: 变余斑状的；一种岩石结构

e.en: The sample showed a {blastoporphyritic} texture.
e.zh: 样品呈现变余斑状结构。

e.en: Geologists noted the {blastoporphyritic} pattern in the rock.
e.zh: 地质学家注意到岩石中的变余斑状结构。

blastosphere.t: 囊胚；中空的胚胎细胞球

e.en: The {blastosphere} consists of a hollow ball of cells.
e.zh: 囊胚由一团中空的细胞构成。

e.en: Scientists examined the {blastosphere} under a microscope.
e.zh: 科学家在显微镜下观察囊胚。

e.en: She described the {blastospheric} stage in detail.
e.zh: 她详细描述了囊胚阶段。

e.en: {Blastospheric} cells can develop into many tissues.
e.zh: 囊胚细胞可发育成多种组织。

blastostyle.t: 生殖体；水螅的繁殖结构

e.en: Each {blastostyle} produces tiny medusae.
e.zh: 每个生殖体都会产生微小的水母体。

e.en: The hydroid colony bears several {blastostyles}.
e.zh: 水螅群落上长着数个生殖体。

e.en: The vault is {blastproof} and fireproof.
e.zh: 这个金库防爆又防火。

e.en: They installed {blastproof} doors at the entrance.
e.zh: 他们在入口装了防爆门。

e.en: The fertilized egg develops into a {blastula}.
e.zh: 受精卵会发育成囊胚。

e.en: A {blastula} is a hollow sphere of cells.
e.zh: 囊胚是一个由细胞组成的中空球体。

blastulae.t: 囊胚的复数形式；早期胚胎

e.en: He photographed several {blastulae} for the study.
e.zh: 他为研究拍摄了几个囊胚。

e.en: The {blastulae} were preserved for further analysis.
e.zh: 这些囊胚被保存以便进一步分析。

e.en: I was shocked by the {blatancy} of the lie.
e.zh: 这个谎言的露骨程度让我震惊。

e.en: His {blatancy} offended everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他的张扬冒犯了在场的每个人。

blate.t: 害羞的；腼腆胆怯的；苏格兰方言

e.en: The boy was too {blate} to speak up.
e.zh: 这男孩太腼腆，不敢开口。

e.en: She wasn't {blate} about asking for help.
e.zh: 她请求帮助时一点也不害羞。

blatherskite.t: 夸夸其谈者；废话连篇的人

e.en: Don't listen to that {blatherskite}.
e.zh: 别听那个夸夸其谈的人胡说。

e.en: He's a complete {blatherskite} when nervous.
e.zh: 他一紧张就变成了话痨。

blattered.t: 啪啪作响；喋喋不休（过去式）

e.en: Rain {blattered} against the windows all night.
e.zh: 雨整夜啪啪打在窗户上。

e.en: The drunk man {blattered} on for hours.
e.zh: 那醉汉嘟囔了好几个小时。

e.en: He's a notorious {blatterer} at meetings.
e.zh: 他在会议上是出了名的话痨。

e.en: Avoid the village {blatterer} at all costs.
e.zh: 无论如何要避开村里的长舌妇。

blattering.t: 啪啪作响；喋喋不休（现在分词）

e.en: She heard rain {blattering} on the tin roof.
e.zh: 她听见雨啪啪打在铁皮屋顶上。

e.en: He kept {blattering} about his old job.
e.zh: 他不停地唠叨自己以前的工作。

blatters.t: 啪啪作响；喋喋不休（单三）

e.en: Hail {blatters} against the metal shed.
e.zh: 冰雹啪啪砸在铁皮棚屋上。

e.en: She {blatters} on whenever she's nervous.
e.zh: 她一紧张就唠叨个不停。

blazonment.t: 纹章描述；炫耀性的展示

e.en: The shield's {blazonment} took hours to complete.
e.zh: 这盾徽的描绘花了好几个小时。

e.en: She disliked any public {blazonment} of wealth.
e.zh: 她讨厌任何公开炫耀财富的行为。

e.en: The book explains medieval {blazonry}.
e.zh: 这本书讲解中世纪的纹章学。

e.en: Heraldic {blazonry} decorated the banners.
e.zh: 旗帜上装饰着纹章图案。

e.en: The driftwood on the beach looked {bleached-white}.
e.zh: 海滩上的浮木看起来惨白。

e.en: Her hair was {bleached-white} from years of sun.
e.zh: 她的头发因常年日晒而漂得发白。

bleacheries.t: 漂白厂；纺织漂白工厂（复数）

e.en: Several {bleacheries} polluted the river last century.
e.zh: 上世纪几家漂白厂污染了这条河。

e.en: Old {bleacheries} once lined the canal banks.
e.zh: 旧时漂白厂沿着运河两岸排开。

bleacherite.t: 看台观众；坐廉价座位的人

e.en: Every {bleacherite} cheered the home run.
e.zh: 每个看台观众都为这次本垒打欢呼。

e.en: He was a loyal {bleacherite} at every game.
e.zh: 他每场比赛都是忠实的看台观众。

bleachery.t: 漂白厂；纺织品漂白车间

e.en: The old {bleachery} closed last year.
e.zh: 那家老漂白厂去年关门了。

e.en: She worked at a textile {bleachery}.
e.zh: 她在一家纺织漂白厂工作。

e.en: Tears {bleared} her vision.
e.zh: 眼泪让她的视线变得模糊。

e.en: His eyes were {blear} from lack of sleep.
e.zh: 他因缺觉而双眼朦胧。

blear-eyed.t: 眼神朦胧的；睡眼惺忪的

e.en: He stumbled {blear-eyed} into the kitchen.
e.zh: 他睡眼惺忪地踉跄走进厨房。

e.en: The {blear-eyed} students yawned in class.
e.zh: 睡眼朦胧的学生们在课堂上打哈欠。

e.en: Smoke {bleared} her eyes.
e.zh: 烟熏得她两眼朦胧。

e.en: His vision {bleared} after long hours of reading.
e.zh: 长时间阅读后他视线变得模糊。

e.en: Her eyes grew {blearier} as the night wore on.
e.zh: 夜深了，她的眼睛越发朦胧。

e.en: His vision was even {blearier} this morning.
e.zh: 今早他的视力比平时更模糊。

e.en: He looked his {bleariest} after the all-nighter.
e.zh: 通宵之后他显得睡眼最朦胧。

e.en: She had the {bleariest} eyes of anyone there.
e.zh: 她的眼睛是那里最朦胧的。

e.en: She leaned against the {back-rest} and closed her eyes.
e.zh: 她靠在椅背上闭上了眼睛。

e.en: The chair has an adjustable {back-rest} for comfort.
e.zh: 这把椅子配有可调节的靠背以提升舒适度。

e.en: We took a quiet {back-road} to avoid the traffic.
e.zh: 我们走了一条僻静的小路以避开交通。

e.en: The {back-roads} of the countryside are beautiful in autumn.
e.zh: 乡间小路在秋天非常美丽。

e.en: The shy students always sat in the {back-row}.
e.zh: 害羞的学生总是坐在最后一排。

e.en: From the {back-row}, I could barely see the stage.
e.zh: 从后排我几乎看不见舞台。

e.en: Politics is full of mutual {back-scratching} between officials.
e.zh: 政界中官员之间充满了互相利用的勾当。

e.en: Their alliance is just convenient {back-scratching}.
e.zh: 他们的联盟只是图方便的互相吹捧罢了。

e.en: Write your name on the {back-side} of the paper.
e.zh: 把你的名字写在纸的背面。

e.en: He fell and hurt his {back-side}.
e.zh: 他摔倒了，伤到了屁股。

back-slapping.t: 过分热络的恭维；勾肩搭背式的客套

e.en: The reunion was full of {back-slapping} and loud laughter.
e.zh: 聚会上充满了热络的寒暄和大笑声。

e.en: I dislike the {back-slapping} culture of corporate events.
e.zh: 我不喜欢企业活动那种过分热络的客套文化。

e.en: Don't trust him; he'll {back-stab} you the moment he can.
e.zh: 别相信他，他一有机会就会在背后捅你一刀。

e.en: That comment felt like a clear {back-stab}.
e.zh: 那句话感觉就是赤裸裸的背后中伤。

e.en: Office politics here involves a lot of {back-stabbing}.
e.zh: 这里的办公室政治充满了暗箭伤人。

e.en: She lost her job because of a colleague's {back-stabbing}.
e.zh: 她因为同事的背后中伤而丢了工作。

e.en: He kept {back-stepping} to avoid the puddle.
e.zh: 他不停地后退以避开水坑。

e.en: The dancer's {back-stepping} was perfectly timed.
e.zh: 那位舞者的退步动作时机把握得恰到好处。

e.en: I don't want any {back-talk} from you, young man.
e.zh: 小伙子，我不想听你顶嘴。

e.en: Her {back-talk} got her sent to the principal's office.
e.zh: 她的顶嘴让她被叫去了校长办公室。

e.en: Stop {back-talking} your mother right now.
e.zh: 立刻别再跟你妈妈顶嘴了。

e.en: The teacher punished him for {back-talking}.
e.zh: 老师因为他顶嘴而惩罚了他。

e.en: I have three {back-to-back} meetings this morning.
e.zh: 今天上午我有三场连续的会议。

e.en: They stood {back-to-back} for the photo.
e.zh: 他们背靠背站着拍照。

e.en: The coach took a {back-to-basics} approach to training.
e.zh: 教练采取了回归基础的训练方式。

e.en: We need a {back-to-basics} review of our strategy.
e.zh: 我们需要对策略做一次回归基础的审视。

e.en: You've put your sweater on {back-to-front}.
e.zh: 你把毛衣前后穿反了。

e.en: He read the report {back-to-front} by mistake.
e.zh: 他不小心把报告倒着看了。

e.en: The store has a big {back-to-school} sale every August.
e.zh: 这家店每年八月都有大型开学季促销。

e.en: My kids are excited for {back-to-school} shopping.
e.zh: 我的孩子们很期待开学季购物。

e.en: After many failures, it's time to go {back-to-the-basics}.
e.zh: 经历多次失败后，是时候回归基础了。

e.en: Their training emphasizes a {back-to-the-basics} mindset.
e.zh: 他们的训练强调回归基础的思维方式。

back-to-the-future.t: 回到未来；时光倒流式的

e.en: The retro design feels distinctly {back-to-the-future}.
e.zh: 这种复古设计有明显的回到未来式的感觉。

e.en: His proposal had a {back-to-the-future} quality to it.
e.zh: 他的提案有一种回到未来般的特质。

e.en: After the holidays, it's {back-to-work} on Monday.
e.zh: 假期过后，周一就要重返工作了。

e.en: The government launched a {back-to-work} program for parents.
e.zh: 政府推出了一项让家长重返职场的计划。

e.en: He {back-tracked} on his earlier promise.
e.zh: 他对之前的承诺改口了。

e.en: We {back-tracked} along the trail to find her glove.
e.zh: 我们沿原路返回去寻找她的手套。

e.en: The team used {back-translations} to verify accuracy.
e.zh: 团队使用回译来核对准确性。

e.en: {Back-translations} often reveal subtle mistranslations.
e.zh: 回译常常能揭示出细微的翻译错误。

e.en: Always {back-up} your files before updating the system.
e.zh: 在更新系统前一定要备份你的文件。

e.en: The officer called for {back-up} immediately.
e.zh: 那名警官立即呼叫了支援。

e.en: We slipped out the {back-way} to avoid reporters.
e.zh: 我们从后门溜走以避开记者。

e.en: He knew a {back-way} into the old town.
e.zh: 他知道一条进入古城的小路。

e.en: The kids are playing in the {back-yard}.
e.zh: 孩子们正在后院玩耍。

e.en: We grow tomatoes in our {back-yard}.
e.zh: 我们在后院种番茄。

e.en: She did a perfect {backbend} during her gymnastics routine.
e.zh: 她在体操表演中完成了一个完美的下腰。

e.en: Yoga class ended with a deep {backbend}.
e.zh: 瑜伽课以一个深度后弯结束。

e.en: Daily {backbends} have improved her flexibility.
e.zh: 每天的下腰练习提高了她的柔韧性。

e.en: The dancer practiced {backbends} for hours.
e.zh: 那位舞者练习了几个小时的下腰。

e.en: Don't {backbite} your colleagues; it ruins trust.
e.zh: 不要背后说同事的坏话，那会破坏信任。

e.en: She refused to {backbite} even when others did.
e.zh: 即使别人这么做，她也拒绝在背后中伤他人。

e.en: He felt {backbitten} by the people he had trusted.
e.zh: 他感到被自己曾信任的人在背后中伤。

e.en: Many {backbitten} employees eventually quit.
e.zh: 许多被暗中中伤的员工最终辞职了。

e.en: Stand clear of the rocket launcher's {backblast}.
e.zh: 请远离火箭发射器的后喷焰区域。

e.en: The {backblast} from the bazooka can be deadly.
e.zh: 火箭筒发射时的后喷气流可能致命。

e.en: He grew up in the {backblocks} of Australia.
e.zh: 他在澳大利亚的偏远内陆地区长大。

e.en: Few visitors ever reach the {backblocks}.
e.zh: 很少有游客能到达那些偏远地区。

backbreaker.t: 极其辛苦的工作；累垮人的事

e.en: Harvesting by hand was a real {backbreaker}.
e.zh: 手工收割真是一项累垮人的活儿。

e.en: That last project turned out to be a {backbreaker}.
e.zh: 最后那个项目结果累得人喘不过气。

e.en: Farm chores in summer are real {backbreakers}.
e.zh: 夏天的农活是真正累垮人的活。

e.en: These deadlines are absolute {backbreakers}.
e.zh: 这些截止期限简直把人累垮了。

e.en: Mining used to be {backbreaking} work.
e.zh: 采矿过去是极其辛苦的工作。

e.en: She does {backbreaking} labor on the farm every day.
e.zh: 她每天在农场做累人的体力活。

backchannel.t: 私下渠道；非正式沟通渠道

e.en: Diplomats often use a {backchannel} to negotiate quietly.
e.zh: 外交官常通过私下渠道进行秘密谈判。

e.en: They reached an agreement via a {backchannel}.
e.zh: 他们通过非正式渠道达成了协议。

e.en: She {backcombed} her hair to add volume.
e.zh: 她倒梳头发让发型显得蓬松。

e.en: Stylists often {backcomb} hair for retro looks.
e.zh: 造型师常常倒梳头发以打造复古造型。

e.en: Researchers used a {backcross} to confirm the gene's location.
e.zh: 研究人员使用回交来确认基因的位置。

e.en: A {backcross} can recover desired traits in offspring.
e.zh: 回交可以在后代中恢复所需的性状。

e.en: The hybrid was {backcrossed} with its parent strain.
e.zh: 杂交品种与亲本品系进行了回交。

e.en: Plants are often {backcrossed} to stabilize traits.
e.zh: 植物常通过回交来稳定性状。

e.en: Several {backcrosses} were needed to isolate the trait.
e.zh: 分离这一性状需要进行多次回交。

e.en: The breeder {backcrosses} the line every generation.
e.zh: 育种员每一代都对该品系进行回交。

e.en: {Backcrossing} is common in plant breeding programs.
e.zh: 回交在植物育种项目中很常见。

e.en: They use {backcrossing} to introduce disease resistance.
e.zh: 他们通过回交引入抗病性。

e.en: His sudden {backdown} surprised the negotiators.
e.zh: 他突然的让步令谈判者感到意外。

e.en: The minister's {backdown} was seen as a defeat.
e.zh: 那位部长的退让被视为一次失败。

e.en: Firefighters watch for sudden {backdrafts} during a blaze.
e.zh: 消防员在火灾中要警惕突然出现的回火。

e.en: Poor ventilation can cause dangerous {backdrafts}.
e.zh: 通风不良会引起危险的逆向气流。

e.en: All my photos are {backed-up} to the cloud.
e.zh: 我所有的照片都备份到了云端。

e.en: Traffic was completely {backed-up} for miles.
e.zh: 交通堵塞了好几英里。

e.en: He works on the {backend} of the application.
e.zh: 他负责应用程序的后端开发。

e.en: The {backend} handles all the database queries.
e.zh: 后端处理所有的数据库查询。

back-and-forth.t: 来回；反复的争论或讨论

e.en: After much {back-and-forth}, they finally agreed on a price.
e.zh: 经过反复讨价还价，他们终于谈妥了价格。

e.en: The ball moved {back-and-forth} across the net.
e.zh: 球在网两边来回飞动。

e.en: As a {back-bencher}, she rarely got to ask questions in parliament.
e.zh: 作为一名后座议员，她很少有机会在议会上提问。

e.en: Several {back-benchers} openly criticized the prime minister.
e.zh: 几位后座议员公开批评首相。

e.en: The office was full of {back-biting} and gossip.
e.zh: 办公室里充斥着背后中伤和流言蜚语。

e.en: I can't stand all the {back-biting} in this team.
e.zh: 我受不了这个团队里成天的背后中伤。

back-blast.t: 火箭筒后喷气流；后座爆风

e.en: Stand clear of the {back-blast} when the rocket is fired.
e.zh: 火箭发射时请远离后喷区域。

e.en: The {back-blast} from the launcher scorched the wall.
e.zh: 发射器的后喷气流烧焦了墙面。

e.en: His shot bounced off the {back-board} and into the hoop.
e.zh: 他的投篮打在篮板上反弹入筐。

e.en: The medics strapped him to a {back-board}.
e.zh: 医护人员把他固定在脊柱板上。

e.en: Small farmers are the {back-bone} of the rural economy.
e.zh: 小农户是农村经济的中坚力量。

e.en: He didn't have the {back-bone} to stand up to his boss.
e.zh: 他没有骨气敢顶撞老板。

e.en: Harvesting rice by hand is a real {back-breaker}.
e.zh: 手工收割稻谷真是个累垮人的活。

e.en: This deadline is going to be a {back-breaker}.
e.zh: 这个截止日期会让人忙得喘不过气。

back-breaking.t: 极其辛苦的；累得腰酸背痛的

e.en: Mining used to be {back-breaking} work.
e.zh: 采矿过去是累得腰酸背痛的活儿。

e.en: They spent the day in {back-breaking} labor under the sun.
e.zh: 他们顶着烈日干了一整天极其辛苦的活。

back-burner.t: 次要位置；暂缓处理的事项

e.en: The project was put on the {back-burner} until next year.
e.zh: 这个项目被搁置到明年再处理。

e.en: Family issues had to take a {back-burner} during the trial.
e.zh: 审判期间家庭事务只能暂时放一放。

e.en: The proposal was quietly {back-burnered} after the merger.
e.zh: 合并之后这项提案被悄悄搁置了。

e.en: Her novel got {back-burnered} when the baby arrived.
e.zh: 孩子出生后她的小说写作就被搁置了。

back-channel.t: 秘密渠道；非正式沟通途径

e.en: The two governments communicated through a {back-channel}.
e.zh: 两国政府通过秘密渠道进行沟通。

e.en: Diplomats often use {back-channels} to test new ideas.
e.zh: 外交官常通过非正式渠道试探新方案。

e.en: The forwards were told to {back-check} more aggressively.
e.zh: 前锋被要求更积极地回防。

e.en: His failure to {back-check} led to the goal.
e.zh: 他没能回防导致了对方进球。

back-checker.t: 回防球员；后撤防守的人

e.en: He's a tireless {back-checker} on the ice.
e.zh: 他在冰场上是个不知疲倦的回防球员。

e.en: Good {back-checkers} save countless goals.
e.zh: 出色的回防球员能化解无数次进攻。

back-comb.t: 逆向梳理头发使其蓬松

e.en: She would {back-comb} her hair to add volume.
e.zh: 她会倒梳头发让发量看起来更蓬松。

e.en: The stylist {back-combed} the model's bangs.
e.zh: 造型师把模特的刘海倒梳了一下。

e.en: The blurb is printed on the {back-cover} of the book.
e.zh: 内容简介印在这本书的封底上。

e.en: Her photo appeared on the {back-cover}.
e.zh: 她的照片出现在封底上。

e.en: He got the job through the {back-door}.
e.zh: 他是走后门得到这份工作的。

e.en: Hackers found a {back-door} into the system.
e.zh: 黑客找到了进入系统的后门。

e.en: He refused to {back-down} from his demands.
e.zh: 他拒绝在自己的要求上让步。

e.en: The company's {back-down} surprised everyone.
e.zh: 公司的退让让所有人感到意外。

e.en: Snowy mountains formed a stunning {back-drop} to the village.
e.zh: 雪山为村庄构成了壮丽的背景。

e.en: The play used a painted {back-drop} of a forest.
e.zh: 这出戏用了一幅画着森林的背景幕布。

e.en: He works on the {back-end} of the website.
e.zh: 他负责网站的后端开发。

e.en: Most of the profits come at the {back-end} of the deal.
e.zh: 大部分利润出现在交易的后期。

back-fence.t: 邻里间的；街坊闲谈式的

e.en: It was just {back-fence} gossip about the neighbors.
e.zh: 那不过是邻里间的闲言碎语。

e.en: They exchanged news over the {back-fence}.
e.zh: 他们隔着后院的栅栏聊家常。

e.en: Workers will {back-fill} the trench tomorrow.
e.zh: 工人明天会把沟回填好。

e.en: Let me {back-fill} you on what happened in the meeting.
e.zh: 我来把会上发生的事补充告诉你。

e.en: His attempt to impress the boss {back-fired} badly.
e.zh: 他想给老板留下好印象的努力适得其反。

e.en: The car {back-fired} as it pulled away.
e.zh: 汽车启动时排气管发出回火爆响。

e.en: The verb 'edit' is a {back-formation} from 'editor'.
e.zh: 动词 edit 是从 editor 逆构而来的。

e.en: Linguists study {back-formation} as a word-building process.
e.zh: 语言学家把逆构词作为一种构词方式来研究。

back-handed.t: 拐弯抹角的；表面恭维实为讽刺的

e.en: That was a {back-handed} compliment if I ever heard one.
e.zh: 那简直就是我听过最明显的拐弯抹角式恭维。

e.en: She gave him a {back-handed} apology.
e.zh: 她给了他一个不痛不痒的道歉。

e.en: The official was accused of accepting {back-handers}.
e.zh: 那名官员被指控收受贿赂。

e.en: He gave the ball a quick {back-hander}.
e.zh: 他迅速反手把球击了回去。

e.en: Things are very different {back-home} in my village.
e.zh: 在我老家村子里，情况完全不同。

e.en: He misses the food {back-home}.
e.zh: 他想念家乡的味道。

e.en: You can order {back-issues} of the magazine online.
e.zh: 你可以在网上订购这本杂志的过期刊。

e.en: The library keeps {back-issues} on microfilm.
e.zh: 图书馆用缩微胶片保存旧期号。

e.en: The new policy provoked a fierce {back-lash}.
e.zh: 新政策引发了强烈的反弹。

e.en: There was a public {back-lash} against the decision.
e.zh: 公众对这一决定产生了强烈反对。

e.en: The photographer used {back-lighting} to create a halo effect.
e.zh: 摄影师用逆光制造出光晕效果。

e.en: The screen has adjustable {back-lighting}.
e.zh: 这块屏幕有可调节的背光。

back-loaded.t: 后期付款较多的；后端加重的

e.en: His contract is heavily {back-loaded} with bonuses.
e.zh: 他的合同奖金大多集中在后期发放。

e.en: The schedule is {back-loaded} with difficult opponents.
e.zh: 赛程后段安排了大量强劲对手。

back-marker.t: 落在最后的人；垫底选手

e.en: The leader had to lap several {back-markers}.
e.zh: 领跑者不得不套圈好几位垫底选手。

e.en: He started the season as a {back-marker}.
e.zh: 他这个赛季开局时是垫底选手。

back-number.t: 过期刊物；过时的人或事

e.en: That singer is a {back-number} now.
e.zh: 那位歌手如今已经过气了。

e.en: I found an old {back-number} of the journal.
e.zh: 我找到了一本这本期刊的过期号。

back-of-the-envelope.t: 粗略估算的；信封背面式的

e.en: I did a {back-of-the-envelope} calculation of the costs.
e.zh: 我对成本做了个粗略的估算。

e.en: It's just a {back-of-the-envelope} estimate.
e.zh: 这只是个粗略估算的数字。

e.en: She works in the bank's {back-office} operations.
e.zh: 她在银行的后台业务部门工作。

e.en: They've outsourced most of their {back-office} functions.
e.zh: 他们把大部分后台业务都外包出去了。

back-order.t: 延期交货订单；缺货待发订单

e.en: The item is on {back-order} until next month.
e.zh: 这件商品要到下个月才能发货。

e.en: We'll place a {back-order} for you.
e.zh: 我们会为您下一个延期交货的订单。

e.en: The book is {back-ordered} and will ship in two weeks.
e.zh: 这本书已缺货待发，两周后才能发货。

e.en: All the popular sizes are {back-ordered}.
e.zh: 所有热门尺码都缺货等补。

e.en: The story was buried on the {back-page}.
e.zh: 这条新闻被塞在末版不起眼的地方。

e.en: Sports news usually runs on the {back-page}.
e.zh: 体育新闻通常刊登在末版。

e.en: All the ports are on the {back-panel} of the device.
e.zh: 所有接口都在设备的后面板上。

e.en: Unscrew the {back-panel} to access the battery.
e.zh: 拧下后盖板就能取出电池。

e.en: The defender played a risky {back-pass} to the keeper.
e.zh: 后卫冒险地把球回传给守门员。

e.en: His {back-pass} was intercepted by the striker.
e.zh: 他的回传球被前锋断下。

e.en: There was a lot of {back-patting} after the deal closed.
e.zh: 交易达成后大家相互吹捧了一番。

e.en: Enough {back-patting} — let's get back to work.
e.zh: 别再相互吹捧了，回去干活吧。

e.en: The minister began to {back-pedal} on his earlier statement.
e.zh: 那位部长开始对自己先前的言论改口。

e.en: He had to {back-pedal} furiously to avoid a tackle.
e.zh: 他不得不拼命后退以躲开抢截。

e.en: She quickly {back-pedaled} when she saw his reaction.
e.zh: 看到他的反应，她迅速改了口。

e.en: The candidate {back-pedaled} on his tax promise.
e.zh: 那位候选人在减税承诺上改了口。

e.en: The CEO is {back-pedaling} on the layoff announcement.
e.zh: 首席执行官正在对裁员公告改口。

e.en: He kept {back-pedaling} as his opponent advanced.
e.zh: 对手步步逼近，他不停地往后退。

back-pedalled.t: 改了口；后退了（英式拼写）

e.en: The spokesperson {back-pedalled} on the comments overnight.
e.zh: 发言人一夜之间就对那些言论改了口。

e.en: He {back-pedalled} furiously to keep his balance.
e.zh: 他飞快地往后退以保持平衡。

back-pedalling.t: 正在改口；正在后退（英式拼写）

e.en: The government is {back-pedalling} on its climate pledges.
e.zh: 政府正在对其气候承诺改口推诿。

e.en: You could see him {back-pedalling} under the high ball.
e.zh: 你能看到他在高空球下不断后退。

back-pedals.t: 改口；后退（第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {back-pedals} when challenged in public.
e.zh: 一旦被当众质问，他总是改口。

e.en: The boxer {back-pedals} to avoid the jab.
e.zh: 那位拳手向后退以躲开刺拳。

e.en: The knight's armor included a heavy {back-plate}.
e.zh: 骑士的盔甲包含一块沉重的后背护甲。

e.en: Remove the {back-plate} to reach the wiring.
e.zh: 拆下背板就能接触到线路。

e.en: The display unit comes with two interchangeable {back-plates}.
e.zh: 这款显示器配有两块可更换的背板。

e.en: Medieval {back-plates} were often elaborately decorated.
e.zh: 中世纪的后背护甲常装饰得很华丽。

e.en: The film used {back-projection} for the driving scenes.
e.zh: 这部电影的驾车镜头使用了背投技术。

e.en: {Back-projection} can make a small studio look vast.
e.zh: 背投技术能让小摄影棚看起来非常宽阔。

back-projections.t: 背投画面；后投影图像（复数）

e.en: The stage featured rotating {back-projections} of city skylines.
e.zh: 舞台上不断切换着城市天际线的背投画面。

e.en: Older films relied on {back-projections} for outdoor effects.
e.zh: 早期电影依靠背投来制造户外场景效果。

barrelhouse.t: 低档酒馆；早期爵士钢琴风格

e.en: He learned to play piano in a {barrelhouse} on the riverfront.
e.zh: 他在河边的一家小酒馆里学会了弹钢琴。

e.en: The band played raucous {barrelhouse} blues all night.
e.zh: 乐队整晚演奏着喧闹的酒馆布鲁斯。

barren-ground.t: 贫瘠土地；北美苔原地带

e.en: Caribou migrate across the {barren-ground} each summer.
e.zh: 驯鹿每年夏天穿越苔原地带迁徙。

e.en: Few crops survive on this {barren-ground}.
e.zh: 很少有作物能在这片贫瘠的土地上存活。

e.en: She planted {barrenwort} in the shaded corner of the garden.
e.zh: 她在花园的阴凉角落种了淫羊藿。

e.en: {Barrenwort} is sometimes used in traditional medicine.
e.zh: 淫羊藿有时被用作传统药材。

e.en: The lawyer was disbarred for {barretry}.
e.zh: 那位律师因唆讼罪被取消了执业资格。
