e.en: Old statutes treated {barretry} as a serious offense.
e.zh: 古老的法令将唆讼视为重罪。

barricado.t: 路障；设置路障（古旧用法）

e.en: They built a {barricado} across the narrow lane.
e.zh: 他们在狭窄的小巷里筑起了路障。

e.en: The rebels tried to {barricado} the gate.
e.zh: 叛军试图用路障封住大门。

e.en: The {barrier-island} protects the coast from storm surges.
e.zh: 这座堰洲岛保护海岸免受风暴潮的侵袭。

e.en: Erosion is gradually shrinking the {barrier-island}.
e.zh: 侵蚀正逐渐使这座堰洲岛缩小。

e.en: The wine matured for two years in a French {barrique}.
e.zh: 这款葡萄酒在法国橡木桶中陈酿了两年。

e.en: Each {barrique} imparts subtle flavors to the wine.
e.zh: 每一只橡木桶都赋予葡萄酒微妙的风味。

e.en: He was admitted as a {barrister-at-law} in 1998.
e.zh: 他于1998年获准成为出庭律师。

e.en: The card listed her title as {barrister-at-law}.
e.zh: 名片上她的头衔是出庭律师。

e.en: A {barrow-man} sold roasted chestnuts on the corner.
e.zh: 一个推车小贩在街角卖烤栗子。

e.en: The old {barrow-man} called out his prices loudly.
e.zh: 那位老推车小贩大声吆喝着价格。

e.en: She used to {bartend} at a downtown jazz club.
e.zh: 她曾在市中心的一家爵士酒吧当酒保。

e.en: He learned to {bartend} during college.
e.zh: 他在大学期间学会了调酒。

e.en: He {bartended} on weekends to pay his rent.
e.zh: 他周末当酒保以支付房租。

e.en: She {bartended} at that hotel for five years.
e.zh: 她在那家酒店当了五年酒保。

e.en: He took a {bartending} course before moving to the city.
e.zh: 他搬到城里之前上了一门调酒课程。

e.en: {Bartending} pays well if you work the right shifts.
e.zh: 如果排到合适的班次，调酒收入很不错。

e.en: The {bartendress} mixed cocktails with practiced ease.
e.zh: 那位女酒保熟练自如地调着鸡尾酒。

e.en: She worked as a {bartendress} in a small pub.
e.zh: 她在一家小酒馆当女酒保。

bartends.t: 当酒保（bartend的第三人称单数）

e.en: He {bartends} three nights a week.
e.zh: 他每周有三个晚上做酒保。

e.en: She {bartends} at the hotel downtown.
e.zh: 她在市中心的酒店当酒保。

e.en: Ancient {barterers} exchanged grain for cloth at the market.
e.zh: 古代以物易物者在集市上用谷物换布匹。

e.en: The fair attracted {barterers} from neighboring villages.
e.zh: 这场集市吸引了邻村的以物易物者。

e.en: A gilded {baldaquin} hung above the altar.
e.zh: 一座镀金的华盖悬在祭坛之上。

e.en: The throne stood beneath an embroidered {baldaquin}.
e.zh: 宝座立于一顶绣花华盖之下。

e.en: The kids teased the old {baldhead} on the bench.
e.zh: 孩子们取笑长椅上的那个秃头老头。

e.en: He's been a proud {baldhead} since his thirties.
e.zh: 他从三十多岁起就坦然顶着光头。

e.en: A {baldheaded} man waved from the doorway.
e.zh: 一个秃头男人在门口挥手。

e.en: He went {baldheaded} into the negotiation.
e.zh: 他毫无准备地直接闯入谈判。

e.en: A {baldish} man in glasses opened the door.
e.zh: 一个戴眼镜、有点秃的男人开了门。

e.en: He's getting a bit {baldish} on top.
e.zh: 他头顶有点稀疏了。

e.en: The old {baldpate} smiled and tipped his hat.
e.zh: 那个秃头老人微笑着抬了抬帽子。

e.en: A shiny {baldpate} gleamed under the stage lights.
e.zh: 一个光亮的秃头在舞台灯下闪闪发光。

e.en: A {baldpated} judge presided over the trial.
e.zh: 一位秃顶的法官主持了审判。

e.en: The {baldpated} priest greeted us warmly.
e.zh: 那位秃顶的牧师热情地迎接了我们。

e.en: The knight wore a leather {baldric} across his chest.
e.zh: 骑士胸前斜挎着一条皮制的佩剑带。

e.en: His sword hung from an ornate {baldric}.
e.zh: 他的剑挂在一条华丽的肩带上。

e.en: A {balefire} blazed atop the watchtower.
e.zh: 一团烽火在瞭望塔顶燃烧。

e.en: They lit a {balefire} to mark the solstice.
e.zh: 他们点起篝火以庆祝至日。

e.en: She launched a swift {balestra} to surprise her opponent.
e.zh: 她迅速使出跃步进攻，出其不意地攻击对手。

e.en: The fencer's {balestra} caught the judges' attention.
e.zh: 那位击剑手的跃步进攻引起了裁判的注意。

balibuntal.t: 巴厘草编（用于制帽的细草辫）

e.en: She wore a fine {balibuntal} hat to the garden party.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶精致的巴厘草编帽参加花园派对。

e.en: The shop sold elegant {balibuntal} bonnets.
e.zh: 那家店出售优雅的巴厘草编女帽。

e.en: Archers fired through the {balistraria} in the keep wall.
e.zh: 弓箭手透过城堡墙上的射箭孔射击。

e.en: Each tower had a narrow {balistraria} for defense.
e.zh: 每座塔楼都有一个狭窄的射箭孔用于防御。

balkanizes.t: 使（地区或群体）分裂为对立小派

e.en: Partisan media {balkanizes} the country's public discourse.
e.zh: 党派媒体使国家的公共讨论日益分裂对立。

e.en: The reform {balkanizes} an already fragile coalition.
e.zh: 这项改革使本已脆弱的联盟更加四分五裂。

e.en: Critics warned against {balkanizing} the internet into national zones.
e.zh: 批评者警告不要将互联网分裂为各国版块。

e.en: The policy risks {balkanizing} the workforce.
e.zh: 该政策有使员工队伍四分五裂的风险。

balkier.t: 更笨重的；更不听使唤的

e.en: This suitcase is {balkier} than the old one.
e.zh: 这个手提箱比旧的更笨重难拎。

e.en: The mule grew {balkier} as the path steepened.
e.zh: 路越陡，那头骡子越不肯走。

e.en: It was the {balkiest} horse in the stable.
e.zh: 那是马厩里最不听使唤的马。

e.en: He picked up the {balkiest} box on the cart.
e.zh: 他拿起了车上最笨重的那个箱子。

e.en: The donkey's {balkiness} delayed the whole caravan.
e.zh: 那头驴的执拗使整个商队都耽搁了。

e.en: He complained about the cart's {balkiness} on rough roads.
e.zh: 他抱怨那辆车在崎岖路面上的笨重难推。

e.en: He {balkingly} agreed to attend the meeting.
e.zh: 他勉勉强强地同意出席会议。

e.en: The horse moved {balkingly} toward the gate.
e.zh: 那匹马很不情愿地朝大门走去。

e.en: He won the {balkline} championship three years running.
e.zh: 他连续三年赢得界线式台球冠军。

e.en: The cue ball stopped just behind the {balkline}.
e.zh: 母球正好停在界线后方。

ball-and-chain.t: 沉重负担；（戏称）束缚人的配偶

e.en: His debts became a real {ball-and-chain}.
e.zh: 他的债务成了真正的沉重枷锁。

e.en: He jokingly called his wife the old {ball-and-chain}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑地把妻子称作那个'拖油瓶'。

e.en: The hip is a {ball-and-socket} joint.
e.zh: 髋关节是一种球窝关节。

e.en: The lamp uses a {ball-and-socket} mount for flexibility.
e.zh: 那盏灯使用球窝接头以便灵活转动。

e.en: The {ball-boy} ran to fetch the stray ball.
e.zh: 球童跑去捡那颗滚出去的球。

e.en: He worked as a {ball-boy} at the tennis open.
e.zh: 他在网球公开赛上担任球童。

ball-breaker.t: 极难对付的事或人；折磨人的活

e.en: That final exam was a real {ball-breaker}.
e.zh: 那场期末考试真是要命。

e.en: His new boss is a total {ball-breaker}.
e.zh: 他的新老板是个超级难缠的人。

ball-buster.t: 难搞的人或事；苛刻的家伙

e.en: That hike was a real {ball-buster}.
e.zh: 那段徒步真是累死人。

e.en: The drill sergeant is a notorious {ball-buster}.
e.zh: 那位教官是出了名的严苛。

e.en: It was a {ball-busting} schedule of back-to-back meetings.
e.zh: 那是一份连轴开会、累死人的日程。

e.en: They survived a {ball-busting} week of drills.
e.zh: 他们熬过了一周折磨人的训练。

e.en: Their {ball-control} in midfield was outstanding.
e.zh: 他们在中场的控球能力非常出色。

e.en: The coach drilled the team on {ball-control}.
e.zh: 教练专门训练了球队的控球技术。

baudekin.t: 金线锦缎；织金锦（中世纪贵重织物）

e.en: The bishop wore robes of rich {baudekin}.
e.zh: 主教身穿华贵的金线锦缎长袍。

e.en: Medieval merchants traded {baudekin} from the East.
e.zh: 中世纪商人从东方贩运织金锦。

e.en: The region's {bauxitic} soil supports a thriving aluminum industry.
e.zh: 该地区的铝土矿土壤支撑着兴旺的铝业。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {bauxitic} deposits across the plateau.
e.zh: 地质学家测绘了高原上的铝土矿矿藏。

bawbee.t: 苏格兰古铜币；半便士小钱

e.en: The poor lad hadn't a {bawbee} to his name.
e.zh: 这穷小子身上一文钱也没有。

e.en: She spent her last {bawbee} on a loaf of bread.
e.zh: 她把最后一枚小钱花在一条面包上。

bawcock.t: 好小子；好家伙（古语，亲昵称呼）

e.en: How now, my hearty {bawcock}, well met!
e.zh: 哟，我的好小子，幸会幸会！

e.en: Shakespeare's characters greet each other as fine {bawcock}.
e.zh: 莎士比亚剧中人物彼此以「好家伙」相称。

bawdier.t: 更下流的；更猥亵的（bawdy 的比较级）

e.en: His jokes grew {bawdier} as the night wore on.
e.zh: 夜越深，他的笑话越下流。

e.en: The {bawdier} verses were cut from the school edition.
e.zh: 较为猥亵的诗句在学校版本中被删去了。

e.en: Strong emotions can {becloud} your judgment.
e.zh: 强烈的情绪会蒙蔽你的判断力。

e.en: Rumors {becloud} the real issue.
e.zh: 流言遮蔽了真正的问题。

e.en: His vision was {beclouded} by tears.
e.zh: 他的视线被泪水模糊了。

e.en: Her mind was {beclouded} by fear.
e.zh: 她的头脑被恐惧搅乱。

e.en: The fog was {beclouding} the mountain peak.
e.zh: 雾气正笼罩着山峰。

e.en: Anger is {beclouding} your reasoning.
e.zh: 愤怒正在搅乱你的理智。

e.en: Smoke {beclouds} the entire valley.
e.zh: 烟雾笼罩了整个山谷。

e.en: Fatigue {beclouds} his decisions.
e.zh: 疲倦使他的决策变得糊涂。

bed-and-breakfast.t: 提供住宿和早餐的小旅馆

e.en: We stayed at a charming {bed-and-breakfast} by the sea.
e.zh: 我们住在海边一家迷人的家庭旅馆。

e.en: The village has several lovely {bed-and-breakfasts}.
e.zh: 村里有几家可爱的家庭旅馆。

bed-and-breakfasts.t: 提供住宿和早餐的小旅馆

e.en: Many {bed-and-breakfasts} dot the countryside.
e.zh: 乡间散布着许多家庭旅馆。

e.en: She compared prices at three {bed-and-breakfasts}.
e.zh: 她比较了三家家庭旅馆的价格。

bed-blocker.t: 长期占用医院床位的病人

e.en: Hospitals struggle with so-called {bed-blockers}.
e.zh: 医院饱受所谓占床患者之苦。

e.en: He was labeled a {bed-blocker} after recovery.
e.zh: 康复后他被视为占床者。

e.en: The hotel had a serious {bed-bug} problem.
e.zh: 那家酒店有严重的臭虫问题。

e.en: She was bitten by a {bed-bug} overnight.
e.zh: 她夜里被臭虫咬了。

e.en: She washed all the {bed-clothes} on Sunday.
e.zh: 她周日洗了所有的被褥。

e.en: The {bed-clothes} were tangled around him.
e.zh: 被褥缠绕在他身上。

e.en: Politics makes strange {bed-fellows}.
e.zh: 政治造就奇怪的同盟。

e.en: They were unlikely {bed-fellows} on this issue.
e.zh: 在这个问题上他们是出人意料的盟友。

e.en: The cowboys settled the herd on the {bed-ground}.
e.zh: 牛仔们把牛群安顿在过夜场地。

e.en: They picked a flat {bed-ground} for the night.
e.zh: 他们选了一处平坦的过夜地。

e.en: He came downstairs with terrible {bed-head}.
e.zh: 他顶着一头睡乱的头发下了楼。

e.en: A lamp was clipped to the {bed-head}.
e.zh: 一盏灯夹在床头上。

e.en: The novel's hero loves to {bed-hop}.
e.zh: 小说主人公喜欢沾花惹草。

e.en: She refused to {bed-hop} around campus.
e.zh: 她拒绝在校园里乱搞男女关系。

bed-in.t: 为抗议而长时间卧床；磨合

e.en: Lennon and Ono held a famous {bed-in}.
e.zh: 列侬和小野洋子举行过著名的卧床抗议。

e.en: New brakes need time to {bed-in}.
e.zh: 新刹车需要时间磨合。

e.en: Their {bed-ins} drew global attention.
e.zh: 他们的卧床抗议引起了全球关注。

e.en: Several {bed-ins} were staged that year.
e.zh: 那一年举办了好几次卧床抗议。

e.en: The hospital installed a hydraulic {bed-lift}.
e.zh: 医院安装了液压床用升降器。

e.en: A {bed-lift} helps move bedridden patients.
e.zh: 床用升降器帮助搬动卧床病人。

e.en: His dog was his nightly {bed-mate}.
e.zh: 他的狗是他每晚的床伴。

e.en: She missed her warm {bed-mate}.
e.zh: 她想念那位温暖的床伴。

e.en: He unrolled his {bed-roll} by the fire.
e.zh: 他在火堆旁展开铺盖卷。

e.en: Each scout carried a {bed-roll}.
e.zh: 每个童子军都带着一卷铺盖。

e.en: The house has four {bed-rooms}.
e.zh: 这栋房子有四间卧室。

e.en: Both {bed-rooms} face the garden.
e.zh: 两间卧室都朝向花园。

e.en: She changed the {bed-sheet} every week.
e.zh: 她每周更换床单。

e.en: A clean {bed-sheet} feels wonderful.
e.zh: 干净的床单感觉真好。

e.en: He kept a glass of water at his {bed-side}.
e.zh: 他在床边放了一杯水。

e.en: The doctor sat by the patient's {bed-side}.
e.zh: 医生坐在病人床边。

bed-sit.t: 兼作起居室的卧室；单间公寓

e.en: He rented a tiny London {bed-sit}.
e.zh: 他在伦敦租了一间狭小的单间公寓。

e.en: Her first {bed-sit} had a leaky roof.
e.zh: 她第一间单间公寓屋顶漏水。

bed-sitter.t: 兼作起居室的卧室；单间公寓

e.en: The student lived in a cramped {bed-sitter}.
e.zh: 那名学生住在一间拥挤的单间公寓里。

e.en: He furnished his {bed-sitter} on a budget.
e.zh: 他用有限预算布置了单间公寓。

e.en: She advertised her {bed-sitting-room} to let.
e.zh: 她登广告出租那间起居卧室。

e.en: The {bed-sitting-room} overlooked a quiet street.
e.zh: 这间起居卧室俯瞰一条安静的街道。

e.en: The building was divided into {bed-sitting-rooms}.
e.zh: 这栋楼被分隔成多间起居卧室。

e.en: Many students rented {bed-sitting-rooms} nearby.
e.zh: 许多学生在附近租用起居卧室。

e.en: Grandma knitted me woolly {bed-socks}.
e.zh: 奶奶给我织了毛茸茸的睡袜。

e.en: A warm {bed-sock} kept her feet cozy.
e.zh: 温暖的睡袜让她的脚很舒服。

e.en: The hostel offered cheap {bed-space}.
e.zh: 那家旅舍提供廉价床位。

e.en: Hospitals are short of {bed-space}.
e.zh: 医院床位紧缺。

e.en: A loose {bed-spring} squeaked all night.
e.zh: 一根松动的床垫弹簧整夜吱吱作响。

e.en: He felt every {bed-spring} through the mattress.
e.zh: 他隔着床垫能感受到每根弹簧。

e.en: {Bed-wetting} is common in young children.
e.zh: 幼儿尿床是常见现象。

e.en: He outgrew his {bed-wetting} by age seven.
e.zh: 他七岁时就不再尿床了。

e.en: The children {bedaub} the walls with paint.
e.zh: 孩子们把墙涂得到处是颜料。

e.en: Mud {bedaubed} his boots after the hike.
e.zh: 远足后泥巴沾满了他的靴子。

e.en: Ancient walls were {begirding} the small town.
e.zh: 古老的城墙环绕着这座小镇。

e.en: Mist was {begirding} the mountain peak at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分薄雾环绕着山顶。

e.en: A stone wall {begirds} the old monastery.
e.zh: 一道石墙环绕着这座古老的修道院。

e.en: The river {begirds} the entire valley.
e.zh: 这条河环绕着整个山谷。

e.en: The castle stood {begirt} by a deep moat.
e.zh: 城堡被一道深护城河环绕着。

e.en: The island lay {begirt} with coral reefs.
e.zh: 那座小岛被珊瑚礁环绕着。

e.en: The actress tried to {beglamour} the audience.
e.zh: 那位女演员试图迷住观众。

e.en: His charm could {beglamour} anyone he met.
e.zh: 他的魅力能迷住任何遇见他的人。

e.en: Rats began to {begnaw} the wooden beams.
e.zh: 老鼠开始啃咬那些木梁。

e.en: Doubts started to {begnaw} at his confidence.
e.zh: 疑虑开始啃噬他的信心。

e.en: The {begoggled} pilot waved from the cockpit.
e.zh: 戴着护目镜的飞行员从驾驶舱挥手。

e.en: A {begoggled} child rode past on a scooter.
e.zh: 一个戴着护目镜的孩子骑滑板车经过。

e.en: The wizard cried, "{Begone}, foul spirit!"
e.zh: 巫师喊道:"滚开,邪灵!"

e.en: "{Begone} from my sight!" the king roared.
e.zh: "从我眼前消失!"国王怒吼道。

e.en: "{Begorra}, that's a fine horse!" he exclaimed.
e.zh: "天哪,真是匹好马!"他惊叹道。

e.en: "{Begorra}, you've grown so tall!" cried his aunt.
e.zh: "天哪,你长这么高了!"姑姑喊道。

e.en: Coal dust would {begrime} the workers' faces.
e.zh: 煤尘会弄脏工人们的脸。

e.en: Don't let the soot {begrime} your white shirt.
e.zh: 别让煤烟弄脏你的白衬衫。

e.en: His {begrimed} hands left marks everywhere.
e.zh: 他沾满污垢的双手到处留下痕迹。

e.en: The miners emerged with {begrimed} faces.
e.zh: 矿工们出来时脸上沾满了污垢。

e.en: Soot {begrimes} every surface in the workshop.
e.zh: 煤烟弄脏了车间里的每个表面。

e.en: City pollution {begrimes} the old marble statues.
e.zh: 城市污染弄脏了古老的大理石雕像。

e.en: Smoke was {begriming} the freshly painted walls.
e.zh: 烟雾正在弄脏刚粉刷的墙壁。

e.en: Dust kept {begriming} her white cotton dress.
e.zh: 灰尘不断弄脏她的白色棉布裙。

e.en: The salesman's {beguilement} cost her dearly.
e.zh: 那个推销员的欺骗让她损失惨重。

e.en: She read novels for {beguilement} on the train.
e.zh: 她在火车上读小说消遣。

e.en: Beware of {beguilers} promising easy riches.
e.zh: 小心那些承诺轻松致富的骗子。

e.en: Such {beguilers} prey on lonely elderly people.
e.zh: 这种诱骗者专门欺骗孤独的老人。

beguine.t: 贝甘舞（一种加勒比舞蹈）

e.en: They danced a slow {beguine} on the terrace.
e.zh: 他们在露台上跳了一支慢节奏的贝甘舞。

e.en: The band played "Begin the {Beguine}" again.
e.zh: 乐队又演奏了一遍《开始贝甘舞》。

e.en: The program promotes {behavior-change} among teens.
e.zh: 该项目促进青少年的行为改变。

e.en: Lasting {behavior-change} requires consistent effort.
e.zh: 持久的行为改变需要持续的努力。

e.en: Therapists study patients' {behaviour-patterns} carefully.
e.zh: 治疗师仔细研究患者的行为模式。

e.en: Children develop {behaviour-patterns} from their parents.
e.zh: 孩子们从父母那里养成行为模式。

e.en: The {behaviouralist} analyzed voting trends in detail.
e.zh: 那位行为主义学者详细分析了投票趋势。

e.en: As a {behaviouralist}, she studied workplace habits.
e.zh: 作为行为学家,她研究工作场所的习惯。

e.en: His {behaviouristic} approach ignored mental states.
e.zh: 他的行为主义方法忽略了心理状态。

e.en: They applied a {behaviouristic} model to learning.
e.zh: 他们将行为主义模型应用于学习。

e.en: The deal was negotiated {behind-closed-doors}.
e.zh: 这笔交易是秘密谈判达成的。

e.en: Decisions made {behind-closed-doors} eroded public trust.
e.zh: 暗箱操作的决定削弱了公众的信任。

behind-the-counter.t: 柜台后的；需药剂师配售的

e.en: That medicine is sold {behind-the-counter} only.
e.zh: 那种药只在柜台后凭处方出售。

e.en: She worked {behind-the-counter} at the pharmacy.
e.zh: 她在药房柜台后工作。

e.en: They shared {behind-the-scene} stories from the film.
e.zh: 他们分享了影片的幕后故事。

e.en: Much {behind-the-scene} work made it possible.
e.zh: 许多幕后工作才使之成为可能。

e.en: A lot of {behind-the-scenes} negotiation occurred.
e.zh: 幕后进行了大量谈判。

e.en: The documentary shows {behind-the-scenes} footage.
e.zh: 这部纪录片展示了幕后花絮。

e.en: Don't text while {behind-the-wheel} of a car.
e.zh: 开车时不要发短信。

e.en: He spent hours {behind-the-wheel} every day.
e.zh: 他每天花数小时开车。

behindhand.t: 落后的；拖延的；过期未付的

e.en: They were {behindhand} with the rent again.
e.zh: 他们又拖欠了房租。

e.en: He felt {behindhand} on all his projects.
e.zh: 他觉得所有项目都落后了。

e.en: He spoke at length on her {behoof}.
e.zh: 他长篇大论地为她的利益辩护。

e.en: The trust was set up for the children's {behoof}.
e.zh: 信托是为了孩子们的利益而设立的。

e.en: The walls were {behung} with ancient tapestries.
e.zh: 墙上挂着古老的挂毯。

e.en: Trees stood {behung} with colorful lanterns.
e.zh: 树上挂着五彩缤纷的灯笼。

e.en: The factory produces {beetsugar} for export.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产甜菜糖用于出口。

e.en: Europe relies heavily on {beetsugar} production.
e.zh: 欧洲在很大程度上依赖甜菜糖生产。

e.en: He took a punch right on the {beezer}.
e.zh: 他鼻子上正中一拳。

e.en: That old {beezer} still tells the best jokes.
e.zh: 那个老家伙讲的笑话还是最棒的。

e.en: She was {befittingly} dressed for the ceremony.
e.zh: 她为这场典礼穿戴得十分得体。

e.en: He responded {befittingly} to the criticism.
e.zh: 他对批评做出了得体的回应。

e.en: They {beflower} the church for every wedding.
e.zh: 他们每次婚礼都用鲜花装点教堂。

e.en: Spring will soon {beflower} the meadows again.
e.zh: 春天很快又会让草地繁花盛开。

e.en: Don't {befog} the issue with irrelevant details.
e.zh: 别用无关的细节把问题搞混。

e.en: Heavy mist began to {befog} the valley.
e.zh: 浓雾开始笼罩整个山谷。

befogged.t: 被弄糊涂的；被雾笼罩的

e.en: His mind was {befogged} by lack of sleep.
e.zh: 由于缺乏睡眠他头脑昏沉。

e.en: The {befogged} hills disappeared from view.
e.zh: 被雾笼罩的山丘从视野中消失了。

e.en: His explanation was actually {befogging} the issue.
e.zh: 他的解释其实让问题更模糊了。

e.en: A {befogging} mist settled over the harbor.
e.zh: 一层迷蒙的雾气笼罩了港口。

e.en: Jargon often {befogs} otherwise simple ideas.
e.zh: 行话常常把本来简单的想法搞得模糊不清。

e.en: Smoke {befogs} the city every autumn.
e.zh: 每到秋天烟雾就笼罩这座城市。

e.en: Don't let smooth talkers {befool} you.
e.zh: 别让花言巧语的人愚弄你。

e.en: He tried to {befool} the judges with false credentials.
e.zh: 他试图用伪造的证书蒙骗评委。

e.en: She felt {befooled} by his empty promises.
e.zh: 她觉得自己被他空洞的承诺愚弄了。

e.en: The crowd was easily {befooled} by the magician.
e.zh: 观众轻易就被魔术师骗倒了。

e.en: He has a knack for {befooling} gullible investors.
e.zh: 他很擅长愚弄轻信的投资者。

e.en: Stop {befooling} yourself about his intentions.
e.zh: 别再自欺欺人地揣度他的意图了。

e.en: Flattery often {befools} even sensible people.
e.zh: 奉承常常连明智的人也会被骗倒。

e.en: He {befools} his rivals with clever misdirection.
e.zh: 他用巧妙的误导手法愚弄对手。

e.en: The ad showed {before-and-after} photos of customers.
e.zh: 广告展示了顾客的前后对比照片。

e.en: She loves watching {before-and-after} renovation videos.
e.zh: 她喜欢看装修前后对比视频。

e.en: Please book your tickets {before-hand}.
e.zh: 请提前预订车票。

e.en: We prepared everything {before-hand}.
e.zh: 我们事先把一切都准备好了。

e.en: Her {before-tax} income exceeds 100,000 dollars.
e.zh: 她的税前收入超过十万美元。

e.en: The figures shown are {before-tax} amounts.
e.zh: 所示数字为税前金额。

e.en: {Beforetime} this land belonged to the king.
e.zh: 从前这片土地属于国王。

e.en: As was the custom {beforetime}, they bowed deeply.
e.zh: 按照从前的习俗，他们深深鞠躬。

e.en: The river suffered serious {befoulment} from the factory.
e.zh: 这条河遭到工厂的严重污染。

e.en: He spoke of the {befoulment} of his good name.
e.zh: 他谈到自己名誉受到的玷污。

e.en: Her {befriendment} of the new student was kind.
e.zh: 她主动结交新同学的举动很善良。

e.en: The dog's {befriendment} of the cat surprised us.
e.zh: 那只狗与猫成了朋友，让我们很惊讶。

e.en: Tall reeds {befringe} the quiet pond.
e.zh: 高高的芦苇围在静静的池塘边。

e.en: They {befringe} the curtains with golden tassels.
e.zh: 他们给窗帘镶上金色流苏。

e.en: "{Begad}, that was a close call!" he cried.
e.zh: "天哪，真是惊险！"他喊道。

e.en: {Begad}, I never expected to see you here.
e.zh: 天哪，我没想到会在这里见到你。

begem.t: 以宝石装饰；如宝石般点缀

e.en: Dewdrops {begem} the morning grass.
e.zh: 露珠像宝石般点缀着清晨的草地。

e.en: Craftsmen {begem} the crown with rubies.
e.zh: 工匠用红宝石装饰这顶王冠。

begemmed.t: 镶满宝石的；如宝石点缀的

e.en: She wore a {begemmed} tiara to the ball.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶镶满宝石的头冠去舞会。

e.en: The night sky was {begemmed} with stars.
e.zh: 夜空中繁星点点如宝石般闪烁。

e.en: Frost was slowly {begemming} every leaf.
e.zh: 霜慢慢把每一片叶子点缀得如宝石般。

e.en: The jeweler is {begemming} the new bracelet.
e.zh: 珠宝匠正在给新手镯镶嵌宝石。

beggar-my-neighbor.t: 损人利己（政策）；一种纸牌游戏

e.en: The tariffs amounted to a {beggar-my-neighbor} policy.
e.zh: 这些关税相当于一种损人利己的政策。

e.en: The kids played {beggar-my-neighbor} all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在玩"敲三家"纸牌游戏。

beggar-my-neighbour.t: 损人利己（政策）；一种纸牌游戏

e.en: Such {beggar-my-neighbour} tactics hurt global trade.
e.zh: 这种损人利己的策略损害了全球贸易。

e.en: We learned {beggar-my-neighbour} from our grandmother.
e.zh: 我们从外婆那里学会了"敲三家"纸牌游戏。

e.en: The novel depicts the harsh world of {beggardom}.
e.zh: 这部小说描绘了乞丐世界的艰辛。

e.en: He sank into {beggardom} after losing everything.
e.zh: 他失去一切后沦为乞丐。

e.en: Illness drove the family into {beggarhood}.
e.zh: 疾病让这一家沦为乞丐。

e.en: He wrote movingly about his years of {beggarhood}.
e.zh: 他动人地写下了自己乞讨为生的岁月。

e.en: The room's {beggarliness} shocked the visitors.
e.zh: 房间的寒酸让访客大为震惊。

e.en: He hated the {beggarliness} of his upbringing.
e.zh: 他憎恶自己成长环境的贫困寒酸。

e.en: Gambling reduced him to {beggary}.
e.zh: 赌博使他沦为乞丐。

e.en: The war left thousands in utter {beggary}.
e.zh: 战争让数千人陷入赤贫。

e.en: Stone walls {begird} the ancient city.
e.zh: 石墙环绕着这座古城。

e.en: Mountains {begird} the lonely valley.
e.zh: 群山环抱着这座僻静的山谷。

e.en: The fortress was {begirded} by a deep moat.
e.zh: 这座要塞被一条深深的护城河环绕。

e.en: He {begirded} himself with a leather belt.
e.zh: 他用皮带束在腰间。

e.en: Drugs that block the {beta-receptor} can lower blood pressure.
e.zh: 阻断β受体的药物可以降低血压。

e.en: The {beta-receptor} plays a key role in heart rate regulation.
e.zh: β受体在心率调节中起关键作用。

beta-test.t: 对软件进行测试版试用

e.en: We will {beta-test} the new app next month.
e.zh: 我们下个月将对新应用进行测试版试用。

e.en: Volunteers helped {beta-test} the game before launch.
e.zh: 志愿者在发布前帮助测试这款游戏。

e.en: Carrots are rich in {betacarotene}.
e.zh: 胡萝卜富含β-胡萝卜素。

e.en: The body converts {betacarotene} into vitamin A.
e.zh: 人体会将β-胡萝卜素转化为维生素A。

e.en: He decided to {betake} himself to the countryside.
e.zh: 他决定动身前往乡下。

e.en: She would {betake} herself to her studies after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后她会去专心读书。

e.en: He had {betaken} himself to a quiet inn.
e.zh: 他已动身前往一家安静的客栈。

e.en: They had {betaken} themselves to prayer.
e.zh: 他们已开始专心祈祷。

e.en: He {betakes} himself to the library each morning.
e.zh: 他每天早晨都去图书馆。

e.en: She {betakes} herself to writing whenever she can.
e.zh: 一有机会她就埋头写作。

betcha.t: 我敢打赌（bet you的口语缩写）

e.en: You {betcha} I'll be there on time!
e.zh: 你放心吧，我肯定准时到！

e.en: I {betcha} he forgets her birthday again.
e.zh: 我敢打赌他又会忘了她的生日。

e.en: He sat by the fire, {bethinking} himself of his youth.
e.zh: 他坐在炉边，回想起自己的青年时代。

e.en: She kept {bethinking} herself of unfinished tasks.
e.zh: 她不停地想起那些未完成的事。

bethinks.t: 想起；思量（bethink的第三人称单数）

e.en: He {bethinks} himself of an old friend.
e.zh: 他想起了一位老朋友。

e.en: She {bethinks} herself of the lesson she once learned.
e.zh: 她回想起自己曾经学到的教训。

bethought.t: 想起；考虑（bethink的过去式与过去分词）

e.en: He {bethought} himself of his promise.
e.zh: 他想起了自己许下的承诺。

e.en: She {bethought} herself of an old letter in the drawer.
e.zh: 她想起抽屉里有一封旧信。

e.en: The bullies tried to {bethump} him after class.
e.zh: 那些恶霸下课后想痛打他一顿。

e.en: He swore he would {bethump} anyone who insulted his family.
e.zh: 他发誓要痛打任何侮辱他家人的人。

e.en: He devoted his life to {bibliology} and rare manuscripts.
e.zh: 他毕生致力于书志学和珍稀手稿研究。

e.en: The course covers {bibliology} from medieval scrolls onward.
e.zh: 该课程涵盖从中世纪卷轴以来的书志学。

e.en: She practiced {bibliomancy} by opening the Bible at random.
e.zh: 她随手翻开圣经进行书卜。

e.en: Ancient scholars sometimes used {bibliomancy} to make decisions.
e.zh: 古代学者有时用翻书占卜来做决定。

e.en: His {bibliomania} filled every room with old books.
e.zh: 他的藏书癖让每个房间都堆满旧书。

e.en: Collectors with {bibliomania} will pay anything for first editions.
e.zh: 有藏书癖的收藏家愿为初版书一掷千金。

e.en: The old {bibliomaniac} owned thirty thousand volumes.
e.zh: 那位老藏书狂拥有三万册书。

e.en: Only a true {bibliomaniac} would buy that duplicate.
e.zh: 只有真正的藏书狂才会买那本重复的书。

e.en: He has {bibliomaniacal} tendencies that worry his family.
e.zh: 他有藏书狂的倾向，让家人担心。

e.en: Her {bibliomaniacal} obsession drained the household budget.
e.zh: 她嗜书成癖耗尽了家里的预算。

e.en: The library used a {bibliometer} to gauge reader activity.
e.zh: 图书馆用图书计量器来衡量读者活动。

e.en: A {bibliometer} once measured how often books were borrowed.
e.zh: 图书计量器曾用来测量借阅频率。

bibliopegic.t: 装帧的；与书籍装订有关的

e.en: The museum displayed several {bibliopegic} masterpieces from Florence.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几件来自佛罗伦萨的装帧杰作。

e.en: Her {bibliopegic} skills are admired across Europe.
e.zh: 她的装帧技艺在欧洲广受赞誉。

e.en: The {bibliopegist} restored the leather covers beautifully.
e.zh: 那位装帧家把皮革封面修复得很漂亮。

e.en: Only a master {bibliopegist} could repair this binding.
e.zh: 只有装帧大师才能修复这种装订。

bibliopegistic.t: 图书装帧的；装订工艺的

e.en: The exhibition highlighted {bibliopegistic} techniques from the Renaissance.
e.zh: 展览着重介绍了文艺复兴时期的图书装帧工艺。

e.en: He published a {bibliopegistic} study of medieval bindings.
e.zh: 他发表了一项关于中世纪装订的装帧工艺研究。

e.en: Fine {bibliopegy} requires both patience and artistry.
e.zh: 精良的装帧术需要耐心和艺术修养。

e.en: He studied {bibliopegy} under a master in Paris.
e.zh: 他在巴黎师从大师学习装帧术。

e.en: As a {bibliophage}, she devours three novels a week.
e.zh: 作为一个书虫，她每周啃完三本小说。

e.en: Every true {bibliophage} loves the smell of old pages.
e.zh: 每个真正的书虫都喜欢旧书页的味道。

e.en: Any {bibliophil} would treasure this rare edition.
e.zh: 任何爱书人都会珍视这本稀有版本。

e.en: He's a {bibliophil} with a vast personal library.
e.zh: 他是个爱书人，私人藏书极丰。

e.en: Her {bibliophilic} passion drove her to every used bookstore.
e.zh: 她的爱书热情驱使她逛遍每家旧书店。

e.en: The club caters to {bibliophilic} tastes.
e.zh: 这个俱乐部迎合爱书者的品味。

e.en: His {bibliophilism} began in childhood with picture books.
e.zh: 他的爱书癖始于童年时的图画书。

e.en: {Bibliophilism} is a harmless but expensive hobby.
e.zh: 嗜书是种无害却昂贵的爱好。

e.en: The {bibliophilist} kept his rare folios in a glass case.
e.zh: 这位藏书家把珍本对开本放在玻璃柜里。

e.en: Every {bibliophilist} dreams of owning a Gutenberg Bible.
e.zh: 每位藏书家都梦想拥有一本古腾堡圣经。

e.en: His {bibliophily} eventually became a profitable business.
e.zh: 他对书的喜爱最终发展成一项有利可图的事业。

e.en: {Bibliophily} runs in our family across generations.
e.zh: 我们家几代人都热爱藏书。

e.en: His {bibliophobia} made school assignments very difficult.
e.zh: 他的恐书症让学校作业变得很困难。

e.en: Few people genuinely suffer from {bibliophobia}.
e.zh: 真正患恐书症的人很少。

e.en: The {bibliopolar} trade flourished along the Seine.
e.zh: 塞纳河沿岸的书商生意兴隆。

e.en: His family ran a {bibliopolar} shop for generations.
e.zh: 他家几代人经营售书生意。

e.en: The old {bibliopole} knew every rare title in Paris.
e.zh: 那位老书商熟知巴黎每一本珍本书。

e.en: A {bibliopole} appraised the manuscript at thousands.
e.zh: 一位书商把这份手稿估价数千元。

e.en: The {bibliopolic} guild met monthly in the cathedral.
e.zh: 书商行会每月在大教堂聚会。

e.en: His {bibliopolic} reputation reached collectors abroad.
e.zh: 他作为书商的名声传到了海外的收藏家圈子。

e.en: {Bibliopolism} thrived in nineteenth-century London.
e.zh: 售书业在十九世纪的伦敦十分兴盛。

e.en: He learned {bibliopolism} from his uncle's shop.
e.zh: 他从叔叔的书店里学会了售书生意。

e.en: The {bibliopolist} specialized in eighteenth-century poetry.
e.zh: 这位书商专营十八世纪诗集。

e.en: A respected {bibliopolist} attended every major auction.
e.zh: 一位备受尊敬的书商出席每场重要拍卖。

e.en: {Bibliopoly} once centered around the cathedral square.
e.zh: 书业曾以大教堂广场为中心。

e.en: His grandfather entered {bibliopoly} as a young apprentice.
e.zh: 他祖父年轻时当学徒进入书业。

e.en: The monastery's {bibliotheca} contained ancient illuminated manuscripts.
e.zh: 修道院的藏书室藏有古代彩绘手稿。

e.en: Scholars came from afar to consult the {bibliotheca}.
e.zh: 学者们从远方赶来查阅这座藏书馆。

e.en: The {bibliothecarian} cataloged every incoming volume by hand.
e.zh: 那位图书馆员手工编目每一本新到的书。

e.en: A learned {bibliothecarian} guided us through the archives.
e.zh: 一位博学的藏书管理员领我们参观档案。

e.en: The {bibliothecary} kept meticulous records of every loan.
e.zh: 图书馆员对每次借阅都保存详尽记录。

e.en: Her {bibliothecary} duties included rare-book preservation.
e.zh: 她的图书馆员职责包括珍本保护。

e.en: Doctors recommended {bibliotherapy} to ease her anxiety.
e.zh: 医生建议用阅读疗法来缓解她的焦虑。

e.en: {Bibliotherapy} can help children process difficult emotions.
e.zh: 阅读疗法能帮助孩子处理复杂情绪。

bibliothetic.t: 图书排架的；图书分类排列的

e.en: The new {bibliothetic} system organizes books by subject.
e.zh: 新的图书排架系统按主题组织书籍。

e.en: Modern libraries follow {bibliothetic} principles for accessibility.
e.zh: 现代图书馆遵循图书排架原则以便取阅。

e.en: He applied {bibliotic} methods to date the manuscript.
e.zh: 他用文献鉴定方法来确定手稿年代。

e.en: The forgery was exposed by careful {bibliotic} analysis.
e.zh: 通过细致的文献鉴定分析，这份伪作被揭穿。

e.en: {Bibliotics} helps determine the authenticity of old documents.
e.zh: 文献鉴定学有助于判定古文献的真伪。

e.en: She studied {bibliotics} to authenticate historical letters.
e.zh: 她学习文献鉴定学以鉴定历史信件。

e.en: A respected {bibliotist} examined the disputed signature.
e.zh: 一位德高望重的文献鉴定专家检查了那个有争议的签名。

e.en: The {bibliotist} concluded the document was a forgery.
e.zh: 文献鉴定专家断定那份文件是伪造的。

e.en: Botanists noted the plant's {bibracteate} flower structure.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物花具二苞片。

e.en: The species is easily identified by its {bibracteate} stems.
e.zh: 该物种很容易凭其具二苞片的茎来辨认。

e.en: His {bibulosity} eventually ruined his health.
e.zh: 他嗜酒最终毁了健康。

e.en: The poet's {bibulosity} was legendary among friends.
e.zh: 这位诗人的嗜酒在朋友间是出了名的。

e.en: The orchid has a {bicalcrate} lip with two spurs.
e.zh: 这种兰花的唇瓣具两距。

e.en: Botanists describe the flower as {bicalcrate}.
e.zh: 植物学家将这种花描述为具两距的。

e.en: The fruit develops into a {bicapsular} structure when ripe.
e.zh: 果实成熟时形成双蒴结构。

e.en: This species is distinguished by its {bicapsular} seed pods.
e.zh: 该物种以其二室蒴果而区别于他种。

e.en: Add a teaspoon of {bicarb} to the cookie dough.
e.zh: 在饼干面团里加一茶匙小苏打。

e.en: She used {bicarb} to clean the stained kettle.
e.zh: 她用小苏打清洁污渍斑斑的水壶。

e.en: The doctor reviewed the patient's {bicardiogram} for irregularities.
e.zh: 医生查看了病人的双心电图以发现异常。

e.en: A {bicardiogram} records signals from both sides of the heart.
e.zh: 双心电图记录心脏两侧的信号。

e.en: The larva has a distinctive {bicaudate} appearance.
e.zh: 幼虫具有独特的双尾外观。

e.en: Several reef fish are notably {bicaudate}.
e.zh: 有几种珊瑚礁鱼类明显呈双尾形。

e.en: The artist mixed a touch of {bice} into the sky.
e.zh: 画家在天空里调了一点灰蓝色。

e.en: Her dress was the soft {bice} of a winter morning.
e.zh: 她的连衣裙是冬日清晨那种柔和的灰蓝色。

e.en: The study took a {bicentric} approach across two hospitals.
e.zh: 该研究在两家医院采取双中心的方式进行。

e.en: This species shows a {bicentric} distribution in Asia.
e.zh: 该物种在亚洲呈双中心分布。

e.en: Mythology often features a {bicephalous} dragon guarding treasure.
e.zh: 神话中常出现守护宝藏的双头龙。

e.en: The country's {bicephalous} leadership confused foreign diplomats.
e.zh: 该国的双头领导让外国外交官感到困惑。

e.en: Mercury {bichlorid} was once used as an antiseptic.
e.zh: 二氯化汞曾被用作消毒剂。

e.en: The lab synthesized a new {bichlorid} compound.
e.zh: 实验室合成了一种新的二氯化物。

e.en: Mercury {bichloride} is highly toxic and corrosive.
e.zh: 二氯化汞剧毒且具腐蚀性。

e.en: The compound is a {bichloride} of mercury.
e.zh: 这种化合物是汞的二氯化物。

e.en: Her fluffy white {bichon} loved chasing the ball.
e.zh: 她那只毛茸茸的白色比熊犬喜欢追球。

e.en: The {bichon} is known for its cheerful temperament.
e.zh: 比熊犬以性情开朗而闻名。

e.en: The wrestler executed a perfect {backfall}.
e.zh: 那名摔跤手完成了一个漂亮的后摔。

e.en: She suffered a sudden {backfall} on the icy stairs.
e.zh: 她在结冰的楼梯上突然向后摔倒。

backflash.t: 回火现象；闪回的瞬间记忆

e.en: The welder dodged a sudden {backflash} from the torch.
e.zh: 焊工躲开了焊枪突然冒出的回火。

e.en: A {backflash} of memory hit him at the door.
e.zh: 他在门口突然闪现一段回忆。

e.en: He engaged the {backgear} to slow the lathe.
e.zh: 他挂上减速齿轮以放慢车床转速。

e.en: The old machine's {backgear} was badly worn.
e.zh: 那台旧机器的减速齿轮已严重磨损。

e.en: The truck found a profitable {backhaul} from Chicago.
e.zh: 卡车从芝加哥揽到了一笔有利可图的回程货。

e.en: Cellular networks rely on fiber for {backhaul}.
e.zh: 蜂窝网络依靠光纤进行回程传输。

e.en: The carrier was {backhauling} empty containers home.
e.zh: 承运人正把空集装箱回程运回。

e.en: They saved fuel by {backhauling} every load.
e.zh: 他们靠每趟回程载货来节省燃料。

backheating.t: 回热加热；尾部回流加热

e.en: The furnace uses {backheating} to improve efficiency.
e.zh: 该炉子采用回热方式提高效率。

e.en: Engineers studied the {backheating} of the kiln.
e.zh: 工程师研究了窑炉的回热现象。

backhouse.t: 屋后小屋；旧时室外厕所

e.en: Grandpa still used the old {backhouse} on the farm.
e.zh: 祖父在农场上仍在使用那间旧的室外厕所。

e.en: Tools were stored in the {backhouse} behind the barn.
e.zh: 工具都存放在谷仓后的小屋里。

e.en: The mason carefully cut a {backjoint} in the stone.
e.zh: 石匠在石块上小心地凿出后凹槽。

e.en: A clean {backjoint} keeps the wall watertight.
e.zh: 干净利落的后接缝能让墙体不渗水。

backlining.t: 书脊衬里；后部加衬材料

e.en: The conservator replaced the worn {backlining}.
e.zh: 修复师更换了破旧的书脊衬里。

e.en: Heavy {backlining} reinforces the spine of the book.
e.zh: 厚实的后衬能加固书脊。

e.en: The publisher's {backlist} still sells steadily.
e.zh: 这家出版社的存货书目仍销量稳定。

e.en: Classic novels fill most of their {backlist}.
e.zh: 他们的存货书目里大多是经典小说。

backlists.t: 出版社的现存书目列表

e.en: Both publishers maintain extensive {backlists}.
e.zh: 两家出版社都保有大量存货书目。

e.en: Their {backlists} include hundreds of titles.
e.zh: 他们的存货书目包含数百种图书。

e.en: The contract avoids {backloading} the costs.
e.zh: 该合同避免把成本推到后期。

e.en: Trucks save money through {backloading}.
e.zh: 卡车通过回程装货节省费用。

e.en: They filmed the chase on the studio {backlot}.
e.zh: 他们在片场外景地拍摄了那场追逐戏。

e.en: Tourists wandered the famous {backlot} all day.
e.zh: 游客们在那著名的片场外景地逛了一整天。

e.en: Hollywood {backlots} are shrinking each year.
e.zh: 好莱坞的外景场地正逐年缩小。

e.en: Several {backlots} were sold to developers.
e.zh: 几处外景场地被卖给了开发商。

e.en: The leader lapped a slow {backmarker} on turn three.
e.zh: 领跑者在第三弯道追上了一名垫底选手。

e.en: The {backmarker} fought hard to avoid last place.
e.zh: 那名垫底选手拼命想摆脱最后一名。

e.en: She sat in the {backmost} row of the theater.
e.zh: 她坐在剧院最后一排。

e.en: The {backmost} car of the train was empty.
e.zh: 列车最后一节车厢空无一人。

backnumber.t: 过期刊物；过时的人或事物

e.en: He searched for a {backnumber} of the magazine.
e.zh: 他在找一本过期的杂志。

e.en: That style is a complete {backnumber} now.
e.zh: 那种风格现在已经完全过时了。

e.en: Plug the cable into the {backpanel} of the router.
e.zh: 把电缆插到路由器后面板上。

e.en: The amplifier's {backpanel} has many inputs.
e.zh: 功放的后面板上有许多输入接口。

e.en: He gave his son a quick {backpat}.
e.zh: 他迅速地拍了拍儿子的背。

e.en: The speech was just one long {backpat}.
e.zh: 那番讲话不过是一长串自我吹嘘。

e.en: The minister began to {backpedal} on his promise.
e.zh: 那位部长开始在自己的承诺上退缩。

e.en: He had to {backpedal} hard to stay upright.
e.zh: 他得使劲倒蹬车才能保持平衡。

e.en: The senator quickly {backpedaled} after the backlash.
e.zh: 在受到反对后那位参议员迅速改口。

e.en: She {backpedaled} when she saw the dog.
e.zh: 她看到那条狗时连忙后退。

e.en: He kept {backpedaling} on every campaign promise.
e.zh: 他在每一项竞选承诺上都不断改口。

e.en: She was {backpedaling} furiously on her bike.
e.zh: 她正拼命地倒蹬自行车。

e.en: The CEO {backpedalled} on his earlier remarks.
e.zh: 那位首席执行官在自己先前的言论上改口了。

e.en: Reporters noticed how he {backpedalled} so quickly.
e.zh: 记者们注意到他改口之快。

backpedalling.t: 正在改口；正在退缩（英式）

e.en: The minister was clearly {backpedalling} in the interview.
e.zh: 那位部长在采访中显然正在改口。

e.en: He kept {backpedalling} when asked tough questions.
e.zh: 被问到尖锐问题时他不停地退缩。

e.en: He always {backpedals} when challenged in public.
e.zh: 他在公开场合被质疑时总是改口。

e.en: She {backpedals} furiously down the steep hill.
e.zh: 她在陡坡上拼命倒蹬。

e.en: Engineers measured the gear's {backpitch} carefully.
e.zh: 工程师仔细测量了齿轮的反向螺距。

e.en: The pitcher tried an unusual {backpitch} grip.
e.zh: 投手尝试了一种少见的反握投球方式。

e.en: The server's {backplane} connects all the modules.
e.zh: 服务器的背板把所有模块连接起来。

e.en: A faulty {backplane} caused the entire outage.
e.zh: 一块故障背板导致了整次停机。

e.en: Researchers {backproject} the image onto the model.
e.zh: 研究者将图像反向投影到模型上。

e.en: They {backproject} CT slices to reconstruct the volume.
e.zh: 他们反向投影CT切片以重建立体图像。

e.en: The CT scanner uses filtered {backprojection} algorithms.
e.zh: CT扫描仪使用滤波反投影算法。

e.en: Filtered {backprojection} sharpens the reconstructed image.
e.zh: 滤波反投影能让重建图像更清晰。

e.en: We took a quiet {backroad} home.
e.zh: 我们走了一条安静的乡间小路回家。

e.en: The {backroad} wound through old farms.
e.zh: 那条小路蜿蜒穿过老农场。

backrope.t: 后支索；船尾系船的绳索

e.en: The sailors tightened the {backrope} before the storm.
e.zh: 水手们在风暴来临前拉紧了后支索。

e.en: A frayed {backrope} can endanger the rigging.
e.zh: 磨损的后支索会危及整个索具。

backrub.t: 按摩背部；轻揉对方的背

e.en: She gave her tired husband a {backrub}.
e.zh: 她给疲惫的丈夫揉了揉背。

e.en: A short {backrub} eased his sore shoulders.
e.zh: 短暂揉背让他酸痛的肩膀舒服了不少。

e.en: Long {backrubs} are her favorite reward.
e.zh: 长时间揉背是她最爱的奖励。

e.en: He gives the best {backrubs} after work.
e.zh: 他下班后揉背最舒服。

backrun.t: 反向流动；水彩中的水痕

e.en: A {backrun} ruined the wet watercolor wash.
e.zh: 一道水痕毁掉了湿润的水彩晕染。

e.en: Engineers prevented a {backrun} of fluid.
e.zh: 工程师阻止了液体的反向回流。

e.en: Radar relies on {backscattering} from raindrops.
e.zh: 雷达依赖于雨滴的背向散射。

e.en: Electron {backscattering} reveals the crystal structure.
e.zh: 电子背向散射能揭示晶体结构。

e.en: Grandma keeps a wooden {backscratcher} by the bed.
e.zh: 奶奶在床边放着一只木制挠背器。

e.en: He bought a bamboo {backscratcher} as a gag gift.
e.zh: 他买了一只竹制不求人当作搞笑礼物。

backscratching.t: 挠背；互相利用，互相吹捧

e.en: The committee was full of mutual {backscratching}.
e.zh: 委员会里充斥着相互吹捧。

e.en: The cat enjoys gentle {backscratching} every morning.
e.zh: 那只猫每天早上都喜欢轻轻挠背。

e.en: Travelers offered a small {backsheesh} to the guard.
e.zh: 旅客给了卫兵一点小费。

e.en: Officials demanded {backsheesh} before stamping documents.
e.zh: 官员们在盖章前索要贿赂。

e.en: Workers on the {backshift} go home at midnight.
e.zh: 上傍晚班的工人午夜下班。

e.en: Reported speech often requires a tense {backshift}.
e.zh: 间接引语常常需要时态后移。

e.en: The luthier described the instrument as {bichord} because each note has two strings.
e.zh: 制琴师称这件乐器为双弦琴，因为每个音都有两根弦。

e.en: Mandolins are typical {bichord} instruments.
e.zh: 曼陀林是典型的双弦乐器。

e.en: The lab uses potassium {bichromate} as an oxidizing agent.
e.zh: 实验室使用重铬酸钾作为氧化剂。

e.en: Old photographic processes relied on {bichromate} salts.
e.zh: 早期摄影工艺依赖重铬酸盐。

e.en: The print was made on {bichromated} gelatin.
e.zh: 这张照片是在经重铬酸盐处理的明胶上制作的。

e.en: {Bichromated} colloid hardens when exposed to light.
e.zh: 经重铬酸盐处理的胶体见光会硬化。

e.en: The pottery features a striking {bichrome} pattern.
e.zh: 这件陶器有醒目的双色花纹。

e.en: Archaeologists unearthed several {bichrome} vases.
e.zh: 考古学家出土了几只双色陶瓶。

e.en: The protocol calls for {bicine} buffer at pH 8.
e.zh: 实验方案要求使用 pH 8 的双甘氨肽缓冲液。

e.en: We replaced Tris with {bicine} for better stability.
e.zh: 我们用双甘氨肽替换了 Tris 以获得更好的稳定性。

e.en: The doctor pointed to the {bicipital} groove on the humerus.
e.zh: 医生指着肱骨上的二头肌沟。

e.en: He felt pain along the {bicipital} tendon.
e.zh: 他感到二头肌肌腱处疼痛。

e.en: The geometer studied a {bicircular} quartic curve.
e.zh: 这位几何学家研究了一种双圆四次曲线。

e.en: Möbius transformations preserve {bicircular} structures.
e.zh: 莫比乌斯变换保持双圆结构不变。

e.en: The blacksmith shaped the rivet on a small {bickern}.
e.zh: 铁匠在一个小双角铁砧上锻造铆钉。

e.en: A {bickern} has two tapering horns for fine work.
e.zh: 双角铁砧有两个尖角，用于精细加工。

e.en: Grab some {bickies} to go with the tea.
e.zh: 拿点饼干配茶喝。

e.en: That car must have cost a few {bickies}.
e.zh: 那辆车想必花了不少钱。

e.en: He clamped the {bickiron} into the vise.
e.zh: 他把双角铁砧夹进台钳里。

e.en: A jeweler's {bickiron} is delicate and small.
e.zh: 珠宝匠用的双角铁砧小巧精致。

e.en: Want a {bicky} with your cuppa?
e.zh: 喝茶要不要配块饼干？

e.en: The dog begged for a {bicky}.
e.zh: 狗狗讨着要饼干吃。

e.en: Some shorebirds are described as {bicolligate}.
e.zh: 一些滨鸟被描述为蹼连两趾的。

e.en: The {bicolligate} foot helps the bird wade.
e.zh: 蹼连两趾的足部有助于这种鸟涉水。

e.en: She bought a {bicolor} scarf in red and white.
e.zh: 她买了一条红白双色的围巾。

e.en: The team unveiled a {bicolor} jersey.
e.zh: 球队公布了一款双色球衣。

e.en: The cat had a striking {bicolored} coat.
e.zh: 那只猫有一身醒目的双色皮毛。

e.en: He wore {bicolored} shoes to the party.
e.zh: 他穿着双色皮鞋去派对。

e.en: The chemist measured absorbance with a {bicolorimeter}.
e.zh: 化学家用双色比色计测量吸光度。

e.en: A {bicolorimeter} compares two wavelengths simultaneously.
e.zh: 双色比色计可同时比较两种波长。

e.en: The shop sells solids and {bicolors}.
e.zh: 店里出售纯色款和双色款。

e.en: These {bicolors} are this season's bestsellers.
e.zh: 这些双色款是本季的畅销品。

e.en: The flag is a simple {bicolour} design.
e.zh: 这面旗帜是简洁的双色设计。

e.en: They chose a {bicolour} scheme for the logo.
e.zh: 他们为标识选了双色方案。

e.en: The hall was decorated in {bicoloured} ribbons.
e.zh: 大厅用双色丝带装饰。

e.en: He sketched a {bicoloured} bird in his notebook.
e.zh: 他在笔记本上画了一只双色鸟。

e.en: Cyprus is often described as a {bicommunal} state.
e.zh: 塞浦路斯常被描述为双族群国家。

e.en: Talks aim at a {bicommunal} federation.
e.zh: 谈判旨在建立双族群联邦。

e.en: In older Russian texts, compact spaces are called {bicompact}.
e.zh: 在较早的俄文文献中，紧空间被称为双紧空间。

e.en: The lemma assumes the space is {bicompact}.
e.zh: 该引理假设该空间是双紧的。

e.en: The fabric uses {bicomponent} fibers for stretch.
e.zh: 这种面料使用双组分纤维以增加弹性。

e.en: They applied a {bicomponent} epoxy adhesive.
e.zh: 他们使用了双组分环氧胶黏剂。

e.en: The {biconcavity} of erythrocytes aids gas exchange.
e.zh: 红细胞的双凹特性有助于气体交换。

e.en: He measured the {biconcavity} of the lens precisely.
e.zh: 他精确测量了透镜的双凹度。

e.en: The bead was shaped like a tiny {bicone}.
e.zh: 这颗珠子形状像个小双锥体。

e.en: Crystals sometimes grow into a {bicone}.
e.zh: 晶体有时会长成双锥体。

e.en: They installed a {biconical} antenna on the roof.
e.zh: 他们在屋顶安装了一根双锥形天线。

e.en: The vase has a {biconical} silhouette.
e.zh: 这只花瓶呈双锥形轮廓。

e.en: The algorithm uses a {biconjugate} gradient method.
e.zh: 该算法使用双共轭梯度法。

e.en: They proved a {biconjugate} duality theorem.
e.zh: 他们证明了一条双共轭对偶定理。

e.en: Russia is a {bicontinental} country.
e.zh: 俄罗斯是一个横跨两大洲的国家。

e.en: He spent his career in a {bicontinental} role.
e.zh: 他的职业生涯一直担任横跨两大洲的职务。

e.en: A magnifying glass typically uses a {biconvex} lens.
e.zh: 放大镜通常使用双凸透镜。

e.en: The pill is {biconvex} and easy to swallow.
e.zh: 这种药片呈双凸形，容易吞服。

e.en: The {biconvexity} of the lens determines its focal length.
e.zh: 透镜的双凸性决定了其焦距。

e.en: He analyzed the {biconvexity} of the function.
e.zh: 他分析了该函数的双凸性。

e.en: Napoleon famously wore a black {bicorn}.
e.zh: 拿破仑因戴黑色双角帽而闻名。

e.en: The statue depicts a {bicorn} beast.
e.zh: 这尊雕像描绘了一只双角怪兽。

e.en: The admiral's {bicorne} sat neatly on his head.
e.zh: 海军上将的双角帽端正地戴在头上。

e.en: A {bicorne} was standard issue for officers.
e.zh: 双角帽曾是军官的标准装备。

e.en: The general wore a {bicorned} hat.
e.zh: 将军戴着一顶双角帽。

e.en: Heralds drew a {bicorned} dragon on the shield.
e.zh: 纹章师在盾牌上画了一条双角龙。

e.en: The scan revealed a {bicornuate} uterus.
e.zh: 扫描显示她有一个双角子宫。

e.en: Many rodents have a {bicornuate} uterus.
e.zh: 许多啮齿动物的子宫为双角形。

e.en: The medieval bestiary mentions a {bicornuous} beast.
e.zh: 中世纪动物寓言集中提到一种双角野兽。

e.en: Some snails have {bicornuous} tentacles.
e.zh: 一些蜗牛长有双角状触须。

e.en: The myth describes a {bicorporal} creature.
e.zh: 神话中描述了一种双躯生物。

e.en: Astrologers once called Gemini a {bicorporal} sign.
e.zh: 占星家曾将双子座称为双躯星座。

e.en: Ancient texts speak of a {bicorporeal} demon.
e.zh: 古籍中讲到一种双躯恶魔。

e.en: The painting shows a {bicorporeal} figure.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了一个双躯体形象。

e.en: Botanists noted that the leaf is {bicostate}.
e.zh: 植物学家指出该叶具两条主脉。

e.en: A {bicostate} leaf has two prominent veins.
e.zh: 双脉叶具有两条明显的叶脉。

e.en: In some old papers, distances are given in {bicron}.
e.zh: 在一些旧文献中距离以皮米为单位给出。

e.en: One {bicron} equals a trillionth of a meter.
e.zh: 一皮米等于万亿分之一米。

e.en: The compass has a {bicrural} structure.
e.zh: 圆规具有双脚结构。

e.en: Anatomists describe certain muscles as {bicrural}.
e.zh: 解剖学家把某些肌肉描述为双头的。

e.en: Canada has long debated the merits of {biculturalism}.
e.zh: 加拿大长期讨论双文化主义的利弊。

e.en: She wrote a thesis on {biculturalism} in immigrant families.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于移民家庭双文化主义的论文。

e.en: The architect designed a {bicurved} glass facade.
e.zh: 建筑师设计了一个双曲玻璃幕墙。

e.en: The blade has a subtly {bicurved} edge.
e.zh: 刀刃有一道微妙的双曲弧线。

e.en: The dentist pulled my upper {bicuspid}.
e.zh: 牙医拔掉了我上颌的前臼齿。

e.en: He was born with a {bicuspid} aortic valve.
e.zh: 他天生有一个二尖式主动脉瓣。

e.en: The reagent contains a {bicyanate} group.
e.zh: 该试剂含有一个二氰酸根。

e.en: They synthesized a stable potassium {bicyanate}.
e.zh: 他们合成了一种稳定的二氰酸钾。

e.en: Medlars must {blet} before they become edible.
e.zh: 欧楂果必须熟透变软后才能食用。

e.en: The fruit will {blet} if left on the tree.
e.zh: 果实留在树上会过熟变软。

e.en: Stop your {blether} and get to the point.
e.zh: 别再废话连篇，快说重点。

e.en: They {blether} on for hours about nothing.
e.zh: 他们能就些无聊事唠叨好几个小时。

e.en: That {blethering} old fool never stops talking.
e.zh: 那个唠叨的老糊涂从不闭嘴。

e.en: I'm tired of his {blethering} nonsense.
e.zh: 我厌倦了他喋喋不休的废话。

e.en: {Bletting} softens the medlar's harsh tannins.
e.zh: 后熟过程能软化欧楂粗涩的单宁。

e.en: The persimmons require {bletting} before eating.
e.zh: 这些柿子要经过软熟过程才能吃。

e.en: We found wild {blewits} growing in the woods.
e.zh: 我们在树林里发现了野生的紫丁香蘑。

e.en: {Blewits} have a distinctive bluish-purple cap.
e.zh: 紫丁香蘑有独特的蓝紫色菌盖。

blimpish.t: 守旧顽固的；保守反动的

e.en: His {blimpish} views shocked the young staff.
e.zh: 他守旧顽固的观点让年轻员工大跌眼镜。

e.en: The colonel had a {blimpish} air about him.
e.zh: 那位上校带着一股老派顽固的气息。

blimpishly.t: 守旧顽固地；保守反动地

e.en: He {blimpishly} dismissed every modern idea.
e.zh: 他守旧地否定一切现代观念。

e.en: She spoke {blimpishly} about today's youth.
e.zh: 她用一副老顽固的口吻评论当今年轻人。

e.en: His {blimpishness} alienated younger colleagues.
e.zh: 他的守旧顽固疏远了年轻同事。

e.en: The party's {blimpishness} cost it the election.
e.zh: 该党的保守顽固让它输掉了选举。

e.en: {Blimy}, that was a close call!
e.zh: 天哪，刚才真是好险！

e.en: {Blimy}, look at the size of that fish!
e.zh: 我的天，看看那条鱼有多大！

e.en: My friend set me up on a {blind-date}.
e.zh: 朋友给我安排了一次相亲。

e.en: The {blind-date} went surprisingly well.
e.zh: 这次相亲出乎意料地顺利。

e.en: She walked {blind-folded} through the maze.
e.zh: 她蒙着眼睛穿过迷宫。

e.en: The hostage was {blind-folded} and tied up.
e.zh: 人质被蒙住双眼并捆绑起来。

blind-side.t: 出其不意地袭击；攻其不备

e.en: Don't let competitors {blind-side} you.
e.zh: 别让竞争对手打你个措手不及。

e.en: The news seemed to {blind-side} the CEO.
e.zh: 这消息似乎让首席执行官措手不及。

e.en: I was completely {blind-sided} by the layoff.
e.zh: 那次裁员让我完全猝不及防。

e.en: She felt {blind-sided} by his sudden resignation.
e.zh: 他突然辞职让她感到措手不及。

e.en: Soldiers built a {blindage} from logs.
e.zh: 士兵们用原木搭起防护掩体。

e.en: The trench was reinforced with a heavy {blindage}.
e.zh: 战壕用厚重的掩体加固。

e.en: His {blindered} view ignored obvious risks.
e.zh: 他狭隘的眼光忽视了明显的风险。

e.en: The {blindered} horse trotted calmly down the street.
e.zh: 那匹戴着眼罩的马沿街悠然小跑。

e.en: He is the {blindest} fan of that team.
e.zh: 他是那支球队最盲目的粉丝。

e.en: Even the {blindest} critic could see the flaw.
e.zh: 再眼盲的评论家也能看出这个缺陷。

e.en: The cave is home to a rare {blindfish}.
e.zh: 这个洞穴里栖息着一种稀有的盲鱼。

e.en: {Blindfish} have evolved without functional eyes.
e.zh: 盲鱼进化成了没有功能性眼睛的物种。

e.en: The {blindman} tapped his cane along the path.
e.zh: 那位盲人沿路敲着拐杖。

e.en: Children played {blindman}'s buff at the party.
e.zh: 孩子们在派对上玩蒙眼捉人游戏。

blindsight.t: 盲视（无意识的视觉感知）

e.en: Studies of {blindsight} reveal hidden visual pathways.
e.zh: 对盲视的研究揭示了隐藏的视觉通路。

e.en: Patients with {blindsight} can detect motion they can't see.
e.zh: 盲视患者能察觉到他们看不见的运动。

e.en: The team was {blindsighted} by the merger news.
e.zh: 合并的消息让团队措手不及。

e.en: I felt {blindsighted} by her harsh criticism.
e.zh: 她严厉的批评让我猝不及防。

e.en: The cathedral's {blindstory} adds visual depth.
e.zh: 这座大教堂的盲层增添了视觉层次。

e.en: Light never reaches the {blindstory} above the arches.
e.zh: 光线从不照进拱门上方的盲层。

e.en: A {blindworm} slithered through the damp grass.
e.zh: 一条蛇蜥滑过潮湿的草丛。

e.en: Despite its name, the {blindworm} is not blind.
e.zh: 虽然名字叫蛇蜥，它其实并不瞎。

e.en: The rapper wore tons of {bling-bling}.
e.zh: 那位说唱歌手戴满了浮夸闪亮的首饰。

e.en: Her outfit was all {bling-bling} and glitter.
e.zh: 她全身都是亮闪闪的浮夸装饰。

e.en: It was over in the {blink-of-an-eye}.
e.zh: 事情一眨眼就结束了。

e.en: In the {blink-of-an-eye}, the deer vanished.
e.zh: 一眨眼的工夫，鹿就消失了。

e.en: The old {blinkard} squinted at the menu.
e.zh: 那位眯眼老人凑近菜单细看。

e.en: Don't be such a {blinkard} about politics.
e.zh: 别在政治问题上这么糊涂迟钝。

e.en: The router's {blinky} lights signaled activity.
e.zh: 路由器闪烁的灯光表示有数据传输。

e.en: She wore {blinky} earrings to the party.
e.zh: 她戴着一闪一闪的耳环去参加派对。

blintz.t: 布林饼（犹太式薄煎饼卷）

e.en: She ordered a cheese {blintz} for breakfast.
e.zh: 她早餐点了一份奶酪布林饼。

e.en: My grandmother makes the best {blintz} in town.
e.zh: 我外婆做的布林饼是镇上最棒的。

blintze.t: 布林饼（犹太式薄煎饼卷）

e.en: He filled the {blintze} with sweet ricotta.
e.zh: 他在布林饼里填入甜味的乳清干酪。

e.en: The {blintze} was crisp on the outside.
e.zh: 这布林饼外皮酥脆。

e.en: We had {blintzes} with sour cream and jam.
e.zh: 我们吃了配酸奶油和果酱的布林饼。

e.en: The deli serves cherry {blintzes} on Sundays.
e.zh: 这家熟食店周日供应樱桃布林饼。

e.en: Cotton thrives on the {blackland} soils of central Texas.
e.zh: 棉花在德州中部的黑土地上长势良好。

e.en: Farmers prized the rich {blackland} for its fertility.
e.zh: 农夫们因这片黑土肥沃而格外珍视。

e.en: She sketched the portrait with a piece of {blacklead}.
e.zh: 她用一支石墨笔勾勒出那幅肖像。

e.en: The stove was polished with {blacklead} once a week.
e.zh: 炉子每周用黑铅擦亮一次。

blackleggery.t: 破坏罢工的行为；工贼行径

e.en: The union denounced the workers' {blackleggery} during the strike.
e.zh: 工会谴责那些工人在罢工期间的工贼行径。

e.en: His {blackleggery} cost him every friend at the factory.
e.zh: 他的破坏罢工行为让他失去了厂里所有朋友。

e.en: The posters glowed under the {blacklight} at the party.
e.zh: 派对上海报在黑光灯下发出荧光。

e.en: Detectives used a {blacklight} to find hidden stains.
e.zh: 侦探用紫外线灯找出隐藏的污渍。

e.en: The tiny {blackpoll} migrates thousands of miles each year.
e.zh: 小小的黑顶白颊林莺每年迁徙数千英里。

e.en: We spotted a {blackpoll} singing high in the spruce.
e.zh: 我们看到一只黑顶白颊林莺在云杉高处鸣唱。

e.en: A long {blacksnake} slid across the sunny path.
e.zh: 一条长长的黑蛇从洒满阳光的小路上滑过。

e.en: Farmers welcome a {blacksnake} for keeping rats away.
e.zh: 农民欢迎黑蛇出现，因为它能赶走老鼠。

e.en: The film borrows heavily from 1970s {blacksploitation} cinema.
e.zh: 这部电影大量借鉴了七十年代的黑人剥削电影。

e.en: Critics debate whether {blacksploitation} empowered or stereotyped Black actors.
e.zh: 评论界争论黑人剥削电影究竟是赋权还是固化了黑人演员形象。

e.en: She stirred {blackstrap} molasses into the gingerbread batter.
e.zh: 她把黑糖蜜搅入姜饼面糊中。

e.en: A spoonful of {blackstrap} adds iron to the diet.
e.zh: 一勺黑糖蜜可为饮食增添铁元素。

e.en: Tabloids tried to {blackwash} the candidate before the election.
e.zh: 小报试图在选举前抹黑那位候选人。

e.en: His memoir is a thinly veiled {blackwash} of his rivals.
e.zh: 他的回忆录其实是对对手的露骨抹黑。

e.en: Tudor collars were often decorated with intricate {blackwork}.
e.zh: 都铎时期的领子常用精细的黑线刺绣装饰。

e.en: She learned {blackwork} embroidery from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她跟祖母学习黑线刺绣手艺。

e.en: The printer sent over a {blad} of the new catalogue.
e.zh: 印刷厂送来了新目录的样张。

e.en: He tore off a {blad} of paper to scribble notes.
e.zh: 他撕下一片纸来潦草记笔记。

e.en: The fish has a {bladderlike} organ for buoyancy control.
e.zh: 这种鱼有一个囊状器官用于控制浮力。

e.en: Her purse was a soft, {bladderlike} pouch of leather.
e.zh: 她的钱包是个软软的囊状皮革袋。

e.en: A male {bladdernose} inflates a sac on its head to attract mates.
e.zh: 雄性冠海豹会鼓起头上的囊袋来吸引配偶。

e.en: Researchers tagged several {bladdernose} seals near the ice floes.
e.zh: 研究人员在浮冰附近为几只冠海豹做了标记。

e.en: The {bladdernut} produces papery seed pods that rattle in the wind.
e.zh: 省沽油会结出纸质种荚，在风中沙沙作响。

e.en: Children loved popping the {bladdernut} pods like balloons.
e.zh: 孩子们爱把省沽油的果荚像气球一样捏破。

e.en: Undercooked pork can transmit the {bladderworm} stage of tapeworm.
e.zh: 未煮熟的猪肉可能传播绦虫的囊尾蚴阶段。

e.en: Veterinarians inspect carcasses for {bladderworm} cysts.
e.zh: 兽医会检查胴体是否带有囊尾蚴包囊。

e.en: The {bladderwort} traps tiny prey with vacuum-powered sacs.
e.zh: 狸藻用真空囊袋捕捉微小的猎物。

e.en: Floating {bladderwort} covered the surface of the pond.
e.zh: 漂浮的狸藻覆盖了池塘的水面。

e.en: Several {bladderworts} grow in the boggy parts of the reserve.
e.zh: 保护区沼泽地带生长着多种狸藻。

e.en: Botanists classify {bladderworts} among the carnivorous plants.
e.zh: 植物学家将狸藻归入食虫植物之列。

e.en: {Bladderwrack} clings to rocks along the cold Atlantic shore.
e.zh: 墨角藻附着在寒冷的大西洋岸边礁石上。

e.en: Some supplements use dried {bladderwrack} for its iodine content.
e.zh: 一些保健品因含碘而使用干燥的墨角藻。

e.en: The plant produces a curious {bladdery} fruit.
e.zh: 这种植物会结出奇特的囊状果实。

e.en: Its {bladdery} swim sac helps the fish stay buoyant.
e.zh: 那囊状的鳔帮助鱼儿保持浮力。

e.en: He pressed the {blade-tip} lightly against the wood.
e.zh: 他把刀尖轻轻抵在木头上。

e.en: Erosion was worst at the turbine's {blade-tip}.
e.zh: 涡轮叶片尖端处的磨损最为严重。

e.en: The butcher trimmed the meat from the {bladebone}.
e.zh: 屠夫从肩胛骨上把肉剔下来。

e.en: She roasted a {bladebone} of mutton for Sunday lunch.
e.zh: 她为周日午餐烤了一块带骨羊肩肉。

e.en: The skilled {blademan} carved each fillet in seconds.
e.zh: 那位熟练的用刀人几秒就片好一块鱼柳。

e.en: Legend tells of a fearless {blademan} who guarded the king.
e.zh: 传说中有一位无畏的持刀人守护着国王。

e.en: A master {bladesmith} hammered the glowing steel into shape.
e.zh: 一位刀剑大匠把炽热的钢锤打成形。

e.en: She apprenticed with a Japanese {bladesmith} for five years.
e.zh: 她跟随一位日本刀匠学徒五年。

e.en: His swift {bladework} dazzled the audience at the duel.
e.zh: 他迅捷的剑术让决斗的观众眼花缭乱。

e.en: The chef's {bladework} turned the onion into perfect dice.
e.zh: 厨师的刀法把洋葱切成了完美的方丁。

blady.t: 叶状的；多叶的（澳洲方言）

e.en: Cattle picked at the tough {blady} grass on the hillside.
e.zh: 牛在山坡上啃食那叶子坚硬的茅草。

e.en: The paddock was overrun with {blady} weeds after the rains.
e.zh: 雨后这片牧场长满了叶状杂草。

blae.t: 青灰色的；铅灰色的（苏格兰）

e.en: The dying man's lips turned a sickly {blae} color.
e.zh: 那垂死之人的嘴唇变成病态的青灰色。

e.en: Storm clouds hung {blae} over the Highland hills.
e.zh: 暴风云铅灰色地压在高地群山之上。

e.en: We picked baskets of {blaeberry} on the moor in August.
e.zh: 八月我们在荒原上摘了一篮篮越橘。

e.en: Granny baked a wonderful {blaeberry} pie every summer.
e.zh: 奶奶每年夏天都会烤一个美味的越橘派。

e.en: We ordered a steaming bowl of {blaff} at the seaside shack.
e.zh: 我们在海边小棚里点了一碗热腾腾的加勒比鱼汤。

e.en: The book landed with a soft {blaff} on the rug.
e.zh: 那本书扑通一声轻轻落在地毯上。

e.en: He managed to {blag} a free upgrade to business class.
e.zh: 他成功蒙混到一次免费升舱到商务舱。

e.en: The crew planned to {blag} the bank in broad daylight.
e.zh: 那帮人打算光天化日之下抢劫那家银行。

e.en: That charming {blagger} talked his way past security.
e.zh: 那个能说会道的骗子一路蒙混过了保安。

e.en: Police finally caught the {blagger} behind the jewelry heists.
e.zh: 警方终于抓到了珠宝劫案背后的劫匪。

blags.t: （英俚）骗取；蒙混（动词第三人称单数）

e.en: She always {blags} her way into sold-out concerts.
e.zh: 她总能蒙混进入早已售罄的演唱会。

e.en: He {blags} freebies from every shop he visits.
e.zh: 他每去一家店都能骗到点免费东西。

e.en: He droned on with the usual corporate {blah-blah}.
e.zh: 他像往常一样喋喋不休地说着公司的废话。

e.en: Spare me the {blah-blah} and tell me the truth.
e.zh: 少跟我废话，直接说实情。

e.en: The speech was just {blah-blah-blah} from start to finish.
e.zh: 那场演讲从头到尾都是废话连篇。

e.en: She rolled her eyes at his endless {blah-blah-blah}.
e.zh: 她对他没完没了的唠叨翻了个白眼。

e.en: A painful {blain} formed on the back of his heel.
e.zh: 他的脚后跟上长了一个疼痛的脓疱。

e.en: The plague left every survivor scarred with {blain} marks.
e.zh: 那场瘟疫让每个幸存者都留下了脓疱的疤痕。

bikie.t: 飞车党成员；摩托帮派分子

e.en: Police arrested several {bikies} after the brawl.
e.zh: 斗殴过后，警方逮捕了几名飞车党成员。

e.en: His brother joined a {bikie} club last year.
e.zh: 他哥哥去年加入了一个飞车党。

e.en: She paired her shorts with a colorful {bikini-top}.
e.zh: 她把短裤和一件彩色比基尼上衣搭在一起。

e.en: The {bikini-top} matched her sarong perfectly.
e.zh: 这件比基尼上衣和她的纱笼非常搭配。

e.en: Want a {bikky} with your tea?
e.zh: 要不要来块饼干配茶？

e.en: The kids ate all the {bikkies} I baked.
e.zh: 我烤的小饼干都被孩子们吃光了。

e.en: The sound /p/ is a {bilabial} stop.
e.zh: 音位 /p/ 是一个双唇塞音。

e.en: English has several {bilabial} consonants.
e.zh: 英语中有好几个双唇辅音。

e.en: Sage flowers are typically {bilabiate}.
e.zh: 鼠尾草的花通常呈二唇形。

e.en: Botanists describe the corolla as {bilabiate}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种花冠描述为二唇形的。

bilander.t: 双桅小帆船；荷兰式商船

e.en: A Dutch {bilander} sailed into the harbor at dusk.
e.zh: 一艘荷兰双桅小帆船在黄昏时驶入港口。

e.en: Merchants once used the {bilander} for coastal trade.
e.zh: 商人们曾用这种双桅小帆船做沿海贸易。

bilbo.t: 西班牙细身长剑；古式细剑

e.en: He drew his {bilbo} from its scabbard.
e.zh: 他从剑鞘里抽出他的西班牙细剑。

e.en: The collector displayed an antique {bilbo} on the wall.
e.zh: 收藏家在墙上展示了一把古董细身长剑。

bilboes.t: 脚镣；犯人脚上的铁制镣铐

e.en: The mutineers were clapped in {bilboes} below deck.
e.zh: 叛变者被锁上脚镣，关在甲板下。

e.en: Sailors feared being put in the {bilboes}.
e.zh: 水手们害怕被戴上脚镣。

bilby.t: 兔耳袋狸；澳洲长耳袋狸

e.en: The {bilby} is an endangered Australian marsupial.
e.zh: 兔耳袋狸是一种濒危的澳大利亚有袋动物。

e.en: Children received chocolate {bilbies} for Easter.
e.zh: 复活节时孩子们收到了巧克力兔耳袋狸。

e.en: The liver produces {bile-acids} to digest fats.
e.zh: 肝脏分泌胆汁酸用来消化脂肪。

e.en: Doctors carefully measured her {bile-acid} levels.
e.zh: 医生仔细测量了她的胆汁酸水平。

e.en: The cabinet panels are framed by a heavy {bilection}.
e.zh: 柜子的镶板由厚重的凸出线脚围边。

e.en: Carpenters carved the {bilection} from solid oak.
e.zh: 木匠用实心橡木雕出这道浮凸线脚。

e.en: Stones can block the {bileduct} and cause jaundice.
e.zh: 结石可能堵塞胆管，引发黄疸。

e.en: Surgeons repaired the damaged {bileduct} during the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术中修复了受损的胆管。

bilestone.t: 胆结石；胆中形成的结石

e.en: The patient passed a small {bilestone} overnight.
e.zh: 病人一夜之间排出了一颗小胆石。

e.en: Old medical texts call gallstones {bilestones}.
e.zh: 古老的医学文献把胆结石称作胆石。

bilevel.t: 错层式建筑；双层结构的

e.en: They bought a {bilevel} house in the suburbs.
e.zh: 他们在郊区买了一栋错层式住宅。

e.en: The {bilevel} train can carry far more commuters.
e.zh: 这种双层列车可以运送多得多的通勤者。

bilgewater.t: 船底污水；废话；胡说八道

e.en: The hold reeked of stale {bilgewater}.
e.zh: 船舱里弥漫着舱底污水的恶臭。

e.en: He dismissed the rumor as utter {bilgewater}.
e.zh: 他认为那条谣言纯属胡说八道。

bilgy.t: 有舱底污水味的；发霉腐臭的

e.en: The cabin smelled {bilgy} after weeks at sea.
e.zh: 在海上漂了几周后，船舱里有股舱底污水的霉味。

e.en: Old wooden boats often turn {bilgy} below deck.
e.zh: 旧木船的甲板下面常常会出现腐臭的污水味。

e.en: {Bilharziasis} is common in tropical freshwater regions.
e.zh: 血吸虫病在热带淡水地区很常见。

e.en: The clinic treated several cases of {bilharziasis} last year.
e.zh: 该诊所去年治疗了好几例血吸虫病患者。

bilimbi.t: 三敛果；一种热带酸味果实

e.en: She pickled the sour {bilimbi} fruits in brine.
e.zh: 她把酸酸的三敛果用盐水腌了起来。

e.en: {Bilimbi} grows on a small tropical tree.
e.zh: 三敛果生长在一种小型热带树上。

biliment.t: 古时的华丽服饰；装饰品

e.en: The duchess wore a jeweled {biliment} on her gown.
e.zh: 公爵夫人在长裙上佩戴着镶满宝石的华丽饰物。

e.en: Old inventories list silks and {biliments} together.
e.zh: 旧时的清单把丝绸和华丽饰物列在一起。

e.en: We need to find a {bilinear} mapping between the spaces.
e.zh: 我们需要在两个空间之间找到一个双线性映射。

e.en: The algorithm uses {bilinear} interpolation to scale images.
e.zh: 该算法使用双线性插值来缩放图像。

bilingual-education.t: 双语教育；用两种语言进行的教学

e.en: She strongly supports {bilingual-education} for immigrant children.
e.zh: 她大力支持为移民儿童提供双语教育。

e.en: The school offers {bilingual-education} from kindergarten onward.
e.zh: 这所学校从幼儿园起就提供双语教育。

e.en: Researchers studied her {bilinguality} for several years.
e.zh: 研究人员对她的双语能力进行了多年研究。

e.en: The country prizes its official {bilinguality}.
e.zh: 这个国家以其官方的双语状态为荣。

bilinguist.t: 通晓两种语言的人；双语者

e.en: He works as a {bilinguist} at the embassy.
e.zh: 他在大使馆担任双语工作人员。

e.en: Trained {bilinguists} are in high demand at international firms.
e.zh: 训练有素的双语者在跨国公司很抢手。

benzotrichloride.t: 三氯甲苯；苄基三氯化物

e.en: {Benzotrichloride} reacts with water to form benzoic acid.
e.zh: 三氯甲苯遇水反应生成苯甲酸。

e.en: Industrial use of {benzotrichloride} requires strict safety controls.
e.zh: 工业上使用三氯甲苯需要严格的安全管控。

benzotrifluoride.t: 三氟甲苯；苄基三氟化物

e.en: The lab uses {benzotrifluoride} as a polar solvent.
e.zh: 实验室把三氟甲苯当作极性溶剂使用。

e.en: {Benzotrifluoride} appears in many fluorinated drugs.
e.zh: 三氟甲苯出现在许多含氟药物中。

benzoxazine.t: 苯并恶嗪；一类杂环化合物

e.en: {Benzoxazine} resins offer excellent thermal stability.
e.zh: 苯并恶嗪树脂具有出色的热稳定性。

e.en: Researchers synthesised a new {benzoxazine} derivative.
e.zh: 研究人员合成了一种新的苯并恶嗪衍生物。

e.en: {Benzoxazinone} compounds show antifungal activity.
e.zh: 苯并恶嗪酮类化合物具有抗真菌活性。

e.en: The plant produces a defensive {benzoxazinone}.
e.zh: 这种植物会产生具防御作用的苯并恶嗪酮。

benzoxazole.t: 苯并恶唑；含氮氧的杂环化合物

e.en: {Benzoxazole} is a building block in many drugs.
e.zh: 苯并恶唑是许多药物的结构单元。

e.en: They added a {benzoxazole} ring to the core structure.
e.zh: 他们在核心结构上加入了一个苯并恶唑环。

benzoxy.t: 苯氧基；化学取代基片段

e.en: The {benzoxy} group was attached to the ring.
e.zh: 苯氧基连接在环上。

e.en: A {benzoxy} substituent changes the molecule's properties.
e.zh: 苯氧基取代基改变了该分子的性质。

benzoxyperoxycarbonylation.t: 苯氧基过氧化羰基化反应

e.en: The {benzoxyperoxycarbonylation} step requires careful temperature control.
e.zh: 苯氧基过氧化羰基化步骤需要严格的温度控制。

e.en: They reported a novel {benzoxyperoxycarbonylation} of alkenes.
e.zh: 他们报道了一种新型的烯烃苯氧基过氧化羰基化反应。

e.en: A {benzoyl} group protects the alcohol during synthesis.
e.zh: 在合成过程中，苯甲酰基保护了醇基。

e.en: {Benzoyl} peroxide is used to treat acne.
e.zh: 过氧化苯甲酰可用于治疗痤疮。

benzoylaconine.t: 苯甲酰乌头碱；乌头类生物碱

e.en: {Benzoylaconine} is a metabolite of aconitine.
e.zh: 苯甲酰乌头碱是乌头碱的代谢产物。

e.en: They detected {benzoylaconine} in the herbal extract.
e.zh: 他们在草药提取物中检测到苯甲酰乌头碱。

benzoylation.t: 苯甲酰化反应；引入苯甲酰基

e.en: The {benzoylation} of the amine proceeded smoothly.
e.zh: 胺的苯甲酰化反应顺利进行。

e.en: Selective {benzoylation} protected one hydroxyl group.
e.zh: 选择性苯甲酰化保护了其中一个羟基。

benzoylecgonine.t: 苯甲酰爱康宁；可卡因代谢物

e.en: Urine tests detect cocaine via {benzoylecgonine}.
e.zh: 尿检通过苯甲酰爱康宁来检测可卡因。

e.en: {Benzoylecgonine} can persist in samples for days.
e.zh: 苯甲酰爱康宁可在样本中存留数日。

benzoylene.t: 苯二酰基；连接两环的双羰基

e.en: The {benzoylene} bridge linked the two aromatic units.
e.zh: 苯二酰基桥连接了两个芳香单元。

e.en: {Benzoylene} ureas display interesting fluorescence.
e.zh: 苯二酰基脲类化合物显示出有趣的荧光性质。

benzoylformaldoxime.t: 苯甲酰甲醛肟；有机合成中间体

e.en: The team isolated pure {benzoylformaldoxime} from the mixture.
e.zh: 研究小组从混合物中分离出纯净的苯甲酰甲醛肟。

e.en: {Benzoylformaldoxime} reacts further to form the product.
e.zh: 苯甲酰甲醛肟进一步反应生成产物。

benzoylimino.t: 苯甲酰亚胺基；酰基取代基

e.en: A {benzoylimino} group was introduced at this position.
e.zh: 在此位置引入了一个苯甲酰亚胺基。

e.en: The {benzoylimino} substituent stabilised the intermediate.
e.zh: 苯甲酰亚胺基取代基稳定了中间体。

benzoylpropethyl.t: 苯甲酰丙乙酯；一种除草剂

e.en: Farmers sprayed {benzoylpropethyl} on the wheat fields.
e.zh: 农户在麦田里喷洒了苯甲酰丙乙酯。

e.en: {Benzoylpropethyl} controls grass weeds in cereal crops.
e.zh: 苯甲酰丙乙酯可防治谷类作物中的禾本科杂草。

benzozone.t: 苯并臭氧；旧时使用的消毒剂

e.en: The chemist analysed a sample of {benzozone}.
e.zh: 化学家分析了一个苯并臭氧样品。

e.en: {Benzozone} was once used as a disinfectant.
e.zh: 苯并臭氧曾被用作消毒剂。

benzpyrene.t: 苯并芘；一种强致癌多环芳烃

e.en: Cigarette smoke contains {benzpyrene}, a known carcinogen.
e.zh: 香烟烟雾中含有致癌物苯并芘。

e.en: Exposure to {benzpyrene} increases cancer risk.
e.zh: 接触苯并芘会增加患癌风险。

benzsulfamide.t: 苯磺酰胺；早期磺胺类抗菌药

e.en: {Benzsulfamide} is an early sulfonamide antibiotic.
e.zh: 苯磺酰胺是一种早期的磺胺类抗生素。

e.en: Researchers tested {benzsulfamide} against bacteria.
e.zh: 研究人员用苯磺酰胺对细菌进行了测试。

benzthiazuron.t: 苯噻草脲；选择性除草剂

e.en: {Benzthiazuron} controls broadleaf weeds in beet crops.
e.zh: 苯噻草脲用于防除甜菜田的阔叶杂草。

e.en: Soil residues of {benzthiazuron} were monitored.
e.zh: 土壤中的苯噻草脲残留受到监测。

benztropine.t: 苯托品；治疗帕金森病的抗胆碱药

e.en: Doctors prescribe {benztropine} to control tremors.
e.zh: 医生开具苯托品以控制震颤。

e.en: {Benztropine} can cause dry mouth and constipation.
e.zh: 苯托品可能引起口干和便秘。

benzylacetone.t: 苄基丙酮；带覆盆子香气的香料

e.en: {Benzylacetone} smells like raspberries.
e.zh: 苄基丙酮闻起来有覆盆子的香气。

e.en: Bees produce small amounts of {benzylacetone}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂会产生少量的苄基丙酮。

benzylaniline.t: 苄基苯胺；染料化学常用原料

e.en: {Benzylaniline} is used in dye chemistry.
e.zh: 苄基苯胺用于染料化学。

e.en: They synthesised {benzylaniline} from aniline and benzyl chloride.
e.zh: 他们用苯胺和苄基氯合成了苄基苯胺。

benzylbenzene.t: 苄基苯；二苯甲烷的别名

e.en: {Benzylbenzene} is another name for diphenylmethane.
e.zh: 苄基苯是二苯甲烷的别名。

e.en: The reaction yielded {benzylbenzene} as the major product.
e.zh: 该反应以苄基苯为主要产物。

benzyleneglycol.t: 苄基乙二醇；苯乙二醇衍生物

e.en: {Benzyleneglycol} can be obtained by reducing the aldehyde.
e.zh: 通过还原醛可制得苄基乙二醇。

e.en: The product was identified as {benzyleneglycol}.
e.zh: 产物被鉴定为苄基乙二醇。

benzylic.t: 苄基的；与苄基位相关的

e.en: The {benzylic} hydrogen is easily abstracted.
e.zh: 苄基位的氢容易被夺取。

e.en: Oxidation occurred at the {benzylic} position.
e.zh: 氧化反应发生在苄基位上。

benzylidene.t: 亚苄基；常见的醛缩合官能团

e.en: A {benzylidene} acetal protected the diol.
e.zh: 亚苄基缩醛保护了二醇。

e.en: {Benzylidene} groups are common in carbohydrate chemistry.
e.zh: 亚苄基在糖类化学中很常见。

benzyloxybenzaldehyde.t: 苄氧基苯甲醛；有机合成原料

e.en: {Benzyloxybenzaldehyde} served as the starting material.
e.zh: 苄氧基苯甲醛被用作起始原料。

e.en: They condensed {benzyloxybenzaldehyde} with malononitrile.
e.zh: 他们将苄氧基苯甲醛与丙二腈缩合。

benzylpenicillin.t: 苄青霉素；天然青霉素的代表

e.en: Doctors administered {benzylpenicillin} intravenously.
e.zh: 医生静脉注射了苄青霉素。

e.en: {Benzylpenicillin} is the original penicillin G.
e.zh: 苄青霉素就是最早的青霉素G。

benzylthiourea.t: 苄基硫脲；金属络合常用配体

e.en: {Benzylthiourea} can complex with metal ions.
e.zh: 苄基硫脲可与金属离子形成络合物。

e.en: They prepared {benzylthiourea} from benzylamine.
e.zh: 他们用苄胺制备了苄基硫脲。

benzyne.t: 苯炔；高活性的有机反应中间体

e.en: {Benzyne} is a highly reactive intermediate.
e.zh: 苯炔是一种反应活性很高的中间体。

e.en: Trapping {benzyne} requires careful technique.
e.zh: 捕获苯炔需要精细的实验技巧。

e.en: The artist {bepainted} the walls with vivid colors.
e.zh: 艺术家把墙壁涂上了鲜艳的色彩。

e.en: Old poems describe how dawn would {bepaint} the sky.
e.zh: 古诗描绘黎明如何为天空敷上颜色。

e.en: Children {bepelted} the snowman with snowballs.
e.zh: 孩子们用雪球不停地砸雪人。

e.en: Hailstones {bepelt} the rooftops every winter.
e.zh: 每到冬天，冰雹接连不断地砸在屋顶上。

bephenium.t: 苄酚铵；治疗钩虫病的驱虫药

e.en: {Bephenium} was used to treat hookworm infections.
e.zh: 苄酚铵曾用于治疗钩虫感染。

e.en: Doctors prescribed {bephenium} as a deworming agent.
e.zh: 医生把苄酚铵开作驱虫药。

e.en: Workers {beplaster} the cracked walls every spring.
e.zh: 工人们每年春天都给开裂的墙抹上石膏。

e.en: She {beplastered} her face with thick makeup.
e.zh: 她在脸上涂了厚厚的妆。

e.en: The fence was {beplastered} with old posters.
e.zh: 围墙上贴满了旧海报。

e.en: His jeans were {beplastered} with mud after the hike.
e.zh: 徒步之后他的牛仔裤上满是泥浆。

beplastering.t: 正在涂抹；不断糊上一层层

e.en: She kept {beplastering} the wall until smooth.
e.zh: 她一直在墙上抹石膏直到表面光滑。

e.en: Stop {beplastering} my desk with sticky notes.
e.zh: 别再把我的桌子贴满便条了。

beplumed.t: 戴着羽饰的；插着羽毛装饰的

e.en: The {beplumed} knight rode into the courtyard.
e.zh: 那位插着羽饰的骑士骑马走进庭院。

e.en: She wore a {beplumed} hat to the ceremony.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶插着羽毛的帽子出席典礼。

bepowder.t: 撒粉于；扑粉于；古语用法

e.en: Servants used to {bepowder} their masters' wigs.
e.zh: 仆人过去常给主人的假发扑粉。

e.en: Snow began to {bepowder} the rooftops.
e.zh: 雪开始把屋顶撒上一层白。

e.en: Critics {bepraised} the young novelist's debut.
e.zh: 评论家们对这位年轻小说家的处女作大加赞赏。

e.en: Don't {bepraise} him until you've seen the work.
e.zh: 在你看过作品之前别对他大加吹捧。

bepuff.t: 吹胀；夸大吹捧；过度抬高

e.en: Critics tend to {bepuff} every new film as a masterpiece.
e.zh: 评论家们往往把每部新片都吹捧成杰作。

e.en: The wind {bepuffed} the curtains into the room.
e.zh: 风把窗帘吹得鼓胀进屋里。

e.en: Such riddles can {bepuzzle} even the cleverest minds.
e.zh: 这种谜语连最聪明的人也会被难倒。

e.en: Her sudden silence {bepuzzled} everyone at the table.
e.zh: 她突然的沉默让在座的所有人都困惑不已。

e.en: Wild {blanketflower} covered the dry prairie.
e.zh: 野生天人菊布满了干燥的草原。

e.en: She planted {blanketflower} along the fence.
e.zh: 她沿着篱笆种了一排天人菊。

blankety.t: 该死的（用以替代脏话的委婉语）

e.en: Where did that {blankety} key go now?
e.zh: 那把该死的钥匙又跑哪去了？

e.en: He muttered something {blankety} under his breath.
e.zh: 他低声嘟囔着一句该死的话。

blankety-blank.t: 该死的；他妈的（避免脏话的委婉说法）

e.en: Get that {blankety-blank} dog off my couch!
e.zh: 把那条该死的狗弄下我的沙发！

e.en: The {blankety-blank} car won't start again.
e.zh: 这破车又发动不起来了。

blanketyblank.t: 该死的（blankety-blank 的连写形式）

e.en: That {blanketyblank} printer has jammed again.
e.zh: 那台破打印机又卡纸了。

e.en: He stubbed his {blanketyblank} toe on the door.
e.zh: 他在门上撞到了该死的脚趾。

blanketyblankblank.t: 该死的（加强语气的委婉骂语）

e.en: Where is my {blanketyblankblank} phone charger?
e.zh: 我那该死的手机充电器到哪去了？

e.en: This {blanketyblankblank} traffic never moves.
e.zh: 这该死的车流根本就动不了。

blankies.t: 小毯子（儿语，blanky 的复数）

e.en: The toddlers carried their {blankies} everywhere.
e.zh: 小娃娃们走到哪儿都带着小毯毯。

e.en: Both kids fell asleep clutching their {blankies}.
e.zh: 两个孩子都抓着小毯毯睡着了。

e.en: He won't sleep without his {blanky}.
e.zh: 没有那条小毯毯他就睡不着。

e.en: She dragged her {blanky} across the floor.
e.zh: 她拖着小毯毯走过地板。

e.en: He ordered the veal {blanquette} for lunch.
e.zh: 他午餐点了白汁炖小牛肉。

e.en: Her {blanquette} simmered slowly all afternoon.
e.zh: 她的白汁炖肉文火慢炖了一整个下午。

e.en: We watched the rocket {blast-off} from the pad.
e.zh: 我们看着火箭从发射台上腾空而起。

e.en: The {blast-off} was delayed by bad weather.
e.zh: 发射因天气恶劣而推迟。

blast-supply.t: 鼓风供给装置；爆破物资供应

e.en: Engineers checked the {blast-supply} pipe before ignition.
e.zh: 工程师点火前检查了鼓风供给管道。

e.en: The mine relies on a steady {blast-supply}.
e.zh: 矿场依赖稳定的爆破物资供应。

e.en: The {blast-tube} channels exhaust away from the engine.
e.zh: 喷气管把废气从发动机引开。

e.en: A crack in the {blast-tube} grounded the jet.
e.zh: 喷气管的一道裂缝让那架战机停飞。

e.en: The rock's {blastability} determines drilling spacing.
e.zh: 岩石的可爆破性决定钻孔间距。

e.en: Engineers tested the ore's {blastability} on site.
e.zh: 工程师在现场测试了矿石的可爆破性。

blastema.t: 芽基；再生芽（生物学用语）

e.en: A salamander forms a {blastema} after limb loss.
e.zh: 蝾螈断肢后会形成再生芽基。

e.en: Cells in the {blastema} dedifferentiate before regrowth.
e.zh: 芽基中的细胞在再生前会去分化。

e.en: Both wound sites grew identical {blastemas}.
e.zh: 两处伤口都长出了相同的再生芽基。

e.en: Researchers compared {blastemas} from young and old newts.
e.zh: 研究者比较了幼年与成年蝾螈的芽基。

e.en: They studied {blastematic} cells under the microscope.
e.zh: 他们在显微镜下研究芽基细胞。

e.en: The tissue showed clear {blastematic} activity.
e.zh: 该组织表现出明显的芽基活动。

e.en: The {blastfurnace} smelts iron ore continuously.
e.zh: 高炉持续不断地冶炼铁矿石。

e.en: Workers monitor the {blastfurnace} temperature closely.
e.zh: 工人们密切监控高炉温度。

blastie.t: 矮小可怜的家伙（苏格兰古语）

e.en: Burns called the louse a wee {blastie}.
e.zh: 彭斯把那只虱子称作可怜的小东西。

e.en: Don't tease the poor {blastie}.
e.zh: 别再逗弄那可怜的小家伙了。

e.en: Youth is most vulnerable to such {blastment}.
e.zh: 年轻人最易受到这般摧残。

e.en: Frost laid a quiet {blastment} on the buds.
e.zh: 霜冻悄悄摧残了花蕾。

e.en: Fluid fills the {blastocele} during early development.
e.zh: 早期发育阶段囊胚腔内充满液体。

e.en: The {blastocele} expands as cleavage continues.
e.zh: 随着卵裂进行，囊胚腔不断扩大。

blastochyle.t: 囊胚腔液（胚泡腔内液体）

e.en: They sampled the {blastochyle} for analysis.
e.zh: 他们取了囊胚腔液进行分析。

e.en: {Blastochyle} carries nutrients across the early embryo.
e.zh: 囊胚腔液把养分输送到早期胚胎各处。

blastocoel.t: 囊胚腔（早期胚胎内的腔）

e.en: The {blastocoel} forms after several rounds of cleavage.
e.zh: 囊胚腔在几轮卵裂之后形成。

e.en: Cells migrate inward through the {blastocoel}.
e.zh: 细胞经由囊胚腔向内迁移。

e.en: A small {blastocone} appeared on the yolk surface.
e.zh: 卵黄表面出现了一个小卵裂锥。

e.en: The {blastocone} marks the start of cleavage.
e.zh: 卵裂锥标志着卵裂的开始。

blastocyte.t: 未分化胚胎细胞；胚芽细胞

e.en: Each {blastocyte} can give rise to many lineages.
e.zh: 每一个胚芽细胞都能分化出多种细胞谱系。

e.en: They isolated a single {blastocyte} for culture.
e.zh: 他们分离出一个胚芽细胞进行培养。

e.en: The {blastoderm} sits atop the yolk in bird eggs.
e.zh: 鸟卵中胚盘位于卵黄之上。

e.en: Cells in the {blastoderm} begin to differentiate.
e.zh: 胚盘中的细胞开始分化。

e.en: They photographed the {blastodermatic} layer.
e.zh: 他们拍摄了胚盘层的图像。

e.en: The textbook described {blastodermatic} folding.
e.zh: 教科书描述了胚盘的折叠过程。

e.en: The {blastodermic} cells form three primary layers.
e.zh: 胚盘细胞形成三个原始胚层。

e.en: He sketched the {blastodermic} disc on the board.
e.zh: 他在黑板上画出了胚盘。

blastodisc.t: 胚盘（鸟类卵黄上的小白点）

e.en: The fertilized {blastodisc} appears as a pale spot.
e.zh: 受精的胚盘表现为一个淡白色的小点。

e.en: Look closely and you'll see the {blastodisc}.
e.zh: 仔细看就能看到胚盘。

blastoid.t: 芽海百合（已灭绝的棘皮动物）

e.en: The fossil bed yielded several {blastoid} specimens.
e.zh: 那处化石层出土了几件芽海百合标本。

e.en: Each {blastoid} once anchored to the seafloor.
e.zh: 每一只芽海百合曾固着在海底。

blastokinesis.t: 胚动；昆虫胚胎在卵内的位移

e.en: {Blastokinesis} reorients the embryo within the egg.
e.zh: 胚动使胚胎在卵内重新定位。

e.en: They filmed {blastokinesis} in locust embryos.
e.zh: 他们拍摄了蝗虫胚胎的胚动过程。

blastokolin.t: 芽抑素（一种植物生长抑制物质）

e.en: Researchers extracted {blastokolin} from dormant buds.
e.zh: 研究者从休眠芽中提取了芽抑素。

e.en: {Blastokolin} suppresses premature sprouting.
e.zh: 芽抑素抑制过早发芽。

e.en: The child was diagnosed with a rare {blastoma}.
e.zh: 那个孩子被诊断出一种罕见的母细胞瘤。

e.en: Surgeons removed the {blastoma} successfully.
e.zh: 外科医生成功切除了该母细胞瘤。

e.en: They tracked {blastomeric} divisions hour by hour.
e.zh: 他们逐小时追踪卵裂球的分裂。

e.en: Each {blastomeric} cell carries the full genome.
e.zh: 每个卵裂球细胞都带有完整基因组。

blastomogen.t: 致瘤物；可诱发肿瘤的物质

e.en: The chemical proved a potent {blastomogen} in mice.
e.zh: 该化学品在小鼠体内被证实为强致瘤物。

e.en: Workers were exposed to a known {blastomogen}.
e.zh: 工人们曾接触一种已知的致瘤物。

blastomycete.t: 芽生菌（一类出芽繁殖的真菌）

e.en: A {blastomycete} infection can affect the lungs.
e.zh: 芽生菌感染可累及肺部。

e.en: They cultured the {blastomycete} on agar plates.
e.zh: 他们在琼脂平板上培养了这种芽生菌。

e.en: He has a {blokeish} sense of humour.
e.zh: 他有一种粗犷男人式的幽默感。

e.en: The pub had a very {blokeish} atmosphere.
e.zh: 那家酒吧充满了爷们儿气息。

blondest.t: 最金黄色的；最浅发色的

e.en: She has the {blondest} hair in the class.
e.zh: 她的头发是班上最金黄的。

e.en: Of the three sisters, Anna is the {blondest}.
e.zh: 三姐妹当中，安娜的头发最浅。

blondie.t: 金发女郎；白巧克力布朗尼

e.en: He teasingly called her {blondie}.
e.zh: 他打趣地叫她金发妞。

e.en: She baked a tray of {blondie} squares.
e.zh: 她烤了一盘白巧克力方块蛋糕。

e.en: We had {blondies} for dessert tonight.
e.zh: 今晚甜点是白巧克力布朗尼。

e.en: Her {blondies} are even better than her brownies.
e.zh: 她做的白巧克力布朗尼比可可布朗尼还好吃。

blood-and-guts.t: 血腥暴力的；勇猛拼命的

e.en: It's a {blood-and-guts} action movie.
e.zh: 那是一部血腥暴力的动作片。

e.en: He gave a {blood-and-guts} speech to the troops.
e.zh: 他向士兵发表了一篇热血激昂的讲话。

blood-and-thunder.t: 渲染暴力的；耸人听闻的

e.en: He loves old {blood-and-thunder} novels.
e.zh: 他喜欢那种渲染暴力的旧小说。

e.en: The play was pure {blood-and-thunder} melodrama.
e.zh: 这部戏完全是耸人听闻的情节剧。

e.en: The battle turned into a {blood-bath}.
e.zh: 那场战斗演变成了一场大屠杀。

e.en: Critics called the film a {blood-bath}.
e.zh: 影评人称这部电影简直是血流成河。

e.en: A red {blood-cell} carries oxygen through the body.
e.zh: 红血细胞将氧气输送到全身。

e.en: The test counts each {blood-cell} type.
e.zh: 该化验会统计各种血细胞的数量。

blood-cemented.t: 以鲜血凝结的；浴血结成的

e.en: Their {blood-cemented} alliance survived the war.
e.zh: 他们以鲜血凝成的同盟挺过了战争。

e.en: It was a {blood-cemented} brotherhood between the two clans.
e.zh: 两族之间结成了浴血凝成的兄弟情谊。

e.en: She let out a {blood-chilling} scream.
e.zh: 她发出一声令人毛骨悚然的尖叫。

e.en: The novel ends with a {blood-chilling} twist.
e.zh: 小说以一个令人胆寒的反转收尾。

e.en: The doctor found a {blood-clot} in his leg.
e.zh: 医生在他腿部发现了一个血栓。

e.en: A {blood-clot} can travel to the lungs.
e.zh: 血块有可能流到肺部。

blood-curdling.t: 令人毛骨悚然的；惊悚的

e.en: A {blood-curdling} scream filled the hallway.
e.zh: 一声毛骨悚然的尖叫充满了走廊。

e.en: He told us a {blood-curdling} ghost story.
e.zh: 他给我们讲了一个吓人的鬼故事。

e.en: The cyclist was banned for {blood-doping}.
e.zh: 那名自行车手因使用血液兴奋剂而被禁赛。

e.en: {blood-doping} boosts oxygen in the muscles.
e.zh: 血液回输能提高肌肉中的氧含量。

e.en: Police found a {blood-drenched} towel at the scene.
e.zh: 警方在现场发现了一条浸满鲜血的毛巾。

e.en: The film offers a {blood-drenched} retelling of the war.
e.zh: 这部影片以血腥的笔触重述了那场战争。

e.en: Exercise improves {blood-flow} to the brain.
e.zh: 运动能改善大脑的血流。

e.en: The injury reduced {blood-flow} to her hand.
e.zh: 那处伤减少了她手部的血液流通。

e.en: The nurse drew a {blood-gas} sample.
e.zh: 护士抽取了一份血气样本。

e.en: His {blood-gas} levels were abnormal.
e.zh: 他的血气指标异常。

e.en: He breeds {blood-horse} stock on his farm.
e.zh: 他在自己的农场培育纯种马。

e.en: Each {blood-horse} sold for a fortune at auction.
e.zh: 每匹纯种马在拍卖会上都卖出了天价。

e.en: In medieval times, a {blood-letter} treated many illnesses.
e.zh: 中世纪时，放血医师治疗多种疾病。

e.en: The village {blood-letter} was also the barber.
e.zh: 村里的放血医师同时还是理发师。

blood-letting.t: 放血疗法；流血冲突；裁员

e.en: Doctors once practised {blood-letting} for fevers.
e.zh: 医生曾用放血疗法来治疗发烧。

e.en: The merger led to corporate {blood-letting}.
e.zh: 这次合并导致了公司大规模裁员。

e.en: The doctor checked his {blood-lipoid} levels.
e.zh: 医生检查了他的血脂水平。

e.en: A poor diet raises {blood-lipoid} values.
e.zh: 不良饮食会升高血脂指标。

e.en: The nurse took my {blood-pressure}.
e.zh: 护士给我量了血压。

e.en: High {blood-pressure} runs in his family.
e.zh: 高血压在他家族中是遗传性的。

e.en: She wore a {blood-red} dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿着一条血红色的连衣裙去参加派对。

e.en: The sky turned {blood-red} at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时天空变成了血红色。

e.en: They share a close {blood-relationship}.
e.zh: 他们之间有近亲血缘关系。

e.en: The will favoured anyone with a {blood-relationship} to him.
e.zh: 遗嘱偏向任何与他有血缘关系的人。

e.en: The tribe traces all {blood-relationships} carefully.
e.zh: 该部落仔细追溯所有血缘关系。

e.en: Adoption created bonds beyond {blood-relationships}.
e.zh: 收养建立了超越血缘的关系。

blood-relative.t: 血亲；有血缘关系的亲属

e.en: She is my only {blood-relative} in the city.
e.zh: 她是我在这座城市里唯一的血亲。

e.en: Only a {blood-relative} can donate the organ.
e.zh: 只有血亲才能捐献该器官。

e.en: The talks aimed to prevent further {blood-shed}.
e.zh: 会谈旨在防止进一步的流血冲突。

e.en: There was much {blood-shed} during the revolt.
e.zh: 那场起义中发生了大量杀戮。

e.en: His eyes were {blood-shot} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后他双眼布满血丝。

e.en: She rubbed her {blood-shot} eyes wearily.
e.zh: 她疲惫地揉了揉布满血丝的眼睛。

e.en: Diabetics must monitor their {blood-sugar} daily.
e.zh: 糖尿病患者必须每天监测血糖。

e.en: Eating sweets can spike your {blood-sugar}.
e.zh: 吃甜食会让血糖飙升。

e.en: The doctor ordered a {blood-test}.
e.zh: 医生开了验血检查。

e.en: My {blood-test} results came back normal.
e.zh: 我的验血结果正常。

e.en: The {blood-thirsty} crowd cheered for more violence.
e.zh: 嗜血的人群叫嚷着想看更多暴力场面。

e.en: He played a {blood-thirsty} villain in the film.
e.zh: 他在片中饰演一个嗜血的反派。

e.en: What's your {blood-type}?
e.zh: 你的血型是什么？

e.en: My {blood-type} is O positive.
e.zh: 我的血型是O型阳性。

e.en: {blood-typing} is required before any transfusion.
e.zh: 输血前必须进行血型鉴定。

e.en: The lab handles all {blood-typing} for the hospital.
e.zh: 该化验室负责医院所有的血型鉴定。

e.en: She wandered around with a {blissed-out} smile after the concert.
e.zh: 演唱会结束后，她带着陶醉的微笑四处游荡。

e.en: He looked completely {blissed-out} on the beach.
e.zh: 他在沙滩上看起来完全沉浸在幸福里。

e.en: They led a {blissless} existence in the gloomy town.
e.zh: 他们在那座阴郁的小镇过着毫无幸福的生活。

e.en: The marriage had become a {blissless} routine.
e.zh: 这段婚姻已经变成毫无幸福感的例行公事。

e.en: His feet were red and {blistery} after the long hike.
e.zh: 长途徒步之后，他的脚又红又起水泡。

e.en: The paint had a strange {blistery} surface.
e.zh: 那层油漆表面起着奇怪的水泡。

blit.t: 位块传输；快速复制图形数据

e.en: The engine can {blit} thousands of sprites per frame.
e.zh: 该引擎每帧可以位块传输数千个精灵图。

e.en: We {blit} the buffer to the screen each tick.
e.zh: 我们在每一帧把缓冲区拷贝到屏幕上。

e.en: Children sang in {blitheful} voices on the village green.
e.zh: 孩子们在村中草地上用愉快的声音唱歌。

e.en: She gave him a {blitheful} wave from the window.
e.zh: 她从窗口快活地向他挥了挥手。

blithered.t: 胡言乱语；语无伦次地说

e.en: He {blithered} on about politics for hours.
e.zh: 他就政治问题胡言乱语了好几个小时。

e.en: The drunk man {blithered} something nobody understood.
e.zh: 那个醉汉嘟囔了些没人听懂的话。

blithers.t: 胡扯；喋喋不休地说蠢话

e.en: He {blithers} whenever he gets nervous.
e.zh: 他一紧张就会喋喋不休地说蠢话。

e.en: She just {blithers} on without making any sense.
e.zh: 她只顾胡扯，毫无逻辑可言。

e.en: A {blithesome} tune drifted from the open window.
e.zh: 一首欢快的曲子从敞开的窗户飘出来。

e.en: She greeted everyone in a {blithesome} mood.
e.zh: 她以愉快的心情向每个人打招呼。

e.en: They danced {blithesomely} around the bonfire.
e.zh: 他们围着篝火欢快地跳舞。

e.en: The children chattered {blithesomely} on the way home.
e.zh: 孩子们在回家路上愉快地说个不停。

blitzers.t: 突袭的防守球员；闪电进攻者

e.en: The {blitzers} broke through the line and sacked the quarterback.
e.zh: 突袭防守球员突破防线擒抱了四分卫。

e.en: Coaches diagram routes for the {blitzers} to follow.
e.zh: 教练为突袭球员设计推进路线。

blizzardy.t: 暴风雪般的；风雪交加的

e.en: We canceled the trip because of the {blizzardy} weather.
e.zh: 由于风雪交加的天气，我们取消了行程。

e.en: The pass becomes dangerous in {blizzardy} conditions.
e.zh: 在暴风雪般的天气里，这条山口非常危险。

e.en: Grandfather loved {bloaters} on toast for breakfast.
e.zh: 爷爷早餐喜欢吃配吐司的熏鲱鱼。

e.en: The market sold fresh {bloaters} from the coast.
e.zh: 市场出售来自海岸的新鲜熏鲱鱼。

bloatware.t: 臃肿软件；预装的多余软件

e.en: The new laptop came loaded with {bloatware}.
e.zh: 这台新笔记本预装了大量臃肿软件。

e.en: I spent an hour uninstalling {bloatware} from the phone.
e.zh: 我花了一个小时卸载手机里的臃肿软件。

e.en: The caricature showed a {blobber-lipped} villain leering at the heroine.
e.zh: 漫画里那个厚嘴唇的反派正色眯眯地看着女主角。

e.en: He drew a {blobber-lipped} face in the margin of his notebook.
e.zh: 他在笔记本边缘画了一张厚嘴唇的脸。

e.en: The old play described the servant as {blobberlipped} and clumsy.
e.zh: 那部老戏把仆人描写得嘴唇肥厚又笨手笨脚。

e.en: Cartoons of the era often featured {blobberlipped} caricatures.
e.zh: 那个时代的漫画常出现嘴唇肥厚的夸张人物。

e.en: They used a {block-and-tackle} to lift the engine from the boat.
e.zh: 他们用滑车组把发动机从船上吊起来。

e.en: A simple {block-and-tackle} can multiply your pulling force.
e.zh: 简单的复式滑轮就能成倍放大拉力。

block-booking.t: 统包预订；整批订购（影片或场次）

e.en: Old Hollywood used {block-booking} to force theaters to take weaker films.
e.zh: 老好莱坞利用统包预订迫使影院接收较差的影片。

e.en: The studio's {block-booking} practice was eventually banned.
e.zh: 该制片厂的整批订购做法最终被禁止。

block-buster.t: 轰动一时的卖座大片；强力炸弹

e.en: The studio is hoping for another summer {block-buster}.
e.zh: 制片厂希望再推出一部夏季卖座大片。

e.en: The novel became an unexpected {block-buster}.
e.zh: 这部小说出乎意料地成了畅销巨作。

block-front.t: 凹凸面板式（家具正面造型）

e.en: The auction featured a rare {block-front} chest of drawers.
e.zh: 拍卖会上有一个罕见的凹凸面板式抽屉柜。

e.en: Newport craftsmen were famous for their {block-front} furniture.
e.zh: 纽波特的工匠以制作凹凸面板式家具闻名。

block-in.t: 先粗略勾画轮廓；打底稿

e.en: I always {block-in} the main shapes before adding detail.
e.zh: 在添加细节之前，我总是先粗略勾画主要形状。

e.en: She used charcoal to {block-in} the composition.
e.zh: 她用炭笔勾画出整幅画的构图轮廓。

block-printed.t: 用木刻版印的；雕版印制的

e.en: She wore a {block-printed} cotton scarf from India.
e.zh: 她戴着一条来自印度的雕版印花棉围巾。

e.en: The exhibit displayed {block-printed} fabrics from the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 展览展出了十八世纪的雕版印花织物。

e.en: The class learned traditional {block-printing} techniques.
e.zh: 这堂课教授了传统的木版印刷技术。

e.en: {Block-printing} is still practiced in many Indian villages.
e.zh: 在印度许多村庄，雕版印花至今仍在流传。

e.en: The ship served as a {blockade-runner} during the civil war.
e.zh: 内战期间，这艘船曾充当突破封锁的船只。

e.en: He was famous as a daring {blockade-runner}.
e.zh: 他作为一名大胆的突破封锁者而出名。

e.en: {Blockade-running} brought enormous profits but huge risks.
e.zh: 突破封锁运输带来了巨额利润，也伴随巨大风险。

e.en: Many fortunes were made through {blockade-running}.
e.zh: 许多财富都是靠突破封锁运输赚来的。

blockaders.t: 封锁者；执行封锁的舰艇或人员

e.en: The {blockaders} patrolled the harbor entrance day and night.
e.zh: 封锁部队日夜巡逻港口入口。

e.en: Smugglers tried to slip past the {blockaders} at night.
e.zh: 走私者试图在夜里溜过封锁人员。

e.en: The shelves are made of strong {blockboard}.
e.zh: 这些架子是用结实的细木工板做的。

e.en: He cut the {blockboard} to fit the cabinet.
e.zh: 他把细木工板裁切成适合柜子的尺寸。

blockbusting.t: 低价收购房产再高价转售的手法；轰动一时的

e.en: The neighborhood changed rapidly because of illegal {blockbusting}.
e.zh: 由于非法的低买高卖手法，这个社区迅速变样。

e.en: The film was a {blockbusting} success at the box office.
