e.en: She became {bristlier} whenever the topic came up.
e.zh: 每当谈起这个话题，她就变得更加易怒。

breachy.t: 易冲破栅栏的；爱乱跑的（牲畜）

e.en: The {breachy} cattle kept escaping through the fence.
e.zh: 那些爱乱跑的牛不断从栅栏里溜出去。

e.en: Old farmers still call such an unruly bull {breachy}.
e.zh: 老农们仍把这种不安分的公牛称作易冲栏的。

e.en: Translation work is her {bread-and-butter}.
e.zh: 翻译是她谋生的本行。

e.en: Customer service is the company's {bread-and-butter} business.
e.zh: 客户服务是这家公司的核心业务。

e.en: Ukraine is often called the {bread-basket} of Europe.
e.zh: 乌克兰常被称为欧洲的粮仓。

e.en: She placed a warm {bread-basket} on the table.
e.zh: 她把一篮热腾腾的面包放在桌上。

e.en: We sell wooden {bread-bins} in three sizes.
e.zh: 我们出售三种尺寸的木质面包箱。

e.en: The shelf holds two metal {bread-bins}.
e.zh: 架子上摆着两个金属面包箱。

e.en: Slice the loaf on the wooden {bread-board}.
e.zh: 在木制面包板上切这条面包。

e.en: Engineers tested the circuit on a {bread-board}.
e.zh: 工程师在面包板上测试了电路。

e.en: She is the main {bread-earner} of her family.
e.zh: 她是家里主要的经济支柱。

e.en: Losing his job left the {bread-earner} desperate.
e.zh: 失业让这位顶梁柱陷入绝望。

e.en: He nibbled a crispy {bread-stick} before dinner.
e.zh: 他在晚饭前嚼着一根脆面包棒。

e.en: Each plate had a thin Italian {bread-stick}.
e.zh: 每个盘子里都放着一根细长的意式面包棒。

breadage.t: 面包类食品的总称；面包制品

e.en: The bakery donates leftover {breadage} to the shelter.
e.zh: 这家面包店把剩余的面包类食品捐给收容所。

e.en: All the day's {breadage} was packed into crates.
e.zh: 当天所有的面包制品都装进了板条箱。

e.en: Don't be such a {breadhead} — money isn't everything.
e.zh: 别这么财迷，钱不是一切。

e.en: He's turned into a real {breadhead} since the promotion.
e.zh: 自从升职后他就变成了一个十足的财迷。

e.en: Many {breadless} families relied on the soup kitchen.
e.zh: 许多无面包果腹的家庭只能依赖施粥所。

e.en: The pantry was bare and the children went {breadless}.
e.zh: 食品柜空空如也，孩子们没了面包吃。

e.en: She enrolled in a weekend {breadmaking} class.
e.zh: 她报名参加了周末的面包制作课。

e.en: {Breadmaking} requires patience and practice.
e.zh: 做面包需要耐心和练习。

breadnut.t: 面包果坚果；面包果近缘种

e.en: The {breadnut} tree grows wild in the Caribbean.
e.zh: 面包果树在加勒比地区野生生长。

e.en: We roasted {breadnut} seeds for a snack.
e.zh: 我们烤了些面包果种子当零食。

breadroot.t: 草原食用根；印第安萝卜

e.en: Native tribes once dug for {breadroot} on the plains.
e.zh: 印第安部落曾在平原上挖掘食用根来吃。

e.en: {Breadroot} can be eaten raw or dried for storage.
e.zh: 面包根可以生吃，也可以晒干储存。

breadstuffs.t: 谷物制品；面粉与面包类食品

e.en: The pantry was full of flour and other {breadstuffs}.
e.zh: 食品柜里堆满了面粉和其他面食原料。

e.en: Wartime rationing limited household {breadstuffs}.
e.zh: 战时配给制限制了各家的面食供应。

e.en: A line is essentially a {breadthless} length.
e.zh: 线本质上就是没有宽度的长度。

e.en: Geometry defines a curve as {breadthless}.
e.zh: 几何学把曲线定义为没有宽度的。

e.en: Fold the cloth {breadthways} for storage.
e.zh: 把布按宽边方向折叠以便收纳。

e.en: Cut the loaf {breadthways} into thick slices.
e.zh: 将这条面包横向切成厚片。

e.en: Lay the planks {breadthwise} across the beams.
e.zh: 把木板横向架在梁上。

e.en: Slice the cake {breadthwise} for even portions.
e.zh: 沿宽边切蛋糕，使每块大小相同。

e.en: The contract has a {break-clause} after two years.
e.zh: 该合同两年后可启动解约条款。

e.en: Both parties may invoke the {break-clause} early.
e.zh: 双方都可提前援引解约条款。

e.en: He learned to {break-dance} from YouTube videos.
e.zh: 他通过油管视频学会了跳霹雳舞。

e.en: The kids love to {break-dance} in the park.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里跳霹雳舞。

e.en: {Break-dancing} became an Olympic event recently.
e.zh: 霹雳舞最近成为了奥运比赛项目。

e.en: She watched the {break-dancing} battle in awe.
e.zh: 她惊叹地观看了那场霹雳舞对决。

e.en: Stress caused her nervous {break-down}.
e.zh: 压力导致了她精神崩溃。

e.en: The car's {break-down} ruined our trip.
e.zh: 汽车故障毁了我们的旅行。

e.en: The startup hopes to {break-even} this year.
e.zh: 这家创业公司希望今年实现收支平衡。

e.en: Sales must double to reach the {break-even} point.
e.zh: 销售额必须翻倍才能达到盈亏平衡点。

e.en: Police investigated the {break-in} at the warehouse.
e.zh: 警方调查了仓库被闯入的案件。

e.en: Neighbors heard the {break-in} at midnight.
e.zh: 邻居们半夜听到了闯入的动静。

e.en: Recent {break-ins} prompted new security cameras.
e.zh: 最近的入室盗窃案促使大家装了新监控。

e.en: The neighborhood reported five {break-ins} last month.
e.zh: 上个月这个街区报了五起入室盗窃。

e.en: He drove at a {break-neck} speed.
e.zh: 他以飞快的速度驾车。

e.en: We worked at a {break-neck} pace to finish.
e.zh: 我们以拼命的节奏赶完了工作。

e.en: Talks reached a sudden {break-off} point.
e.zh: 谈判突然走到了中断的关口。

e.en: Their {break-off} of relations shocked everyone.
e.zh: 他们断绝关系让所有人震惊。

e.en: Prisoners planned a daring {break-out}.
e.zh: 囚犯们策划了一次大胆的越狱。

e.en: A measles {break-out} closed the school.
e.zh: 麻疹的爆发让学校停了课。

e.en: She saved the {break-point} with a strong serve.
e.zh: 她用一记强力发球化解了破发点。

e.en: Negotiations reached a critical {break-point}.
e.zh: 谈判到了关键的临界点。

e.en: Teen {break-ups} can feel devastating.
e.zh: 青少年的分手可能让人崩溃。

e.en: The band suffered several lineup {break-ups}.
e.zh: 这支乐队经历了几次成员解散。

e.en: Test the {breakability} of the new glass.
e.zh: 测试这种新玻璃的易碎性。

e.en: Engineers measured the {breakability} of each sample.
e.zh: 工程师测量了每个样品的可破坏性。

e.en: The DJ mixed a heavy {breakbeat} into the set.
e.zh: 那位 DJ 在歌单里混入了厚重的碎拍。

e.en: Hip-hop grew from {breakbeat} loops in the Bronx.
e.zh: 嘻哈音乐源自布朗克斯区的碎拍循环。

breakboard.t: 武术训练用木板；劈砍板

e.en: Karate students smashed a {breakboard} with their elbows.
e.zh: 空手道学员用肘击碎了训练木板。

e.en: The instructor held the {breakboard} steady.
e.zh: 教练稳稳地举着劈砍板。

e.en: Tropical doctors call dengue {breakbone} fever.
e.zh: 热带地区的医生把登革热叫做骨痛热。

e.en: The patient suffered {breakbone} pain in his joints.
e.zh: 病人感到关节有断骨般的剧痛。

e.en: She loves to {breakdance} at street festivals.
e.zh: 她喜欢在街头节庆上跳霹雳舞。

e.en: Watch him {breakdance} on a cardboard mat.
e.zh: 看他在纸板垫上跳霹雳舞。

e.en: The cafe finally hit its {breakeven} mark.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆终于达到了盈亏平衡点。

e.en: We need more customers to reach {breakeven}.
e.zh: 我们需要更多顾客才能实现收支平衡。

e.en: That reckless {breakhead} drove straight into the ditch.
e.zh: 那个莽撞的家伙直接把车开进了沟里。

e.en: Don't be a {breakhead} — slow down and think.
e.zh: 别做冒失鬼，慢下来想一想。

e.en: The {breakin} happened while we were on vacation.
e.zh: 我们度假时发生了入室盗窃。

e.en: Police found no evidence of forced {breakin}.
e.zh: 警方没找到强行闯入的证据。

e.en: The therapist guided her through {breaking-down} her trauma.
e.zh: 心理咨询师引导她逐步剖析自己的创伤。

e.en: {Breaking-down} the project into steps made it manageable.
e.zh: 把项目拆分成步骤后就好处理了。

e.en: {Breaking-in} new boots takes a few days.
e.zh: 磨合一双新靴子要花几天。

e.en: He was caught {breaking-in} through the back window.
e.zh: 他从后窗闯入时被抓个正着。

e.en: Designers measured the {breakover} angle of the truck.
e.zh: 设计师测量了这辆卡车的通过角。

e.en: A steep {breakover} can scrape the chassis.
e.zh: 过陡的越障角可能刮到底盘。

e.en: Workers gathered for tea at {breaktime}.
e.zh: 工人们在休息时间聚在一起喝茶。

e.en: We chatted in the canteen during {breaktime}.
e.zh: 课间我们在食堂里聊天。

e.en: Tall hedges form a natural {breakwind} for the orchard.
e.zh: 高高的树篱为果园形成了天然防风屏。

e.en: Farmers planted a {breakwind} of pines along the field.
e.zh: 农民沿着田边种了一排松树作防风林。

e.en: Quick, grab some {breaky} before school.
e.zh: 快点，上学前随便吃点早餐。

e.en: Aussies often shorten breakfast to {breaky}.
e.zh: 澳洲人常把 breakfast 简化成 breaky。

e.en: Endless {breast-beating} won't undo the mistake.
e.zh: 再多的捶胸顿足也无法挽回错误。

e.en: The CEO indulged in public {breast-beating} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻之后这位 CEO 公开夸张地自责。

e.en: We waded {breast-deep} through the river.
e.zh: 我们齐胸深地涉过那条河。

e.en: Soldiers stood {breast-deep} in the trench water.
e.zh: 士兵们站在齐胸深的战壕水中。

e.en: She {breast-fed} all three of her babies.
e.zh: 她用母乳喂养了三个孩子。

e.en: {Breast-fed} infants tend to have stronger immune systems.
e.zh: 母乳喂养的婴儿往往免疫力更强。

e.en: Doctors encourage mothers to {breast-feed} for six months.
e.zh: 医生鼓励母亲哺乳六个月。

e.en: She chose to {breast-feed} her newborn.
e.zh: 她选择用母乳喂养新生儿。

e.en: {Breast-feeding} provides essential antibodies.
e.zh: 母乳喂养能提供必需的抗体。

e.en: Public {breast-feeding} is now widely accepted.
e.zh: 如今在公共场合哺乳已被广泛接受。

breast-feeds.t: 用母乳喂养（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {breast-feeds} her baby every two hours.
e.zh: 她每两个小时给宝宝喂一次母乳。

e.en: Whenever the infant cries, the mother {breast-feeds}.
e.zh: 婴儿一哭，母亲就给他哺乳。

e.en: He had the {bristliest} beard I had ever seen.
e.zh: 他的胡子是我见过最粗硬的。

e.en: That was the {bristliest} brush in the shop.
e.zh: 那是店里刷毛最硬的刷子。

brittle-star.t: 阳遂足；蛇尾（海洋无脊椎动物）

e.en: A {brittle-star} clung to the underside of the rock.
e.zh: 一只阳遂足紧贴在岩石下方。

e.en: Divers spotted several {brittle-stars} on the reef.
e.zh: 潜水员在礁石上发现了几只蛇尾。

e.en: Yellow {brittlebush} flowers covered the desert slope.
e.zh: 黄色的脆灌木花覆盖了沙漠山坡。

e.en: The {brittlebush} thrives in dry, rocky soil.
e.zh: 脆灌木在干燥的岩石土壤中生长茂盛。

e.en: Hydrogen {brittlement} can weaken steel parts.
e.zh: 氢脆会削弱钢制零件。

e.en: Engineers tested the alloy for {brittlement}.
e.zh: 工程师测试了合金的脆化情况。

e.en: This is the {brittlest} glass we make.
e.zh: 这是我们生产的最易碎的玻璃。

e.en: Old bones are often the {brittlest}.
e.zh: 年老的骨头往往最为脆弱。

e.en: They want a {broad-based} education for their children.
e.zh: 他们希望孩子接受全面的教育。

e.en: The reform has {broad-based} support.
e.zh: 这项改革获得广泛支持。

e.en: He gave a {broad-brush} summary of the issue.
e.zh: 他对该问题作了粗略概述。

e.en: Avoid {broad-brush} judgments about a whole culture.
e.zh: 不要对整个文化作笼统的评判。

e.en: The match will be {broad-cast} live tonight.
e.zh: 这场比赛今晚将现场直播。

e.en: Farmers {broad-cast} seed across the field.
e.zh: 农民们将种子撒播在田里。

e.en: India still operates many {broad-gauge} railway lines.
e.zh: 印度至今仍运营许多宽轨铁路。

e.en: They proposed a {broad-gauge} reform of the system.
e.zh: 他们提议对该体系进行大规模改革。

e.en: She is a {broad-gauged} thinker on policy issues.
e.zh: 她在政策问题上视野开阔。

e.en: The country built a {broad-gauged} rail network.
e.zh: 该国修建了宽轨铁路网。

e.en: He won the {broad-jump} at the school meet.
e.zh: 他在校运会上赢得了跳远比赛。

e.en: She trained hard for the {broad-jump}.
e.zh: 她为跳远刻苦训练。

e.en: {Broad-leafed} trees dominate this valley.
e.zh: 这个山谷以阔叶树为主。

e.en: The garden was full of {broad-leafed} plants.
e.zh: 花园里满是阔叶植物。

e.en: {Broad-leaved} forests turn brilliant colors in autumn.
e.zh: 阔叶林秋天变得色彩斑斓。

e.en: This species is a typical {broad-leaved} tree.
e.zh: 这是一种典型的阔叶树。

broad-minded.t: 心胸开阔的；思想开明的

e.en: Her parents are remarkably {broad-minded}.
e.zh: 她的父母非常开明。

e.en: We need a {broad-minded} approach to this debate.
e.zh: 我们需要以开阔的胸襟来对待这场辩论。

e.en: He prefers reading a serious {broad-sheet} newspaper.
e.zh: 他更喜欢看严肃的大报。

e.en: The story made the front page of every {broad-sheet}.
e.zh: 这条新闻登上了所有大报的头版。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {broad-spectrum} antibiotic.
e.zh: 医生开了一种广谱抗生素。

e.en: This sunscreen offers {broad-spectrum} protection.
e.zh: 这款防晒霜提供广谱防护。

e.en: The carpenter shaped the beam with a {broadax}.
e.zh: 木匠用阔斧将横梁削成型。

e.en: A medieval {broadax} hung on the wall.
e.zh: 墙上挂着一把中世纪的宽刃斧。

e.en: He swung the {broadaxe} with practiced ease.
e.zh: 他熟练自如地挥动着阔斧。

e.en: A {broadaxe} was used to square the logs.
e.zh: 宽刃斧用来把圆木修成方木。

e.en: Several {broadaxes} hung in the old workshop.
e.zh: 老作坊里挂着几把宽刃斧。

e.en: The museum displays antique {broadaxes}.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着古董宽刃斧。

e.en: A colorful {broadbill} perched on the branch.
e.zh: 一只色彩鲜艳的阔嘴鸟栖息在枝头。

e.en: Hunters spotted a {broadbill} on the lake.
e.zh: 猎人在湖上发现了一只阔嘴鸭。

e.en: He wore a black {broadbrim} against the sun.
e.zh: 他戴着一顶黑色宽边帽遮阳。

e.en: A Quaker in a {broadbrim} stood at the door.
e.zh: 门口站着一位戴宽边帽的贵格会教徒。

e.en: She wore a {broadbrimmed} straw hat to the beach.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶宽边草帽去海滩。

e.en: The cowboy's {broadbrimmed} hat shaded his face.
e.zh: 牛仔的宽边帽遮住了他的脸。

e.en: Old {broadgage} tracks still cross the desert.
e.zh: 古老的宽轨铁路依然横穿沙漠。

e.en: They converted the line from {broadgage} to standard.
e.zh: 他们把这条线路从宽轨改为标准轨。

e.en: India retains an extensive {broadgauge} network.
e.zh: 印度保留着广泛的宽轨铁路网。

e.en: He brings a {broadgauge} perspective to policy debates.
e.zh: 他在政策辩论中带来了宽广的视角。

e.en: The path was {broadish}, just enough for two.
e.zh: 小路略宽，刚好能容两人并行。

e.en: He has a {broadish} face and bright eyes.
e.zh: 他长着一张略宽的脸和明亮的眼睛。

e.en: Native {broadleaves} are being replanted in the park.
e.zh: 公园里正在重新种植本地阔叶树。

e.en: {Broadleaves} provide habitat for many birds.
e.zh: 阔叶树为众多鸟类提供栖息地。

e.en: They laid soft {broadloom} throughout the office.
e.zh: 他们在整个办公室铺上了柔软的宽幅地毯。

e.en: The hallway was carpeted in cream {broadloom}.
e.zh: 走廊铺着米色宽幅地毯。

e.en: Collectors prize a well-preserved {broadpiece}.
e.zh: 收藏家珍视保存完好的宽币。

e.en: He found an old {broadpiece} in the attic.
e.zh: 他在阁楼里发现了一枚古老的宽币。

e.en: The country launched a {broadscale} vaccination campaign.
e.zh: 该国发起了大规模的疫苗接种运动。

e.en: They support {broadscale} environmental reforms.
e.zh: 他们支持广泛的环境改革。

broadwife.t: （旧时美国）属于他主之妻的奴妻

e.en: Historical records mention his {broadwife} on a neighboring plantation.
e.zh: 史料提及他在邻近种植园的奴妻。

e.en: The term {broadwife} reflects a painful era of slavery.
e.zh: 奴妻这个词反映了奴隶制痛苦的年代。

e.en: Lay the board {broadwise} across the supports.
e.zh: 把木板横放在支架上。

e.en: The fabric is folded {broadwise} for cutting.
e.zh: 布料沿宽边方向折叠以便裁剪。

e.en: He hammered a {brob} into the timber.
e.zh: 他把一枚大扁头钉钉入木料。

e.en: The old beams were fastened with iron {brobs}.
e.zh: 旧梁是用铁制扁头钉固定的。

e.en: The agent took a small {brocage} on the deal.
e.zh: 中介从这笔交易中收取了少量佣金。

e.en: They argued over the amount of {brocage}.
e.zh: 他们为佣金的数额争论不休。

e.en: The chairs were upholstered in red {brocatel}.
e.zh: 椅子用红色花缎包覆。

e.en: She admired the gold {brocatel} curtains.
e.zh: 她欣赏那金色的织锦缎窗帘。

e.en: The drawing room was draped in heavy {brocatelle}.
e.zh: 客厅里挂着厚重的花缎帷帐。

e.en: Italian {brocatelle} was prized across Europe.
e.zh: 意大利花缎在欧洲备受推崇。

e.en: The ancient {broch} still stands on the windswept hill.
e.zh: 那座古老的圆塔仍矗立在风口的山丘上。

e.en: Archaeologists excavated a Pictish {broch}.
e.zh: 考古学家发掘了一座皮克特人圆塔。

e.en: Green {brochantite} crystals lined the cavity.
e.zh: 绿色的水胆矾晶体布满了空腔。

e.en: The mineral collection includes a fine {brochantite} specimen.
e.zh: 矿物藏品中有一块精美的水胆矾标本。

e.en: She wore a gown of fine {broche} silk.
e.zh: 她穿着一件精美的提花真丝礼服。

e.en: The cushions were covered in floral {broche}.
e.zh: 靠垫覆着花卉提花织物。

e.en: The lab synthesized {bromic} acid for the experiment.
e.zh: 实验室合成了溴酸用于实验。

e.en: {Bromic} compounds are often unstable.
e.zh: 含溴化合物常常不稳定。

e.en: His speech was full of {bromidic} clichés.
e.zh: 他的演讲满是陈腐的套话。

e.en: She gave a {bromidic} answer to the reporter.
e.zh: 她对记者给出了一个老生常谈的回答。

e.en: Chemists {brominate} the compound to add a bromine atom.
e.zh: 化学家对该化合物进行溴化以加上一个溴原子。

e.en: They {brominate} the solution under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 他们在受控条件下对溶液进行溴化。

e.en: The reagent {brominates} the alkene rapidly.
e.zh: 该试剂迅速将烯烃溴化。

e.en: This catalyst {brominates} aromatic rings selectively.
e.zh: 这种催化剂选择性地对芳香环进行溴化。

e.en: They are {brominating} the sample in the fume hood.
e.zh: 他们正在通风橱中对样品进行溴化。

e.en: The {brominating} agent must be handled carefully.
e.zh: 该溴化试剂必须小心处理。

e.en: The {bromination} of benzene requires a catalyst.
e.zh: 苯的溴化反应需要催化剂。

e.en: Selective {bromination} is key to this synthesis.
e.zh: 选择性溴化是该合成的关键。

e.en: Chronic use of bromides can cause {bromism}.
e.zh: 长期使用溴化物可能引起溴中毒。

e.en: Doctors rarely diagnose {bromism} today.
e.zh: 如今医生很少诊断出溴中毒。

e.en: He took a {bromo} to settle his stomach.
e.zh: 他喝了一剂溴剂来安抚肠胃。

e.en: The {bromo} group activates the reaction site.
e.zh: 溴基团激活了反应位点。

e.en: A {bromoalkane} reacts readily with sodium hydroxide.
e.zh: 溴代烷烃容易与氢氧化钠反应。

e.en: They studied the kinetics of the {bromoalkane}.
e.zh: 他们研究了该溴代烷烃的反应动力学。

e.en: {Bromobenzene} is used as a precursor in many syntheses.
e.zh: 溴苯被用作许多合成反应的前体。

e.en: They distilled the {bromobenzene} carefully.
e.zh: 他们小心地蒸馏溴苯。

e.en: {Bromochloromethane} was once used in fire extinguishers.
e.zh: 溴氯甲烷曾被用于灭火器中。

e.en: Production of {bromochloromethane} is now restricted.
e.zh: 溴氯甲烷的生产现已受到限制。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {bromocriptine} for her condition.
e.zh: 医生为她的病情开了溴隐亭。

e.en: {Bromocriptine} can lower prolactin levels.
e.zh: 溴隐亭可以降低催乳素水平。

e.en: {Bromodeoxyuridine} is used to label proliferating cells.
e.zh: 溴脱氧尿苷被用于标记增殖中的细胞。

e.en: They injected {bromodeoxyuridine} into the mice.
e.zh: 他们给小鼠注射了溴脱氧尿苷。

e.en: {Bromoform} is a dense, colorless liquid.
e.zh: 溴仿是一种密度大的无色液体。

e.en: They tested the sample for {bromoform} contamination.
e.zh: 他们检测了样品是否被溴仿污染。

e.en: The reaction proceeds through a {bromonium} ion intermediate.
e.zh: 反应通过溴鎓离子中间体进行。

e.en: The {bromonium} ion explains the stereochemistry observed.
e.zh: 溴鎓离子解释了观察到的立体化学结果。

e.en: The doctor examined the smaller {bronchia} on the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描片上检查了较小的支气管分支。

e.en: Inflammation had spread into the {bronchia}.
e.zh: 炎症已蔓延到支气管分支。

e.en: She suffered from a chronic {bronchic} condition.
e.zh: 她患有慢性支气管疾病。

e.en: The {bronchic} tissue appeared swollen.
e.zh: 支气管组织看起来肿胀。

e.en: Each {bronchiole} branches into tiny air sacs.
e.zh: 每条细支气管都分支成微小的肺泡。

e.en: Asthma narrows the {bronchiole} walls.
e.zh: 哮喘会使细支气管壁变窄。

bronchitic.t: 支气管炎的；患支气管炎的

e.en: His {bronchitic} cough kept him up all night.
e.zh: 他的支气管炎咳嗽让他整夜没睡。

e.en: Cold winters are hard on {bronchitic} patients.
e.zh: 寒冷的冬天对支气管炎患者很难熬。

e.en: The surgeon located the affected {bronchium}.
e.zh: 外科医生找到了受影响的小支气管。

e.en: Each {bronchium} feeds a portion of the lung.
e.zh: 每条小支气管供应肺的一部分。

e.en: The cowboy tried to ride the wild {broncho}.
e.zh: 牛仔试图骑那匹野马。

e.en: A {broncho} bucked him off in seconds.
e.zh: 一匹野马几秒钟就把他甩了下来。

e.en: Doctors performed a {bronchoalveolar} lavage.
e.zh: 医生进行了支气管肺泡灌洗。

e.en: The {bronchoalveolar} sample was sent for testing.
e.zh: 支气管肺泡样本被送去化验。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with a {bronchocele}.
e.zh: 患者被诊断为支气管膨出。

e.en: A small {bronchocele} can press on nearby tissue.
e.zh: 小的支气管膨出会压迫附近组织。

e.en: Cold air can trigger sudden {bronchoconstriction}.
e.zh: 冷空气可能引发突然的支气管收缩。

e.en: Inhalers help reverse {bronchoconstriction}.
e.zh: 吸入器有助于缓解支气管收缩。

bronchoconstrictor.t: 支气管收缩剂；引起支气管收缩的

e.en: Histamine acts as a {bronchoconstrictor} in the lungs.
e.zh: 组胺在肺部起到支气管收缩剂的作用。

e.en: They tested a new {bronchoconstrictor} agent.
e.zh: 他们测试了一种新的支气管收缩剂。

e.en: The doctor inserted a {bronchofiberscope} for inspection.
e.zh: 医生插入支气管纤维镜进行检查。

e.en: A {bronchofiberscope} reveals airway lesions.
e.zh: 支气管纤维镜能显示气道病变。

bronchogenic.t: 支气管源性的；起源于支气管的

e.en: He was diagnosed with {bronchogenic} carcinoma.
e.zh: 他被诊断为支气管源性癌。

e.en: A {bronchogenic} cyst was found in her chest.
e.zh: 她胸部发现了一个支气管源性囊肿。

e.en: {Bronchography} maps abnormalities in the airways.
e.zh: 支气管造影术可以显示气道的异常。

e.en: The clinic still occasionally uses {bronchography}.
e.zh: 该诊所仍偶尔使用支气管造影术。

e.en: Increased {bronchophony} suggests lung consolidation.
e.zh: 支气管语音增强提示肺实变。

e.en: The intern listened for {bronchophony} during the exam.
e.zh: 实习医生在检查时听诊支气管语音。

e.en: The elderly man developed {bronchopneumonia}.
e.zh: 那位老人患上了支气管肺炎。

e.en: {Bronchopneumonia} can follow a bad flu.
e.zh: 严重流感后可能继发支气管肺炎。

e.en: Premature babies risk {bronchopulmonary} dysplasia.
e.zh: 早产儿有患支气管肺发育不良的风险。

e.en: Surgeons mapped the {bronchopulmonary} segments.
e.zh: 外科医生绘制了支气管肺段图。

e.en: She underwent a {bronchoscopy} last week.
e.zh: 她上周做了支气管镜检查。

e.en: {Bronchoscopy} helped locate the small tumor.
e.zh: 支气管镜检查帮助定位了小肿瘤。

e.en: A {bronchotomy} was needed to remove the object.
e.zh: 需要施行支气管切开术取出异物。

e.en: {Bronchotomy} is rarely performed today.
e.zh: 如今支气管切开术已很少施行。

e.en: The right {bronchus} is shorter than the left.
e.zh: 右支气管比左支气管短。

e.en: A foreign object lodged in his {bronchus}.
e.zh: 一个异物卡在他的支气管里。

e.en: The old {broncobuster} had scars from years of riding.
e.zh: 那位老驯马牛仔身上满是多年骑马留下的伤疤。

e.en: Every ranch hand admired the daring {broncobuster}.
e.zh: 每个牧场工人都钦佩那位大胆的驯马牛仔。

brontides.t: 地鸣；类似远雷的低沉地声

e.en: Locals reported strange {brontides} before the quake.
e.zh: 地震前当地人报告听到了奇怪的地鸣。

e.en: Scientists still debate what causes {brontides}.
e.zh: 科学家们仍在争论地鸣的成因。

e.en: The observatory installed a new {brontograph}.
e.zh: 天文台安装了一台新的雷电记录仪。

e.en: A {brontograph} traces every nearby thunderclap.
e.zh: 雷电记录仪会记录附近的每一次雷鸣。

e.en: The {brontometer} measured the storm's intensity.
e.zh: 雷暴测量仪测出了风暴的强度。

e.en: Early meteorologists relied on the {brontometer}.
e.zh: 早期气象学家依赖雷暴测量仪。

e.en: The ancient {bronzesmith} forged ornate weapons.
e.zh: 古代的青铜匠锻造华丽的武器。

e.en: A skilled {bronzesmith} can repair antique statues.
e.zh: 熟练的青铜匠能修复古董雕像。

e.en: The geologist identified the rock as {bronzite}.
e.zh: 地质学家鉴定那块岩石为古铜辉石。

e.en: {Bronzite} is prized for its metallic luster.
e.zh: 古铜辉石因其金属光泽而备受珍视。

e.en: He caught a fat {brookie} from the mountain stream.
e.zh: 他从山间小溪里钓到一条肥美的溪鳟。

e.en: Anglers love hunting {brookie} in cold creeks.
e.zh: 垂钓者喜欢在冷溪里寻找溪鳟。

e.en: {Brookite} crystals are rare and prized.
e.zh: 板钛矿晶体十分罕见且珍贵。

e.en: The museum displayed a perfect {brookite} specimen.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块完美的板钛矿标本。

e.en: A clear {brooklet} ran through the meadow.
e.zh: 一条清澈的小溪穿过草地。

e.en: Children waded in the shallow {brooklet}.
e.zh: 孩子们在浅浅的小溪里涉水玩耍。

e.en: {Brooklime} grows along damp stream banks.
e.zh: 水苦荬生长在潮湿的溪岸边。

e.en: She picked some {brooklime} for her herbal tea.
e.zh: 她采了一些水苦荬来泡草药茶。

e.en: We spotted some {brookweed} growing along the marsh edge.
e.zh: 我们在沼泽边发现了一些水茴芹。

e.en: The botanist pressed a {brookweed} specimen into her notebook.
e.zh: 植物学家把一株水茴芹标本夹进了笔记本。

broomball.t: 扫帚球（类似冰球的运动）

e.en: Our office team plays {broomball} on Friday nights.
e.zh: 我们办公室的队伍每周五晚上打扫帚球。

e.en: She slipped on the ice during the {broomball} match.
e.zh: 她在扫帚球比赛中在冰上滑倒了。

e.en: He's been a {broomballer} since university.
e.zh: 他从大学起就是扫帚球运动员。

e.en: The rink was full of {broomballers} warming up.
e.zh: 溜冰场上挤满了正在热身的扫帚球运动员。

broomcorn.t: 帚用高粱（用来制作扫帚的高粱）

e.en: The farmer harvested rows of {broomcorn} for the local broom maker.
e.zh: 农夫收割了一排排帚用高粱卖给当地的扫帚匠。

e.en: They tied bundles of {broomcorn} together to dry.
e.zh: 他们把一捆捆帚用高粱扎在一起晾干。

e.en: {Broomrape} can devastate a clover crop within weeks.
e.zh: 列当能在几周内毁掉一片三叶草作物。

e.en: He pulled a stalk of {broomrape} from the field margin.
e.zh: 他从田边拔起一株列当。

broomy.t: 长满金雀花的；像扫帚的

e.en: They hiked across the {broomy} hillside in late May.
e.zh: 五月末他们徒步穿过长满金雀花的山坡。

e.en: A {broomy} tangle covered the abandoned lot.
e.zh: 废弃空地上覆满了像扫帚一样杂乱的灌木。

brose.t: 苏格兰燕麦糊（开水冲燕麦的一道菜）

e.en: Granny made a thick bowl of {brose} on cold mornings.
e.zh: 奶奶在寒冷的早晨会煮一大碗稠燕麦糊。

e.en: He ate his {brose} with a splash of cream.
e.zh: 他在燕麦糊里加了一点奶油吃。

brother-german.t: 同父同母的兄弟；亲兄弟

e.en: In the will, only a {brother-german} could inherit the estate.
e.zh: 按遗嘱，只有同父同母的兄弟才能继承这份产业。

e.en: He insisted that James was his {brother-german}, not a half-brother.
e.zh: 他坚称詹姆斯是他的亲兄弟，不是同父异母的兄弟。

e.en: As a {brotherless} only child, she leaned on her cousins.
e.zh: 作为没有兄弟的独生女，她很依赖表兄弟们。

e.en: He grew up {brotherless} in a household of sisters.
e.zh: 他在一个全是姐妹的家庭中长大，没有兄弟。

e.en: His {brotherlike} concern touched her deeply.
e.zh: 他兄弟般的关怀深深打动了她。

e.en: They shared a {brotherlike} bond despite being unrelated.
e.zh: 他们虽无血缘，却有着兄弟般的情谊。

e.en: The team was held together by a real sense of {brotherliness}.
e.zh: 这支队伍是靠真正的兄弟情谊凝聚在一起的。

e.en: He spoke of {brotherliness} as the highest virtue.
e.zh: 他把兄弟情谊视为最高的美德。

brothers-in-law.t: 姐夫；妹夫；连襟（brother-in-law 的复数）

e.en: Both her {brothers-in-law} came to the wedding.
e.zh: 她的两个姐夫都来参加了婚礼。

e.en: My {brothers-in-law} run a restaurant together.
e.zh: 我的几位连襟一起经营一家餐馆。

e.en: The {browless} mannequins gave the shop window an eerie look.
e.zh: 那些没有眉毛的人体模型让橱窗显得有些诡异。

e.en: Chemo had left her temporarily {browless}.
e.zh: 化疗让她一时没了眉毛。

brown-bag.t: 自带午餐；用纸袋装着带去

e.en: Most of us {brown-bag} our lunch to save money.
e.zh: 我们大多数人都自带午餐以省钱。

e.en: They held a {brown-bag} seminar at noon.
e.zh: 他们中午办了一场自带午餐的研讨会。

brown-earth.t: 棕壤（一种温带森林土壤）

e.en: The orchard thrives on the rich {brown-earth} of the valley.
e.zh: 果园在山谷肥沃的棕壤上长势喜人。

e.en: Geographers classified the area as {brown-earth} soil.
e.zh: 地理学家把这片区域归类为棕壤。

e.en: He'll {brown-nose} the boss to get a promotion.
e.zh: 他会对老板拍马屁以求升职。

e.en: Nobody likes a {brown-nose} in the team.
e.zh: 团队里没人喜欢马屁精。

e.en: She {brown-nosed} her way into the manager's good books.
e.zh: 她靠拍马屁讨得了经理的欢心。

e.en: He's {brown-nosed} every supervisor he's had.
e.zh: 他对自己的每位上司都拍过马屁。

brown-noses.t: 拍马屁（第三人称单数）；马屁精们

e.en: He always {brown-noses} the new director.
e.zh: 他总是对新主管拍马屁。

e.en: The office is full of {brown-noses}.
e.zh: 办公室里到处都是马屁精。

e.en: Her constant {brown-nosing} annoyed everyone.
e.zh: 她不停地拍马屁惹恼了所有人。

e.en: He got the job by shameless {brown-nosing}.
e.zh: 他靠厚颜无耻地拍马屁得到了那份工作。

e.en: The factory suffered a {brown-out} during the heat wave.
e.zh: 工厂在热浪期间遭遇了一次电压骤降。

e.en: A sudden {brown-out} dimmed the office lights.
e.zh: 一次突然的电压骤降让办公室的灯都变暗了。

e.en: The bruise had faded to a sickly {brown-purple}.
e.zh: 那块淤青已经褪成了一种病恹恹的棕紫色。

e.en: She painted the petals a deep {brown-purple}.
e.zh: 她把花瓣画成了深棕紫色。

e.en: We hold a weekly {brownbag} session for new hires.
e.zh: 我们每周为新员工举办一次自带午餐的分享会。

e.en: He prefers to {brownbag} it rather than eat out.
e.zh: 比起出去吃，他更愿意自带午餐。

browned-off.t: 恼火的；厌烦的（英式口语）

e.en: I'm getting really {browned-off} with these delays.
e.zh: 这些拖延真让我越来越恼火。

e.en: He looked thoroughly {browned-off} after the meeting.
e.zh: 开完会后他看上去十分不爽。

e.en: She picked the {brownest} loaf on the shelf.
e.zh: 她挑了货架上颜色最深的那条面包。

e.en: His skin was the {brownest} after a summer outdoors.
e.zh: 在户外过完一个夏天后，他的皮肤晒得最黑。

e.en: Don't {brownnose} the manager just to get ahead.
e.zh: 别为了出头就去拍经理的马屁。

e.en: Everyone could see he was a {brownnose}.
e.zh: 谁都看得出来他是个马屁精。

e.en: He's the office {brownnoser} and proud of it.
e.zh: 他是办公室里的马屁精，还挺得意。

e.en: Nobody trusts a shameless {brownnoser}.
e.zh: 没人会信任一个厚颜无耻的马屁精。

brownprint.t: 棕图（一种棕色底图的复印件）

e.en: The architect handed over a fragile old {brownprint}.
e.zh: 建筑师递过来一张脆旧的棕图。

e.en: They made a {brownprint} copy of the plan.
e.zh: 他们把图纸复印成了一份棕图。

browsability.t: 可浏览性；易于浏览的程度

e.en: The redesign greatly improved the site's {browsability}.
e.zh: 重新设计大大提升了网站的可浏览性。

e.en: They tested the catalog for {browsability} on mobile.
e.zh: 他们测试了目录在手机上的可浏览性。

e.en: {Brrr}, it's freezing out here!
e.zh: 哆嗦，外面冷死了！

e.en: She opened the door and gasped, "{Brrr}!"
e.zh: 她打开门，倒抽一口气："好冷啊！"

bryological.t: 苔藓学的；与苔藓研究相关的

e.en: She published a {bryological} survey of the cloud forest.
e.zh: 她发表了一份云雾林的苔藓学调查报告。

e.en: The museum hosts a small {bryological} collection.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏着少量苔藓学标本。

bryologist.t: 苔藓学家；研究苔藓的学者

e.en: The {bryologist} identified the moss within seconds.
e.zh: 那位苔藓学家几秒钟就辨认出了那种苔藓。

e.en: A visiting {bryologist} led the field trip.
e.zh: 一位来访的苔藓学家带队进行了野外考察。

bryology.t: 苔藓学；研究苔藓植物的学科

e.en: He devoted his career to {bryology}.
e.zh: 他把整个职业生涯献给了苔藓学。

e.en: The university offers a course in {bryology}.
e.zh: 该大学开设了一门苔藓学课程。

bryophyte.t: 苔藓植物；苔类与藓类的统称

e.en: Mosses are the most familiar kind of {bryophyte}.
e.zh: 藓类是最常见的苔藓植物。

e.en: Each {bryophyte} thrives in damp shade.
e.zh: 每种苔藓植物都喜欢潮湿阴暗的环境。

bryophytic.t: 苔藓植物的；属于苔藓类的

e.en: The rocks were covered in a {bryophytic} layer.
e.zh: 岩石上覆盖着一层苔藓植物。

e.en: They studied {bryophytic} diversity in the swamp.
e.zh: 他们研究了沼泽中苔藓植物的多样性。

bryozoology.t: 苔藓动物学；研究苔藓虫的学科

e.en: Few biologists specialize in {bryozoology}.
e.zh: 很少有生物学家专攻苔藓动物学。

e.en: Her thesis broke new ground in {bryozoology}.
e.zh: 她的论文在苔藓动物学领域开辟了新天地。

bubbie.t: 奶奶；外婆（意第绪语口语昵称）

e.en: My {bubbie} bakes the best challah in town.
e.zh: 我奶奶烤的哈拉面包是镇上最好吃的。

e.en: He still calls his grandmother {bubbie}.
e.zh: 他至今仍叫祖母“bubbie”。

e.en: She relaxed in a hot {bubble-bath} after work.
e.zh: 下班后她在热腾腾的泡泡浴里放松。

e.en: The kids poured too much {bubble-bath} into the tub.
e.zh: 孩子们往浴缸里倒了太多泡泡浴液。

bubble-top.t: 圆顶罩；车顶透明气泡罩

e.en: The vintage car had a clear {bubble-top}.
e.zh: 那辆老爷车装着透明的圆顶罩。

e.en: Engineers redesigned the helicopter's {bubble-top}.
e.zh: 工程师重新设计了直升机的气泡形顶罩。

e.en: Don't be such a {bubblehead}—read the instructions.
e.zh: 别这么糊涂——把说明读一下。

e.en: He played a charming {bubblehead} in the sitcom.
e.zh: 他在情景喜剧里演了一个可爱的傻大姐。

e.en: She gave a {bubbleheaded} laugh and walked off.
e.zh: 她傻乎乎地笑了一声就走开了。

e.en: The script makes him sound {bubbleheaded}.
e.zh: 剧本把他写得头脑空空的。

e.en: The presidential limo had a {bubbletop}.
e.zh: 那辆总统专车装有透明圆顶罩。

e.en: Pilots peered through the canopy {bubbletop}.
e.zh: 飞行员透过气泡形座舱罩向外张望。

e.en: Champagne is {bubblier} than prosecco.
e.zh: 香槟比普罗赛克起泡酒泡沫更多。

e.en: She seemed {bubblier} than usual today.
e.zh: 她今天似乎比平时更活泼。

e.en: Her {bubbliness} brightened the whole office.
e.zh: 她的活泼劲儿让整个办公室都明亮起来。

e.en: The wine is prized for its {bubbliness}.
e.zh: 这款酒因丰富的气泡而备受推崇。

e.en: Come here, {bubby}, give me a hug.
e.zh: 过来，小家伙，抱一个。

e.en: He still calls his little brother {bubby}.
e.zh: 他还叫他小弟弟“bubby”。

bubinga.t: 布宾加木；非洲红木的一种

e.en: The guitar's back is made of {bubinga}.
e.zh: 这把吉他的背板是用布宾加木做的。

e.en: {Bubinga} has a striking reddish grain.
e.zh: 布宾加木有醒目的红色纹理。

bubkes.t: 一无所获；屁都没有（口语）

e.en: After all that work, I got {bubkes}.
e.zh: 忙活了半天，我什么都没捞到。

e.en: They paid him {bubkes} for the gig.
e.zh: 那场演出他们一分钱都没给他。

bubo.t: 腹股沟淋巴结肿块；横痃

e.en: A swollen {bubo} signaled the plague.
e.zh: 肿大的淋巴结预示着鼠疫。

e.en: The doctor lanced the painful {bubo}.
e.zh: 医生切开了那个疼痛的淋巴肿块。

buboes.t: 腹股沟淋巴结肿块（复数）

e.en: Plague victims developed painful {buboes}.
e.zh: 鼠疫患者会长出疼痛的淋巴结肿块。

e.en: The {buboes} appeared overnight.
e.zh: 那些淋巴肿块一夜之间就冒了出来。

e.en: He wore an embroidered {bubu} to the wedding.
e.zh: 他穿着绣花的布布袍去参加婚礼。

e.en: The market sold colorful {bubu} robes.
e.zh: 市场上卖着色彩鲜艳的布布袍。

e.en: The startup had a {buccaneerish} streak.
e.zh: 那家初创公司带着一股海盗般的冒险劲儿。

e.en: He grinned with {buccaneerish} charm.
e.zh: 他露出海盗般的迷人笑容。

e.en: A {buccinal} blast announced the king.
e.zh: 一阵号角声宣告国王驾到。

e.en: The poet described the wind's {buccinal} roar.
e.zh: 诗人描述了风像号角般的轰鸣。

e.en: The {buccinator} helps you blow out candles.
e.zh: 颊肌帮助你吹灭蜡烛。

e.en: Trumpet players rely on the {buccinator} muscle.
e.zh: 小号手十分依赖颊肌。

e.en: The dentist measured the {buccolingual} width.
e.zh: 牙医测量了牙齿的颊舌向宽度。

e.en: The fracture extended in a {buccolingual} direction.
e.zh: 裂纹沿着颊舌方向延伸。

bucentaur.t: 威尼斯总督的金色礼船

e.en: The {bucentaur} carried the doge across the lagoon.
e.zh: 那艘金色礼船载着总督穿过潟湖。

e.en: A model of the {bucentaur} sat in the museum.
e.zh: 博物馆里陈列着那艘礼船的模型。

buchu.t: 布枯叶；南非药用灌木叶

e.en: She brewed a tea from dried {buchu} leaves.
e.zh: 她用干布枯叶泡了一杯茶。

e.en: {Buchu} has long been used in folk medicine.
e.zh: 布枯叶在民间医学中有悠久的使用历史。

e.en: The mustang began to {buck-jump} wildly.
e.zh: 那匹野马开始疯狂地弓背尥蹶子。

e.en: He was thrown when the horse {buck-jumped}.
e.zh: 马一弓背猛跳，他就被甩了下来。

e.en: The report condemned departmental {buck-passing}.
e.zh: 报告谴责了各部门之间的推诿扯皮。

e.en: Stop the {buck-passing} and own the mistake.
e.zh: 别再踢皮球了，承认错误吧。

e.en: The old {buckayro} could rope any steer.
e.zh: 那个老牛仔能套住任何一头公牛。

e.en: Tales of the lone {buckayro} filled his books.
e.zh: 他的书里满是孤独牛仔的故事。

e.en: {Buckbean} grows in cold northern bogs.
e.zh: 睡菜生长在北方寒冷的沼泽中。

e.en: Herbalists once prized {buckbean} as a tonic.
e.zh: 草药师曾视睡菜为良药。

e.en: The novel mocked every village {buckeen}.
e.zh: 那部小说嘲讽了每一个乡村小绅士。

e.en: He played the {buckeen} despite his poverty.
e.zh: 尽管贫穷，他还是装出一副绅士派头。

e.en: Howdy, {buckeroo}, ready to ride?
e.zh: 你好啊，牛仔，准备好骑马了吗？

e.en: The young {buckeroo} won the rodeo.
e.zh: 那个年轻牛仔赢得了牛仔竞技赛。

bucketeer.t: 投机商；非法交易经纪人

e.en: Regulators cracked down on every {bucketeer}.
e.zh: 监管机构严打每一个非法经纪人。

e.en: He turned out to be a small-time {bucketeer}.
e.zh: 他原来只是个小打小闹的非法经纪。

e.en: The knife had a {buckhorn} handle.
e.zh: 那把刀有一个鹿角刀柄。

e.en: Hunters mounted the {buckhorn} above the fireplace.
e.zh: 猎人们把鹿角挂在壁炉上方。

e.en: The lord kept a pack of {buckhound}s.
e.zh: 那位贵族养了一群猎鹿犬。

e.en: The {buckhound} caught the deer's scent.
e.zh: 那只猎鹿犬嗅到了鹿的气味。

e.en: He sported a {buckish} top hat and cane.
e.zh: 他戴着一顶纨绔风的礼帽，拿着手杖。

e.en: The novel pokes fun at his {buckish} airs.
e.zh: 小说取笑他那纨绔派头。

e.en: The bronco began to {buckjump} fiercely.
e.zh: 那匹野马开始猛烈地弓背跳跃。

e.en: He stayed on through every {buckjump}.
e.zh: 他在每一次弓背猛跳中都没被甩下来。

e.en: Only experts can ride that {buckjumper}.
e.zh: 只有高手才骑得了那匹烈马。

e.en: The {buckjumper} threw three riders in a row.
e.zh: 那匹烈马接连甩下了三个骑手。

buckminsterfullerene.t: 巴克明斯特富勒烯；C60分子

e.en: {Buckminsterfullerene} consists of sixty carbon atoms.
e.zh: 巴克明斯特富勒烯由六十个碳原子组成。

e.en: They synthesized {buckminsterfullerene} in the lab.
e.zh: 他们在实验室里合成了巴克明斯特富勒烯。

buckminsterfullerenes.t: 巴克明斯特富勒烯（复数）

e.en: They isolated several {buckminsterfullerenes} for testing.
e.zh: 他们分离出几种巴克明斯特富勒烯用于测试。

e.en: {Buckminsterfullerenes} have unusual electrical properties.
e.zh: 巴克明斯特富勒烯具有不寻常的电学特性。

buckra.t: （旧时加勒比黑人对白人的称呼）白人老爷

e.en: In old plantation novels the field hands referred to the master as {buckra}.
e.zh: 在旧时种植园小说里，田间工人称主人为「白人老爷」。

e.en: The word {buckra} carries a heavy historical weight.
e.zh: buckra这个词承载着沉重的历史分量。

e.en: The farmer attached a {buckrake} to the tractor to gather the cut grass.
e.zh: 农夫把集草耙挂在拖拉机后面收拢割下的草。

e.en: A wide {buckrake} can clear a meadow in minutes.
e.zh: 一台宽幅集草耙几分钟就能清空一片草场。

e.en: He cut firewood with an old {bucksaw} in the shed.
e.zh: 他在棚子里用一把旧框锯锯柴火。

e.en: A {bucksaw} is lighter than a chainsaw but slower.
e.zh: 框锯比链锯轻，但锯起来慢。

buckshee.t: （英式俚语）免费的；额外白得的

e.en: He got a {buckshee} ticket from his mate at the gate.
e.zh: 他在门口从朋友那里白得一张票。

e.en: There was a {buckshee} pint waiting on the bar.
e.zh: 吧台上还摆着一杯免费啤酒等着他。

e.en: He tied a white {bucktail} onto the hook for bass fishing.
e.zh: 他把一只白色鹿尾毛拟饵绑在钩上钓鲈鱼。

e.en: A {bucktail} jig works well in murky water.
e.zh: 鹿尾毛铅头钩在浑水里效果不错。

e.en: The cartoon rabbit had two enormous {buckteeth}.
e.zh: 那只卡通兔子长着两颗大龅牙。

e.en: Braces eventually corrected his {buckteeth}.
e.zh: 牙箍最终矫正了他的龅牙。

e.en: A single {bucktooth} stuck out when he smiled.
e.zh: 他笑起来时露出一颗凸出的龅牙。

e.en: The dentist filed down his prominent {bucktooth}.
e.zh: 牙医把他凸出的龅牙磨小了一些。

e.en: A {bucktoothed} boy grinned at the camera.
e.zh: 一个龅牙的小男孩对着镜头咧嘴笑。

e.en: The mascot is a friendly {bucktoothed} beaver.
e.zh: 吉祥物是一只长着龅牙的友好海狸。

e.en: The lab synthesized a new kind of {buckytube} for the battery.
e.zh: 实验室合成了一种用于电池的新型碳纳米管。

e.en: A {buckytube} is essentially a rolled-up sheet of graphene.
e.zh: 巴基管本质上就是卷起来的石墨烯片。

bucolically.t: 田园诗般地，乡村风光地

e.en: Sheep grazed {bucolically} on the hillside.
e.zh: 羊群在山坡上悠然地吃着草，宛如田园画。

e.en: The poem ends {bucolically} with a shepherd at sunset.
e.zh: 这首诗以夕阳下的牧羊人收尾，富有田园气息。

e.en: The two managers got all {buddy-buddy} after the deal closed.
e.zh: 交易一谈成，两位经理就变得像铁哥们儿似的。

e.en: I don't trust his sudden {buddy-buddy} attitude.
e.zh: 我不相信他突然变得这么哥们儿热乎的态度。

budget-holder.t: 预算负责人，掌管预算者

e.en: As the {budget-holder}, she has to approve every purchase.
e.zh: 作为预算负责人，她得审批每一笔采购。

e.en: Each department's {budget-holder} reports to the finance director.
e.zh: 每个部门的预算负责人都向财务总监汇报。

budget-minded.t: 精打细算的，注重省钱的

e.en: The hotel caters to {budget-minded} travelers.
e.zh: 这家酒店面向精打细算的旅客。

e.en: She gave us {budget-minded} tips for furnishing the apartment.
e.zh: 她给了我们一些省钱布置公寓的建议。

budgeteer.t: 编制预算的人，预算工作者

e.en: The veteran {budgeteer} spotted the error in seconds.
e.zh: 那位资深预算员几秒钟就发现了错误。

e.en: Every {budgeteer} dreads the end of the fiscal year.
e.zh: 每个做预算的人都怕财年末的到来。

e.en: The frost left the rose bushes {budless} that spring.
e.zh: 那年春天霜冻让玫瑰丛一颗花蕾也没长。

e.en: A {budless} branch usually means the plant is stressed.
e.zh: 一根不发芽的枝条通常意味着植物正受胁迫。

e.en: Tiny {budlets} appeared along the stem after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后茎干上冒出了一个个小芽。

e.en: Each {budlet} will eventually open into a full flower.
e.zh: 每个小芽最终都会绽放成完整的花朵。

e.en: The {budworm} infestation devastated the spruce forest.
e.zh: 芽虫的爆发使云杉林遭到严重破坏。

e.en: Foresters spray to control the spruce {budworm}.
e.zh: 林务员喷药防治云杉芽虫。

e.en: The car's clear coat is fully {buffable} after curing.
e.zh: 车漆面在固化之后完全可以抛光。

e.en: Choose a {buffable} wax for the best shine.
e.zh: 挑一款可抛光的车蜡才能打出最佳光泽。

buffalofish.t: 水牛鱼（北美一种淡水鱼）

e.en: Anglers on the Mississippi often catch {buffalofish}.
e.zh: 在密西西比河上钓鱼的人常常能钓到水牛鱼。

e.en: Smoked {buffalofish} is a regional delicacy.
e.zh: 熏水牛鱼是当地的一道特色菜。

e.en: The workshop floor was covered in leather {buffings}.
e.zh: 工坊地板上铺满了皮革打磨下来的碎屑。

e.en: They sweep up the metal {buffings} at the end of each shift.
e.zh: 他们每班下班时都会把金属抛光屑扫起来。

bufflehead.t: 白枕鹊鸭（一种小型潜水鸭）

e.en: A pair of {bufflehead} ducks bobbed on the icy lake.
e.zh: 一对白枕鹊鸭在结冰的湖面上起伏游动。

e.en: The male {bufflehead} has a striking white patch on its head.
e.zh: 雄性白枕鹊鸭头上有一块显眼的白斑。

e.en: His political {buffoonism} masked a sharp strategic mind.
e.zh: 他在政治上的滑稽作派掩盖了一颗精明的战略头脑。

e.en: The audience grew tired of the actor's constant {buffoonism}.
e.zh: 观众渐渐厌倦了那位演员不停的丑角作派。

bug-eyed.t: 瞪大眼睛的；目瞪口呆的

e.en: He stared {bug-eyed} at the magician's trick.
e.zh: 他瞪大眼睛盯着魔术师的把戏。

e.en: The kids were {bug-eyed} with excitement.
e.zh: 孩子们激动得眼睛瞪得圆圆的。

e.en: She works as a professional {bug-hunter} for the security firm.
e.zh: 她在那家安全公司当专业漏洞猎人。

e.en: The little {bug-hunter} ran around the garden with a net.
e.zh: 那个捉虫小能手拿着网在花园里跑来跑去。

e.en: She planted {bugbane} along the shaded border.
e.zh: 她在背阴的花境边种了升麻。

e.en: The {bugbane} was prized for its tall white spikes.
e.zh: 这种升麻因其高高的白色花穗而备受喜爱。

e.en: The old {bugeye} was restored at the maritime museum.
e.zh: 那艘老式凸眼帆船在海事博物馆里被修复了。

e.en: They sailed a wooden {bugeye} across the bay.
e.zh: 他们驾着一艘木制凸眼帆船穿过海湾。

buggier.t: 更多漏洞的；故障更多的

e.en: This release feels {buggier} than the last one.
e.zh: 这个版本感觉比上一版漏洞还多。

e.en: The beta build is noticeably {buggier} on older phones.
e.zh: 测试版在旧手机上明显问题更多。

bughouse.t: 疯人院；精神病院；疯狂的

e.en: The trading floor turned into a complete {bughouse}.
e.zh: 交易大厅简直变成了疯人院。

e.en: He muttered something about a {bughouse} idea.
e.zh: 他嘟囔着说了个疯狂的主意。

e.en: The company hired a freelance {bughunter} to test the app.
e.zh: 公司雇了个自由职业漏洞猎人来测试这款应用。

e.en: Every {bughunter} on the team got a bonus.
e.zh: 团队里的每个捉虫人都拿到了奖金。

e.en: A soldier sounded the {bugle-horn} at dawn.
e.zh: 一名士兵在黎明吹响了军号。

e.en: The hunter raised his {bugle-horn} to call the hounds.
e.zh: 猎人举起猎号召唤猎犬。

e.en: A tiny {buglet} crawled across the page.
e.zh: 一只小虫子爬过书页。

e.en: There's still a {buglet} in the login flow.
e.zh: 登录流程里还有个小漏洞。

e.en: Blue {bugloss} flowers lined the country road.
e.zh: 蓝色的牛舌草花开在乡间小路两旁。

e.en: She added {bugloss} petals to the salad.
e.zh: 她在沙拉里加了几片牛舌草花瓣。

e.en: The kids called their uncle a {bugologist}.
e.zh: 孩子们管他们叔叔叫昆虫学家。

e.en: He's a self-styled {bugologist} with a backyard collection.
e.zh: 他自封为昆虫学家，在后院收藏了一堆标本。

e.en: She joked that her hobby was amateur {bugology}.
e.zh: 她开玩笑说自己的爱好是业余昆虫学。

e.en: The class was basically backyard {bugology}.
e.zh: 这堂课基本上就是后院昆虫学。

e.en: He kept a {bugout} bag by the front door.
e.zh: 他在前门旁备了一个应急逃生包。

e.en: They had a {bugout} plan in case of wildfire.
e.zh: 他们准备了一套应对山火的紧急撤离方案。

e.en: {Bugseed} grows in dry sandy soil.
e.zh: 虫实草生长在干燥的沙质土里。

e.en: The botanist pointed out a patch of {bugseed}.
e.zh: 植物学家指着一片虫实草。

e.en: The cabinet was decorated with elaborate {buhl}.
e.zh: 那个柜子装饰着精致的镶嵌细工。

e.en: He restored the antique {buhl} table for the museum.
e.zh: 他为博物馆修复了那张古董镶嵌细工桌。

buhlwork.t: 镶嵌细工；布尔镶嵌工艺

e.en: The desk featured intricate {buhlwork} on its surface.
e.zh: 那张书桌的桌面上有精巧的镶嵌细工。

e.en: She admired the brass and tortoiseshell {buhlwork}.
e.zh: 她欣赏着那件黄铜和玳瑁的镶嵌细工。

e.en: The mill used a heavy {buhr} for grinding wheat.
e.zh: 磨坊用一块沉重的磨石来磨小麦。

e.en: He chiseled the {buhr} back into shape.
e.zh: 他把那块磨石重新凿出形状。

e.en: The old mill still has its original {buhrstone}.
e.zh: 那座老磨坊还保留着最初的磨石。

e.en: A pair of {buhrstone} wheels ground the grain.
e.zh: 一对磨石碾磨着谷物。

e.en: The treaty calls for a gradual {build-down} of nuclear arsenals.
e.zh: 该条约要求逐步削减核武库。

e.en: They negotiated a {build-down} of troop levels.
e.zh: 他们就部队规模的逐步削减进行了谈判。

e.en: The highway was financed under a {build-operate-transfer} model.
e.zh: 这条高速公路是按建设—经营—移交模式融资的。

e.en: They signed a {build-operate-transfer} contract for the power plant.
e.zh: 他们为这座电厂签订了一份建设—经营—移交合同。

e.en: There was a slow {build-up} of traffic on the highway.
e.zh: 高速公路上的车流逐渐增多。

e.en: The film got a huge media {build-up} before release.
e.zh: 这部电影上映前媒体大肆造势。

e.en: Sediment {build-ups} blocked the drainage pipes.
e.zh: 沉积物的积聚堵塞了排水管。

e.en: The team studied military {build-ups} along the border.
e.zh: 该团队研究了边境地区的军事集结。

builder-upper.t: 鼓舞士气者；增强体力的食物

e.en: Coach is a real {builder-upper} for the rookies.
e.zh: 教练对新人来说真是个鼓舞士气的人。

e.en: This soup is a great {builder-upper} after a cold.
e.zh: 这汤是感冒后绝佳的滋补品。

e.en: The truck delivered {building-materials} to the site.
e.zh: 卡车把建筑材料送到了工地。

e.en: Prices for {building-materials} have risen sharply.
e.zh: 建筑材料的价格大幅上涨。

e.en: They are {building-out} the office to fit more staff.
e.zh: 他们正在扩建办公室以容纳更多员工。

e.en: The startup is {building-out} its sales team.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在扩充销售团队。

e.en: They bought a small {building-plot} on the hill.
e.zh: 他们在山上买了一小块建筑用地。

e.en: Each {building-plot} comes with planning permission.
e.zh: 每块建筑用地都已获得规划许可。

e.en: Pressure was {building-up} inside the boiler.
e.zh: 锅炉内部压力正在不断累积。

e.en: She is {building-up} a loyal customer base.
e.zh: 她正在逐步建立起一批忠实的客户群。

e.en: The kitchen has {built-in} appliances throughout.
e.zh: 这间厨房到处都是内置电器。

e.en: The phone has a {built-in} translator.
e.zh: 这部手机内置了翻译功能。

e.en: The cabinets have {built-in-lighting} above the counters.
e.zh: 橱柜在台面上方装有内置照明。

e.en: They chose {built-in-lighting} for the hallway ceiling.
e.zh: 他们为走廊吊顶选择了嵌入式照明。

e.en: The diode's {built-in-potential} prevents current at zero bias.
e.zh: 二极管的内建电势使得零偏压时无电流通过。

e.en: Doping levels affect the junction's {built-in-potential}.
e.zh: 掺杂浓度会影响结的内建电势。

e.en: Speed limits are lower in {built-up} areas.
e.zh: 在建筑密集区限速更低。

e.en: Years of {built-up} resentment finally exploded.
e.zh: 积压多年的怨恨终于爆发了。

e.en: Python's {builtin} functions handle most basic tasks.
e.zh: Python 的内建函数能处理大多数基本任务。

e.en: He used a {builtin} method instead of writing his own.
e.zh: 他用了一个内建方法，而不是自己写一个。

buirdly.t: 健壮的；魁梧的（苏格兰方言）

e.en: He was a {buirdly} lad of the highlands.
e.zh: 他是高地一个魁梧健壮的小伙子。

e.en: The blacksmith had {buirdly} shoulders.
e.zh: 那位铁匠有一双健壮的肩膀。

e.en: {Brucine} is a bitter alkaloid found in nux vomica seeds.
e.zh: 番木鳖碱是马钱子种子中一种味苦的生物碱。

e.en: Researchers used {brucine} to study nerve conduction.
e.zh: 研究者用马钱子碱研究神经传导。

e.en: {Brumal} winds swept across the moor.
e.zh: 冬日的寒风席卷荒野。

e.en: She loved the {brumal} silence of the forest.
e.zh: 她喜爱森林中那冬日般的寂静。

e.en: Wild {brumbies} roamed the Australian outback.
e.zh: 野生的布兰比马在澳大利亚内陆游荡。

e.en: The rancher tamed a young {brumby}.
e.zh: 牧场主驯服了一匹年轻的野马。

e.en: Morning {brume} hung over the valley.
e.zh: 晨雾笼罩着山谷。

e.en: The lighthouse barely pierced the {brume}.
e.zh: 灯塔的光几乎穿不透浓雾。

brummagem.t: 华而不实的；廉价俗艳的

e.en: He sold {brummagem} jewelry to tourists.
e.zh: 他向游客兜售华而不实的首饰。

e.en: The shop was full of {brummagem} trinkets.
e.zh: 店里满是廉价俗丽的小饰品。

brummy.t: 伯明翰人；伯明翰口音的

e.en: His thick {Brummy} accent gave him away.
e.zh: 他浓重的伯明翰口音暴露了他的身份。

e.en: She's a proud {Brummy} born and raised.
e.zh: 她是地道的伯明翰人，土生土长。

e.en: We climbed through the {brumous} morning air.
e.zh: 我们在雾蒙蒙的清晨空气中攀登。

e.en: The {brumous} hills disappeared into grey.
e.zh: 雾蒙蒙的山丘消失在灰蒙蒙之中。

e.en: She married a {Bruneian} businessman.
e.zh: 她嫁给了一位文莱商人。

e.en: {Bruneian} cuisine reflects strong Malay influences.
e.zh: 文莱菜系深受马来风味的影响。

brung.t: bring 的非标准过去式：带来（方言/口语）

e.en: He {brung} his guitar to the party.
e.zh: 他把吉他带到了派对上。

e.en: Look what the cat {brung} in!
e.zh: 瞧瞧猫叼进来什么了！

e.en: {Brunizem} soils support highly productive cornfields.
e.zh: 棕黑土支撑着高产的玉米田。

e.en: Researchers carefully studied the {brunizem} layers.
e.zh: 研究人员仔细考察了棕黑土的土层。

e.en: A {brush-fire} threatened the hillside homes.
e.zh: 一场灌丛火灾威胁到了山坡上的住宅。

e.en: The dispute became a political {brush-fire}.
e.zh: 这场争端演变成了政坛上的一场小风波。

brush-lubricated.t: 用电刷润滑的（技术术语）

e.en: The motor uses a {brush-lubricated} commutator.
e.zh: 这台电机采用电刷润滑式换向器。

e.en: {Brush-lubricated} bearings reduce friction quite efficiently.
e.zh: 电刷润滑式轴承可有效减小摩擦。

e.en: He gave her the {brush-off} at the party.
e.zh: 在派对上他把她冷淡地打发走了。

e.en: Don't take the {brush-off} too personally.
e.zh: 别把这种冷遇放在心上。

e.en: Her bold {brush-strokes} defined the canvas.
e.zh: 她大胆的笔触决定了整幅画作的气质。

e.en: He added a final {brush-stroke} to the portrait.
e.zh: 他给那幅肖像添上了最后一笔。

e.en: A {brush-turkey} scratched leaves into a mound.
e.zh: 一只丛冢雉把落叶扒成了一个土堆。

e.en: {Brush-turkeys} build huge incubation mounds.
e.zh: 丛冢雉会筑起巨大的孵化丘。

e.en: I need a {brush-up} on my French grammar.
e.zh: 我得把法语语法复习一下。

e.en: She booked a {brush-up} lesson before the exam.
e.zh: 她在考试前预约了一节复习课。

e.en: The paint's {brushability} makes it easy to apply.
e.zh: 这种油漆的易刷性使其涂刷起来很方便。

e.en: Manufacturers carefully test the coating's {brushability}.
e.zh: 厂家会仔细测试涂料的可刷性。

e.en: The pitcher threw a {brushback} to intimidate him.
e.zh: 投手投了一个内角逼身球来威慑他。

e.en: {Brushback} pitches often spark heated arguments.
e.zh: 逼身球常常会引发激烈的争吵。

e.en: Cattle grazed across the dry {brushland}.
e.zh: 牛群在干旱的灌木荒地上吃草。

e.en: Coyotes hunted throughout the {brushland}.
e.zh: 郊狼在灌木荒野上四处捕猎。

e.en: She gave the salesman a quick {brushoff}.
e.zh: 她干脆地把推销员打发走了。

e.en: His proposal got an icy {brushoff}.
e.zh: 他的提议遭到了冷淡的拒绝。

e.en: He needs a {brushup} on safety procedures.
e.zh: 他需要复习一下安全规程。

e.en: A weekend {brushup} course helped a lot.
e.zh: 一个周末的复习课帮助很大。

brusk.t: 唐突的；粗率的（brusque 的变体）

e.en: His {brusk} reply ended the conversation.
e.zh: 他生硬的回答结束了对话。

e.en: Don't be so {brusk} with the new staff.
e.zh: 别对新员工那么生硬。

brutalisation.t: 残忍化；变得野蛮；残暴对待

e.en: The war led to widespread {brutalisation}.
e.zh: 那场战争导致了大范围的残暴化。

e.en: He spoke of the {brutalisation} of prisoners.
e.zh: 他谈到了对囚犯的残暴对待。

brutalism.t: 粗野主义（建筑风格）；残暴行为

e.en: The library is a classic example of {brutalism}.
e.zh: 这座图书馆是粗野主义建筑的典型代表。

e.en: Critics deplored the regime's {brutalism}.
e.zh: 评论家强烈谴责该政权的残暴。

e.en: The {brutalist} concrete tower divided opinion.
e.zh: 那座粗野主义风格的混凝土高塔引发了争议。

e.en: She studied {brutalist} architecture in Berlin.
e.zh: 她在柏林研究粗野主义建筑。

brutalitarian.t: 残暴极权的；野蛮专制的

e.en: The novel depicts a {brutalitarian} regime.
e.zh: 这本小说描绘了一个残暴极权的政权。

e.en: Refugees fled the {brutalitarian} state.
e.zh: 难民们逃离了那个野蛮专制的国家。

brutified.t: 使变得麻木残忍（brutify 的过去式）

e.en: Years of war had {brutified} the soldiers.
e.zh: 多年的战争使士兵们变得麻木残忍。

e.en: Hardship {brutified} the once-gentle man.
e.zh: 艰难的生活让这个原本温和的男人变得粗暴。

e.en: Constant violence can {brutify} a person.
e.zh: 持续的暴力会让人变得麻木残忍。

e.en: Such labor tends to {brutify} the workers.
e.zh: 这种劳作往往会使工人变得粗野。

brutifying.t: 使变野蛮的；使麻木残忍的

e.en: He warned of the {brutifying} effects of war.
e.zh: 他警告说战争会使人变得麻木残忍。

e.en: She wrote about the {brutifying} prison routine.
e.zh: 她描写了那令人变得麻木的监狱日常。

e.en: The film exposes the {brutism} of warfare.
e.zh: 这部影片揭露了战争的野蛮本性。

e.en: He firmly condemned the {brutism} of the regime.
e.zh: 他坚决谴责该政权的野蛮行径。

e.en: Awright {bruvver}, how's it going today?
e.zh: 嘿兄弟，今天过得怎么样？

e.en: Me and me {bruvver} grew up here.
e.zh: 我和我兄弟就在这儿长大。

e.en: The dentist diagnosed her with {bruxism}.
e.zh: 牙医诊断她患有磨牙症。

e.en: Stress can worsen nighttime {bruxism}.
e.zh: 压力会加重夜间磨牙的症状。

bulldyke.t: 男性化的女同性恋者（俚语，含贬义）

e.en: The term {bulldyke} is considered offensive by many.
e.zh: 许多人认为这个词带有冒犯性。

e.en: She rejected the {bulldyke} label imposed on her.
e.zh: 她拒绝接受别人强加给她的这个标签。

bullet-head.t: 圆而小的脑袋；顽固的人

e.en: He had a closely shaved {bullet-head}.
e.zh: 他剃着一颗圆圆的小脑袋。

e.en: That stubborn {bullet-head} won't listen to reason.
e.zh: 那个顽固的家伙根本听不进道理。

bullet-headed.t: 头小而圆的；倔强固执的

e.en: The {bullet-headed} sergeant barked another order.
e.zh: 那个圆头小脑的中士又吼出一道命令。

e.en: He was too {bullet-headed} to admit his mistake.
e.zh: 他太固执了，不肯承认错误。

e.en: The soldier's shaved {bullethead} gleamed in the sun.
e.zh: 士兵剃光的圆脑袋在阳光下发亮。

e.en: Don't be such a {bullethead} about it.
e.zh: 别在这件事上这么固执。

e.en: The {bullgrader} cleared the construction site quickly.
e.zh: 推土平地机迅速清理了工地。

e.en: They rented a {bullgrader} for the road project.
e.zh: 他们为道路工程租了一台推土平地机。

e.en: He {bullheadedly} refused all advice.
e.zh: 他固执地拒绝一切建议。

e.en: She pursued her plan {bullheadedly}.
e.zh: 她一意孤行地推进自己的计划。

e.en: His {bullheadedness} cost the team the contract.
e.zh: 他的固执让团队失去了那份合同。

e.en: Her {bullheadedness} eventually paid off.
e.zh: 她的固执最终得到了回报。

bullier.t: 更具威吓性的；更欺负人的

e.en: His tone grew {bullier} with each question.
e.zh: 他的语气随着每一个问题变得更加咄咄逼人。

e.en: The older boys were {bullier} than the rest.
e.zh: 那些大男孩比其他人更爱欺负人。

e.en: The {bullionist} argued against paper currency.
e.zh: 那位硬币本位主义者反对使用纸币。

e.en: Nineteenth-century {bullionists} dominated monetary debates.
e.zh: 十九世纪的硬币本位论者主导了货币辩论。

e.en: Their {bullmastiff} guards the property at night.
e.zh: 他们的斗牛獒犬夜里看护房产。

e.en: A {bullmastiff} can weigh over fifty kilograms.
e.zh: 斗牛獒犬体重可超过五十公斤。

e.en: The {bullnecked} bouncer blocked the entrance.
e.zh: 那个粗脖子的保镖挡住了入口。

e.en: He was a short, {bullnecked} wrestler.
e.zh: 他是个矮个子、粗脖子的摔跤手。

e.en: The old {bullocky} drove his team across the outback.
e.zh: 那位老赶牛车人赶着牛队穿过内陆。

e.en: He swore like a {bullocky}.
e.zh: 他骂起人来像个赶牛车的。

e.en: The patient developed a {bullous} skin condition.
e.zh: 患者出现了大疱性皮肤病。

e.en: {Bullous} pemphigoid mainly affects elderly people.
e.zh: 大疱性类天疱疮主要影响老年人。

bullroarer.t: 牛吼器（一种甩动发声的乐器）

e.en: The {bullroarer} produced a low humming sound.
e.zh: 牛吼器发出低沉的嗡嗡声。

e.en: Aboriginal ceremonies often featured a {bullroarer}.
e.zh: 原住民仪式中常会用到牛吼器。

bullshot.t: 牛肉清汤伏特加鸡尾酒

e.en: He ordered a {bullshot} at the brunch bar.
e.zh: 他在早午餐吧台点了一杯牛肉清汤鸡尾酒。

e.en: A {bullshot} is a savory cold-weather drink.
e.zh: 牛肉清汤伏特加是一种适合冷天的咸味饮品。

e.en: Their {bullterrier} loves chasing tennis balls.
e.zh: 他们的牛头梗喜欢追网球。

e.en: A {bullterrier} needs plenty of exercise daily.
e.zh: 牛头梗每天需要大量运动。

e.en: The angler landed a huge {bulltrout}.
e.zh: 那位钓手钓上了一条巨大的公鳟鱼。

e.en: {Bulltrout} thrive in cold mountain streams.
e.zh: 公鳟鱼在寒冷的山间溪流中生长良好。

bullwhack.t: 用牛皮鞭抽打；牛皮长鞭

e.en: The driver cracked his {bullwhack} over the oxen.
e.zh: 赶车人朝牛队甩响了牛皮长鞭。

e.en: He learned how to {bullwhack} a stubborn team.
e.zh: 他学会了用长鞭驱赶顽固的牛队。

bullwhacker.t: 赶牛车的人；用长鞭驱牛者

e.en: The {bullwhacker} hauled freight across the prairie.
e.zh: 那位赶牛车人把货物运过大草原。

e.en: Old {bullwhackers} told wild tales by the fire.
e.zh: 老赶牛车人围着火堆讲狂野的故事。

e.en: He did the {bullwork} while others supervised.
e.zh: 他干着重活，别人在一旁监督。

e.en: Most of the {bullwork} fell to the interns.
e.zh: 大部分苦力活都落到了实习生头上。

e.en: The politician hired {bully-boys} to intimidate voters.
e.zh: 那个政客雇打手来恐吓选民。

e.en: A pair of {bully-boys} guarded the door.
e.zh: 两个打手守在门口。

e.en: The new recruit was {bullyragged} for weeks.
e.zh: 那位新兵被欺凌了好几个星期。

e.en: She felt {bullyragged} into accepting the deal.
e.zh: 她觉得自己是被逼着接受了那个协议。

e.en: The constant {bullyragging} drove him to quit.
e.zh: 持续的欺凌让他选择了辞职。

e.en: Teachers will not tolerate any {bullyragging}.
e.zh: 老师不会容忍任何欺凌行为。

e.en: She kept her passport in her {bum-bag}.
e.zh: 她把护照放在腰包里。

e.en: Tourists love wearing {bum-bags} for convenience.
e.zh: 游客喜欢戴腰包，因为很方便。

e.en: Fans tried to {bum-rush} the stage.
e.zh: 歌迷试图蜂拥冲上舞台。

e.en: The crowd {bum-rushed} the entrance when doors opened.
e.zh: 开门的瞬间人群挤着冲进入口。

e.en: He stuffed his cash into a {bumbag}.
e.zh: 他把现金塞进了腰包里。

e.en: {Bumbags} are back in fashion this year.
e.zh: 今年腰包又流行起来了。

e.en: The {bumbailiff} arrived to seize the goods.
e.zh: 那名差役前来扣押货物。

e.en: In Dickens's day, a {bumbailiff} was much feared.
e.zh: 在狄更斯时代，差役令人闻风丧胆。

e.en: Don't forget your {bumbershoot}, it's pouring.
e.zh: 别忘了带雨伞，外面下大雨呢。

e.en: Grandpa always carried a black {bumbershoot}.
e.zh: 爷爷总是带着一把黑色的伞。

e.en: A {bumble-bee} buzzed around the lavender.
e.zh: 一只大黄蜂在薰衣草丛中嗡嗡作响。

e.en: {Bumble-bees} are vital pollinators.
e.zh: 大黄蜂是重要的传粉者。

e.en: He railed against the petty {bumbledom} of city hall.
e.zh: 他痛斥市政厅里小官僚的昏庸傲慢。

e.en: Such {bumbledom} stifles every reform attempt.
e.zh: 这种小官僚作风扼杀了每一次改革尝试。

e.en: Our hen developed {bumblefoot} after an injury.
e.zh: 我们的母鸡受伤后得了禽掌炎。

e.en: {Bumblefoot} can be treated with proper bandaging.
e.zh: 禽掌炎可以通过妥善包扎来治疗。

bumblepuppy.t: 乱打的桥牌；一种击球游戏

e.en: They played a chaotic round of {bumblepuppy}.
e.zh: 他们乱七八糟地打了一局桥牌。

e.en: Children once amused themselves with {bumblepuppy}.
e.zh: 孩子们曾以这种击球游戏自娱自乐。

bumbo.t: 朗姆酒糖水（旧时水手饮品）

e.en: The sailors drank {bumbo} after their long voyage.
e.zh: 水手们漫长航行结束后喝起了朗姆酒糖水。

e.en: {Bumbo} was a favorite drink in colonial taverns.
e.zh: 朗姆酒糖水是殖民地酒馆里很受欢迎的饮品。

bumboat.t: 卖货小船（向停泊船只供货的小艇）

e.en: A {bumboat} pulled alongside to sell fruit.
e.zh: 一艘卖货小船靠了过来兜售水果。

e.en: {Bumboats} surrounded the cruise ship in the harbor.
e.zh: 卖货小船在港口里围着邮轮转。

bumfluff.t: 少年下巴上的稀软胡须

e.en: His chin sported a wisp of {bumfluff}.
e.zh: 他下巴上挂着一缕稀软的小胡子。

e.en: Teenage boys often grow {bumfluff} before real beards.
e.zh: 青春期男孩在长出真正的胡子前常先冒出绒毛胡。

e.en: He wore a tight {bumfreezer} jacket.
e.zh: 他穿着一件紧身的短上衣。

e.en: That {bumfreezer} barely covers your waist.
e.zh: 那件短上衣几乎遮不住你的腰。

bumkin.t: 船首外伸短杠（航海术语）

e.en: The sailor secured the rope to the {bumkin}.
e.zh: 水手把绳子系在船首外伸短杠上。

e.en: A wooden {bumkin} extended from the bow.
e.zh: 船首伸出一根木制的外伸短杠。

e.en: Dried {bummalo} is a popular Mumbai snack.
e.zh: 晒干的龙头鱼是孟买的热门小吃。

e.en: They ordered fried {bummalo} at the seaside restaurant.
e.zh: 他们在海边餐厅点了炸龙头鱼。

e.en: She ordered a chicken {brochette} for dinner.
e.zh: 她晚餐点了一份鸡肉串。

e.en: The chef arranged the vegetables on a {brochette}.
e.zh: 厨师把蔬菜串在签子上。

e.en: Collectors prize a rare {brockage} from the mint.
e.zh: 藏家珍视铸币厂罕见的错版币。

e.en: The coin shows an obvious {brockage} error.
e.zh: 这枚硬币有明显的冲压错误。

e.en: A {brocket} darted across the forest path.
e.zh: 一只短角鹿窜过林间小道。

e.en: The {brocket} is native to South America.
e.zh: 短角鹿原产于南美洲。

e.en: The cliff is composed of weathered {brockram}.
e.zh: 这座悬崖由风化的角砾岩构成。

e.en: Geologists collected samples of {brockram} nearby.
e.zh: 地质学家在附近采集了角砾岩样本。

e.en: She steamed some {brocoli} for dinner.
e.zh: 她蒸了些西兰花当晚餐。

e.en: Children often dislike eating {brocoli}.
e.zh: 小孩子常常不喜欢吃西兰花。

e.en: He used a stick to {brod} the cattle.
e.zh: 他用棍子驱赶牛群。

e.en: The shepherd's {brod} lay against the fence.
e.zh: 牧人的尖棒靠在围栏上。

e.en: He used a {brog} to pierce the leather.
e.zh: 他用尖钻刺穿皮革。

e.en: The cobbler reached for his {brog}.
e.zh: 鞋匠伸手去拿他的锥子。

e.en: Maidens would {broider} the cloth with gold thread.
e.zh: 少女们会用金线在布上刺绣。

e.en: She learned to {broider} fine silk in her youth.
e.zh: 她年轻时学会了在丝绸上刺绣。

e.en: She wore a {broidered} silk gown to the ball.
e.zh: 她穿着绣花丝绸长袍参加舞会。

e.en: The chapel cloth was richly {broidered}.
e.zh: 礼拜堂的布料绣工精美。

e.en: The court hired a famed {broiderer} for the tapestry.
e.zh: 宫廷聘请了一位著名绣工制作挂毯。

e.en: Each {broiderer} had their own signature stitch.
e.zh: 每位绣花匠都有自己的独门针法。

broidering.t: 刺绣行为；做绣活（古英语）

e.en: She spent the afternoon {broidering} the tablecloth.
e.zh: 她花了一下午刺绣桌布。

e.en: Quiet {broidering} was a common pastime.
e.zh: 安静地刺绣是常见的消遣。

broiders.t: 刺绣；绣花（古语动词第三人称）

e.en: She {broiders} silk handkerchiefs for the gentry.
e.zh: 她为贵族绣制丝绸手帕。

e.en: He never {broiders} unless paid handsomely.
e.zh: 不重金邀请他绝不动针。

e.en: Her gown was decorated with delicate {broidery}.
e.zh: 她的礼服装饰着精致的绣花。

e.en: The tapestry's {broidery} took years to complete.
e.zh: 挂毯的绣工耗费多年才完成。

brokage.t: 经纪业务；中介佣金（古语）

e.en: The merchant earned a small {brokage} on each sale.
e.zh: 商人每笔交易赚取微薄佣金。

e.en: Old laws regulated the {brokage} of goods at port.
e.zh: 古法规范港口货物的中介业务。

broken-backed.t: 折断的；颓败的；龙骨折断的

e.en: The {broken-backed} ship limped into harbor.
e.zh: 那艘龙骨折断的船蹒跚驶入港口。

e.en: He returned a {broken-backed} man after the ordeal.
e.zh: 经历磨难后他变成了颓败之人。

broken-down.t: 损坏的；破旧的；身心垮掉的

e.en: We pushed the {broken-down} car off the road.
e.zh: 我们把那辆抛锚的车推到路边。

e.en: He lived in a {broken-down} cottage by the river.
e.zh: 他住在河边一间破旧的小屋里。

broken-field.t: 阵型零散的；穿插突进的（橄榄球术语）

e.en: His {broken-field} running thrilled the crowd.
e.zh: 他穿插突进式的奔跑让观众热血沸腾。

e.en: She watched the {broken-field} highlights again.
e.zh: 她又看了一遍突进精彩集锦。

e.en: She was {broken-hearted} after the breakup.
e.zh: 分手后她心碎不已。

e.en: He sang a {broken-hearted} ballad on stage.
e.zh: 他在台上唱了一首伤心的歌谣。

e.en: The {broken-winded} horse could no longer race.
e.zh: 那匹气喘的马再也无法参赛。

e.en: Only a {broken-winded} mule remained in the barn.
e.zh: 谷仓里只剩一匹喘不上气的骡子。

e.en: Their {brokendown} truck blocked the alley.
e.zh: 他们抛锚的卡车堵住了巷子。

e.en: She sold the {brokendown} furniture cheaply.
e.zh: 她把破旧的家具便宜卖了。

brokenhearted.t: 心碎的；伤心欲绝；悲痛的

e.en: He wrote a {brokenhearted} letter to his ex.
e.zh: 他给前任写了封心碎的信。

e.en: The {brokenhearted} child clung to her mother.
e.zh: 心碎的孩子紧紧抱着母亲。

e.en: Her {brokenheartedness} colored every poem she wrote.
e.zh: 她的伤心情怀渗透在每一首诗中。

e.en: Time slowly eased his {brokenheartedness}.
e.zh: 时间慢慢抚平了他的心碎。

broker-dealer.t: 证券经纪自营商；经纪自营机构

e.en: The firm registered as a licensed {broker-dealer}.
e.zh: 该公司注册为持牌证券经纪自营商。

e.en: Every {broker-dealer} must follow strict rules.
e.zh: 每家经纪自营商都必须遵守严格规定。

brolga.t: 澳洲鹤；澳大利亚特有大型鹤

e.en: A {brolga} performed its courtship dance in the wetlands.
e.zh: 一只澳洲鹤在湿地跳起求偶舞。

e.en: We spotted a {brolga} feeding by the lake.
e.zh: 我们看到一只澳洲鹤在湖边觅食。

e.en: She prepared a warm cup of {broma} for the guest.
e.zh: 她为客人准备了一杯热可可饮品。

e.en: Old recipes mention {broma} as a soothing drink.
e.zh: 古老食谱里提到这种可可饮品令人舒缓。

bromal.t: 溴醛；三溴乙醛；化学化合物

e.en: The lab synthesized {bromal} for further research.
e.zh: 实验室合成溴醛用于进一步研究。

e.en: Old textbooks describe {bromal} as a sedative compound.
e.zh: 旧教科书把溴醛描述为镇静化合物。

bromamide.t: 溴酰胺；溴化酰胺类化合物

e.en: Researchers studied {bromamide} reactions in the lab.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验室研究溴酰胺反应。

e.en: The compound {bromamide} forms under specific conditions.
e.zh: 溴酰胺这种化合物在特定条件下形成。

bromance.t: 男性间亲密友谊；兄弟情谊

e.en: Their {bromance} became a running joke at work.
e.zh: 他们的兄弟情谊成了同事间的笑谈。

e.en: The film celebrates a touching {bromance}.
e.zh: 这部电影歌颂了一段感人的兄弟情。

e.en: {Bromanil} is used in certain organic syntheses.
e.zh: 四溴对苯醌用于某些有机合成。

e.en: The chemist examined a sample of {bromanil}.
e.zh: 化学家检测了四溴对苯醌样本。

e.en: Excess {bromate} in water poses a health risk.
e.zh: 水中溴酸盐过量会带来健康风险。

e.en: Some bakers used to {bromate} flour for stronger dough.
e.zh: 过去一些面包师会用溴酸盐处理面粉增强筋度。

bromated.t: 溴酸盐处理过的；溴化的

e.en: The {bromated} flour produced firmer loaves.
e.zh: 经过溴酸盐处理的面粉烘出的面包更结实。

e.en: Many bakeries no longer use {bromated} ingredients.
e.zh: 许多面包店不再使用溴化原料。

e.en: The lab tested several {bromates} for safety.
e.zh: 实验室检测了几种溴酸盐的安全性。

e.en: She {bromates} the dough by adding the additive.
e.zh: 她通过添加溴酸盐处理面团。

bromating.t: 溴酸盐处理；溴化（进行式）

e.en: The process of {bromating} flour is now banned.
e.zh: 用溴酸盐处理面粉的工艺现已禁止。

e.en: They are {bromating} the mixture in stages.
e.zh: 他们正在分阶段对混合物进行溴化处理。

e.en: Industrial {bromation} requires careful monitoring.
e.zh: 工业溴化需要严格监控。

e.en: The {bromation} step improved the dough's elasticity.
e.zh: 溴酸盐处理步骤改善了面团弹性。

bromatium.t: 蚁巢菌瘿；蚁植共生膨大体

e.en: Each ant tended a tiny {bromatium} on the plant.
e.zh: 每只蚂蚁照看植株上一个小小的菌瘿。

e.en: The {bromatium} provides nutrients to the colony.
e.zh: 菌瘿为蚁群提供养分。

e.en: She earned a degree in {bromatology}.
e.zh: 她取得了食物学学位。

e.en: Modern {bromatology} overlaps with food chemistry.
e.zh: 现代食物学与食品化学有所交叉。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed mild {bromatoxism} from spoiled meat.
e.zh: 医生诊断为变质肉类引起的轻度食物中毒。

e.en: Outbreaks of {bromatoxism} prompted stricter inspections.
e.zh: 食物中毒事件促使加强检查。

e.en: The textbook lists {bromaurate} among rare gold salts.
e.zh: 教科书把溴金酸盐列入罕见金盐。

e.en: She isolated a tiny crystal of {bromaurate}.
e.zh: 她分离出一小颗溴金酸盐晶体。

bromcymene.t: 溴代伞花烃；溴异丙基甲苯

e.en: {Bromcymene} appears in some essential-oil derivatives.
e.zh: 溴代伞花烃存在于某些精油衍生物中。

e.en: The lab analyzed traces of {bromcymene} in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室分析了样本中微量的溴代伞花烃。

bromegrass.t: 雀麦草；牧场雀麦；饲料禾草

e.en: Farmers planted {bromegrass} for hay.
e.zh: 农民种植雀麦作干草。

e.en: Cattle grazed contentedly on the {bromegrass}.
e.zh: 牛群在雀麦草地上悠然吃草。

bromelain.t: 菠萝蛋白酶；菠萝中的酶

e.en: {Bromelain} is extracted from pineapple stems.
e.zh: 菠萝蛋白酶提取自菠萝茎。

e.en: Some supplements contain {bromelain} for digestion.
e.zh: 一些保健品含有菠萝蛋白酶帮助消化。

bromeliaceous.t: 凤梨科的；属于凤梨科植物的

e.en: The greenhouse showcased many {bromeliaceous} species.
e.zh: 温室展示了许多凤梨科植物。

e.en: Tropical forests are rich in {bromeliaceous} plants.
e.zh: 热带雨林中凤梨科植物繁多。

bromelin.t: 菠萝蛋白酶旧名；又称菠萝酵素

e.en: Older texts use the spelling {bromelin}.
e.zh: 旧文献使用 bromelin 这种拼写。

e.en: Pure {bromelin} can tenderize meat effectively.
e.zh: 纯菠萝蛋白酶可有效嫩化肉类。

e.en: The lamp had a {bulb-shaped} glass shade.
e.zh: 这盏灯有一个灯泡形的玻璃灯罩。

e.en: She admired the {bulb-shaped} flower vase.
e.zh: 她欣赏那个球茎形的花瓶。

e.en: The plant produces {bulbaceous} roots underground.
e.zh: 这种植物在地下长出鳞茎状的根。

e.en: Botanists collected several {bulbaceous} specimens from the field.
e.zh: 植物学家从田里采集了几株鳞茎类标本。

e.en: The patient suffered from {bulbar} palsy after the stroke.
e.zh: 病人在中风后患上延髓性麻痹。

e.en: Doctors examined the {bulbar} region of his brain.
e.zh: 医生检查了他大脑的延髓区域。

e.en: Each {bulbel} can grow into a new plant.
e.zh: 每个小鳞茎都可以长成一株新植物。

e.en: The gardener separated the tiny {bulbel} from the parent bulb.
e.zh: 园丁把小子球从母球上分开。

e.en: Many lilies are {bulbiferous} plants.
e.zh: 许多百合是有鳞茎的植物。

e.en: The {bulbiferous} species spreads quickly in the garden.
e.zh: 这种生鳞茎的物种在花园里蔓延得很快。

e.en: The pendant had a {bulbiform} crystal at the end.
e.zh: 吊坠末端有一颗鳞茎形的水晶。

e.en: She sketched the {bulbiform} structure carefully.
e.zh: 她仔细地描绘那个球茎形的结构。

e.en: Garlic produces a small {bulbil} on its stem.
e.zh: 大蒜在茎上长出一个小珠芽。

e.en: Each {bulbil} can be planted to grow new plants.
e.zh: 每一颗珠芽都可以种下来长出新植物。

e.en: The botanist observed a tiny {bulbille} on the leaf.
e.zh: 植物学家在叶子上观察到一个小珠芽。

e.en: Many ferns reproduce through {bulbille} structures.
e.zh: 许多蕨类通过小珠芽结构繁殖。

e.en: The ornament had a {bulblike} shape.
e.zh: 这个装饰品形状像灯泡。

e.en: She noticed the {bulblike} swelling on the stem.
e.zh: 她注意到茎上球茎状的膨大。

e.en: Researchers studied the {bulbonuclear} pathways in the brainstem.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了脑干中的延髓核通路。

e.en: The {bulbonuclear} fibers connect important regions.
e.zh: 延髓核纤维连接着重要的区域。

e.en: A tiny {bulbule} formed at the base of the plant.
e.zh: 植物基部形成了一个小鳞茎。

e.en: Each {bulbule} will eventually develop roots.
e.zh: 每个小鳞茎最终都会长出根。

e.en: The {bulginess} of the bag made it hard to close.
e.zh: 袋子鼓鼓囊囊使它很难关上。

e.en: He noticed the slight {bulginess} of his pocket.
e.zh: 他注意到口袋微微鼓起。

bulgogi.t: 韩式烤肉；韩国铜盘烤肉

e.en: We ordered {bulgogi} at the Korean restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在韩国餐厅点了韩式烤肉。

e.en: She marinated the beef to make {bulgogi}.
e.zh: 她腌制牛肉来做韩式烤肉。

e.en: He stuffed his {bulgy} wallet into his pocket.
e.zh: 他把鼓鼓的钱包塞进口袋。

e.en: The cat's {bulgy} eyes followed every movement.
e.zh: 猫凸出的眼睛追随每一个动作。

e.en: She was diagnosed with {bulimarexia} last year.
e.zh: 她去年被诊断患有暴食厌食混合症。

e.en: Doctors are studying treatments for {bulimarexia}.
e.zh: 医生正在研究暴食厌食症的疗法。

e.en: The coat fitted him {bulkily} around the shoulders.
e.zh: 外套在他肩膀上显得臃肿。

e.en: She walked {bulkily} across the room.
e.zh: 她笨重地走过房间。

e.en: The farmer raised the {bull-calf} for breeding.
e.zh: 农夫养这只小公牛用来配种。

e.en: A young {bull-calf} stood beside its mother.
e.zh: 一头年幼的小公牛站在母亲身旁。

e.en: We watched a {bull-fight} in Madrid last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在马德里看了一场斗牛。

e.en: The {bull-fight} drew thousands of spectators.
e.zh: 斗牛比赛吸引了数千名观众。

e.en: The {bull-fighter} bowed to the cheering crowd.
e.zh: 斗牛士向欢呼的人群鞠躬。

e.en: He trained for years to become a {bull-fighter}.
e.zh: 他训练多年才成为斗牛士。

e.en: Don't be so {bull-headed} about your decision.
e.zh: 别对你的决定那么固执。

e.en: Her {bull-headed} attitude annoyed everyone.
e.zh: 她固执的态度让大家恼火。

e.en: The {bull-puncher} drove the cattle across the plain.
e.zh: 赶牛人把牛群赶过平原。

e.en: He worked as a {bull-puncher} on the ranch.
e.zh: 他在牧场当赶牛人。

e.en: The {bull-roarer} produced a deep humming sound.
e.zh: 牛吼器发出低沉的嗡鸣声。

e.en: Aboriginal ceremonies often used a {bull-roarer}.
e.zh: 原住民仪式常使用牛吼器。

e.en: Stop talking {bull-shit} and tell me the truth.
e.zh: 别胡扯，告诉我真相。

e.en: He thought the entire story was {bull-shit}.
e.zh: 他觉得整个故事都是胡扯。

e.en: The hedge was full of {bullace} fruit in autumn.
e.zh: 秋天篱笆上结满了野李。

e.en: She picked some {bullace} to make jam.
e.zh: 她摘了些野李子做果酱。

e.en: Wild {bullaces} ripen in late autumn.
e.zh: 野李子在深秋成熟。

e.en: Birds love eating the small {bullaces}.
e.zh: 鸟儿喜欢吃这些小野李。

e.en: The patient developed several {bullae} on his skin.
e.zh: 病人皮肤上出现几个大水疱。

e.en: Doctors examined the painful {bullae} carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了疼痛的大疱。

bullate.t: 起泡的；表面有疱状突起的

e.en: The leaves had a {bullate} surface with raised areas.
e.zh: 叶片表面起泡，有隆起的区域。

e.en: Botanists described the plant as {bullate}.
e.zh: 植物学家形容这种植物表面起泡。

bullbaiting.t: 纵犬咬牛（古代血腥娱乐）

e.en: {Bullbaiting} was once a popular blood sport.
e.zh: 纵犬咬牛曾是一种流行的血腥运动。

e.en: The town finally banned {bullbaiting} in the 19th century.
e.zh: 小镇在19世纪终于禁止了纵犬咬牛。

e.en: A {bullbat} swooped through the dusk sky.
e.zh: 一只夜鹰掠过黄昏的天空。

e.en: Locals call the nighthawk a {bullbat}.
e.zh: 当地人把夜鹰叫作 bullbat。

bullboat.t: 圆形皮筏（北美原住民用）

e.en: Native trappers crossed the river in a {bullboat}.
e.zh: 土著猎人乘圆形皮筏渡河。

e.en: The {bullboat} was made of buffalo hide.
e.zh: 这种圆筏是用水牛皮做的。

e.en: Thorns of the {bullbrier} caught his sleeve.
e.zh: 刺菝葜的刺勾住了他的袖子。

e.en: {Bullbrier} vines covered the old fence.
e.zh: 刺菝葜的藤蔓覆盖了旧栅栏。

e.en: The new {bullcalf} stayed close to its mother.
e.zh: 新生的小公牛紧靠在母亲身边。

e.en: He bought a healthy {bullcalf} at the market.
e.zh: 他在市场上买了一只健康的小公牛。

bulldagger.t: 男性化女同性恋者（俚语，含贬义）

e.en: The slang term {bulldagger} is offensive to many.
e.zh: 「bulldagger」这种俚语让许多人觉得冒犯。

e.en: She objected to being called a {bulldagger}.
e.zh: 她反对被叫作 bulldagger。

bulldike.t: 男性化女同性恋者（俚语，含贬义）

e.en: The word {bulldike} is now considered offensive slang.
e.zh: 「bulldike」一词现在被视为冒犯性俚语。

e.en: Older texts sometimes used {bulldike} pejoratively.
e.zh: 旧文本有时贬义地使用 bulldike 一词。

e.en: Her father is a successful {business-man}.
e.zh: 她父亲是个成功的商人。

e.en: The {business-man} flew to Tokyo for a meeting.
e.zh: 那位商人飞去东京开会。

business-savvy.t: 精通商业的；有商业头脑的

e.en: She is young but very {business-savvy}.
e.zh: 她虽年轻，却很有商业头脑。

e.en: The startup needs more {business-savvy} leaders.
e.zh: 这家初创公司需要更多有商业头脑的领导者。

e.en: His emails are full of empty {business-speak}.
e.zh: 他的邮件满是空洞的商业行话。

e.en: Try to avoid {business-speak} when talking to customers.
e.zh: 和客户交谈时尽量避免商业套话。

buskin.t: 古希腊罗马演员所穿的高底靴；悲剧

e.en: The actor wore a leather {buskin} on stage.
e.zh: 演员在台上穿着皮制高底靴。

e.en: The {buskin} symbolized classical tragedy.
e.zh: 高底靴象征着古典悲剧。

buskined.t: 穿高底靴的；悲剧风格的

e.en: A {buskined} actor strode across the ancient stage.
e.zh: 一位穿高底靴的演员大步走过古老的舞台。

e.en: His {buskined} delivery felt overly grand.
e.zh: 他那悲剧式的台词念得过于夸张。

e.en: They had a huge {bust-up} after the party.
e.zh: 派对结束后他们大吵了一架。

e.en: The band's {bust-up} shocked their fans.
e.zh: 乐队的解散让粉丝们震惊。

bust-ups.t: 激烈争吵；关系破裂（复数）

e.en: Their marriage survived several public {bust-ups}.
e.zh: 他们的婚姻经历了几次公开争吵后仍然维持着。

e.en: The team has had too many {bust-ups} this season.
e.zh: 球队这赛季内讧太多。

e.en: She was voted the {bustiest} actress of the decade.
e.zh: 她被评为这十年间胸部最丰满的女演员。

e.en: The magazine ranked the {bustiest} celebrities.
e.zh: 杂志列出了胸部最丰满的名人排行榜。

busway.t: 公交专用道；快速公交车道

e.en: The new {busway} cut commute times in half.
e.zh: 新建的公交专用道让通勤时间缩短了一半。

e.en: Cars are not allowed on the {busway}.
e.zh: 小汽车不得驶入公交专用道。

e.en: My {busybodied} aunt knows everyone's secrets.
e.zh: 我那爱管闲事的姨妈知道所有人的秘密。

e.en: Don't be so {busybodied} about your neighbors.
e.zh: 别这么爱打听邻居的事。

e.en: {Butanoic} acid gives rancid butter its smell.
e.zh: 丁酸赋予了变质黄油那种气味。

e.en: Chemists studied the {butanoic} compound's properties.
e.zh: 化学家研究了这种丁酸化合物的性质。

e.en: {Butanol} can be used as an industrial solvent.
e.zh: 丁醇可用作工业溶剂。

e.en: Researchers produced {butanol} from corn waste.
e.zh: 研究人员用玉米废料生产丁醇。

e.en: {Butanone} is commonly used in paint thinners.
e.zh: 丁酮常用于油漆稀释剂中。

e.en: The lab smelled strongly of {butanone}.
e.zh: 实验室里弥漫着浓烈的丁酮气味。

butcher-block.t: 砧板拼接式（厨房台面、家具）

e.en: We installed a {butcher-block} countertop in the kitchen.
e.zh: 我们在厨房装了砧板拼接式台面。

e.en: The {butcher-block} table looks rustic and warm.
e.zh: 那张砧板拼接式桌子显得朴素而温馨。

e.en: A {butcherbird} sang from the eucalyptus tree.
e.zh: 一只钟鹊在桉树上鸣叫。

e.en: The {butcherbird} impales prey on sharp thorns.
e.zh: 伯劳鸟会把猎物刺在尖刺上。

e.en: Critics condemned the war's sheer {butcherliness}.
e.zh: 评论家谴责这场战争的残忍嗜血。

e.en: His {butcherliness} on the battlefield horrified everyone.
e.zh: 他在战场上的残暴让所有人胆寒。

e.en: {Butene} is used to produce synthetic rubber.
e.zh: 丁烯用于生产合成橡胶。

e.en: The plant cracks naphtha to make {butene}.
e.zh: 该工厂裂解石脑油以生产丁烯。

e.en: He was offered the {butlership} of the manor.
e.zh: 他获邀担任庄园的管家一职。

e.en: The {butlership} had been in his family for generations.
e.zh: 管家一职在他家世代相传。

e.en: Wine was stored in the castle's {butlery}.
e.zh: 葡萄酒存放在城堡的备餐间里。

e.en: She polished the silver in the {butlery}.
e.zh: 她在管家室里擦拭银器。

bump-and-run.t: 短传冲撞战术；近距离贴防

e.en: The cornerback used a {bump-and-run} on the receiver.
e.zh: 角卫对外接手采用了贴身贴防战术。

e.en: Defenses often rely on {bump-and-run} coverage.
e.zh: 防守组经常采用近距离贴身防守。

e.en: Traffic was {bumper-to-bumper} all morning.
e.zh: 整个早上车流都首尾相接。

e.en: We sat in {bumper-to-bumper} traffic for hours.
e.zh: 我们在拥堵的车流中坐了好几个小时。

bumpety.t: 颠簸作响地；磕磕碰碰地

e.en: The cart went {bumpety} down the hill.
e.zh: 小车颠簸作响地滚下山坡。

e.en: We rode {bumpety} over the cobblestones.
e.zh: 我们颠簸地驶过鹅卵石路。

e.en: The truck rolled {bumpily} across the field.
e.zh: 卡车颠簸地驶过田野。

e.en: Their relationship moved {bumpily} forward.
e.zh: 他们的关系跌跌撞撞地向前发展。

e.en: The {bumpiness} of the road made me nauseous.
e.zh: 路面的颠簸让我感到恶心。

e.en: Some {bumpiness} during landing is normal.
e.zh: 着陆时有些颠簸是正常的。

bumpity.t: 颠簸碰撞地；磕磕碰碰地

e.en: The wagon went {bumpity} along the track.
e.zh: 马车沿着小路颠簸前行。

e.en: Down the stairs the ball went {bumpity}.
e.zh: 球磕磕碰碰地滚下楼梯。

bumpkinish.t: 乡下人似的；土里土气的

e.en: His {bumpkinish} accent gave him away.
e.zh: 他土气的口音暴露了他。

e.en: She found his manners rather {bumpkinish}.
e.zh: 她觉得他的举止颇为乡气。

e.en: He was loud and {bumptions} at the meeting.
e.zh: 他在会上又吵闹又自大。

e.en: Her {bumptions} attitude irritated everyone.
e.zh: 她那骄傲自大的态度惹恼了所有人。

e.en: The {bunchbacked} old man shuffled by.
e.zh: 驼背的老人慢吞吞地走过。

e.en: He played a {bunchbacked} villain on stage.
e.zh: 他在舞台上扮演了一个驼背反派。

bunchberry.t: 草茱萸（一种林下小植物）

e.en: We spotted {bunchberry} along the trail.
e.zh: 我们在小路边发现了草茱萸。

e.en: {Bunchberry} blooms in early summer.
e.zh: 草茱萸在初夏开花。

e.en: The {bunchflower} grows in wet meadows.
e.zh: 簇花藜芦生长在湿润的草甸上。

e.en: We pressed a {bunchflower} into the book.
e.zh: 我们把一朵簇花夹进了书里。

e.en: Cattle grazed on the {bunchgrass} prairie.
e.zh: 牛群在丛生禾草的草原上吃草。

e.en: {Bunchgrass} thrives in arid climates.
e.zh: 丛生禾草在干旱气候下繁盛生长。

e.en: The fabric hung {bunchily} at the waist.
e.zh: 布料在腰部成簇地堆垂下来。

e.en: Grapes grew {bunchily} along the vine.
e.zh: 葡萄成串聚集地长在藤上。

e.en: I disliked the {bunchiness} of the curtains.
e.zh: 我不喜欢窗帘那种皱成一团的样子。

e.en: The {bunchiness} of his sweater bothered him.
e.zh: 毛衣堆成一团让他很别扭。

bunchy.t: 成簇的；成束的；皱成一团的

e.en: Her hair looked {bunchy} after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后她的头发缠成了一团。

e.en: These flowers grow in {bunchy} clusters.
e.zh: 这些花成簇地丛生。

e.en: His speech was pure {buncombe}.
e.zh: 他的演讲纯粹是胡说八道。

e.en: Voters dismissed it as political {buncombe}.
e.zh: 选民们把它当作政治空话不予理会。

bundist.t: 崩得分子（犹太工人联盟成员）

e.en: The {bundist} movement was strong in Poland.
e.zh: 崩得运动在波兰势力很强。

e.en: Her grandfather was a committed {bundist}.
e.zh: 她祖父是一名坚定的崩得分子。

bundled-up.t: 裹得严严实实的；穿得厚厚的

e.en: The kids were {bundled-up} against the cold.
e.zh: 孩子们裹得严严实实以抵御寒冷。

e.en: She came in {bundled-up} from the snow.
e.zh: 她从雪地里裹得厚厚地走了进来。

bunfight.t: 喧闹的茶会；吵闹的社交聚会

e.en: The reception was a real {bunfight}.
e.zh: 那场招待会真是闹哄哄的。

e.en: We attended a charity {bunfight} last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我们参加了一个慈善聚会。

bunfights.t: 喧闹的茶会；吵闹聚会（复数）

e.en: The college held weekly {bunfights}.
e.zh: 学院每周举办喧闹的聚会。

e.en: These fundraising {bunfights} bore me.
e.zh: 这些募捐茶会让我厌倦。

bungallow.t: 平房；单层小屋（bungalow的变体拼写）

e.en: They bought a small {bungallow} by the sea.
e.zh: 他们在海边买了一栋小平房。

e.en: The {bungallow} had a wide front porch.
e.zh: 那栋平房有宽敞的前廊。

bungaloid.t: 平房式的；像平房一样杂乱蔓延的

e.en: The suburb was a {bungaloid} sprawl.
e.zh: 那郊区是一片平房式的杂乱蔓延。

e.en: Critics mocked the {bungaloid} architecture.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑那种平房式建筑风格。

bungarotoxin.t: 银环蛇毒素；阿尔法银环蛇毒素

e.en: Researchers use {bungarotoxin} to study receptors.
e.zh: 研究人员使用银环蛇毒素来研究受体。

e.en: {Bungarotoxin} blocks neuromuscular signals.
e.zh: 银环蛇毒素阻断神经肌肉信号。

bungie.t: 蹦极绳；橡皮拉绳（bungee的变体）

e.en: He strapped his bag down with a {bungie}.
e.zh: 他用一根橡皮拉绳把包绑住。

e.en: We hooked the tarp on with {bungie} cords.
e.zh: 我们用拉绳把防水布固定住。

e.en: The crate was a {bunglesome} thing to carry.
e.zh: 那只箱子搬起来很笨拙。

e.en: His {bunglesome} attempt at repair failed.
e.zh: 他笨拙的修理尝试以失败告终。

e.en: They paddled the {bungo} upstream.
e.zh: 他们划着平底小舟逆流而上。

e.en: A wooden {bungo} ferried goods across the river.
e.zh: 一条木制小船将货物运过河去。

bunkerage.t: 船用燃料费；储煤舱位费

e.en: The company paid the {bunkerage} at the port.
e.zh: 公司支付了港口的船用燃料费。

e.en: {Bunkerage} costs rose with fuel prices.
e.zh: 船用燃料费随油价上涨。

e.en: His old army {bunkie} called him.
e.zh: 他从前军中的同铺战友给他打了电话。

e.en: We slept in a tiny {bunkie} by the lake.
e.zh: 我们睡在湖边一间小木屋里。

e.en: He was arrested for running a {bunko} scheme.
e.zh: 他因经营骗局而被捕。

e.en: The {bunko} squad investigated the swindle.
e.zh: 反诈小组调查了这桩骗局。

e.en: He learned to {bunny-hop} on his bike.
e.zh: 他学会了用自行车做兔跳动作。

e.en: The kids did the {bunny-hop} dance.
e.zh: 孩子们跳起了兔跳舞。

bunodonts.t: 丘齿类动物（牙齿表面有圆形结节）

e.en: Pigs and humans are {bunodonts}.
e.zh: 猪和人都属于丘齿类动物。

e.en: {Bunodonts} have low-crowned, rounded teeth.
e.zh: 丘齿类动物的牙齿矮冠且圆润。

buntal.t: 棕榈纤维；棕榈编织草帽

e.en: She wore a wide {buntal} hat to the beach.
e.zh: 她戴了一顶宽大的棕榈草帽去海滩。

e.en: {Buntal} fibers come from palm stems.
e.zh: 棕榈纤维取自棕榈茎部。

buntline.t: 卷帆索；用于缩帆的绳索

e.en: The sailor tugged on the {buntline}.
e.zh: 水手拉动了卷帆索。

e.en: A loose {buntline} flapped in the wind.
e.zh: 一条松开的卷帆索在风中拍打。

buntons.t: 矿井支撑梁；井筒导轨横梁

e.en: The {buntons} held the mine shaft secure.
e.zh: 支撑梁让矿井保持牢固。

e.en: Steel {buntons} replaced the wooden ones.
e.zh: 钢制横梁取代了原来的木制横梁。

e.en: We camped beneath a giant {bunya} tree.
e.zh: 我们在一棵巨大的大叶南洋杉下露营。

e.en: {Bunya} nuts are a traditional Aboriginal food.
e.zh: 大叶南洋杉的果实是原住民的传统食物。

bunyip.t: 班伊普（澳洲传说中的沼泽怪兽）

e.en: Children feared the {bunyip} in the swamp.
e.zh: 孩子们害怕沼泽里的班伊普怪兽。

e.en: The {bunyip} is part of Aboriginal folklore.
e.zh: 班伊普是原住民民间传说的一部分。

e.en: She works out to keep her {bunz} firm.
e.zh: 她坚持锻炼让臀部紧实。

e.en: Those new jeans really show off her {bunz}.
e.zh: 那条新牛仔裤把她的臀部曲线衬托得很好看。

e.en: He gripped the rifle by the {butt-end}.
e.zh: 他握住步枪的枪托端。

e.en: The {butt-end} of the log was charred.
e.zh: 原木的粗端被烧焦了。

e.en: The pipes were joined with a {butt-weld}.
e.zh: 这些管子是用对接焊连接的。

e.en: A clean {butt-weld} requires careful alignment.
e.zh: 干净的对接焊接需要精确对位。

e.en: {Butter-and-eggs} bloomed along the roadside.
e.zh: 柳穿鱼沿着路边盛开。

e.en: She picked some {butter-and-eggs} for the vase.
e.zh: 她摘了一些柳穿鱼插进花瓶里。

e.en: She frosted the cake with {butter-cream}.
e.zh: 她在蛋糕上抹了奶油糖霜。

e.en: The {butter-cream} filling was rich and sweet.
e.zh: 这奶油糖霜馅料浓郁又香甜。

e.en: Grandma stewed {butterbeans} with ham.
e.zh: 奶奶用火腿炖了皇帝豆。

e.en: The salad had corn and {butterbeans}.
e.zh: 沙拉里有玉米和皇帝豆。

e.en: {Butterbur} grows along the damp stream.
e.zh: 款冬生长在潮湿的溪边。

e.en: Some people take {butterbur} for migraines.
e.zh: 有些人服用款冬来缓解偏头痛。

e.en: The cake was covered in vanilla {buttercream}.
e.zh: 蛋糕上裹着香草奶油糖霜。

e.en: She piped {buttercream} roses on the cupcakes.
e.zh: 她在纸杯蛋糕上挤出奶油糖霜玫瑰。

e.en: Don't be so {butterfingered} with the dishes!
e.zh: 端盘子别那么笨手笨脚！

e.en: He felt {butterfingered} after dropping the vase.
e.zh: 摔了花瓶后他觉得自己笨手笨脚的。

butterfingers.t: 笨手笨脚的人；爱失手的人

e.en: You {butterfingers}, that's the third glass!
e.zh: 你这笨手笨脚的家伙，这都第三个杯子了！

e.en: The team's goalie was a real {butterfingers}.
e.zh: 队里的守门员真是个笨手笨脚的人。

e.en: {Butterwort} traps insects on its sticky leaves.
e.zh: 捕虫堇用黏黏的叶子捕捉昆虫。

e.en: We found {butterwort} in the bog.
e.zh: 我们在沼泽里发现了捕虫堇。

e.en: Stop being such a {butthole} to your sister.
e.zh: 别再对你妹妹这么混蛋了。

e.en: That driver was a total {butthole}.
e.zh: 那个司机就是个十足的混蛋。

e.en: Don't be such a {buttinski} at meetings.
e.zh: 开会时别这么爱多管闲事。

e.en: Our neighbor is a known {buttinski}.
e.zh: 我们的邻居是出了名的爱管闲事。

e.en: He's a {buttinsky} who interrupts every conversation.
e.zh: 他是个爱插嘴打断每段对话的多事鬼。

e.en: Quit being a {buttinsky} and mind your own business.
e.zh: 别再多管闲事，管好你自己的事吧。

e.en: He {buttled} for the duke for years.
e.zh: 他给公爵当了多年的管家。

e.en: She offered to {buttle} at the dinner party.
e.zh: 她主动提议在晚宴上充当管家。

e.en: He wore a crisp {button-down} shirt.
e.zh: 他穿着一件笔挺的纽扣领衬衫。

e.en: The firm has a {button-down} corporate culture.
e.zh: 这家公司有保守传统的企业文化。

e.en: {Buttonbush} attracts bees with its round flowers.
e.zh: 风箱树用圆球状的花朵吸引蜜蜂。

e.en: We planted {buttonbush} by the pond.
e.zh: 我们在池塘边种了风箱树。

buttoned-down.t: 保守传统的；中规中矩的

e.en: He has a {buttoned-down} management style.
e.zh: 他的管理风格很保守传统。

e.en: The bank's {buttoned-down} image reassures clients.
e.zh: 这家银行中规中矩的形象让客户感到放心。

buttoned-up.t: 拘谨的；不善言辞的；井井有条的

e.en: He's too {buttoned-up} to share feelings.
e.zh: 他太拘谨了，不愿分享感受。

e.en: Their finances are completely {buttoned-up}.
e.zh: 他们的财务管理得井井有条。

e.en: She used a {buttonhook} on her boots.
e.zh: 她用钩扣器扣靴子上的纽扣。

e.en: The antique {buttonhook} had an ivory handle.
e.zh: 这件古董钩扣器有个象牙手柄。

e.en: She prefers {buttonless} pullovers in winter.
e.zh: 她冬天喜欢穿无纽扣的套头衫。

e.en: The {buttonless} jacket fastened with a zipper.
e.zh: 这件无纽扣外套用拉链扣合。

e.en: The flower had small {buttonlike} blossoms.
e.zh: 这种花开着小小的纽扣状花朵。

e.en: Her eyes were {buttonlike} and shiny.
e.zh: 她的眼睛圆得像纽扣一样亮闪闪的。

e.en: The doll had {buttony} black eyes.
e.zh: 这个娃娃有一双像纽扣似的黑眼睛。

e.en: She wore a {buttony} vintage jacket.
e.zh: 她穿着一件缀满纽扣的复古外套。

e.en: The rifle's {buttplate} was made of brass.
e.zh: 这把步枪的枪托底板是黄铜做的。

e.en: He replaced the worn rubber {buttplate}.
e.zh: 他换掉了磨损的橡胶枪托底板。

e.en: The shotgun had a wooden {buttstock}.
e.zh: 这把猎枪有个木制的枪托。

e.en: He adjusted the {buttstock} to fit his shoulder.
e.zh: 他调整了枪托以贴合他的肩膀。

e.en: They used a {buttweld} to join the pipes.
e.zh: 他们用对接焊把管子连接起来。

e.en: The {buttweld} held up under pressure tests.
e.zh: 对接焊在压力测试中表现良好。

e.en: The old mill ground its grain with a {burstone}.
e.zh: 那座老磨坊用磨石碾磨谷物。

e.en: Quarrymen valued {burstone} for its hardness.
e.zh: 采石工看重磨石的坚硬。

e.en: This pipeline is {burstproof} under high pressure.
e.zh: 这条管道在高压下不会爆裂。

e.en: They marketed a {burstproof} water balloon for kids.
e.zh: 他们推销一种儿童用防爆水球。

e.en: Network traffic tends to be {bursty} at peak hours.
e.zh: 网络流量在高峰时段往往是突发性的。

e.en: He speaks in a {bursty} rhythm when excited.
e.zh: 他兴奋时说话节奏一阵一阵的。

e.en: The old sailor carried a heavy {burthen} on his back.
e.zh: 那位老水手背着沉重的负担。

e.en: The poem speaks of life's eternal {burthen}.
e.zh: 这首诗讲述生命永恒的重担。

e.en: He felt deeply {burthened} by his many duties.
e.zh: 他被诸多职责压得心力交瘁。

e.en: Her heart was {burthened} with quiet sorrow.
e.zh: 她的心头压着无声的忧伤。

burthening.t: 使负担；增加重负（古英语）

e.en: Stop {burthening} him with so many extra tasks.
e.zh: 别再给他加这么多额外的负担了。

e.en: The new tax is {burthening} small farmers.
e.zh: 新税正给小农户增加重负。

e.en: Life's {burthens} grow lighter when shared with friends.
e.zh: 生活的重担与友人分担便轻了几分。

e.en: He bore his {burthens} without a single complaint.
e.zh: 他承担重负却从无怨言。

e.en: The pasture was overrun with prickly {burweed}.
e.zh: 牧场上长满了带刺的苍耳。

e.en: Sheep wool got tangled in the {burweed}.
e.zh: 羊毛被苍耳缠住了。

e.en: The friendly {bus-driver} waved as we got on.
e.zh: 热情的公交司机在我们上车时挥了挥手。

e.en: Our {bus-driver} stops at this corner every morning.
e.zh: 我们的公交司机每天早上都在这个路口停车。

e.en: I forgot to bring my {bus-fare} this morning.
e.zh: 我今天早上忘了带公交车费。

e.en: The {bus-fare} went up by fifty cents.
e.zh: 公交车费涨了五毛钱。

e.en: We waited under the {bus-shelter} during the heavy rain.
e.zh: 大雨中我们在公交候车亭里等车。

e.en: Someone had spray-painted the new {bus-shelter}.
e.zh: 有人在新的候车亭上涂了鸦。

e.en: Meet me at the {bus-station} at noon.
e.zh: 中午在公交总站等我。

e.en: The {bus-station} was crowded with weekend travelers.
e.zh: 公交总站挤满了周末出行的旅客。

e.en: There is a {bus-stop} just outside our school.
e.zh: 我们学校门口就有一个公交车站。

e.en: I missed the bus and waited at the {bus-stop}.
e.zh: 我错过了车,只能在车站继续等。

e.en: Electricity flows through the thick copper {busbar}.
e.zh: 电流通过粗铜汇流排传输。

e.en: Engineers inspected the substation's main {busbar}.
e.zh: 工程师检查了变电站的主母线。

e.en: He wore a faded {bush-hat} on the safari.
e.zh: 他戴着一顶褪色的丛林帽去野外旅行。

e.en: Soldiers in the jungle often preferred a {bush-hat}.
e.zh: 丛林作战的士兵常爱戴丛林帽。

e.en: Their marketing tactics were embarrassingly {bush-league}.
e.zh: 他们的营销手法业余得令人尴尬。

e.en: I won't put up with such {bush-league} behavior.
e.zh: 我可不容忍这种不入流的做法。

e.en: A tiny {bushbaby} stared at us from the branch.
e.zh: 一只小婴猴从枝头盯着我们看。

e.en: Tourists hoped to spot a {bushbaby} after dark.
e.zh: 游客希望天黑后能看到一只婴猴。

e.en: A startled {bushbuck} bounded into the thicket.
e.zh: 一只受惊的薮羚跳进了灌木丛。

e.en: The hunters tracked a {bushbuck} through dense forest.
e.zh: 猎人在密林中追踪一只薮羚。
